articleTitle: Design of Collaborative Innovation Platform of Industrial Clusters in Guangdong Province Based on OGSA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Collaborative innovation is a source of maintaining the core competitiveness and sustainable development of the industrial clusters. It includes the collaborative innovation between different industrial clusters as well as enterprises within the industry cluster. Based on the analysis of existing innovation service platforms in Guangdong and the need for collaborative innovation between the platforms, this paper proposes a collaborative innovation platform of industrial clusters in Guangdong based on OGSA (Open Grid Service Architecture) and its network topology. Then, the paper focused on the composition and advantages of that platform.

articleTitle: Decision of Merchant Transmission Investment Under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of the merchant transmission investment, regulation policy has brought uncertainty to the realization of financial transmission right. Investors should consider the uncertainty brought about by the electricity market when they make decision. These uncertainties will lead to a wide range of risks. The paper will discuss varieties of risk factors under uncertainty which merchant transmission investors are facing. Risk decision model and specific methods to quantify and avoid risk are provided to help the investors make decision.

articleTitle: Option Pricing in Jump-Diffusion Models with Stochastic Volatility
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many underlying assets of option contracts exhibit both jump-diffusion process and stochastic volatility. This paper investigates the valuation of options when the underlying asset follows a jump-diffusion process with stochastic volatility ,which correlated asset return process. A closed form solution is derived for European options through the use of characteristic function and the Fourier transform. The proposed model allows the option pricing formula to capture the market implied volatility smile within a unified framework.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussion on the Environmental Problems Caused by Coal Mining - Taking Inner Mongolia for an Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Assessing the Benefits of Reforestation Placements in Soil Erosion Using a Spatial Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A spatial soil erosion model is developed to assess the benefits of reforestation placements in soil erosion. In the model, connections among the cells are set up by runoff, we suppose that the total soil erosion in each cell is determined by two main parts, the soil loss calculated by USLE model and the sediment yield delivered from the upland. The results show that the most effective reforestation placement is not always the area with the highest slope as we usually think, and the efficiency of reforestation placement depends on whether spatial interaction is considered or not.

articleTitle: The Revolution of Government Management Mode: An Analysis and Countermeasure Study on Issues Existing in On-Line Administrative Examination and Approval
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the Chinese governments throughout the country are going all out to push the on-line examination and approval to strive for a higher administrative efficiency. However, the on-line administrative examination and approval is as a matter of fact a reform of the traditional examination and approval mode and issues such as understanding, law, technology and application exist in it. Analysis is conducted with regard to those issues and corresponding solutions are proposed based on it.

articleTitle: Generating the Semantic Containers for the Query Interfaces of Deep Web
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the myriad emergence of the online Web Database, the Web is divided into a two layers information platform which is composed of surface Web and deep Web. The huge information hidden in the deep Web is higher in the quality than the surface Web. This interests the researchers of the traditional database community. In order to adapt the Web community, the idea of information fusion is further transformed. However, the nature of the Web is great different from the database in structure, principle and function. Query reformulation is one of the technical challenges. The only accessible method to get the information in the deep Web is through the query interfaces provided by the Website of deep Web. There are many semantic restrictions between the attributes in the query interface. Some attributes are co-occurred and the others are exclusive sometimes. To generate a valid query, we have to reconcile the key attributes and their semantic relations. To address the problem, a method based on the HTML codes is presented in this paper. Different kinds of semantic containers can be got through analyzing the codes of the query interface. The experiment is carried out on the famous dataset of deep Web to show the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors of IT Investment Attitude: An Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the influence of IS maturity, top managers' knowledge of IT, and top managers' risk perception on organizational IT investment attitude. We collected data of 147 Chinese organizations, including firms and government departments. Results indicate that, top managers' knowledge of IT and top managers' risk perception have significantly positive influences on IT investment attitude. But the influence of IS maturity on IT investment attitude is insignificant. These results will be useful for researchers and practitioners to better understand IT investment decision.

articleTitle: A Thinking about Creative Imitation: Japan's Case and Inspiration for China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The theory of creative imitation and the rapid development of Japan's economy after the second world war show that it is a wise choice for Chinese enterprises to adopt the strategy of creative imitation. The enterprises should take advantage of their familiarity with the domestic market, select an appropriate object to imitate when implementing the strategy of creative imitation so that they can finally occupy the market by upgrading their capacity with unremitting efforts and striving to form a cost advantage.

articleTitle: Mutation Analysis about Construction Project Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In life-cycle of construction project, there have been structure and responsibilities and information mutation in construction project organization at least. According to the dissipative and mutation character of construction project organization, the quantitative and qualitative of the construction project organization should be analyzed comprehensively by use of dissipation theory and mutation theory. The cusp mutation model of construction project organization is made up through using cusp mutation model, and the critical point of the construction project organization has been analyzed. The causes of mutation is analyzed and preventive measures is put forward by combining project cases.

articleTitle: Application of Diffusion Theory in the Development of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper demonstrates the diffusion process of e-commerce with BASS innovation diffusion model. It estimates the parameters of the model and establishes the online consumer diffusion model and predicts the cumulative number of online consumers in the next few years based on the statistic data of online buyers. At the same time, it also analyzes all the factors affecting the increase of online buyers and verifies the result of the prediction from the model. Finally, the paper discusses the model with the results.

articleTitle: Two-Way Capital Flows Model Based on Multi-Market Arbitrage: Empirical Analysis on Short-Term Capital Flows in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As small-country two-asset model, the portfolio balance theory could not explain why the low interest rate policy in China could not avoid speculative foreign capital influx, but stimulates greater bubble in financial market. This paper proposes a two-way capital flow model based on multiple-assets arbitrage, where bilateral capital flow between two countries depends on investors' portfolio adjustment among bonds, stocks, real estate and the foreign exchange market in both countries. Empirical analysis shows that net international capital flow from 1990 to 2006 in China is positively correlated with the interest rate and rate of return of stock market in China and exchange rate of RMB against USD, negatively correlated with that in USA. This paper suggests that exchange rate and interest rate marketization will be effective in keeping the independence of domestic monetary policy under speculative capital flows.

articleTitle: Effect of IT Capability on IT Project Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on individual interview and questionnaire survey, this paper constructs a model of the impacts of IT capability on the risk of project implementation, and makes three hypotheses which been tested by structural equation model. Finally we find that the risk of IT project implementation would be reduced by improving the IT capability of staff of customer enterprise, but the influence of IT infrastructure and the level of IT application haven't been verified.

articleTitle: Research on the Relation between Coal Mine Safe Production and Economic Level of Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The disparities among our country mortality rates per million tons in coal mine and other main mining countries is great, so the coal mine safe production becomes the noticeable questions, which keeped an eye on by the community more and more. Same as other industry profession safety, the coal mine safety has close contact with national economic development in addition to the safety engineering technology itself. The paper applies the measurement economical modeling analysis method and establishes the measurement economical model, indicates the relations between the coal mine safe production and the economic development. The paper further points out improvement of the coal mine safety level through regulating major influencing factors of the model.

articleTitle: A Decision-Making Model of Budget Allocation for the Restoration of Traditional Settlement Buildings
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional settlement conservation is an important work for most global organizations due to its potential cultural, social, economic benefits. The government agencies around the world earmark financial resources for necessary maintenance, repairs and management. Still, budgetary limitations make it difficult to carry out comprehensive restorations of settlement buildings. In Taiwan, the existing methods for allocating cultural preservation subsidies are neither transparent nor systematic. This study employed a hybrid approach combining the Fuzzy TOPSIS with the 0-1 knapsack problem to support decision makers in determining the optimal subsidy decisions and relevant evaluation methods. According to the results of a pilot test, the proposed model is effective in selecting cases for restoration and also in allocating budget resources in an appropriate manner. Thus it remedies the shortcomings of existing appraisal methods and can also be effectively applied to similar cases in other countries.

articleTitle: Rectify the Valuation on the Customers Value - A Case Study of China First Automobile Group
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Stylized facts show us that a value chain has put corporations into a circumstance in which they cooperate and compete one another. Companies in a value chain should analyze the competition advantage in order to find the core resources and technology, to get the value increment. Under such background, the corporate value which means to maximize the stakeholders' interests should be leaded by the customers' value. Reviewed the literatures on customer value and corporate valuation, analyzed the differences among the valuation methods, and gave the reasons that this paper selected free cash flow method. This paper focused on stating the rectifying process of the corporate valuation result based on customer value. A case study on China First Automobile Group is given. As part of the case study, a set of customer satisfaction index is designed and used to do a survey through about 730 questionnaires. This paper analyzes the result in the end.

articleTitle: The Influence of IT Innovation on E-Business Models Evolution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the influence of IT innovation on e-business models, this paper analyzes the importance of IT as an enabler to the evolution of e-business models. In addition, a life cycle model of e-business evolution, which reveals the periodic effect of IT on e-business models evolution, is proposed, and some examples are analyzed.

articleTitle: Ordering Policy with Joint Adoption of Revenue Sharing and Advance Booking Discount Program
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study discusses the ordering problem in a supply chain with duopolistic suppliers and duopolistic retailers based on revenue sharing (RS) scheme and advance booking discount program. We obtain the optimal ordering quantities and advance booking discount (ABD) coefficients for the retailers.

articleTitle: Research of Famous-Brand Product's Vitality Based on Customer Elasticity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After developing an outer model of the famous-brand product vitality, this paper presents the concept and calculation formula of the famous-brand product vitality index, the concept of customer elasticity on the basis of Product Famous-brand Vitality Index. The paper also takes Haier's product as an example to calculate out its famous-brand vitality index, the customer elasticity index at customer's different age and income levels. Based on the analyses of the result, the paper gives some suggests for Haier Group.

articleTitle: Model of Production vs. Customer Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mass customization is a prevalent thought as an overwhelming competitive advantage. However serials of articles debated on competitive market show that the judgment may not be true. Those authors insist that enterprises would choose different production models in competitive market concerning about consumer interaction costs, transportation costs, and product attributes et al. But they do not take the complete customer's customization motivation into account while discussing with the choice of production models. This article firstly develops a model to join customer's customization motivation on enterprise's profit; then discusses the diversification of the profit under various markets; lastly propose some novel viewpoints about choosing production models under competitive circumstance.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study of Dynamic VaR on the Index of Shanghai Security Market Based GARCH-EVT
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper propose a method for estimating VaR and related risk measures describing the tail of the conditional distribution of a heteroscedastic financial return series. Our approach combines GARCH models to estimate the current volatility and extreme value theory for estimating the tail of the innovation distribution of the GARCH model. We use our method to estimate VaR and conditional expected shortfalls. Using backtesting of Shanghai stock market we find that there is serious ARCH effect on return rate of the stock market and GARCH-EVT model gives better estimates than GARCH-Normal and GARCH-t model.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Knowledge Reduction Based on the Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a practical method for knowledge reduction, discernible matrix (DM) has been widely used in practice. However, due to the high cost of constructing and reducing of a matrix, the efficiency of this method falls far short of people's demands. In order to decrease the cost of knowledge reduction based on the ideas of set theory, the paper presents a new approach, which is called the minimum discernible core set (MDCS). Beginning at the selection of an indiscernible attribute, other attributes are added one by one until obtaining a set, which can discern a knowledge system. The paper focuses on the related theories and algorithms of knowledge reduction. Algorithm 1 can get all the MDCS of a knowledge system, while Algorithm 2 that has lower time can get a MDCS of that by using heuristic search rules. Compared with time complexity and space complexity of DM, MDCS has less time and space according to our analysis for the algorithms of DM and MDCS.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Energy Demand Prediction of India Based on Relationship between Energy Consumption and Economy Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Assets and Capabilities of Business Model in Software Business
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we focus on the assets and capabilities of software companies from the perspectives of business models and value-creating networks. Prior to analyzing the key assets and capabilities in connection with diverse business models, we review the literature of related topics, including interorganizational exchange, strategic networks and capabilities. Then we present a classification scheme for distinguishing between different types of software business models. We classify software business models with two dimensions: the level of involvement in customer relationships and the level of homogeneity of offerings for multiple customers. In the empirical part of our research, we explore the key assets and capabilities, i.e. resources, in four different business model types. Finally, on the basis of our data, we identify acquisition and development of these resources either internally or externally through networks. Our aim is to study assets and capabilities in association with business models of software companies in order to understand the development of resources in specific business contexts.

articleTitle: Measuring Index System and Method of Organizational Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational intelligence is an important index for evaluating the competitiveness of organizations which is not only the carrier of innovation ability, but also plays the great promotion role of organization's innovation ability. Departing from the development of organizational intelligence, the concept and characteristics of organizational intelligence are defined and analyzed, and the measuring index system of organizational intelligence is put forward that includes human resources, knowledge management, internal environment of organizations, resources operation, and external supporting factors. The measuring model of organizational intelligence is established on the basis of the entropy theory. All these can offer the references of decision-making for appraising and developing organizational intelligence.

articleTitle: Comprehensively Promote the Experimental Teaching Level of Economics and Management Specialty with the Application of Modern Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analysis the current condition of modern information technology that used in the field of economics and management experimental teaching, and points out its decisive role in economics and management talents training. We should maintain the interaction of experimental teaching and scientific research and constitute an innovative experimental platform for students with the application of modern information technology to comprehensively promote the economics and management experimental teaching effects.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Development, Problems and Countermeasures of Accounting Personnel Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of science and technology advances, business informationization impacts directly on accounting informationization. As new demands for accountants emerge under the new environment of accounting, current training for accounting personnel cannot meet the needs of enterprises any longer. Therefore, the educational institutions must be closely integrated with the needs of accounting informationization for the talented individuals and adjust education programs so as to cultivate the promotion of social progress, to meet the needs of complex accounting professionals. This article mainly expatiates the accounting information of the importance of education, describes China current situation of the accounting informationization education, analyzes of the problems in accounting education and professional training, and the corresponding solving strategy solution.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of Security Certificate Base on Grid-Computer
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science

publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science

articleTitle: Frame Design for Simulation Software for Financial Development Strategy-Oriented for Coal Enterprises: Taking Yanzhou Coal Mining Co., Ltd. as an Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's economic and institutional changes requires us to study and construct the enterprise's financial development strategy as soon as possible. Taking Yanzhou Coal Mining Co., Ltd. as an example,this article tries to construct a frame of simulation software for financial development strategy-oriented for coal enterprises,including software for evaluating financial indices, software for optimizing capital structure, software for steady growth in dividends, and software for supporting financial expansion,which may help to determine the long-term financial development strategy of the future, and to objectively provide reliable data evidence for business decision makers.

articleTitle: The Sustainable Development of Urban Environmental Management - The Reuse of Old Industrial Buildings Combined with Creative Industries in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the 20th century, more and more complex urban functions challenge the urban environment management. Based on the concept of sustainable development, the projects that reuse the old industrial buildings combined with the creative industries play a positive role in the urban environmental protection and promote the sustainable operation of the urban environmental management. From the case of 798 Art Zone, this article puts forward a new mode of the urban environmental management in China -the multi-network management mode of the sustainable development. In this way, the side-by-side work mode that divides the task into several stages and blocks should be changed into to the mesh model of the multi-member and multi-stage coordination. The power focus should be shifted gradually to the grass-roots communities. At the same time, the political game among the government, the non-governmental organizations, the civil groups, the developers and the market mechanisms should be introduced into urban planning, in order to cope with the ever-changing requirements, and to improve the efficiency of the urban environmental management.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Market Segmentation Based on Factor Clustering Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the application of the compound model of factor analysis and cluster analysis in the market segmentation of telecommunications services. Fourteen observed variables of consumers' attitudes to mobile communication company are represented by three public factors through factor analysis. Then according to different public factor scores, the samples are clustered to four segmentation markets by K-means cluster analysis. Four segmentations' respective market development proposals are put forward.

articleTitle: Stock Market Index Tracking
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper contributes to the literature in two ways. For academics, we present original discussions on combining an interdisciplinary mean variance model and a goal programming method. For practitioners, we present an original discussion on using a DSS to support index investing. The results of an empirical survey of the Taiwan stock market are also presented.

articleTitle: The Study of the New Mode of the Strategic Management Based on the Construction and the Evaluation of Value-Assisted Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the core value system of the corporation according to the systematic viewpoints, the paper puts forward the value-assisted system which has close ties with the core value system, particularly analyses the features and the content of the value-assisted system and the positive impact which the construction of value-assisted management system of the enterprise has on the enterprise as well; further combining with the realization flow of the core value of the enterprise, the paper puts forward the steps and the methods to build the value-assisted systems on the basis of the core value system, so that the construction of the value-assisted management system can be operational and practical for the enterprise; finally establishes the evaluation model of the value-assisted management system based on cost analysis of the core value and the support value, which can help the enterprise evaluate own self logically in the process of the value-assisted management in order to reform and realize the core value of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Structure of Regional Industrial Complex System and the Measurement on Orderly Degree of the System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional industrial system is a complex system, it has the characteristics of complex system, among which "emergency " is the most important, while whether the emergency emergerges or not depends on the self-organization degree of the system elements, therefore, in the paper, we first analyzed the structure of regional industrial complex system, knew about the composition of regional industrial system, and then we use "entropy" to measure the "orderly degree " (that is the self-organization degree) of the system. In the last part of the paper, we choose China's automobile industry to make an empirical analysis, from the result of the measurement, we can see it checked up with the developing practice of automobile industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Sustainable Environment Development and Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows Based on Minimal Cost for Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Evolutions and Value Analysis of "Hangzhou Mode" Operation Solution of Digital Television
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, overall transformation of digital television has already become an important task during the development of state digital television. Both the Government and digital TV operators pay special attention to maintaining a balanced development between ordinary public service and commercial paid service, and exploring a development path for digital television industry that adapts to Chinese circumstances, including the structure of property rights, industrial platform and operation mode. This paper bases on present industrial background of overall transformation of digital television, and regards "Hangzhou Mode" digital television as its sample, which is of great exploring significance. This article starts from industry road, operating system, industrial platform, technical platform and operation solution of digital TV, discusses the way to establish effective operation mode of digital TV, and thus provides some references for promoting industrialized and large-scale development of digital TV.

articleTitle: The Career Commitment of Contingent Workforce in Semiconductor Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The growth in the number of contingent employees is one of the most important developments in the labor market in recent years. Most studies focus on regular workers' commitment to the organization they belong. However, career commitment is the variable that describes one's attitude toward professional development. The study examines the relationship between goal instability and career commitment in the case of contingent employees working for a client company. The study uses a survey of 124 on-site engineers in the semiconductor industry. Hiring contingent employees is an important trend in the future, and its performance will be even more important to the client company than it is today. The results conclude that the client company cannot ignore this part of the workforce at a time when market flexibility is crucial. The client company should try to reduce or eliminate on-site employees' dissatisfaction with work circumstances if it hopes to ensure their positive attitude to work and high performance.

articleTitle: Assessment of Project Sustainability for Poverty Reduction in Rural China Based on Different Models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project sustainability is one of the important aspects of project management. The sustainability of anti-poverty projects will undoubtedly exert great influences on the long-term benefit of the projects for sustained poverty reduction. By adopting ANOVA analysis and post hoc tests based on field questionnaire data using the SPSS software, this paper makes an empirical assessment of the differences between different poverty reduction models in rural China, in an attempt to identify the differences of the sustainability of anti-poverty projects between four major poverty reduction models, i.e. sister-region support, relocation of farmers, the whole village approach and utilizing foreign capital. Major findings include: (1) the degrees of sustainability of projects differ dramatically between different anti-poverty models; (2) different models are significantly different in post-management agency and staff, post-management rules and regulations, post-management funds, sources of farmers' income, development ideology and overall project sustainability; (3) projects under the models of utilizing foreign capital and the whole village approach have better performances in most aspects of this project sustainability assessment. Policy implications are proposed accordingly based on these findings.

articleTitle: Energy's Contribution to China's Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on a scientific and sustainable development perspective, this paper presents an analytical framework of evaluating comprehensively China's energy utilization in terms of its contribution to economic, ecological and social development during the period from 1978 to 2005. The results show that the energy comprehensive contribution to economic, ecological and social development rises steadily. Specifically, energy consumption has a very strong benefit effect on China's economic development; Energy-intensive enterprises' impact on China's environment deterioration appears strengthened rapidly; owing to energy consumption's regional unbalanced distribution, the deviation among east, middle and west regional development and their industrial structure are exacerbated, which worsen the imbalance of its social development.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Costs Analysis of Perpetual Asphalt Pavement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the life cycle costs of three asphalt pavement structures: flexible base perpetual asphalt pavement, semi-rigid base perpetual asphalt pavement and semi-rigid base asphalt pavement which was a kind of wide-used asphalt pavement structure in china. The management costs and the user's costs among the three pavement structures were calculated respectively. Study show that the economic and social benefit of semi-rigid base perpetual asphalt pavement is the best which supplied the reasonable information for the investment decision-making of highway construction.

articleTitle: The Research of All-Around Performance Management System in Power Supply Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Performance management (PM) is the best way to help staff increase performance and achieve enterprise strategy through the workflow of PM. In this paper, after researched some certain municipal level power supply enterprises, we analyzed and integrated various PM methods, established a comprehensive PM system combining with latest information technology and implementing ideas. Using principles and technology of BSC, we also established a KPI system introduced by BSC. According this, an all-around PM information system was designed and developed based on Internet. It is a software system to support PM as the core of HRM system. Finally, anticipated purpose is achieved after running primarily and practice proved that this system is notably effective.

articleTitle: Innovation Systems of the Government Management Based on E-Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the development of globalization, cyberization, and integration of economics, e-government has become the goal and focus of many countries in the world. It has become the central part of construction of informatization for every country. E-government is an important criteria for the efficiency of a government. This paper firstly reviewed the development and characteristics of e-government, and then discussed the contents of innovation from five aspects of management, i.e. conceptions, systems, functions, structures, and models. This study further proposed the ensuring measures that can improve innovation of the government.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stabilization of Cu and Zn in the Sediments by Montmorillonite for the Management of Heavy Metal-Contaminated Municipal Sludge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The adsorption, desorption and species distribution characteristics of Cu and Zn in the sediments with or without montmorillonite spiked were investigated by isothermal adsorption and sequential extraction procedure. The results show that the montmorillonite spiked in the sediments enhanced the adsorption capacity of sediments for Cu and Zn and facilitated the transformation of Cu and Zn from less stable phases to more stable phases, especially advanced the translation of Cu and Zn from exchangeable fraction to the other fractions. Meanwhile, the montmorillonite inserted in the sediments restrained Cu and Zn leached from the sediments. These results imply that the addition of montmorillonite to the sediments facilitated the stability of heavy metals in the sediments and restrained the environmental risk of heavy metals to the aquatic environment to some extent.

articleTitle: Integration System for Insurance E-Channel Based on Attributes Positioning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To obtain maximal channel benefits, a clear attributes positioning is the base for channel integration system. Based on our empirical work, a CSSM (communication, services, sales and management) frame of attributes positioning for insurance e-channel was presented, and then the characteristics and comparative advantages of insurance e-channel were summarized. After that, AHP method was used to judge the priority of these four attributes, and a formula was put forward to answer the question of when and how to integrate the sale attributes of e-channel with traditional agent channel, since the attribute of sale channel was less important than other three attributes. The integration process took several factors into accounts, which include policy price, unit cost, product value given by customers, preference degree of customer in e-channel, and cost coefficient at some channel advantage. The possible difficulties and targeted routes were suggested to speed up the integration between insurance e-channel and offline agent channel.

articleTitle: Synergy Management of Contruction Supply Chain Based on Emergence Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Over the last decades, although there have been some changes in construction industry with the development of the technology and culture, much research projects suggest that construction is still ineffective. With the increasing complexity of the construction projects and high uncertainty of the environment, collaborative relationships between organizations in construction supply chain (CSC) is necessary and important to improve the performance of construction supply chain management. The system thinking is a pattern of thinking following the emergence theory. Synergy is one of ways inducing emergence. Based on emergence mechanism of complex system theory, synergy management ways of CSC can be set up to enhance CSC competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Impacts of Hedge Funds on American Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Revised Shift-Share Model and Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although the traditional shift share model has a widely use, it has many defects in the regional study. It can be developed into more revised expressions and extensions. In this paper, the time variable is introduced into the model and another mathematical expression is formulated. Then, an empirical study is conducted and the results have also indicated that the revised model is benefit to the regional analysis.

articleTitle: A Structural Framework of SPMS for Value Chain of Service Supply Chain by Ecology Analogy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To measure service supply chain (SSC) with penetrable value perspective, a structural framework of strategic performance measurement system (SPMS) for value chain (VC) of SSC is put forward by ecology analogy. Based on the belief that the competition and cooperation of value supply in supply chain (SC) and value demand in demand chain (DC) are the root of dynamic complexity of SSC, a general value flow model in SC and in DC are put forward respectively by analogy with the universal energy flow model. The measures extracted from the two value flow models consider main interest groups of a firm. A structural framework for firm is a self-evident structure with two fulcrums of the co-action between the firm and suppliers or between the firm and customers, which helps expressing the balancing of contradictory goals. A three levels (firm, SSC, environment) structural framework of SPMS for VC of SSC interlinks many pairs of supplier/customer and integrates spatiotemporal SSC structure and environment, which might realize the dynamic evolution of the structural framework of SPMS for firm with SSC and environment.

articleTitle: The Research on the Frequency Drift of the Coaxial and Circular Waveguide Resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The UHF adjacent channel combiner is in a great demand because of the shortage of the frequency resource along with the development of the "China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting (CMMB)" system and the "Digital Television Terrestrial Broadcasting (DTTB)" system. The high-selectivity band-pass filter is a must for the adjacent channel combiner. The characteristics of the frequency drift caused by the temperature of the coaxial and waveguide resonators, which were used to construct the filter, were investigated in this paper. Two types of the coaxial resonator and two types of cylinder waveguide resonator were studied. The main reason of the coaxial resonant frequency drift was found out. Some frequency drift compensation methods were proposed as well in this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Identification of Cross-Cultural Risk in Multicultural Interactions of Transnational Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Environment Carrying Capacity Evaluation in Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the current environmental situation in Shaanxi Province and the conception of Environmental Carrying Capacity (ECC) , an evaluation index system of ECC in Shaanxi Province was established, including environmental pollutant-accommodating capacity (EPC), resource supply capacity (RSC) and man-made support capacity (MSC). In the meanwhile, the ECC in Shaanxi Province from 2001 to 2006 was evaluated through combining Analytic Hierarchy Process and State-space method. Thus the paper intends to provide theoretical basis for Shaanxi Province in making an effective environment protection strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Workflow-Based Quality Information Active Sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Integrated quality management requires realizing closed-loop control of quality management process, efficient and sensible quality information sharing. A workflow-based quality information active sharing (WQIAS) mechanism is presented in the paper. The requirements of WQIAS system are analyzed, the overall scheme of the system is put forward, then the system architecture is established, and the main components of the system are analyzed, the executive logic is illustrated. According to the enterprise quality project, the WQIAS prototype system is developed to verify the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Water Quality Evaluation of Songhua River and Water Environment Capacity Calculation in Harbin
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On basis of monitoring data from 2001 to 2005 of Songhua River's dry season in Harbin by Harbin Environmental Protection Administration, this paper applicated Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) model based on Hybrid Hierarchy Genetic Algorithm (HHGA)and taked water quality evalucation of six monitoring sections: Zhushun tun, Ashe internal estuary, lower Ashe estuary, Hulan internal estuary, lower Hulan estuary and High Dingzi mountain. The result showed that the model was reasonable and feasible, which didn't merely determine the structure and parameters of RBFNN conveniently and precisely, but had practical conclusion. The water quality of six monitoring sections was respectively Pi , inferior V, IV, inferior V, IV, IV by inoculating. Zhushun tun was only accord with water quality target. The section from Zhushun tun and Ashe internal estuary was severe pollution zone. The monitoring and evaluation of water environment can provide the scientific basis for water resources' management and the calculation of water environmental capacity. According to water environmental function zones and water quality target, based on river hydrological characteristics, the distribution of blowdown part to rivers and other factors, by using the software of "river water environmental capacity analysis system" to calculate water environmental capacity of function zones , the calculation results showed Songhua river 's main stream and the tributary Hulan river had environmental capacity, Ashe river had no environmental capacity. Laid the foundation and proposed measuring basis for total amount reduction in 2010 .

articleTitle: Expressway Extension Project Construction Management Based on the Programme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The expressways extension project need a huge amount of investment, complex object system, as well as high difficulty of construction technique and will bring large social impact. To introduce an idea of programme management can efficiently improve our management level of expressways extension project. The paper relies on Hu-ning expressway extension project, analyses the programme characteristics of expressway extension project and investigates the breakdown structure of programme system, also study the application of the idea of programme management in the whole life-cycle of expressway extension project management. A new management idea of expressway extension project based on the programme is brought forward, which combines with the engineering breakdown structure (EBS) and project breakdown structure (PBS). It is propitious to the effective improving of cost management, help to build the information management matrix and the whole life-cycle cost management matrix of extension project, also can help to set up documents information systems and information reporting systems of projects (sub-projects), final is contributive to achieve the integrated management in the whole life-cycle of expressways extension project. The success of the management idea used in Hu-ning project management will offer direction and reference to expressways extension project management for the future.

articleTitle: A Risk Evaluation Model of PC Cluster with Seismic Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study's objective is to solve performance evaluation problem of PC cluster in processing seismic data intensive computing. The objective of performance evaluation is determining the relationship between the number of PC node and the scale of tasks to be processed to decide whether the transaction of seismic data processing should be transformed from mainframe computer to PC cluster platform. In particular, this paper presented a model based on least-squares regression for evaluating the performance of PC cluster. The model begins with the comparison of the computing performance of PC clusters by collecting experiential data, and proceeded by establishing performance evaluation model of PC cluster using least-squares regression, as well as performing error analysis and significance test. To study the effects of the proposed model, a series of experiments based on PC cluster are designed and implemented. The results show that the computational efforts, communication traffic and their relationship play an important role in task processing of PC cluster. This study's conclusions indicate that PC cluster can be substituted for mainframe computer in order to save the expense of processing seismic data.

articleTitle: Compliance-Oriented Process Maps and SLA Ontology to Facilitate Six Sigma Define Phase for SLA Compliance Processes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A key component of a services-based economy are the processes that establish and maintain compliance to Service Level Agreements (SLA). An SLA is a contract between a service provider and a customer that specifies the governing parameters of a service and the penalties for non-compliance. This paper presents a new methodology and conceptual tools to facilitate Six Sigma's Define phase within the DMAIC approach. These tools are specifically designed for the Six Sigma approach to SLA compliance processes and can be applied to any SLA compliance process across industries. The newly introduced tools include an SLA Ontology and Compliance-Oriented Process Maps. SLA Ontology is a conceptual model of a SLA that guides the Define phase. Compliance-Oriented Maps draw a service-oriented view of the compliance process itself and use nineteen generic compliance services in order to arrive at SIPOC maps in a disciplined fashion.

articleTitle: A Study on the Techniques of Mass Appraisal in Real Estate Tax Base and Mortgage Valuation Based on Quantile Regression
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper researches the regression method of mass appraisal in the real estate taxation and mortgage, which tests the secondary residential section data and compares with the result of ordinary least squared regression method (OLS). The study finds that property characteristics impact differently to the real estate in the different value range. Therefore, the mass appraisal method based on quantile regression can make the full use of relevant information that helps to improve the accuracy of mass appraisal for the purpose of the real estate taxation and mortgage.

articleTitle: The Relativity Research among IT Innovation, Organization Studying and the Formation of Core Competence - Based on the Example Analysis of State-Owned Electric Power Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: IT innovation is a kind of important means for our enterprises to raise the information-based construction efficiency in present stage, and the organization learning is a kind of valid method to grow corporate culture and optimize the organization structure. There is natural fusion between the IT innovation and organization learning which promotes the formation and exaltation of enterprise core competence commonly. This paper can disclose the tiny view conduction mechanism of IT innovation and organization learning in the process of core competence formation through the empirical analysis of typical case of national electric power enterprise to provide the realistic theory identification for our enterprises to strengthen the IT innovation and organization learning.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the Relationship between China's Fictitious Economy and Real Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The fictitious economy and real economy constitute a new pattern of economic system in the modern society. The theoretical model about interaction development between fictitious economy and real economy is deduced based on the theory of financial development and economic growth, and empirical analysis on the relationship between China's fictitious economy and real economy using 2001 to 2008 monthly data is done based on the theoretical model and China's development situation. The results show that the fictitious economy does not Granger cause real economy, the real economy also does not Granger cause fictitious economy, and there is at most one cointegrating equation between the fictitious economy and real economy. The results indicate that China's fictitious economy departures from real economy in the short term, but they will have coordinated development in future. Some countermeasures and suggestions are given in order to promote the coordinated development and reduce the degree of departure according to the actual economic development.

articleTitle: Game Analysis Based on Nash Bargaining Model for Cooperative Innovation in Complex Product System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes cooperative innovation strategic choice of complex product system as research object, establishes complete information dynamic game model of cooperative innovation of complex product system modularization development, and adopts Nash bargaining solution to achieve the qualification of strategic choice from system company and cooperative unit. On the basis of this, it sets up and solves game model of external benefit containing system company, further compares and analyzes the change rule of both sides in game theory as well.

articleTitle: Safety Culture Assessment of Power Supply Enterprises Based on Trapezium-Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to know the construction conditions of the safety culture in power supply companies this paper sets up an overall and objective safety culture assessment index system of power supply enterprises based on the power industry characteristics. The weights of indexes can be got by improved AHP and comprehensive scores can be obtained by linear weighted method. Then an assessment model is introduced which adopts the trapezium-cloud model to make grade division (concept partition) of the safety culture instead of the hard division method in previous studies. The concepts gained by this way can reflect the data distribution characteristics more obviously. Finally we can obtain the cloud parameters by using backward cloud generator, which are used for evaluation. What's more, the example in this paper shows that the model is feasible and effective and it can offer more valuable information.

articleTitle: Research on Trusted Electronic Commerce Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Lacking of trust is one of the most important causes which make the e-commerce can't be more widely available. How to obtain the trust of Internet users has become an important factor in the development of e-commerce in China .This paper begins with the analysis of the current trust situation of electronic commerce and then proposes the concept of trusted e-commerce and a framework for trusted electronic commerce and an evaluation system framework for the trusted electronic commerce and a thought of how to do the evaluation. The evaluation result-trust level can be used as a basis for user choosing e-commerce application. The signification of this research is offered in the finally.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Interaction of Environmental Quality for Urban Community
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Develop IT Outsourcing Contract Based on QFD
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many companies expand a great amount of effort to increase the performance of information technology (IT) outsourcing. Yet, in IT outsourcing, contracts is critical to the outcome and developing a good outsourcing contract is problematic. Unfortunately, the area of exploitation and operation outsourcing contract is still rather immature. Many firms fall into the black hole of contracts. This paper provides insight in techniques for developing IT outsourcing contracts. The goal of drafting an outsourcing contract is to combine the revenue of IT service provider with the company's profit and establish a win-win relationship. In this article we describe and discuss quality function deployment (QFD) as a framework for managing IT outsourcing requirements. In the manufacturing sector, QFD has been successfully applied to determine customers' needs for the design at its early stages of development. In order to overcome the difficulties arising from contract oriented specification and service-oriented customer satisfaction, the outsourcing contractor would find the QFD methodology useful. The research looks into the merits of the QFD system and the problems in the application of QFD in IT outsourcing contracts. The results suggest that using QFD is better focus on customers' outsourcing requirements and contributes to the outsourcing performance. Some factors would influence the quality of IT outsourcing contracts based on QFD, including adequate describing requirements, handing relations between requirements and the technology.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Management Framework in R & D Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At the era of knowledge economy, knowledge management is attached more and more importance to our country in all circles. Only after fully understanding the importance of knowledge management and successfully implementing knowledge management can organizations maintain the continuous developmental vitality in the fierce competitive environment. Successful implementing of knowledge management is based on building a specific knowledge management framework. This paper starts from the concept of knowledge management, and then analyses the current situation of knowledge management in R & D organization. After that, we put forward a model of knowledge management framework in R & D organization, and finally, make a further analysis and expatiation on staff, knowledge environment and knowledge management platform, which are the three core parts of the model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Toward a "Compact settlement": A Sustainable Development Way of Settlements for Chinese City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Farmer Satisfaction Index Research on Irrigation and Water Conservancy Construction Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Irrigation and water conservancy construction relates to the comprehensive agricultural productivity, the problem of increasing of farmers' income, the people's livelihood, and its performance has gradually become the focus of concern. As participants and users of irrigation and water conservancy facilities, farmers get more benefit from irrigation and water conservancy construction than other people. This article makes a research which based on Guangdong as an example about the farmer satisfaction index of irrigation and water conservancy construction performance, using gray correlation analysis model to analyze the situations about the farmers' satisfaction index of irrigation and water conservancy construction performance who came from 6 different cities in Guangdong province and the primary factors which impact on satisfaction index, and then seeks the root of the problem in order to provide the scientific basis to improve the performance of irrigation and water conservancy construction in Guangdong.

articleTitle: Analysis of Geological Environmental Safety and Ground Soil Predominant Period Variation in City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: City construction on a large scale brings fast, strongly, extensively and obviously for disturbance of geological environment. For example, development of underground space on a large scale in city, fall of underground water table, adoption of overlength piles foundation and action of city construction load, etc. affects change of structure and properties on geological body and ground soil. The change of mechanical characteristic of geological body and ground soil affects partially or wholly site classification and dynamic properties, accordingly influence resonance characteristic of ground soil and construction. Above variety will influence parameters of overlay soil layer, such as variety of shear wave velocity, simultaneously predominant period of ground soil will be also changed. City construction load influences directly resonance characteristic of ground and construction by changing character of geological body, which makes intensity of seismic disaster different. This paper chiefly expounds factors in city construction which influences structure varieties of geological body, and analyses interrelation between geological body, ground soil structure and predominant period, and plans main research ideas and implements case analysis. Analysis indicated that it was very much important to research question of interrelation between city construction and the ground soil predominant period variation, which it is not available to be avoided for city geological environment safety.

articleTitle: Research on Customs Service Quality of Power Enterprise Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By rough set theory applied to the basic concepts of electricity customers in the analysis of the quality of services, focused on how to measure the importance of attributes specific to the method used in the analysis. Through Zigong customers' questionnaire of service quality as an example, the analysis indicates that the approach based on rough set of customer service quality can simple and effective analyze the important influencing factors on the quality of customer service, and provide a theoretical basis for future power enterprises to improve service quality.

articleTitle: A Study on the Relationship between Board Behaviors and Board Performance: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The literature on the relationships between board attributes and corporate performance is mixed, and one important reason is that the intermediate variable, i.e., board behaviors is ignored. This paper empirically researches the impact of board behaviors on board performance based on a survey in China. Our results show that the conflict of the board has significant positive effect on the strategic role of the board and insignificant positive effect on the monitoring of the board, and that the use of knowledge and effort norms of the board have insignificant positive effects on board performance. Based on our empirical investigation, the monitoring of China Securities Regulatory Commission on board behaviors is meaningful largely in terms of the form rather than the substance. Thus, there is a long way to go to regulate the board behaviors of listed companies in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Spatial Pattern of Urban Commercial Service Based on Voronoi Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The spatial distribution of commercial service has significant importance for land management and urban planning. This paper attempts to discuss the spatial pattern of the commercial service at a general/city scale based on the voronoi model which is a powerful tool for the proximity analysis in GIS. Firstly, the commercial parcels are assigned to particles enduring their commercial function so as to divide the city zone into pieces as their service areas. Then the research is advance in two folds. On the one hand, the spatial connection relationship of the commercial service particles is illustrated by the allelomorphic net derived from the voronoi diagram. On the other hand, the commercial dominance index and the commercial balance index are designed to investigate the commercial service capability of the corresponding commercial parcels. We apply the analysis on a case study of Jingzhou city, China. The results indicate that the spatial distribution of the commercial service is in a pattern of "Corridor", while in the urban planning it is more concentrated in the pattern of "Patch-Corridor".

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Challenges and Countermeasures of China's Outbound M&A in the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Effects of Export on Technological Innovation: An Analysis Based on the Current Economic Crisis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's export has been inevitably impacted by the current economic crisis, and many export enterprises are striving against the pressure of international market. Further and continual development of these enterprises depends on technology innovation, thus, this paper tries to identify the other side of the current crisis influences namely the technological innovation opportunity. The finding is that technological innovation can be improved through competition effect and spillover effect by means of learning by exporting and connection. The corresponding policies and measures are also explored.

articleTitle: Study on Selection of Superseded Leading Industries of Daqing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the necessity of industries transformation in resource-oriented city Daqing. Ten alternative industries in Daqing are comparative analyzed and calculated through the method of principal component analysis (PCA), then the order of the alternative industries is listed as follows: chemical industry, electrical installations manufacturing, food-processing industry, pharmaceutical industry, plastic products industry, general mechanical manufacturing, fabricated metal products, specialized equipment manufacturing, electronic and communication equipments manufacturing and transportation equipment manufacturing. We choose the first three as the superseded leading industries eventually. The result of selection suits the practical situation of Daqing, and is of certain reference value for the industries transformation of Daqing.

articleTitle: Application of Rough Set in Diagnostics of Supply Chain Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on how to diagnose Supply Chain Integration of one firm with its trading partners between shipping and inventory or purchasing and raw material management. Based on the SCOR model, several papers gives the concept model on how to evaluate performance of Supply Chain Integration, which can hardly be used by only a frame. In this paper, an algorithm is developed for diagnosing Supply Chain Integration based on Rough Set, combining with Fuzzy Logic and Statistics. It reduces the uncertainty of the system and accelerates the process of diagnosing by Reduction and Covering. The proposed method results in several incompetent functions of integration for being developed by one firm. With chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> test, the effectiveness of the diagnostic result can be proved. Using a simulation example, applicability of the method is illustrated.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Technical Cooperation of New Energy between China, Japan and Korea
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of Corporate Social Responsibility and Globalization on Sustainable Development and Productivity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An Economic Evaluation Method of Offshore Drilling Platform Overhaul Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The stable and efficient operation of offshore drilling platform is the prerequisite that enable success of offshore petroleum exploration and development activities. Offshore drilling platforms are often required periodical overhaul to restore its operational capacity after long time use in the marine environment. However, not all offshore drilling platform overhaul projects are economically feasible. In order to determine the economic feasibility of a platform overhaul project, economic evaluation is conducted. In this paper, an economic evaluation method of offshore drilling platform overhaul projects is proposed. At the same time, the paper also puts forward the economic evaluation methods of the other two alternative programs, new platform update and modernized refit. A scientific platform overhaul decision can be made basing on the economic evaluation results of the three programs.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Intensive Service Business Model Research from Innovative Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The essence of knowledge-intensive service is a process of knowledge innovation in between service provider and clients with high levels of knowledge interaction. By far, domestic research on operational performance in knowledge-intensive service business is not yet perfect, most of the literature limited to some specific industries or simple introduction of services marketing, policy supporting. However, for industry, profitability is the fundamental condition to ensure its sustainability and healthy growth. Based on the perspective of innovation the paper studies four elements: service concept, customer interface, delivery system and technology selection that incur the innovation. The paper analyzed the characteristics of each business model and key points of designing and leveled in dimension of the value creation magnitude, divided the business model into three types: business model of direct knowledge-service provision, business model of providing innovative platform and business model of integration of innovative elements. Typical feature of the first model is KIBS offering direct knowledge performance. The second one focuses on providing customers with technical ideas and solutions rather than a direct result. The last one emphasizes passing clients the capability of improving knowledge innovation. The paper also makes comparative study among models as per elements and characteristics of innovation, designating the key points of designing business model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Psychological Recovery by Community Reconstruction and Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Training Strategy Research of MIS Commerical Application in Perspective of Career Continuing Progression
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The competency of solving business-related problem by using IT is an important ability for college students (specially for those who are majoring management of information system-MIS) in pursuing their career progression, but current curriculum design and training method might not be able to help students fulfill their needs to obtain IT competency. Based on learning theory and TAM theory, an advanced training model targeting to college students will be presented in this paper. By using real life problem-solving strategy of IT such as Internet, this training model could largely help students obtain analytical skill and problem solving ability in IT circulation. Further, it could greatly arouse students' interest in IT knowledge, continuing to enhance their IT skills and comprehensive capability, eventually help students be able to apply such knowledge and skills to the real work, and help them realize desired career progression. The validity of this training model is verified by an e-commerce contest introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on Process Reengineering of Capital Flow in Manufacturing Enterprises: In Order to Reduce Purchasing Cost
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
