articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Knowledge Management and High Intelligent Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Improved Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluation Model of Core Competence for Gold Mining Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the opening up of the domestic gold market, gold mining companies are faced with challenges. The possession of resources cannot guarantee a competitive advantage. It has become vital for enterprises to evaluate, foster and develop their current core competence in order to sustain their advantageous positions in the market. This article attempts to establish a set of scientific evaluation indices system of core competence, and apply this improved fuzzy synthetic evaluation model to evaluate their core competence. This model avoids the information overlap caused by the fuzzy nature and complexity of the indices by the orthogonal transformation. It has adopted the entropy method to reduce subjectivity.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Regional Economy Investment Environment Based on TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of economy, the issue of investment environment on regional economy has become a major topic for the theory research of decision-making home and abroad. This paper implies TOPSIS to the regional economic investment evaluation. It is a great help for the investors' scientific and rational decision in choosing the investment environment by presenting clearer and more logical result of comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: A Low Rate Speech Transmission System Based On Controller Area Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A speech transmission system was designed to conquer the restriction of analog communication system in coal mine. After compressed by multi-band excitation, the voice data was transmitted on CAN (controller area network)-bus to achieve long transmission distance at low speed. Compared simulation data and experimental data, it got the result that CAN-bus can bare the speech data after MBE coding compression, and the composing of system voice is perfect and understandable, with the distortion of voice signal les15%, voice intensity les90 dB after magnified, and suitable for voice transmission in coal mine.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of "Tourism-Environment" Coupling Pattern: A Case Study of Kanasi Lake, Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Improvement of Government Procurement Performance Evaluation Index System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Government procurement performance evaluation is an effective means to expedite the procurement outcome of government's departments. The key factor to setting up an effective evaluation system of government procurement is choosing reasonable evaluation indexes with accurate weights related. The purpose of this paper is to provide a new method based on data mining to improve the GP evaluation system, and to found a dynamic framework of evaluation system's continual development via the data warehouse technology. By proving the scientific value of this new method, the author thinks that it can avoid the defects of the past methods efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Method of Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Management information system is the major fundamental course for the specialty of computer and related. This article describes how to improve teaching effect, train the students the operation ability by using mission-driven teaching method and case teaching method for MIS teaching according to different teaching contents.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the Urban Planning and Development in an Arid City - Urumqi, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Credit Scoring Model of the Self-Employed People
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Self-employed People are firms in style but are individuals in features while measuring their credit, it is more reasonable to judge their credit status using credit scoring system than credit rating method. Choosing the self-employed people registered in Changsha as a sample, a credit scoring system is developed and tested. The test results using both the training sample and testing sample show satisfactory precision of the prediction. A credit scoring card is developed based on the model coefficients, it can be conveniently used in practice, and be used as guidance of supervision and administration as well.

articleTitle: Organizational Factors and the Performance of Knowledge Transfer in Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The importance of managing knowledge in organizations for competitive advantage has received an amount of attention in recently years. Relatively little study has been performed on tacit knowledge transfer in the construction industry. This paper aims to investigate the relationship between organizational factors and the performance of knowledge transfer. Organizational culture, organizational structure, IT technology, and No-IT approaches as four main independent variables were identified and were also tested against knowledge transfer performance. To achieve an in-depth empirical study, two UK consultant firms and one China construction project were chosen for case study. The results reveal that there are significant relationships between some of the variables and the performance of knowledge transfer. Therefore, it is necessary for construction organizations to consider these factors in implementing knowledge management strategies within/across organization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Management Mode Based on the Process of Enterprise Core Values
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Eight Methods for Decomposing the Energy Intensity of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Energy intensity is crucial to the development of a society. China experienced a dramatic decline in energy intensity from the onset of economic reform in the late 1970s. Decomposition methodology is a useful analytical tool in energy consumption and energy intensity analysis, to the best of our knowledge, no decomposition study has taken into account the price index. In this paper, we use the decomposition methods derived from economic index numbers to decompose the China's energy intensity into structural change and efficiency change. The results show that technological change plays the dominant role in decreasing energy intensity in 1985-2005. According to research, the author suggests energy intensity reduction strategies should aim at structural adjustments and accelerate technological innovation.

articleTitle: Decision-Making of Knowledge Teams in Enterprise Based on Knowledge Conflict
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The knowledge conflicts exist in the process of enterprise knowledge intercommunion are analyzed firstly. A decision-making method of knowledge teams constitution in enterprise is put forward on the base of conflict theory and knowledge reduction, and the constitution models of knowledge teams in enterprise based on knowledge conflict are constructed, the influences that the conflict threshold value to the constitution of knowledge teams in enterprise are studied. Finally, the important effects of decision-making of knowledge teams in enterprise based on knowledge conflict in enterprise knowledge management are analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Game between Financial Innovation and Financial Regulation Based on ICTs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: One of the most imperative initiatives of promoting financial innovation, resisting financial risks, preventing financial crisis and strengthening financial regulation is to keep the balance of financial innovation and financial regulation which are based on ICTs. The authors analyze the ICTs-based mechanism of financial innovation and diffusion. The analysis of its impact on the reform of financial regulation is also discussed in the paper. According to China's actual conditions, the authors give some suggestions on financial regulation system which is based on modern information infrastructure.

articleTitle: Research on Strategic Decision of Proper Transition from 2G to 3G
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The issue of the 3G licenses represents the initial takeoff of 3G service in China. How to coordinately develop the 2G and 3G service and what are the strategies during the transitional period from 2G to 3G become hot topics within the industry. The scientifically transitional strategy plays a very important role in the development of mobile industry. However, there are seldom quantitative decision models on this area so far. This paper finds out the strategic balance point between 2G development and 3G promotion from the perspective of maximizing the benefit of the telecom operator. It firstly analyzes the realistic situation in 3G transitional period, as well as the coexistence relationship of 2G and 3G, on the basis of which it makes the profit model, and then further builds the strategic decision model. Finally, it puts forward the strategy decision method and suggestions.

articleTitle: Automated Identification on Odd and Even Fields Based on Active Video
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Identification on odd/even fields is one of problems in digital video processing for picture sequences only included in the active video. A new approach to automated detection of field orders is proposed in this paper. The method which adopts horizontal edge detection to obtain horizontal edge picture, then compares to the vertical energy attained by accumulating the value of every pixel in the edge picture, does not rely on blanking intervals and synchronizing information. Experimental results show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: The Practice of Digital City Management System in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During City Regeneration Program of Hangzhou, a digital city management system was created in order to improve the effective of city management. The system is a significant part in regeneration program. The system realized the digital-object, digital-subject and digital-component. It is a public participateble system, which integrated and distributed city resource in an equal way. It is a system guided by city governance concept. The practice will help the complex city create a new harmonious management mechanism.

articleTitle: The Research on Debt Financing Strategy and Competition Strategy under Technology Innovation Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article builds a three-stage game model to analyze how the enterprises' financing strategy affects their technology innovation activity with spillover effect and quantity decision when they form technology innovation alliance. We show that the enterprise's innovation activity is negatively affected by the technology innovation spillover and positively affected by its debt financing strategy; the equilibrium saving cost and the equilibrium profit under being debt financing both are lower than them under not being debt financing. However, the equilibrium quantity is dependent on spillover effect.

articleTitle: Knowledge Acquisition Based on Vague Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The theory of vague set is a new theory in the field of fuzzy information processing. In this paper, we make an attempt to extend the approaches of computing attributes reductions in the literature. We first review the basic notion termed vague rough set by combing rough set theory and vague set theory. Then, by using the vague rough lower approximation distribution in the vague decision information systems, the new concept of the discernibility matrix is proposed. Finally, an approach for extracting decision rules from the vague decision information systems is proposed. These studies provided a new avenue to uncertain fuzzy knowledge acquisition.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction of Franchise Project Quality Risk Management System Based on Project Insurance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Chinese Urban Residential Micro-Location
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to problems in the research of Chinese urban residential's micro-location, for example lacking the research in selection of urban residential's micro-location of different groups which have different income level and lacking research in the method which can be used in appraising the residential's micro-location, etc, in the first this paper finds out the factor which influence the residential's micro-location, second proposes the index system which can be used to evaluate urban residential's micro-location. In this paper AHP and entropy method is integrated in order to appraise the micro-location of Chinese urban residential, and provide the procedure. And then take a residence in Tianjin as a concrete example and analysis the micro-location of the residential. This paper wants to give some academic references in order to help Chinese urban residentials to have reasonable layout and help Chinese real-estate sector to have a sustainable development.

articleTitle: An Improved LU Decomposition Encoding Method of LDPC Codes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concerning the high encoding complexity of low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, an improved LU decomposition encoding method is proposed, which is able to take full advantage of the characteristics of the sparse parity-check matrix, such as cyclicity and equality of row weight. Experimental results show that, the proposed method can reduce dramatically the memory requirements in hardware implementation, while maintaining the computational complexity nearly.

articleTitle: Choices of International Technical Transferring of Chinese Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the entrance of WTO, one of the long-term tasks for Chinese agricultural development is that the implement of the walking-out strategy and the international transferring of agricultural technology. Whether the double-win goal can be achieved is mostly depended on the selection of the ways of transfer. This article concludes that China should mainly adopt the transfer way of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the agricultural technology transference to the developed countries, whereas the export trade and the permit trade to the developing countries.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Conservation and Utilization of Industrial Heritage in the Process of Urban Development - Industrial Landscape Design Paper Subtitle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Competitiveness Model of Textile & Fashion MICE Based on Customer Value
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on customer value, a competitiveness structural equation model of textile & fashion MICE (meeting, incentive, convention and exhibition) and the main dimensional research hypotheses were developed. After data processing of questionnaires by LISREL 8.7 and the tool of SEM (structural equation modeling) technology, the three dimensions of function value and the five dimensions of customer value were proved. The relationships among the dimensions were also analyzed and the importance of them as to textile & fashion MICE competitiveness in order was given.

articleTitle: Design of Safe Early-Warning System for Roof Spatial Latticed Structure of Wuhan Natatorium
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The safe early-warning system for roof spatial latticed structure of Wuhan Natatorium is composed of sensing subsystem, database and administration subsystem and safe early-warning identification subsystem, which is automatic operation by system integration technique. According to the characteristics and service environment of roof spatial latticed structure of Wuhan Natatorium, the two key techniques are proposed; one is assessment structural key rods' work status by data-acquisitions from strain gauges, another is detection firn thickness on the roof by fuzzy pattern identification method. The results of safe early-warning are displayed clearly by friendly interactive interface. The system operating satisfactorily demonstrates the efficient of safe early-warning system.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Mobile Payment and Its Industry Chain on Customer Value
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the 3G era, the cell phone is not only a simple voice communication tool, more and more value-added services can be realized via it, while mobile payment is one of the most typical representatives. Although the members on the mobile payment supply chain are all very active and willing to push its development, the lack of the objective understanding of the customer value and the status of going each one's own business will become big barriers for the development of mobile payment. From the perspective of improving customer's value, this paper designed the measure indicators and made the empirical research on the influence of mobile payment and its industry chain on customer value, so as to provide the actual reference for the industry chain development of mobile payment, and make it widely applied in different fields of informatization construction. Meanwhile, it could also provide great reference for the mobile operators on industry positioning, business model design and customer value improvement.

articleTitle: Co-Creating Innovative Si-Soft Service System and Infrastructure: Implementation of the NSoC Program as a Transition Paradigm of Taiwan Semiconductor Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With dramatic changes of semiconductor industries, the services of Taiwan Hsinchu Science Park have to make proper transformation to meet the demands of high-tech companies. This paper advocates a powerful new concept - "customer-centric services system" (CCSS)- being introduced in Hsinchu Science Park Administration (HSPA), Taiwan. The services platform elevate the customer-centric value via delivering CCSS in terms of establishment of a Platform-based and add-value service system. Through a case study on the implementation of an official NSoC Program top-down from Taiwan government, Si-Soft Research Center via delivering CCSS in Hsinchu Science Park have provided sounded high-tech R&D environment, well-equipped public facilities, effective services administration, open innovation on global networks, and mechanisms of integrative intelligent-property collections etc.. The further aims at validating the NSoC on applying the concept of CCSS has introduced a brand new "park-in-park" model to form the full-fledged Knowledge ecosystem as a park transition paradigm in challenging global economy.

articleTitle: Integrated Service Outsourcing: A Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The growing pressure to reduce costs and improve efficiency induces many organizations to undertake service outsourcing initiatives. This paper presents a conceptual model that help shed light on the complexities of outsourcing service and knowledge work. The models offer a simple yet powerful way to conceptualize outsourcing of knowledge and service work and to identify the inherent challenges that such strategies entail. The implications of the conceptual models have been discussed in a range of propositions that can be viewed as foundations for new inquiry in this research stream. A case study of the steel producer Baosteel of China highlights that the adoption of integrated service outsourcing is an appropriate strategy to pursue.

articleTitle: A Review of Theories and Research Based on Instant Messaging
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Instant messaging (IM) is a communication media which integrates several media technologies. Comparing with other communication technologies, it can achieve more efficient interaction like traditional face-to-face communication. By studying the quantitative and qualitative IM researches in recent ten years, the author saw several limitations in previous studies, including study methods, content, theory, etc. This paper will discuss the limitations in detail. Furthermore, we found that media research and psychology research can be a good reference to research in IM field. The author identified two specific research areas that are very important but ignored by IM researchers in the past: personalized requirements of IM users and construct personalized IM usage behavioral patterns by adopting integrated approach and advanced statistic methods.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Low-Noise Asphalt Pavement to Improve the Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traffic noise has become a serious environmental problem to human life. The relationship between pavement type and vehicle noise is studied, and the noise-reduction mechanisms of low-noise asphalt pavement are discussed. By testing, we can know the relationship between noise and speed is basically appeared linear growth. The noise-reduction reasons of OGFC asphalt mixture mainly lie in the absorption-noise effect of porous asphalt mixture and the damping effect of flexible asphalt material. Aiming to the problem of excessive noise of cement concrete pavement, in order to reduce traffic noise to pollute city environment,the method is adopted to use low-noise asphalt overlay of OGFC to pave old cement concrete pavement.

articleTitle: Product Realization-Based Performance Evaluation of Supply Chain Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the concept of integrated total supply chain performance evaluation, a product realization-based performance evaluation system is presented to assess the performance of supply chain integration from all perspectives and in a dynamic tracking way using the theory of project management. And, in the light to balanced scorecard, the performance is investigated from the five aspects cost, sourcing process, the integrated degree between the focal come and suppliers, quality, and order fulfillment. At the end, a scorecard template is established to illustrate how the system works.

articleTitle: Automating the Evaluation of Engineering Device Procurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Engineering devices procurement involves many factors besides price, such as brand requirement, the urgency of the need, the delay of the contract, the supplier, etc. In this paper, we provide an index framework for the evaluation of engineering device procurement. The weight of each index, sub-index and sub-sub-index is calculated with AHP method. We then introduce our software implementation of the evaluation process. Based on the user selection of device and its evaluation index framework, the software automatically generates user interface. The user simply selects from a group of drop-down lists and enters the price of the device. The software calculates the final score and grades it. A set of tools is provided in the software to facilitate the configuration of indices, scores tables and the maintenance of tables. With this software, procurement managers and corporate executives can make their evaluation of procurement quickly done and keep evaluations consistent with each evaluation.

articleTitle: The Communication Feature of "Newspaper-Internet Interaction" in the New Media Age
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the new media age, "newspaper-Internet interaction" not only indicates the complementary relationship between traditional medium newspaper and new medium Internet, meaning that newspapers can broaden news sources and innovate news contents and forms with the help of Internet, while in return, the Internet can draw support from newspapers in an effort to increase its hits, enhance its reputation and expand its influences, but also marks the leap in communication technology, the transformation of media production and management mode and the revolution in news receiver consumption experience, and declares the coming of media integration era.

articleTitle: The Research on ERP Acceptance Model Based on Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The theory of information technology becomes a research focus in recent years. According to implementing characteristic and requirement of ERP and the current situation of domestic and international enterprises, this text has proposed acceptance model of ERP system and probed into the key factor of implementing ERP of enterprises from the individual behavioral respect on the basis of unified theory of acceptance and use of technology.

articleTitle: Flexible Management Information System Based on Axiomatic Design
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: MIS flexibility is more and more important. We analyze flexible business process units, study the substance of axiomatic design. Axiomatic design can meet 6 criteria which flexible process units partition should follow. Creatively we propose the method to construct flexible MIS based on axiomatic design. Finally we cite an example of the flexible social insurance MIS to validate this method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Calculating Tobin's Q of China Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: CRM Strategies Based on the Five Stages of Telecommunications Enterprise Customer Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on telecommunications enterprise customer relationship management (CRM) and market segmentation, this paper analyzes the main problems of customer segmentation of CRM in the telecommunications industry, and makes use of customer life cycle -this new sub-variable to compete the original breakdown variables, thus re-subdivides the telecommunications market in China. In view of different customer groups re-subdivided by the above new sub-variable, it puts forward different competitive strategies and marketing strategies of CRM to help telecommunications companies raise customer value and maintain customer loyalty. All these will upgrade the core competitiveness of telecommunications business especially under the current severe economic crisis.

articleTitle: The Supply Chain's Risk Evasion Strategy Considering the Forward Contracts with Structure of Floating Rate
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The forward contracts have recently emerged for a broad range of commodities and many companies have started to utilize them in addition to their traditional procurement via spot market. This kind of procurement makes the most of the convenience of spot market and risk evasion function of risk evasion via forward contracts. We develop and solve mathematical models that determine the optimal order quantity to purchase via forward contracts and the optimal quantity to purchase via spot markets in different spot market distribution. Considering the time value of the fund, this paper analyzes the pricing of the forward contract in the floating interest rate. Based on the research on pricing of the forward contracts, we can make further study on the decision model of the enterprises' procurement strategy.

articleTitle: An Early Detecting All-Zero DCT Blocks For Avs-P2
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an efficient algorithm to reduce redundant DCT and quantization computations for AVS-P2 encoding. A theoretical analysis is performed to study the sufficient condition for DCT coefficients to be quantized to zeros in AVS-P2. As a result, a sufficient condition derived to early detect all-zero 8 x 8 DCT blocks. Compared with original algorithms in reference software rm52j, the proposed algorithm provides a new method and efficient condition to predict all-zero DCT blocks. The experimental results demonstrate this new all-zero block method reduces the computational complexity of AVS-P2 encoder remarkably while the degradation in video quality is negligible.

articleTitle: Study of MA Protection Technology Based Extending Inheritance Trees
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mobile agents (MA) are autonomous software entities that are able to migrate across heterogeneous network execution environments, they have wide application prospects. The security issues are becoming obstacles for the application of mobile agents. Compared with host protection, the research of mobile agents active protection is at the beginning stage. Obfuscation is a technique in which the mobile code producer enforces the security policy by applying a behavior transformation to the code before sending it to run on different platforms. This paper presents a protection scheme of mobile agent in network management application, which combining method of extending inheritance hierarchy tree and time checking technology to protect the security of MA. The protection scheme is tested in actual network management environment, which can effectively identify the malicious host.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Prediction Method and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Satisfaction Degree Towards Public Transit Based on Reliability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposed a novel model to evaluate the service level of public transit in peak hour. The evaluation index are selected by using analytic hierarchy process, which includes travel time reliability, punctual arrival reliability, capacity reliability, driving skills of drivers, crowing level of vehicle, vehicle environment, and economical ticket price. The quantitative value of satisfaction degree can be obtained according to fuzzy theory. At last, the case studies are performed by two typical bus lines of Shenzhen and Beijing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Comprehensive Understanding of Refinancing and Restructuring in Project Finance Strategies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Public Health Risk Economic Growth and Health Care System : Experiential Test and Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Security Model for a Multi-Agent Negotiate Protocol Based on Bit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an efficient contract net protocol based on bit commitment in insecure open network environments. To make securea security architecture uses a bit commitment protocol and RSA algorithm which implements both encryption and digital signature. It has a high quality of security and can satisfy all the secure requirements of bid unforgeability, result verifiability, bid secrecy and it requires almost no participation of TTP.

articleTitle: An Ontology Learning Method for Product Configuration Domain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Ontology learning, which seeks to discover ontological knowledge from various forms of data automatically or semiautomatically, can overcome the bottleneck of ontology acquisition in ontology development. Now most of existed ontology construction tools only support manual building ontology and it results in lowly efficiencies, highly workloads and many mistakes etc. At the same time, it's very difficult for knowledge updating and maintenance in time. In order to resolve these problems, a framework system of domain ontology automatic construction is proposed in this paper. Through ontology learning by using existed enterprise database and huge interrelated domain knowledge in Website, product configuration domain ontology is established. Key technologies of ontology learning, such as domain concepts extraction and semantic relationships between concepts extraction in different data sources structures, are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Mining Enterprise's Knowledge Capital Based on Unascertained Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge capital is the most important capital in knowledge economy era. So, it is the valid method of improving core competence of mining enterprise to strength the knowledge capital management of mining enterprise. First, this paper establishes index system of knowledge capital of mining enterprise by analyzing the elements of knowledge capital and combining with the reality of mining enterprise. Then, the paper determines the weights of the indexes by weight entropy, and constructs a comprehensive evaluation model of knowledge capital using unascertained theory. Finally, with an example, the paper evaluates the knowledge capital of a mining enterprise using this model. This study helps the mining enterprise to improve the management of its knowledge capital and find the way to cultivate its core competence.

articleTitle: Investor Relations on the Internet: Comparison of SSE50 and Dow30
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent financial crisis, U.S. based financial institutions seems to be hurt more seriously than China based ones. Does this mean that China based capital market institutions have made great progress and do better than U.S. based ones? This study investigates investor relations related items on Web sites of listed companies in Shanghai Stock Exchange, and New York Exchange. To compare the IR efforts situation of companies in these two markets, a Web site based investor relations index WBIRX<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2009</sub> is put forward. Then, by comparison, the study shows that, despite some fast progress, both in formats and contents, SSE50 index companies are far more underdeveloped comparing with Dow30 companies. Both IR related items number, classification and quality should be improved for companies listed in Mainland China.

articleTitle: Treatment Measures of Early Water Damage on Asphalt Pavement of Freeway
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapidly development of freeway in China in recent years, the investigation of asphalt pavement performance whether in south China or in north China shows that asphalt pavement appears more or less water damage after the road has opened to traffic for one year or so. The paper analyzes the early water damage of asphalt pavement of Nanchang-Zhangshu freeway in Jiangxi Province. According to the different kinds diseases of asphalt pavement caused by early water damage, such as pumping, loose, segregation, rut, pot holes and so on, the paper analyzes the relationship between the diseases and the water damage, puts forward some treatment technology measures and construct requirements for median, catch water well, material design of pavement surface over-layer and road special position as sag vertical curves. At last, the paper puts the treatment technology and measures in practice combining with Chang-Zhang freeway maintains engineering, nearly two years service performance of the test road shows that the measures have good effect for reducing early water damage of asphalt pavement. And these have some reference value for preventing early water damage of asphalt pavement.

articleTitle: Application of the Entropy Model in the Analysis of Structural Ordering Degree on Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The type of construction project organization will change in its entire life cycle (ELC). There are different organization types in different stages, and there will be different merits or drawbacks for each type. It's qualitatively for people to choose construction project's organization type at present, and structural ordering degree can be use to choose construction project organization type quantiflcational. The ordering degree critical points for different forms of construction project organization should be put forward and the gist for quantitative selection should be provided by mean of applying the entropy model to calculate the different structure of construction project organization and making up judgment model.

articleTitle: Empirical Relationship between Interest Rate Policy and Price Stability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In last two years, people have paid more and more attentions to price fluctuations. China Centre Bank frequently uses the approach of adjusting interest rates to influence price fluctuations. This article will introduce a monetary policy model that covers different time periods, different types of interest rates and policy disturbances. It also depicts durative and directional track of interest rates impulse in the decade. And it evaluates how strong and how timely prices index reacts to interest rate policy. Finally this article does dynamic analysis on the impulse disturbance.

articleTitle: A Flow Rationing Strategy over Multiple Flow Classes on Restricted Paths
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the trend of globalization and increasing transportation volume, integrated automated shipment handling systems have appeared in major cargo terminals. In such terminals, a critical decision is the route selection linking various origins (such as system gate points) and destinations (such as storage racks). We study such a routing optimization problem and propose a flow rationing routing strategy, which reserves various sets of paths for corresponding cargos and only admits the cargos with less importance on more important paths only when their saturability is low. A Markov Decision Processes model is developed to make the decision on the admission policy. Extensive numerical experiment is conducted to prove the effectiveness of the routing strategy our proposed.

articleTitle: The Research of Safety Input-Output for Construction Enterprises in China - Based on the Case Study of Huayu Construction Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction is one of the most hazardous industries due to its unique nature. The safety records of construction sites are poor in China. Safety issues have gained vital importance throughout the construction industry. As a prerequisite to realize safety goals in construction sites, how to predict safety input and make a reasonable distribution is an important issue in the construction industry. This paper aims to find an appropriate method to calculate reasonable safety input. By analyzing the basic characteristics of safety input and using the method of input-output econometrics, the safety input is classified reasonably and an input-output model for construction enterprises is established. Based on the investigation to Huayu company, satisfied safety data, as a reliable reference, has been obtained from the input-output model. According to the data, each building enterprise can provide related safety input data to the government, enterprises and relative departments as an important foundation for future safety policy, and the enterprise may decide its operation policy and investment. In a word, it has strong practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on the Organization's Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge management as a response to globalization, changes in consumer preferences, technological advances and faster product updates and other issues arising between the market and enterprise organizations have been of concern of the theoretical and practical circles. With in-depth study of this field, many researchers have through into an unprecedented effort to knowledge management. In this paper, the existing research results have been sorted, it analysis the status quo from the activities of the mechanism of organizational knowledge, organizational coordination and control, knowledge management technology systems, and discusses the problems need to be studied in depth from above aspects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Device Discovery Mechanism Based on Lighting Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the necessity of introducing device discovery mechanism into lighting control system is analyzed, objective evaluations to the device discovery approach of traditional lighting control system is given, then their defects are pointed out. A device discovery mechanism appropriate to lighting control system is proposed, and we make it as an important judgment for measuring the device discovery mechanism of network lighting control system. At last, a feasible and effective discovery mechanism for next-generation lighting control system is supposed.

articleTitle: The Approaches of Developing Advanced Third Party Logistics Service for the Medium-Sized Third Party Logistics Service Providers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With fast development of national economy, demand for the third party logistics is largely increased. This paper firstly definite the scope and characteristics of the medium-sized third party logistics service providers. On the base of it, this paper analyzes the status in quo and current existing problems of medium-sized third party logistics service providers. And finally it puts forwards some approaches for the medium-sized third party logistics service providers to develop advanced third party logistics service.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Time Performance Frontiers and Time-Based Competition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Nash Equilibrium and the Interactive Language Teaching of College English
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Various kinds of teaching modes and methods need to be used in English teaching. The interactive approach to language teaching has provided a new space for English language teaching in colleges and universities. Nash equilibrium focuses on the combination of the dominant strategies or actions of all players. It is an effective way to improve the effectiveness of English teaching in universities by combining Nash equilibrium theory with the theory of the interactive approach to language teaching. Teachers can better analyze and master the dynamic of learning by applying Nash equilibrium effectively in interactive language teaching, so as to promote the reform of teaching methods continuously. Students can better grasp the language skills to fully enhance the use of language.

articleTitle: Inland Water Transport Decision Support System for Sustainable Development Based on Data Warehouse and On-Line Analytical Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the lack of effective evaluation on the sustainable development of inland water transport, an indicator system is designed for evaluation, illustration and checking of inland water transport sustainable development and an inland water transport decision support system for sustainable development is constructed based on data warehouse and online analytical processing (OLAP). The system structure includes 5 layers: application interface layer, auxiliary decision making function layer, warehouse management and data interface layer, information warehouse layer and data layer. The system function includes monitoring, evaluation, early warning, comprehensive analysis and search. The data warehouse is designed including determining subject, dimension design, logic model design, the choice of granularity and data partition. The subject of the data warehouse consists of the early warning indices of inland water transport sustainable development. The snow model for data warehouse consists of 4 dimensions(geological area, organization, indicator and time) and 3 granularities(annual, quarterly and monthly).The partitioning scheme for the data warehouse is to do partitioning on the geological area dimension first followed by partitioning on the organization dimension. The multidimensional decision making procedure, including slicing, dicing and rotation, is discussed. The system utilizes the data from multiple sources and provides a support for multi-objective decision making to realize the dynamic analysis, monitoring and early warning in inland water transport sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Foreign Investment on Producer Services in China: From Industrial Interaction and Systematic Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As economy goes global, a large number of foreign investment swarm into China, thus how to make good use of these investment becomes the hotspot. With the characters of high-agglomeration, high-growth and high-radiation, producer services are the important access to the adjustment industrial structure and the upgrading of regional competitiveness. Based on industry interaction and systematic research perspective, this study attempted to construct a three-dimensional scientific research framework concerning influencing factors of foreign investment in producer services. According to the correlative data of 22 provinces in China, some empirical research methods, such as multiple regressions, are adopted to analyze and validate the theoretical framework. Some references are provided for producer services of foreign investment in Tianjin and even for the industrial structure adjustment in China.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Financial Strategy of Diversification Focusing on Dynamic Matching
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Risk of E-Government System Based on QSIM and Logistic Curve
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk of e-government system hinders its development and attracts much attention. When the status of the risk is evaluated, three interrelated and interactional dimensions including disaster, victim and disaster handler should be discussed. The causes of vulnerability of the system are discussed based on evaluation and the association relation between the causes and evaluation indexes are described based on QSIM (qualitative simulation) theory. The key factors can be easily seen based on the discussion. Logistic curve theory is used to study the status of the risk of e-government system and the impact of the factors. The future research is proposed at last.

articleTitle: Leadership Performance of Social Entrepreneur in Social Entrepreneurship Service, Does Personal Value Matters?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social entrepreneurship has been rapidly emerging in the public and non-profit sectors over the last few years. Successful social entrepreneurship rely more on social entrepreneurs' personal vision and charisma to reach social mission and fulfill social needs. This paper first tries to define the personal value of social entrepreneurs and then employs the method of statistical analysis to find out the relationship between personal value and social entrepreneurs' personal leadership performance and social organizational performance corporate social capital on social entrepreneurship success. The results indicates that personal value of social entrepreneur has impressive and direct positive influence on leadership performance and social organizational performance, some reasons for the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Establishment of Integration Platforms of Clients' Organizing Interface in Large-Scale Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During the construction course of large-scale projects, as the core of all participants, the tasks of coordination clients facing are the most complex. This is the problem of clients' organizing interface management. In order to research the problem of clients' organizing interface management, this paper puts forward the conceptual model of interface integration from the perspective of clients in large-scale construction project, and considers that establishing the integration platforms of organizing interface to promote the integration abilities is the most important. Above all, this paper analyzes the significance about setting up clients' organizing interface integration platforms in large-scale construction projects. Basing on these, this paper establishes the system of clients' organizing interface integration platforms in large-scale projects. This paper holds that during the construction course of large-scale projects, clients should try to establish three kinds of organizing interface integration platforms, which are informational exchange platform, informal communication mechanism, and breaking promise punishment and keeping promise incentive mechanism, to improve the efficiency of promoting the efficiency of clients' integration abilities, and to ensure the constructions carried out smoothly.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Knowledge Enterprise' Technological Innovation Capability Based on the DHGF
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the knowledge based economy era, every enterprise seek survival and development by introducing more high technology, so innovation ability is playing an unprecedented constructive role for the knowledge based enterprise, and the technical innovation capability becomes more and more important. But technology innovation capability has many uncertainty and fuzziness in their lots of attributes, so single measure methods rarely workable. The DHGF evaluation method integrates success of the Delphi method, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP), grey theory and fuzzy evaluation method, with which we can get a comprehensive evaluation to the target enterprise with multiattribute index system. Based on the analysis to the theoretical principle, we established the index system for the knowledge enterprise' technological innovation capability, and gave the empirical analysis used by the DHGF evaluation method, and have proved that the DHGF evaluation is a more preferable method to the technical innovation capability evaluation.

articleTitle: An Exploration of the Guiding Theories on the National Geopark Tourism in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Just after a seven-year construction, China's national geopark, with its remarkable success, is making a head start in the world. But there still exist a series of problems in its development and construction due to a lack of theory of tourism of geology and the ambiguity between geology tourism and tourism geology. On the basis of the synthetic analysis of the main problems, this paper will discuss the guiding theories in different construction phases of geoparks from the perspective of geology tourism other than tourism geology and tries to form some basic theories, which can be referred to in the course of sustainable development of China's national geoparks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparison of Planning and Construction Indicators between Shanghai and International Cities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Promoting Dynamic Capabilities with Excellent Organizational Routines in Fast Changing Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evolution of organizational routine has a close relationship with firm's dynamic capabilities, between which organizational learning is an intermediary factor. Organizational routine has two aspects that influent its evolution:the ostensive aspect and the performative aspect. The former embodies what we typically think of as the structure. The latter embodies the specific actions, by specific people, at specific times and places, that bring the routine to life(Feldman&Pentland,2003). In this paper, a circular model is made, which shows the interrelationship between organizational routine evolution and organizational learning that can give rise to firm's dynamic capabilities. With a case study to the model proposed, this paper argues that the performative aspect of organizational routine contributes new knowledge to organizational learning, and the products of organizational learning are stored in the ostensive aspect of organizational routine. Pressure from environment and performing of subjective initiative which influencing the performative aspect of organizational routine can enhance the evolution of organizational routine.

articleTitle: Study on System Integration Model Based on Multi-Agent System for Coal Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the characteristics that the agent system technology can divide the system into agent with independence and independent function, achieve the higher level system function, the new idea was put forward, which is merging the existing information system and new system developed and constructed in the future, solving the ubiquitous problem of "detached island of information", realizing integration in coal enterprise, by using layered integration tactics and MAS technology. The system integration model with the core models of function agents, workflow agent and production plan optimization and mediation agent was set up. Such technological problems as standardization of agent structure, encapsulation of agent in existence, development of new agent etc. were researched.

articleTitle: The Decision Policies of Accepting or Rejecting Rental Request on Its Different Start and End Time
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Housing rental is a huge market across the world, this paper supposes that landlords offer different products distinguished by their different length of duration. When a rental request arrives, landlords' empirical choice to accept or reject it might not be a sensible decision making the expected revenue maximized in a long-term view. We structure a model to compare revenue densities of alternative choices and offer complementary numerical examples based on collected data. The result shows that landlords can make a specific choice and optimize their revenue according to our decision policy. The outcome can also be applied in general rental industry.

articleTitle: The Model of Quality Management for Emergency Based on 6Sigma
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergency is a multi-stages, multi-layered process, involving the complex emergency supplies and resources, which lead the goal to dynamic changes and non-controllable, such as material, information and etc. This paper brings 6Sigma into management of emergency project. First, it analyzes the basic principle of 6Sigma. Then, it explains process management of emergency project. Finally, it puts forward DMAIC model of process management of emergency project. DMAIC model is an advanced management pattern of multi-stages, continuing improvement and circulated ascending, which has provided the basis for the implementation of process quality control.

articleTitle: Decision Support System of Site Selection of Utilization of the Offshore Wind Energy Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Systematic analysis to site selection of utilization of the offshore wind energy is made in this paper and evaluating indicator system of site selection of making use of marine wind energy is established, we comprehensively study the way site selection with grey theory integrated method, which causes the measure results to be more scientific and reasonably that using gray statistics method to establish evaluation matrix, determining the weight of related indexes with the gray connection analysis and carrying on the comprehensive judgement for decision support with the fuzzy method. We also developed decision support information system with VB and GIS on base of this model to carry on the especial analysis and the demonstration to the region related information.

articleTitle: Building Advanced Budgeting System with SAP SEM/BA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Advanced budgeting system based on SAP SEM/BA is used by an enterprise is an effective option to inform and guide your decision making to keep your products and services competitive. This paper systematically introduces the main contents of SAP SEM/BA and analyzes how to build advanced budgeting system with SAP SEM/BA.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Correlation between Entrepreneurial Innovation and Enterprise Growth in China: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Degradation of p-Nitrophenol in Aqueous Solution by Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study on degradation of p-Nitrophenol (p-Np) in aqueous solution by ultrasound process was given in this paper. The influence on degradation and laws by several factors, which included the initial concentration, the initial pH, the energy density, the reaction temperature and the presence of saturated gas, were discussed. The results showed that the initial concentration, the initial pH, the energy density were the main factors. The p-Np of lower concentration can be degraded in lower pH and higher energy density. When the initial pH value ranged from 11 to 3, the degradation efficiency of p-Np varied from 14.8% to 50.1%; when the energy density decreased to 3.13 W/mL from 1.25 W/mL, the degradation efficiency of p-Np decreased to 8.76% from 50.1%. Moreover, within the concentration range which was studied, the reaction followed the first-order kinetic reaction, when the initial concentration was over 60 mg/L; the tendency which was the first-order rate constant with the augment of initial concentration was not obvious sufficiently. Aerating into the solution contributes the degradation of p-Np, but the efficiency was not obvious, and the variation of temperature has almost no influence on the degradation of p-Np.

articleTitle: Fiscal Influence Factors of Technique Efficiency for Counties of Central China: Stochastic Frontier Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the panel data of 498 counties of Central China from 2000 to 2006, this paper uses a stochastic frontier approach to estimate the fluctuation of technical efficiency in this region, and empirically calculates the effect of fiscal factors influencing the technical efficiency. The empirical results show that, with the implementation of "central rise" strategy, technical efficiency of counties in Central China presents a continuous increasing trend; capital plays a leading role in the process of county economic development; Increase in revenue can obviously improve the technical efficiency, while increase in expenditure will lower the technical efficiency. Reducing the fiscal deficit and improving the utilization efficiency of the fiscal expenditure are important measures to improve the technical efficiency of county economy in Central China.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Effectiveness of Computer-and-Classroom-Based College English Teaching Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of Web technology has brought a new insight into China's English language teaching and learning. This paper is a one-and-a-half-year experiment of testing the effectiveness of two teaching methods based on the computer and traditional classrooms in Wuhan University of Technology. Two classes of students from both the higher level (Level A) and the average level (Level B) of grade 2006 were taught by the Online Learning Plus model and the other two classes from the two levels were taught by the Online Learning Alone model. The goal was to optimize students' language learning and to find a new direction of teaching innovation. The final results indicated that it was highly likely that there existed real differences in student learning as a function of teaching methods. The Online Learning Plus model was proved to be superior to the Online Alone model for both the higher-level students and the average-level students.

articleTitle: The Assessment Model about the Disaster-Bearing Capacity of City's Lifeline after Dam-Break
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on system value engineering and grey theory, an assessment model about the disaster-bearing capacity of city's lifeline after dam-break is put forward. First, the connective reliability of the city's lifeline after dam-break is put forward. Second, the relation between loss and function is established and the loss through function reliability is obtained. At last, the assessment model about disaster-bearing capacity of city's lifeline after dam-break is finished through the balance between the loss and the connectivity reliability of the city's lifeline and a numerical example is given to show its application. This model overcomes some deficiencies of traditional assessment method, such as lack of correlation analysis and causal analysis of the factors and loss. It can be used for making safety and reliability evaluation for complex systems.

articleTitle: A Study on the Inter-Influence of Science and Technology Progress and Chinese Textile Industry Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the basic characters of corporations competition are changing, a new hyper competition time is coming. Therefore, the function on the economic growth of the science and technology progress is more and more remarkable, and it has already become the source of economic growth and forever motive force. The science and technology progress influences not only the speed of the economic growth but also the quality and the way of the economic growth directly. This article takes Chinese textile industry as the example, analysis the influence of science and technology progress to textile industry economic growth, The main research of the article is to find out the question between science and technology progress and textile industry economic growth, put forward the countermeasure and suggestion to promote national and regional scientific and technology progress and influence each other in economy growth greatly, and promote the style of Chinese textile economic growth change from extensive style to intensive style.

articleTitle: Selection of Residential Land Based on Integration of MCDA and Gravity Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) is a decision-making method based on multi-criteria, which considers the influences of multi-criteria on the demanding objectives. It helps decision makers sorting viable scenarios and selecting the most appropriate scenario. In residential land selection process, MCDA is applied to analyze the influences of natural and ecological factors on the suitability of residential land. And the gravity model is used to analyze the accessibility by modeling the accessibility potential surface in GIS. The data used include spatial data (road network, district and street boundaries etc.), physical condition data, ecological and environmental data, public facility data, and environment condition data such as noise, air pollution. The detailed method is introduced in this paper as well as a case study of using the proposed method in Wuchang district, Wuhan, China. The testing results show the effectiveness of the proposed quantitative analysis method in urban planning.

articleTitle: Evaluating Collaborative Design Systems Organizational Performance by Using Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the advancement of technology, customers and vendors collaborative design systems is already the existing trend. Previous study has shown that the efficient exchange and sharing of product data through out the lifecycle is critical to the collaborative design. The main purpose of this research is to proposed collaborative design information systems that can effectively integrate suppliers and client resources. As a result of other different industries, and its information system collaborative design process will be different. Approach: This study places the focus the use of Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) decision support tool for collaborative design information system in Taiwan Highway Bureau's Control Information Systems (CIS) of case study analysis. Conclusions: Combination of AHP-based approach proposed in this paper can provide decision makers with a more balanced, realistic, and accurate representation of the risk and challenge of conducting collaborative design for control information system.

articleTitle: Improvement to Fair Algorithms in Resilient Packet Rings
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first introduces two kinds of fair algorithms in resilient packet ring networks, the operation mechanism of each algorithm is discussed in detail and their drawback is also analyzed. We enhance these two algorithms by modifying the calculation for fair rate. Through theoretical analysis and simulations, we show that the improved algorithms can reduce the oscillations of the sending rate greatly and achieves better link utilization.

articleTitle: Using Mobile Knowledge Management on WirelessNetwork: Perceived Self-Efficacy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the wireless network, the important knowledge management is quickly acquired the right knowledge using mobile devices. It can be increased self belief and work efficiency. The recent years study show that perceived ease of use and perceived usefulness constructs of technology acceptance model have been considered important in determining the individuals' acceptance and use of IT. In this study, we will introduce the self-efficacy as a new factor that reflects the characteristic of the mobile knowledge management. This paper addresses why users can be used mobile knowledge management and how user's using is affected by the self-efficacy. The results showed that the research model mediated the usage behavior intentions even in the mobile knowledge management through the wireless network environment.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Online Purchase Behavior: Implications to Improve the Existing Credit Rating System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dishonest sellers, low-quality merchandise, invalid credit evaluation system, low efficient dispute-resolution mechanism are the key factors that make credit become primary concern for consumers making online consumption decision, and hamper the development of C-C market. This article firstly analyzes consumers' demand and behavioral characteristics and the occurred problems of credit system, then focuses on how consumer perceive the credit status and make decision based on Theory of Reasoned Action; further, it sets up a Model of Four Aspects to explain how the factors from four aspects affect consumer's building confidence. Credit assessment index and consumer behavior intention index are put forward as the main factors which affect online consumer confidence and generate consumption behavior. Finally, this paper makes substantive recommendations to improve the existing credit system.

articleTitle: Development and Application of City Three-Dimensional Foundation Information Consultant System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A city three-dimensional foundation information consultant system is developed based on random field theory to predict unknown geotechnical parameters. Taking the geographical information system (GIS) as development platform, the general structure module and database of the system is designed. By means of writing programs in Mapinfo, Visual Basic and Excel, dynamic multi-way inquiry, statistics can be carried on. Random field prediction of engineering geotechnical parameters can be obtained with optimum estimation. Especially the output of visual prediction database and three-dimensional prediction graph may provide a good policy-making support service for the city foundation information management. As an example, this developed system is applied to manage engineering geological data of drilling holes in a city successfully.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Efficiency Subsidy Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper develops an optimal energy efficiency subsidy model and analyze it. Consumer choice failure is necessary for subsidies to be warranted when electricity prices are too high. To deal with consumer choices failure, it portrays welfare effects of subsidizing efficiency by assigning the full welfare benefits of those investments through expansion of the set of individuals. Such an ascription is inconsistent with basing welfare on revealed preference, but the inconsistency is an inevitable consequence of assuming that consumers fail to act in their self-interest by under-investing in efficiency. Analyzing these models reveals that if the gain in surplus from those overcoming consumer choice failure is simply reduced spending on energy, and if no consumers make such investments on their own, then capping the revenues of a generator or utility selling electricity will induce it to substitute energy efficiency for generation when doing so is less costly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Value-Integrated Mechanism of Total Customer Participation: A Knowledge Management Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Measurement and Control of Strategic Risk-Taking Capacity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays internal control is treated the same as risk management and forms an important part of strategic decision making, but putting strategic internal control into practice is difficult. This is mainly because the way to measure risk and the point where to control it are hard to determine. This report suggests to more realistically look at the sum-effect of all risks, from the perspective of finance. A simple model is presented based on system dynamics, giving a complete view of the total financial risk-taking capacity of an enterprise. In combination with a unified organization to coordinate the whole internal control system, this will greatly assist company in achieving its business' strategic vision.

articleTitle: Contributing Factors Analysis of China Stock Markets Causality Based on Scales
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Granger causality test is combined with the wavelet multi-resolution analysis to decompose the return series of stock markets index into different scale components. From the aspect of scale components, the reason that causality from Shanghai stock market return to Shenzhen's is valid and the reverse causality is invalid is analyzed. The conclusion can be the prove for studying the relationship between the two markets together with its causes and trend.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm Research of Infrared Radiation - Temperature Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Infrared imaging is the concentrative embodiment of the highest level of contemporary infrared technology, and infrared imaging technology becomes one of the key technologies of current national defense science and technology. In the infrared imaging simulation, after gaining the temperature of object scene, firstly establish the radiation temperature model to calculate the radiation quantum of object, and then produce the infrared images according to the gray mapping model. In addition, when calculate object real temperature with the measured temperature from thermograph, temperature value need to anti-count with radiation temperature model. This paper gives an optimization algorithm by least-squares fitting in allusion to the calculating complexity by Planck formula. By comparing performance, it is proved that this algorithm can greatly reduce the calculating time in precondition of guaranteeing the accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimal Weighted Approach in Dual-Response Surface Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dual-response surface method is a powerful method for simultaneously optimizing the mean and the variance of responses in quality engineering, in which the minimization of the mean squared error (MSE) is an effective approach. To date, the relative weights of bias and variance have been equally set or determined only by the data. However, the weights should be determined according to the tradeoffs on decision maker's preference. In this paper, we proposed an optimal weighted mean squared error (MSE) approach to determine the weights of bias and variance based on both a decision maker's preference structure and the data. In addition, examples are given to illustrate the proposed approach and compared with other existing procedures.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Derivative Pricing of Knock Out Discount Accumulator
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Constitution and Calculation Method Research on Environmental Cost by Petroleum Exploration Industrial: A Case Study of Daqing City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper in the perspective of environmental cost calculation is intent to unravel activities, relevant to petroleum exploration, would cast chilly effects on city and regional ecological environment, in the way of value performance model to attracting great attention of whole society. This paper provides a conception of environmental cost, constitution of that cost, classification, quantification and expression form, on the ground of documents summarizing and ingesting. Apply a case study of oil exploration industry in Daqing city-the engine of China industrial, moreover analyzing effects on city and regional ecological environment, according to the three aspects that composed environmental cost. In the end, Calculating and estimating environmental cost, and discovery a new path, under the perspective of geography, other than traditional methods, a unique idea and method, of environmental cost calculation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Performance Evaluation of Production Line Workers from the Perspective of Strategy Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Supply Chain System Based on TOC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the economic crisis background, the maintenance function has evolved from being centered on short term questions such as the use of resources and allocation of costs to strategic considerations such as asset profit enhancement and fast response to the market demand.
