In this paper, our objective is to jointly optimize the maintenance of a capacity-constrained node, it's feed node and inlet buffer size in a supply chain system. By the development of a basic supply chain model, the optimization is achieved, and an empirical example is used to illustrate the application of the model.

articleTitle: Assessment on Social and Economic Development in the Underdeveloped Regions in China: A Case Study in the Lanzhou-Xining Town-Compact Region
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the present situation of social and economic development in the Lanzhou-Xining town-compact region in the underdeveloped Gansu and Qinghai provinces in China is assessed by selecting 22 indexes related to the social and economic development and using the multivariable statistical factor analysis, breakpoint model, variance analysis, etc. The followings are the results. First, all the counties have the low social and economic development levels. Second, the industry has the position deficiency of oriented economic development of county-level. Third, it is the extremely unbalanced social and economic development level among different counties and different industries within each county. Fourth, it is a decrease of social and economic development levels of counties from the central cities towards the peripheral regions in a hierarchical structure. Fifth, there are high social and economic development levels for these counties along the main traffic lines. Sixth, it is high correlation between social and economic development levels and education development levels. In general, the situation of regional social and economic development presents the "pointaxis" economic growth mode. For the regional development in the future, it is suggested to organize the social and economic activities with the "point-axis system" mode and strengthen the diffusion effect of the central cities. Furthermore, with the supports from state of scheme, policy, fund to raise the regional socio-economic development and reduce the difference of the per capita living standard and the basic public services from the relatively developed area.

articleTitle: Research on Tunnel Three-Dimensional Information Inquiry System Based on ArcGIS Engine
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: 3D GIS is the newest trend of GIS science development. At present, the 3D display is mainly based on the virtual reality technology. We attempt to unify the ArcGIS engine platform and the 3D modeling software multigen creator to establish 3D GIS. Finally, a 3D tunnel information inquiry system is established, which can provide a new method for the establishment of 3D tunnel information platforms.

articleTitle: Choosing a Path for Governmental Administrative Decision in Netizen Participation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development and popularization of network information technology has been promoting network to be one of the most important channels and means of citizen participation and governmental decision-making as well. Under the background of netizen participation, new developing challenges are facing governmental decision-making as new opportunities being brought to it. This paper aims to discuss the choices of governmental administrative decision by taking netizen participation into consideration.

articleTitle: Study of Neighborhood Relationship in China Urban Residential Community in the Age of Internet
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the investigation of the urban residential communities in Beijing and Xuzhou, this article analyses Internet's influence on neighborhood relationship from three aspects: communication, participation and consciousness. Internet provides a wide selection for residents' communication. Instead of being an obstacle, Internet has become a new method to promote neighborhood relationship. That means Internet could affect positively on the shaping of a new neighborhood relationship in China urban residential communities.

articleTitle: An Approach to Text Knowledge Analysis Based on Many-Valued Context
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Text knowledge analysis plays a very important role in knowledge processing. In order to find interesting patters, we introduce text analysis into the formal concept analysis(FCA) field. FCA is a valid tool for data mining and knowledge processing. In the paper, we present a method for extracting the conceptual patterns and concept lattice from multiple knowledge sources. The method consists of two steps: the first is to insert some related many-valued contexts (MVCs) (which represent text knowledge) into some corresponding column or cell of other MVC in accordance with certain rules, and then extract formal concepts and concept lattice. Our insertion method not only is semantic-preserving, but adds the dimension of attributes for describing objects. Hence, the discovered concepts have the more richer intents and are more denser in the concept lattice. The paper mainly applied the method to column insertion operation and cell insertion operation, and obtained some propositions, which can be used by knowledge engineers to represent and analyze text knowledge (especially, text objects) and to extract new semantics information or associate rules from concept lattices.

articleTitle: Analysis of Building the Flexible IT Strategy of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the progress of society, operational environment of enterprises has changed greatly. Enterprises have to transform their strategies of operation and have some flexibility in order to adapt the new requirements of market. Information technology brings some hopes for enterprises to improve their efficiency of business. This paper mainly studies the flexible IT strategy from three aspects. Firstly, this paper discusses flexibility of enterprises and reengineering of organization, and analyzes the efficient causes of flexibility of enterprises. Secondly, rigidity and flexibility of IT are analyzed in this paper, and we propose that modern enterprises should have some visibility and flexibility of strategy in order to adapt the demands of changes. Finally, this paper describes some viewpoints on choice of IT strategy based on the view-angle of flexibility, and discusses three flexibility granularity of IT strategies of enterprises.

articleTitle: Exergy Efficiency Performance on a Thermoacoustic Engine Micro-Cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thermoacoustic engine micro-cycle is of great importance to the thermoacoustic phenomenon. By taking an exergy efficiency criterion as the objective, the performance of a thermoacoustic engine micro-cycle model with heat transfer loss was analyzed by using finite-time thermodynamics. The analytical expression about the exergy efficiency is derived. The relations between the exergy efficiency and the oscillating temperature, the exergy efficiency and the heat efficiency, as well as the exergy efficiency and the sound work output rate relation of the micro-cycle are investigated by numerical examples. The results obtained herein can provide some theoretical guidance for the design of a real thermoacoustic engine.

articleTitle: Asymptotics of Discounted Aggregate Claims for Renewal Model with Risky Investment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the assumption that the claimsize is subexponentially distributed and the insurance surplus is totally invested in risky asset, a simple asymptotic formula of discounted aggregate claims for renewal risk model within finite horizon is obtained. The main results we derived extend the corresponding conclusion of related references.

articleTitle: A Social Web Approach to Managing Information and Knowledge in the AEC Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As Social Web applications have begun to dominate the Internet and changed the way in which people communicate, there is a need to study the application of Social Web concepts in managing information and knowledge. This paper discusses the potential for using four types of social interaction (social tagging, wiki, blogging, and social networking) in the AEC industry.

articleTitle: Using RBAC to Enforce Solaris System Security
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Security of operating system is the most important part of a system. Role-based access control (RBAC) is a security feature, also is the hotspot of access control filed. This paper mainly introduces the feature of Solaris RBAC model, the relationship of RBAC elements in Solaris, analyzes the cooperating work of roles, privileges and authorizations in Solaris RBAC. By testing planning and configuring RBAC in Solaris, the experiments prove that RBAC and privileges provide a more secure alternative to superuser, can enforce the Solaris system security effectively.

articleTitle: Detecting Knowledge Activities of Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Today, knowledge is becoming an important element of economic activity and the competitiveness of enterprises increasingly, the study on knowledge activities of the cluster is inevitable. This paper detects the characteristics of knowledge and knowledge activities of clusters and establishes a model of cluster knowledge activities. It holds a corresponding discussion about the mathematical model and points out if following those directions internal intellectual activity efficiency can be achieved: improving elements and resources being used for the knowledge innovation, production and acquisition, selection and Internalization; strengthening the exchange of information among members thus to improve the sensitivity of the market trends and accuracy; accelerating the proliferation of new knowledge strategies.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Effects of Share Retention and Lockup on IPO Underpricing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, with the data of the 226 companies listed on Shanghai security exchange and Shenzhen security exchange during sample period between January 2006 and September 2008, the effects of company owner's retention and lockup on underpricing are investigated by using the multivariate regression model. The regression results show that the share retention and lockup ratio is positively correlated to IPO underpricing in Shanghai stock market, but in Shenzhen stock market these two factors negatively affect on IPO underpricing; The results of the regression of lockup period show that, whether in Shanghai or Shenzhen stock market, the lockup period is not related to the underpricing significantly.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Some Urban Public Traffic Networks in South China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we present the empirical investigation results on the urban public traffic networks (PTNs). We study four urban public traffic networks in south China, which are the urban public traffic networks of Guangzhou, Changsha, Zhuhai and Xiamin. The empirical results on the four big cities show that the accumulative act degree distributions of PTNs take neither power function forms, nor exponential function forms, but they are described by two power piecewise function. We also study the accumulative act size distributions of PTNs of the four cities, and they are described with a shifted Poisson distribution. In the end we shall explain the reason why the degree distribution of PTNs is difference from that of the other complex networks.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Knowledge Management Implementing Performance of Large and Medium Enterprises in Heilongjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on existed theory of knowledge management, this paper chooses the large and medium enterprises in Heilongjiang as subjects. The questionnaire that involves more than 100 enterprises is made whose results are analyzed by Structural Equation Model (SEM) in terms of large sample analysis. Consequently, this paper establishes tests and modifies the effecting factors model of knowledge management implementing performance, which reveals the relationship between knowledge management concept, knowledge management activity, knowledge management technique & staff and knowledge management implementing performance respectively. Besides, in terms of the characters and practical conditions of large and medium enterprises in Heilongjiang, a set of improving suggestions and recommendations has been figured out so as to facilitate enterprises' knowledge management implementing.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Chinese Telecommunication Market Development Based on the Diffusion Model of the Network Innovations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The diffusion model of the innovations in the market has been combined with the average revenue per user model of the innovative products, and the revenue model for the different vendors has been submitted afterwards. Based on the models, the empirical study has been done for China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom and China Netcom using the date from 2002 to 2007, including the growing numbers of the subscribers, average revenue per user and the main operating revenues. In addition, the analysis and forecast of the revenues and the market share changes of the dominating Chinese telecommunication carriers both before and after their restructuring have been given. The results will provide the decision-making reference for the relevant administrations and enterprises' managements.

articleTitle: A Study of the Relationship between the Values and Consumer Decision-Making Style of Telecommunications Services of University Students
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, in the field of consumer behavior research, the study of consumer decision-making style from the perspective of the values is the widespread concerned subject. The purpose of this study is to explore the relationship between personal values and consumer decision-making style of telecommunications services of university students by a 651-questionnaire survey. Based on literature review and data collection, this paper adopts exploratory factor analysis (EFA), confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and correlation analysis (CA), and finally points out the conclusions and the limitations of this study.

articleTitle: Product Quality Control Based on Collaborative Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the network manufacture, the difficulties and complications of remote quality control come from a lot of factors such as the complication of system, the multiplicity of the products, and the extensiveness of information and the higher requirements of the clients especially the different manufacture source of the parts, materials, equipments, processes, industrial standards, and the difference of the operators' skills. This paper begins with the analysis of characteristics of quality control under coordinated produce condition and obtains the architecture of quality coordinated control system in the remote manufacture; and then analyses the BP model of fuzzy neural network, finally uses an example to introduce the adjusting method of product quality target control.

articleTitle: The Research on the Influencing Factors of the Engineering Quality and Gray Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyses the factors of influencing the engineering quality in each stage in a system view, points out the reasons of the engineering quality's accident. Then it puts the gray system theory into engineering quality analysis and determines the primary and secondary relations between the factors of influencing the engineering quality. At last, puts forward different quality control measures according to different quality reasons, and this also establishes the theoretical foundation for quality control.

articleTitle: Office Environmental Satisfaction Analysis in Australia
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous research showed that satisfaction with one or more environmental factor does not necessarily produce equal satisfaction with the total environment and not all factors are equally important. In addition, the relative importance of the various factors differed from country to country. In order to gain a better understanding of the influential factors of office environmental satisfaction in Australia, this paper hence aims to apply the AHP to quantify the critical influential factors for the employees' satisfaction with the office environment in Australia. The findings from this research have provided some insights for the quantitative measurement of critical factors for office environmental satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of R&D Process Cooperative Work
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the connotation of R&D process cooperative work, establishes the structural equation model of the relationship between R&D process recognition, R&D process design, R&D process execution and R&D process achievement, and obtains the following conclusions based on exploratory factor analysis, confirmatory factor analysis and overall structural equation model analysis: in cooperative R&D system, R&D process recognition and R&D process design are both positively correlated to R&D process execution and R&D process achievement, and R&D process execution is also positively correlated to R&D process achievement.

articleTitle: Systems Archetype Analysis of Entrepreneur's Competency Model - Hidden Systems and Imagined Leverage: Obstacles to Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Successful innovation and entrepreneurship demand a competent leader. This project found that a leader's competency and thus the successful innovation and entrepreneurship mainly depend on the leader's C.I-ability (Communication and Information processing). A straightforward, simple model is presented based on system dynamics, for which several new concepts are defined: the C.I.-ability archetype and Imagined Leverage. The out-of-proportion effect that single actions unknowingly and unwittingly have is recognized and defined as the Three-Singles-Effect. This report explains the few basic concepts that define and control leader competency, while another presents the model to quantify it, the resulting combination of simplicity and quantification being unique in competency modeling.

articleTitle: MultiFractal Distribution of Soil Arsenic in Tongling City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In soil environmental science, local accuracy in high value area and the local singularity of contaminating elements in soil is particularly concerned, for it provides significant information for pollution assessment and analysis. Traditional geostatistics interpolation could not reflect those types of information accurately, attributing to its smoothing effect. In this paper, we applied multifractal method, which is considered to be a powerful tool to enhance local singularity, to study the spatial distribution of Arsenic in soil in Tongling, China. The results show that there is strong spatial self-similarity exhibited in pattern of Arsenic in the soil. The Comparison between maps of kriging and multifractal method indicates that the latter enhanced and retained the local structure, and could reflect the singularity of spatial distribution more effectively. The method can be widely applied to the study of spatial distribution of element in soil, especially the heavy metal in soil of mining city.

articleTitle: Research on the Configuration of Early-Warning Management System for Urban Bridge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bridge accidents occur frequently, so new system/idea must be introduced to keep bridge safe, and then to protect public possessions and lives. From the safety science point of view, it's pointed out that safety early-warning system of urban bridge is mainly composed of four factors: human, bridge, environment and management, based on the state of the art of bridge safety. Primary configuration of safety early-warning management system for urban bridge is put forward, which is formed from four subsystems: human factor control subsystem, bridge condition monitoring and forecasting subsystem, bridge accidents and emergency disposal subsystem and urban bridge safety early-warning management subsystem. It makes some beneficial attempt for a more serviceable urban bridge management system.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Function of Local Governments' Official Tourism Websites - A Perspective of Internet Marketing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper evaluated the e-commerce function of 31 provinces' official tourism websites in mainland China from the perspective of Internet marketing. The assessment was conducted mainly from the following five aspects: marketing strategy, information serving, transaction processing, technology supporting and website operating. The results indicate that most official tourism Web sites are at the preliminary stage of information providing. It is necessary to improve the functions of implementing the destination marketing strategy, transaction processing and so on. As far as the eastern, middle and western parts of China are concerned, there are no significant differences among different regions in the official tourism websites' Internet marketing function. Finally, the authors put forward some suggestions for further development of official tourism websites.

articleTitle: Study on Regional Water-Saving Effects of Irrigation Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From three aspects of irrigation water source, regional water resources, and crops yield increase, this paper brings forward a new method to assess regional water-saving effect of different irrigation projects. The expressions of regional water-saving effects have been derived, and a practical example has been provided to illustrate how to use the formulas to assess regional water-saving effects, obviously this method also can be used to improve management of water-saving irrigation projects.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Customer Participation on Service Innovation in Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service innovation has become an important means to meet challenges and gain competitive advantages for domestic commercial banks. Customer participation in the process of innovation is the most significant characteristic of service innovation in commercial banks. This article proposes that the essence of the process of service innovation in commercial banks is knowledge transfer, and then select customer knowledge transfer as intermediate variable to explore the impact of customer participation in the process of innovation on the performance of service innovation in commercial banks. Data collected from the commercial banks in Harbin indicate that customer participation has a positive impact on service innovation performance in commercial banks, but the impact is realized through the intermediate function of customer knowledge transfer, that is, three dimensions of customer participation trough affecting customer knowledge transfer, thereby affect service innovation performance.

articleTitle: The Research of Distance Education System Based on P2P and CDN Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces design and implementation of distance education system based on P2P (peer to peer) and CDN (content delivery network) technology. The text gives the design of living, VOD (video on demand), testing and the conclusion at finally in the paper. Users can get the service of video on demand and living in the Web, be able to significantly save bandwidth and server costs. The P2P+CDN streaming media distance system is designed for bandwidth bottleneck and Web server based on the current mode of distance education network technology does not support the existence of dynamic multimedia data and real-time streaming data problem. Each node in the network is both a service provider and consumer, the system solved the problem of Web service model and streaming media, and have the advantage of low bandwidth and server capacity, easy to deploy and high scalable.

articleTitle: Vessel Collision Force Protection for Bridge Piers Determined According to Probability Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Now the city traffic development is rapid. The vessel collision force protection based on the probability method in AASHTO LRFD. Vessel-bridge collisions occur frequently, which cause the hidden troubles to the operation of bridges and ships, and thus induce a new research. In this paper, by using the fundamental dynamics principle of ship-bridge collision and mathematical probability statistics, the acceptable collision damage probability of bridge is analyzed, the numerical model of vessel-bridge collision is established, and the simulation analysis method is proposed. An feasible scheme and some related facilities for vessel collision force protection design are proposed, which can prevent vessel-bridge collision, and reduce the hidden troubles of collision, to assure the safety of both water and land traffic operation. In the future, it is expected that the clarification may provide reference for the vessel collision force protection for bridges in China.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation Model of Interconnected Regional Electric Grid Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The necessity of interconnecting electric power grid among regions is proved by analyzing the characteristics and problems of the interconnected power grid. This paper establishes a cooperative game model based on multi-person cooperative game by ways of game theory, and Shapley value method was adopted to solve the model. The calculation of a case results show that this cooperative game model is helpful to incarnate the influence among the members, distribution results are more rational than traditional methods. An improved model was proposed considering the personalized costs of each regional power grid. Thus it can be used for optimal decision of electricity transaction.

articleTitle: Model of Enterprise Financial Risk Evaluation and Its Application Based on the Incomplete Linguistic Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the model of enterprise financial risk evaluation is proposed on the basis of modern multiple attribute linguistic evaluation method. The method of evaluation based on uncertain extended ordered weighed averaging (UEOWA) operator is given under the incomplete linguistic information. The example of evaluation for enterprise financial risk is presented to show the feasibility and effectiveness of this method. This can offer a new approach for the evaluation of enterprise financial risk.

articleTitle: Xixi Mode: Study on City Operation for Wetland Park
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The comprehensive protection of Hangzhou Xixi Wetland park is an important part in the organic renovation of Hangzhou. This article introduced and analyzed the three-stage protection project within the city operation system from the aspects of conception, implementation process and effects. It also probed into the theoretical and practical experience and mode of city operation for Wetland park.

articleTitle: Integrating Linkage Effect Analysis Using I-O Method and DEA-Oriented Performance Assessment on China's LED Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Input-output (I-O) analysis and data envelopment analysis (DEA) are tools that both can be used in study on the production process. Whilst these two types of model are similar in structure, I-O analysis is directed to assessing performance consequents to the other sectors as a basis for determining the role of an industry and DEA to assessing performance consequents to the industry itself as part of development planning function. This paper is a joint application of I-O analysis and DEA to study on China's LED industry. This study, therefore, has two major goals. The first is obtaining at least a preliminary indication of the role of the LED industry by addressing inter-industry linkage effects in 42 sectors. The second goal is getting some useful information for industry development planning through examining input-output efficiency.

articleTitle: A B3C E-Business Model for Chain Industry Based on Third-Party Payment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the development bottleneck of third-party payment and chain industry, this paper raised a B3C e-business model for chain industry in which third-party payment plays an important role. The author took focus on improving the traditional B2C model and strengthening the function of third-party payment enterprises in supply chain, that is to say, third-party payment enterprises participate in systems of commodity marketing, electronic payment and settlement, chain stores management, and so on. The paper introduced this solution of e-business for chain industry from four aspects: network sale, Internet payment and settlement, chain stores evaluation and management, joint cyber-marketing.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise's Transnational Merger and Acquisition Risks under Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: March 18th, 2009, Ministry of Commerce officially announced that they overruled the transnational merger and acquisition between Coca-Cola and Huiyuan. In this article, I believe that the main source of M&A risk is the information asymmetry, so we will combine the case Coca-Cola and Huiyuan's transnational merger and acquisition, and explore the risks under asymmetric information. The paper focuses on the pricing risk of asymmetric information and introduces the signaling game theory. At the end, some preventive measures are given.

articleTitle: A Model Explaining the Paradoxes of Private Benefits of Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Researches related to PBC has found some inconsistent questions called Paradoxes of PBC under the formalism which considers that PBC is harmful to small shareholders. This theory reminds that present views on PBC may distort the nature of large shareholder encroachment. This paper introduces a model to explain the Paradoxes of PBC, and the results shows that some proper PBC has incentive effects. Furthermore, excessive PBC will be harmful to small shareholders and firm value, so it should be remedied.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis Based Optimum Design of Inpatients Satisfaction Degree Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The correlation analysis method on questionnaire investigation data is proposed to optimize primary satisfaction degree assessment method by analyzing current problems in satisfaction degree evaluation index system in order to make sure the independence among assessment data. The evaluation indexes of the inpatient satisfaction degree are established through correlation analysis of 34 primary assessment satisfaction data in 5 evaluation index systems, which are medical technique data of doctor, situation of hospital care, service attitude of staffs, facility conditions, and doctor's moral. The evaluation index system optimized by correlation analysis not only maintains reliability and efficiency and also improves the practicability and applicability of assessment.

articleTitle: The Bullwhip Reduction in Supply Chains with Simple Order-Up-To Policy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The bullwhip problem in supply chain is first outlined. It's followed by the overview of bullwhip measures both in statistical and control engineering approaches. Then a widely researched simple Order-Up-To (OUT) policy is presented. To find a way to reduce the variance amplification, we tried the optimal MMSE forecast to AR(1) demand process. After applying a novel metric from discrete control theory, the exact analytical expressions of variance amplification are obtained. Further investigation shows several insights about how to mitigate the bullwhip effect in certain type of supply chain concerned in this paper. In despite of the variance amplification characteristic guaranteed by most researchers, this proves that the bullwhip effect is controllable even within simple OUT policy. Besides replenishment rules, we conclude in this paper that the demand patterns and forecasting methods also play an important role in variance decreasing.

articleTitle: A Grey-Artificial Neural Network Stochastic Volatility Model for Return Volatility
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we develop a new concept of volatility models. The objective is to apply grey residual and artificial neural network into stochastic volatility to estimate return volatility.

articleTitle: Research on the Growth Trajectory of Communication, Computer and Other Electronic Equipment Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the growth trajectory of communication, computer and other electronic equipment (CCEE) industry over the period of 1991-2006 by Simple Logistic Growth Model and Bi-logistic Growth Model, the analytical results indicate that there are two different growth trajectories among them. The sub-industries belonging to the second trajectory have Granger Casualty relation with software industry. In addition, the internal rate of return to R&D and the growth rate of total factor productivity (TFP) kept an increasing trend before 2003, but has changed to decrease since that year, which indicated that CCEE industry begins to change from rapid growth period to relatively slow growth mature period.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Total Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Construction Quality Guarantee System of Power Transmission and Transformation Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Quality of power transmission and transformation project is important to the development of national economy and people's life. The construction quality guarantee is much more difficult with the project becoming more and more complex. So this paper tries to form a perfect construction quality guarantee system. It mainly contains the construction quality objectives, the plan of construction quality, the thought guarantee system, the organizations guarantee system, the work guarantee system and the quality control information system.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship between Network Competence and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network competence is the base of creating and maintaining sustainable competitive advantage. The paper explains the internal mechanism between network competence and firm performance. We separately discuss the definition of network competence, network learning and network power, and analyze the relationship among network competence, network learning, network power and firm performance. We also promote a conceptual framework and the hypothesis, and look forward to future study.

articleTitle: Study on the Division of Logistics Hub and Its Influence Scope in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of the logistics industry has strongly driven the growth of the national economy. It is a comprehensive industry which includes service and equipment production. This paper attempts to identify the division of logistics hub and its influence Scope. The paper builds comprehensive evaluation index system of logistics development level, calculates and compares the evaluation scores and the spatial differentiation. Considering geometric particularity of Voronoi diagram, the rationality for dividing up space and the solvability by computer, the paper tries to apply it in the studying of delimitation of influenced area, and gives an analytic demonstration taking the logistics of provinces and cities in China as an example. Some conclusions have been obtained as follows: (1) the influenced area of the logistics is essentially in their administrative region in China. And the influenced area of the provinces and cities which have a higher integrative strength scores, usually covers a wider area than its actual administrative region, on the contrary, the influenced area of the provinces and cities which have a lower integrative strength scores, covers a smaller area than its actual administrative region; (2) The eastern and the central of China with a bigger density have a smaller influence radius, and the absolute influenced area is not so wide. The situation of the western goes to the opposite; (3) the Guangzhou, Shanghai and Beijing as the core of the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta and the Bohai region, have become logistics industry development hub in China, and radiated the surrounding provinces and cities, showed their respective sphere of influence.

articleTitle: Realization of Lowpass and Bandpass Leapfrog Filters Using OAs and CCCIIs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The systematic procedure for realizing lowpass and bandpass leapfrog ladder filters using only active elements is presented. The proposed architecture is composed of only two fundamental active building blocks, i.e., an operational amplifier (OA) and a current controlled conveyor II (CCCII), without external passive element requirement, making the approach conveniently for further integrated circuit implementation with systematic design and dense layout. The characteristic of the current transfer function can be adjusted by varying the external bias currents of CCCIIs. As illustrations to demonstrate the systematic realization of current-mode ladder filters, a 3rd-order Butterworth low-pass filter and a 6th-order Chebyshev bandpass filter are designed and simulated using PSPICE.

articleTitle: Ruin Probability in the Presence of Risky Investment by Insurance Capital
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper researches the ruin probability with insurance capital investing in risky asset. Under the assumptions that the claim-arrival follows renewal process and the claimsize is of Pareto distribution, by using BlackScholes formula to re-express the surplus process, the asymptotic formulae of finite and infinite time ruin probability are derived. Relationship between ruin probability and renewal function is obtained. In addition to this, the connection between ruin probability and volatility coefficient is also derived. The results extend the corresponding conclusions of some references, such as Kluppelberg, Stadtmuller (1991) and Tang (2005).

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Equity Mispricing and Market Timing Behaviour of Equity Financing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the hypothesis about irrational market would induce the equity mispricing, we forming a mispricing index to measure equity misevaluation, an empirical study of the panel data of Dow Jones China 88 from 2000 to 2004 is carried out to explore the relationship between equity mispricing and timing of equity financing. Research finds that, by controlling the other variables, equity mispricing index has a negative impact on selection of corporate capital structure. The higher the equity is overvalued, the more likely the corporate choose equity financing; corporate with intense capital structure constraint are more likely choose debt financing, which indicates that there is market timing behaviour of equity financing in Chinese blue chips.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi-Protocol Compatible RFID Reader Used in Warehouse Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of large scale integrated circuit, internet communication, information security and so on, Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has entered the commercial application stage, to be the most actively and promising high-tech in modern information technology field it plays a tremendous role in promoting humanity enters a information-based and digital society. Now a big trouble in promoting RFID technology's widely used is Cost Barriers which cumbers its scale and socialization application. In order to be suitable for different kind of protocols and save cost, A RFID reader compatible with two main RFID protocols is presented in this paper. Such research is based on a fund of RFID technology used in warehouse management application. In this paper we will introduce how the reader works and give the simulation of the reader's efficiency.

articleTitle: Data Mining for Design Curriculum Development and Personalized Training Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There exit many problems in current industrial design teaching and learning for Chinese higher education. The aims and objectives of our research are to provide personalized training scheme for students through improving current curriculum. For the aim, the questionnaires are made to get information about design innovation and design innovative personal. Through data mining and PCA (principle component analysis) for the questionnaires, the innovation training archives is established on classifying different personality with respect to creativity and innovation. The questionnaires mainly contain innovation design factors, design course modules, design course activities, and design capabilities. Through design information mining, old curriculum problems are found and improved curriculum is designed. By the innovation training archives, personalized training scheme is to provide for the students to recommend relevant learning scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis on Development Situation of Total Investment in Fixed Assets in Heilongjiang Province in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the relative statistics of fixed assets investment (FAI) in recent years, this paper pays more attention to analyze on moving state of total investment in fixed assets in Heilongjiang province, to study on development situation of component factors of FAI through H-P filter, which its results show FAI is in smooth and stable situation overall. The key factors of FAI are discussed to achieve sensitivity analysis, adopting the method of multilinear regression analysis.

articleTitle: The Research of Financial Distress Restructuring
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper sets up models for the financial distress restructuring strategies in both cases that the interests of shareholder and manager are consistent or not in order to study the effect of restructuring strategies on the condition of "information asymmetry". Through the quantitative analysis of earning expectations of the shareholder, manager and creditor, this paper studied the optimal strategy of all the parties and their changes. Finally, this paper found that the two sides' optimal restructuring strategies to deal with financial distress were different when the interests of shareholder and manager were inconsistent. The manager could damage the benefits of the shareholder to maximize self-interest using his information advantage and domination. This article also addresses some corresponding recommendations to solve this issue.

articleTitle: RMB Revaluation, NDF and Chinese Capital Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines Chinese financial market data to assess the likelihood of RMB exchange rate, interest rate, NDF and Chinese A share-price using by VAR model, impulse response and variance decompositions. We find an evidence of bidirectional causality between interest-rate differential and exchange rate. The results further suggest uni-directional causality from spot exchange rate variable to NDF. Specially, the empirical results show that the 3-month non-deliverable forward premia are important series linking these variables. The forward premia has some extent effect on predicting series A share-price changes. Therefore, these finding indicates that the expectation of RMB revaluation lead to international speculative capital movement, even capital control in China, which in turn has effect on Chinese capital markets.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Enterprise Innovation and Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Objective Decision Model on Reasonable Low Price Bid Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Reasonable low price bid evaluation is widely implemented in the biding system in China. According to analysis of the evaluation methods and their theoretical basis, the actual methods have all deviated the true meaning of reasonable low-price, and even caused to the phenomenon such as baleful round-biding and successful bid by low-cost price. In order to address those problems, in this paper, summarizing of the influencing factors of reasonable low price based on the analysis of life cycle cost control, and then combining with the value engineering theory, it provides a multi-objective decision model. According to a case study, the model can generally reflect the strength of bidders and select a bidder who offered a reasonable low-price.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System Technique Based on BP-SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the fact that the detection of intrusion is inefficient and lacks intelligence in current intrusion detection system, this paper integrates BP neural network and support vector machine (SVM) based on the theory of neural network integration, applying fuzzy clustering technology to cluster data, choosing data from the cluster centre to train ensemble individuals, then selecting and integrating those individuals of significant diversity. The theoretical analysis and experimental results show that this ensemble method is efficient for detection rates and unknown attacks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Planning and Prospect in City Emergency Management Field
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: MC Study of Electrical Apparatus Products with Virtual Reality Designing Based on B/S mode
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mass customization product design in the virtual design system based on B/S mode is studied. The approach is based on prototype product parameterized modeling and VRML language, and is supported by Eletrical Apparatus Product Intelligent Design System (IDS). The IDS processes the customer's requirements of products and produces a design result document including the designed product structure and parameters. The CAD system-MDT generates the solid product model with the parameters by means of parameterized model database then transforms the models into the models of VRML language. The customers can observe the models of MC product with the browser. The approach is a new way to virtual design of MC product.

articleTitle: Study on Water Quality Assessment of Hydraulic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discussed the content of water quality impact assessment about hydraulic engineering and analyzed the position of water quality impact in the whole water environmental impact. We used the method combining the standard index with integrated water quality index, and gave the quantitative calculation for the indicators of water quality impact. Taking Dayuandu navigation project as an example, we analyzed the water quality parameter. The results show that the evaluation method is reasonable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: China Cities Development and Logistics Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Service Innovation Performance Evaluation in Service Enterprise - Based on Wuhan Telecom Best Tone Center
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management in the E-Commerce of Publishing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The advent of knowledge economy and recent boom in knowledge management practices has created the conditions for a wide range of publishing enterprises to take full advantage of knowledge resources to enhance their own competing abilities and decision response efficiency in the e-commerce. The infusion between e-commerce and knowledge management in publishing enterprises can result in the formation of knowledge commerce. But how to realize its practices depends on the construction of one kind of system platform integrating e-commerce with knowledge management by means of some radical technologies, say, Web mining and ontology-based knowledge portal technologies can play an important role in the detection and refinement of clients' information, staffs' knowledge and integration of knowledge flows in e-commerce practices.

articleTitle: Value Innovation Circulation of Construction Enterprises: A Chinese Case
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although it is true that the issues of low added value growth and disco responding status in the international construction market for China construction market have been dealt with extensively from different perspectives, studies on the value innovation combined with Deming cycle of TQM are few. This study tackles the issues by analyzing the relative theory to purify the broader concepts of value innovation, then, integrates the Deming cycle of TQM by analyzing the relationship between innovation and TQM. During this retrospect, the combined point is identified to build the value innovation circulation model for China construction industry and the criteria of decision making for the value innovation based on the classic theory of marginal value and the four steps of value innovation. Then, the marginal value in the five conditions is compared. It shows that two necessary and sufficient conditions and one necessary condition about the decision criteria are certificated in the value innovation of China construction industry (VICI). Finally, the study provides the model of the VICI evolvement to explain the running of value innovation circulation, and it also further puts forward the element transition matrix of CIVI to interpret the change of the buyers' claim in the circulation of the CIVI reasonability and the inner mechanism of value innovation circulation. The study provides useful references for further studies that explore the value innovation used in the China construction industry and those used in other construction industries.

articleTitle: An Assessment Model of Institutional Resilience in Urban Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergency institutions are the most important force to dispose and eliminate incidents and relieve the stress of urban public safety. The assessment of the capability of emergency institution is an important issue in urban emergency management to identify the defects of institutions and provide useful information to improve the overall capability of the entire urban region. This paper introduces the concept of institutional resilience and presents a quantitative assessment model based on the analysis of influencing factors. A simulated case study demonstrates the effectiveness and feasibility of the model in the identification and comparison of institutional resilience.

articleTitle: Brief Analysis of Harmonious Community's Construction in Transformation of Village in the City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the characteristics of village community in the city before transformation firstly, and puts forward the aim of community construction in transformation of village in the city. Then this paper points out methods of constructing harmonious community in village in the city from different aspects. Based on the grey system theory, this paper establishes dynamic evaluating model of sustainable development about harmonious community of villages in city. Finally the paper proposes a new community management mode based on the characteristics of village in the city.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperation of the Small and Medium Enterprise Clusters Based on Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain management has become a new model of enterprise management in the 21st century. It minimizes internal friction of the supply chain system, improves the system's overall competitiveness and promotes each member's competitive power in the system. As a regional economy phenomenon, industrial clusters receive more and more people to pay attention because of its unusual regional economy competitiveness. This article gives countermeasures of small and medium enterprise (SME) cluster cooperation based on supply chain management, combined with the relationship between supply chain and the small and medium enterprise clusters, on the basis of the characteristics and cooperation of China's small and medium enterprise clusters.

articleTitle: Research on Standardization Purchasing Management: An Application Case of Purchasing for Self-Service Terminals in Telecommunication Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the improvement of Internet and telecommunication technology, the IT corporations are facing the challenges of transformation, and the purchasing is in the key place of the operation system in the corporations. Central purchasing was the last direction. This paper study the case of the standardization purchasing management of Communication corporations, takes the example of purchasing for self-service terminals.

articleTitle: The Environmental Performance Research of Automotive Remanufacturing Industry Based on Entropy Weight Fuzzy Synthesis Evaluation in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis takes the theory of sustainable development and the theory of circulation economy as its guiding thought, differentiates the appraisal level, the appraisal body from the perspective of environmental performance, then builds up an effective indicator system of automotive remanufacturing environmental performance evaluation. At the same time it introduces the entropy method, carrying on the fuzzy quality synthetic evaluation of the environmental performance management target, and using the operational method of entropy power fuzzy quality synthetic evaluation method to make the reasonable appraisal and further to provide a new way of the automotive remanufacturing industry's environmental performance appraisal.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Micro-Insurance Plan Based on Risk Degree of Debris Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Study on Logistics Distribution of Electronic Commerce Based on B to C
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of network and electronic technology, logistics distribution had become the bottleneck of the development of electronic commerce. The paper introduced the existing two main models and three logistics distribution model in electronic commerce of B to C-buliding own distribution system model, third-party logistics and the distribution model of postal service, and and discussed the advantages and disadvantages of the three models. On the basis of the analysis the paper provided a new model and electronic commerce and logistics form.

articleTitle: KM Risk Evaluation System Based on CBR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We put forward a method of building a knowledge management risk evaluation system applied the case-based reasoning. It includes four aspects to establish a risk evaluation model. They are building a casebase, case representation, similar case retrieval and case adjustment.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of Human Capital Operation on the Enterprise Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The human capital (HC) is the most important capital in the knowledge-based economy time, and the HC operations have certain impacts on enterprise performance. Based on the analysis of HC, HC operation and enterprise performance as well as literature research, the paper proposes the hypothesis of four dimensions of HC operations on effect of enterprise performance and constructs a structural equation model. Furthermore, the paper has a statistical analysis and model fit to testify the theory through using SPSS13.0 and AMOS4.0 software. The conclusion shows that the hypothesis of which HC investment has a positive influence on the growth dimension of enterprise performance was not supported by empirical testing, and HC investment has a positive influence on the financial dimension, image dimensions and staff dimension of enterprise performance was supported. At the same time, the hypothesis of which HC integration, HC incentive and HC appreciation has a positive influence on the enterprise performance was supported by empirical testing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Sale Team Evaluation and Improvement In Marketing Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of 3-D Temperature in Reinforced Concrete Structure under Fire
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Calculating the change of temperature field in reinforced concrete under fire is very important for the analysis on the change law of intensity, deformation and fire resistance performance in high rise building construction. Based on the unsteady three-dimensional heat conduction differential equation, the discrete equation of unsteady three-dimensional temperature field under fire is established with control volume method. Comparison between the numerical results of the unsteady temperature field for the reinforced concrete slab in fire and the tested data shows that they are basically identical. Computation of one reinforced concrete corner in fire, made up with slab, beams, column and brick walls, is conducted and related results are presented. The result shows: the temperature distributions of the surfaces exposed to fire in all directions is not uniform and the integral structure temperature field calculation of building under fire is a problem that should be considered in three dimensional method. The wave-like temperature distribution is showed in the exposed surface because of the steel bars. The fire resistance analysis of the slab and column which are viewed as a whole should be considered simultaneously.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Inflow of Foreign Capital Impact on Chinese Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the economic and financial globalization, transnational business in banking industry becomes a trend. China liberalizes financial markets progressively after the accession to WTO in 2001. I build the evaluation model of integrated impact of foreign investment on China's banking sector, coupled with econometric methods such as factor analysis and regression analysis; provide reference in addressing the direction and focus of Chinese commercial banks.

articleTitle: The Permit Management and Safety Assessment of Shengli Bridge under Overweight Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of transportation industry, the number of times that overloaded vehicle pass through bridges increases day by day. Taking Shengli bridge as an example, the bridge model was established with finite element software in this paper. According to the vehicle parameters, the vehicle loading model was abstracted, and the process that overloaded vehicle pass through the bridge was simulated. Finally, the safety margin of the bridge was evaluated on the basis of bearing capacity analysis. Permit management measures for the bridge were proposed, which can be referenced by relevant situation.

articleTitle: The Impact of Equity Structure Reform on the Relationship between Equity Structure and Equity Agency Cost: An Empirical Analysis of Retail Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With data of Chinese retail listed companies from 2004 to 2007, We take a theoretical and empirical analyses on the moderating effect of equity structure reform on the relationships between equity structure and equity agency cost for the state-owned and non-state-owned companies. The results of this research show that due to the impact of the equity structure reform, the equity agency cost is increased for non-state-owned companies, and decreased for state-owned companies; the sharp decrease of the ownership concentration degree of the state-owned companies results in a significant change of the relationship between equity agency cost and equity restriction degree; the relationship between the equity agency cost and the proportion of management share-holding has not been changed for both groups of companies.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Underwriter Reputation Based on Principal Components Analysis in China IPO Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of DSM Programs under the Clean Development Mechanism Using CGE Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses a computable general equilibrium to analysis the economical and environmental impact of demand-side management program. Aiming at the DSM program of improving energy efficient, the paper deeply study the changes of economical and environmental of demand side management program under the clean development mechanism which brought subsidies. The study found that the clean development mechanism would increase the welfare. The demand-side management program would increase economic welfare if the ratio of unit cost of electricity savings to price of electricity is 0.4 or lower even without clean development mechanism. If the ratio is greater than 0.4, the program under clean development mechanism would be needed to achieve positive welfare impacts. The welfare impact depends on the price of carbon credits the program generates. For a given level of welfare impacts, the demand side management program under the clean development mechanism would reduce the emissions.

articleTitle: Simulation Evaluating Feasibility of Highway Construction Schedules Considering Random Factors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In highway engineering, lots of random factors including raining, quantity and status of machines available for projects have direct impact on activities time. Therefore, while scheduling a project, managers always increase spare machines or prolong the activity time to avoid delaying the project time when those random factors have bad influence in construction site. However, how many are the spare machines and how long are the prolonged activities time, which are estimated subjectively by managers. This subjective estimation has been criticized for systematically overestimating or underestimating quantity of the machines and the activity time. In the paper, we analyze main random factors influencing the highway construction, and propose the algorithms to simulate if it is raining and the status of the machines in construction site. By analyzing the simulation trials results, there are lots of useful information for the project managers to evaluate the feasibility of the construction schedule.

articleTitle: A Portfolio Decision Model Based on the Organizational Development Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper a portfolio decision model is demonstrated, which is based on organizational development strategy. The paper is to analyze the theory and reality of modern strategy management and project management, and to deal with the conformity and contradiction perceived in the application of strategy management and project management in organizational development.

articleTitle: Study of the Driving Factors of Customer Loyalty Based on Customer Value - A Empirical Analysis on the Third Part Logistics(3pl) Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on customer value, this paper builds up the driving mode of the customer loyalty to find the value factors leading to customer loyalty. And we test the mode by questionnaires investigation. The results show that customer value is the most key factor to build up customer loyalty and the customer value factors include reputation and impression of enterprise, quality and price factors, and they are ranked according to their effect on customer loyalty from the lowest strength to the highest strength.

articleTitle: Prescription Map Generation Intelligent System of Precision Agriculture Based on Web Services and WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the result of soil sampling and test, soil properties map can be achieved by interpolation. After that, a prescription map can be generated to conduct variable-rate fertilization. This process is the core of precision agriculture. It can not only save fertilizer, but also improve economic and environment benefit. The system which was based on geography information system (GIS) could: 1) interpolate soil properties map by Kriging method; 2) integrate yield, meteorological data and soil data into a database; 3) loose coupling GIS with knowledge model based on Web services technology; 4) generating and releasing a prescription map on Web, and sharing the model-base on Web. The study constructed the basic frame and process flow of prescription map based on knowledge model, Web services and WebGIS, improved the rationality and reliability of the prescription map, implemented to generate and release a prescription on Web, and make it easy for user to get a prescription map.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Method for Construction site layout of Interbasin Water Diversion Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the features and the complexity of the inter-basin water diversion project, the multiobjective hierarchical structure model was established based on numerous assessment indexes and initial layout schemes. The model was solved through the improved AHP method with the optimum transfer matrix. The proposed method was successfully applied to the construction site layout of the middle route of the south-to-north water diversion project. It provides a new method for the optimal decision-making of the construction site layout in the water diversion project.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Housing Development in Urban Renewal in China: A Comparative Respective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Behavioral Explanation to Linearity of Incentive Contract Incorporating Inequity Aversion
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: So far the classical contract theory has never given a reasonable explanation to why most incentive contracts in reality are linear, although it has been applied to many economic domains widely in recent years. By incorporating inequity aversion into the standard frame of designing optimal contract, which is an important preference investigated by game experiments and behavioral economics while ignored by the classical contract theory, this paper shows that the optimal contract under inequity aversion is linear definitely, and the slope increases with the strength of inequity aversion within the limit 0.5, which is consistent with the result of positive findings. Therefore, incorporating inequity aversion surely provides a rational explanation to the linearity of incentive contract from the approach of behavioral contract theory.

articleTitle: A Study on the Know-How Value Assessment Model Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the rough set theory, the author, in this paper, provides relevant algorithms for reduction the know-how value assessment index system and structures a know-how value assessment model.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Risks in the Venture Capital Project Choosing Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Both the static and the dynamic game analysis show that the equilibrium outcomes depend on the judgment to the entrepreneurial risks information, for entrepreneur is the soul of business start-up, who obviously owns some private information advantage even while attracting investment from venture capitalist. And some empirical countermeasures, such as entrepreneurship information gathering, signaling of business plan and contractual arrangement beforehand are brought forward so as to increase the operating efficiency of venture capital.

articleTitle: The Information Integration of Apparel Supply Chain Based on Web Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web service is a state-of-the-art technology which is utilized for information integration of apparel supply chain (ASC). The overall demand of ASC is introduced first. Then, the dynamic integration framework of apparel supply chain based on Web service encapsulating, publishing, discovering, invoking and compositing is investigated. Under the framework, this paper gives a description for the service classification designing and integrating method.

articleTitle: Modeling of Nitrogen Conservation by the Addition of Mg and P Salts Mixtures for the Management of Urban Food Waste Treatments
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A nitrogen conservation model in the thermophilic composting process of simulated food waste, in which phosphate and MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> mixtures (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> + MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>HPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> + MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and KH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> + MgSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> mixtures) were introduced for nitrogen (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N) conservation, was developed for the management of composting combined with Contois function. The established model showed good agreement with experimental observation for NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> -N conservation.
