The average fixation fraction of Runs B, C and D was respectively 30.77%, 69.38% and 73.13%.

articleTitle: Large Shareholdings and Firm Value: Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the cross-section data of Chinese non-financial listed companies from year 2001 to 2005, this paper investigates the effects of large shareholdings on firm value, as measured by Tobin's Q. Consistent to our theoretical expectation, there is a significant curvilinear relationship between large shareholdings and firm value. The results indicate that in the context of concentrated ownership, the key to improve corporate governance is to arrange ownership structure reasonably so as to induce large shareholders' monitoring behaviors and restrict their expropriation.

articleTitle: Product Lifecycle Oriented Knowledge Management System for Product Rapid Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to modern manufacturing conceptions and the bottleneck problems of computer integrated manufacturing system (CIMS), a product rapid development system is studied as well as its architectural structure. After analysis of knowledge management system for product rapid development (KMS-PRD) requirement, the needs for KMS-PRD are explored in depth. A framework of KMS-PRD is proposed to support product rapid development by providing a knowledge collection, storage, share, reuse and application platform. According to the framework, the key issues and challenges is investigated to guide the development of KMS-PRD. The results of this research will facilitate the rationalization of product development and thus shorten the development time.

articleTitle: Innovation on Nash Negotiation Model about Profit Allocation of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to obtain the optimal profit allocation strategy among the cooperation enterprises in supply chain, consisting of one supplier and two distributors, Nash negotiation model considering investment weght is developed. Fristly, some advantages and disadvantages of Nash negotiation model in profit allocation of supply chain are discussed. Then, it is proposed to improve the model through the investment weight. Finally, the presented example demonstrates that the total profit of supply chain reaches the maximum, when building the cooperationship, and shows that the innovation is more reasonable and more appropriate.

articleTitle: Study on the Harm of Extortionate Price of Real Estate over the City's Development and Its Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The influential factors, e.g. the management of government and the loans provision of banks were analyzed aiming at the reasons of real estate extortionate price in Wuhan. It has been deduced that the loans control is the most effective way to restrain extortionate price of real estate by analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Moreover, the suggestion that the local government should take the advantage of the global financial crisis to adjust urban development has been proposed.

articleTitle: The Trustworthiness Metric Model of Software Process Quality Based-On Life Circle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through analyzing basic characters of software process, from three dimensions: software process products, software process actions and software entities, this paper establishes the measurement indicators system of software process quality trustworthiness, and introduces the measurement model of software process trustworthiness. Instances studies show the model can not only evaluate the trustworthy degree of software process quality, but also identify potential risk factors in software developing process, and provide trusted decision-making reference for avoiding risk of projects and improving product quality.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on Game Theory Analysis of the Real Estate Bubble Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Study on the Environmental Effect of China's Textile Export
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: On Evaluation Method of Metropolitan Manufacturing Enterprise Informatization Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, there is no complete and commonly used assessment system or comprehensive evaluation method of manufacturing enterprise informatization in our country, though some research have been done on enterprise informatization. In this paper, firstly, the assessment system of manufacturing enterprise informatization is proposed; then, taking the manufacturing enterprises in Tianjin for example, principal component analysis method is adopted to decide the weight of the indices and the method to calculate the manufacturing enterprise informatization index is demonstrated; finally, the evaluation result of informatization index is discussed.

articleTitle: An Open Onboard Internet System Model for the M-Commerce on Train
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An open onboard Internet system model based on the centralized access mode is designed for the m-commerce on train which is easy to merge the oncoming broadband wireless access and network technologies.The functionalities and entities in each layer are investigated and the hot issues are discussed according to this model. It is shown that the onboard Internet applications including the m-commerce on train are feasiable based on this open model.

articleTitle: Design of Operational P2P-Oriented Intelligent Node Overlay Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the lack of security and management mechanism in peer to peer (P2P) network, this paper designs an operational and scalable intelligent node overlay network which is P2P-oriented with digital right management functionality and good authentication and accounting capabilities supporting large-scale deployment. It not only can convenience the network communication and make the share and interact more direct but also realizes the user authentication management and user security-billing mechanism in terms of the operation.

articleTitle: Attribute Recognition Model and Its Application on Water Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Attribute mathematics is a new mathematics branch based on the basic concepts of attribute set and attributes measurement, and the model established on the theory can recognize things effectively. Through concisely presenting the basic concepts and theory of attribute mathematics, we put emphasis on the modeling idea and method of attribute recognition model. An example about water quality evaluation was given to further illuminate the practical application methods of attribute recognition model. We expected the dissertation of attribute mathematics in the paper could attract the attentions of scholars.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Based Research on Housing Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the reform of residential policies in China, housing market is of great concern to many people. Both from practitioners and academics are there a large body of researches on this issue, normatively and positively. This paper investigates into factors that influence housing prices based on present situations in China, and establishes a system dynamics model to explore the mechanism of the market. The model is composed of three sectors which are product sector, consumer sector and developer sector. Intra relationships within each sector and interactions between the sectors are described. The model established can be used to predict the behaviors of the housing market, as long as data are adequately available. Therefore, it can act as a support for government's prudent policy issuing, developers' informed investment decision, and consumers' rational consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Factors of Independent Innovation of Scientific and Technological Talents in Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The influence factor model of independent innovation of scientific and technological talents (S&T talents) in universities is studied in this paper firstly. The influence factor model contains organization-layer and ability-layer. Organization-layer includes three kinds of factors. They are organizational structure factor, organizational institution factor, and organizational culture factor. Organizational structure factor can be shown from three aspects: department setting-up, power disposition and construction of basic scientific research organization. Organizational institution factor can also be shown from three aspects: personnel management system, distribution system and evaluation system. Meanwhile, organizational culture factor can be explained from three aspects too, including values of organization, school-running ideas and organizational learning. Ability-layer includes four kinds of factors. Then, the mechanism of action through which innovative organization-layer affects innovative ability-layer is analyzed. Finally, the mechanism of action through which innovative ability-layer affects innovative achievements is concluded. Organization-layer affects innovative achievements through the influence on innovative ability-layer.

articleTitle: Urban Heat Island Effect and Its Contribution to Urban Warming in Lanzhou in Recent 50 Years
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban heat island effect of Lanzhou city is analyzed using the average temperature, the maximum temperature and the minimum temperature during 1956-2005. Then the heat island intensity trends and contribution rates are calculated using the linear trends of three temperatures of Lanzhou city and the suburb. Results show that the differences of three temperatures between Lanzhou city and the suburb are all taking on increasing trends. The linear trends of average temperature, the maximum temperature and the minimum temperature are 0.371degC /10a, 0.169degC /10a and 0.654degC /10a, respectively. The minimum temperature increases most obviously. In recent 50 years. temperatures increase mainly in the latter 25 years (1981-2005), and the linear trends of average temperature, maximum temperature and the minimum temperature of Lanzhou city are 0.789degC/10a, 0.997degC/10a and 0.625degC/10a, respectively while those of the suburb are 0.395degC/10a, 0.188degC/10a and 0.674degC/10a. The heat island contribution rates of three temperatures are 87.0%, 49.6% and 100%, respectively. The linear trends of average temperature and the minimum temperature in winter are the most in both city and the suburb, but the heat island contribution rate of the winter temperatures are not the largest, this maybe mainly related with the severe air pollution in winter in Lanzhou city, because it can hold back urban heat island in some extent. In the latter 25 year, urban heat island effect of Lanzhou city was becoming stronger, but the contribution rates of average temperature and the maximum temperature are declining. This study is important to city planning and studying urbanization and the effect of environmental change on urban temperature.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comprehensive Correspondence Analyses between Logistics Service Concrete Modes and Three Series of Decision Drives
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Web Service Application Research in a RFID-Based Logistics Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper introduces Web service technology into an RFED-based logistics management (RLM) system. Of which Web services' high usability, platform independence and languages independence is used to design a fully transparent and uniform software interface layer, it helps to complete data acquisition, modification, and monitoring functions. In the paper, the behavior of Web service in the RFID-based logistics management system is described, analyzed, the result shows that the Web service interface layer, a cross-platform of cross-language, has good interoperability and reusability.

articleTitle: Research on Job-Shop Problem Based on Multi-Colony Diploid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-Colony Diploid Genetic Algorithm (MCDGA) is studied in order to apply the scheduling theory to the production practice. Aimed at the job-shop dynamic scheduling for agile manufacturing, Job Shop Problem model based on MCDGA is proposed. Finally, the present algorithm is tested on Shanghai Volkswagen, Automobile Co.Ltd. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is more effective compared with genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A Method of Modifying the Weight of Multi-Interest Agents in Intuitionistic Fuzzy Group Decision-Making of Initial Water Right Allocation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Group decision that multi-interest agents take part in is an important method, which can promote the democratization and scientific process in the water resources allocation. And the weight of multi-interest agents play an important part in the efficiency of group decision. This paper proposes a method of modifying weight based on similarity measures of intuitionistic fuzzy matrix after multi-interest agents' negotiation about weight. The method can show both subjective and objective degrees of decision making, and make the final decision more reliable. The case conducted that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: The Design of Peasant-Oriented Information Service System Based on WAP and SMS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This test introduces a method of the design and implementation of peasant-oriented information service system based on WAP (Wireless Application Protocol) and SMS (Short Messaging Service), terminal users can get personalized information services through mobile WAP, SMS and web. This paper introduces the system components, network architecture, interface design, the design of SMS, WAP and WEB site, information management system design module, and system testing, finally give a conclusion. It can build a more accurate orientation, self-interaction, cheap and convenient information service system.

articleTitle: Cointegration Analysis of the Relationship between the Speed of Regional Economic Growth and That of the Development of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of regional economic (except for Qinghai, Tibet) development on the scale and speed of higher education by the use of co-integration theory, and it makes the whole empirical analysis all the region's economic growth rate and speed of the development of higher education, the promotion of coordination of higher education and economic development.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of Iron and Steel Logistics E-Commerce System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An e-commerce system is designed according to actual demand and operation of current iron and steel enterprises. Seven modules of this system, including customer management, contract management, distribution, warehouse, vehicle, and financial management, and checking or inquiring management module are elaborated separately. Four main subsystems, i.e. procurement, warehouse, distribution, and financial settlement management are discussed, and the data flow is analyzed.

articleTitle: Co-Integration Analysis and an Error Correction Model for Urban Land Use Structure and Economic Growth in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theories of the information entropy of urban land use structure, co-integration and error correction model, this thesis analyses the relationship between economic growth, urbanization level and the information entropy of urban land use structure. The information entropy values of China's urban land use structure from 1981 to 2004 have been calculated in this paper. The relationship between China's GDP and the information entropy of urban land use structure is investigated in details. The results indicate a co-integration relationship between GDP and the information entropy of urban land use structure. However, there is no co-integration relationship between urbanization and the information entropy of urban land use structure. On the basis of the above analyses, the error correction model on GDP and the information entropy of urban land use structure is instituted. The application of the model shows that every 1% decrease in the information entropy value of urban land use structure demands a 59.53% growth in GDP. Because of the existing co-integration relationship between the economic growth and the information entropy of urban land use structure, the order degree of China's urban land use structure has relied heavily on the economic growth for a long time. The economic growth will significantly affect the optimal regulation of urban land use structure in the future. Further investigation also shows that economic growth and urbanization act as the direct driving force of the optimization of urban land use structure, but the optimization of urban land use structure can't promote the economic growth and the urbanization. Therefore, it becomes a very pressing strategic issue to adjust the economic structure and industrial distribution to optimize the distribution of urban land use and to optimize the structure of urban land use to improve the efficiency and promote the socio-economic development.

articleTitle: Application of Web and Data Warehouse in MDSS Based on Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: First of all, the necessities and advantages of applying Web and data warehouse to MDSS was analyzed and the multi-agent systems theory was introduced. Further, the business schemas in the data warehouse were identified and the multi-dimension datasets were established. The structure of the Web-enabled MDSS was designed based on multi-agent systems and each agent's function was given. Finally, the developing tools and the implementation of the Web-enabled data warehouse were discussed.

articleTitle: Turnover at the Top: Tenure Dissimilarity as a Determinant of Executive Turnover in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent heterogenization in Chinese top management teams has triggered intense interest in both antecedents and consequences of team diversity. The current study explored the relationship between individual tenure dissimilarity and executive turnover in the background of Chinese traditional socio-culture and institutional changes. Results indicated that individual dissimilarity in tenure was a solid predictor of executive turnover. Furthermore, our test of moderating effects showed that the more market-oriented a firm behaved in executive selection, the more significant the effects of individual tenure dissimilarity on executive turnover would be. The study highlights tenure dissimilarity in explaining executive turnover in Chinese settings.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Evaluation of the Underway Replenishment Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Cash-Cash Flow Sensitivity of Chinese Firms - Findings Associated with Uncertainty and Financial Constraints
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Standard Competition and ICT Standardization Strategy in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The future competition of economy and politics lies in the competition of standards. Standard competition takes various forms. A dynamic process model of standard competition based on the standard lifecycle theory is proposed and analyzed. And Porter's famous diamond model as a macroanalysis tool is combined with the proposed micro model to analyze the competition power of ICT (Information & Communication Technology) standard in China. Competition strategies for both government and domestic enterprises are also presented.

articleTitle: An Error-Resilient Scheme for Video Transmission
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The framework of a systematic lossy error protection for error-resilient video transmission is discussed and an unequal error protection base on systematic lossy error protection is proposed. The systematic portion of the transmission consists of a video bitstream transmitted without channel coding over an error-prone channel. Error-resilience is achieved by transmitting a supplementary bitstream generated by Wyner-Ziv encoding of the video signal. The macroblock information and the transform coefficients are protected separately. The simulation results show that this scheme can provide graceful degrading video quality over a great range of symbol error rates compared with conventional FEC.

articleTitle: Study on Theory and Realization Strategy of Keeping Sequence of Reinforcement Judgment for Existing Levees Based on the Risk Assessment Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a study on theory and methodology of keeping sequence of reinforcement judgment for existing levee based on the risk assessment theory. On the basis of risk analysis for main failure modes and break losses of levees engineering, an analysis model for reinforcement judgment of the existing levee is presented. The analysis method for risk probability of levee break by all probable breach routs can be discussed, that the relationship between qualitative description for whether or not appearance of failure event and the quantitative failure probability can be analyzed in this analysis method. And assessment model of failure consequences by losses of levee break including population casualties and economic loss and environmental and social influence loss is also studied in this decision-making model, which every loss can be transformed into the loss degree index, then the risk index of different levees can be calculated by product of loss degree index and risk probability of levee break and can be used as the theory foundation for reinforcement judgment of different existing levees.

articleTitle: A Bibliometrics Study on Research Competitiveness of Engineering Universities in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the reasonable index system is established on informetrics theory firstly and then a evaluation is made on Chinese engineering universities scientifically and objectively from the aspects of research productive forces,research influence,research innovation power and research development strength.This paper takes engineering for example, using ESI (Essential Science Indicators) as original data. Our study reflects the position of Chinese "985" project universities by international level, promoting the internationalization of Chinese education.

articleTitle: Profit Margin Contract in a Dominant-Retailer Supply Chain under Asymmetric Information with Supplier's Cost Disruptions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A supply chain model involving one supplier and one dominant retailer is developed. Profit margin contracts under asymmetric information are proposed with and without disruptions. Our research shows that the supply chain contract modeling has some kind of robustness, i.e., if variation of supplier's cost is sufficiently small the supply chain would keep original production plan. Decisions must be re-made if supplier's cost change is larger and exceeds an upper bound.

articleTitle: Study of Weak Signal Detection in Chaos Based on Volterra Filter
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the reconstruction of the chaotic dynamic space and the updating capability of adaptive techniques with nonlinearity of Volterra series. A third-order Volterra filter which is used to detect weak target signal in chaos is investigated. And its SVDPARAFAC approach is proposed. The method of using the singular value decomposition (SVD) and parallel factor (PARAFAC) decomposition to factor second and third order kernels is introduced in detail. The experimental results show this method has much better prediction performance for chaotic flow than nonlinear normalized least mean square (NLMS) adaptive Volterra filter and can detect out a very weak target signal in chaos when SNR gets to-70 dB.

articleTitle: The Complex Regeneration of Grand Canal Area in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Grand (Peking-Hangzhou) Canal and its areas in Hangzhou are getting decadency; the environment is contaminated by the end of last century. Regeneration of Canal and its area is a part of Hangzhou city regeneration program. The local government used the concept of city governance and Market-oriented methods. In the conservation program the infrastructures had been created, dwelling situation had been proved and industrial had been transformed. It is a successful course for canal and its area's renaissance.

articleTitle: Intercity Distribution Network: An Integrated Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the world city network theory, this essay constructs a conceptual model of intercity distribution network, and studies on the basic issues such as constitution of the intercity distribution network, and the micro-dynamic mechanism of the network formation.

articleTitle: The Study on the Development of Chinese Logistic Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The logistic industry has become the third source of profits following the manufacturing and business. Chinese logistic enterprises still have some problems, such as lagging behind the concept, antiquated facilities, uneven development, logistics and e-commerce out of line, the shortage of qualified personnel, a single technology, lack of economies of scale and so on. We should learn from foreign logistic theoretical research in conjunction with the national conditions of China, in order to find a gap and find out the development focus of the logistics business, which will promote Chinese rapid economic development.

articleTitle: Research on Services Outsourcing Contracts under Moral Hazard and Participation of Customer Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer enterprise's participation in outsourcing service can reduce cost and improve efficiency, but the customer enterprise may involve in a dilemma for the moral hazard of the service provider. Focusing on moral hazard of the service provider, a principal-agent model with participation of the customer enterprise is established. Based on the model the relationship of the customer's participation, the service provider's effort and revenue sharing contract are analyzed. The results indicate that when the customer's participation and the service provider's effort are complementary, the service provider can be incented and the proportion of revenue-sharing should be increased with participation increasing. Otherwise, the service provider cannot be incented and the proportion of revenue-sharing should be decreased with participation increasing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Management of Intellectual Property in Enterprises Based on Technology Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of RAGA-SA on Solving Critical Water Depth of Trapezoid Section in Open Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Critical water depth is an important hydraulic parameter in open channel hydraulics, which is a key sign of distinguishing the flow state of water in an open channel. The traditional methods for calculating critical water depth of trapezoid section in an open channel are the trial-and-error method, approximate solution and iteration method, whose shortcomings were that the solution process needed a large number of calculations and result with low accuracy. For this reason, the method of Real-coded Accelerating Genetic Algorithm based on Simulated Annealing (RAGA-SA) was built in this paper to solve this problem. The Simulated Annealing algorithm was used to improve the convergence rate and quality of individuals during the late of evolution in RAGA. Practicality and accuracy of RAGA-SA were tested through calculating critical water depth of an open channel with trapezoid section. SA can prevent from a local optimal value in RAGA and made the quality of solution improved at 7%. The results of case study showed that convergence speed of RAGA-SA was faster than SGA and the accuracy was higher than traditional methods to calculate the critical depth at trapezoid section and the result was right. Furthermore, the RAGA-SA can be used in optimization problems in other fields such as determining the water surface curve of a natural channel and contraction section depth of an overflow dam in downstream.

articleTitle: An Immune Evolutionary Algorithm for Teacher/Class Timetabling Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The traditional evolutionary algorithm for teacher/class timetabling problem commonly evolves in a slow speed and trends to be stick to local optima. In this study, an immune-inspired evolutionary algorithm is proposed to solve the above problems. The algorithm utilizes the immune mechanisms including clonal selection, hypermutation, affinity evaluation, immune elimination and memory. The corresponding operators are designed. While the diversity is maintained, the convergence performance is improved by self-adaptive operators, such as clonal selection, hypermutation, crossover and mutation. Through the simulation experiments and comparative study, the algorithm is proved to be effective in solving the timetabling problem.

articleTitle: The Forecast of the Rural Energy Consumption Structure Based on the Grey Model Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this article, we applied the grey model to forecast the rural energy consumption structure. The research results indicated that the rural energy consumption structure would not change largely, and the consumption structure would develop to the direction with high quality and commercialization. In next 5 years, for the rural energy consumption structure, the proportion of the commercial energy will increase slowly and the use of the living energy will still occupy the leading status, and in the living energy consumption, the traditional biomass energy will still occupy the dominant status, and the proportion of the electric power will increase slowly, and the proportion of the firedamp will increase largely.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Improving ABC Classification of Inventory Management Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Equity Formation from Relationship among Customer-Centered Marketing Theories
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The forming mechanism of customer equity is the foundation of study on customer equity driver and promotion. Through studying the previous research, this issue discusses customer equity formation from relationship among customer-centered marketing theories, and then analyzes the relationship between customer loyalty and customer equity, the relationship among customer satisfaction, relationship marketing, brand marketing, customer value and customer loyalty. The forming mechanism framework of customer equity is established, which is supposed to provide reference to following study on customer equity formation.

articleTitle: The Research on Subject Database Construction and Allocation in Vehicle MIS Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the problem of data environment in the vehicle management information system integration construction, this paper mainly analyses the advantage of subject database, discusses the method of constructing subject database which is based on entity aggregation, and provides the allocation mode of subject database.

articleTitle: Study on the Information Integration of the Product-Family-Oriented Supply Chain Planning Based on Generic Bills of Materials
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For configuring reasonably the resources in the product-family-oriented supply chain and adjusting speedily the supply chain planning, the Generic-Bills-of-Materials-based information integration was researched. First, with the Generic bills of materials (GBOM) as the uniform framework, the concept of Generic task point (GTP) was presented. In terms of the product description information, organize information and technique process information, the GTP was analyzed how to describe the product-family-oriented supply chain planning information of a certain node in GBOM. Then, the instantiation process of the GTP was discussed. The characteristics of the information integration system of the product-family-oriented supply chain based on the GBOM (IISPFSCGBOM) were analyzed. Furthermore, the architecture of the IISPFSC was presented and discussed.

articleTitle: A Study on Green Supply Chain Achievements Evaluation Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study on green supply chain achievements evaluation is an important component in the study on the green supply chain management. It is needed to scientifically and reasonably analyze and evaluate the benefits which can the implementation of the green supply chain bring to enterprises. We select the corresponding input and output indexes from the index systems of green supply chain achievements evaluation proposed by numerous scholars, and DEA method is used to evaluate it.

articleTitle: Domestic Wastewater Treatment of Infiltration System by Soil and Cinder Layered-Filled
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cinder, as the filling materials, were filled with the layers of soil to improve the hydraulic permeability of the soil infiltration system in treating domestic wastewater at different hydraulic loading cycle. Larger hydraulic loading cycle was dosed 2 times daily with wastewater at 10 cm/d; shorter hydraulic loading cycle was dosed 16 times daily with wastewater at the same loading. The results showed that treating the wastewater at larger hydraulic loading cycle, COD, ammonia and total phosphorus were removed by 87%, 92%, 98%, respectively, COD, ammonia, total nitrogen and total phosphorus were removed by 92%, 56%, 38%, 97%, respectively, at shorter. The effect of soil and cinder infiltration system on removal of pollutant could be improved significantly by running shorter hydraulic loading cycle.

articleTitle: CO Diffusion Simulation in the Third Layer Construction of Main Power House
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: CO Diffusion in main power house is a major influencing factor on construction management. Under forced ventilation, the CO diffusion of construction is investigated using a 3D high Reynolds number k - epsiv model. The wall roughness is considered in the wall function. Ventilation on the third layer of main power house of Xiangjiaba hydropower station with complex geometry is used as a case. The geometric structure has a decisive effect on airflow distribution. It is concluded that the CO concentration decreases gradually with the increasing of the ventilation time. However, isoconcentration curves have the same tendency after 1800s. The CO concentration meets the ventilation and dust-prevention health standard after 3249s. The prediction by the present model is confirmed by the experimental measurement by Nakayama.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Building the Harmonious Labor Relation: Via Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: What Determine the Office Rent?: A Time-Series Cross-Sectional Analysis of Chinese Markets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the Chinese economy is growing rapidly, the office market has become a heated investment area in the 21st century in China. However, there are few academic researches on China office market especially the rent level. In order to find out the determinants of office rent, a time-series cross-sectional analysis is carried out in this paper based on a demand-supply equilibrium dynamic adjustment model, using data of 13 cities over ten year period 1998-2007. The demand resulting from the increase of GDP and use of foreign funds has significant positive influence on rent. Meanwhile, the rent level is cut down by tremendous supply measured by new completed office area. Other factors such as total service sector employment, employment in finance and real estate and short-term interest rate have weak influences on office rent.

articleTitle: Game Model Analysis on the Policy of Unbundled Network Elements
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On September 28th, 2008, MIIT released urgent notice on the co-construction and sharing of telecommunications infrastructure which referred to the policy of unbundled network elements (UNEs).This article introduced the unbundling policy and mainly analyzed strategies of the stakeholders by two game models, a modified Cournot duopoly model for the UNEs price regulation and a bids game model with incomplete information on the policy of UNEs. Based on the first one, we suggest that (1) the regulator should mandate the unbundling policy to improve the social welfare; (2) the network elements should be subdivided first, and be treated differently. In the second model, we tried to set forth a simple liner strategy and give out some suggestions for all the players in this model.

articleTitle: Public Transit Passenger Transportation Quantity Forecast Based On Synthetic Integrated Multi-Variable Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The passenger transport system is a multi-level and nonlinear complicated system affected by multi-factors. Grey forecast model to predict urban public transit passenger transportation quantity attracts more attention. Take public transit data of Shijiazhuang city, Hebei province as an example. First, determine the key factors that influence public transit passenger transportation quantity according to the calculation of grey incidence. The region total output value, amount of service bus, urban population, urban road length and service line length are selected. The former two have distinguished incidence, while the latter three are in the same level. In order to avoid information loss caused by giving up the three factors, integrate the three factors of the same incidence level synthetically. Take grey incidence value as weight coefficient to normalize urban population, urban road length and service line length with different magnitude, and then sum up by weight to integrate a synthetic factor. Next, set up MGM (l, n) model to forecast.

articleTitle: Integrated Supply Chains of the Natural Disaster Relief Substances
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As is well known that the natural disasters are usually uncertainty and unavoidable, the effective transportation and distribution of the material for disaster mitigation can relieve the disaster and reduce the influence on the peoples' life. In this article, the author summaries the characters of natural disasters and the difficulties faced by disaster relief people in the supply chain of the disaster relief material, develops an integer programming model in which the materials are divided into two kinds, the common and the reusable, and gives the solution method. The research results indicate that the supply chain of disaster relief should be integrated both longitudinally and horizontally so as to realize the effective operation after the natural disaster coming into truth.

articleTitle: Modeling Undesirable Factors in the Measurement of Energy Efficiency in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a non-parametric method based on data envelopment analysis (DEA) is proposed to measure the energy efficiency. Majority of the previous studies did not consider the pollution when measuring energy efficiency, and hence the results are partially distorted on the perspective of environment. However, this paper takes into account the undesirable factors such as waste water, waste gas and solid wastes under the DEA technology that exhibits constant returns to scale (CRS) and variable returns to scale (VRS) respectively. The result indicates that the DEA model with the undesirable output as byproduct is more appropriate in energy efficiency measuring. Moreover, comparing to DEA model based on CRS, the model supported by VRS is more preferable, since in real cases, production process of VRS is more likely to be observed. Finally, an empirical study on measuring the energy efficiency of 30 provinces in China is presented.

articleTitle: Microcosmic Simulation Research on U-Turn Design of the Signalized Intersection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper simulations and analyzes the U-turn design of the signalized intersection with central dividing strip by using the microcosmic traffic simulation software AIMSUN. The conflict feature of left turn traffic at level crossing in urban road, including conflict point, space and time feature, and influence of left turn traffic to traffic at the crossing are analyzed. Targeting at the traffic feature of left turn traffic, it is suggested to use U-turn design at the signalized intersection with central dividing strip, so the number of conflict points can be reduced, capacity improved, and traffic delay of other phases is reduced. At last, as an example, a signalized intersection in Shanghai is analyzed. Aiming to reach the least delay, this example simulates the traffic flow qualifications of channelization in getting to know the detailed position of left-turn portal in AIMSUN. By comparing the traffic analysis of intersection, we can get that the saturation and traffic delays are improved remarkably after U-turn design.

articleTitle: The Measurement and Analysis of the Contribution Ratio of Science and Technology Progress of Chinese Citrus
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adopting the input-output Time Series Cross Section data of Chinese citrus, using formula of total factor productivity, the authors have figured out the progress ratios of science and technology of citrus in the 8 major production areas in China in recent 20 years. The result indicates the following: (1) The contribution ratio of Citrus is just an index highly related to policy orientation in the current stage; (2) The ratios fluctuated with an increasing trend in the last 20 years, the average value reached 39.41%, while the contribution ratio of Intelligent Progress and that of Scale Economy Effect were respectively 10.09% and 29.32%; (3) The overall trend of the contribution ratios of science and technology in the major production areas dominated the others , but there existed significant difference; (4) The scale economy played an important role in enhancing the output of Chinese citrus in the past 20 years. According to the research, suggest the government increase the science and technology input, encourage the citrus industry transferring to the middle and western parts of China and increasing the planting areas to product on a large scale, during the development, build a proper warning mechanism and complete a distribution system of Citrus market, build an emergency mechanism of climate disaster to make its negative effect on Chinese citrus touch the bottom.

articleTitle: Inventory Control and Logistics Management Based on Networked Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A networked distributed inventory management system of logistics based on coordination center is established in this paper. The storage data consists of user information, delivery time, requirement information and the inventory of warehouse. Through the coordination center, the funds and supply ability between suppliers are dispensed to satisfy the demands of customers. The warehouse orders and allocation strategy are realized by an improved genetic algorithm and random simulation method to minimize the total cost of stock.

articleTitle: Study on a Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Iron and Steel Enterprise's Intellectual Capital Based on Unascertained Mathematics Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: First, this article forms the iron and steel enterprise's intellectual capital evaluation indicator system through the analysis of the constituent elements of intellectual capital. Second, the article determines the weight of every indicator through the information entropy theory. Third , based on the unascertained mathematics theory, the article sets up a comprehensive evaluation model of the iron and steel enterprise's intellectual capital so that we can get the result of comprehensive evaluation by the model. Finally, this article gives an example combining the application of the model. This article provides an idea to identify and measure the intellectual capital of enterprise and this will be conducive to the culture of enterprise's core competencies.

articleTitle: Research of Land E-Government Decision Support System Based on Ontology and Workflow Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the growing demand for collaboration of comprehensive analysis and decision support of the information in land management department, traditional workflow systems, which can define the flows of service management, lacks the flexible methods and intelligent decision. In this paper, an e-government decision support system is proposed based on ontology and workflow. Especially, the design and implement process is discussed in details. Finally, an example of land e-government decision support system of Jiangxia district, Wuhan, is taken to prove the views mentioned above.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Downburst Wind Loads
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wind hazard is the one which has the widespread influence in natural disasters. Transmission towers have experienced a number of failures due to downburst wind events in recent years, with devastating economical and social consequences. Based on the mechanism of downburst wind load, the present paper proposes an AR model method of adding turbulence to the non-turbulent wind speed. The various aspects of the model are then integrated to create a method suitable for generating wind speed time histories for the dynamic analysis of high-rise structures subjected to downburst winds.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis of Stackelberg Duopoly's Strategies to Their Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To study the operation mechanism of supply chain with unbalanced bargaining power, we construct an evolutionary game model under Stackelberg duopoly competition in this paper. The results suggest that the strategy of "cost transfer" is not necessarily the best strategy for retailer duopoly and there exit different evolutionarily stable strategies (ESS) when the degree of "cost transfer" is different. At last, the numerical examples are also given.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Trusted Computing Platform Based on EFI
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Trusted computing has become a new and challenging research issue in the field of information security. To further enhance the safety of BIOS, we construct a trusted computing platform based on extensible firmware interface (EFI), the trust chain is transferred from the first stage of EFI to the operating system by applying TPM (trusted platform module) and TSS (TCG software stack). We presented the principle mechanism of EFI and the realization framework of trusted computing platform, proposed the key technologies such as chain of trust, construction of TMP and TSS, validation of file integrity, and etc. Theoretic analysis demonstrated the effectiveness of this new trusted computing platform.

articleTitle: Optimization on the Layout of Valley Urban Space to Deal with the Earthquake Emergency
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article focuses on the layout of the urban space, in the face of the earthquake disaster to the valley city the article analysizes the shortage on the layout of valley urban space from the macro, meso, micro-level, as well as reasonable from the three levels the layout of urban space to reduce the impact of the earthquake disaster.

articleTitle: The Emergency Relief Prototype System Design and Implementation Based on LBS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the real needs of emergency relief work, the paper put forward a framework of emergency relief prototype system based on LBS. Because of limited software and hardware resources of the mobile device, spatial data organization and structure is modified and designed in this paper. Specifically, the pre-generation technology, caching strategy based on the tile map and positioning technology are proposed to improve the performance of the system. Finally, the emergency relief system is implemented according to the framework and good result is achieved.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Transportation Demand Management in China: Research and Practice of Staggered Work Hours, Congestion Pricing and High Occupancy Vehicle Lanes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Relationships among Relational Embeddedness, Structural Embeddedness and Innovation Performance: An Empirical Study of South China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationships among relational embeddedness, structural embeddedness and innovation performance are discussed with samples with High-tech samples drawn from South China. Moderated regression stepwise regression approaches are used to analyze the models. The results show that: (1) the relational embeddedness between firms, suppliers and customers has a positive impact on innovation performance, (2) the structural embeddedness between firms, suppliers and customers has a positive impact on innovation performance and, (3) the closer a firm's relational embeddedness with their suppliers and customers is in the industry network, the more notably the firm's structural embeddedness influences on firms' innovation performance. These findings support the view that firms can improve their innovation performances by strengthening the construction of their relationships in the industry network.

articleTitle: Study and Simulation on Performance of QOSTB
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, theoretical study and application simulation are made for quasi-orthogonal space-time block code which is usually adopted in wireless telecommunication. A new coding and decoding method are introduced for an improved quasi-orthogonal space-time block code together with its performance analysis and simulation results.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Fair Value and Profit Quality's Relativity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fair value is a term that is used usually for the quality of relativity and the truth of data, sometimes we can not really understand what is the meaning of it and we also have difficulties to use it properly. This thesis will begin from the relativity between fair value and corporation's net profit, it will research the effect on corporation's net profit due to the change of measure property by empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Simulations of Temperature and Smoke Distributions of Fires in a Road Tunnel with Roof Openings
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To interpret the characteristics of smoke flow in a road tunnel with roof openings, numerical simulations were conducted by using CFD software FDS4.07 version. Also the predicted results were compared with the experimental data of a full scale experiment in a literature. With aiming at the engineering application, the software FDS can provide reliable predictions. Then various velocities varying from 1.0 m/s to 3.0 m/s of natural wind under the same fire were simulated numerically. It was found that with an increase on the wind velocity from 1.0 m/s to 3.0 m/s, the length of the back flow was reduced from 105.0 m to 75.0 m. And the various velocities did not have significantly different effect on smoke longitudinal propagation at the early and decay stage of the fire development. Under the different velocities the gas temperature at safety height 1.8 m could not pose a threat on the life covering 300 m from fire source downstream.

articleTitle: Does Corporate Governance Quality affect R&D Expenditures?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Investment in R&D spawns innovations, which in turn, foster economic growth. In recent years, researchers have become increasingly aware of the impact of corporate governance on innovation. We examine the relation between research & development (R&D) expenditures and a governance index that contains various antitakeover and shareholder protection provisions. Using a broad based measure that encompasses 51 governance factors (Brown and Caylor, 2005), the empirical results indicates a positive association between corporate governance quality and R&D expenditures. In addition, the paper also shows that firms which are more financially constrained tend to reduce investment in R&D.

articleTitle: Interaction of Urbanization and Industry Restructure of Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional economic system includes the industry structure and geographical subsystems. Yangtze River Delta is the most sparkly area in China. Since 1978, the implementation of reform and open policy, majority cities of the area has developed into the stage of industrialization period. With the statistical data of Yangtze River Delta 1978-2007, this paper uses correlation analysis, comparative analysis and multivariate statistical methods to make a quantitative study on the relationship of industry restructure and urbanization, and find level of urbanization lags behind, industry doesn 't push urbanization sufficiently, and vice versa.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comprehensive Assessment and the Regional Differentiation Laws of Urban-Rural Integration in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Noise Reduction Method for Chaotic Time Series and Its Application Based on Least Square Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With regard to the need of non-noise data for the many existing chaos-discerning methods, the noise reduction method for chaotic time series based on least square support vector machine is proposed, followed by specific steps for its application. The result of emulation by Henon reflection system proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Reducing Data Cube Size Rapidly
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Efforts have been devoted to address the problem of how to reduce the size of a data cube through exploiting the relation of the cube tuples recently. In this paper, we present a novel technique to reduce data cube size by dividing the cube into chunk and using this reduced data cube to provide answers to queries directly. The experiments use both synthetic and real-world data. The results indicate that the technique can efficiently reduce the cube size. Through comparing the algorithm with some other algorithms, we can conclude that the technique of reducing size of cube is more efficient than others.

articleTitle: Pulse Coupled Neural Network Model of Flood Disaster Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evaluation of flood disaster has great guidance to the systematic management of flood disaster. It is a new attempt that pulse coupled neural network model is used in the evaluation of flood disaster. This method adjusted threshold value through the output of impulse, and using dynamic threshold decided the grade of flood disaster. This model simplified the training of the weight compared to BP model, which was simpler, convenient and intuitionistic. Compared the results of pulse coupled neural network model with grey association, grey clustering and synthetic grey-fuzzy, it shows that pulse coupled neural network model is scientific and practicable to evaluation of flood disaster loss.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of General Model Management and Service System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional model management and service system, which is the key component of DSS, only supports the single format model in the special application field. Based on requirements of multi-model-aided decision, this paper designs the general model management and service system which provides the general management and service for different format models on network. The system proposes the solution to manage different format models by providing model frame generator which aims to analyze decision problem top-down and model application frame which aims to integrate model function bottom-up.

articleTitle: Hi-Tech Industrialization Bond: Modeling and Pricing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new financial instrument, hi-tech industrialization bond was introduced in accordance with the usual process of asset-backed securitization. Monte Carlo simulation was applied to modeling and pricing hi-tech industrialization bond under certain parameter settings according to reality of Ningbo. It is concluded that hi-tech industrialization bond is feasible and can be alternative way to get more bank loans for hi-tech industrialization projects.

articleTitle: The Impact of E-Commerce on China's Taxation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic commerce is an unconventional market economy that is based on the sophisticated Internet technology. Great changes have taken place because the electronic business brings about profound impacts on a country's taxation system, taxation policy and taxation methods as well. China's ecommerce is still at the initial stage, the analysis of the status and function of electronic business in China's taxation system will be of great meaning for the development of China's electronic commerce, of great importance for the perfection of China's taxation system, and of great help for the formulation of corresponding policies which are important to enhance China's e-commerce development.

articleTitle: Farmers' Financial Knowledge and Access to Formal Financial Credit in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge levels of different social groups vary. Rural society members divide into groups with the economic reform in China. The structure of rural society becomes complex and rural society stratifies seriously. We test the financial knowledge level of different regions in rural China with empirical analysis using data collected from eastern and western China and analyze the effect of financial knowledge level on farmers' credit constraint of formal financial organizations. The results reveal that financial knowledge levels vary in different regions of rural China. Farmers with higher level of financial knowledge confront lower level of credit constraint.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Chinese Information Retrieval Using Clustering Expansion
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Application Study on a Coating Process Capability Analysis with Measurement Errors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concerning the evaluation of coating process capability, this article demonstrates how to calculate process capability indices with measurement errors in practice under bi-variance condition and presents a practical procedure of calculating process capability with an example application.

articleTitle: Literature Retrieval Strategies and Skills and Their Help for Newly-Enrolled Graduate Students
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It's common for newly-enrolled graduate students that they have no idea where to obtain and how to filter the mass data to what they need effectively. To help them span this dizzy situation, this paper puts forward a series of literature retrieval ways and skills in different cases and how to utilize the searched results correspondingly, based on the modern literature citation system. Moreover, taking science citation index (SCI) database as an example, this paper introduces how to search the most influential references in power electronics efficiently and analyze the results.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of E-Commerce Website Success Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the proliferation of the Internet and e-commerce applications, consumers are increasingly interacting with e-commerce Websites. This paper provides the empirical test of an adaptation of DeLone and McLean's IS success model in the context of e-commerce. We examined the key characteristics of e-commerce Website. Exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis are applied to data collected by questionnaire from 329 users of e-commerce Websites. Based on the survey, we empirically derived four dimensions of e-commerce website success model: information, design, assurance and communication. The findings provide several important implications for e-commerce research and practice. This paper concludes by discussing limitations of the study which should be addressed in future research.

articleTitle: Study on the Maturity-Based Evaluation System of Talents' Development in Knowledge Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since 1990s, the phenomena of high failure rate of projects have triggered researches into talents and their development in knowledge enterprises. Focusing on talents' development maturity, the article presents the evaluation system of talents' development in knowledge enterprises. For the reason that talents' development system in knowledge enterprises is a complicated system which is composed of many interrelated and interactive factors, the evaluation index system of talents' development in knowledge enterprises is not an internal independent hierarchical structure. Therefore, the article adopts analytic network process (ANP) to evaluate the maturity grades of talents' development in knowledge enterprises. The purpose of maturity-based evaluation system of talents' development in knowledge enterprises is to measure the maturity level of talents' development in knowledge enterprises and tries to find out existing problems so as to provide foundation for working out development plan and for improving the maturity level of talents' development in knowledge enterprises.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Managerial Ownership Motivation and Enterprise Performance: The Evidence from Chinese Business Groups
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the preceding studies, after setting up study frame and theory hypotheses, this paper analyzed the data of 651 business groups from Shanghai and Shenzhen stock market. The results show that in Chinese business groups, there is a liner positive correlativity between the extent of managerial ownership motivation and the performance of business groups, which reflects the convergence effect of interest. There is another founding that the relationship between the percentage of the managers who have some internal ownership and the performance of business groups acts as an obvious U-formed curve. The outcomes of this study will provide some advices for the system of governance and motivation of business groups, and can be used for reference by government to develop domestic business group.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussion on Flood Control Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Macroeconomic Cycle and Earnings Management Effect on Loan Loss Provisions: Evidence from US Banks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Estimating both static and dynamic models, this paper confirm earnings management effect and its associated effect with macroeconomic cycle on Loan Loss Provision hypotheses for US commercial banks. Moreover, the effects seem to be influenced by different loan loss provisions level. According the result, it suggests that the financial surveillance may need to be strengthened during recessionary phases, when banks are more likely to become fragile and have to manipulate earnings.

articleTitle: Several Characteristics on the Development of Informatization in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article discusses on the development of informatization in China, on basis of analysis of the developing trend of the world's informatization. The article states that the level of informatization development has become an important indicator in measure of the ability of international competitiveness, the degree of modernization, overall national strength and the ability of economic growth of countries and regions. In discussing the characteristics on the development of informatization in China, the article suggests that China put informatization coverage of the overall situation of modernization as a major strategy, the information network already became the important basis facility which the support development of economy and society, the information industry has become a leader in development of the national economy, information technology plays a significant supporting role in various fields of national economic and social development, informatization development environment has been further optimized.

articleTitle: Public Wireless Broadband Internet: Free Lunch?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the users' demand for informationization and mobile increasing, based on the development of wireless broadband technology, wireless cities in China are advancing to the implementation stage ahead. This paper attempts to take San Francisco for example to study the problems encountered by U.S. (United States) cities in the process of promoting public wireless broadband network, and the policies and results of solving them. Some proposals will be brought forward for the development of Chinese wireless.

articleTitle: Stage Differences of Continuous Innovation Abilities in China's Biotechnology Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is widely regarded that evaluation is a complex systematic project, which involving many aspects of the process in technological innovation, epically for the pharmaceutical sector. Based on 18 original-designing indicators and the Factor analysis, the paper evaluates the stage differences of continuous innovation abilities in Chinese hinterland provinces' biotechnology industry. And then it originally divides the involved provinces into eight categories. Research finding indicates that each category significantly represents the different level on the regional innovation capability. The study lays stress on the question that deserves attention is uneven regional development in biotech industry. Implications from this research can be used as references to policy makers and business companies in china.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Corporate Sustainable Development Strategies of Wuhan City Circle: Based on the Perspective of Core Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the mechanism that how core competitiveness impacts on sustainable development based on the perspective of Wuhan City Circle. Conclusions show that core competitiveness has a significant positive impact on sustainable development; and its three dimensions also have significant positive impacts on sustainable development; furthermore, market opportunity competence and environmental uncertainty significantly and positively moderate the relationship between core competitiveness and sustainable development.

articleTitle: RMB Exchange Rate and China's Foreign Currency Deposits and Loans: An Empirical Evidence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the reform of RMB exchange rate, China's foreign exchange deposits and loans have varied. As one falls, another rises with the change of Renminbi exchange rate.With the continuous appreciation of Renminbi, China's foreign currency deposits have reduced and foreign currency loans have increased. Commercial banks' loan-deposit ratio has expanded, resulting in shortage of foreign currency and the emergence of foreign currency liquidity risks. With the devaluation of the RMB exchange rate, foreign exchange deposits have been increasing and foreign exchange loans have been reducing. Empirical studies also support that the RMB exchange rate correlates negatively with foreign currency loans but positively with foreign currency savings deposits. This shows that RMB exchange rate really affects China's foreign exchange deposits and loans and the financial operation.Therefore, reforms of foreign exchange rate regime and auxiliary systems shuold be further deepened.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Electricity Transmission-Distribution Pricing Regulation for China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Retailer Sales Effort under Drop-Shipping Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Drop-shipping is a rising channel operation model born in the environment of rapid development of e-commerce and information technologies. According to drop-shipping model, retailers take charge of nothing but marketing and sales, while suppliers handle production and delivery. Retailer sales effort influences market demand and supplier's output, which finally determine the profit. In this paper, based on classic newsvendor model, we provide quantitative relationship between retailer sales effort and supplier's output, model the interaction of effort level, output and profit, and analyze the influence of retailer sales effort on supplier's output and final profit by means of computer simulation. The analysis indicates that, profit varies with retailer sales effort heavily, but only high level of retailer sales effort can hardly help increasing profit, and there are always specified combinations of effort level and output leading to optimal profit of retailer, supplier, and the whole supply chain.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on a General Mode of B2B Construction Material Procurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Recursive Analysis on the Factors of Earnings Management Behavior of the Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Earnings management behavior has become a common instrument for the company management to manipulate the profit in the capital market. At present, the earnings management research is mainly about the earnings management's producing conditions, motivation and empirical test and its time and place, and the like. However, specific calculative items and accountant methods of the corporation authorities are still paid less attention. In this paper, the recursive analysis is used to analyze the calculative items, and get three indexes which have the distinct relation to the earnings management, and furthermore, the regressive equation is used to carry out distinctive analysis and reasonable interpretation through SPSS.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application of QFD in Enterprise Requirements-Oriented Quality Management of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Exploring the Importance of Informal Networks on Management of Tacit Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Steam Turbine Malfunction Decision Support System Based on Distributed Integrated Intelligent Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Shipping steam turbine malfunction decision support is a complex system problem. In this paper, the method of Real time On-line Decision Support system for off-site emergency of nuclear power plants (RODOS) is used for reference, and the distributed system structure, system-integrated philosophy and intelligent-run mechanism, are introduced to system, then the frame and structure of shipping steam turbine distributed integrated intelligent malfunction decision support is put forward. This system can make full use of the independence, response and consciousness of distributed integrated intelligent theory, and offer effective support to malfunction treat decision-making of steam turbine.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Service Strategy Based On Consumer Perceived Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Power Customer Value Assessment Research Based on K-Means Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the circumstance of electricity market reform, the concept of customer relationship management has been introduced to the power grid enterprises in China, and customer value is the core of this new concept. Power grid company related to all fields of society, which have to stress on social responsibility as well as the economic benefits of their own. This paper establishes customer value evaluation index system concerning customer current value and potential value considering the effect of social energy conservation on power customer. Order-depth analysis method is used to evaluate customer value. Interests sub-selection method and K-means method is employed in customers clustering from two dimensions of current and potential value. Empirical analysis is carried out based on the fact of a municipal power supply enterprise in Sichuan province.

articleTitle: A Multi-Dimensional Credit Evaluation Model of E-Commerce Transactions (Jan 2009)
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of the inadequacies of existing credit evaluation model for e-commerce, a multi-dimensional transactions credit evaluation system applying for e-commerce is given and key factors affecting the credit of e-commerce transactions are extracted in this paper. The author proposes three methods for the calculation of transactions credit.
