They're static integration calculation, dynamic integration calculation in different dimensions and index calculation method. A multi-dimensional credit evaluation model of e-commerce transactions is established and some recommendations on the credit information reveal are given by the author.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Synthetic Assessment on the City Disaster Emergency Capability Based on Fuzzy Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the characteristics of the city disaster, the index system of the city disaster emergency capability assessment is established, and its weight is determined by the analytic hierarchy process. Moreover, the fuzzy synthetic assessment model based on fuzzy pattern recognition is established, and the final assessment grade is expressed by the relative eigenvalue, this model can construct the optimum subordinate degree of fuzzy information, which make the result of assessment more scientific and accurate.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Objective Extension Group Decision-Making Model Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-objective extension group decision-making is a new tool which integrates matter-element extension, group decision-making and multi-objective optimization. This paper studies multi-objective conversion and standardization, extension association optimization under entropy and the extension decision-making space under preference of the group decision-making; as a result, comparison and selection of objects in changing environment can be made, and systematic decisionmaking problems of multi-objective conversion and multiproject optimization in multi-objective decision-making can be solved, thus improving the accuracy and the reliability of group decision-making.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy-QFD Approach to the Assessment of Green Construction Alternatives Based on Value Engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, the concept of sustainable development is increasingly prevalent in the contemporary world. Under this circumstance, the green buildings, which play a crucial role in achieving the goal of sustainability, have become more in demand in the construction industry. Although the duration of the construction process is comparatively short in the life cycle of a project, the impact of the process on the surroundings is profound and lasting. In addition, a mass of resources and energy is consumed during the construction phase. Therefore, green construction programs should be applied and evaluated in order to reduce the environmental problems and resources consumption to achieve the goal of green building. Firstly, this study proposes an approach combining fuzzy set theory and quality function deployment (QFD) method to establish an evaluation model of the green construction program. Then value engineering method is introduced to solve the problem of the green construction alternatives optimization by the function-cost analysis. Finally, a case study is given to illustrate the evaluation process of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Information Security Awareness in Higher Education Based on the Concept of Design Theorizing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper provides a comparative study exploring factors affecting information security awareness of end users, including information system decision makers, in the context of three higher education environments: the US, the UK, and the UAE. An interpretive case-study approach is employed for the UK and the UAE using multiple data gathering methods, while for the US research relies on secondary data drawn from a largescale survey. The concept of design theorizing is used to interpret and discuss the results. The research reveals a number of similarities between the three studied environments while identifying in the case of the UAE a number of key socio-cultural factors, including conscientiousness, cultural assumptions and beliefs, and social conditions affecting university end users behavior and attitude towards work, in general, and information security awareness, in particular. A model is proposed to initiate and promote IS security awareness in the studied environments.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Potential of Public Building in Jiangbei District of Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Jiangbei belongs to Metropolitan Advanced Economic Sphere of Chongqing so its character of energy consumption can be very typical in Chongqing. A energy consumption investigation of 72 public buildings was organized by People's Local Congress in Jiangbei. Based on the investigation data and information coming from energy audit and site measurement for 14 public buildings, character of energy consumption for six different types of public building is summed up, and problems and its solutions of six energy consumption systems of public building are analysed also. It was pointed out that electricity is the main form of building energy and building electricity consumption was more than 50% of total electricity consumption in Jiangbei. Also, electricity consumption of public building, among which energy for heating, air conditioning and lighting can be half, is nearly 50% of building electricity consumption. At last, energy saving potential of public building in Jiangbei is evaluated. It is determined that if 289.3 million yuan is invested in energy saving retrofit project of public bulding in Jiangbei, it will create 9,640 work opportunities a year, drive 723.3 million yuan output of other industries and reduce 161,629 tons of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission.

articleTitle: ABMS: Agent-Based Modeling and Simulation in Web Service Selection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agent-based modeling and simulation (ABMS) is a new approach to modeling systems comprised of autonomous interacting agents. It promises to have an important role in research and education. Some researchers have contended that ABMS "is a third way of doing science". ABMS has been applied to a wide range of research in a varied number of complex domain problems. Social simulation is playing an increasingly important role in today's interconnected society. In this paper we apply agent based modeling and simulation to investigate the impact of Goldbaum's innovative "Follow the Leader" in social networks in Web services selection using a recommender system that guides a user to select the best service that matches his requirements and preferences. We test and evaluate several customers' behaviors scenarios using our simulation tool "SSSS: service selection simulation studio".

articleTitle: Bayesian Theory and Robust Control Strategy in Risk Management of Large-Scale Engineering Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A novel method to identify the index of node importance and the critical path from the view of system theory, information theory and control theory is proposed in this paper to improve project management level and reduce and evade risks in project management. Bayesian theory and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> control strategy is used to study risks for dam safety on the basis of analyzing multi-scaling characteristics of risks. This method is used to identify key nodes and the critical path. In order to shorten the early warning time and control key nodes and the critical path, the trained DBN is adopted in risk management and robust control strategy is used in calculating the control water level. Then project risks can be controlled and a new decision support system can be provided for project management. The application of the proposed method to a case study shows that the method is reliable and practical.

articleTitle: City Brand Positioning in Urban Agglomeration: Samples of 8 cities in Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It turns more and more important for a city to create a brand under the severe inter-urban competition. Brand positioning is crucial for city brand. Based on forerunner's research achievement and the experimental results, especially on the city brand positioning with full use of city resource endowment, this paper emphasizes on the research of city brand position under urban agglomeration through learning target audience (investors, travelers and immigrants) perception of city, comparing with target audience perception of rival cities, and analyzing characteristics of urban agglomeration development. Compared with the similarity and difference of concerns among the investors, travelers and immigrants, we summarize the attributes of city brand positioning, improve the IPA methods by factor analysis, and put forward FPM/UA methods and strategy under urban agglomeration. We exert the improved IPA methods to make statistics and comparative analysis of 8 selected cities in Yangtze river delta as examples. Finally, we respectively put forward detailed suggestions on brand positioning of 8 sample cities by FPM/UA methods and strategy.

articleTitle: Information Flows across Non-Deliverable Forwards, Deliverable Forwards and Spot Markets: Evidence from Korean Won and Rmb
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the interrelation and information flows across the Won-dollar and RMB-dollar spot, deliverable forward (DF) and non-deliverable forward (NDF) markets on different openness policy backgrounds. Using the constant conditional correlation GJR multivariate GARCHM model, the dynamic conditional correlation GARCH model and copula models, this paper finds that opening up NDF and capital liberalization bring better market integration as well as higher volatility. At the same time the effectiveness of central bank interventions and the independence of economics policies might be affected. Policies of market segmentation help improve the influence of onshore markets on price discovery, especially when DF markets are not well-developed, although these policies are not sustainable.

articleTitle: The Simplified and Secure Conditional Access for Interactive TV Service in Converged Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For interactive TV (ITV) services in converged network, the DVB-based DTV and the IP-based IPTV coexist in a single dual mode set-top box (STB) and the traditional one-way DVB-CA cannot be adapted to the variation. In this paper, a simplified and secure conditional access scheme based on the simplified double layer is proposed to realize authentication and access control between servers and STBs. In this scheme, the advanced encryption standard (AES) and the common scramble algorithm (CSA) are combined to secure the ITV service and its entitled control message. The video fingerprint and legitimate watermark is used for the piracy tracking and the conditional playing. The elliptic curve based authentication algorithm is used for secure authentication. Under the tripartite participation, the service key access protocol is designed to dynamically update the service keys. The algorithm in the front-end, the algorithm in the STB client and the service key access protocol are proposed in detail. Through the test in an actual application environment and the analysis of security, the proposed conditional access system is very secure with high performance for high definition ITV service and large scale customers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Positive Analysis on the Industry in Shanghai City Core Centre
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Cognitive Analysis of a PC Based Simulation of a Powered Wheelchair Navigation Task
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Shared control, also known as sensorbased control, is an important technique utilised in today's Rehabilitation Integrated Systems (RISs). The degree of sharing between the disabled user and the system is dependent upon the user's abilities and is determined with actual and virtual driving tests. A mechanism of how people extract control variables from sensory data is required. A computerised experiment, Windowstrade programmed 2-D simulation of a powered wheelchair navigation task, has been conceived for collecting such useful information. The experiment is also used in an attempt to quantify some navigation measurements such as cognitive complexity and safety as a fundamental component of the authors' safety research of RISs. This paper presents an in-depth cognitive task analysis of the data obtained from the simulation experiment. It was derived from the authors' early rehabilitation engineering research and will provide a basis for further investigations aiming at the enhancement of the independence of disabled people.

articleTitle: Integrating the Personas Technique into the Product Configuration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To product development and design, confirming user's preference characteristics has been the most primary problem. Persona is a very useful tool of requirement engineering to gather data about users, but seems seldom apply to industrial design. In this paper, a method of persona-driven analysis and the concept of product design method is proposed. It focus on extracting user's role characteristics and preferences by empirical data and then build a Product Configuration and design system construction with a series of criteria data and mapping rules based on persona. First, the data of product information and user preferences will be collected by user interview and marketing investigation. Second, the representative characteristics will be extracted as role attributes by rough set and conjoint analysis , and templates of typical user's characteristics, product preference attributes, mapping rules will be established. Based on these templates, a system of product design and configuration will be constructed which facilitated to search, match, reuse the information corresponding to similarly user template. Finally, a case was given to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: How Do Interpartner Legitimacy and Trust Affect Distribution Flexibilities and Distribution Competitiveness?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores how interpartner legitimacy and trust of distributors in supply chain affect access flexibility and partnership value based on distinction between physical distribution flexibility and demand management flexibility by using dyadic data and coalignment analysis. The results show that physical distribution flexibility coalignment has only been affected by interpartner legitimacy, while demand management flexibility is determined both by legitimacy and trust, through their mediating effect, it will influence distribution competitiveness.

articleTitle: Allocation Rules in the EU ETS: Impact on Electricity Prices and Economic Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper demonstrates that cost-free allocation, commonly called grand-fathering, implies an increase in electricity prices even when strong competition prevails on electricity markets. As our estimations for Germany's power sector show, these price increases result in substantial windfall profits, giving rise to public skepticism and calls for an auctioning of certificates in the future. While empirical evidence on the ETS' impacts is scant, the findings reviewed here indicate that even in the absence of certificate auctioning, energy-intensive industry sectors may suffer heavily from the ETS-induced electricity price increases. We argue that an abrupt transition to a complete auctioning system may endanger the competitive position of energy-intensive industries in Europe, unless all other major industrial and transition countries are integrated into a global emissions trading system.

articleTitle: Research for Ant Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Base on the way of dealing with missions of wireless sensor network communication system, this paper sets up a dynamic model of wireless sensor networks communication, establishes reference model of wireless sensor networks communication and executes simulation of wireless sensor network communication, which can be used by researchers to make the applied solutions and predict the problems. Therefore we can estimate in advance distribute rationally, change the layout of the wireless sensor network dynamically regarding on the application requirement, and handle the communication in wireless sensor networks flexibly to support the changing requirement of the flexible relationship of network communication.

articleTitle: Media Convergence and the Cross-Cultural Communication of Media Events: A Sharon Stone Case Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Impulsed by both the communication globalization and new-tech application, media convergence has become an inevitable trend for the media development of countries around the world. Based on the analysis of enormous controversies provoked by Sharon Stone's "karma" remark, this article probes the meaning of media convergence to the cross-cultural communication of media events. Our research has four major findings. First, media convergence greatly promotes the communication of cross-cultural events, in that the mature degree of media convergence determines the speed, span and depth of communication for cross-cultural events; the mutual complementarity and regurgitation feeding between traditional and new media in media convergence are very distinctive; media convergence avoids the language barrier of cross-cultural communication in certain degree. Second, media convergence reconstructures the communication rules of media events, in that journalism and communication transits from single-authority to multi-authorities; traditional media still plays the guidance role of public opinion; network media is becoming the concourse of multi-authorities. Third, the weakening of cross-cultural interpretation for the key word is the important cause of cross-cultural conflicts, which is shown in the cultural conflicts in network nationalism frame and the subculture conflicts in the same ethical frame. Fourth, the ideological opposition is the profound reason for cross-cultural conflicts. We conclude that the meanings of media convergence to the cross-cultural communication of media events manifest in multiple levels. On one hand, media convergence technologically creates enormous communication energy and consequently promotes the content communication for cross-cultural events and narrows the span of space and time between our culture and the others. On the other hand, the technology convergence has not yet produced the culture convergence; in contrast, intervened by multiple powers as nationalism, subculture conflicts and ideologies, media convergence intensifies, amplifies and increases cultural conflicts and prejudices, creating new barriers for cross-cultural communication.

articleTitle: A Way to Combat the Financial Crisis, from the Perspective of Supply Chain Management - Evidence from Chinese Troubled Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wall Street financial tsunami has scratched the global economy into the winter and already had tangible effects on the real economy and business. Some Chinese enterprises landed in a predicament. How to cope with the financial crisis and transform the "crisis" into "opportunity" becomes a top priority. In this paper, the author analyzes those underlying factors that restrict enterprises' further developments, and then puts forward some countermeasures to current financial crisis from the perspective of supply chain management. These measures touch on five different aspects of business management, which include integrity management, corporate development strategy, self-owned brands building, quality control management, and information integration and sharing.

articleTitle: Research on the Framework of the Risk Planning and the Implementation Strategy of Large-Scale Urban Development Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of China's urbanization, a large number of economic, social, environmental and other risks have been emerged in the large-scale urban development project in the urban construction, promoting a gradual deterioration of the operating environment for the urban construction. In this paper, the author analyzes the risk characteristics of the large-scale urban development project, constructs the risk planning framework of the large-scale urban development project and states that the necessary way of solving the risk problems is to construct the decision-making, implementary and supervisory mechanism in the risk planning management. The paper aims at promoting the comprehensive and effective macro regulation and control of the risk of the large-scale urban development project and directing the urban construction to develop properly and orderly.

articleTitle: Systems Thinking Solving Bullwhip Effect in Supply Chain: From the Perspective of System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the principles of System Dynamics, this paper discusses the causes of the bullwhip effect and possible approaches to controlling it, from the perspective of the dynamic mechanism of the supply chain. This paper takes as example the beer game, each outcome of which show a surprisingly similar bullwhip effect, regardless of who plays the game and when. The only explanation of this is the unstable structure of the beer game system that leads to the bullwhip effect. This paper suggests that this unstable structure is caused by controllable delays - ordering cycle - being smaller than uncontrollable delays - lead time within the whole chain. Looked into are the two most straight forward solutions, increasing ordering cycle and making full use of en-route inventory information, and why the former is difficult to implement.

articleTitle: A Practical Model on Strategic Decision Making: Based on the Complex Systems Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A practical model on strategic decision making is built helpful to introduce a new situation map on strategic decision making. The complex system theory states that the use of analytic hierarchy process and swing weighting is feasible to acquire the multiplex relative weights of factors which belong to the practical model. The situation map, generated by the combination of the multiplex relative weights of factor, is used as guidance of strategic decision making. The paper describes two modeled situations. In addition, the situation map shows the real case of strategic decision making.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Finance and Taxation Policy for Preventing Financial Risk in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Evolution of the Structure of Mainland China's System of Public Administrative Value since Reform and Opening Up
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study of Competitive Advantage to Service Integrator in Service Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, based on literature and theory review, we advanced the framework of the service integrator ability and argued that resources and supply capability, demand management and strategy fit with customer are three critical factors to service integrator's competitiveness. We further hold empirical study based on these hypotheses, the result shows that the factors have different impact on competitiveness for different type of downstream through seemingly unrelated estimation. For large enterprise, the significant factors are resources and supply capability, strategy fit. While for SMEs, resources and supply capability as well as demand management play an important role to supplier's competitiveness.

articleTitle: Study on Polarization and Diffusion Effect in Capital Cities of the Central China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on polarization theory, this present research uses data of the secondary and tertiary industry of five capital cities in Central China and their suburb during 1990-2005 to carry on empirical studies, which demonstrate that the regional difference does not apply with the singular inverse U model but the overlapping of multiple inverse U models. The secondary industry is in the diffusion phase while the tertiary industry the phase of resource absorption. Regional differences in capital cities near the Yangtze delta area such as Hefei, Nanchang, Changsha etc are much bigger than Zhengzhou and Taiyuan and it takes more regional gradient difference for capital cities near the Yangtze Delta Area to implement the diffusion effect or polarization effect.

articleTitle: Research on the System of Rural Fund Allocation Efficiency in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the background of New Rural Construction and increasing input of fund into rural areas consistently by the central government, this essay set up a system to analyze the allocation efficiency of rural fund using DEA method and its influencing factors. The result demonstrates: (1) Although the rural fund allocation efficiency in china remains stable trend in recent years, there are different situations in different provinces; (2) The rural fund allocation efficiency in Western Region is lower than that of Central and Eastern Region, also the scale efficiency of Midwest Region is lower than that of Eastern Region. If this continues, rural fund allocation in Midwest Region (especially the west) will have to face double restriction of insufficient fund input and its inefficient allocation. Accordingly, this essay provides policy recommendations such as improving the supply of fund and its allocation efficiency to promote the New Rural Construction in Midwest Region.

articleTitle: The Effects of Different Feedback Modes in Video Practice to Improve the Decision Making of Novice Officials of Ice Hockey
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study was to examine the effects of various conditions (video with text, video with audio, video with audio and text) of feedback during video practice in the use of a multimedia environment. The study evaluated the learner's recall and transfer in understanding the playing rules for decision making in calling penalties. Two experiments were conducted for this research. Participants of experiment one included undergraduate recreational sport majors enrolled in a national university in central Taiwan. Experiment two included CTIHF (Chinese Taipei Ice Hockey Federation) level-one referee seminar attendants. This research found that the presentation of video with audio and text feedback in multimedia learning was the most effective in recalling previously learned knowledge; results regarding near transfer were inconclusive. Implications for practice and further research are provided.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model for Establishing an Ecological Defense System to Control Rapidly Sprawling Urbanization: A Case Study from Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rapid economic growth stimulates a surprising and uncontrolled urbanization wave in China, and necessarily brings about, in turn, poor environment quality and low life amenity. By what means the situation can be substantially transformed into a healthy track has been a puzzled and considerably difficult work challenging all Chinese. The article attempts to explore the conceptual model for establishing an ecological defense system in Yuelu District of Changsha, Hunan province, China, a rapid urbanized area, primarily focusing on its spatial pattern and adaptable scheme in order to control its continuing sprawl and improve local environment. For achieving the aim, authors first define the concept and its key qualities, then analyze and compare differing schemes with the principal purposes of defending urbanization and resolving prevailing urban ills, in terms of their principal goals, elements and spatial patterns. Finally, three elements are indentified, that is, the eco-base, eco-fortress and eco-corridor, and the skeleton and final scheme are set out, comprising 3 zones enhancement zones, buffer zones and core conservation zones and designing a weblike spatial pattern composing of urban green spaces, greenways, waterways, wetlands, forested hills and mountains, farmlands and villages. The system is designed as an eco-centric, forest-oriented, sustainable network of life support system. In order to accomplish its anticipated functions, it must make every efforts to obtain supports from legislation, administration, residents, enterprises and other institutions, to launch large-scale mass propagations and specific training, and ultimately to compete a high level priority over so called "gray" planning processes, at lest concurrently.

articleTitle: Development of a Classification Index System for Cross-Border Emergent Atmospheric Environment Risk Sources
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on the effects of pollution incidents on sensitive receptors. A classification index system for cross-border emergent atmospheric environmental risk sources has been developed which considers the environmental factors near the risk source and the potential for cross-border pollution that influence the extent of possible harm from a risk source, and evaluating criteria for indexes have been given. The cross-border atmospheric environment risk sources have been divided into four categories, identified as extreme risk sources, high risk sources, moderate risk sources and low risk sources. An AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation has been used to evaluate the risk grades for two examples, a 30-tonne liquid chlorine storage tank from T Chemical Co. Ltd. and an 8-tonne liquid chlorine storage tank from X Chemistry plant in Dalian City, where the incident considered is an instant explosion.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Farmers' Behavior Change after Technical Training of Pesticide Use - Based on Farmers Investigation in Guangdong, Sichuan and Yunnan Provinces
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To investigate farmers in Guangdong, Sichuan and Yunnan provinces randomly, the paper analyzes farmers' behavior change after technical training. 57.21% farmers will turn safe technical knowledge into actual scientific behaviors; all specific behaviors have changes in different degree after training. Further, whether farmers' behavior is changed that is as explained variable for logistic analysis. The results of SPSS show that different areas, safe technical knowledge, basis of pesticide purchase and some specific behaviors all have significant roles to farmers change behavior after training.

articleTitle: A Framework of Trans-Boundary Water Conflict Model Based on Qualitative Simulation of Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Applying computer simulation management experiment method to study the issue of trans-boundary water conflict is proposed in the paper. Based on the thought that the nature of water conflict is strained relations among peoples due to water benefit disputes, a trans-boundary water conflict system is regarded as a complex network system composed of conflict players and the interrelationships among them. So, the paper focuses on the fact that to solve water conflict, to control the human behaviours is the key issue. Therefore, firstly, by reviewing the status quo of water conflict model and the related researches, the existing problems of the present studies are analyzed and the computer simulation management experiment method is proposed to set up a human behaviour model and a water conflict multi-agent system. And then, a framework of trans-boundary water conflict model based on qualitative simulation of human behaviour is designed, including the network graph model of trans-boundary water conflict system, agent behaviour modelling, conflict relationship modelling and the model functions of conflict early warning and control. The framework diagram is given in the paper and the related technologies are pointed out. The paper aims at finding out an effective method to study and solve trans-boundary water conflict on the basis of understanding, early warning and controlling human behaviour in trans-boundary water conflict.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between China's Tertiary Industry and the Oil Demand
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the author's previous study on the relationship between China's industrial structure and the oil emand, in order to continue to probe into the inherent law of China's oil demand increase, we use cointegration method and establish vector error correction model to perform quantitative analysis on the interconnection of China's tertiary industry and the oil demand. The research proved that, in either the respect of short-term flucation, or that of longterm equilibrium, the China's oil demand is influenced unequally by the output value growths of the intertiary industry sectors. In addition, the oil demand has relatively strong inertia in shor-tterm, as well as the reverse adjustment capacity derived from long-term equilibrium.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization for Dynamic Job-Shop Scheduling in Manufacturing Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a layered hybrid ant colony and genetic algorithm to solve the multi-objective optimization of dynamic job-shop scheduling problem in manufacturing grid. This algorithm is constructed in a layered structure, where the out layer uses ant colony algorithm to select the machine and the inner layer uses genetic algorithm with neighborhood search to optimize the job scheduling. We use a test example to show the feasibility and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Experience and Enlightenment from American Floor Area Ratio Dynamic Regulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Electrochemical Behavior of Chalcopyrite Oxidation Leaching under Oxygen Pressure and Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reports our recent study on the electrochemical behavior of chalcopyrite oxidation leaching under oxygen pressure and low temperature. We examined the open-circuit voltage, cyclic voltammetric curve and potentiodynamic potential of chalcopyrite and pyrite under different temperature and different solution conditions. We analyzed the dissolution mechanisms of chalcopyrite and pyrite under various leaching conditions. It was found that the oxidation of chalcopyrite is easier than that of pyrite in both aqueous and acidic solutions. In particular, the strength of chalcopyrite oxidation is in the order of aqueous solution, acidic solution and acidic solution with sodium chloride. Moreover, the introduction of copper (IT) chloride or ferric chloride into the acidic leaching system can greatly strengthen the direct oxidation and electrochemical dissolution of chalcopyrite.

articleTitle: An Optimized Model of Supply Chain Network Structure Based on CVaR Constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The past optimized model of SC network structure always choose not the risk, but rather the cost or customer satisfaction merely as the decision goal, which is not correspondent with practical decision. In order to supply scientific optimized model for decision makers preferring different risks, we introduced CVaR (conditional value-at-risk), a kind of recently developed instrument for measuring financial risks, to study the optimization of risk-avoiding SC network structure and to measure the risk of SC network. We also established a multi-objective optimized model taking respectively the risk and the cost of SC network as its decision goal to make the SC network built on this model more competitive.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Should the Staffs of the SOEs Be Well Informed of the Real Situation?: A Case Study of a Tobacco Corporation in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of Financing Structure of Electric Power Listed Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is a study on the financing structure of electric power listed company through an empirical analysis method. According to the financial accounting theory, the suitable financing structure can effectively enhance the value of company. Through a detailed study using the data of electric power listed companies from 2004-2006, which belongs to the security markets of Shanghai and Shenzhen, We summarize the characteristics of electric power listed company: debt financing is the main method widely used in electric power listed company, especially long-term debt financing method. This find bases the foundation for further study of the financing effect of listed power companies.

articleTitle: An Integrative Approach to Food Safety Accidents: Total Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergency management of food safety accidents is one field that emergency academics and practices have put emphasis on in the recent years. Sanlu milk powder scandal, an extraordinarily large food safety accident occurring on September, 2008, raised questions about emergency management model for improving the performance in emergency management of food safety accidents. This paper aims to construct China's total emergency management model of food safety accidents. The related literature of food safety accidents and emergency management is first reviewed. Then the deficiencies in the current emergency management are analyzed, followed by the expatiation of total emergency management concept. Finally, China's total emergency management model of food safety accidents is constructed.

articleTitle: First-Mover Advantage and Interconnection between Internet Backbone Providers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competition game and interconnection sequential equilibrium between two IBPs (IBPs: backbone providers) are studied to promote development and make out reasonable interconnection policy. For the former, the paper emphasizes the relationships between corporation profits, social welfare and interconnection quality. It concludes that interconnection between IBPs should be hierarchical and differential, and interconnection quality to a certain extent is essential. For the latter, if interconnection quality between the existed services or consumers is high, IBPs must implement high interconnection quality of the new services or consumers. It also reaches the conclusion that when Internet is of a small scale, interconnection quality between IBPs must be high. Finally, according to these conclusions, the paper analyzes the preferred policy implications for regulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Satisfaction of Salesman in Department
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, more and more enterprises gradually realize that the employee is valuable wealth. It is important to improve employee's satisfaction for human resources investment and value-added human resources. Based on the satisfaction research of salesman in department and analysis, summarize some common problems in terms of counter sellers satisfaction at present. Put forward the corresponding solution for these issues.

articleTitle: On Risk Pre-Warning Model of Derivative Financial Instrument Based on Process Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By reason of enormous risk, complexity and nonlinearity of derivative financial instrument, risk pre-warning model of derivative financial instrument is built based on process neural networks.So the timely, effective pre-warning of derivative financial instrument will come true, which helps not only to know the potential risk of derivative financial instrument, but also to prepare for risk countermeasures.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Transmission Investment Based on Matter Element
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evaluation of the transmission investment project plays a great role in the grids construct. Taking account the factors of technology and economic, this paper put forwards a index system of transmission investment evaluation. Above all, matter-element analysis theory is introduced into the project estimation, and extension set is built, the ternary-matter-element model on object, character and eigenvalue is set up. The function of correlation degree is integrated to measure off the object, and the best project of transmission investment is selected. The last, the feasibility and validity of the method of matter-element analysis model is proved by a numeral case.

articleTitle: Payout Policy under Transitory Economy - An Empirical Evidence from China Securities Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the index of Chinese marketization and the index of regional corporate governance environment, this paper provides an analysis of the relationship between governance environment and payout policy of the listed companies in China. This paper shows that regional corporate governance environment will have a positive impact on the payout policy of listed companies in China: the higher degree of marketization, the smaller degree of government intervention and the higher level of the rule of law, the more dividends that the company paid.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Corporate Strategic Mission Statements Quality and Financial Performance: An Analysis on Chinese Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lighted Navigational Aids Using GIS Mapping
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology to help navigate more safely using GIS Mapping. A proposed methodology can build up lit maps to most bay areas and port entrances. A detailed description of the range ring methodology is given and recommendations are drawn. It is concluded that the mapping of a lit area will help revision and maintenance of existing withdraws of bay lighting. A practical implementation of the methodology is applied to Great South Bay area in New York. Results show that there is a need to increase the buoys light and revise existing buoys locations in order to make night navigation through the bay safer.

articleTitle: Vibration Control Management to Secure Safety and Fast Drilling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to achieve the highest rate of return of investment, drilling project must increase rate of penetration under safety drilling. Drilling project management is one of key factors to secure drilling safely and fast. But the factors which affect the present management are not analyzed effectively in system, especially for vibration phenomenon of drilling operation, so couldn't manage exactly. Only after systematic analysis various factors, such as the structure of drill bit and drilling string system (bottom hole assembly, bit type), operational parameters drilling art (weight on bit, rotation of bit), geometry of drilled trajectory and formation character, the method and procedure of vibration control management can be established to decrease harm of vibration, achieve highest rate of penetration, shorten drilling period and increase rate of return of investment.

articleTitle: The Risk Sharing Contract for BOT Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the optimal risk-sharing contract for BOT projects. For the private company, because of the uncertainties, coming from supply and demand, they cannot evaluate or is unwilling to bear the huge risks. So the society will be confronted with a long term shortage of infrastructures. Through applying the guaranteed lowest income for companies and competitive bidding, government can stimulate company to take part in the construction of infrastructures. On this foundation it also carries on the design to the government administrative behavior in the other public projects.

articleTitle: Research on Role-Authorized and MVC-Based Content Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays many E-commerce corporations need to implement effective content management for controlling the data resources of their Websites. In this paper, a role-authorized and MVC-based content management method is proposed. Firstly, the presentation mechanism of content management is designed based on MVC model. Secondly, the system users is separated into three types, including system administrator, content manager and visitor, then a role-authorized model is designed. The proposed method can bring good performance to the content management of E-commerce corporations.

articleTitle: A New Concept and Application of Cash Profits
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Focus on the question that how to take advantage of accounting information more effective in corporate decisions, we propose a new concept of "cash profit" which combines the information both from cash flow and accrual earnings. The connotation and superiority of cash profit is analyzed. Based on empirical hypothesis, we exam the impacts of cash profits measure and accounting earnings measure on corporate investment and financing decisions. The empirical results suggest that cash profits are a relative useful measure of firm performance to accounting earnings measure.

articleTitle: Examining the Influence of Group Size on R&D Team Performance via Partial Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Team size may affect the ability of teams to perform tasks. We use a research model to examine team performance in small-sized and large-sized R&D teams. In the model, knowledge sharing and group cohesiveness facilitate team performance. Trust promotes knowledge sharing. Transactive memory system (TMS) mediates the relationship between trust and knowledge sharing. The model is assessed using data from a sample of 245 members of 60 R&D teams and is analyzed using partial least squares (PLS) method and multi-group comparison analysis method. The results of this study indicate: (1) knowledge sharing influences team performance in large-sized teams, (2) trust influences knowledge sharing in small-sized and large-sized teams, (3) TMS mediated the relationship between trust and knowledge sharing in small-sized and large-sized teams, (4) group cohesiveness influences team performance in small-sized and large-sized teams, and (5) group cohesiveness influences team performance more strongly for small-sized teams than large-sized teams.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Evaluation on the Competitiveness of Chinese Firms Participating in Offshore Service Outsourcing - A Preliminary Assumption
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Study of Corporate Governance and Companies' Innovation Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Few literature was made for the research of corporate governance effect on companies' innovation efficiency. In this paper, we do the empirical study of this topic. The result shows that controlling shareholders exert positive effect on the innovation efficiency; managers with decent stimulation also make a positive effect. However, some governance variables is not significant.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Distribution Utilities Based on DEA & AHP models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a procedure and method for assessing the operation performance of distribution utilities which is the hierarchical yardstick competition method. The hierarchical analysis of factors reflecting the operation situation of distribution utilities is inosculated in the overall goals, the criteria layer and the factor layer by employing the analytic hierarchy process. The judgment matrix and data envelopment analysis are used to gain the weights and performance factor of assessment criteria in the criteria layer and factor layer respectively. An example is provided to clarify the method suggested by this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the Correlation between Audit Firm Industry Expertise and Audit Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Audit firm industry expertise is an important factor that can impact on audit quality. In the west, empirical studies show that the audit firm industry expertise is positively correlated with audit quality. Based on the western and domestic research, this paper processes further empirical research. The results show that the audit firm industry expertise is significantly positively correlated with audit quality in China, and the correlation increased along with time. We also found that the audit firm industry expertise acts differently in different industries. Besides, it is more effective in positive earnings management audit, and plays a more important and visible role in large-scale audit.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on the Relationships between Individual Differences and Psychological Contracts - Using Knowledge Employees as Research Participants
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research examines the relationships between individual differences (equity sensitivity and careerism) and psychological contracts (transactional, balanced, and relational) using knowledge employees as research participants. We test the hypothesized relationships using hierarchical regression analysis with data from a sample of 452 knowledge employees from several big cities of China. The results show that equity sensitivity is positively related to transactional psychological contract and negatively related to balanced psychological contract, and careerism is positively related to transactional psychological contract and balanced psychological contract, and negatively related to relational psychological contract.

articleTitle: Study on the Process and Effect Factors of Knowledge Transfer in Industry-University Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industry-University (IU) as an important mode of cooperation was concerned by academic circles, business and society. This article puts forward a model of knowledge transfer process in Industry-University cooperation from the angle of Industry-University cooperation knowledge management, sets up a new analytical framework for this field, and finds out the factors that impact on Industry-University cooperation knowledge transfer, finally, presents the corresponding measures so as to enhance the effect of knowledge transfer.

articleTitle: Investor Sentiment and the Near-Term Stock Returns: Evidence from Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using a vector autoregression (VAR) model, we study how investor sentiment and near-term stock returns interact each other. We find that both past market returns and sentiment are important determinants of investor sentiment. Sentiment has predictive power for near-term future stock returns. Our results suggest asset pricing models should consider the role of investor sentiment. In addition, our evidence does not support the conventional wisdom that sentiment primarily affects small stocks and extreme growth stocks, on the contrary, it appears that the stronger relationship exist between investor sentiment and large-cap value stocks in China A-share market.

articleTitle: Multi-Organization Key Agreement and Secret Sharing for CERS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a comprehensive communication, information and command system, the coalition emergency response system (CERS) is integrated with communication, computer, network, GIS, GPS, graph, image, video monitoring, database and information processing, etc. This system is a new hot research at present. Furthermore, there are many problems for the CERS security to be solved. The multi-organization key agreement and secret sharing for CERS is focused in the paper. The multi-Diffie-Hellman exchange and (T, N) threshold are offered to realize the multi-organization key agreement and the multi-organization security sharing respectively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Time Effectiveness and Countermeasures of the Integration of Urban Rail Transit and Land Utilization - Taking Wuhan for Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the Absorptive and Creative Capability Based on Overlapping Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The essence of organizational learning consists of knowledge absorption as well as the cultivation of the absorptive and creative capability. Overlapping knowledge has an important effect on knowledge absorption and creation. The paper establishes and analyses the relationship between overlapping knowledge and the absorptive and creative capability. The main conclusion includes that the capability of knowledge absorption and creation can be optimized through adjusting the degree of overlapping knowledge. Lastly, management implications are concluded.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Establishment of Trust Mechanism in Real Estate Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Trust mechanism is the foundation for the effective operation of real estate supply chain, the success of real estate project is mainly determined by the performance and maintenance of trust mechanism. The game analysis, which selects a real estate enterprise and a contractor in the supply chain, showed that if desired trust action to be the participants' optimal choice, the crucial step is to transform one time game into unlimited repeated games, namely constructing cooperative relationship based on long term trust within real estate supply chain participants. Therefore, the establishment of trust mechanism in real estate supply chain is an effective measure to solve long term cooperation, through maintaining trust relationship among participants to raise supply chain operational efficiency. This paper established the process model of the real estate supply trust mechanism, detailed discussed the strategies of constructing real estate supply chain trust mechanism, aiming for providing an reliable reference for the real estate supply chain effective and efficient operation.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Independent Innovation Capability of Equipment Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the meaning of independent innovation capability, and then an evaluation index system consisting of four aspects is designed. Using fuzzy theory, fuzzy pairwise comparison matrix is established based on triangular fuzzy numbers, then the alpha-cut concept to deal with the imprecision are put forward, fuzzy weight is analyzes based on geometric mean, and integration of fuzzy weight are made using center-of-gravity techniques, fuzzy evaluation based on alpha-cut for independent innovation capability is put forward, and the index priority are made. At last, the application of this method in the independent innovation capability is inquired with a practical example.

articleTitle: A Venture Capital Evaluation Model of Chinese Creative Enterprises Based on Grey Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of exclusive nature and risks of Chinese creative enterprises, the paper puts forward a value evaluation index system of venture capital of Chinese creative enterprises by six factors as product, entrepreneur, environment and risks, creativity, technology, marketing, competence. Then a practical multilevel venture capital evaluation model of creative enterprises is constructed by applying grey theory.

articleTitle: IFC-Based Information Lifecycle Management in Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction project is a complex, integrated business activity involving a large number of professional participants, and it usually covers a long time span. Construction information usually scatters in each project phase. In order to share and reuse information in construction lifecycle, the information flow in construction projects is depicted by IDEFO technique, where six phases are introduced. In the view of lifecycle management, an information lifecycle management model is suggested in this paper based on IFC techniques. The model will enhance modern construction management performance through comprehensive construction information classification and functions.

articleTitle: Advanced Keyword Query Optimization on Relational Data Stream
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Despite the recent surge in the research for processing keyword search queries over relational database, only little attention has been devoted to studying on relational data stream. The research for keyword search over relational data stream is intense interest because streaming data is recently a major research topic of growing interest in the data management. In this regard we first analyze the researches related to process keyword search queries over relational data stream, and then this paper focuses on the method of minimizing the join cost occurred while processing keyword search queries. In this paper, we propose an advanced keyword search that can yield more meaningful results for users on relational data streams. We also propose a query optimization method using layered-clustering for efficient query processing.

articleTitle: ESS_SKN: An Effective, Strong Anonymous and Secure Shared Key Negotiation Protocol in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The anonymous security in MANETs has drawn more attention in the military and commercial applications. In the current anonymous routing protocols, the trapdoor used to hide the destination ID is encrypted by symmetric key due to its efficiency. However there exist limitations in their symmetric key anonymous negotiation. We proposed a novel protocol based on IBE cryptosystem to negotiate the shared key. It innovatively constructs the trapdoor using bilinear map to hide the destination ID. And the source node can randomly generate and update the pseudo public key and private key to hide itself true ID. We proved that it is an anonymous, effective and secure protocol through analysis and comparison with other methods. It is mentioned that our method can also be to construct the trapdoor used in the anonymous route discovery phase.

articleTitle: Environmental Load Assessment of Alumina during Its Life Cycle Manufacturing Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper describes a complete set of environmental load assessment index of resource depletion, energy consumption and environmental discharges for alumina and presents the mathematical model for calculating environmental load of alumina during its whole manufacturing process chain. To demonstrate the method, a case study comparing the environmental load of alumina during its whole Bayer manufacturing process with two methods of caldron digestion and tube digestion is presented, and the load information on final product of alumina as well as intermediate product are also obtained simultaneously to support the effective identification and subsequent improvement of the aspects in those processes of digestion, precipitation, evaporation, aluminium trihydrate calcining that contribute the significant loads.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Evolution of Enterprise Strategic Network: From an Ecological Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a complex system, the strategic network has many similar attributes as the natural ecological system. Drawing lessons from theories and models of ecology, this paper researches on eco-relationship among enterprises, and concludes that the main eco-relationships in the midst of strategic network nodes are cooperation, cooperative competition, and co-existence. At the same time, according to different node relationships, this paper builds up corresponding eco-evolutionary models for the strategic network. By analyzing the models, we get the conditions under which the strategic network nodes achieve stable equilibrium in different inter-node-relationships. The achievement helps us to have a better understanding of the principles in the process of strategic network evolution, sharpening the overall competitive edge of the system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study over the Relation between Safety Accidents and Development of Social Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Research on Flow and Water Quality Numerical Simulation for Urban River Network in Fuzhou
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, according to the previous studies and water body's hydrodynamic and quality features in the tidal river network region, one-dimensional hydrodynamic and water quality model is established and validated. The results show that the calculated value of hydrodynamic model can better match the measured and reflect the tidal fluctuation trends accurately, and water quality model can reflect the changes of contaminants reverberating within the river network in the impact of fluctuation in tide. This study with a certain directive significance provides a theoretical foundation to solve the problems of water environment of Fuzhou City.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Evolution Model and Mechanism of Social Contradictions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In connection with the status of the social contradictions in China, This article attempts to stage the evolution of the social contradictions in the positioning of both quantitative and qualitative (disappearance and transformation). Through the analysis of the evolution of social contradictions, the process of evolution will be divided into five stages (embryo, development, turbulence, intensification and disappearance and transformation), and thus determine the characteristics and critical point of each stage as well as the standards of evolution. Eventually build a description of the evolution of mechanism of social contradictions.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Route Selection of the Employees' Knowledge Reception
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through 335 questionnaires collected from 22 corporations in our survey, the two key factors which can influence the employee's knowledge reception readiness in the process of knowledge transfer, namely the degree of knowledge customization and the reliability of the knowledge source, are studied empirically. Moreover, the mediate effect of the employees' involvement degree and specialization degree to the route is analyzed. Therefore, increase the requirement of the external knowledge customization as well as the authority of the external consultants will be help to advance the employees' knowledge reception readiness, and then make an influence to the work performance. When receiving the external knowledge, it is important to not only enhance the employees' involvement and specialization but also to pay attention to the employees' attitude to the reform brought by the external knowledge as well as the resistance caused by the reform so that the external knowledge could be evaluated properly and received. Finally, the suggestions for the managerial practice as well as the future research direction are proposed.

articleTitle: A Governance Framework for E-Government Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: IT governance is a very effective way to keep the goal of e-government development consistent with that of public services. The paper, based on the IT governance theory, analyzes the key problems in China's e-government development, and proposes a governance framework for e-government from perspectives including value chain management, decision-making power and responsibility model, and performance evaluation model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Effect of Investment in Human Capital on Employment in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Optimal Model of Software Project Cost Risk Resolution Strategy Combination Based on COCOMOII
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article first develops the definition of software project cost risk and the efficiency of software project risk resolution strategy combination, then taking the efficiency as the selection criteria, proposes an optimal model for choosing software project cost risk resolution strategy combination based on the COCOMOII model. The model can provide us suggestions of how to select the appropriate software project cost risk resolution strategy combination at the stage of software project risk planning. Finally an example was given to prove the practicability and feasibility.

articleTitle: Multichannel Blind Image Restoration Using Subspace-Based Extended CLS Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm based on subspace and extended constrained least squares (CLS) for multichannel blind image restoration. Subspace-based methods are good solutions for multichannel blind image restoration, but always sensitive to noise. An adaptive singular value decomposition (SVD)-based denoising technique is used to improve the degraded images quality, and a priori distribution of blurs derived from subspace approach is added to the extended CLS multichannel blind image restoration method, which makes a new regularization function to recover images. Experimental results show that, this algorithm is convergent and works well even on very noisy circumstances.

articleTitle: Spatial Pattern Analysis of Banking Industry in Urban Area of Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to explore the location characteristics of banking industry and accordingly the spatial effect of social and economic factors, this paper investigates the spatial distribution of the mesh point of five state-owned banks based on GIS and spatial statistic methods. The global Moran's I is calculated to measure the pattern of banking industry in urban area of Shanghai at the global scale, based on which, the Moran's I scatter plot and local indicators of spatial association (LISA) are introduced to detect the spatial autocorrelation at the local scale. The result shows that there exists spatial interdependence of the bank density of postal districts, while the distribution of bank mesh point exhibits the trend of heterogeneity at the same time, which is due to the history legacy and the join force of market and government intervention.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on China's E-Money Regulation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years the regulation of our country's E-money has faced multiple challenges. This article uses game theory and establishes three complete information of static game models between E-money issuing instrument, E-money circulating institution, E-money users and supervisors of which government take the lead. Through the discussion of model equilibrium it will disclose the key to E-money supervision and offer corresponding advice.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Land Resources Management Information System for Shihezi, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Use of land resources changes rapidly in China. Difficulties and problems in managing land resources are various, such as unnecessary repeatability, low use efficiency, slow data updating and long cycle. A major reason for this is data sharing. To build land resources management information system and to make its functions practical are very important. In this study, we investigated rules of building land resources management information system, and presented methods and framework of design and realization.

articleTitle: Data Disposal and Analysis with Least Squares Collocation in Tall Building Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As more and more high-rise buildings are constructed in cities in China, the monitoring, evaluation and maintenance are involved in simultaneously during tall building operation and management. Further more, the different data process and analysis results of health monitoring of tall building can create different maintenance and management disposal methods, and which conduct important influence on evaluation of safety, stability and future using. Traditional theories and methods of data processing commonly used in regression curve and multiple linear regressions etc. But there only can be used for dealing with similar observations, on the other hand, the gross error of data has no good approach to analysis and calculate in high precise. In this paper, a tall building deformation was monitored through precise leveling between datum mark and subsidence point. The subsidence analysis method based on least squares collocation was used during data disposal process. With Gauss Function to simulate covariance matrix of observation data in different monitoring points, the optimal subsidence and incline rate were calculated. Then the stability and safety of tall building can be evaluated in a short period or medium-term, make decisions for maintenance and management.

articleTitle: Operational mechanism and simulation on river basin water resources adaptive allocation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Lack of water is an urgent problem to be settled. The application of river basin water allocation mechanisms helps to allocate water reasonably and efficiently and harmonize the relation between government and market in course of river basin water management. Based on the changes of river basin water allocation mechanisms, the paper get three conclusions: (1) river basin water allocation mechanisms should be an adjustive, innovative, and adaptive process of water-rights-coursed changes and marketization-oriented reform;(2) river basin water adaptive allocation mechanisms should be a dualistic one between administrative allocation and market allocation; (3) the key to river basin water resources adaptive allocation mechanism lies in adaptation of microcosmic agents and emergence of water system which was verified by simulation on the platform of Swarm.

articleTitle: The Research on Distance Optimization of Batch-Order Picking Based on GA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we address the problem of batching orders in a parallel-aisle warehouse, with the objective to minimize the travel distance of picking all of the batches. This study develops an order batching approach based on genetic algorithms (GAs). Unlike to previous batching methods, in this paper it pays attention on the selection of seed orders. And it obviously reduce the distance of picking compared with other approach.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Steam Technology for Removing Oleoresin from Masson Pine Wood by Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Complex Planning and Development of City Traffic and Its Properties
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: City traffic plays an important role in the city construction system. With respect to the situation that the transport infrastructure effectiveness can't match with its investment, at the basis of the analysis on the influence mechanism between city traffic and the surrounding properties, this paper quantitative analyzes the extent impact on the surrounding properties from city traffic by using Hedonic Price Method (HPM), and makes recommendations that integrated planning and development should be drawn up between city traffic and the surrounding properties.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Guide the Management of Urban Outdoor Ads by the Setting Planning: Taking Example of Kim Keqiao Avenue Advertising Management in Shaoxing County
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Reexamination and Extension of Customer Bonding Tactics in B2C E-Commerce Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reexamines and extends customer bonding tactics in B2C e-commerce environment in China. Findings indicate that B2C e-commerce firms retain customers through financial, social and structural means. Financial bonding tactics can be categorized into two sub-tactics: "saving money "and "gift with purchase". Social bonding tactics consist of "customer focus" and "creating community". Structural bonding tactics include "convenient to use", "responsiveness", and "risk reduction". Structural bonding tactics are more important than other bonding tactics, followed by social and financial bonding tactics. In seven dimensions, "risk reduction" is most important, followed by "convenient to use", "responsiveness", "gift with purchase", "creating community", "customer focus" and "saving money". Finally, implications, limitations and future researches are discussed.

articleTitle: The Study and Realization of Software Re-Engineering in Java Persistence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Legacy system re-engineering is an important question for study in Software engineering field. Thus, study on Legacy system's persistence is significant. The main task of Java's persistence is to identify, describe and realize the variability and identity. Under the guide of software re-engineering's, thought, this article utilized reconstruction and design pattern, and raised means how to separate and use variability and identity of Java's persistence, and apply these in persistence realization of telecommunication system bases on JavaEE.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Stage Multi-Site Capacity Planning Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of current strong globalization trend, manufacturers and planners are more willing to cooperate in many aspects such as purchasing, production, planning and so on. Accordingly, multi-site capacity planning should also be done in order to maximize the overall interests. Firstly, the difference between multi-site capacity planning and traditional capacity planning is discussed. Then a two-stage multi-site capacity planning system is put foreword and mathematical model is constructed. Finally, the practical case is given to verify the validation of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of E-Pay Payment Framework Based on Campus E-Card
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Combined with the actual situation of the campus network, analyze the structure and application framework of existing E-card system. Combined with the payment system of E-card, a viable framework for e-pay payment is proposed. The proposing of E-pay payment provides solutions for the online application of campus E-card.
