We also provide different solutions for the flow of recharge, transfer and settle accounts based on the E-pay payment framework.

articleTitle: The Study on Risk Evaluation of Networked SME Cluster Based on Gray-Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprises cluster is posing great competence as well as facing much risk. By subdividing the type of cluster, networked small and medium-sized enterprises cluster is chosen as target; by analyzing the primary sources of risk, an index system for evaluating the risk is built up; and on the basis of gray-fuzzy theory, the synthetic risk evaluating model is given in this paper. An actual application indicates that this model is valid and feasible.

articleTitle: Disposal of Pharmaceutical Wastewater by Combined Coagulation and Two-Stage ARB Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An innovative process, combined coagulation and two-stage aged refuse bioreactor (ARB) process was introduced to treat pharmaceutical wastewater. The results showed that the combined process can efficiently degrade the pharmaceutical wastewater. As a primary treatment, coagulation process can partially remove contaminants of the wastewater. Further treatment of two-stage ARB can remove the contaminants thoroughly. The treatment efficiencies in the biodegradation process decreased with increase of hydraulic load. After primary treatment by coagulation, under the suggested conditions of wet/dry of 1:7, introduction time of 6 h and hydraulic load of 500 L/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>refuse/day, the effluent of two-stage ARB meets the national discharge standard of pharmaceutical industry in China. The combined process for pharmaceutical wastewater treatment is technically feasible and cost-effective. Biodegradation plays a key role in removal of contaminants in two-stage ARB process.

articleTitle: A Research on Growth Drivers of Listed Companies in China's SME Board
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SMEs (small and medium enterprises) are the very critical strength to drive the development of national economy. China has set up the SME Board in order to guarantee the stable and continuous growth of the SMEs, and then the research in this field has become very hot for the research of SMEs. Based on the introduction of SMEs' growth and their growth drivers, this paper uses multi-regression and panel regression methods to make the empirical analysis of growth drivers of listed companies in China's SME Board. The results reflect the effect of size is higher than other growth drivers. With regard to the effects of financial ability, growth ratio of major business is taking the lead.

articleTitle: Designment and Optimization of Green Supply Chain Management Mode of Modern Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with economy globalization and China acceding to WTO, adopting green supply chain management mode is becoming an important strategy to promote international competitiveness roundly for our country enterprise. On the base of introducing to green supply chain management mode and its construction, this thesis combines national conditions in the present stage of our country, and has put forward countermeasure and suggestion for green supply chain's reformation and optimization, thus offer valuable reference for the fact that green to supply practice of chain management.

articleTitle: Grey-stochastic analysis on complex uncertainty for the Run Risk of Reservoir Dam
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aimed at the quantitative analysis for the run risk of dam, an evaluation method based on grey-stochastic risk analysis and its engineering application was put forward. According to the disposal of regarding the complicated uncertainty relationship in the run of dam as a grey-stochastic complex uncertainty, the analysis method of grey-stochastic risk probability was set up. By ascertaining the functional function, the grey-stochastic risk probability was transformed into commonly stochastic risk probability. Finally, the amended first-order second-moment method was utilized to calculate quantitatively the failure risk of reservoir dam and the risk value obtained falls in a grey space, which satisfactorily reflects the uncertainty of the run risk of dam.

articleTitle: Internal Capital Markets in Business Groups and Financing Constraints: Evidence from China's Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tests the function of internal capital markets in China's business groups. Our evidence shows that due to the scarce of necessary conditions and existence of severe tunneling, internal capital markets in China's groups aggravate financing constraints of affiliated listed companies. Because nonstate-owned groups have more intensive motivation to tunnel through internal capital markets, listed companies controlled by them have severer financing constraints than those controlled by state-owned groups. Listed companies controlled by local groups have severer financing constraints than those controlled by central groups.

articleTitle: Application of Web-Based Data Mining in Personalized Online Recruiting System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Online recruiting methods become an important part in the recruitment system. However, the lack of personal service in a Web environment is one of development bottlenecks of online recruiting system. First, this paper analyzes single online candidate's personal requirements. According to their requirements, a personalized recommendation system framework is proposed based on the technology of Web usage mining. The system provides individual recommendations in accordance with the analysis of single job seeker's searching custom and interest, so the quality of service could be improved. Then, this paper researches on two key algorithms: maximum forward path (MFP) mining algorithm and association rules mining algorithm, and implements the programming of the two algorithms in the proceed of Web-based data preprocessing and mining .Finally, the result of the test indicates that the system designed in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Based Logistics Management in Distribution Plan
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intensified globalization and consequent competitive pressures have reemphasized the importance of third party logistics (3PL). supply chain management (SCM) and intelligent system(IS) support logistics management system, The proposed knowledge-based logistics management system ( K-LMS ) is a hybrid integration of knowledge processing modules: a mathematical algorithm for calculating ,the capability value of customers' suppliers. In order to improve the quality of decision making, this paper proposes a knowledge-based logistics management system (K-LMS) to support logistics managers with the provision of the most satisfactory results in distribution plan .

articleTitle: Pilot Scale Test to Treat Coal Gasification Wastewater Using UASB and CBR Combination Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In a pilot-scale study on anaerobic UASB and anoxia CBR and two-stage aerobic CBR treatment of coal gasification wastewater, the effect of removal of COD and ammonia nitrogen was examined. The results show that this combination process has characters of short HRT, high volume loading, strong resistance to organic shock loads, stable effluent, and high removal rate (above 95%) of main pollutants.

articleTitle: Relaxation Matching for Chinese Character Recognition Using Adjacency List
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the complexity in structure and the various distortions in different styles of Chinese characters, it is more suitable to use a structural matching algorithm for computer recognition of Chinese characters. Relaxation matching is a powerful technique which can tolerate considerable distortion. In this paper, we apply a new relaxation matching technique to character recognition based on constraint relation. The correlativity relation of strokes will be verified after the initialization matching. Several rules are devised for the relaxation matching. Adjacency list structure is use to storage the information of strokes. The structure makes matching more effective. The purpose is to achieve optimal matching.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Credit Evaluation Information System Design of Modern Logistics Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Novel Particle Filtering Framework Using Genetic Monte Carlo Sampling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Particle degeneration is a key issue in the performance of a particle filter. In this paper we introduce genetic Monte Carlo into sampling process with the basic idea of solving particle degeneration by means of evolution thought. It is shown that the novel particle filtering framework can effectively eliminate particle degeneration and reduce its dependency on the particle validity. Furthermore, the new genetic particle filter can be optimized by three key genetic factors - selection, crossover and mutation probabilities.

articleTitle: Motion Evolution Law of Slope Rolling Stones and Protective Measures
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Slope rolling stone is one of the engineering geological disasters on the process of the fundamental construction in the mountain area. Combined with the slope rolling stones problem in a certain open pit mine, the influence factors, trajectory of slope rolling stones and interaction between slope and rolling stones were analyzed. The slope rolling stones movement model was built and the trajectory of rolling stones was predicted by the method of the random probability. Based on the space location of the point of fall, the bouncing height and the kinetic energy distribution law of the rolling stones, the protective measures were put forward and the height and the strength of the interception net were designed.

articleTitle: Establishment of Model of IT Performance Influence Factors for Chinese Construction Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The potential performance influence factors of the Chinese 's construction companies' enterprise tier are identified and be divided into four perspectives, which are enterprise characteristics, enterprise personnel characteristics, IT environment characteristics, system characteristics, including 38 items. Experts are surveyed about the influence factors and the model, the data are analyzed with CVR(Content Validity Ratio)method. Then the performance influence factors and model are validated and made based on the survey result.

articleTitle: Analysis of Market-Oriented Learning Mechanism of Construction Energy Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rapid and stable development of Chinese economy has raised a powerful requirement for construction industry which has achieved proper standard of technology and management. Under the environment of market economy, facing new environment, problems and fierce competition, to improve self-adaptability, construction industry must continuously jump out of the routine and traditional frame to search for new solutions. This paper tries to analyze its mechanism and bring forward relevant strategies, which is helpful for building enterprises. Based on the learning mechanism of signal evolution, the paper integrates the tendency and characteristics of building enterprises to research the market-oriented learning mechanism of Building enterprise. Applying the self-adaptability learning theory, the paper have put forward the self-adaptability learning model of building production process in the two conditions to adjust and betterment the building production process from different point of views, this to say, first, aiming at the problems in production and marketing, construction enterprises need to adjust strategies in continuous error revision learning. Second, under the precondition of enterprises' limited learning ability, to avoid the saturation of learning capacity, we need to add a limit to perception weigh.

articleTitle: On the Digital Construction and Development of Scenic Spots in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of digital scenic spots is a completely new research field. At present, the study achievements on it both at home and abroad are rare. This paper, based on the serious reality posed on the service and management of scenic spots, firstly analyzes the concept of digital scenic spot, proposes the necessity of its construction, and analyzes its current construction situations in China as well as the restricting factors such as insufficient awareness, being lack of effective cooperation and inadequate specialized talents. At last, it comes up with concrete suggestions from digital construction planning formulation, funds invested safeguarding, professional talents cultivation and introduction, aiming at enhancing the whole service management level of scenic spots in China, promoting scientific utilization and protection of scenic resources and enhancing tourists' satisfaction eventually.

articleTitle: Study on Spatial Structure of Retailing Based on GIS in Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the agility of market economy, the characteristic of market spatial structure becomes more complex since the reform and opening up. The spatial structure has broken through the traditional framework which is non-equilibriums and scattered, and represented such modern development character as diversification, grade, network, and non-equilibrium. This paper chooses 200 stochastic retailing stores whose acreages all exceed 40 m2 in the four circles of Wuhan city, after the analysis of spatial difference on acreage, number, population density, and manage forms with GIS spatial methods, and hence it is concluded that the retailing spatial structure of Wuhan city has took on figure of rating circle wholly and frame of centralization-diffusion and enchasing partially as location is concerned, centralization and diffusion takes place simultaneously, and has behaved that retailing concentrated in heartland of city with more favorable traffic and market location by the means of market infiltration, and distributed in suburb more dispersive by market monopoly.

articleTitle: Regret Aversion, Two-Fund Separation and Optimal Assets Allocation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The essential behavior of an investor will influence his financial activities. Regret aversion is a well-established psychological theory that suggests investors may feel regret and disappointed when they find out that their decisions turn out to be wrong. This paper establishes a new utility function based on regret aversion. The new function is not only the function of final wealth but also the function of the ex-post optimal level of final wealth. Then the paper considers the regret aversion in asset allocation model of an investor. It is also found that the optimal assets allocation model based on regret aversion generates two-fund separation. Finally the paper takes empirical studies in Shanghai stock market and obtains portfolio frontiers of the new model. Also the conclusion that the model generates two-fund separation is testified.

articleTitle: An Improved Channel Coding Scheme Based on BICM for CMMB
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cutoff rate is a sensible parameter specifies both a range of code rates and a measure of the coding complexity to achieve a desired error probability. China mobile multimedia broadcasting (CMMB) is an important part and a hotspot of the 3rd generation of mobile communication in China. As a scenario of radio communication, the research on CMMB has to be considered over the Rayleigh fading channels. Bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) is known as a remarkable scheme with better code diversity and cutoff rate than others over Rayleigh fading channels. In this paper, an improved channel coding scheme based on BICM is proposed to achieve better reliability than the conventional one of CMMB over Rayleigh fading channels. The simulation results show that the error correction capability of the proposed scheme outperforms the conventional one of CMMB considerably. When BER is below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>, the improved channel coding scheme can achieve more than 1 dB code gain.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Behavior of Abutment of Urban Bridge in Considering of Footing Uplift and Soil Yielding
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to evaluate the dynamic behavior of the abutment with footing uplift and soil yielding, this paper analyzed the seismic response of the abutment supported by spread foundation. In discrete element method, the soil and abutment system is simulated by mass-spring model, and the pounding between the girder and the abutment, the elastic-plastic response of the back-fill soil and the underlying soil is modeled by the nonlinear spring. Moreover, the Winkler soil spring is used to simulate the interaction between the abutment footing and the underlying soil. After comparing the results, it is shown that the effect of uplift seismic isolation is significant in reducing the plastic deformation of abutment stem at the plastic hinge regions. The yielding of underlying soil decreases the plastic deformation of abutment stem also, at the same time increases the effect of foundation uplift. However, the settlement induced by the yielding of underlying soil will make the tilt of abutment.

articleTitle: Studies on the Effect of Private Benefits of Control on Corporate Investment Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With samples of companies with control rights transferred from the year 2005 to 2007, this paper utilizes a multiple regression model to examine the effect of private benefits of control on corporate investment behavior. The empirical study results show that private benefit of control is positively correlated with the corporate fixed assets investment scale, where the higher the private benefits of control increases, the larger the corporate fixed assets investment scale becomes. It reveals that the company will increase the investment scale in order to obtain more private benefits of control. Therefore, the private benefits of control will affect corporate investment behavior.

articleTitle: An Incremental Building Algorithm of Concept Lattice Based on Binary Operations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Building concept lattice has been a focus of applied research on formal concept analysis. In this paper, several theorems which reflect the relationship between concepts are listed and proved by studying the characteristics of concepts. Furthermore, two incremental building algorithms of concept lattice that based on basic concept are illuminated. In order to improve efficiency of algorithms, binary operation is used to calculate the concepts and it is easy implemented on computer. Finally, the experimental results show its effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: RFID Authentication Scheme Base on Real-Time Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The information of RFID applications may be transferred by the congested communication network, we propose an authentication scheme, where secret session-key sharing is accompanied with the successful authentications. This scheme has reduced the communication bandwidth sharply.

articleTitle: The Impacts Mechanisms of Regulatory Focus on Entrepreneurial Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Decision regulation was neglected in the research domain of entrepreneurial decision. After investigating 277 entrepreneurs, the paper analyzed the effects of regulatory focus on the decision making by ANCOVA and regression analysis. The findings indicated the criteria of decision making were significantly varied according to groups of regulatory focus. Meanwhile, the relationships of opportunity recognition and decision making had three distinctive modes.

articleTitle: The Model of Association Rules Mining with Brain Function Image for Recognition of Chinese Words
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study's objective is to solve discovering knowledge issue from data of brain function image for recognition of Chinese words. The concern is formulated as data mining. In particular, this paper presented an association rules data-mining model based on software architecture. The model is characterized by transparent conversions between heterogeneous data formats using MDI (metadata information), communication models from one to the other sources of data using broadcasting, and united programming interfaces. This model of conducts an access-processing application. The result shows that model is feasible. This study's conclusions indicate that model could provide a possible thoughtful method of integration on large-scale data mining.

articleTitle: Stock Pricing Model: Considering the Feedbacks in Investors' Trade Decision Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A novel kind of stock pricing model with feedback (SPMF) in the framework of stochastic volatility model is investigated by taking into account the complexity and underlying feedbacks in trade decision network of three kinds of investors. Several specific stock pricing models are designed according to the specific initial setting of trade decision network. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation show that new SPMF covers the existing stochastic volatility models and our previous works, and specializes in characterizing the complex behaviors of stock price under manipulation.

articleTitle: System Vulnerability of Urban Lifeline in Emergency Response
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study presents the concept of urban lifeline to bring a systematical view on major urban utilities and critical infrastructures. System vulnerability caused by the interrelationship among sub-systems is discussed in consideration of the context of emergency response. A modeling and simulation approach to analyze interdependencies is developed.

articleTitle: Flexibility Information Integration Evaluation in Closed-Loop Green Supply Chain for Urban Environmental Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A number of methodologies have been used to explore the opportunity to enhance the flexibility in closed-loop supply chain but most of them are inadequate to express the information integration issues in supply chain. The purpose of this paper is to build an ISM and find out the relationship between influence facets of flexibility information integration evaluation in closed-loop green supply chain for urban environmental management.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Relationship of Multinational Subsidiary's Entrepreneurial Orientation and Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Basing on samples of 143 multinational subsidiaries in China, the thesis discusses and validates effect of multinational subsidiary's entrepreneurial orientation and its subdimensions on performance. The thesis also explores moderating role of environmental dynamism. The thesis found multinational subsidiary's EO was positively associated with performance, and environmental dynamism hadn't moderating effect on relationship of multinational subsidiary's entrepreneurial orientation and performance. The thesis extends research production of existing corporate entrepreneurship and makes the conclusion that corporate entrepreneurship can forecast enterprise performance gain validation in the use of multinational subsidiary.

articleTitle: Ranking and Analysis of the Influence Factors of the Ecotourism Carrying Capacity: A Case Study in Jixian County Ecotourism Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of ecotourism must consider local carrying capacity. If the numbers of visitors are so huge that use of the resource exceeds the carrying capacity of the site, the resource shortage and environmental degradation would not be avoided. In this study, a case study is conducted for analyzing the influence factors of the local ecotourism carrying capacity. Jixian County Ecotourism Park is located in north part of Tianjin, China. And the park attracts lots of visitors annually. However, large amount of visitors also make a great pressure to the carrying capacity of local area. 2008 Beijing Olympic game may lead to more visitors flowing into this area, deteriorating the environment of the ecotourism sites. This study focuses on the carrying capacity of the local area, identifying and ranking the main influence factors of the carrying capacity of Jixian county ecotourism park. The analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used as the basic research tool in this study. The research result would be helpful for setting up the efficient management system in this area.

articleTitle: Service Culture and Its Impact on Service Innovation: Based on the Model of Service Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In many countries, service sector has become the dominant sector. Modern service sector requires talents skillful at multidisciplinary subjects including IT services, business models, management skills, psychology etc. The multidisciplinary features bring about new challenges for services innovation. In this paper, we introduce the service culture concept as well as service innovation theory, and then present service value-chain model. Based on this model, we analyze the impact of service culture, and conclude that service culture influences the innovation from three aspects: interior, exterior and delivery. In the end, based on Haier Case Study, we analyze the practical significance of service culture to enterprise development.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Growth Efficiency of International Competitiveness in the Shipbuilding Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The shipbuilding industry is the international industry. Its international competitiveness attracts so much attention not only from shipyard's managers but also scholars and policymakers. On the basis of analyzing the factors affecting international competitiveness of the shipbuilding industry, the evaluation index system on international competitiveness of the shipbuilding industry is established in this paper. The growth efficiency evaluation model on the international competitiveness of the shipbuilding industry is designed as a two-stage relative evaluation model. Then an example is given to illustrate how the evaluation model works and how the results show the changes of international competitiveness in the shipbuilding industry and the implementation effect of the relative policies.

articleTitle: Application of IT2 FLS in Direction Relation Approximate Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It was necessary to consider the uncertainty of spatial data and fuzziness of relative conception in direction relation representation and reasoning, because of the fuzziness of the direction concepts and the inherent uncertainty of spatial data. The 8-direction asymmetry fuzzy model was built, in this model each primary direction tile has 60 degrees and each secondary direction tile has 30 degrees. This model was extended after considering the location error of reference point based on interval type-2 fuzzy set, and the primary membership function and uncertainty of membership value was discussed and the attribute of this model was analyzed too. Under this model, the reasoning method was built based on IT2 FLS, this method take the location error of reference point, cognitive habit and percentage of target in each direction tile into account, certain and uncertain information was considered in this method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Knowledge Management Based on Six-Step Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Treatmental Efficiency of Wastewater from Small Hospital by Vertical Flow Constructed Wetland
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The wastewater from small scale hospitals is not treated properly in China, especially considering some trace substances. In this paper, the hospital wastewater of the University of Science and Technology Beijing was treated by using Vertical Flow Constructed Wetland (VFCW). The removal effects of the absorbable organic halide (AOX), COD, number of fecal coli-forms, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N etc were investigated. Furthermore, a contrastive experiment was carried out to compare the VFCW method and the former chlorination disinfection method. The results of the experiment with VFCW showed that the mean removal efficiencies of AOX, COD, number of fecal coli-forms, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N respectively were 73.3%, 82.8%, 99.7%, 68.6%, while the chlorination disinfection treatment experiment showed that the AOX of the effluent increased by 14.3% and the mean removal efficiency of COD of the effluent was only 53.3%. The results of the experiment demonstrate that using VFCW to treat wastewater from small hospitals has a great possibility of increasing in popularity.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Strategic Alliance Stability from the Perspective of Symbiosis Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the characteristic of symbiotic system, and the paper researches on enterprise strategic alliance's structure and stability from the perspective of symbiosis theory, proposes the factors of O-RSP dimension stability, constructs the stability mechanism model in O-RSP dimension, and proposes the method to achieve the steady development of alliance symbiosis system.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Stock Preferences of China's Stock Mutual Funds Based on the Count Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the improvement of market power, Stock Preferences of China's stock mutual funds has become one of the most popular issues. Basing on the related research literatures, this papers used Count panel data model and the sample of Chinese listed firm from 2003 to 2006 to empirically study the factors affecting the number of mutual fund that holding the share of particular listed firms, which will show us the stock preferences of China's mutual fund.

articleTitle: Inpatients' Perceived Service Quality: A Dramaturgical View
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important component of service encounter theory, drama theory is designed to describe the process of service encounter in a dramaturgical view. In this paper, in the basis of drama theory and research findings of patients' perceived service quality, we propose several influencing factors of inpatients' perceived service quality and carry out an empirical study. The results demonstrate that the physical environment of hospitals and the service performance of doctors and nursing staff have a significant positive impact on patients' perceived service quality. Finally, we propose some advice for the advancement of patients' perceived service quality.

articleTitle: Optimal Ordering Policy for Perishable High Technology Products Based on Two-Direction Substitutable Demand
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the maximize profits, the decision of how to obtain optimal quantity for the two kinds of perishable high-tech products is discussed, with two-direction substitutable demand and considering the cost of out-of-stock products. By establishing stochastic demand model, the optimal ordering quantity policy is derived, with two-direction substitutable demand. A numerical example is used to demonstrate that vendors would gain more profits due to taking into account the two-direction substitution between the perishable high-tech products.

articleTitle: Study of Robot Soccer Attack Path and Action Based on Recursive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To the question of high degree of real-time at the process of robot soccer competition, dynamic environment of uncertainty, as well as the attack path and the collision position and posture, recursive algorithm had been used to analysis several common situations during the game. Solved the position and posture of the robot soccer rapid adjustment when the ball passed to the stadium boundary; After center of goal line, forecast offensive path and kicking position and posture of attacking robot soccer, allows it quickly move in accordance with the prediction path; according to the relative position of the opposing players and the goalkeeper, attacking robot soccer selects attack path and adjust pose when the penalty kick, at the same time can also make a deceptive movement to deceive the opposing goalkeeper. Finally, large numbers of experiments had been carried out on the simulation platform, and have achieved very good results.

articleTitle: Research on Middle and Small Scale Logistics Enterprises' Development Patterns under Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the further division of social work and the development of logistics and supply chain, how to participate supply chain and provide better services to companies in chain is a new task which middle and small scale logistics enterprises facing presently. There are some main development patterns of middle and small scale logistics enterprises which include vendor (distributor) cooperation based on specialization, virtual management and comprehensive participation of supply chain. Middle and small scale logistics enterprises can use AHP in development pattern selection.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Warehousing Cost Control of Agricultural Products Logistics Based on Optimal Warehousing Quantity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Novel Key Management Scheme for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new key management protocol for wireless sensor network was put forward based on one-way key chain, which could afford deterministic security and could reduce the storage cost compared with existing typical pre-distribution protocols. This protocol could distribute, evict and renew the cluster-key by one-time local broadcasting based on the difficulty of factorization of polynomial, and resolve the problems of lower resiliency to node capture and higher communications for key distribution and renewing. Performance and simulation results show that this protocol can afford the best security to the node capture attacking and requires lower storage cost; moreover, it also can reduce the communication cost of key distribution and renewing from o(N, o(n) to o(N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>), o(I) respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban Land Expansion and Spatial Diversity Based on RS and GIS - A Case Study of Changsha City, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the urban land expansion becomes an important content in the research on land use dynamic change .Using the multi-temporal RS images of Changsha City in 1979, 1996, 2003, 2008 and developing information of urban land from 1949 to 2008, the quantitative, land use structure, spatial diversity and other characteristics of urban land expansion are studied based on RS and GIS in 5 different periods. It's important to provide the information for urban planning and management. The results show that the speed and intensity of Changsha urban land expansion have gradually increased, and the urban spatial expansion patterns have experienced a conversion from a single external space expansion to a combination of external and internal expansion, from a circle-layered or linear continuous expansion to a form of plaque-like or group-like non-continuous expansion in recent 60 years.

articleTitle: The Research and Practice of Beijing E-Government Information System Integration Framework
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper put forward an inter-departmental system integration framework to resolve the problem of information interchange among government departments. With the investigation of inter-departmental application integration requirements in Beijing in the past 5 years, we prosecuted and established a universal facing inter-departmental application integration framework. The framework has been reused in Beijing municipal government and 6 subordinate governments. These governments have integrated more than 80 interdepartmental application systems in the union framework by the end of 2008. Through practice, we can draw the conclusion that the framework can be reused in the other governments and resolve their information interchange problems.

articleTitle: Design and Development of the Travel Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In a rapid tourism development situation, the tourism information technology application just in a backwardness stage. It takes the travel recommendation system design as study object, and analyses the difference between in travel recommend and common e+commerce recommendation system based on the particularity of tourism information service. Therefore, the design idea and Theoretical Model of the travel recommendation system (TRS) have been put forward. On the comprehensive understand about travel information service requirement, the authors design a three layers application framework including browser/Web's server/database server, and build up the system structure of TRS. The functions and features of the TRS, the recommendation principle and algorithm practice are described latter. At last, it use experiment method to verify the recommendation mechanism for TRS.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Comparison of the Auctioneer's Private Information and Common Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Application of Risk Management in China: A Survey and Analysis of Current Practices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Different Laborer's Stock of Education Levels and the Economic Growth: A Granger Causal Analysis of China from 1981 to 2006
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses co-integration analysis and Granger causal relation test to empirical study the relation between different laborer's stock of education level (primary, secondary, college, and graduate) and economic growth of China from 1981 to 2006. The results indicate that the dynamic equilibrium relation only exists between laborer's stock of secondary and college educated and economic growth in China. Meanwhile the Granger causal is only significant from laborer's stock of secondary education to economic growth.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge-Based Enterprise Growth System Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the coming of knowledge-based economy age, knowledge-based enterprises displayed outstanding competitive strengths by suiting for the complex environment swiftly, but there still are many difficulties in its growth, such as short life, small scale and management difficulties. While the existing theoretical research on knowledge-based enterprise does not pay any attention to the growth of knowledge-based enterprise, let alone systematic study. This paper raised six subsystems of knowledge-based enterprise growth system, including organization subsystem, strategy subsystem, system subsystem, personnel subsystem, culture subsystem and knowledge subsystem. Based on the definition of the subsystem, the paper uses the statistical analysis method to select 29 elements that affect knowledge-based enterprise growth obviously.

articleTitle: A Shared Memory Parallel k-NN Query Algorithm for M-tree
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A shared memory parallel k-NN algorithm for M-tree index structure is introduced in this paper, which is called SMP A-NN. The processing of the pending request (PR) queue is a core operation in the traditional k-NN query algorithm, which is also time-consuming. Therefore, we separate the long queue into multi-parts and assign them to different threads. This improvement takes full advantage of SMP architecture and can keep good load balancing between threads. We implement this algorithm on a common shared memory parallel PC server. A lot of experiments have illustrated the proposed SMP k-NN can speed up the query and improve the performance of M-tree for large dataset.

articleTitle: Risk Management of China's Pension Funds: An Analysis Based on ALM Optimization Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ALM assesses the stochastic characteristics of underlying liabilities and their sensitivities to risk factors. The main goal of pension fund investment is to minimize risk at a given rate of return. Therefore, it is practical for us to analyze risk factors of pension funds investment in the framework of ALM. This paper starts with regulatory rules and risk factors of China's pension funds. And then in the perspective of the corporate sponsor, we examined the impacts of regulation (inclusive of accounting regulation) on the company's funding cost, cash flow and cover ratio of the balance sheet in both final pay plan and career average plan. Our finding is that the NFC calculated based on our model will result in a low return low risk portfolio. The contribution strategy of the corporate sponsor is relatively flexible because of no additional contribution constraints.

articleTitle: Elucidating the Development of Chinese Leisure Industry from Industrial Cluster Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the progress of the national's leisure idea in China, leisure industry has gained increasing currency as an agent for regional economic development. Leisure industrial clusters are becoming one of the centerpieces of economic development policy in many parts of the world. Thus far cluster analysis has largely been applied in the manufacturing industry. Based on the theory of industrial cluster and combined with the concrete reality of China, this paper identifies the key factors that influence the creating and development of leisure industrial cluster. The paper also proposes three major model of cluster creation in leisure industry.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Influence Factors of the Implementation of Using Genuine Software
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent years, government agencies have achieved some degree of success on strengthening the protection of software copyright and enhancing its managements and laws. According to technology acceptance model theory, the reason why consumers have intention to accept genuine antivirus software were explored from five aspects, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, subjective norm, self efficacy and perceived expense. The effects of these factors on the intention to using genuine antivirus software were studied by structural equation model. Some suggestions and future research directions are also put forward.

articleTitle: The Effect of External Contextual Factors on the Choice and Usage of Methods in Web Development Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The decision of which Web development method to choose, and how that method is enacted for a particular project, is subject to the influence of a number of factors. This paper looks specifically at external contextual factors which may potentially effect the behavior of the development team. The findings of an empirically-grounded analysis of a field study of Web developers in Ireland is presented.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Impact Analysis of Transportation Industry on China's Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The New Vigorous Economic Model of China - Study of Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The initiator of the U.S. financial crisis is sweeping the globe. The world economic situation is worthy. To put more effort on new economic model study is not only the urgent need for the change of China s economic structure, but also the key issues to adapt to the good and quick economic development. Outsourcing Services is the world's vigorous economic development and economic model. In this paper, the outsourcing from theory of economic, science and technology, innovation of system is studied.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of Central Bank Communication on Public Expectations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Evaluation of the Destructive Innovation in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The destructive innovation is an important way for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to survive in the fierce competition. However, there are also risks of failure in destructive innovation. The current study paid more attention to the successes of destructive innovation, but few scholars studied how to analyze its risks to help decision-makers in SMEs determine whether the destructive innovative projects are worth investing. A systematic classification of risks is provided in this paper and an index system of risk evaluation is presented including technical risks, organization and administration risks, market risks and policy risks. On the basis of grey system theory, a grey hierarchy evaluation model is put forward to assess destructive innovation risks quantitatively in accordance with the index system.

articleTitle: Research on Selecting the Participants of the Governmental Investment Construction Projects Based on the Second-Price Sealed Bid-Auction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The author studies the methods of second-price sealed bid-auction for choosing participants of the governmental investment construction projects. To introduce the auction model based on secondary price when choosing professional project management companies, will effectively avoid the abnormal phenomenon of "Bad money drives good money out of circulation" in the construction projects, so as to provide institutional guarantor to the success of governmental construction projects. Concrete case study is given to support this theory and its efficacy.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluating and Selecting Electric Equipment Supplier Based on Hierarchy Process Analysis and Grey Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evaluating and selecting electric equipment suppliers practically, effectively and reasonably can control the quality of power plant runs. On the basis of analyzing existing appraising method for supplier selection, this article builds up a comprehensive evaluation index system for electric equipment suppliers. AHP for determining criterion's weight is expounded, and then the appraisal and selection model based AHP and GRA is built. Finally, Charge with an example to explain the concrete application of this method on appraising electric equipment supplier.

articleTitle: Targeting Valuable Customers within a Retail Reward Program Database by RFMG Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Despite the proliferation of database marketing in the marketing engineering literature, there is little research that focuses on how to segment customers and find out the valuable customers within a reward programs database. The paper develops a RFMG model, which based on RFM model by creating gap coefficient to consider purchases made at competitors, to target valuable customers. The validity of our model is statistically tested using a reward program database of a shopping mall in Beijing. The results show that RFMG model not only can target more valuable customers than RFM model but also can find out the most valuable customer group in a reward program database.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Chain Store Fuzzy Cluster Model Based on the Goods Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Evaluating Coordinated Development among Land Use, Natural Environment and Social-Economic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to evaluate the coordinated development among subsystems of a system, a method is designed and key procedures are involved as following. Firstly, the system is divided into several subsystems and a number of representative elements are chosen. Secondly, based on distinguishing criterions, element states are divided into three classifications: idea goal state (ID), secondary objective state (SE) and inferior objective state (IN). Then the element number of each classification in a subsystem is counted and state degree of a subsystem is determined by a designed function. Thirdly, a system state is determined by the actual state degrees of the subsystems in multidimensional spaces. Two distances (harmony degree and development degree) are used to evaluate the coordinated development among subsystems. The method is used to evaluate the coordinated development among land use, natural environment and social-economic in Tongzhou town.

articleTitle: SPA-Based Investigation on Pricing Model of Convertible Bonds
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Convertible bond is a hybrid derivative security, involving the characteristics of both common corporate bonds and stocks. With the common pricing model, the market price be always underestimated. As a result, it debases the reliability of the models. Based on set-pair-analysis method, this paper chooses B-S model and option exchanges model to identify and modify them. Adopted by the empirical test, the new model is more applicability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Measuring Earnings Manipulation in the Financial Distress Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Rainwater Utilization in Tianjin, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Saving water resource is one important part of environmental regulation. While water availability has been decreasing all over the world, rainwater utilization has been suggested to promote water resource saving. Tianjin, China, faces the same problem of lack of freshwater resource. Rainwater utilization is one effective measure to solve this problem. In this paper, the characteristics of rainwater in Tianjin were introduced and the necessity and possibility of rainwater utilization were discussed. In addition, a novel catalyzed ozonation/granular activated carbon (GAC) rainwater runoff treatment process was adopted for efficient and safe use of rainwater.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Demand Trend and Training Mode of the Human Resources of Chinese National Geopark
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Effects of Corporate Governance on Merger and Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the relationship between corporate governance and Merger and Acquisition with 921 Chinese listed companies as our sample. Empirical outcome shows: ownership structure is an important factor which drives a listed company to be M&A targeted company; the proportion of largest shareholdings and the second to the tenth largest shareholding ratio and state share proportion have a significant negative relation with the possibility of being targeted company. However, board of directors' governance has not significant relation with the possibility of being targeted. Whether board chairman and CEO are the same person and independent director's ratio are not closely related with the possibility of being targeted companies.

articleTitle: Multi-Mode Double Resource-Constrained Time/Cost Trade-Offs Project Scheduling Problems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The discrete time/cost trade-offs problem (DTCTP) is a widely concerned subject in project scheduling. However, in traditional research, it only treat cost as a non-renewable resource constraint, the availability of renewable resources per period has been neglected. Therefore, when renewable resources are considered, the traditional DTCTP is extended to a new multi-mode double resource-constrained time/cost trade-offs problem (MDRCTCTP), which involves both renewable and non-renewable resources constraints simultaneously. The required amount of renewable resources is added to the execution mode for each activity and by predefining the resource price, and the activity costs are related to the renewable resources. The objective of MDRCTCTP is to minimizing the project makespan with respect to the renewable resource limitation and the project total cost budget. Finally, we validate the MDRCTCTP by adopting a numerical example, the results show that the optimizing project duration is longer than the traditional DTCTP.

articleTitle: Study on Plant Landscape Information Visualization and Its Key Technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Plant is one of the fundamental elements of the urban ecological environment and landscape, and the plant landscape information visualization is an important development trend of industrial information system. The plant landscape information visualization can be used to highlight the value and effect of plant landscape from many aspects, draw the spatial framework of plant landscape and conduct spatial analysis on landscape resources, which is of great significance to people's understanding of the development & utilization and sightseeing value of plant landscape and to the enhancement of its aesthetic value. In this paper, the related concepts, contents and significances of plant landscape information visualization are stated, and the key technology system framework of plant landscape information visualization based on multiple high technologies are discussed, thus providing support for plant landscape information visualization.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Model of Information Sharing in the Management of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The information sharing in supply chain reinforces the communication of effective information and collaboration among enterprises, improves the sharing level of information, eliminates the magnified effect of information distortion, and is the key to the management of supply chain. This paper has a quantitative analysis on the value of supply chain management before and after information sharing by building up a kind of simple quantitative model of bullwhip effect.

articleTitle: Research on The Evidenced-Management Method of Engineering Quality Problems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to eliminate the disadvantage of polyploidy factors to engineering quality, two tasks are pointed out. One, the factor group including polyploidy factors should be broken down into single factor; Two, each single factor should be treated with completely under three conditions. The three conditions are controllability of object, validity of measures, and stability of environment. Together the theoretical analysis result of the three conditions with the characteristics of construction project, a new program named work-procedure control method is put forward for achieving above two tasks, and a five-grade judgment standard is established to identify the quality control ability. At last, a real construction example is presented for proving the validity of this new method.

articleTitle: Research on INSS Operation Mechanism and Configuration Mode for High-Tech Virtual Enterprise Based on C/S Framework
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High-tech virtual enterprise is a new enterprise network organization with international economy integration and knowledge economy dynamic development. According to the enterprise decision environment change, negotiation conception and mode would be increasingly updated and deepened, those require intelligence decision method and network development technology to be mutually combined. This paper analyses INSS operation process for high-tech virtual enterprise under C/S framework, provides INSS problem processing mechanism and function structure, and then establishes multi-agent collaboration manner. From the management characteristics for negotiation decision mode of high-tech virtual enterprise, INSS conflict resolution schemes and strategies are correspondingly presented. Therefore, the research could effectively improve colony negotiation efficiency and benefit, provide excellent service guarantee for coalition project successful accomplishment.

articleTitle: Research on the Microstructure of Realized Volatility in Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Realized volatility (RV) is a very good nonparametric volatility measurement for Chinese stock market. However, this volatility estimator is often influenced by microstructure noise and it will be biased. When the biased RV is used as the estimator for the true volatility, mistakes will appear in the volatility analyzing and forecasting. In order to solve the problem, this paper uses three kinds of methods: Z ratio-statistic, bias correction -autocorrelation adjusting, EMA (exponential moving average)-filtered volatility to correct RV by finding the optimal interval of Chinese Shanghai stock exchange composite index. Three-minute intervals are the optimal interval of composite index and now RV is unbiased because that price is not contaminated by noise. Our findings show that these methods mentioned could make realized volatility more effective and accurate.

articleTitle: The Agent Negotiation in Materials Procurement and Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important branch of artificial intelligence, agent is characterized in intelligence, initiative, interaction, reactivity, cooperation, etc. A future trend of enterprises' development is to introduce agent to enterprises' materials procurements and management activities, enabling several agents coordinate with each other without a direct artificial interference, accomplishing the task of materials procurement and management, and achieving the intelligence in materials procurement and management. This paper discusses the negotiating period in materials procurement and management.

articleTitle: A MetaModel Approach for WorkFlow Modeling Based On Event B
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We proposed a MetaModel approach in modeling and analysis of workflow based on event B. A workflow model is divided into three aspects: the promotion of process that we called step in operation, running time constraints and database updating. Basic properties such as activity dependency and time progressing are defined in a metamodel, a workflow model is a dynamic instance that written in event B and refined from metamodel and extends from every single static activities that written in normal B with data operations . We also provide an example to show how a workflow can be encoded into event B specification. The analysis of properties is up to the proof obligations that generated automatically from B tool kit.

articleTitle: Study on Consumer Behavior of Wireless Music
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focused on the behavior mechanism and influence factors of wireless music consumption. Both theoretical and empirical methods were used to explore the inherent mechanism of wireless music consumption behavior under China's current consumer environment and culture. Through reviewing on the previous research papers, this study developed a theoretical model of wireless music consumption behavior. 450 wireless music consumers were chosen for our investigation. The result indicates that perceived communication, perceived entertainment, and perceived personality are the three most important influence factors of consuming intention to use, while perceived ease of use has a weaker effect on consuming intention.

articleTitle: An Open Innovation Model for Business Innovation of Chinese Telecom Operators
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the traditional innovation models based on the proprietary system and internal R&D are reaching their limits, the open innovation model has been developing steadily in recent years, especially in the ICT sector which is characterized by a strong segmentation of skill-sets among firms. Business drive has taken the place of engineering drive in telecom market, which indicates that business innovation is more important than ever before. This paper firstly studies open innovation and business drive from the view of open innovation, and then proposes an open innovation model suitable for the operators according to the situation of Chinese telecom market to guide their innovation activities. At last, it discusses user innovation and collaboration as major emphasis for Chinese operators.

articleTitle: The Interrelations among the Project Team's Conduit Networks, Knowledge Network and Its Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the perspective of network, a project team's social capital consists of conduits network, and resource exchange network. Prior research intensively studies the effect of the structure of conduits network on the team's performance, assuming knowledge transfer is the causal mechanism linking conduits network to performance. This paper attempts to explore the interrelations between conduits network and knowledge network, and further distinguish the different influence between various conduit networks, and hypothesizes that a project team's knowledge network mediates the effect of various conduit networks on the team's performance. This research can enrich our knowledge of disparate influence of the various conduit networks on knowledge transfer, and imply some management practices to enhance the organization's social capital, and hence improve the organization's performance.

articleTitle: Applying Game Option Model and Simulation in the Optimal Timing of Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines the core enterprise using its first-mover advantage to determine the optimal timing for establishing virtual enterprise. Combined the real options with the principal-agent model, we investigate the revenue allocation between partners. Each enterprise's degree of best effort level in the virtual enterprise is resulted from Cournot model and the reputation effect respectively, corresponding to the Nash equilibrium and Pareto equilibrium. We calculate the option value and threshold value for the core enterprise and compare the timing interval between the two different kinds of equilibrium. The numerical calculation is applied to examine the impact of each member's cost coefficient and contribution coefficient on optimal timing. Summing up, the correlation between members' contribution coefficient and timing of virtual enterprise is not monotonous but showing the feature of lying "S"-shape.

articleTitle: Study on Re-Positioning Telecom Industry in Information Society
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the ITU-defined framework of information society, this paper will deeply analyze the supporting role of industrial part in information society, then discuss the potential opportunities of telecom industry and try to define its new position in information society combined with its existing capacity, providing theoretic support for transformation of telecom industry.

articleTitle: The Method of Process Knowledge Acquisition and Application for Corporation Basis in the Technology of Business Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are lots of acting processes of intelligent capital, structural capital and relation capital in the business process of corporations. If the process knowledge of corporation is managed well, it not only can offer supports of decision-making for corporation to make knowledge strategy, but also can accelerate sharing and recycle of process knowledge and improve the level and efficiency of corporation management. This article investigates the process knowledge acquisition from the point of operation process and according to the discussion of business process technology, as well as the factual application of idiographic corporation, establishes a method of acquiring corporation's process knowledge through the technology of business process.

articleTitle: Incentive Compensation Based on Managerial Ability and Overconfidence Bias
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The traditional principal agent relationship is studied under the agent's rationality and ability homogeneity. In fact, agent's behaviors are affected by their psychological bias, and there exists heterogeneity in the agent's abilities, which can affect the firm output. Thus, the agent's ability and overconfidence bias are introduced into the principal agent relationship. Through the optimal contracts and the relative static analysis, it is shown that different contract designs can affect different ability accumulation and bring out different output. Overconfidence bias can align agent's actions to the interests of principal and can motivate agents' human capital accumulation. Economic stimulus measures are needed to boost managers' confidence and entrepreneur long term development.

articleTitle: Based on Fuzzy Petri Nets Binding Nature of the Planning Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When planning agent is used to solve the binding plan, it should not only get the solution of problem, but also consider the credibility of binging solution in the problem. In this paper, we studies solution of the complex planning in a variety of constraints, using a tool of fuzzy Petri Nets combined with fuzzy reasoning algorithm. In addition, we identify the most important constraints and calculate the credibility of various binding conditions in planning by the formal reasoning algorithm of fuzzy reasoning process. And finally testifies the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm through a practical example.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Merged and Acquired Enterprises after Cultural Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies methods of fuzzy mathematics to set up the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model for evaluation of enterprise culture. It provides a scientific and practical quantitative method for systematic analysis and comprehensive evaluation of enterprise culture of merged and acquired enterprises after their cultural integration.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of High-Tech Enterprises'External Environmental Quality in Technological Leapfrogging
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological leapfrogging serves as the highest level of technological innovation. This paper firstly constructs an evaluation index system of external Environmental Quality for Technological Leapfrogging on basis of analyzing the external factors influencing on Technological Leapfrogging for High-tech Enterprise; then putting forward an Evaluation Model of external Environmental Quality based on BP Neural Network. Finally, this paper proves the effectiveness of the evaluation model combined with practical example.

articleTitle: The Strategic Study on Informatization Development of Textile Machinery Industry of Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has found out about the current situation of informatization development of textile machinery industry of Shaanxi Province through surveying, its development situation, obtained corresponding strength opportunity strategy, strength threat strategy, weakness opportunity strategy, weakness threat strategy, then carried on phased planning from actual condition and put forward the corresponding implementation main points to Shaanxi textile machinery industry.

articleTitle: Identification and Assessment of the Risk Based on Product Oil Distribution Project by AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is all kinds of risk consisting in every logistic distribution link of product oil because of the bigger product oil distribution district and the more complex distribution goods, a wide variety, quantity, and so on. Any question in a single spoken of earlier link happened will affect accuracy ,security and timeliness of indicator. This paper constructs evaluation index system and evaluation module by analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE).

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on the Portfolio of QDII Fund and Greenhouse Gas Emission Permits
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The European Union Allowance (EUA) futures traded on European Climate Exchange (ECX) is selected to represent the Greenhouse Gas Emission Permits (carbon assets) in this paper. The Copula function is applied to get the joint distribution function of the return rates of EUA futures and a Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) fund in China. Based on the joint distribution function of the two assets, the distribution function of any portfolio of the two assets is presented. Then, at different significance levels optimal portfolios of the two assets with the minimal Value at Risk (VaR) are shown. Through analysis of the optimal portfolios, it is found that all of the optimal portfolios showed a higher rate of return than the original QDII fund, and had lower VaRs at different significance levels. Meanwhile, the optimal investment proportional coefficient is found to have a low sensitivity to the variation of VaR required by potential investors, thus the feasibility of the proposed portfolios is further proved.

articleTitle: Stability of Industrial Technology Innovation Alliance Based on Knowledge Transfer Value
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge transfer values are closely related to the alliance stability. These values produced by the knowledge transfer process are divided into basic values, added values, synergetic values, further-developmental values and negative values. A dynamic model based on the value is established by using the system decision theory to analyze the stability of equilibrium points, and point out the knowledge transfer positivity of partners is inversely proportional to the synergy values which the other obtains after accepting knowledge, and proportional to the sum of added values and negative values lost by others transfer knowledge. These results may provide some managerial implications for enterprises which will prepare to establish or have already established the alliance and seek further development.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Extension of the Resource-Based View on the Product Development of Entrepreneurial Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Relationships of Service Quality Management Based on the Criteria for Excellence Performance of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service organizations account for a substantial portion of the output of a growing number of economies. Based on the criteria for Excellence Performance of China and survey data, the relationships among "leadership, 'strategy planning', 'customers and market', 'information, analysis and improvement', 'resources management', 'process management', and 'performance results" in service industry of China are systematically analyzed in this paper. This quantitative analysis provides a guideline for service organizations in China to identify the linkage among core values of total quality management and to identify strengths, deficiency, and opportunities to enhance competitiveness and ensure the future success of business.

articleTitle: Imperfect Information Game Analysis of Electronic Commerce Transactions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic commerce is a business model which uses Internet as a primary tool and allows the seller to provide goods and services to the buyer by the E-commerce platform. It has broken the limitations of traditional business model and has greatly improved the efficiency of the transaction. Because of information asymmetry in E-commerce transactions, the buyers couldn't fully grasp the information of the seller's credit, the quality of merchandise and so on, so sometimes it's difficult to complete the transaction in a virtual network environment. This paper, from the perspective of imperfect information static and dynamic games, is attempted to discuss the two players' strategies and playoffs in different conditions. Finally, the paper suggests a few reasonable and effective measures to establish the better E-commerce environment based on the game conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Government Process Remodeling in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Exact government process models can ensure the normal running of electronic government. Unfortunately, traditional modeling approaches have some limitations to meet these demands due to their inherent static properties. Therefore this paper researches an automatic government process remodeling approach. The core of the method is process remodeling algorithm. In the algorithm a Markov transition matrix is set up based on process logs in BPMS. And according to the matrix the eight remodeling rules of process logical relations are designed. The remodeling method can not only automatically remodel the various government processes, but also greatly enhance the process modeling efficiency.

articleTitle: A New Clustering Algorithm Using Attribute Boosting
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Combining multiple clusterings is an effective technique for improving clustering accuracy. In this paper, a new boosting clustering algorithm is proposed to improve the performance of clustering of data sets. In this algorithm, attribute subsets are extracted based on their importance. The method alters the distribution by emphasizing particular attributes while standard boosting algorithms alter the distribution by emphasizing particular training examples. A distribution over the attributes is updated at each iteration by conducting a sensitivity analysis and the attributes used by the model learned in the current iteration.
