The experimental results on several real-life and benchmark data sets show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of clustering.

articleTitle: The Influence of Personal Reading Experience on the Design of Digital Books
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article affirmed the diversity and importance of reading experience in the digital reading from the humanities and technology perspective. And then it discusses the psychological influence on digital books and attempts to propose new demands for digital books design.

articleTitle: Application of Optimization Grouping Model Based on Weight Analysis in the Edgewise Open City in Western China: A Case Study of Yining City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The edgewise open city in western China is fast growing in recent years, through the case study of typical city - Yining, the study draws the most important influence factor: GDP, investment in fixed assets, value of foreign trade and disposable income of urban residents. Then this paper analyses them and creates the combinatorial optimization model, utilizes the analytic approach of the weight to predict the Yining city spatial expansion demanding in the following several years. Finally, the paper draws the conclusion that the city along the borderline in the west is in the elementary stage of outwards expansion at present, concern that the land-use of development need more extensive and frequent concerning in the future.

articleTitle: The Study about Enterprise Knowledge Management Model Based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of technology, enterprises should have the capacity of innovating so as to survive in this environment. This paper integrates the innovative tool TRIZ with the theory of enterprise knowledge management, gives a knowledge management model based on TRIZ, advises using the TRIZ method for enterprises to manage and innovate. This model composes of six parts: knowledge base, knowledge management system, knowledge operating process, knowledge management strategic environment, knowledge visualization environment and TRIZ tool, these parts contact from one another, can manage the enterprise knowledge effectively, and can help integrate and technically innovate for enterprise knowledge.

articleTitle: Validity Verifying Method of Software Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To ensure the validity of software project management method and improve the success rate of software projects, a quantitative and systemic validation method of software project management method validity was studied combined with some actual project cases. By the data revision of the schedule result, the usability of the data could be ensured. By the short-term and small-amount data verification, the organization could obtain the implementation result in time. By the long-term and large-amount data verification, the organization could track the implementation result of software project management method chronically. The statistics of the actual data indicate that these verification methods could reflect the validity of the project management methods adopted by the organization, and could obtain continuous improvement.

articleTitle: Model of Coach Electing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electing the best eligible coach, getting the nice-to-have reflect expert idea's result, and avoiding the effect of difference between subjective preference and objective preference on decision makers are the major problems of this paper. In order to minimize decision maker's total deviation between subjective preference value and objective preference value, we adopt alternative preference information referred to as utility value to study candidate coach electing problem. To make decision making reasonable, the choice of attribute weight must make total deviation of decision maker's subjective preference and objective preference value minimized. Adopting numerical example to the actual selection of candidate coaches, the effects of it are fairer.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on the Effect of University on Regional Innovation System in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Pricing of Freight Options with Stochastic Volatilities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the freight option pricing problem. In this paper we set up the theoretical framework for the valuation of options traded in the freight derivatives market. The option price is determined in series form for the case in which the stochastic volatility is independent of the freight. Numerical solutions are also produced for the case in which the volatility is correlated with the freight. In a Monte Carlo experiment we show that our formula gives accurate prices.

articleTitle: Ruin Probability of Stop-Loss Reinsurance with Diffusion Term
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper researches ruin probabilities of insurance companies with reinsurance business. Under the assumptions that the diffusion term is considered and that claimsize is exponential distribution, the relationship between deductible and ruin is obtained. The survival probability is derived on the corresponding insurance and reinsurance company. The results extend Gerber's corresponding results for classical risk model.

articleTitle: Flexibility Integrated System Model and Building of Construction Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the instability of competitive environment and the uncertainty of project owner's demand, improving flexibility of construction supply chain (CSC) will promote the competence of enterprise, supply chain and industry. The paper proposes the conceptual model and flexible system integrated model of CSC. And the paper considers that the enhancement of CSC flexibility should integrate three levels: point-line-plane (enterprise-supply chain-industry).

articleTitle: Knowledge Representation and Reasoning of Cataloging Based on Domain Ontology and Rule
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study of audio-video material cataloging on domain ontology and rule reasoning will carve out a brand-new realm. Nowadays, the situation of setting many general rules only out of data without domain knowledge will generate substantial useless information. Concerning such problem, this paper builds the knowledge base of catalogue concepts and rules on SWRL (semantic Web rule language), which realizes the sharing of knowledge of audio-video material catalogue and the integration with relative information. Then, the improvement of rete algorithm is used to improve the efficiency of rule-based matching and the reasoning production rule using Jess is given as well. At last, the experiment on reasoning examples is carried out in protege3.4.1.

articleTitle: A Design of Price Discount Project in Different Relationships among Supply Chain Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The coordinate of the relationship among supply chain enterprises is important to supply chain management. And the price discount is the most used coordinate mechanism of the relationship among supply chain enterprises. First of all, various relationships among different enterprises are discussed; secondly, aiming at these various relationships, different price discount projects are designed in order to maximization the profit of supply chain enterprises; lastly, the different projects are compared with each other and the range of rate of price discount is get.

articleTitle: Primary Research of Risks Evaluation on Urban Land Reserve Planning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main objective of this study is to discuss the quantificational risk assessment model of urban land reserve planning. Based on the proposed model, the risk of urban land reserve planning in Nanjing was evaluated by using literature data and empirical analysis. The results show that the whole situation of the risk of urban land reserve planning in each district of Nanjing was in bad situation. The proportion of the land area in the larger risk grade was more than 66 percent. The difference of planning risk in each land grade except for the eighth grade was little. It means that the proposed risk assessment model of urban land reserve planning is feasible, providing a favorable reference for the risk assessment model of urban land reserve.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of Promulgating Regulation Fair Disclosure on Stock Return: Evidence from SME Board in China's Shenzhen Exchange
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Forest Reconstruction Using Point Cloud Data of Airborne LIDAR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Computer modeling and visualization of forest landscape recently becomes a hot topic, whose study can benefit such fields as virtual reality, ecology, forest management, physical geography and botany, etc. It is a problem to get the 3D model of the forest quickly and accurately. In this article, the placement of the trees and terrain are derived automatically from airborne lidar data. 3D structure of the trees is also extracted from lidar data. Combining these feature and AMAP software, 3D model of the tree is created.

articleTitle: Spatial Variability and Pollution Analysis of Soil Cd in Tongling City, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at providing useful information for risk assessment of environmental pollution, soil remedy and decision making, the paper interprets the spatial variability of Cd in soil in the Tongling mining area, China, and analyzes the pollution by using a geostatistical method. The dataset of soil elements content is derived from the project of "Multi-Target Regional Geochemical Survey in Jianghuai Drainage Area in Anhui Province" by Anhui Institute of Geological Survey, China. With normalized datasets that are transformed by Box-Cox, the variogram is fitted with spherical model. The results show that the variograms exhibit anisotropy, which is probably controlled by the distribution of ore deposits. The Cd in soil in the Tongling mining area has high pollution hazard. The pollution of Cd may result from lead-zinc deposits, the exploitation, and agricultural irrigation with waste water.

articleTitle: Horizontal Evaluation on Technological Innovation in Chinese Low-Tech Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of reform and opening up toward transformation of economic system, adaptation to informationization and economic globalization, low-tech manufacturing industry (LTMI) is an important driving force of China's economic development. However, most researches in China now focus on high-tech industry (HTI) and therefore relevant research findings on low-tech industry (LTI) are deficient. Based on innovation theory and DEA method, this paper gives an all-around horizontal evaluation on the efficiency of technological innovation in Chinese low-tech manufacturing industry. This is of certain theoretical value and practical significance to the guidance for further development of different technology industries in manufacturing industry in China and to the formulation of relevant policies.

articleTitle: Incentive Contracts of R&D Personnel's Technological Innovation Based on Organizational Slack
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes a principal-agent model of R&D personnel's technological innovation based on organizational slack on the condition of asymmetrical information. Through the analysis of the model, this paper obtains the optimal incentive contracts when R&D personnel engage in "technology innovating" and "getting organizational slack" simultaneously. The firm should optimize the incentives for "technology innovating" and "getting organizational slack" according to the interdependance of the cost functions between these two activities. Generally speaking, if R&D personnel's time of "technology innovating" is not limited tightly, the cost functions of "technology innovating" and "getting organizational slack" are complementary. So strengthening the incentives for the "technology innovating" of R&D personnel could not only promote their performance of "technology innovating" but also improve their performance of "getting organizational slack".

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Modes of the Rural Information Services in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the history and several typical modes of the Rural Information Service (RIS) in China; it also provides a review of related research produced by Chinese researchers and their overseas counterparts on rural information provision since the 1980s. Based on analyzing the existed problems , the suggestion on accelerating the development of rural information service in the future will be put forward. The research production gives support of decision making for the national agriculture government and the department concerned.

articleTitle: Teaching Evaluation and Diagnosis Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing teaching evaluation and diagnosis is the important measure to guarantee and improve the quality of teaching .This paper describes designed ideas and realized methods of evaluate and diagnose teaching effect of teacher, based on BP neural network, finally does the MATLAB simulated experiments. The experiment indicates that the method avoids the subjective factors and uncertainties of the traditional evaluation process,to ensure impartiality and accuracy of the evaluation result. It supplies with a new method to do a better job for teaching evaluation and diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on the Relationships between Perceptions of Organizational Practices and Psychological Contracts - Using Knowledge Employees as Research Participants
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research examines the relationships between conceptions of organizational practices (POS, LMX, and perceived meaning of work) and psychological contracts (transactional, balanced, and relational) using knowledge employees as research participants. We test the hypothesized relationships using hierarchical regression analysis with data from a sample of 452 knowledge employees from several big cities of China. The results show that POS, LMX and perceived meaning of work are all positively related to balanced psychological contract and relational psychological contract respectively, and perceived meaning of work is negatively related to transactional psychological contract, and neither POS nor LMX is related to transactional psychological contract.

articleTitle: GIS Construction in Community Scale
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project of GIS in large scale has faced difficulties, including ill-suited administration structure; complex data collection; lack of fund and technician. The development of GIS doesn't consist with the society and economy in China. Building it in small scale could detour to the destination. A community scale GIS is a basic application of local spatial data infrastructure. It's easy to achieve, and by combining a series of community scale GIS. Hangzhou, an old Chinese city, has a steady communities cluster. The citizen in Hangzhou has strongly common sense of the community. All these make it possible to build a well working community GIS.

articleTitle: Relief Equipment Layout Model for Natural Disaster with Uncertain Demands
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper a stochastic programming model is proposed to determine a relief equipment layout system for earthquake disasters. Since it is difficult to predict the timing and magnitude of any disaster and its impact, the disposition process is treated in a random manner, and both the epicenter and magnitude and the following resource requirements are represented as random variables. We will establish a multi-stage stochastic programming model for relief equipment layout. At the same time, its determinate equivalence is solved with Lingo software package. Finally, a case study is presented to highlight the significance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Economic Analysis of Intellectual Property Damages
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge management can not be separated from intellectual property protection, and intellectual property damages play a crucial role in intellectual property protection. Based on the use of economic analysis, this paper comprehensively analyzes the characteristic, compensation principle and compensation amount of intellectual property infringement, and makes an empirical analysis by using the practical data. Furthermore, a new system of intellectual property damages is constructed, which has three main points. Firstly, the infringer has more chance of escaping liability in intellectual property infringement. Secondly, it should be determined by the chance of escaping liability whether compensatory damages principle is applied or punitive damages principle. Finally, punitive damages of intellectual property are directly proportional to the actual harm and inversely proportional to the product of the probability of detecting infringement and the probability of bearing liability if detecting infringement.

articleTitle: Toward the Structure of Organizational Cultural Identification: An Empirical Study in Chinese Context
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The primary purpose of this research is to explore the structure of organizational cultural identification. Qualitative and quantitative methods were used to build and test the factors structure of cultural identification in organizations. Through exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis, the four dimensions structure of organizational cultural identification was confirmed, and the Organizational Cultural Identification Scale (OCIS) was constructed.

articleTitle: Impacts of Trade Protection upon China's Outbound M&A in the Global Financial Meltdown
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Protectionist pressures have been mounting worldwide since 1980s due to the large and persistent balance of trade deficit in the United States, and grow even greater in the global financial meltdown. Moreover, the pressures are spreading over movement of products and capital. In this article we apply a term "Spreading Trade Protection (STP)" to the situation under which the governments concerned take the advantage of inconsistency between national interests and economic interests to prevent foreign enterprises from entering the domestic markets. In fact, as an irrational block to free trade and free capital mobility, STP has fortified the imbalance of interest allocation between groups with advantages in factor endowment or in industrial transfer. The authors compare the features and implications between traditional trade protection and STP, identifying the protection range of STP beyond the traditional ones. To explore the underlying motives of various interest groups abroad to adopt STP over China's overseas M&A, the authors probe into the mechanism of STP, infer the major courses of STP in terms of China's overseas M&A. In addition, the authors go further to investigate the impacts of STP on China's overseas M&A and figure out the countermeasures in the financial crisis.

articleTitle: Research on Business Process Modeling of the Weapon Maintenance Equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It introduces the conception of the business process modeling and the essential method of the weapon maintenance equipment business process modeling. It explains the procedure of the weapon maintenance equipment business process modeling based on organization structure, business process and business information. At last, it put forwards the business model optimizing methods.

articleTitle: Process Model Based Scale-Free Knowledge Grid Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: So called knowledge grid is a virtual knowledge or experience sharing environment for innovation. Experts, software, engineers are all viewed as the resource nodes of the grid framework. Within the knowledge grid, the resource nodes can cooperate for a task such as product innovation design, the cooperation among the resource nodes are called linking edge. As a result of the distributed, dynamic, and self-organizing features of resource nodes, learning the grid composition and analyzing the knowledge dynamical features of the knowledge is vital for the management of knowledge grid. However, the modeling of the knowledge grid is the fundament for the analyzing. So a case based modeling technology was proposed in the paper. In which various practical workflow cases were used as the data source of nodes and edges information of the knowledge grid, and workflow engine technologies were used to extract the grid information and scale-free complex analyzing method could be adopted to analyze the knowledge grid in order to support the knowledge management and decision.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Cracking of Waste Deinking Aggregates for Pulping Environment Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the massive agent in the paper mills, deinking agent was wasted to pollute environment. What's worse, wood extractives increased environmental pollution. Therefore, PyGC/MS was used to analyze the bioenergy resource of bamboo ethanol extractives. Relative content of each component was determined by area normalization. The ethanol extractives contain 117 compounds namely 2-furancarboxaldehyde, 5(hydroxymethyl) (7.06%), trimethylamine (5.64%), phenol, 2(1,1-dimethylethyl) (5.24%), benzofuran, 2,3-dihydro (4.95%), lupan-3-one (4.66%), phenol, 2,6-dimethoxy(4.47%), acetic acid (4.21%), phenol, 2-methyl (4.06%), 4H-pyran-4-one, 2,3dihydro-3,5-dihydroxy-6-methyl(4.00%), lH-pyrazole, 3,5dimethyl (3.87%), phenol (3.45%), 2-furancarboxaldehyde, 5-methyl (2.90%), phenol, 2-methoxy-4-(l-propenyl)(2.04%), etc. So the rare medicinal materials and rare spice is riched in the extractives of Moso bamboo, and the by-products can be used as not only top grade cosmetics and skin care, but also bio-energy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Current Status and Policy Option of the Service Economy in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Pre-production Logistics Distribution Mode in Automobile Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: First of all, theory and existing operation of pre-production logistics in auto company are analyzed, then the shortcomings of inbound logistics of companies in China are discussed. An optimized strategy of auto company pre-production logistics distribution is set forth. At the same time, a programming model of inbound logistics transportation is created and a simulation model is developed by Arena system. Finally, the idea and strategy in this paper are proved advanced by a case study.

articleTitle: An OFDM Transmission System for Aerial photography
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An OFDM transmission system for aerial photography is provided in this paper. The system can process and transmit the SDTV data stream in real-time with a bandwidth of 2 MHz. The structures of the OFDM transmission system are described and the design and implementation of a PC-based receiver is discussed in detail and simulation and test results are also included in this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on How to Create an Excellent Design Organization in Design Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Streetscape Management Based on Elemental Constitution: The Mode of Streetscape Development under the Chinese Background
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Streetscape is a basic carrier of city image, while it presents the structure of urban planning and construction. By analyzing of the character of streetscape's composing system, this paper is illustrated by two aspects of space guiding and specific performance. In first aspect, integrative targets are set, and principles are given to improve the street interface. In the other aspect, with projects practice, controls of space configuration and constituents are provided systematically for construction the interior order of the streetscape's elements.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Study on Appraisal Index System of Independent Colleges' Credibility
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Independent Colleges, as a new model of higher education reform and development, has undergone an unprecedented developing over the past decade, and has gradually become an important part of higher education in China. However, while Independent Colleges has been developing rapidly, its lack of credibility has become one focus of attention in our society. It has become imperative that how to construct a set of evaluation index system of credibility of Independent Colleges to promote the development of Independent Colleges in China on the basis of Scientific Outlook on Development. Our empirical study found that the four-dimensional index system, which consists of organization mission and objectives, public information, fundraising, as well as fund use, is one of programs to assess credibility of Independent Colleges.

articleTitle: The Authentic Leadership and Its Relationship with CSR Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper probed into the authentic leadership development and its relationship with CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) behaviors. Three models clarified the antecedents, moderators and mediators of authentic leadership to CSR behaviors respectively. The relationship between the moral psychological capital and authentic leadership was analyzed in model 1. The moderating effect of legal constraints between the authentic leadership and CSR behaviors was discussed in model 2. The mediating effect of organizational values between authentic leadership and CSR behaviors was discussed in model 3.

articleTitle: The Grey Evaluation Model on Attendee Evacuation in Planned Special Events
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In planned special events, the attendee evacuation is a very important part of the whole traffic organization and management. After the literatures of traffic management about planned special events were reviewed, the characteristics of the attendee flow in planned special events, the evacuation objectives and the evaluation indicators, etc., were discussed and analyzed in detail. Then, a multilevel grey evaluation model was established, which can be applied to evaluate the different evacuation schemes. Finally, it was illustrated by one case that this model was applicable and practicable.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Web-Based Intelligence Mining Service System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we have completed the analysis of intelligence mining system architecture framework and workflow, and showed the design frame of the web intelligence mining service system (IMSS). We have constructed and integrated intelligence experts brainpower supplemented by data mining technology, through the study on working mechanism of collection, analysis, services, counter-intelligence of the Web mining intelligence service system. We also expounded on the important and enlightening role that this research plays in the network security and the construction of military network.

articleTitle: Ecological Footprint Accounting and Analysis Applied to Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The strategy of sustainable development is paid more attention by the people in the world. It is urgently to solve such problems by an appropriate method. This article applies ecological footprint to account and analyze the sustainable development of China's Heilongjiang province from 1995 to 2006. The following results were obtained. The arable land contributed most to the ecological footprint among the six components of the ecological footprint per capita of Heilongjiang province. It is consonant with the actual condition. The ecological capacity per capita changed form 2.3136 gha in 1995, declined to 2.2907 gha in 1997, and rose to 2.7701 gha in 2006. The total ecological capacity increased from 1.08 ><107 gha in 1995 to 1.37 times 107 gha in 2006. Although the ecological capacity increased slightly, the increase was slower than that of the ecological footprint. The results show that Heilongjiang province suffered unsustainable from the years 1995 to 2006. The ecological deficit reached the peak in 2000 with 0.9204 gha and it reduced form 2001 to 2006. The main reason was the excess exploitation and consumption of natural resource and improper economical development.

articleTitle: Exergy Analysis of Iron and Steel Eco-Industrial Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The iron and steel production industry entails high resource and energy consumption and generates a serious amount of waste and pollution. The need to conserve energy and reduce emissions underlines the importance of correctly and comprehensively evaluating the iron and steel industrial systems. Properly evaluating the utilization levels of resources and energy is one of the important tasks. In this publication I introduce a thermodynamic exergy analysis method to analyze and evaluate iron and steel industrial systems. The utilization levels of resources and energy are evaluated by comparing the result of the exergy calculation for the traditional production chain and for the material and energy recycling eco-industrial chain. The systemic problems are thus revealed and measures for improvement are proposed, providing a theoretical basis for planning and construction of iron and steel eco-industrial parks.

articleTitle: X86 Platform: The Best Infrastructure for MID
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: MID (mobile Internet device) is a new type of interesting internet device, which can provide full internet experience at anytime and anywhere. The definition and functions of MID were presented. And the difference among MID and smart mobile phone and UMPC (ultra mobile PC) and netbook and notebook was simply described. Then the two possible CPU platform-ARM infrastructure and X86 infrastructure, which comprised the core hardware platform of MID, were discussed explicitly. X86 infrastructure was compared with ARM infrastructure in terms of platform size, CPU processing ability, power consuming, software & hardware ecosystem of MID, etc. The results of comparison told that X86 infrastructure was more suitable for MID. This result would give a guide to MID development.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment Strategy for Merton's Portfolio Optimization Problem under a CEV Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies Merton's portfolio problem for an investor who can trade a risk-free asset and a stock. We consider the case where the stock price follows a constant elasticity of variance (CEV) dynamics. By applying stochastic optimal control theory and variable change technique, we derive an explicit solution for the CRRA utility function. The solution consists of a moving Merton strategy and a modified factor. The moving Merton strategy is equivalent to the original Merton strategy but it has an updated volatility at the current time. The modified factor denotes a supplement part resulted from the change of the volatility.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study on Risk Control of Accounting Policy Choice
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Urban Expansion and Driving Forces Analysis of Jinan Based on Remote Sensing and GIS Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban expansion is a complex economic and social process and has been a hot topic not only in the management of sustainable development but also in the fields of remote sensing and geographic information science (GIS). Jinan is chosen to be the study area, as a fresh case, has not been systematically studied so far on the published literature especially its urban growth pattern and evolution prediction. Based on remote sensing and GIS technology, urban land of the year 1979, 1987, 1995, 2000, 2002, 2004 and 2008 are extracted from multi-original remote sensing data (Landsat MSS/ TM/ETM+, CBERS02B) and analyzed by GIS. Time scale of this research ranges from 1979 to 2008, and is divided into 6 periods (1979~1987, 1987~1995, 1995~2000, 2000~2002, 2002~2004, 2004~2008). (1) Preprocessing such as radiant calibration and geometry extract calibration was executed on the multi-source remote sensing data. (2) Based on the software platform MGE and ArcGIS, urban land was extracted. (3) The spatial-temporal regulation and pattern characteristics of Jinan from the year 1979 to 2008 were quantitatively described in details by quoting indices such as urban expansion intensity, centroid index and so on. (4) The driving forces of urban expansion were analyzed by the principal composition analysis (PCA) method. The systematic research of urban expansion pattern and driving forces analysis in Jinan could be beneficial to local planning system.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Capital Structure on Cash Dividend Based on Data-Mining Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dividend policy, part of the core issues in corporate finance, has been subject to various aspects of close attention. However, there is no generally accepted reason for the chosen of dividend policy. Considering that western dividend theory is always related with capital structure, we analysis the impact of Chinese corporate capital structure on dividend policy using the data mining technique, and examine the applicability of relevant western dividend theory in China. With data mining technique, we disclosure the relationship between capital structure character portfolio and diverse dividend policy; provide reference for dividend policy chosen and investment optimization in China.

articleTitle: Research and Development of City Image Media Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduced our independently developed media monitoring system on city image from five aspects: background, process, architecture, index and application. The system targets on monitoring, analyzing and evaluating a city's image, then help the city accurately know about itself, monitor its news and issues, propose its public relations strategies, market its city brand while perfectly shape the city's image and brand. Now this system is put into use.

articleTitle: The Supplier Alliance Research in Chinese SMEs: Based on Alliance Realizing Process Model and Survey
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Corporation alliance can increase advantages and decrease risks for SMEs. However, the concerned survey shows that supplier alliance situation is far away from the ideal status in China. Thus, this paper sets up an alliance realizing process model, and find out five key process point of supplier alliance, include potential benefits, perceivable benefits, realizable benefits, realized benefits, and benefits distribution. Among that, core competence, alliance consciousness, trust and control, and specific investment are the decisive forces to push forward alliance process. Based on the model and survey data, the nature of supplier management in Chinese SMEs are found out and discussed.

articleTitle: A Performance Appraisal Management System Based on Link Relative Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the working efficiency of every department and employee in Fuzhou Mobile Company of China, a performance appraisal approach based on unified modeling language is proposed. The performance appraisal indictors is defined by link relative method, the dimension of indictor will be eliminated by mathematical transformation. The relative management system is developed, the required data is collected and computed by the system . The evaluation result provided decision support for the supervisor of company .

articleTitle: Research on the Quick Development of Geometric Model for FEA Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A quick transformation was achieved from CAD model to geometric model for finite element analysis through some operations on features (feature simplifying, inhibiting and deleting) on the base of feature identification of CAD model, by using UG/OPEN API and Visual C++6.0, on the platform of UGNX. Describe in detail the process of establishing geometric model for finite element analysis. Finally, an application case is employed and to illustrate that method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Set Based Analysis on Bidding Decision
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is of crucial importance for any construction company to be able to deal successfully with various bidding situations. This paper offers a multi-criterion evaluation approach for contractors to selecting which contracts to bid for. As is generally accepted, bidding decisions can be divided into two consequent stages as bid/no bid and mark-up decisions, and the paper is of no exception. In bid/no bid analysis, a set of criterion is established considering the short-term and long-term effects brought by the project. The criteria include expected profit, productivity enhancement and long-time growth, which are further divided respectively. A fuzzy set approach is adopted to deal with imprecision or vagueness. Through a case study, the approach proves to be practical and can serve as a basis for determination of appropriate mark-up level.

articleTitle: An Econometric Analysis of Building Energy Consumption in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, China's rapid urbanization has caused a tremendous rise of the building energy consumption (BEC), which accounts for a large share of total energy consumption. It's well known that economic growth and energy consumption are closely related. In this paper, we present an empirical analysis of BEC and its impact factors in the term of econometrics, from the data in 1980-2007. The results show that as an important indicator of economic structure and living standards, BEC is and will encounter continuous increase in China. More effort should be put in energy savings and slowing down the growth of BEC.

articleTitle: The Theory and Simulation on the Access to the Strain Mode
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Usually the theoretical approach to obtain the strain modal are based on the traditional parameter identification methods; however, due to Complexity and low-precision of the traditional identification methods, it is obviously not practical for the large tower structure; based on the own characteristics of tower structures and combined with the modal analysis theory, feasibility of the strain modal obtaining approach under the different incentives is explored.

articleTitle: Ammonia Emission Control for the Management of Food Waste through Composting Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A modified ammonia emission model of the simulated food waste composting process was developed based on Contois function for urban waste management in this study. The model was validated through the designed experiments and run in MATLAB7. The modeling results showed good agreement with experiments', with average relative errors of 9.91% for organic matter content and 16.07% for ammonia emission after correction, respectively.

articleTitle: The Factor Analysis of Group Purchasing in Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial cluster has the function of risk sharing. And this paper may use the mathematical model to analyze the whole cluster's procurement strategy including the optimal quantity of the forward contracts. Considering the pricing of the forward contracts in the floating interest structure, this paper makes further analysis on the decision model of the whole cluster. Through the conclusion from the model, the decision maker may increase of decrease the quantity of forward contracts by the value of the influence factors considering the whole cluster's benefit.

articleTitle: Research and Design of ERP Platform Based on SAN Storage System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed and designed ERP application platform architecture based on SAN storage technology; load balancing, disaster recovery backup, etc new technologies whose core is fiber storage solution had been used effectively in platform design, and then presented the advantages and technical implementation method of the SAN. Finally, in order to validate the efficiency and stability of system designed and set up in this paper, the example was studied via establishing ERP application platform in accordance with SAN storage system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Liquidity and Financial Crises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: System Integration of Safe Early-Warning System Hardware for Roof Spatial Latticed Structure of Wuhan Natatorium
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the requirement of safe early-warning for roof spatial latticed structure of Wuhan Natatorium, according to determined monitoring key rods and position of latticed structure by civil engineer through stress analysis, the strain gauges placement and general frame of safe early-warning system are designed in the paper. Measurement principle and modifying project of strain gauges are analyzed in detail. Data-acquisitions communication system by wireless transmission is constructed. The system hardware integration has completed. Data analysis processing software employs database background affair processing method. Wireless data-acquisition software adopts multithreading technique and background serving technique. These are important roles in ensuring the whole safe early-warning system operation accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Application of Department of Integrative System Design in Large and Complex Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Large-scale projects invested by the national government are more and more, some even show the characteristics of giant systems. Traditional project management can't deal with such systems. And meta syntheses is the methodology for complex giant system. The entity who uses the methodology is department of integrative system design. department of integrative system design contains the expert system and the machine system. The machine system has the function of storing and transferring knowledge. The expert system is the carrier of knowledge, experience and wisdom, and the host of inspiration and original thinking. The machine system and the expert system are mutually dependent. Apply meta syntheses into large complex projects, build up department of integrative system design, and analysis the operation of the department.

articleTitle: Research of Airlines Revenue Management Decision Support System Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With airlines as background and combining design theory and framework of data warehouse, this paper points out the design and realization process of airlines revenue management decision support system based on data warehouse, and also probe into data acquisition, ETL design, logic model, realization methods and technologies of data warehouse.

articleTitle: The Requirement Forecast of Geological Talents in China Based on Advantage of Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A reasonable prediction of the demand for geological talents has become a pressing issue in order to meet the requirement of geological talent caused by resources shortage and environment deterioration, and prevent blindness in the higher education expansion. According to the survey of relevant literature, there wasn't a recognized method of geological talents demand forecasting at present. In this paper, we constructed a grey prediction model of the demand for geological talents in China based on grey modeling theory and the related data from 2000 to 2005. Meanwhile, the reliability of grey forecasting model was verified that it had higher prediction accuracy in the field of the short-term forecast of the quantity of geological talent, and a set of proposals for further modification of the model were put forward.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Influencing Factors of Foreign Banks Entry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Why do foreign banks enter China? Is this entry related to China's economic growth and financial policy? Using the statistics data from 1991 to 2008, this paper carries out an empirical study on influencing factors of foreign banks entry in China, and finds that there is a significant positive correlation between the growth of FDI as well as import and export trade and total assets of foreign banks in China. The demonstration also shows that the financial control policy has significant influence on foreign banks entry.

articleTitle: Spatial Outlier Detection Algorithms Based on Knowledge Discovery
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes spatial outliers detection method of studying multiple non-spatial attributes based on special objects. SOFMF algorithm is presented and its implementation has been discussed in detail in this article. Simultaneously analyze and summarize this algorithm: overcome the insufficiency of many clustering algorithms, be able to find clusters in different shapes, be non-sensitive to the input data sequence, process noise data and multi-dimensional data well, and have multi-resolution. A novel idea for spatial data clustering is proposed by the author, emphatically numerous experiments prove this idea can be applied to spatial clustering quite well.

articleTitle: Anatomy of Credit Card Cashing Based on Third-Party Payment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of credit card business in recent years, there emerges credit card fraud. The growing popularity of e-commerce with third-party payment gradually as leading electronic payment means make credit card cashing based on third-party payment become a main form of credit card fraud. The paper makes an overall description of the credit card cashing. Based on the financing channel selection model in which trader chooses among different cashing channel to minimize financing costs, it expounds that oversupply of credit card and high interest rate from normal financing channel push consumers cashing with credit card, while the properties of e-commerce, such as low transaction costs, asymmetric information and hard to monitor, facilitate the credit card cashing. Therefore, third-party payment will become the main channel of credit card cashing. Finally, the paper proposes to control the issuance of credit cards, limit the amount of each C-C transaction paid by credit card, and raise the cost of transaction to restrict credit card cashing through third-party payment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Stakeholder-Based Brownfield Redevelopment Project Integrated Evaluation System: From the Perspective of Ecology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research and Design of LBS System Based on SVG Service Components
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of researching SOA and SVG technologies, this proposed an approach and strategy to build the LBS service system based on the SVG service components, which is used to the actual system design. Enhanced system's flexibility and extendibility, realized managing data, sharing inquiry, dynamic revision, multi-platform operation in the LBS service system.

articleTitle: Study on the Real-Time Quality Information System for the Heterogeneous Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of modern manufacturing model, it makes the mutual cooperation between enterprises, intercross more and more closely. Enterprises need the heterogeneous platforms to carry out the quality of real-time information transmission and interactive with each other. In this paper, with the background of the application of quality management, we present the conditions of heterogeneous platform the model of quality management information system and component model, design and make the model of quality management information system under the heterogeneous platform come true. According to the author's study, the realization of sub-module oriented the workshop manufacturing process and the quality information monitoring module is designed.

articleTitle: Household Disposal Behavior and Attitudes Towards the Recycling of Waste Household Electrical Appliances in Qingdao, P.R. China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the authors conducted a survey of 1700 households to investigate and analyze the urban and rural households' waste household electrical appliances (WHEA) disposal habit, as well as their attitudes on recycling modes and the deposit-refund policy. The investigation results show that more than half of urban and rural households' WHEA are sold to private collectors (called non-formal collector in China), only less than 10% WHEA collected by the government or other formal collectors. And significant preference differences exist in recycling modes and relative policies between urban and rural households. More than half of urban households accept the deposit-refund policy, but most rural informants reject this policy. Key recommendations will then be outlined concerning the future strategic development to encourage and facilitate households to engaging in formal WHEA recycling system.

articleTitle: Economic Security Evaluation of Land Resource: A Case of Shanghai 1999~2006
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research establishes a comprehensive evaluation index system of economic security of land resource by using Delphi and AHP methods. An empirical analysis of Shanghai China is conducted. The conclusions are as follows. (1)The economic security of land resource is on the level of "basic security" in Shanghai from 1999 to 2006. In 2005 and 2006 the compound evaluation values are 62.9 and 68.8 respectively. (2)The favorable factors of the economic security of land resource in Shanghai are that both the grain yield per unit of land area and the proportion of environmental protection investment to GDP have kept on the levels of "absolute security" for several years, and the security level of the production value per planting area increased steadily since 2003. (3) The poor status of quantity security and the sharp fluctuation of land market prices have negative effects on market efficiency and restrain the sustainable socioeconomic development of Shanghai.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Effect of the Water Table Management on the Surface Water Quality in Paddy Field and the Growth of Rice
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using the test method of the field district, we research and compare the content variation features of the nitrate nitrogen, the ammonia nitrogen on the surface of the water and the growth status of rice plant which are in the different water table management after fertilizing in the transgenic rice . The results show that the whole developing trend of the content of the nitrate nitrogen is rapidly increasing , and then is decreasing rapidly after reaching its maximum, but, the whole developing trend of the content of the ammonia nitrogen rises first and fall later. Contrasting the different water table management, the water layer is shallower, the decay rates of the nitrate nitrogen are faster and the content of the nitrate nitrogen of the water is lower. There is a linear positive correlation between the water layer depth and the decay rates, the content of the nitrate nitrogen. But under the deep water layer, the decay rates of the ammonia nitrogen are fastest and the content of the ammonia nitrogen of the water is lowest. However, there is a linear negative correlation between the water layer depth and the tiller number of rice. Therefore, the experiment proposes that using the irrigative method of the shallow water is better way in the transgenic rice. The results are helpful for decline of the content of the nitrogen on the surface water and the growth of rice.

articleTitle: Basis of Value Evaluation: A Comparative Study on the Value Correlations between Three Kinds of Cash Flows
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cash flow is the basis of value evaluations of listed companies. Based on the complete sample data from the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Markets during the year 1998-2005, we compared the value correlations among CFO, FCF and TCF using pricing model and benefit model, and found the value correlation of CFO, and then analyzed the differences of the value correlation of cash flows in different years.

articleTitle: Impact Study of the Territorial Development of Manufacturing Industry Basing on Fuzzy Clustering Analysis of Talent Investment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By selection of a series of indicators, this paper study the impact of the territorial development of manufacturing industry basing on fuzzy cluster analysis , and expatiate on the theoretical framework and its principles. According to the empirical analysis of Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Anhui, Guangdong Province, it explain the increasing talent investment can promote the sustainable development of the manufacturing, the results are more in line with the actual situation, which indicates that this method of study is scientific and valuable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Survival Entrepreneurship Development in China - Based on a Field Investigation in Wuhan, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Policy-Based Access Control Model for Web Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the shortcoming of web services (WS) access control model, discusses many research methods of policy-based access control technology. Based on SAML, XACML, OWL and policy protocol layer, the paper proposes an access control model WS-HPBAC of dynamic hierarchical policy of WS, and realizes a cross-domain semantic WS access control system. The system provides more overall access control mechanism for WS, makes perfect WS authority management ability, and increases WS access control application security. Finally the problems studied further are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on MNC's Political Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Political risk is one of the most important risks in the outward foreign direct investment (OFDI). Because of China's fast development of OFDI, China's multinational companies will face more and more political risks in the future. This paper discusses the evolution and nature of political risks and puts forward the political risk management procedures for multinational companies operation from four aspects: risk identification, risk assessment, risk monitoring and risk controlling.

articleTitle: Study on the Construction of Knowledge Service Platform for Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of knowledge service platform for digital library is the foundation guarantee to realize knowledge innovation in the era of knowledge economy, and is the core of knowledge service. Based on the study of basic theory of knowledge service platform for digital library, this paper constructed knowledge service platform for digital library, and did research on the functions of sub-platforms. Also, it pointed out the key to knowledge service platform system construction for digital library.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Manufacturers' R&D Decision-Making in Defense Procurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is intended to study the manufacturers' decision-making for R&D investment in defense procurement. On the basis of constructing the model of R&D investment scale adjustment of defense procurement, this paper researches the equilibrium of manufacturers' R&D investment decision-making in defense procurement. The influence of valuation of monopolistic contract and differences among manufacturers' abilities on investment is mainly discussed. It comes to the conclusion that: under certain conditions, manufacturers' investment equilibrium of R&D projects is identical to the government expectation, however, if the differences in valuation of monopolistic contracts and manufacturers' abilities exist, the investment equilibrium will deviate from the government expectation. Therefore, in the practice of defense procurement R&D, the government must keep manufacturers' anticipation about the monopolistic contact being consistent with government's; and at the same time, setting basic admission criterion to enable manufactures' ability well-matched, and in this way, the government could induce the manufacturers' investment decisions to the investment equilibrium that it desired.

articleTitle: Research on the Procurement Model of IT Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important part of IT project procurement management, IT project procurement models have played a critical role in enhancing fund use efficiency to achieve the objectives of IT project. This paper discusses the relationship between life cycle and procurement of IT project, thus putting forward two procurement models, that is, single-stage procurement model and two-stage procurement model. The concepts, application conditions, advantages and disadvantages of these two procurement models are analyzed in detail in the paper. Comparisons between these two models are made. Moreover, the paper also conducts comparative analysis on the four sub-models of two-stage procurement model, whose demarcation points are rest on requirement analysis, preliminary design, detailed design and implementation respectively.

articleTitle: Quality Information System Data Integration Technology Based on CORBA and XML
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analysis from the current data in quality information system, the author puts forward the overall framework of quality system data integration in which several heterogeneous data performance of quality information system is analyzed and summed up in detail. For the performance, data integration solution is made concretely. Online quality-supervising system is designed and realized through using the quality information system data integration technology based on CORBA and XML. And then the quality control in manufacturing process under network environment is realized.

articleTitle: Integration of CRM and ERP in E-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studied the Integration of customer relationship management (CRM) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) under electronic-Commerce (EC) environment by analyzing the relationship between CRM and ERP and their different contributions for enterprises. It is pointed that their integration will be a trend for enterprises in future EC competitive environment .Finally it was discussed on the manners of their integration and supporting technical means.

articleTitle: Learning from Auto Makers and Path Dependence: Conflicting Modes to Promote Suppliers' Innovation Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous research has verified that in the auto manufacturing industry, auto makers are crucial knowledge source for suppliers, thus learning from auto makers is an efficient way to improve suppliers' innovation quality. However, some suppliers depend heavily on their own knowledge, which is characterized as high level of path dependence. This paper investigates the incompatible relation of these two modes in promoting suppliers' innovation quality. Using patent data, we verify that although learning from auto makers can significantly improve suppliers' innovations quality in general, for suppliers with high level of path dependence, this improvement is weakened. The result of this paper suggests that, in the auto manufacturing industry, suppliers should adjust his internal institutions, structures and routines to decline their path dependence, and then they can efficiently promote their innovation quality through learning from auto makers.

articleTitle: Modeling on Setting up Bus Lane in Urban Area with the Constraint of Travel Time Reliability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Travel time reliability is of great importance for evaluating the service level of public transit. If service level is expected to effectively improve, the travel time reliability must be enhanced. This paper proposed a novel model for setting up bus lane in urban area with the constraint of travel time reliability. The objective function is to minimize the setting up fare of bus lane. This model is chance constraint programming model, which can be solved by branch-and-bound method and genetic algorithm. The Bus No. 188 is performed as a case study to validate the model.

articleTitle: A New Soft Computing Method of The Economic Contribution Rate of Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a new soft computing method of economic contribution rate of education is proposed. The method is composed of four steps: In the first step, this paper develops a cluster object system according to the level of scientific technology and gets the optimal number of cluster, which determines the number of rules. In the second step, the structure of fuzzy neural networks is determined by the number of rules and the fuzzy neural network (FNN1) from potential human capital (education) to real human capital is constructed and we obtain the economic contribution rate of human capital to real human capital. In the third step, the fuzzy neural networks FNN2 from real human capital to economic growth is constructed and we obtain an economic contribution rate of human capital. In the fourth step, economic contribution rate of education is computed. And last, the algorithm is used to compute the economic contribution rate of education in China between 2003 and 2006.

articleTitle: Quality Management on Valuation Reports of Demolition of Houses in the Urban Area of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of China economy, the process of urbanization and metropolitan allies are accelerated. In this process, the demolition of houses in the urban area has also developed rapidly. Real estate valuation companies are an indispensable intermediary in urban building demolition. Since the valuation results are important for both parties, the quality and fairness of valuation results assume even greater importance. In this paper, the researcher divides the qualities of valuation reports into two kinds: exterior quality and interior quality. Then the paper researcher analyzes many factors that influence the exterior and interior quality of valuation reports. Finally, basing on present circumstances of real estate appraisal industry, the researcher brings forward advice and measure to the government, appraisal institute, enterprise and appraisers.

articleTitle: The Chaotic Price Competition of Travel Products and Innovative Strategies: A Case Study of Hainan Province's Travel Products
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of our country's tourism, the price competition of travel products is becoming more fierce, China's travel agency industry hasn't been the "profiteering industry" previously recognized by the public, the chaotic price competition has made it become a trade of "meager profit" or even "non-profit". Particularly the chaotic price competition of Hainan Province's travel products has already produced a lot of problems to Hainan's tourism. Aiming at these problems, this paper adopts the methods of induction and systems analysis and has induced the manifestation of these problems, analyzed the causes of the chaotic price competition of Hainan's travel products, proposed a series of innovation strategies about how to resolve these problems. Finally, such a conclusion has been drawn: as long as we take some corresponding innovative strategies to restrain the chaotic price competition of Hainan's travel agency industry, alter its relatively single structure of travel products and oversimplified price competition, etc., Hainan's travel agency industry will certainly walk out of the corner and obtain a healthy and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Research on Hot Papers Based on ESI: A Case Study on Clinical Medicine Field
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies on the hot papers of clinical medicine field based on ESI (Essential Scientific Indicator) database, from January 1, 1998 to December 31, 2008. The data about these 324 papers are analyzed by the authors from the aspects of publishing time, country/territory, institution, journal, and so on. In order to discover the hotspots in the clinical medicine field in the global world, the methods of multi-dimension analysis, cluster analysis, pajek visualization are used and 54 pieces of papers are chosen based on citation of the 324 papers. The result shows that cancer is the research hotspot, and the correlativity of the title in the clinical medicine field in the global world can be shown by the cluster analysis. This study provides information for the researchers and scholars in the clinical medicine field, significant and specifically functional to them.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Dynamic Interrelationship between Technology Innovation and Property Right Institutions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Construct and Evaluate the Indicators System of Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study of corporate social responsibility has become a hot research field in the international and domestic academic circles in recent years. But previous results lack quantitative analysis and evaluation model on corporate social responsibility, and the majority of conclusions are mainly qualitative description. Based on the importance of corporate social responsibility nowadays, we divide the corporate social responsibility into five major categories (economic responsibility, laws responsibility, ethical responsibility, charity responsibility and environmental responsibility), establish a much more comprehensive indicators system of corporate social responsibility, and build a more comprehensive evaluation model on corporate social responsibility through the analytical hierarchy process. For the quantitative study on corporate social responsibility, this paper gives the indicators system weight of the corporate social responsibility. Finally we provide many valuable suggestions, which point out the direction for the further research and development in corporate social responsibility.

articleTitle: Application of Analytic Hierarchy Process in Optimization Selection of Groundwater Artificial Recharge Methods in Sanjiang Plain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid increase of paddy area, the groundwater level of well irrigation paddy area in Sanjiang Plain has widely declined in recent years, which has led to more and more "hanging pump", partial overpumping and a series of water environmental problems. Therefore, the groundwater resource dynamic balance in Sanjiang Plain needs to be recovered urgently. In order to solve above-mentioned problems, taking Hongxinglong branch bureau of Heilongjiang state farm for example, this paper optimizationally selects and sorts groundwater artificial recharge methods with the analytic hierarchy process (AHP for short), and proposes large-diameter well recharge is the optimum method. The study can provide scientific gist for groundwater artificial recharge practice and sustainable development of agriculture in Hongxinglong branch bureau and even the entire Sanjiang Plain.

articleTitle: Congruence of Business Ethics in Supplier-Buyer Relationships: A Social Identity Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Applying social identity theory, We aim to develop a Business Ethics Model (BEM) in Supplier-Buyer Relationships, to describe the relations between supply chain performance and congruence of business ethics perceived by suppliers themselves and corresponding buyers. Data was collected from a large multi-national corporation (MNC) in China branch and its 47 suppliers all over the country. Results show that business ethics is positively related to supply chain performance. More specifically, only when business ethics perceived by suppliers themselves is consistent with buyers' perception of suppliers' business ethics, positive relations between business ethics and supply chain performance can been verified. We close by discussing several important research and practical implications for the improvement of supplier-buyer relationships.

articleTitle: Research on Coupling Mechanism of in Corporation Innovation and Human Capital
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the development mode of innovation-driven economy, the importance of basic factors of production which has traditional natural resources and physical capital as the representatives is gradually declining. While the importance of advanced factors of production which have human resources, knowledge and technology as representatives, is increasing. Corporation human capital is the first capital of corporation survival and development, and technological innovation is its internal impetus. Both corporation human capital and technological innovation are the source of corporation's core competence. Therefore , it is necessary to research the interactive relations between corporation human capital and technological innovation .This paper discusses what role the corporation human capital plays in corporation technological innovation and what impact the corporation technological innovation plays on development and utilization of corporation human capital.

articleTitle: Innovation Licensing Schemes under Asymmetric Information on Technology Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An innovation licensor's problem of contracting when the licensor and a potential licensee engage in Cournot competition is studied in this paper. The licensor has a technology innovation that allows reduction of production costs, the magnitude of which is the private information of the licensor. The mode of licensing considered is the general two-part tariff licensing. It is shown that from the perspective of the patent-holding firm, the optimal licensing schemes depend on the actual magnitude of the innovation and the license's prior belief toward the innovation's technology quality. Specifically, for a small innovation, and the licensee believes the magnitude of the innovation is small too, the optimal licensing mode is by pooling contract. For a small innovation, but the licensee believes the magnitude of the innovation is high, the optimal licensing mode is under separating contracts. For the case of a large innovation, the optimal licensing mode is against pooling contract. However, irrespectively of the licensing contracts to offer, licensing by means of a fee and a royalty is superior to using either alone.

articleTitle: Data Mining of Corporate Financial Risks: Financial Indicators or Non-Financial Indicators
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking 164 ST (Special Treatment) listed companies in China's stock market and 328 paired risk-free companies as samples, this paper, adopting Logistic Multiple Regression Model to do multi-step regression analysis, performs data mining to study the relationship between the relative financial and non-financial indicators and the corporate financial risks. The study shows that the three indicators including auditor's opinions, ratio of liabilities to assets and operating income growth rate exert greatest influence on corporate financial risks, and the corporate governance indicators representing by ownership concentration exert relatively noticeable influence on the corporate financial risks warning model.

articleTitle: A Process Optimization Method Based on Process Performance Models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Software process simulation and optimization hold out the promise of improving software development process and supporting CMMI implementation. This paper first brings up a two layer process simulation model (T-PSM). The higher level is called process model which expresses the structure of the model. The lower level contains a behavior model and a computation model. The behavior model describes the simulation behavior of a process and the computation model enables activities in processes with computation capability. Then a process optimization method is proposed by integrating T-PSM with organization's process performance models to obtain simulation data. The process performance models represent the performance of the organizational processes and they are built by organization's historical data. Finally, the system architecture of this method is presented.

articleTitle: Mixed Semi-Structural Decision-Making Approach for Flood Control Operation with PPE Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The decision of reservoir flood operation including quantitative indexes and qualitative indexes is a multiple attribute semi-structural decision-making problem. Aiming at the un-reasonability of qualitative indexes described by defining-numbers, interval numbers based on duality contrast and mood operator are proposed to describe the relative membership degree of qualitative indexes instead of defining-numbers. The relative membership degree matrix can be got by standardized values of quantitative indexes and qualitative indexes. For relative membership degree matrix, with the projection method, comparing the quotients of projection of interval ideal point and negative ideal point, the optimum scheme was chosen. Taken one flood dispatching of Sanmen Gorge Reservoir as example, the optimum scheme is obtained by the above method, which takes on effectivity and easy calculation.

articleTitle: Urban Land Intensive Utilization Appraisal
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
