abstract: The main problems, such as evaluation index is not unified, standard worth evaluation is not unified and evaluation result is also not unified, are existing in the study of China's urban land intensive use evaluation. This paper aims to provide a new approach for the evaluation of China's urban land intensive use according to the problems above. In this paper, evaluation index system is constructed. And entropy method is adopted to improve the evaluation index weight which determined by the analytic hierarchy process (AHP). The weight determined by entropy method which based on data is organically combined with the weight determined by AHP which based on expert judgment by linear weighting method. Furthermore, specific evaluation process is given.

articleTitle: The Influence of Expected Demands Difference on Slotting Allowances: A Simulation Research Based on NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a multi-agent simulation model of a marketing channel which is comprised by a supplier and a retailer developed by Repast J and NSGA-II. A series of experiment scenarios were executed on this simulation model and some useful findings about the effect of the difference between the expected demands of the supplier and retailer on slotting allowances were revealed. The findings indicate that when the retailer's expected demand is higher, the marketing channel will charge slotting allowances to increase their expected profits; when the supplier's expected demand is higher, the rational choice is to forbid charging slotting allowances; when the expected demands are equal, it makes no difference to the marketing channel whether slotting allowances are paid.

articleTitle: GIS Based Fertilizer Recommendations for Maize on a County Scale
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional fertilizer recommendation is urgent needed for the National Soil Testing and Fertilizer Recommendation Program, which started at 2005 and has already covered most counties of agricultural production area in China. This paper took DongChangFu district, LiaoCheng city, Shandong province as an example, established a Geographic Information System (GIS) based fertilizer recommendation system for maize production. The results shown that, through Ordinary Kriging interpolation approach, agricultural soils in this district could be classified into three management zones for phosphorus fertilizer recommendation according to the soil available phosphorus testing (Olsen-P method) value <10, 1030, and >30 mg/kg, respectively. Recommended phosphorus fertilizer rates (P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>) were 143, 95, and 48 kg/hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> respectively. Management zones for potassium fertilizer recommendation were created according to soil available potassium testing (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>OAc-K method) value <50, 50-100, and >100 mg/kg, respectively, while recommended potassium fertilizer rates (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) were 90, 60 and 30 kg/ hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. In conclusion, regional recommendations for phosphorus and potassium fertilizers are practicable on a county scale.

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment of Collaboration and Innovation Risks Based on Risk Matrix
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Establishing "with enterprises as the mainstay, market-oriented and industry-university-collaborated technology innovation system" is an important issue in our national innovation system, while the cooperation between enterprises and university plays a critical part of it. Differences in the nature and targets of organizations, complexity of the industry-university cooperation process, as well as the uncertainty of the technology innovation itself have led to many failed cases. Risks of industry-university collaboration and innovation exist throughout the whole cooperative project from the very beginning to the very end. In this paper, we studied the various risks that exist in the process of industry-university collaboration and innovation, and designed the risk assessment index system of industry-university collaboration and innovation, using risk matrix and Monte Carlo simulation methods to determine the levels of the risks. This conclusion provides the basis for the prevention to fatal risks in the industry-university collaboration and innovation process.

articleTitle: Knowledge Application Techniques in Assistant Knowledge Base System for Product Design
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Product design which is one of the most important stages for manufacturing is a complex activity involving a great amount of knowledge. In this paper, knowledge is divided into three types: formula knowledge, diagram knowledge, table knowledge. Based on these requirements, knowledge base is constructed. This is used to store knowledge and to support the decision-making product design. First, the knowledge representation is formally described. Then, the knowledge navigation and search strategy is detailed. A specific section is dedicated to demonstrating the knowledge application techniques according to the different knowledge types that are proposed. The proposed methods are illustrated with examples. Finally, we conclude with the presentation of application performed with the knowledge application techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Increment-Exploitation Methods for Digital Media Assets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is significantly important to exploit digital media assets based on the principles of decomposition and combination for the content increments in media organizations. This paper brings forward the concepts and the principles of decomposition and combination. Then it proposes a combination model of increment exploitation for digital media assets and expectation income of the combination assets. Finally, it predicts the future developments of the decomposition and combination methods for digital media assets.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Would Customer Participation Certainly Cause Customer Satisfaction?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Study on Project Information Search Channels in the Process of Private Equity Investment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are serious asymmetric information problems in the process of private equity investment, accordingly bringing out information search activities. This paper analyses six available channels of project information search in private equity investment, and analyses the condition of realizing the optimal search scale. Through analyzing the questionnaire, this paper finds that the current private equity investment funds search information mainly from the way of their social network which has some disadvantages. Based on Zhejiang Silicon Paradise Investment & Innovation Service Center Co., Ltd., this paper concludes that it is one of inevitable choices to build information intermediaries supported by government to solve project information search problems at the initial development stage of private equity investment in emerging economies.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Research on the Relationship between Shareholding Concentration and Firm Value under Family Governance: Evidence from Family Owned Listed Companies in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Charging Mode of Third-Party Payment Platform in C-C E-Commerce Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's third-party payment market is growing rapidly, but almost all companies incur loss, as they implement a free policy in order to allow the C-C platform they are affiliated to seize more market share. This article believes that the free model is unsustainable, as it is not consistent with the security and credit guarantee function of TPP. The loss and inherent risk in the existing unstable profit structure will drive TPP charge eventually. We build a model in which users balance the transaction security provided by TPP and the risks from C-C transactions, find that the users' acceptance level toward charging is positively correlated with risks and the transaction amount, and negatively correlated with credit level of C-C market and charge rate. Survey also shows that based on the consideration of transaction risk and cost of platform shift, a moderate level of fee won't affect consumers' choice of platform, but a too high level of fee may drive consumers to leave the online market. This paper proposes a variable charging model which is based on transaction amount and the credit of both sides, aims at encouraging good faith conduct in the market.

articleTitle: Job-Shop Dynamic Scheduling Using Heuristic Immune Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the demands for production scheduling of modern manufacturing corporation, the Job-shop Dynamic Scheduling (JDS) model is originally set up based on the theory of resource optimization. Due to the complicated nature of the JDS, a framework Heuristic Immune Algorithm (HIA) for production scheduling is put forward. Finally, the method mentioned above is applied to solve the JDS of Shanghai Volksvagen, Automobile Co.Ltd., and the most optimal scheduling can be attained. The simulation results demonstrate that the Heuristic Immune Algorithm is feasible and effective for JDS.

articleTitle: Review on the Proportional Method of Bidirectional Compositor
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reviews on the proportional method of bidirectional compositor of the project selection method under constraints. Firstly this paper explains the economic meaning of the internal rate of return and thinks it doesn't express the rate of return of unit investment and can't be used as the concept of marginal revenue so the theory foundation of the method is wrong. And then it analyzes the specific applicable scope of the method that scholars in China never pay attention to when introducing and using it. Finally through the validity proof this paper thinks the proportional method of bidirectional compositor is essentially NPVR ranking method in the special condition. This method has a limited applicable scope and has not good use effect and in the practical application only can be used as an approximate method.

articleTitle: Virtual View Reconstruction from Stereoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An efficient disparity estimation algorithm based on block error and smoothness error was proposed for reconstructing virtual views. The occluded regions were detected by measuring the reliability of disparity estimation, and the disparity values in these regions were determined using object-based interpolation. Finally, the left image and right image were projected onto the plane of virtual view to be reconstructed. This resulted in two projected images. The virtual view was created using a weighted average of these two projected images. The proposed method was tested with several image pairs. Experimental results show our method can provide good disparity map and the reconstructed virtual images have high image quality and good stable depth when viewed stereoscopically.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relation of Producer Services and Manufacturing in Yangtze River Delta Region: Based on Industrial Perspectives and Time-Series Data
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The producer services are new generated from manufacturing industries since 50~60 s of last century. Its development in China was from 1990 s. In this paper, we focus our research on the relation of producer services and manufacturing in Yangtze River Delta Region from industrial perspectives. On the basis of introduction of this region, we use two variables, the added values and employment, to analyze the correlation of two industries. And then we use econometrical model to prove whether the relation we obtained by the analysis is balanced in long times. At last, we give the conclusion that the relation of producer services and manufacturing in Yangtze River Delta Region on added values are correlated, but not the same on employment and specific servicing industries.

articleTitle: Study of a New Type Electron Beam Plane Display Panel System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a new type of display system Electron Beam Plane Display Panel (for short EBPDP). Its working principle is different from the traditional CRT. EBPDP uses the refraction field as frame scan, uses the correction plate to correct arc grating and fan-shaped aberration, and uses the zoom electron gun to focus electron beam. The process is simple and easy to implement. In aspects of color, brightness and price, EBPDP has advantages over LCD, PDP and so on. Its success will prompt the CRT into a new era.

articleTitle: Abstract Oil-Painting Using Texture Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces an improved algorithm based on Efros' algorithm to create abstract oil painting by selectively copying patches of the source image onto the image to be stylized. Contrast to Efros algorithm, our algorithm provides better computing error optimization; another improvement is to change the direction of searching for a better performance. Experimental results show that our algorithm is faster and the abstract oil painting artistic quality of the resulting image is better.

articleTitle: Collaboration Knowledge Innovation in Supply Chain Based on Trust
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper narrates the current research of trust and concludes six characteristics of trust in the supply chain firstly. And after reviewing the study of collaboration in the supply chain, the research question of collaboration knowledge innovation in the supply chain based on trust is proposed. Then knowledge in the supply chain is depicted to illustrate that knowledge innovation is a complex network requiring of cooperation, and trust constitutes the foundation for supply chain coordination. On basis of analyzing one-off coordination gaming, infinite coordination gaming is studied to explain the rational base for trust in the supply chain and four conclusions are drawn. So that it can be seen that trust will gradually be constituted in cooperation gaming and trust in the supply chain can not only reduce the anxious for losing but also decrease the temptation for opportunistic profit. Finally, conclusions of the paper are drawn and limitations of the study and directions for future research are given.

articleTitle: Research on Software Outsourcing Expansion
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, Japan software outsourcing in China develops rapidly, through researching and analyzing the status quo of China's software outsourcing industry, there are now the main problems: most users of foreign-funded enterprises, local small-scale enterprise users, software outsourcing market relatively dispersed, the two premature sides due outsourcing deal, imperfect market environment, etc. So the outsourcing industry to Japan in China are at a coding plant of the primary level, and has the urgent need for becoming the contract dealer of business process outsourcing as a whole to enhance its developments and changes. And then analyze special requests against development tools, Japanese and Japanese style documents in Japanese business. Finally make the following points in favor of China's software outsourcing business development proposals, such as alliances with overseas companies, software companies to enhance their competitiveness and improve the quality assurance system, solving cross-boundary, cross-cultural communication, shaping the corporate culture.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet-Stochastic Coupling Model in Groundwater Dynamic Variation Law
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The variation of groundwater depth is a complicated time series, which is closely related with the climate condition and ecosystem, and is characterized by significant yearly periodicity and randomness. Therefore, it is of great importance to describe the dynamic variation of groundwater with an appropriate model. Taking Hongqiling Farm for example, this paper builds up the groundwater depth dynamic forecast model of Hongqiling Farm through wavelet-stochastic coupling model analysis. Through this method, this paper simulates and forecasts groundwater depth which reveals the dynamic variation regulation of the area and provides scientific basis for the sustainable development of groundwater resources in Hongqiling Farm.

articleTitle: A Study of Spatial Data Mining Technique Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Web was an information resource with dynamic state, at the same time, As the spatial data complexity and its multifamily of application field, to get implicit and useful knowledge of space, it is necessary to study the integration issues of the spatial data and choose a suitable technology for data processing and analysis. In the paper, the features of spatial datum were analyzed, they were seriate and typical non-structure, and they had the characteristics with timeliness, spatial relativity, difficult to decompose and combination. Based on the analysis of traditional data mining processes and structure systems, a pretty flow and architecture were designed for the data mining of spatial datum; the idea of the data integrated and transformed and designing data warehouse were advanced, also, an implementation method was presented for the key technology.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Five-Tiers Architecture Based on Struts and Hibernate for Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: While there are currently many frameworks available to Web applications, many of them are open source projects such as Struts and Hibernate. In this paper we present an efficient five-tiers architecture based on integrating Struts and Hibernate frameworks, we described the implementation of a Web application in details as a sample focusing on utilizing this five-tiers architecture.

articleTitle: Design for the Credible Supervised Model in E-Logistics Based on the Traffic Logistics Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commence and logistics, e-logistics has become increasingly impact to modern social and economic activities. However, the credit's crisis in e-logistics is one of the key factors that hamper the development of the e-commence. At present, lots of researches focus on strengthening the legal supervision and the market's constraint against the non-credible activities in e-commerce without forming correlative supervised model. This paper analyses the formed the non-credible activities in e-logistics and designs a new e-logistics supervised model (ELSM) based on the third-party agency. At the same time, ELSM was realized in the Jiangxi Traffic-Logistics-Network (JTLN). Compared with the safe characters of jctrans.com and taobao.com, JTLN based on ELSM has more safety and higher credible degree. Currently, JTLN has been identified by the experts on Dec 26, 2007, which can not only play a good supervised role on the traffic-logistics field on the Internet, but also provide a new idea to decrease the non-credible activities in other fields of e-business in China.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The R&D Internationalization of Multinationals from the Perspective of Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Information Flows between RMB Offshore Markets and Domestic Markets: Evidence from Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) and Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the interrelation and information flows between the CNY-USD spot and offshore, i.e., NDF, markets. We find that daily changes of the spot and NDF rates can be approximated by a MA (1)-GARCH (1, 1) model. Using the GARCH formulation, this paper tests the spillover effects in conditional mean and volatility between the spot and NDF markets. The results show that there is a mean spillover effect from the NDF market to the spot market and not the other way round, and that a volatility spillover effect exists in both directions. This means information in the offshore market is transmitted to the domestic currency market and the forward market serves an important price discovery role. This also means the domestic financial markets are influenced by the offshore markets.

articleTitle: Research on the Security Solution of the Industry Oriented E-Exchange
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of industry informationization and electronic commerce (e-commerce) promote the emergence of electronic market (e-market). One called electronic exchange (e-exchange) is a typical business model. It requires a higher security level for the business operating system. This paper systematically studies the e-exchange security problems from the view of e-commerce security, analyzes the security requirements of e-exchange and discusses the security mechanism and service. Basing on these, the paper proposes a security solution of the e-exchange. Finally the paper elaborates the realization and application of this solution combined with the case of Guangdong Plastics Exchange (GDPE.com).

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Internal Capital Markets, Performance after Rights Issue and Investors Protection: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of Organizational Learning Measure Based on Organizational Learning Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the idea of Barro's endogenous economic growth model and the balanced score card, this paper considers the impact of organizational learning on organizational performance eventually reflects in financial affairs, customers, internal business progress, and learning & growth of organization. Financial indexes reflect the organizational performance directly. The latter three aspects are embodied in the key impellent power of organizational performance. The output indicators of organizational learning system are analyzed from internal business progress, customers, and learning & growth of organization in detail, which shows the reason why productivity, cost, quality, market share, innovation ability, knowledge accumulation are six key factors of impellent power of organizational performance. Along the thinking of "process of organizational learning-organizational learning capacity-key impellent power of performance-operation performance", the maturity model of organizational learning is designed. Finally, a model is proposed to measure organizational learning by production function, which provides a new idea for the quantification of organizational learning.

articleTitle: Empirically Analyzing Mean-Variance Efficiency and Diversification Contradiction by Chinese Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the computational extension of portfolio optimization, we take a closer look at mean-variance efficiency and diversification contradiction, that is, high concentration in a few securities by Markowitz's portfolio selection. Traditional treatments typically include imposing constraints. Unfortunately, the studies basically hinge on simplified portfolio selection models, focus on a few points of an efficient frontier for example global minimum variance portfolio, or proceed in small scale portfolio optimization. We set up portfolio constraints of upper bound, market value, P/E ratio, turnover ratio, and industry and find that basically the installation of portfolio constraints of upper bound has substantial effect to alleviate the mean-variance efficiency and diversification contradiction, while the effect based on portfolio constraints of market value, P/E ratio, turnover ratio, and industry is quite limited.

articleTitle: The Determinative Factors of the FMS Patterns: A Comparative Analysis among Four Worldwide Groups
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fixed-mobile substitution is an irresistible trend throughout the world. However in the process of FMS, the patterns of fixed to mobile substitution varies with time and are quite different from one place to the other. This paper set up regression models to explore the relationship between the demand for fixed and for mobile, based on the fixed line penetration and mobile penetration from four groups of countries, G7, NIE, ASEAN and BRIC which are divided by the level of telecommunication development. The determinative factors that affect the patterns, the degree and the substitution rate of FMS are studied.

articleTitle: Achieving a Highly Effective Green Supply Chain with a "Product Oriented Model".
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article presents an algorithm of implementation of a green supply chain based on a "Product Oriented Model" to lower negative externalities of the current supply chain on human health. It describes all logical activities implied and rules which define what it is necessary to make, in which order, in a purpose to identify existing weak points, to correct them within a new product design framework and implement a green supply chain., a network that minimizes as much as possible environmental loads. The model comprises four levels; the first concentrates on auditing the existing system for possible change with integration of environmental aspects. The second level is focused on the design of a new product with objectives of greater reduction of materials and energy consumption, reduction of pollution during manufacturing and product use phases, the anticipation of product end of life impacts and the product life span optimization. The third level concerns the manufacturing process based on efficient resource and energy use. Finally the last level is focused on product distribution and delivery including the reverse flow of waste management principles.

articleTitle: Scenario Analysis of Mobile GI Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological advances in three basic fields mobile devices, communication, services architecture have helped the vertiginous evolution of mobile GI services. Mobile computing scenario, which take into account the relative position of users, service components, and available resources, encourages the development and deployment of innovation services. As for Mobile GI Services application, the driving factors of system design and development were identified, stated and analyzed in the paper, which provides a sound basis for future work in this area.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Cooperation and Competition Analysis Based on Flexibility in Port Service Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A multi-stage cooperation and competition model based on flexibility in port service supply chain consisting of a port enterprise and two service providers (SP) is built, using Stackelberg model and Cournot model. Flexibility in port service supply chain is studied. The influence factors of port enterprise's flexibility strategy and SP's flexibility strategy, relationship of port enterprise's flexibility strategy and SP's flexibility strategy, the impact mechanism of port enterprise's compensation strategy and allocation scheme to SP's flexibility strategy, are analyzed. Conditions on which flexibility efforts under equilibrium with Stackelberg competition are greater than equilibrium with Nash competition are given.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Characteristics of Modern Urban Disaster and New Perspective of Urban Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Open Platform for Integrated Broadcast Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes an open platform that provides services for broadcast monitoring systems. The platform is built upon the service oriented architecture, which includes foundation services, expansion services, security service, and communication service. It defines standards and interfaces for application plugins, and integrates broadcast monitoring operations such as data collection, analysis, presentation, and recording. The abstract modules extracted are implemented at multi layers.

articleTitle: Information Flow Modeling of South-to-North Water Diversion Supply Chain Based on Time Compression
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of characteristics of south-to-north water diversion supply chain, from the perspective of time, Markov chain theory is applied to the research of information flow response time distribution of the eastern route south-to-north water diversion supply chain, in order to provide a reference for the operation of this project. This study shows that information collection and processing efficiency of the node management department plays a crucial role in the eastern route south-to-north water diversion supply chain.

articleTitle: Optimal Dynamic Substitution Policy for Components in an Assemble-to-Order System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In assemble-to-order system, the substitution of higher-class components for lower-class components is often applied when the latter are stock-out. However, the decision for substitution should be made in advance. How to manage the substitution in such a system is of managerial interest. We model this scenario as a two-stage mathematical programming where the first step is to determine how many to order for each product at the beginning of the selling season, and the second step is to explore the substitution rule. We exploit the structural properties of the substitution rule and present a dynamic substitution rule. Then we show that our substitution policy is a threshold policy and present its upper bound of the threshold.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Spatial Association Rule Mining Based on Concept Lattice
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An algorithm about spatial association rule mining which is based on concept lattice is presented. Firstly, a concept lattice (a concept hierarchy) diagram is given, Moreover, databases and selected, transform spatial data into attribute data by generalizing spatial are introduced. Then the method of build spatial concept lattice by using: generalize spatial relationships into attribute relationships is given. Finally, an improvement algorithm of spatial association rule mining based concept lattice is offered and the experiment results show the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Multiple Criteria Evaluation of Price Limit in Continuous Double Auction Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tries to find out the optimal price limit in a simulated continuous double auction (CDA) market. We firstly examine the effects of price limit on the performance of CDA market, such as the market efficiency, the price dispersion, the transaction volume, and the average transaction price. Then the evaluation of price limit is given according to multiple criteria chosen from the simulation results. The finding of this paper helps to answer the question what is the appropriate level of price limit in CDA markets, as well as in order-driven stock exchanges.

articleTitle: Research on the Business Model and the Formation Mechanism of Value Network of Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the theories and methods of business model, an improved framework of business model is designed on the basis of Osterwalder's business model ontology and Faber's SOFT business model. Service support network, products/services, customers and finance consist of the business model. Based on this framework, combined with the characteristics of mobile commerce, the business model of mobile commerce is designed and the operating process of mobile commerce is analyzed. According to the theory that the customers are the core of service industry, we deduce the actors in the mobile commerce value network are customers to each other, so the value network is come into being. Then we proposed an integrated value network system of mobile commerce which is made up of three-layers- integrated business platform, mobile commerce supporting system and mobile commerce integrated ecosystem system.

articleTitle: Establishing the Recycled Supply Chain Network of Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a recycle supply chain network model of waste electrical and electronic equipment. The network model consists of manufacturers, recycle site and consumer markets. According to the behaviors of deferent roles in this model, it presents the pricing policy and analyses the situation which would affect the prices. This paper also give some suggest to government which would limit the roles' behaviors in the model to build the balance in the recycle supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinating Re-Order Quantity Decision in the Revenue-Sharing Contract of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, studies that the profits of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain in the revenue-sharing contract under twice ordering policy. Under such contract, the manufacturer decides the revenue-sharing contract ratio and the retailer's unit purchase price. The retailer can only accept or refuse the contract. When the retailer accept the contract, the retailer will decides the first ordering quantity, and decides whether gives a re-ordering quantity, and the number of the reordering quantity before the end of the sales period after watching the market demand. Considers that the strctures of the retailer and the manufacturer under twice ordering policy, and the numerical calculation is done. The results shows that the profits of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain in the Revenue-sharing contract under two ordering policy are more than that of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain under once ordering policy.

articleTitle: Interindustry R&D Spillovers and Productivity: Evidence from China High-Tech Industries
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper deals with the estimation of the impact of interindustry R&D spillover on productivity growth using the panel data of China high-tech industries during the period of 1999-2006. We can find that inter industry R&D spillover has improved the industry's TFP growth, The contribution of interindustry R&D spillovers from pure knowledge to TFP growth and efficiency (EC) growth is highly positive correlated, the estimated coefficient is 0.20-0.26, The estimated coefficient of interindustry rent spillovers on TFP growth and EC growth is 0.11 to 0.20, the effect of pure knowledge spillovers is slightly larger than rent spillovers' effect . However, the effect of interindustry R&D spillover regardless of rent spillover and knowledge doesn't improve technical progress (TC); It's the industry's R&D capital stocks that promote the industry's technical progress.

articleTitle: Competence Assessment of China's Consultation Enterprises Based on BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to competence theory and the characteristics of Chinese management consultation enterprises, this study structures an evaluation indicator system including 3 steps and 23 specific indicators, and based on BP neural networks, the paper puts forward a method which provides a theoretical guidance for management consultation enterprises to evaluate their status in the market and also to seek ways to improve their competence effectively.

articleTitle: Valuing the Overseas Mergers and Acquisitions Price Risk of Chinese Oil Companies: Based on VaR Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This papers analysis the market risk Chinese oil companies facing in overseas mergers and acquisitions (M & A) by using historical simulation ARMA forecasting (HSAF) as the basic analysis method and the spot price of WTI crude oil as the basic analysis variables. It makes the conclusions that the VaR predictive value is much greater than the actual value under the confidence level of 97.6 percent; and, at the most time, the predictive value is 1-2 times than the actual value. This shows that China's oil companies are facing with a great deal of risk when carrying out overseas mergers and acquisitions. Finally, discuss the avoidance way from strengthening market risk assessment in host country, reducing the interest rate and exchange rate risks, determining the ways mergers and acquisitions will take carefully, establishing overseas strategic alliances, entering the region on strategic choice.

articleTitle: A Monetary Model for Analysing Economic Stability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we mainly use dynamic methods to consider how the impatience affects the economic stability. And we assume that labor supply is inelastic and the role that physical capital plays in stabilizing the real side of the economy by ensuring uniqueness of equilibrium in alternative environments if the monetary authority follows interest-rate feedback rules. The rate of time preference may be related with the individual consumption, total income, average consumption habit, average capital holdings and so on. Here, our focus on the average social level is to check its effect on the macroeconomic stability.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation on Knowledge Creation in Regions of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge creation is a basic element of regional innovation system and its capacity can affect the innovation performance of a region. In this paper, effort is made to analyze efficiency of knowledge creation of 31 Chinese provinces. Firstly, invention patents and SCI publications are the outputs of knowledge creation, and full-time equivalent of R&D personnel and internal expenditure on S&T activities are being as the inputs to produce knowledge. Then, data envelopment analysis (DEA) is introduced and employed as a quantitative method to compare the knowledge creation efficiency of 31 Chinese provinces. Through collecting data from China Statistical Yearbook on Science and Technology (2005-2008), the efficiency scores of 31 provinces have been obtained and analyzed. The result shows the relative efficiency of 31 regions in China is not high. Finally, this paper concludes with a brief summary of the main findings.

articleTitle: Implementation of BSC Performance Evaluation System in Power Generation Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprises' performance evaluation is a major topic in capital market, company finance and management accounting fields. The key to the study currently is how to better apply the theory to practice and how to enhance its depth and scope to meet new requirements that had arisen in practice continuously. This paper studied BSC performance evaluation system in power generation enterprises and illustrate how to apply BSC theory to construct and implement a performance evaluation index system in a large power generation enterprise.

articleTitle: E-Commerce in International Trade and Performance Evaluation of Supply Chain Strategic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzes the characteristics of the performance evaluation of supply chain strategy alliance (SCSA) which is based on the e-commerce in international trade. It utilizes the theory of balance scorecard and the model of SCPR to propose the performance evaluation index system of supply chain strategic alliance. It is constructed from the angles of customer satisfaction, internal business processes, financial situation and learning and growth. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation involves the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation factor set, evaluation grade set, the eigen value matrix of index, the degree of membership matrix, the weighing of index and the operation of fuzzy matrix, etc. This method is introduced into the area of the performance evaluation of supply chain strategic alliance.

articleTitle: Modelling of Inexact Multi-Objective Programming for Planning for Economic Development and Environmental Protection in Erhai Lake Basin
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Planning for economic development and environment protection in Erhai Lake basin to balance economic and ecological benefits is urgent. Inexact multi-objective programming (IMOP) could help us to optimize the planning. The paper presents particular model for solving the problem. With the necessary data collected, the research team will go on to use LINGO software and the formulated models in this paper to accomplish the planning.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Urban Network Connection Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the scale extending and the structure complex of urban power network gradually, establishing a rational network structure is significant to reliable and sufficient power supply. This paper collected and sorted out network structure of typical cities and analyzed the characteristics, functions and grid structure used mainly. According to hierarchical thought and the coordinated principle of transmission and distribution, the conception that urban network structure system can be constructed based on reliability of different layers can be described the overall pattern systematically. Then the merits, drawbacks and main applicable scope of typical grid structure were analyzed and evaluated on the condition of saturated load density. Finally, typical grid structures applied in different cities were recommended based on the saturated load density in future.

articleTitle: Research on Deployed Issues of Green Degree about Green Product
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to deploy products' green degree to make products not only accord with green desire but also meet the cost restriction is an important question for enterprises. Based on research about the conception of green degree, the paper improves the measure method of green degree, beings forward the principles and the realizable method about green degree deployed, and builds the deployed model of green degree, designs the process of green degree. This can help enterprises make emphases of green degree deployed clear and choose the optimal program.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: New Idea of Project Management: Research on Harmony Project Management Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Coal Utilization Efficiency of Regions in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we calculate the coal efficient utilization ratio (CEUR) of 29 regions in China from 1995 to 2006, by applying data envelopment analysis (DEA) based on the regional own production frontier. And three inputs (labor, capital stock and coal utilization amount) and one output (GDP) are chosen for DEA. Results show that, the more developed area is, the higher CEUR is. The eastern, central and western areas have the highest, medium and lowest 1995-2006 average CEUR (77.37%, 53.22% and 43.34%), respectively, which implies eastern area's coal utilization is the most efficient and western has the lowest efficiency. Chinese government should emphasize particularly on coal utilization efficiency in central and western area. More investment in coal management and introducing advanced technology are the urgent tasks for central and western area to improve coal efficiency and realize sustainable development.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for the Performance of Research Personnel Based on Scientific Collaboration Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evaluation of the performance of research personnel is full of challenges. The paper treats this problem as the node importance measurement within the scientific collaboration network (SCN), which is formed through the author information from academic papers in Chinese. In the study, the author's status is measured by the node degree in the SCN, and the strength of collaborative relations between authors is measured by edges' weights. If both the value of the node degree and the weights of edges are large enough, then the current node is tend to be important, in other words, the author represented by this node is very important in terms of his/her status and collaborative relations in the SCN. Case study shows that the proposed method can identify the important nodes in the SCN, i.e. key research personnel in the organization, and evaluate the performance in terms of their academic papers published in the high quality journals. This finding is beneficial for crisis management of key talent loss in organizations.

articleTitle: An Equitable Allocation of Fixed Costs and Resources: A Data Envelopment Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In many applications of data envelopment analysis (DEA) approach, there is often a fixed cost or resource which is imposed on all decision making units (DMUs). One nature question then is: how can this cost or resource be assigned in a reasonable way to various DMUs? In this paper, we present a new DEA-based method for obtaining this cost or resource allocation. To illustrate our methods, numerical results for an example from the literature are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Contract Credit System and Its Evaluation System: Mainland China Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction contract credit evaluation system is composed of management of evaluation system, evaluation index, mathematic evaluation model and evaluation software. The contents of construction contract credit evaluation index system are composed of six parts which are level of contract management, ability of concluding contracts, state of concluding contracts, ability of fulfilling contracts, state of fulfilling contracts and contract's creditworthiness in society. The paper discusses the details of these indicators from the owner's and contractor's perspectives.

articleTitle: Study on Decisions of Time Competitive Supply Chain from Perspective of Information-Sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper considers a distribution channel of a two echelon time competitive supply chain with one supplier and one downstream retailer facing a product market characterized by short product life and uncertain demand. In addition, the estimation of demand volatility from the supplier and the retailer is asymmetric. Decision models of optimal planned delivery lead time, ordering, and unit wholesale are established separately under the complete and non-complete information about demand volatility. Compared with the optimal decisions under the complete information on demand volatility, we examine the potential benefits of information sharing and its impacts on the only wholesale price contract, revenue sharing contract, and buyback contract. Results show that the only wholesale price contract cannot reach the channel coordination when the retailer underestimates the demand volatility while the supplier does not, while the reasonable profit sharing contract as well as the buyback contract benefit to facilitate information sharing and to improve the profits of the entire channel.

articleTitle: A Novel Graph-Based Privacy Policy Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Privacy and data protection have become a critical issue in recent years. Not surprisingly, many technologies have been proposed to support privacy data management. The widely used access control model, role based access control (RBAC), significantly simplifies the specification and management of data. In this paper we proposed a privacy-aware system to improve the performance in RBAC, which properly expresses the relationship between data elements. As some vulnerabilities may be raised after certain sensitive data are disclosed, our privacy data graph successfully solved this problem by reducing disclosure of data minimizing overhead. We extend our previous work by refining the definition of roles, thus results in low storage overhead. A full detailed view of the role-based privacy management with experimental results is provided.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Alertness: Mental Schema to Entrepreneurship Opportunity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The author developed a scale for entrepreneurial alertness on the basis of previous literature. Two samples of entrepreneurs (n = 104, n = 277) were investigated, in comparison with one sample of managers (n = 166). After EFA, CFA and MANOVA, the results indicated: (1) The conceptual model was comprised of three aspects (prospecting, reframing and sensitive foresight), with acceptable statistical parameters. (2) Significant difference existed among those three dimensions between entrepreneurs and managers, and were varied with prior experiences.

articleTitle: Measuring the Service Quality of Online Bookstore: An Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper developed a conceptual model through a survey of literature on e-service, and then it has a demonstration analysis of the world's largest online bookstore in China Dangdang.com. The study measured the impact of four dimensions on e-satisfaction and funds the relationship between e-satisfaction and e-loyalty. According to their relationship, it will give a hand to the online bookstore manager to achieving better e-service quality.

articleTitle: Spatial Combination Forecasting Model Based on Panel Data and Its Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of spatial forecasting based on panel data, the significance of spatial autocorrelation on the panel data is tested by Moran I, the first-order spatial autoregressive model and the Kriging algorithm model are established from the perspective of the cross-sectional data, respectively, and back-propagation neural network model trained by the genetic algorithm is established from the perspective of the time-series data. Then a spatial combination forecasting model based on panel data is established by the three single models. The weights are obtained by the information entropy approach. An empirical study shows that the spatial combination forecasting model is the most effective in the accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Study on Agro-Food E-Marketing Framework in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agro-food Marketing is a complex task involving various stack-holders, products and business scenarios. In a developing country like china, this activity is influenced by local, socio-economic and cultural characteristics. While other complex but well-defined business processes are experiencing benefits of services driven e-business; 'marketing of agro-food' has remained untouched by this revolution. Unavailability of proper underlying IT infrastructure will continue to inhibit the implementation and penetration of such technological advancements amongst the users. In absence of such capability, the informal transactions provide meager benefits to a farmer who looses a better price in other potential market, or a wholesaler, who might have got the desired quality product at a lower cost directly from the farm. There is a need to develop affordable and reliable solution that links all the actors involved in the system and provide an environment for a competitive business. This research paper demonstrates Agro-food E-Marketing Framework, developed to aid marketing of agro-food. With the help of the Agro-food E-Marketing Framework, a trader can execute a complete trading business process. This paper also demonstrates a complete business process that is initiated by a farmer with a mobile PDA involving trade of an agro-food in the market place.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Synectics on the Protection Mechanism of Intellectual Property in Witkey Mode
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article raises a new proposal about how to improve the protection mechanism of intellectual property in the witkey mode. This proposal makes use of the synectics, considering about the three participants (the witkey, the mission publisher and the Web site) in the witkey mode, directly towards the problems which exist in the protection mechanism of intellectual property. The proposal includes the establishment of the Internet real-name system, the way to authenticate the right of works based on the technique of "one-press to add watermark"and technique of digital fingerprint, and the foundation of the moral supervision system on the Internet. Meanwhile, the passage also has analyzed the efficiency and advantages of this proposal and showed the whole flow.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research about Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock 300 Index Futures Simulation Trading Based on VaR Measurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Innovation Mode in China Textile Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Textile industry is a pillar of China economy. With 20 years' high speed development, China has become the largest textile production and export country in the world. Nevertheless, labor-intensive product with low additional value holds a leading post, China textile industry encountered "bottle-neck" of development under the influence of macro-regulation policy, a sharp increase in cost and the financial crisis. More and more textile enterprises have realized that cooperative innovation is a realistic way to improve product values and reduce innovation risks. The essential prerequisite of cooperative innovation include: cooperative innovation organization system, the government's support policy, knowledge and information and environment factors, etc. In order to increase the innovation propensity and competitiveness of CTEs, some measures should be considered the most important and remove the obstacles of cooperative innovation.

articleTitle: Underwriting Cycles in Property-Liability Insurance of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines the presence and causes of the underwriting cycles in China. We find the existence of underwriting cycle in automobile insurance line of China. The evidence supports the capital market imperfection hypothesis in Chinese automobile insurance market.

articleTitle: The Impact of Servant Leadership and Altruism-Oriented Culture on the Growth of Research staff
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The growth of research staff is the interactive effect of research leaders, cultural environment of research organization and characteristics of research staff. Using the Theory of Servant Leadership (SL) and Altruism-Oriented Culture (AOC) for reference, we built a theoretical model on the Growth Performance (GP) of research staff. The statistics results of the survey indicated that: (1)The promotion of SL was very evident. (2)GP dimensions were significantly varied as for different combinations of AOC. (3)Because the combinations of AOC were different, the impacts of SL had been indicated as three patterns, which were total/ alternative/ opposite patterns. The study proved the adjusting effects of AOC and revealed the microcosmic mechanism and application conditions of SL's effect.

articleTitle: Design of Deblocking Filter in H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The design methodology of the deblocking filter in H.264/AVC is presented in this paper. To improve the filtering performance, an improved parallel filtering order is proposed. The deblocking filter is implemented with a fully pipelined datapath and the vertical edge and horizontal edge can be filtered simultaneously. And it takes 116 clock cycles to perform a 4:2:0 macroblock filtering. The design is implemented and verified on FPGA.

articleTitle: Study on the Technique of Foundation Construction for Deep Water Bridge and Numerical Simulation in Coastal City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The latest technique of lowering synchronously ultra-large suspended steel cofferdam of Su Tong Yangtze River Highway Bridge under the computer control was presented. The mechanism and construction technology of lowering ultra-large suspended steel cofferdam was illustrated. Based on the finite element analysis software ANSYS, the whole construction process was simulated and further its result was compared with monitoring data. The result had shown: the FE result was consistent with monitoring data and the worst condition was the fourth condition that was water pumping in water level of +4.3 m. The FE result could reflect the force condition of the construction more exactly and had certain guiding significance.

articleTitle: The Dividend Strategy of the Dual Model for Uncertain Income
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The optimal dividend problem proposed by Bruno de Finetti (1957) is to found the dividend-payment strategy that maximizes the expected discounted value of dividends which are paid to the shareholders until the company is ruin or bankrupt. In this paper, the dual model which we considered is perturbed by diffusion and the optimal strategy is the barrier strategy. To determine b*, the optimal level of the dividend barrier, a key tool is the method of Laplace transforms.

articleTitle: Perceived Risks to Online Purchasing Intention In C2C Business - An Empirical Research on Cell phone
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the researches of the perceived risks in the Web, we construct a model to deal with the perception how to influence customers to buy in the field of C2C . Then, get 192 effective questionnaires through Internet survey. It is proved store risk, product risk, and delivery risk are 3 dimensions of C2C consumers' risk perception. The effects of product risk influence consumers' purchasing intention is biggest, followed by store risk.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on Enterprise Decision of Entry into Patent Pool
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has probed into the simulative function of patent pool on enterprise innovation and analyzed the game model of enterprise decision during the establishment of patent pool. As shown from the result, patent pool is able to promote the enterprise innovation and the decision selection according to the profit maximization principle. Therefore, entry into patent pool is an optimal choice for innovative enterprises.

articleTitle: A Framework for Customer-Oriented Service Based on Relationship Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the market competition becomes keen, keeping and developing customer relationship is coming to the front of enterprises for winning the competitive advantage. Customer-oriented service is concerned by more and more enterprises recently. However, decisions for customer-oriented service have been hampered by the lack of conceptual framework necessary to develop customer relationship. Relationship technology is a newly-emerged concept in management field for building up and developing customer relationship. It can collect and comprehend customers' data continuously, then convert them into action. That is to say, it can convert information into action. Regarding relationship technology (RT) as a kind of system engineering, we develop an integrated framework to understanding and analyzing customer-oriented service, and then make customer-oriented service successful. The framework consists of data processing, customer relationship analysis and relationship optimizing. Each of the three aspects is described as a whole in this paper. Based on the RT, We believe in the future this framework can play an increasing role.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on China's National Social Security Fund Investing in Listed Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a long term strategic investor which had special preference on safety, China's National Social Security Fund (NSSF) invested listed corporations through the form of investment portfolio, which operated by professional investment manager. The author made an empirical study based on 2007 annual reports of 842 A share listed corporations in Shanghai stock exchange. There were 22 investment portfolios and 10 investment managers involved. Result showed NSSF appeared on annual reports (2007) of 62 A share listed corporations. Result also showed that the listed corporations invested by NSSF were distributed over 17 industries and 22 regions. China's laws and regulations strictly restricted the investment proportion of National Social Security Fund investing one enterprise out of consideration of dispersing risk. On the premise of complying with the laws, the national council had some approaches to avert the restriction of investment.

articleTitle: Analysis on Generation Costs and Carbon Reduction Routines in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A study was conducted to compare the electricity generation costs of fossil fuel plants, hydro plants, nuclear plants and a number of current commercial technologies expected to become commercially available within the coming decade or so in China. The amount of greenhouse gas emissions resulting per Kwh of electricity generated was evaluated. The objectives were to estimated the costs increase in different scenarios based various carbon reduction goals, and to suggest some potential economical routines for Chinese carbon reduction.

articleTitle: Knowledge Diffusion Capability Generation for Under-Developed Regions' Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge diffusion is one of the key factors that improves the research and development of knowledge and the competence of any regional economy. This paper firstly explains the concept of knowledge diffusion, and then focus on the underdeveloped regions to analyze the constraint factors that determine a region's knowledge diffusion capability with the establishment of a two-layer model compromising both the external factors (environments) and the internal factors (resources).Then the impact of knowledge diffusion on regional industries upgrading in the form of international industrial transfer is analyzed as well. The conclusion gives suggestions on the strategies of developing regions to utilize the principles of knowledge diffusion.

articleTitle: The Barriers and Innovations of Instant Messaging Firms in Internationalization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: New information communication technologies and innovation have largely changed the way of internationalization in some Internet based service firms. Instant messaging (IM) is an international service that has developed rapidly since it was launched in the market a few years ago. However, due to the newness of the technology, little research has been conducted on the internationalization of IM firms. This study aims to address this gap by reviewing the innovation related theories and examining five cases: AIM, MSN Messenger, Google Talk, Skype, and QQ. The key findings indicate that: (1) IM industry is confronting the regulatory barriers, culture barriers (in terms of diversified language options), standardization or customization barriers, which similarly with the conventional services industries; (2) Economic barriers seldom appear in the internationalization since the products and services provided by IM firms are totally free or affordable; (3) IM firms should keep on innovation, not only their products and services, but also the way of developing a new market.

articleTitle: Improved Adoptable Scheme for Authentication and Key Agreement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we analyze that authentication and key agreement (AKA) protocol is vulnerable to false base station attacks. We propose a new security scheme which can better securely realize mutual authentication between mobile station (MS) and network by both sides of communication. This scheme, called improved adoptable AKA (IA-AKA), used random number and signature mechanism to achieve the authentication between MS and network. To analyze the proposed protocol, the BAN logic is used to formalize and prove the security of the improved scheme.

articleTitle: The Research of Management Innovation Support System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly studies the theory and application of computer aid management innovation. Combined with knowledge management, it brings forward a kind of solution about management innovation. It abstracts tens of management innovation principles, and builds a parameter system that is used to describe management innovation problems, and then builds a theory model that is used to solve management innovation problems. Based on the former theory model, we developed the computer aid innovation support system that can successfully support management innovation. Practice indicates that the expandedness of this system is very useful in technology innovation and co-design.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of the Stability Structuring of Inter-Organizational Cooperation in Knowledge Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The opportunism in process of the knowledge chain's inter-organizational cooperation may bring about conflicts and lead to instable operation of the knowledge chain. This paper constructs a game payoff matrix for the knowledge chain's interorganizational cooperation and conflicts and analyzes the basic conditions for the inter-organizational cooperation. After comparing the differences between the two conditions-that cooperative benefit is larger than defection benefit and vice versa, this paper analyzes the influencing factors of the knowledge chain's stable operation. Our research indicates that the stability of the knowledge chain's operation has positive correlation with collaborative value-creation and expectation for a long-term cooperation and has negative correlation with opportunism benefit and knowledge spillover loss.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Employee Job Performance of Coal Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore a model to reflect employee's job performance of coal enterprises, and then pose seven research hypothesizes about the relationships among the main factors and confirm them with structural equation model (SEM) .The existing researches mainly focus on the job performance of general employees without distinguishing trades. In this paper, employees of coal enterprises are selected as the research object. Five major factors are extracted from twenty eight indicators to reflect employee's job performance of coal enterprises. Combining with previous theories and research result, the five factors are referred to as task performance, learning performance, innovative performance, safety performance and contextual performance. Six of the research hypothesizes are supported by the empirical data, but one is rejected.

articleTitle: Discuss and Study Some Key Problems of Agile Supply Chain of Dynamic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century early the core that the rivalship of manufacture is the compitition of the new products based knowledge. The best basic demand is that shorten the cycle of product development. The supply chain operation of dynamic alliance is the one of important factors shortening the cycle of product development that effects on competitive power of the market. The aims of efficient and agile supply chain management model is to shorten the product development cycle, rapid develop new products and response to market in the fastest speed, enabling enterprise in competition of the market in an invincible position. This paper discusses certain key problems, such as the essence and characteristics of the agile supply chain of dynamic alliance, etc.

articleTitle: Application of Grey System Theory in Peace Avenue Overpass Bridge Construction Linear Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Peace Avenue overpass bridge belong to large-span continuous rigid frame, the gray system theory prediction method has been applied to Peace Avenue overpass bridge construction linear control. The construction of pre-camber gray prediction model is established, and is verified at Peace Avenue overpass bridge linear control. Monitoring Practice shows that the gray system theory can be applied to large-span continuous rigid frame bridge construction linear control, and expose high theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Integration of Heterogeneous System Based on Business Object
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There will be many information systems in a modern enterprise. These systems are commercial systems or self-develop software. In order to meet the needs for openness, flexibility, interoperability and speed of development, each enterprise like above would integrate these heterogeneous systems. This paper implements an integration module in a chemical enterprise that has a commercial ERP system, a commercial EAM system and a OA system developed by self. The module is based on object-oriented and component-based technology to achieve the integration requirements and constraints. It encapsulates a business rule into an object oriented component to realize the automatic data exchanging between the ERP and the EAM. And that business object provides a secondary development interface for the OA system. At last this integration module is deployed in the enterprise and has been running for two years. The paper shows the actual running data and gives some prospects of improvement.

articleTitle: The Study about On-Line Information Interaction in Virtual Community Affecting Internet User's Consumption Role Changing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On-line consumption is increasingly becoming the mainstream of social consuming field; so studying consumer behavior based on Internet users becomes much important. This article shows that on-line information interaction would have a positive impact on user's perception, and then would affect internet users changing their consumption roles. In this study, we have built a corresponding model, and conduct related empirical analysis. We found that the origin, form and transmission of on-line information would have impact on user's perception, although sometimes indirect. The perception of user could be divided into perceived usefulness and ease of use. Both would have impact on user's consumption role changing, but the extent of effect is different.

articleTitle: Assessing the Effects of Service Recovery and Perceived Justice on Customer Satisfaction with SEM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this study is to validate a structural equation model of customer satisfaction with service failure/ recovery encounters and to simultaneously test the proposed hypotheses in a car warranty/claims setting. The proposed model based on exchange framework fits well to the empirical data from those respondents who have experienced the service failure/ recovery encounters. The findings provide managers with the understanding of the effective path from a specific recovery attribute to satisfaction through one of the perceived justice dimensions, which have effects on customer satisfaction. This research makes a contribution to both academicians and business practitioners by validating an integrated model to assess the effects of the recovery attributes and the role of perceived justice in the satisfaction model.

articleTitle: Formalizing Delegation Authorization of Workflow Using Graph Transformation with Variables
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supporting delegation mechanisms in workflow systems is receiving increasing interest from the research community. Using graph transformation as a formalism to specify access control has several advantages, from the intuition provided by the visual aspect to the precise semantics and the systematic verification of constraints. Using graph transformation with variables yields very expressive rules that are still comprehensible. After reviewing the basic notations of graph transformation with variables, this article presents specification formalisms for workflow delegation policies using graph transformation with variables. The authorization states are represented by graphs and state transition by graph transformation with variables. The proposed formalization provides an intuitive description for the manipulation of graph structures as they occur in workflow delegation and a precise specification of consistency conditions on graphs and graph transformations. We specifies a type graph to represents the type information in the graph transformation for workflow delegation, a set of rule schemes to build the system states and sets of positive and negative constraints to specify wanted and unwanted framework.

articleTitle: Demands Analysis of Enterprises in Different Life Cycle Stages for Information Intermediaries Services - Investigation on IT Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information intermediaries achieved the information collection, organization and distribution for their clients. This paper researched the IT enterprises in different life cycle stages, and analyzed their demands characteristics for information intermediaries' services through questionnaire investigation. The study identified different services should be provided by information intermediaries to satisfy the demands of different enterprise.

articleTitle: The Evaluation on the Effect of Water Stress on the Growth and Yield of Rice in Cold Area Based on RAGA-PPC Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to solve the difficulty of judging the comprehensive effect of water stress on the growth and yield of rice, projection pursuit classification (PPC for short) method is presented in this paper. This method can find the best projection direction based on the sample data characteristic and judge the contribution of each evaluation index to the comprehensive evaluation target through the best projection direction.
