publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a tool for agent-mediated information exchange between children while chatting online. The Internet plays a significant role in the lives of children today by opening up a whole new world It provides excellent educational opportunities, access to a huge range of information and can be fun. However, it can also be used as a tool to enable abuse of children in a variety of ways. There is the potential for pedophiles to misuse modern technology to gain a child's trust by attempting to contact them through chat rooms and pretending to be a child themselves. Hence, there is a need to automate the process of monitoring information exchange when children chat on-line. An agent mediated autonomous system has been developed that is able to automatically block the transmission of personal data, such as addresses and telephone numbers to other users, if such data is detected in a message. It is proposed that this work is further developed to detect and prevent attempts by users to arrange meetings with other users. The overall aim of the system is to make it safer for children to chat online.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation of Power Supplying Enterprises Based on Principal Component Analysis and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development and reformation of China's power market, the environment of production and management is changing fundamentally. Therefore, considering the risk character of power supply enterprises, an evaluation index system to evaluate the risk in power supply enterprises is established. Then by combining PCA (principal component analysis) and BP neural network together, a risk evaluation model is put forward. At last, we give a test, the result shows that this method can be adopted in the risk assessment of power supply enterprises and it could give an accurate judgement of risk management.

articleTitle: The Non-Equilibrium Vehicle Evacuation Model of Regional Traffic under Planned Special Events and Its Application to the 2008 Olympic Games
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of Chinese economy, more and more large planned special events, such as Olympic Games, Expo, and so on, have been held in many metropolitans, which may bring huge pressures to city's normal transportation. In this paper, a non-equilibrium vehicle evacuation model at small area under planned special events was set up, and the heuristic algorithm was given in detail. Then, we applied the model and its algorithm to the 2008 Olympic football games in the Tianjin sports centre, and compared with the data obtained by Tianjin traffic administration bureau, such traffic flow assignment results were proved applicable and practicable.

articleTitle: Study about Risk Evaluation for Enterprise' Technology Innovation Based-On Grey Hierarchy Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The uncertainty of technology innovation results in high risk. It is very important to innovation success that enterprise systematically manage risks in the technology innovation process. The main task of risk management is to identify and evaluate all risks. In the article, the source of innovation risk is concluded technology risk, market risk, organizing risk and environmental risk. On the basis of grey system theory and AHP method, a grey hierarchy evaluation model is put forward to quantitatively evaluate innovation risks. The purpose is to help enterprise assessing risks and taking countermeasure to minimize the potential loss and increase the innovation income.

articleTitle: An Improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm for Resource Leveling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper provides an overview on the artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) for the resource leveling. Some improved adaptive methods about step length are proposed in the AFSA. This method have better performances such as good and fast global convergence, strong robustness, insensitive to initial values, simplicity of implementation. The simulation results show that the resource leveling based on AFSA avoids premature effectively and prove its feasibility.

articleTitle: Toward an Integrated Customer Knowledge Management Model: A Process-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge is the most important organizational asset. Studies have explored factors that may improve knowledge management within organizations, yet the majority of the research has ignored the knowledge from customers. This study proposes a process-based customer knowledge management model to explore the mechanism through which organizations acquire the knowledge from their customers, integrate and internalize this knowledge, and then apply the knowledge to better serve their customers. The potential contributions and future research directions are then discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Innovative Technology Investigation into Cryogenic Cooling Green Grinding Using Liquid Nitrogen Jet
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Grinding processes are mainly technique employed widely as a finishing process in a variety of materials, such as metals, hardness and brittleness and ductile materials machining to achieve good dimensional and form accuracy of the product with acceptable surface integrity.However, grinding is associated with high specific energy requirements which may be an order higher than that required in other conventional machining processes such as turning, planing, milling etc. Therefore, in grinding process, high grinding zone temperature may lead to thermal damage to the work surface, induces micro-cracks and tensile residual stresses at the ground surfaces, which deteriorate surface quality and integrality of the ground surface. Therefore, grinding fluids are applied in different forms to control such high temperature, but they are ineffective, especially under high speed grinding conditions where the energy of the fluid is not sufficient to penetrate the boundary layer of air surrounding the wheel. Moreover, the conventional flood supply system demands more resources for operation, maintenance, and disposal, and results in higher environmental and health problems. Therefore, there are critical needs to reduce the use of cutting fluid in grinding process, and cryogenic cooling grinding is a promising solution.The work presented in this paper aims at evaluating the grindability and surface integrity of the nickel base superalloy resulting from the application of cryogenic cooling.

articleTitle: Multi Quay Crane Scheduling Problem Based on ACO in Container Terminals
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Quay crane scheduling problem is a very important multi resource scheduling problem in container terminals. This paper gives the general model of quay crane scheduling and introduces a heuristic method Ant Colony Optimization to resolve this problem. According to the advantages of ACO for single resource scheduling, virtual nodes are added into the scheduling graph to change the multi resource scheduling to single resource scheduling. The simulation of quay crane scheduling in practice get satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A Study on Website Operation Efficiency Evaluation: Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Website evaluation of operation efficiency is an important foundation for compare the whole operation conditions of different Websites, and instruct the Website construction. The method for Website efficiency analysis, DEA, proposed in this paper, avoids the defect that focusing on output while ignoring input, emphasizing on the choose of index while neglecting the objectivity of weight, enriches the method and theory of Website efficiency analysis, and promotes the development of the whole Website service level and quality.

articleTitle: Modeling of Personalized Recommendation System Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: These models are designed to enable personalized recommendation to handle the semantic phenomenon. Based on ontology, the method of document feature extraction and user interest model were improved. Two personalized recommendation models were proposed for different scenes. Taking the Web pages about vehicle for example, results show that the model can do personalized recommendation effectively, and recommended results corresponded with the user's real and original interest.

articleTitle: Flexible Design of Delivery Capacity in Urban Water Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Long-term urban water demand is uncertainty. The delivery capacity of urban water distribution system is required to be flexible to satisfy multiple possible water demand in the future. In each prediction phase, water demand can be regarded as a stochastic variable. Based on the uncertain demand prediction information, further consideration is how to effectively utilize the predicted demand conclusion to determine the delivery capability. A multi-objective optimization with multiple prediction phases is applied to minimize both the wasted investment due to overestimated delivery capacity, and supplementary investment due to underestimated delivery capacity. The flexible design can help decision maker to select a low cost long-term decision to deal with various water demands.

articleTitle: Towards High Quality Software Development with Extreme Programming Methodology: Practices from Real Software Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Software quality is essential to software development projects, from the aspects of the customer, sponsor, development team and quality assurance team. Though there are kinds of test tools which help us to find the defect more efficiently, many researchers agreed that it is not enough nor efficient to validate the software product after it is produced. At the other hand, some agile software processes such as extreme programming enable us to produce high quality product but with too much different requirement to the project management. This paper introduces extreme programming (XP) practices in some real software projects, which can be helpful for project stakeholders to manage the quality efficiently and with less risk.

articleTitle: Studying of Classifying Junk Messages Based on The Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional SMS filters are basically text-based filtering. However, the filtering mechanisms have limitations: first, the keyword can easily be replaced by other symbols, which increase the difficulty of filtering; second, is garbage in the ongoing renovation of keywords, filtering mechanism of the high demands of intelligent learning, which is difficult to achieve. Send acts based on the analysis of the filter will be able to solve the above problems. Filters in the design of messages added to the idea of data mining, through classification analysis of the sent messages, thus can be extracted to identify the rules of spam text messages and can send messages to the new classification behavior.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis on Consumer Price Index Rising in China from 2005 to 2008
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is found that the food price rising are the main reasons to promote the overall price level from operational features of the consumer price index (CPI). The food and energy supply shortage and pork price rising are the direct reason of the China price index rising recently. We study the dynamic relations among money supply growth, deposit reserve ratio, raw materials price and CPI index through the establishment of the VAR model. Using the impulse response function we analysis the impulse response which the consumer price inflation rate, consumer price index and raw materials receive the impulse by each endogenous variable. Finally, we evaluate the VAR model and draw some valuable conclusions.

Index Terms: Porcine Reproductive And Respiratory Syndrome Virus

articleTitle: An Ontology-Based Knowledge Management Approach for E-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, with the fast popularization and development of the WWW, more and more people are interested in e-learning via web. There are many e-learning systems now; these systems provide some simple tools to manage and search a lot of teaching materials. However, the traditional teaching materials base neglects to integrate semantic and concept teaching knowledge, it is impossible for all participants to effectively search and share valuable teaching knowledge to satisfy the teaching and learning demands in e-learning. Ontology technology and knowledge management (KM) are the popular technology, they play more and more important roles in development of information system. So this paper integrates ontology technology and knowledge management into e-learning system so that users can easily and conveniently organize, share and reuse knowledge during e-learning. This paper performs the following tasks: (1) introduction e-learning system, ontology technology and knowledge management; (2) presentation of an architecture for e-learning system integrated ontology technology and knowledge management (EL-OKM); (3) discussion of knowledge ontology construction; (4) implementation of a simple prototype system; (5) conclusion and expectation of the further work.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Optimization for Facility Location for Large-Scale Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The sitting of emergency service facilities plays a crucial role in determining the efficiency of safety protection and emergency response. Research on emergency service facilities is abundant. However, this research does not typically address the particular conditions that arise when locating facilities to service large-scale emergencies, such as earthquakes, terrorist attacks, etc. In this paper, we form an improved model for determining the facility locations in response to large-scale emergencies, based on Jia, Ordonez, and Dessouky 's research. The problem is formulated as a maximal covering problem with multiple facility quantity-of-coverage requirements. In this paper, ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm is developed to solve the Large-scale emergency location problem. We evaluate the performance of the model and algorithm by using illustrative emergency examples. We show that the model and ACO algorithm provides an effective method to facility location for large-Scale Emergencies.

articleTitle: Technology on Pollution Prevention of Urban Construction Fugitive Dust
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the pollution status of urban construction fugitive dust and put forwards the comprehensive prevention measures for urban construction fugitive dust. A complex-type chemical dust depressor with excellent performance is got through many experiments. The basic materials of dust depressor include calcium chloride with 5 wt%, magnesium chloride with 10 wt%, and calcium oxide with 2 wt%. The auxiliary material is sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate with 0.01 wt%. The best amount of spraying for dust depressor is 0.8 L/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The dust depressor has perfect properties of moisture retention, wind-resistance, temperature-resistance and water-resistance.

articleTitle: A Model of BPF Automatic Logistics System Based on RFID and Network Routing Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The modern logistics system is a very important part of SCM. This paper presents an optimized information system to realize automatic logistics. This model employs RFID tags to identify goods. Goods are marked based on their locations. And our best path first algorithm for automatic logistics is implemented through a decision-making system that uses the shipment information and the routing tables stored on a server to select the best route based on the overall consideration of shipment requirement, the type of intermediary stops, fees, and security. The routing information of every stop is saved and updated in computer, it describes the type, cost, speed, safety and security of path etc. The logistics optimization and logistics automation is successfully accomplished by the system.

articleTitle: Research on the Enterprise Knowledge Management in Dynamic and Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first carried on the analysis to the relations between the environment and enterprise knowledge management, and then carried another analysis to the dynamic and complex trend in environment development. According to the dynamic and complex environment, we build a knowledge management model for sustainable competitive advantage. Based on this, we put forward some suggestions from knowledge integration and knowledge application for enterprise knowledge management in dynamic and complex environment.

articleTitle: Ecological Product Design Value and Remanufacturing for Green Short Life-Cycle Product with Warranty-Dependent Demand in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to environmental warming and consciousness, business globalization and shortened product life-cycle, numerous attentions have been paid to ecology protection, resource saving and effective operations management. Green product and production processes designs have significant influence on the environment and resource re-usage. The relevant EU regulations, such as WEEE, RoSH and EuP, have been encouraging the enterprises to have a friendly way to the earth and reduce the greenhouse effects by controlling the disposals and the gas emission. These green product design and remanufacturing efforts are investigated in the development of an integrated production inventory model. A numerical example is presented to illustrate the theory.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Model for Performance Evaluation of Supply Chain Based on CAS & Emergence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain, as an effective strategies participating in the intense business competition, has been accepted by scores of enterprises, but how to evaluate its performance properly is still an issue. Based on complex adaptive system (CAS) & emergence, this paper investigates the complex adaptive features and emergency dynamism of supply chain system and innovatively proposes a new method to assess the performance of supply chain.

articleTitle: Time Series Analysis on Ecological Competitive Capacity of Beijing Using Emergy Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An emergy-based analysis was conducted to investigate evolvement of the ecological competitive capacity of Beijing with regard to urban evolution and city development from 1990 to 2005. A newly integrated indicator, ecological competitive capacity index (ECCI) was established by combing conventional emergy indices of percentage of local renewable resource, emergy self-sufficient ratio, emergy/money ratio and waste emergy ratio, to reflect the overall performance of urban system with respect to their long term sustainability. The result shows that the intensity, structure, efficiency and their environmental impact associated with urban emergy use have exhibited diversified changing tendency. However, the ECCI has decreased with fluctuation from 1990 to 1999, but remains relative stable after 1999. The maximum vale of 1 can be found in 1991 while the minimum value of 0 in 1997 among the concerned years. How to enhance the urban ecological capacity and strengthen the capability of sustainable development is an urgent issue confronted by large cities as Beijing.

articleTitle: Analyze and Research on the Organizational Maturity and Its Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the development duration of organization theory base on construing the organization connotation. For this kind of organization transformation, this paper has put forward the study of the unitary organization capability, not for sticking at the point of the researching the organization focus capability. This paper analyzes the organizational maturity model and puts forward the organizational maturity model with its organization capability and corresponding resolution, and points out the content of ways of raising organization capability and the method of evaluating capability. It also puts forward that organizational maturity model not only get a test result, but also help organization finding out the method of advancing organization capability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Does Trust Facilitate Knowledge Sharing?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Business Intelligence in Logistics Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of E-Commerce depends on the level of logistics services. Because of its strong ability on dealing with data, business intelligence has taken an important part in logistics management. This paper points out the demand and application of business intelligence in logistics enterprise, gives an applied model about business intelligence in logistics: illuminates the process about stocking/inventory/producing/transporting /selling, with a program management idea in the model. It's the program management triangle used in the application process, it's a management process from cost, time, quality and scope, and it can help enterprises work in a proper logistic scope, reduce the cost effectively and shorten the logistics time to optimize the effectiveness of logistics.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Transformation from Urban Management to Urban Governance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm with Improved Convergence Capability for QoS-Aware Web Service Selection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA) is a good service selection algorithm to select an optimal composite plan from many composite plans. Since the execution of GA relies on a randomly search procedure to seek possible solutions, bad convergence of GA is produced by random sequences generation. To improve the convergence of GA for Web service selection with global quality-of-service (QoS) constraints, chaos theory is introduced into GA with the relation matrix coding scheme. The chaotic law is based on the relation matrix coding scheme. During crossover process phase, chaotic time series are adopted instead of random ones. The effect of chaotic sequences and random ones is compared during several numerical tests. The performance of GA using chaotic time series and random ones is investigated. The simulation results on Web service selection with global QoS constraints have shown that the proposed strategy based on chaotic sequences can enhance GA's convergence capability.

articleTitle: A Host Oriented Omnidirectional Immune Architecture against Malicious Codes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most recent immune models and algorithms against malicious codes not only take too much cost in learning and training, but they also have shortcomings to some extend. In fact, the biologic enginery of defending harmful invasion always needs the cooperation of multiple systems of the organism. This paper analyses the essence of the malicious codes problem, and then provides a host oriented omnidirectional immune architecture against malicious codes. Instead of detecting or recognizing the exact characters of malicious codes, the architecture gives computer system the self-immune ability against malicious codes by getting rid of the prerequisites for malicious codes to spread and do harm. This paper analysis the principle of the architecture and gives a frame to realize the model function.

articleTitle: Role of Effective Facilitator: FAST Made Effective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Effective software management plan much depends on the nature of the software itself, to be developed. The plan can only remain successful if all the scheduled activities are performed according to the timelines already decided. It has been observed that quite a high amount of projects both in developing and developed countries fail despite the organization wide process maturity. There are many factors that contribute in the successful and on time completion of the software but the most important of the phases is the requirement engineering in which requirement are to be fabricated and rectified again and again to suggest the most appropriate requirements. FAST (Facilitated Application Specification Technique) has emerged as a technology to help decrease the communication gap between the customer and the developer. The success of FAST session generally depends on the way the session is conducted by the facilitator. This paper unleashes the characteristics that a good facilitator must have. The guidelines provided in this paper can be effectively used to measure the relevance, appropriateness and suitability of a facilitator in a development environment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How Can Supply Chain Collaboration Contribute to a Retail Company's Competitive Strategy: The Design of an Empirical Research
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Culture and Knowledge Transfer: Theoretical Considerations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A New Structure of Ontology Model for Semantic Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a 6-tuples based structure of ontology model for semantic retrieval, and uses description logic as expression tool to semantically describe the atomic term, complex terms, instances, instances description, attribute assignment and axioms. Based on the new structure, this paper proposes two types of reasoning (terms-oriented and instances-oriented) for the application of semantic retrieval, as well as the conversion mechanisms and determining algorithms, which enables the reasoning for various relations in a specific domain according to the rules set by domain experts. Finally, this paper puts forward four kinds of information retrieval rules, and analyzes the applications of this new structure in semantic retrieval.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Comprehensive Management System and Operation Model of Urban Disasters
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Spatial Agglomeration Effects and Labor Productivity Variations: Evidence from Chinese Cities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper estimates agglomeration effects on labor productivity for more than 200 Chinese cities from 2001 to 2005, taking into account endogeneity of spatial distribution of employment and spatial fixed effects. Econometric results suggest that agglomeration effects in China are larger than US and European countries, and these effects became larger 2001 through 2005. Results also demonstrate agglomeration effects vary greatly among different parts of China. As control variables, human capital effects and regional fixed effects are estimated as well.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Knowledge Spillover in Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To provide a tool for analyzing the innovation cooperation of knowledge spillover among clustered enterprises this article proposes a game modeling approach basis on the game theory. This article firstly establishes an improved prisoner's dilemma game model to discuss the possibility of the cooperation in one-off gaming. Then, this article extends this model to infinitely repeated game model. The resulting model is used to further probe into the possibility of the cooperation in infinitely repeated gaming. The result shows that the innovation cooperation of knowledge spillover among the clustered enterprises is possible and necessary. This article also puts forward the incentive mechanism for fulfilling the cooperation.

articleTitle: A New Clustering Algorithm Compared With the Simple K-Means
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a new clustering technique named Chinese Reomi's Algorithm (CR for short), for we're Chinese and Reomi is an English name. Because the CR is very much like the simple k-means mechanism, we take the two for comparison. Further more, we suggest a simple but useful way to estimate the number of clusters.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Spatial Organization Variations of Clothing and Textile Enterprises with the Application of Information and Communication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to explore the features of the traditional manufacturing's development by using ICTs, especially the features of the spatial organization variations of the production chain, which is based on time cost. The results show that: (1) enterprises' cycle of designing, manufacturing, and dispatching decreases fast with the help of ICTs, which proves that the time factor plays a key role in the production chain's spatial organization variations brought about by the application of ICTs. (2) The application of ICTs to the traditional manufacturing clothing and textile enterprises chiefly boosts their management of some section of the whole production chain; while for the upgraded enterprises the application of ICTs greatly affects the spatial organization of the production chain as a whole.

articleTitle: Speed and Rotator Magnetic Flux Close Loop Vector Control System for the Linear Induction Motor Based on Neuron Adaptive Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the impact from non-linear, high-level and random interference and other factors, it is not desirable for the vector control system realized by the conventional PI controller, thus it is invented that the speed and rotator magnetic flux close loop, electromagnetic thrust inner loop linear induction motor vector control system Based on neuron adaptive controller, in which the neuron adaptive controller is adopted as speed and magnetic flux regulator. The neuron net features self-learning and adaptation ability. When it is applied for controlling, it does not depends on mathematic model of control object, and can overcome the defect of less robustness of the conventional PI controller while changing of motors' parameter. Finally, to verify the feasibility of design theory, the simulation experiment has been made for the Speed and rotator magnetic flux close loop electromagnetic thrust inner loop linear Induction motor vector control system based on neuron adaptive controller. The results of simulation experiment has shown that this system has not only good dynamic and stable performance, but also better robustness.

articleTitle: NPP Conventional Island Apparatus Supplier Selection Based on AHP and TOPSIS Approaches
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing a long term and stable relationships between owner and suppliers is a certain section in sound supply chain system, especially for nuclear power plant (NPP) that require apparatus' safety and reliability. Based on a brief description of NPP conventional island apparatus, a supplier selection evaluation index set is established, this paper proposed analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) to verify practicality of evaluation index set. Finally, an empirical study is performed to demonstrate the integrated model and identify the suitable supplier(s).

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of Knowledge Workers' Competence Based on Triangular Fuzzy Number and AHP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With knowledge economy' arrival, the evaluation of knowledge workers' competence is an important problem that can remarkably influence competitiveness and development of an organization. Due to the complexity of evaluation index, the fuzziness and incompleteness of evaluation information, we proposed an evaluation method of knowledge workers' competence based on triangular fuzzy number and AHP algorithm. The method is applied to evaluate knowledge workers' competence combining the qualitative and quantitative method by introducing triangle fuzzy number and AHP algorithm. An example is shown. The method in the paper has achieved usability and flexibility for the complex evaluation of knowledge workers competence by comparing the method with fuzzy TOPSIS method.

articleTitle: An Improvement of Protocol Binary in Reconciliation of Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the quantum channel being susceptible to be interfered by noise, the reconciliation in a quantum communication is so important. Though its security is high, the efficiency of protocol binary is low because it needs to repeat the algorithm many times for the even-digit mistakes not being able to be founded. This article will focus on an improvement of protocol binary with the Message-digest Algorithm 5 (MD5) replacing parity check and the advantage is that all kinds of mistakes can be found while the security keeps still high. And then its performance will be contrasted with the protocol binary with parity check by the self-designed simulation platform. The result shows that protocol binary with MD5 can improve efficiency by up to around 45%.

articleTitle: A Research on Increasing Context Perception in Online Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web forum was a fully developed, cheap and popular medium to support online communication. But most of the Web forums still followed the basic table view interface inherited from the antique Bulletin Board System (BBS). The rigid interface limited context perception by users. To avoid troubles of software developing, many Web service providers choose free package (such as the Discuz!) to deploy their Web sites, which furthermore enhanced the homogeneity of page views. Tree View forum was one of the possible rescues. A tree view forum provided richer context information than traditional Table View. But there were only a few Web sites successfully adopted Tree View. To answer the question why Tree View was better in conveying context information but less popular, a Web view generator (WVG) was devised to support Table View and Tree View, as well as other potential Web-page view patterns. Furthermore, research was conducted to test users' perception and understanding of the contents of Web pages in both Tree View and Table View. It was found that Tree View web pages presented the context of discussion better than Table View web pages. The barrier in preventing the popularization of the Tree View related to the inexperience with the Tree View. Tree View was also found to be more reading-time saving than Table View.

articleTitle: Reliability-Based Service Life Prediction of an Ancient Timber Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fungi decay is a main factor which affects the resistance of timber structures by reducing the strength of wood and the geometrical properties of structural lumber. In order to search for scientific method to protect the Chinese ancient timber structures the following works are implemented in the paper. Firstly, the decay depth models are calibrated by using the in-site testing data. Then the resistance of timber beam and column are deduced. Subsequently the reliability theory is proposed to predict the residual life of an ancient timber structure. Finally the main structural members are selected to predict the structural residual life. The result indicates that the resistances of timber structural element are degenerated by fungi decay obviously, and the residual life of historic timber structures can be predicted effectively by the proposed method in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on the Switched LAN Monitor Mechanism and its Implementation Method Based on ARP Spoofing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network monitoring is an important method of network management and preserving safe operation. This paper presents a switched LAN (local area network) monitor mechanism based on ARP spoofing. Using WinPcap library function to capture the packets in switched LAN, the method contributes to the follow-up data analysis and detection of attack. Experimental data and analysis results show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Outline of the Chongqing Construction Industry for Housing Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Green Construction Alternatives Evaluation Using GA-BP Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the characteristics of green construction, this paper defines the key indexes in green construction assessment system which includes resources utilization, environmental protection and construction management. It also builds up green construction assessment model in which relationships among indexes are established. Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) optimized by genetic algorithm (GA) is used to assess green construction alternatives. And a case study has been conducted in order to verify the adaptability of the model.

articleTitle: Promoting Technological Innovation Capacity through Knowledge Management and Service Science
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the era of knowledge-driven economy, technological innovation is a key character. The thesis describes the connotation, purpose and core topics of service science through implementing knowledge management, and finally put forward the suggestion of improving the technological innovation capacity through knowledge management and service science.

articleTitle: A Study on Some Urban Bus Transport Networks in Middle China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We focus on bus transport networks (BTNs), because buses are the main public transportation tool in China. In this paper, we present the empirical investigation results on the urban bus transport networks (BTNs) of four major cities in middle China. In BTNs, nodes are bus stops. Two nodes are connected by an edge when the stops are serviced by a common bus route. Comparing with the developed cities such as Beijing, the degree distributions of BTNs take exponential function forms. The empirical results on the undeveloped cities show that the degree distributions of BTNs take power function forms. To explain these empirical results and attempt to simulate a possible evolution process of BTNs, we introduce a model by which the analytic result obtained agrees well with the empirical facts. In the end , we explain the reason why BTNs in the developed cities and the undeveloped cities exhibit distinct degree distributions.

articleTitle: A New Method for Identifying Traffic Accident Black Spots Avoiding Statistical Influence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to overcome the defects of the existing methods for identifying the road traffic accident black spots which were influenced by the statistical scale and the statistical starting and end points, this paper presents a new method based on the gray correlation degree which is not influenced by the statistical scale. First, the road is divided into some cells which are the same length, and then, the longest cell length is confirmed according to the proportion of the cells in which the accident number is just one. Secondly, that composing the reference sequence makes use of the longest seriate cells in which all the adjacent cells have accidents. And then, the seriate cells are taken as the dynamic comparison sequence whose length is the same as the reference sequence. Thirdly, the gray correlation degrees are calculated by using the accident numbers of the two sequences. Then, the threshold value for identifying the traffic accident black spots can be confirmed according to the accumulative frequency distribution figure of grey correlation degree. Finally, the location and severity of the traffic accident black spots are ascertained by using the figure of the mileage gray correlation degree. The results of the instance demonstrate that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: A USB Flash Disk-Based Model of Mobile TPM with Mass Storage
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a kind of secure and efficient module, TPM is seldom integrated in the motherboard of PC at present, in the paper a USB flash disk-based model of mobile TPM with mass storage is presented. In this mobile TPM, a 32-bits embedded CPU with RISC is adopted, which is integrated kinds of encryption algorithms. The mutual authentication between mobile TPM and the host is proposed; in the other hand, the flash disk with mass storage is partitioned into kinds sections and assigned to different authorities. Furthermore, the USB interface with high speed is used. The last experimental result proves that.

articleTitle: Improved Genetic Programming Based on Lineage Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, it is a major challenge to adopt an effective search method in genetic programming in order to produce an acceptable model in the search space. How to improve the efficiency of GP in a short period of time to produce better solution is very important. Traditional GP use of all the chromosomes for breeding, its search space for complex issues is enormous. In this paper, we introduce lineage relationship of chromosome in GP and propose an improved lineage-based genetic programming algorithm, ILBGP: use of lineage information of several ancestors, at the same time only retains one chromosome with the same fitness randomly. This method maintains the diversity, which can search the space effectively and avoid premature convergence toward local optima.

articleTitle: The Study of Consumer Trust Transference for the Adoption of Mobile Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mobile commerce becomes increasingly popular in China. The applications of mobile commerce are rich. Especially, mobile brokerage service is an emerging application of mobile commerce in the brokerage industry. Although mobile brokerage service has many advantages, the number of investors using the MBS to conduct stock trading is far smaller than those using other trading methods. Lack of trust is a big obstacle for investors to adopt mobile brokerage service. Most studies only consider the impact factors of trust in one environment and rare research explores trust building by trust transference across different environment. Based on mobile brokerage service, we build a model of trust transference from online to mobile setting and empirically test it. The results indicate trust in the online brokerage service of a brokerage firm influences cognitive beliefs about the firm's mobile brokerage service.

articleTitle: Optimal Order Quantity in Hybrid Supply Chain and Its Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering a hybrid supply chain (HSC) in which a supplier has a traditional retailer who also adopts a drop-shipping channel, we model and prove that the retailer's optimal order quantity for decentralized or centralized system exists. Different from traditional supply chain models, customer choice of channel is introduced to the model. The results show that the optimal order quantity for the HSC is influenced by customer choice of channel as well as cost, which is different from a single-channel (or pure) supply channel. To verify the results, number experiment is performed and sensitivity analysis is followed. The result of number experiment shows that the impact of customer choice of channel on optimal order quantity in decentralized HSC is different from that in centralized HSC. At the end of the study the further research direction to the topic is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Third-Party Online Payment Based on Improvement of Coase's Transaction Cost Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cease's transaction cost theory holds that enterprise and market are two organizational forms of transaction which can be mutually substituted.This paper, through the analysis on the role of enterprise and market in resource allocation, reachs that these two organizational forms of transaction do not only substitute, but also complement each other; and then introduce intermediary organization, expand the "enterprise-market" framework of Coase's transaction cost theory to the "enterprise-intermediary organization-market" framework. Using the improved Coase theory, this paper analyses the third-party online payment and its effect on transaction cost and transaction benefit of e-business.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Industry Value Chain and Supply Chain Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply Chain Management sparkplugs upriver and downriver of Supply Chain integrative and cooperative win-win strategic management thought. Construction enterprises form business Value Chain longitudinal contact between construction enterprises and its suppliers via construction project. Supply Chain and Value Chain unify in construction enterprises and its management practice. The research is focused on application of Supply Chain and Value Chain in construction enterprises. Based on the analysis of relation between Value Chain and Supply Chain, Construction Industry Value Chain and Supply Chain Cooperation Model is constructed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Model of Public Service-Oriented Government Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the reform and opening-up policy was put into effect, the "economic government" model which centers on economic development is no longer adapting the needs of China's economic and social development, and the restructuring from "economic government" model to "public service-oriented government" model is imperative. Based on the analysis of government functions and a number of logic models about performance evaluation, this essay designed the evaluation index system with the dimensions of economic regulation, market supervision, social management and public services to measure the performance of public service-oriented government, established the public service-oriented government performance evaluation model based on BP neural network, conducted a comprehensive performance evaluation on the public service-oriented government construction of Qingdao city using this model, and brought forward the countermeasures of strengthening the public service-oriented government construction for Qingdao city.

articleTitle: Application of Improved AHP in Evaluation of Technological Innovation Capability Progress of State-Owned Enterprises in the Northeast Industrial Base
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper established the northeast old industrial base of state-owned enterprises in technological innovation ability evaluation index system is based on the real coded genetic algorithm to speed up the analysis applies to the level of technological innovation ability index system of the research. Then threshold method is used to the technological innovation to the dimensionless standardized index, threshold method to use technological innovation to the dimensionless standardized indicators, the multi-index comprehensive evaluation method is also used to calculate each index, according to index of the degree of the technological innovation ability evaluation and analysis. The consequences show that this method is feasible, and the northeast old industrial base of state-owned enterprises' ability to elevate the building of technological innovation has made progress.

articleTitle: A Decision-Making Model of Concession Period for Municipal Solid Waste Incineration Build-Operate-Transfer Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concession period as a key parameter in build-operate-transfer (BOT) concession contract, has been focused on in many studies in recent years. Some risks and uncertainties need to be considered while determining the concession period of BOT projects, typically in such fields as municipal solid waste incineration for generating electricity. This paper presents a decision-making model for concession period of municipal solid waste incineration BOT projects based on Monte Carlo simulation technique and NPV method. With analyzing the key deterministic parameters and uncertain parameters that influenced the decision-making for concession period of municipal solid waste incineration BOT projects, Monte Carlo simulation technique is applied to quantify the uncertain parameters, then the interval of concession period for the project can be determined. A numerical example is used to demonstrate the process of decision-making model for concession period of practical municipal solid waste incineration BOT project.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of "Imitation-Protection" Behavior in an Advantageous Situation of Patent Holders
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The primary goal of this research is the trait and interaction of patent imitation and protection when the patent institution takes sides with the patent holders. The method used in this paper is game theoretic models, including basic model and leader-follower model. Results from the model show, that the holders will protect their patent actively while the competitors will still infringe to a certain extent. Invaders will have opportunities on condition that the cost of protection appears exorbitant to the holders. Further results from the leader-follower model suggest that, in an advantageous situation of patent holders, the emphasized protection-intention will be regarded as a noncredible-threat. Furthermore, the paradox that "the likelihood of entry increases with the penalty" does not appear in this situation.

articleTitle: The Assessment of the Social, Economic, and Environmental Impacts of Expressway Construction Projects Based on the DFGF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a system of criteria for the assessment of the social, economic, and environmental impacts of expressway construction projects in terms of social economy, social environment, natural environment, and etc, with the establishment of an assessment system based on the DFGF technique. The paper will allocate weights to the criteria through Fuzzy Analytic hierarchy process and calculate the gray assessment coefficient with Gray correlation analysis to obtain the gray assessment weights and the fuzzy weights matrix, before determine the degree of social impact of the expressway construction projects by using the Fuzzy comprehensive judgment. Finally, the paper will conduct an empirical study by choosing the Tanlei Expressway project as an example. The results of the empirical study awarded an assessment score of 80.193 for the social impact of Tanlei Expressway, the score lies between the categories of fairly strong and strong.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DICOM Command Set and Data Set Parser
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: DICOM is an international standard communication protocol for medical equipments and at the present time more and more medical equipments supports and applies DICOM standards. In this situation, through the analysis of the structure of DICOM command set and data set, this paper proposes a scheme on how to parse DICOM command set and data set and in the meanwhile gives a detailed discussion on the design and implementation of that scheme and successfully validates its feasibility and correctness.

articleTitle: Forecasting Moral Hazards in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For forecasting the moral hazards more accurately, and controlling them effectively, the categories of the moral hazards are classified, denoted by two group state vectors. The classification work is based on the 4 levels structure of the moral hazards of the supply chain. Then, a warning model of supply chain moral hazards warning system is constructed to forecast the quantity of the moral hazards in supply chain. The parameters of the model are estimated by the grey theory model, GM(1, 1) and GM (1, n), which decreasing the subjectivity of the state vectors setting.

articleTitle: The Research on the Digital Short Radio Covert Communication Based on Audio Signal Information Hiding Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The covert communication technology based on information hiding is the important applied region of information hiding science, which owes special important meaning to the development of military and other special communication. The short radio covert communication precedes traditional communication technology in many aspects, such as the width of cover and steady signal, strong fight crushing, cheapness, lightness, high dependability and so on. Due to the research meaning and the realistic demand of the short radio covert communication based on information hiding technology, a new method of the digital short radio covert communication based on audio signal information hiding is proposed in this paper, which offers an approach to realize middle and long sized-distance broadcasting communication, settle the problem of frequency congestion, raise the safety and dependability of covert communication and realize wireless telecommunication minimally.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Collaboration Mechanism with Option under Market Demand Indefinite
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The risks created by the market demand indefinite exist in the supply chain inevitably. These risks may result in the problem of coordination in supply chain. The ordering and production plan of the enterprise was influenced by the market demand indefinite, and then the risk and the complexity of profit collocation also can be influenced. The realization of the risk and profit sharing is one of the basic purposes for supply chain management in supply chain. Introducing the option mechanism, this paper analysis the impact of derivatives on supply chain performance when market demand is uncertain, and the option mechanism for upstream downstream is proposed to evade market risk jointly, which can enhance information flows, encourage risk sharing, improve supply chain efficiently and realize the chain partner collaboration.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism of Traffic Mode Choices in Urban Railway Passenger Hub
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The urban rail transit which has large capacity will become main transfer way and change the structure of transfer to certain extent in urban railway passenger hub. The research on the influencing factors for choosing urban rail transit is premise for the optimal arrangement of capacity on urban rail transit which matches with transportation demand in urban railway passenger hub. According to the survey and data analysis, the paper discusses the influencing factors for choosing urban rail transit, acquires the scores of factor which are extracted and orthogonal rotated by principal component analysis, then the scores are regressed by Logistic regression on level 0.05. The influencing factors model for choosing urban rail transit in urban railway passenger hub is established. The influencing weight and operational mechanism on traffic mode choice were obtained. Finally, we apply the model to Wenzhou Train station, the results indicate that the convenience of rail transit, travel time, distance and economy have great effect on traffic mode choice, but the age, gender and occupation have little effect.

articleTitle: Enterprises as Customers: Customer-Centered E-Government System Based on CRM in China Local Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concept and role of customer relationship management (CRM) have been seen as a key element in delivering customer-centered public services when they have evolved in response to both environmental and technological changes. Electronic government (e-government) has been proved that it has the potential to shape public administrations to be more customer-oriented. The current situation and problems of the Department of Science and Technology (DoST) of Chengdu Hi-tech Zone in China, were analyzed firstly. Then the fundamental thoughts and business model of the customer-centered e-government system were presented by introducing the concept of CRM in order to make public administration more customer-centered. Finally, The framework and network platform of the customer-centered e-government system based on CRM were designed and implemented. After more than 1 year running, it is proved that this customer-centered e-government system can improve the performance and efficiency of the DoST of Chengdu Hi-tech Zone, which can improve the satisfaction of its customers in the long run: the enterprises in Chengdu Hi-tech Zone.

articleTitle: An Approach of Constructing Neutral Modeling Command Set of Synchronized Collaborative Design upon Heterogeneous CAD Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The synchronized collaborative design within heterogeneous CAD systems becomes a significant challenge because of the great difference between the modeling operations and underground data structures of different systems. In order to enable it, this paper researches an approach to constructing the neutral modeling command set, an important part of synchronized collaborative design systems, to build the mapping of operations among different CAD systems. A prototype is developed based on the neutral modeling command set to verify the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Trust in E-Commerce of C2C Based on Game-Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although the Internet is revolutionizing the way companies provide their products and services to their customers, marketing studies that investigate consumer acceptance of this technology are limited. The key is trust, which is significant barrier for realizing the potentials of C2C e-commerce. This paper, firstly, review briefly research on trust in e-commerce. Then, a trust model based on game theory is constructed, and some analyses are followed. By analyzing model, we know: breaking faith in bargaining in e-commerce is inevitable if without supervising. While safeguarding mechanism of third-party trust platform can avoid breaking faith and promote trust trade environment in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on the Distribution Characteristics of Business Information in Business Information Platform in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the time of electronic commerce, Internet business information has played a very important role in the development of enterprises, and network business information platform is an important distribution channel of Internet business information. Through investigate the three types of network business information platform: the comprehensive, regional, the industry, and select 12 representative platforms, investigate the distribution of business information in each site, analysis the characteristics of the distribution of business information in the network platform. The results can make users more targeted when access to business information.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness for Process Adjustment Methods
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In modern manufacturing environment, the autocorrelation of process data is universal, and the error of machine settings happened frequently. It is no sense to monitor the process by traditional SPC. Base on Deming's funnel experiment, the necessity of process adjustments was discussed, and the effectiveness of the Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) and Grubbs harmonic rule for process adjustment was studied. In addition, the characteristic contrast between MMSE and Grubbs harmonic rule was analyzed.

articleTitle: 3D Digital City Constructing Methods for People Behavior Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the concept of human-oriented geographic information, we propose a digital city constructing framework for people behavior study in this paper. Two factors, the digital human and the digital city that they live in should be considered when constructing a digital city. It's very important to make the digital human and the digital city spatially matched; they should be aware of the behavior of each other and take responses appropriately. Around this framework, we focus our research on the methodology and key technologies to model the digital city and the digital human based on real data. We also do some preliminary explorations in the field of mutual responses between the digital city and the digital human.

articleTitle: Urban Smart Growth Based on Optimal Allocation of Land Resource
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Smart growth plays a significant role in solving a series of problems in rapidly urban development in China. Optimal allocation in land resource is the key for the realization of smart growth. In view of this, taking Yixing in Jiangsu Province, China for an example, this paper attempted to make a study on urban smart growth based on optimal allocation in land resource. The main objective of this study was to enrich, improve and even deepen certain theory of smart growth and its quantitative analysis method in practice from the perspective of land resource allocation. Based on urban smart growth theory of optimal allocation in land resource, the measurement system for smart growth degree in land use was firstly set up. Then, in order to optimize urban land use structure, grey multi-objective dynamic planning model was employed to get several optioned optimization schemes. Finally, the optimal scheme for land use structure was selected by using the combination method of grey correlation analysis and principal components projection.

articleTitle: Application of Gray System Theory in Bidding Estimation for Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through inducting the gray system theory, the modeling method, applicable condition and the means of precision inspection for Gray GM(1,1) forecasting model are given a brief and comprehensive introduction. On base of a case study how to use the method in the field of project cost forecasting and determine bidding price have been discussed. The features of small-samples and high-accuracy of gray system are fully displayed.

articleTitle: The Information Technology Developing Path and the Influence Effect on the Capital-Labor Ratio in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the production, The technology in some stage always relates to the ratio of the two factors capital and labor. The degree of the technology soaking up the capital and labor will direct influence the economy increase. It also used to reflect and measure a kind of technology advancement. The capital-labor ratio (K/L) can be used to judge a kind of technology which is a capital - denseness technology or a labor - denseness technology. The information technology has wide application and penetrability, in the different technology developing period, the information technology has different soaking degree to the capital and labor, Its innovation's forming and spreading have different influence on the capital-labor ratio (K/L). Here first we'll do some theory analyses to the capital-labor ratio (K/L), i.e to find out their effect rules. And then we'll do some demonstration by using the real example and further analyses the influence effect of the information technology on the capital-labor ratio (K/L) with the mathematics, and find out the conclusion. In the lower informationization period, The information technology is a capital - denseness technology. During the higher informationization period, The information technology is a labor - denseness technology. The conclusion will be redound to the harmony develop for the IT industry and the labor market. Finally offer a series of the suggestions about information technology.

articleTitle: Research on UPnP-Based Media Service Discovery and Its Configuration Strategies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: UPnP is a new Internet protocol by which various intelligent devices, wireless devices, personal computers and so on could access to peer-to-peer networks around the world. With the rapid development of current digital technology, UPnP technology is widely used in all types of family networking products. This paper introduces the system's composition and mechanisms of UPnP, and proposes a process model for the media server's architecting, configuration and discovery based on UPnP and its audio-visual architecture, upon the basis of which the analysis of its advantages is presented.

articleTitle: Study on the Size of Oasis City Urumqi Based on the Restriction of Water Resources
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the changes of the water resource utilization rate and per capita water resource of Urumqi city from 1995 to 2007 based on the international standard of water resource exploitation and utilization and Chinese arid land water utilization rate standards. We also study the structure of water consumption, the proportion of utilization water resources of different sections and the main existing problems. We study the city size under the different water constraint conditions. The result shows that: (1) the average water utilization rate of Urumqi city is 60.01 percent, which is greater than the international standard and Chinese arid land water utilization rate standards; (2)Urumqi is lack of water seriously with the average of 668 m3/person; (3)The largest water consumption section is agriculture; (4) the current population size of Urumqi is larger than that are imitated under different water constraint conditions. This article raises some corresponding development approachs: (1) Improve water use efficiency; (2)interregional water transfer; (3) Sewage treatment and utilization.

articleTitle: Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity in Credit Risk Measurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a modified model for Chinese credit risk management. The model is based on KMV model with consideration of Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticit (GARCH). Data used in this research are from the balance sheet and the Chinese stock market. T-tests and ROC curves are employed to analyze the data, examining the model. It is shown that the model can be applied to identification and measurement of the credit risk of companies and hence offers an efficient way to banks in risk management.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Frazil Ice Evolution in Diversion Channel of Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Frazil ice evolution can result in serious ice damage. Ice damage is a danger to the operation of hydropower station. A 3-D Eulerian multiphase model incorporating the high Reynolds number k-epsiv turbulence model is developed to analyze the formation and evolution of Frazil ice. Frazil ice evolution in the diversion channel of one hydropower station is used as a case. It is concluded that the ice temperature increases quickly along the river, while the water temperature recovers from a minimum value. Ice concentration is very low at the beginning of the diversion channel. After the sudden point, ice concentration increases quickly. The location of the lowest water temperature and sudden change of ice concentration is very near. The study on Frazil ice evolution has a great significance to construction and operation of hydropower station.

articleTitle: Processes Evaluation and Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Experimental investigation of natural gas hydration processes and evaluation of experimental processes are used as a means to evaluation of processes scaled up and processes industrialized. In this investigation an energy consumption evaluation parameter is introduced to evaluate a variety of processes. Parameter analyses indicate that process simplicity or process integration can decrease energy consumption. Moreover, the energy consumption evaluation parameter used as an economic criterion is converted into a process evaluation parameter. Analyses indicate that the process evaluation parameter is relevant to technology level and resource consumption for a system, which can make it applicable to economic analysis and venture forecasting for optimal capital utilization. If some views of game theory are introduced to model equation under the conditions of perfect competition and political factor should be considered, then it is more helpful to evaluate processes being good or bad and how to implement management for them.

articleTitle: Study of Supply Chain Workflow Based on Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The emergence of the grid has brought fundamental changes to collect and deal with information. This paper states the evolution of supply chain model and features of supply chain workflow with grid as platform, studies on the problems about supply chain management with G-SCM as technology supporting, tradition workflow as foundation and grid as platform, and analyses the business process and working mechanism of the planning workflow, purchasing workflow, manufacturing workflow, delivery workflow and returning flow, the internal and external supply chain integration workflow; supply chain workflow. Finally, it looks ahead to prospects and the impact of supply chain management of G-SCM. This paper promotes to E-SCM high to G-SCM, putting forward a new concept of grid supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Service System in New Product Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With economic development and increasing market competition, in machinery industry, if small and medium enterprises want to improve efficiency and profits in order to ensure competition in the market with an invincible position, they must constantly develop new products and shorten the production cycle to reduce production costs. Therefore, how to provide the quality of technical services for new product development has become the key to the process. This paper presents a web-based new product development system, the concept of technical services, and implementation of the system, as well as describes how to carry out necessary function modules.

articleTitle: Consultants Scheduling with Time Windows in Management Consulting Service Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Management consultant scheduling problem in management consulting service enterprise is a NP-hard problem. This paper studies the problem of management consultants scheduling problems with time window. We formulate the problem where the primary objective is to minimize the makespan. This paper proposes a hybrid genetic algorithms (HGA) based on taboo search to solve the problem. It adopts a novel two-chromosome-encoding method for genetic algorithms. A case study with the MATLAB 7.0 platform is carried to test this method. Computational results are reported, which show the effectiveness of the proposed approach in finding desirable solutions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Privatization, Legal Protections and Pyramid Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Service Industry Development and Financial Support in Northeast China Based on Co-Integration Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the data of 1978-2007, the relationship between service industry development and financial support in northeast China is discussed by co-integration analysis and Granger causality test. We can conclude from the results of the empirical analysis that there exists long-term dynamic equilibrium interrelation, and that there is one-way Granger causality between the two, namely financial support is indispensable to service industry development in northeast China, which is helpful to the economy development and decision-making of the government.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study of Entrepreneurial Teams' Performance Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Traffic Flow Characteristics Analysis at Intersection in Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Demand Predicting Model for Purified Water: Application Study on a University
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Purified water is a necessity for daily life of mankind, and its supply chain management impact on production, marketing, and customers etc. In the research, the purified water demand in a university and its factors was studied, and daily temperature and purified water demand data in three months were colleted to analyses and set up a cubic curve mathematical prediction model of purified water demand in the university by using SPSS, multiple regression analysis and curve fitting. The experiment shows that the prediction accuracy of the model is higher and suits to short-term prediction (the next three days). The model is credible and advisable, which can solve some supply chain management issues and improve the management performance of purified water company.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Leadership Capabilities of Different Genders - From View of Critical Thinking
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: City Innovation System Efficiency Prediction Based on Support Vector Machine: Taking Eight Chinese Cities as the Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation system efficiency analysis and prediction play an important role in regional innovation systems development and improve benefit of innovative capacity for country. According to the city innovation system data which is large scale and imbalance, this paper presented a support vector machine model to predict city innovation system efficiency. The method was compared with artificial neural network, decision tree, logistic regression and naive Bayesian classifier regarding city innovation system efficiency prediction for eight Chinese cities. It is found that the method has the best accuracy rate, hit rate, covering rate and lift coefficient, and provides an effective measurement for city innovation system efficiency prediction.

articleTitle: Measurement, Modeling and Systemic Implementation of Cross-Media Communication Effect
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In respect of the research subject of cross-media communication effect, this paper discusses the unity of measure system for evaluating the cross-media communication effect, and compares the technology measuring the communication effect of traditional media and new media.
