At the same time, combining the actual situation of media research market in China, this paper deals with such issues as single source and multi-source data as well as data fusion, and introduces the application of media research and prediction model in cross-media communication. As a specific application, this paper presents the description of eFrontSightcopy, an Internet communication effect real-time measurement and analysis system developed by the team under the guidance of the author.

articleTitle: Supernetwork Model for Minimizing the Interdependent Response of Critical Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Interdependent response among critical infrastructure systems is recognized as key point of vulnerability that can compromise system performance. In this paper, a supernetwork model which contain two critical infrastructures is established, we quantify the possible cost that generate from interdependent response among them, using the variational inequality to solve the minimization problem. After computation, we obtain the solution to the problem, which can minimize the interdependent response of the selected system.

articleTitle: Application Study of E-Commerce Model on Chinese SMEs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly reviews basic process of Chinese SMEs e-commerce, analyzes some e-commerce models applicable to Chinese SMEs, according to the existing problems, and puts forwards an e-commerce model of ASP which should be widely applicable to Chinese SMEs, which are of great significance for the development of Chinese SMEs. All of these will also have an important reference to the application of e-commerce in developing countries.

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Management Mechanism of the Engineering Project during Decision-Making Stage
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Without a scientific risk management mechanism at the stage of the engineering project decision-making, it is very difficult to change the result of projects only by strengthening the implementation management. This paper research the mechanism from four aspects: procedure subsystem, methods subsystem, suitable risk management organization subsystem, law or rule subsystem and the essential condition of the decision-making environment. A series of appraisal index system is constructed and the DEA model (C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R) is used to analysis the four engineering projects as case to testify the scientific risk management mechanism which would be benefit for reducing the risk and improving the engineering project investment effect.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Relationships between China Warrants and Underlying Stock
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through an empirical test, different relationships on call-warrants and put-warrants with their underlying stocks were analyzed. Moreover, whether the effects of warrants on the underlying stocks are same in notice day and list day were analyzed. Correlation coefficient of warrants with their underlying was computed and cumulative abnormal yield and abnormal volatility in notice day and list day were also computed chiefly. The result of the research shows that the call-warrants have high relevance with their underlying stock, and the listing of warrant has no explicit effect on China stock market.

articleTitle: The Influence of Enterprise Senior Management to NPD Projects: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The continuous development and market introduction of new products can be an important determinant of sustained enterprise performance. For approximately 30 years, conceptual and empirical research has been undertaken to identify the critical success factors (CSFs) of new product development (NPD) project. This paper reviews the findings of empirical work into the CSFs of NPD projects influence from enterprise senior management, and sums up 12 CSFs of NPD projects influence from enterprise senior management based on the literature review. Through the questionnaire surveyed gathering data from the 85 China enterprises, used the SPSS software to carry on factors analysis, three parent factors had been found. At last this paper built a conceptual model of NPD projects CSFs based on enterprise senior management. The model establishment provides more systematic theory framework and measure table for NPD project CSFs' research, while it supplies some reference for improving NPD project success rate from the view of the enterprise senior managers in China.

articleTitle: Studying on the Development of Chinese E-Tourism from the View of Consumers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-tourism is a new industry which generated and developed on the basis of Internet. The characteristics of tourism products such as intangible nature, no storage, no distribution links in the logistics make e-tourism become one of the important area of e-commerce application. Due to the differences of people's age, occupation, hobbies, as well as their knowledge, the consumers still have different opinions and understandings to e-tourism. How to study e-tourism from the view of consumers has become an important research topic. Through a questionnaire survey, the basic situations, the attitude to tourism, the concerned issues, the understandings to e-tourism were carefully calculated and analyzed. The results showed that developing e-tourism in China has a large market, but the construction of e-tourism Web sites still had a long way to go. Online transactions should march on under the protection of law and the fast developing technologies.

articleTitle: The Application of RFID Technology in the Quality Management of Farming Fishery Products in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the increment of the fishery products in China, more and more attention is drawn to the safety of farming fishery products from different levels. China always stressed the importance to the issue of food safety. The wide application of RFID and other technology offers great support to the upgrading of the safety level of fishery products. The paper firstly introduces the application principle of RFID and the five steps from producing area to table of farming fishery products. Then it analyzes the role in the safety risk decrease of farming fishery products that is played by the application of RFID. Finally, it puts forward that the application of RFID can combine the realtime control and feedback control together and therefore can improve the safety level of fishery products in China.

articleTitle: Rapid Beam Replacement of Chongqing Monorail: Emergency Beam, Process, and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chongqing monorail line 2 , the first straddle monorail transit in China, was opened to public in 2005. Most of the track beams in the monorail system are prestressed concrete (PC) beams. Because of its complicated alignment and long construction time, once a PC beam is destroyed, the whole line will be out of operation for a long time. To respond to the potential threats on PC beam, a research project was conducted to solve the problem of rapid beam replacement. To achieve the research objectives, the research team first introduced a new type of prefabricated emergency beam, which can be temporarily used to shorten the idling time of the monorail system. Then the research team developed the process of rapid beam replacement for PC beam accident. Next, two key technologies, emergency beam assembling and installation, were studied so that the rescue works would be carried out successfully. This research work could ultimately enhance the capability of rapid beam replacement after extreme events.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Resource Leveraging Exploitation and Organizational Competitiveness Building Up of Entrepreneurial Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: New Concept for Water Management in Urban Areas of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With rapid economic development and urban growth, water shortage and resource pollution is now a serious problem for urban water supply in many Chinese cities. At same time, with enlargement of urban areas and increase of sealing areas (reduction of green spaces, new road and building construction etc.), runoffs of rainwater increase greatly, which lead to the increase of frequency and intensity of urban floods. The majority of water used for indoor domestic purposes is normally discharged after use as wastewater. This wastewater is collected by sewer system and treated at a centralized wastewater treatment plant, then discharged into the waters. Also little polluted rainwater is collected and discharged from residential areas into the waters as early and much as possible. This water management method in urban areas has lead to a range of water crises, including floods and scarcity. Therefore, new concepts to ease this situation should be developed. As alternative water management method, domestic wastewater and rainwater can be collected, treated and reused on site, thereby promoting more water efficient use. On-site water management at this level offers the opportunity to provide benefits for the consumer and the environment. The principal of innovative water management is to minimize the consumption of drinking water and the production of stormwater and wastewater cost-effectively. In this study innovative water management concept will be introduced, which could alleviate the situation of water problems caused by conventional centralized water system as well as insufficient wastewater treatment system in China.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research of China's Foreign Exchange Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article applies GARCH model to Chinese commercial banks exchange rate risk model-based, through empirical analysis of the USD/CNY exchange rate day volatility VaR value show that: (1) Residual items obey the distribution not suitable for distribution of China's foreign exchange market exchange rate yield sequence. Residual items obey GED distribution can be better characterize the distribution of China's foreign exchange market exchange rate yields sequences; (2) The difference of the conclusions of TARCH (1,1)-G model and the EGARCH (1,1)-G model shows that whether there is leverage effect in China foreign exchange market rate yield sequence is not clear.

articleTitle: A Bilateral Multi-Issue Negotiation Protocol Based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In agent bilateral multi-issue bidding negotiation protocol, how to make the negotiation agents gain satisfying result farthest and negotiate efficiently is a key issue. As for this problem, an adaptive genetic algorithm is present in the protocol and the algorithm is applied in bilateral multi-issue simultaneous bidding negotiation protocol in e-commerce. In the protocol, the negotiation agent can send the information of its issue range and the issue weight to the third party agent which it trusts, and then the third party agent use the adaptive genetic algorithm which is present in this paper to give the optimal result. In the protocol experiments, the two methods are used to compare. The first is simple genetic algorithm (SGA), the second is the adaptive genetic algorithm (AGA). The difference is the later algorithm can change the crossover probability and the mutation probability adaptively. The SGA uses 218 runs to gain the satisfying result, while the AGA only uses 152 runs to gain the satisfying result. The experiments show that the protocol present in this paper can help agents to negotiation more efficiently. In the end, the finite state figure of the protocol is present.

articleTitle: An Infectious Disease Model on Risk Diffusion from the Perspective of Business Gene's Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Like the gene of biological organism, business gene is also vulnerable or fragile. The vulnerability of business gene is the main reason that makes a business lack the immunity to risks, or be easily infected by risks. Considering the strong similarity between business risk and infectious disease on the mechanism of diffusion, it is quite possible for us to use the infectious disease model (acronymed as IDM) to explain how business risk diffuses from the perspective of business gene's vulnerability. It is believed that the diffusion of risk triggered by the vulnerability could bring on unsteadiness to business, and even to business ecosystem. In this paper, we have set up a SEIRS model to explore and tell why and how risk diffuses among a specific cluster of businesses as well simulate the process of business risk diffusing with Matlab software.

articleTitle: The RAROC Technology and Its Adjustment in I-Bank Capital Allocation Base on the ERM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the network economy and e-buy is developing, the I-bank is becoming more and more important in our social; it is the most influential financial innovation, which has its own special characters; its development is pressing needing the system and comprehensive risk management. To resist the risk of I-bank, effectively capital allocation can help. The mixed operation trend and network economy environment it face, require the allocation of I-bank must use the approach of integrated risk management which can take the relationship of risk and capital cost into account roundly in a comprehensive and scientific risk management framework with norms process. The paper right start from this point, and adjusted the input-output relationship, the expected risk loss, and economy capital in the RAROC technology combined the characters of I-bank. At the end, the paper raises a support system of using the RAROC technique.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of Dividend Distribution of Listed Companies Based Agency Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The agency theory is the theoretical basis of this paper, which attempts to explain our dividend policy of listed companies, combining with transaction costs. Dividends lead to an increase in external financing, then add agency costs . This paper focuses on demonstrating the close relationship between agency problem and dividend policy of listed companies in Chinese according to theoretical and empirical description on data.

articleTitle: Rights Sharing Scheme for Online DRM System Using Digital Ticket
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rights sharing in DRM system has long been a challenge and a key technical issue. In this paper, a novel rights sharing scheme using digital ticket is proposed. The user who possesses the right object to certain DRM protected content can acquire tickets which act as ownership certifications of the content from right issuer in a controlled manner, and then deliver the tickets to the others. Other user who receives a valid digital ticket can present the ticket to right issuer for specified rights. The proposed scheme introduces little overhead to license server, and is secure against multiple-spending and over-issuing attacks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Effects of In- and Extra-role Customer Service on Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty - Evidence from Chinese Retailing Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of Customer Knowledge Management and Realizing Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly studies the concept and fundamental idea of customer knowledge, and further analyzes the limitations of the traditional customer relationship. On this basis, the paper builds the two-way knowledge transferring model between enterprises and customers combined with the four stages - knowledge acquisition, knowledge use, knowledge adjustment and knowledge evaluation. This study is beneficial not only to improve customer satisfaction, but also be able to effectively improve the enterprise's core competencies.

articleTitle: A New Polynomial Algorithm for Total Tardiness Minimization of the Sequencing Optimal Problem of Parallel Activities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The problem of M activities of N > M parallel activities being adjusted to a procedure chain is one type of the project scheduling. In allusion to M = 3 , a new polynomial algorithm is proposed to minimize the total tardiness criterion. In order to present this algorithm, and search the optimal procedure chain, we propose a Normal Chain Theory by virtue of the relationships of activities' time parameters, together with the properties that the optimal chain contains the activities with the minimum of earliest finish time. By the analysis of this algorithm, we get the time complexity is O(N log N).

articleTitle: Clustering Ensemble Based on Hierarchical Partition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many clustering ensemble algorithms need to predesign initial thresholds before partition data points, which is supervised learning and directly influence the efficiency of clustering. In order to cluster data points under fully unsupervised situation, the hierarchical partition is introduced in this paper. The proposed algorithm makes use of the distribution of results of all clustering memberships by constructing the m-subset of Descartes with the support degree. The theorems and definitions advanced in this paper are detailed proved. Finally, the proposed algorithm is applied in practice and results show that it is effective.

articleTitle: A New Ethernet-Based Architecture to Delivery DTV Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a new Ethernet-based architecture to delivery digital television (DTV) services. In our architecture, new protocol stack and packet encapsulation are proposed to help implementation of DTV services over Ethernet link. We have also done the experiment, which successfully implement the idea. A simple quality of service (Qos) structure is provided in traffic control of nodes to achieve Qos requirements of DTV delivery. Finally, we give a short evaluation to Qos provisions and achieve good results.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Model of the Electric Consumer Market Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The analysis of determining and evaluating the target market is very important in the electric consumer market. In this article, an evaluation model of the electric consumer market is built in analytic hierarchy process (AHP), which is an integrated evaluation method combined with qualitative and quantitative method. It illustrate that the model based on AHP in the power industry is advantage in efficiency and simplification of the analysis process through detailed empirical analysis and application of the theory in this paper. It could support the scientific decision-making of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Rainwater Resources Utilization of Soil Conversation and Benefit Analysis in the Western Mountains of HENAN Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For scarcity of water resources and serious soil erosion in the western mountain in HENAN province, various forms of projects about rainwater resources utilization of soil and water conservation have been carried out since 1990s, from which, corresponding models of development are adopted to the rainwater resources droping on hillsides and channels, as well as small mountain springs and streams. At present, the engineerings have been developed into a more sophisticated technology system. Based on investigation and research, various benefits of these projects are analysed and future direction of development and research are pointed out in the paper.

articleTitle: Simulation Studies on Core-Competition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main research methods of this paper are entropy weight method and simulation analysis method. This research can be totally divided into five steps: the first step is to finish building the evaluation index system of telecommunication industries' core competence, the second step is to finish the simulation modeling work, the third step is to finish debugging and running the simulation program, the forth step is to get the analysis of simulation outcome and the last step is to finish finding out the related solution measures and schemes.

articleTitle: The Impact of Revenue Sharing Contracts on a Retailer's Shelf-Space and Pricing Decisions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is well known that retailers can often increase product sales by offering a price discount or allocating more shelf or display space. The retailer's shelf-space and pricing decisions affect not only the retailer's profitability but also the manufacturer's profitability. This research studies how a manufacturer can use revenue sharing contracts to influence the retailer's shelf-space and pricing decisions. We model a two-echelon supply chain with a manufacturer supplying a certain product to a retailer facing demand that depends on both the price of the product and the shelf space allocated. Under a wholesale-price-only contract, the retailer's shelf-space allocation and pricing decisions and their impact on the manufacturer's decision and the supply chain efficiency are addressed as a benchmark. We then consider the case where the manufacturer replenishes the retailer's shelf under a revenue sharing contract. It is shown that a properly designed revenue sharing contract can increase the profit of the manufacture, comparing to the benchmark case. We further explore whether such a supply contract can coordinate the supply chain.

articleTitle: How to Evaluate the Doctor's Value: Index and Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the basis of many human resource management function in the hospitals, evaluation of the doctor's value is very important. Rough Set theory is involved to evaluate the value of the doctor in this paper. The evaluation approach is expatiated with a case study. The result of the case study demonstrates that rough set method can be used in the evaluation of the doctor's value.

articleTitle: An Approach of Online Hydraulic Simulation for Water Supply Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper exposes our online approach to real-time hydraulic simulation that could hardly be achieved through traditional optimization methods. The proposed approach includes a distribution model of SCADA nodes and an estimation algorithm of instantaneous node water flow. The SCADA model is used to analyze a complex water supply network into simple computation units, and the estimation algorithm is used to adjust the instantaneous distribution of node water flow dynamically according to the measured flow and pressure of SCADA nodes. As a result, it becomes possible to perform real-time calculation of the hydraulic parameters with hydraulic formulas one by one. The proposed approach can satisfy the hard real-time requirement of state estimation of large water distribution networks for its high performance on efficiency, rationality and economy. Therefore, it can be easily integrated into online GIS software for management purpose of water distribution system such as planning, reforming, dispatching, online monitoring, safety detecting and so on.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Forecasting System Based on Datacollection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is one of the countries in the world that suffer serious natural disasters. Frequent and serious biological disasters cause great damage to crop production. The plant disease data of multiform could be analyzed and then a forecasting report was made.This article according to characteristic of the plant disease, introduced forecasts system's design and key technologies realization based on data mining's plant disease system. The data mining function may divide into two kinds: Description and forecast. The data mining is a kind of deep level data analysis, it can extract from the mass data has certain rule knowledge, the deep level's development may further enhance the information resource the use value, the localized data through the data management module data input warehouse, according to the description, the knowledge excavation, finally achieves the forecast the effect. The system collection data management, the report form manufacture and the forecast in windows system.

articleTitle: Energy Audit and Its Application in Coal-Fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper addresses the implementation method of energy audit in coal-fired power plant. Energy audit, as an effective energy-saving and emission-reducing measure, was launched in thousands of high energy-consuming enterprises in China in 2006. In this paper, energy audit concept and purpose is analyzed. By analyzing current utilization situation of energy in China's coal-fired power plant, the significance of energy audit in coal-fired power plant to energy-saving and emission-reducing is introduced. Energy audit contents such as energy management audit, energy utilization audit and energy-saving potential analysis is given. According to energy audit practice in coal-fired power plant, the implementation step and a substantial case of energy audit are proposed.

articleTitle: Current Practices of Shanghai E-Government: A Framework and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this paper is to explore the experience of Shanghai e-government. In this paper, an e-government general framework of district level in Shanghai is introduced. A Shanghai case study of Huangpu District, Songjiang District and Xuhui District (respectively at population, corporate, and geographic field) has been taken up for analysis into the framework. The results obtained suggest that to enhance e-government, it's necessary to plan district-level information systems to promote application integration, inter-departmental information sharing and operational coordination on the basis of unified interexchange platform and library.

articleTitle: Event-Based Text Similarity Computing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A large amount of research results have shown that events exist in many texts. Understanding texts from semantics, texts are composed of events, and events are the basic semantic units for texts. We present a novel approach for computing text similarity, which selects events as the features for documents and computes text similarity from two points of view: event class and event instance. The number of events is usually much fewer than the number of key words in documents. From this side, extracting event characters from documents is a good attempt to solve the high dimension of documents.

articleTitle: Research of Neural Network Based on Fuzzy Clustering in Supply Chain Quality Affecting Elements Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research of influencing elements is a basic work in supply chain quality management. The thesis applies neural network based on fuzzy clustering and makes use of the advantages of the two data-mining technologies, which overcome the shortage of a single data-mining technology. Firstly, it puts forward the algorithm and process of neural network based on fuzzy clustering. Secondly, the memberships of subclass are acquired through clustering the elements based on fuzzy clustering. Then, the memberships are passed into the neural network to study by the form of the input. Finally, the main elements and their weights are acquired and discovered through studying. These works are the basis of supply chain quality in the future.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Logistics Demand Prediction Based on Support Vector Non-Linear Multiple Regression
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper indicates the implications and characteristics of the regional logistics demand, and the key prediction indicator system in the course of regional logistics demand prediction is established and proposes an approach that support vector multiple regression (SVR) and principal component analysis (PCA) can solve the prediction problem of regional logistics demand. A numerical example based on Heilongjiang province of China is given to demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Debt Financing Structure and Its Impact on Corporate Performance: An Empirical Study on Family Owned Listed Firms in Zhejiang Province, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal the impaction of debt financing to corporate performance, we select Zhejiang Province family owned listed corporation as study sample, using multivariate linear regression method, analyzing corporate performance by three factors: overall level of debt financing, debt maturity structure and debt sources structure. Our conclusion is Zhejiang family owned listed firms' debt financing is negative correlated to corporate performance, current debt and long term debt both show a significant negative correlation to corporate performance, selection of debt financing has no significant relation to corporate performance.

articleTitle: The Adoption and Use of Mobile Commerce: An Information Processing Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to its potential to drive the next wave of e-commerce, mobile commerce has attracted much attention from both practitioners and researchers. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework to study the adoption and use of m-commerce from the information processing perspective. Based on the information processing framework, we propose that the fit between the information processing need of m-commerce users and the information processing capacity of mobile applications positively affects the perceived usefulness of users, which in turn influences their intention to adopt and use m-commerce.

articleTitle: Workload Point System Based on Project Schedule Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapidly changing, time limit has become one of the key factor for the project to the success. So the research about how to control and optimize the schedule of the project has been hot. We have applied the advanced control methods and optimization software to the project, but the proportion of the project delay is still high. According to survey, we find that the project delay is not caused by software or method, the main problem is within the planning process and performing process of project schedule. During the plan process of project schedule, the majority of project managers believe that schedule is time limit simply, in fact, the time limit is only one factor. The real determinative factor is man-hour. In terms of man-hour that is important parameters, project workload establishes a functional relationship with the time, which is required for finishing the whole project. This time should be regard as real project schedule. Project planning process insists on the control and optimization for time, but implementation process has focused on the calculation of project workload actually, which is the basis of payment. So it is inevitable to make the project schedule plan become a being hung beautiful picture on the wall. During project execute process, different activities use different standard to measure the progress of activities. The measurement results of different activities can not add simply, at the same time, during the process, a large number of trivial activities cannot be measured, and these activities often become a bottleneck, which lead to project delay. So on the one hand; we will measure a lot of activities to have enough information to reflect the true progress of the project, on the other hand, we still need to turn the measurement results of activities into a time parameter that can be used to compare with project schedule, which can be used to monitor project status. To finish the above process, we must be need additional resources, such as the project team members, particularly project managers, to devote all efforts to calculate the complicated data. To solve the above problem, we use the workload point system (WPS) to control and optimize the project schedule.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Enterprises Knowledge Overflow in Industrial Cluster Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The agent-based simulation is introduced in this paper in view of the complexity of industrial cluster system. The micro-mechanism of enterprises knowledge overflow in industrial cluster is analyzed, and then the enterprises knowledge overflow is simulated based on agent. According to the simulation, the positive and negative effects of enterprises knowledge overflow in industrial cluster are analyzed.

articleTitle: Cultivating the Corporate Core Competence with Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The corporate core competence is the entity of collective knowledge. Based on analyzing the knowledge attribute of the corporate core competence, two factors which are the core knowledge competence and the core operating competence are generalized. This analysis provides theoretical premise for using the knowledge management to cultivate the corporate core competence. According to the knowledge flow during the course of the cultivation of the corporate core competence, this paper uses the theory of the complexity science to pointing out the detailed measures for using knowledge management to cultivate the corporate core competences. That provides theoretical inspiration for cultivating the corporate core competence and set the relationship between corporate core competence and the knowledge management in the times of knowledge-based economy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Web Service Composition Approach Based on improved Particle Swarm Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the rapid growth of the number of the available Web services over the Internet, the quality of services (QoS) becomes an imperative concern for service consumers and providers. How to differentiate their quality based on Qos criteria at Web service level is a challenging issue. Considering that evolutionary algorithm has powerful ability of searching information, a new Web service composition model under improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm is presented in this paper. According to the non-functional attributes Qos of services, the model can select Web services with optimal Qos and compose them into value-added Web services. Furthermore, IPSO model not only can find the service with optimal QoS immediately but also can overcome the bottleneck of the standard PSO model. It can balance the exploitation and exploration and avoid premature convergence to some extent. As a result, web services can be invocated dynamically and be composed automatically and efficiently. The preliminary experimental results indicate that the Web service composition approach based on IPSO model is applicable and feasible to the optimization of general service compositions.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Support System Based on Natural Language Understanding
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we simply introduced the traditional decision support system and its characteristics and limitations. And then some new types of intelligent decision support system are recommended, such as GDSS, DDSS, 3IDSS and IDSSKD. And at last IDSS based on natural language understanding are described in detail. Some techniques and methods of IDSSNLU are introduced detailedly. The prospects of IDSS based on natural language understanding is put foreword.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Architecture of Health Monitoring system for Long-Span Bridge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The agent technology is an intelligent technology for software and hardware that can act on behalf of a client, which is capable of perceiving its environment and carrying out goal-oriented action. Therefore, to resolve the real-time, intelligent, as well as issues such as synergy for long-span bridge health monitoring, a three hierarchical model based on multi-agent technology for long-span bridge health monitoring system was proposed in the paper, and the function of each hierarchy was defined, which provide a guideline for the implementation of long-span bridge health monitoring system.

articleTitle: The Ways of Building Information Modeling to Improve the Value Chain of Building Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction industry has been troubled by its low productivity, one of the fundamental reasons behind the phenomenon is that there are so many non value-adding activities in the design-construction process. This paper first concludes main categories of non value-adding activities and then introduces what is building information modeling (BIM) and its main functions, based on that, the paper finally analyzes how BIM can improve the value chain by reducing the non-value adding activities.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Forecasting Algorithms of Time Series
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Time series forecasting exists in a lot of fields, and many forecasting algorithms were proposed at present. How to evaluate forecasting algorithm is requested in algorithm analysis. The techniques of evaluation of forecasting are studied here, and a novel measure, relative degree of association, is also proposed to evaluate forecasting algorithm. Some experimental results using these measures give performances of these measures in evaluating forecasting algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Time-Partition SDRAM Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Generally, the traditional SDRAM controllers use an arbitral form to deal with the variable accessing requirement. But the design of the arbitral form is very complex. To avoid the complexity, this article introduces a time-partition form SDRAM controller based on multi-DAB project, and compares the arbitral form controller and the time-partition form. At last, the paper analyzes the new form of SDRAM controller and makes a conclusion.

articleTitle: Measuring Complexity of Relationships among Classes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Unified Modeling Language (UML) is widely adopted in the development of software systems and also gets more and more attentions from researchers. Till now, various metrics for UML class diagram have been suggested, however very little work is involved in measuring complexity of relationships among classes. This paper solves this problem to some extent. Finally, a cosmetic wholesale shop is taken for an example to illustrate.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Project Risk Management Based on A.D.HALL Three-Dimension Structure Active-Matrix Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Dynamic Trajectory Analysis of Entrepreneur's Competency: A New, Quantifiable Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new, simple and quantifiable competency model is presented to quantify a leader's abilities and the total ability of a company's management team. This allows best-matches for any given decision making moment or process to be found, thereby maximizing a company's capability for innovation and entrepreneurship. Furthermore the method can uncover hidden or future obstacles that prevent a leader and thus the company from reaching full potential. From many interviews was found the optimal leader profile to maximize a company's innovating and entrepreneurial potential, the most important ability named C.I.-ability or Communication and Information Processing and the disproportionate effect single actions can have on a leader's development dubbed the Three Singles Effect.

articleTitle: Regional Economic Differences of Xinjiang Based on Gravity Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we took a spatial visualization approach instead of a numeric indicator to describe the spatial inequality of development in Xinjiang. Spatial mean in geo-statistics was used as a measurement of spatial equality. The values of spatial mean for GDP level were plotted on the map by geographic information system of prefecture level data. We can see clearly that: (1) the economic gravity centers mainly distributes in the northeast of geographic gravity center. The distance between economic gravity center and geographic gravity center shows an increasing tendency. (2) The moving route of economic gravity center unfolds its 'S' state from 1978 to 2007. The variation of distance in latitudinal direction is mostly bigger than in longitudinal direction. (3) The shift movement is closely correlated with policies of regional economic development, and the shift of economic gravity center is obviously staged and regular under different policies.

articleTitle: Factors That Affect Knowledge Diffusion among Teachers and Students in Local Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We have studied the theory of the process of knowledge transfer, the characters of the knowledge diffusion among teachers and students and the related factors. We find there are four stages in the process of knowledge diffusion among teachers and students in local universities and each stage is influenced by different factors. A conceptual model about the factors that effect knowledge diffusion among teachers and students in local universities is proposed As we have studied the QianLi IT institute in a college of Economics and Management, we have a empirical analysis of the factors affecting knowledge diffusion, and put forward some countermeasures and suggestions to promote the knowledge diffusion in local colleges.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Near-Miss Incident Management of Underground Engineering Safety Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Robust Parameter Design Via Bayesian Generalizedlinear Models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Generalized linear models (GLM) are discussed in this paper, which are used widely in the field of robust parameter design involving non-normal response variables. As for the estimation problems such as data over-dispersion which exist generally in robust parameter design, the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) approach based on adaptive rejection metropolis sampling algorithm is brought forward to simulate dynamically the Markov chain of the parameter's posterior distribution of the GLM. Furthermore, the parameters' Bayesian estimation and significant factors of the GLM will be given when relative objective Jeffreys' prior distribution is used for the parameters of the GLM. Practical industrial experiment data is utilized to simulate and analyze the Bayesian GLM by the SAS software. The results demonstrate that the Bayesian GLM performs more reliable and valid in parameter robust estimation and significant factors identification than the conventional GLM.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study of Knowledge Management Pattern in Supply Chain Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Exploration of Evolution of Knowledge Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores evolution of the notion of knowledge network for the first time. Firstly, the evolution of the concept of knowledge network is discussed from "network of scientific papers" by Price to Brooks' "knowledge map", "knowledge gene" and "knowledge network". Secondly, various concepts in different research viewpoints and research background in the evolution of the concept of knowledge network are analyzed. Four theories are concluded as "theory of map", "theory of gene", "theory of network" and "theory of knowledge forms" from the aspect of discipline of science. Finely, philosophical rules of the concept evolution of knowledge network are expounded.

articleTitle: The Strategic Role of Innovative Capabilities in the Relationship among Social Capital, Knowledge Sharing and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To explore the relationships among social capital, innovative capabilities, knowledge sharing and firm performance, Chinese enterprises participated in this investigation. We found that social capital influenced innovative capabilities, while innovative capabilities influenced knowledge sharing and firm performance positively. Besides, knowledge sharing influenced firm performance positively. And social capital also had a direct influence on knowledge sharing. As anticipated, the intervening effect of innovative capabilities between social capital and knowledge sharing and firm performance was significant. Implications, limitations and future research directions for the study are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Influential Factors and Marginal Price Role of Geographically Weighted Regression Model-Based Urban Residential Land Price
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper is to reveal influential factors and the marginal role of the urban residential land price in order to provide guidance for making policies of scientific urban land use by GWR (geographically weighted regression) model, and then displays the spatial distribution of the marginal role of factors by GIS(geographic information system) drawing tools. As shown by research results, the marginal role of metro sites, commercial outlets, water and greenbelt-landscape has a conspicuous feature of non-stationarity in the research area, while other factor have an inconspicuous feature of non-stationarity. FAR (floor area ratio) has the biggest marginal value-added ability for urban residential land prices compared with other factors. It is concluded that urban residents focus more on the convenient and comfort of houses because of their strong preferences to rapid transportation, business services and conditions of the natural landscape in Nanjing city, which have conspicuous influential feature of localization compared with FAR et al.. ARCGIS, with a good image output visualization technology, can quickly guide us in the control of the main specific block planning to promote scientific management over urban land.

articleTitle: Multiple-Cases and Bibliometric Research on Management Fashion's Dissemination in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies management fashion's dissemination in China by multiple-cases and bibliometric methods. The research shows that management fashion's consumer structure is correlated with its dissemination curve. And the popular curve in recent China is close to a bell shape. Generally, Chinese scholars introduced management techniques into China as triggers and turn them into management fashions, which are characterized by high rationality in the early course of dissemination. Unlike Western countries, prevalent management fashions in China declined earlier and more rapidly. Though it is not inevitable that the management fashions in Western countries should become fashionable in China promptly, we must guard rushing into mass action and scholars must avoid blind introduction to promote the development of Chinese management knowledge.

articleTitle: A Decomposition Analysis on Influencing Factors of Energy Consumption in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Decomposition analysis has been popular in the study on influencing factors of energy consumption. This paper takes a quantitative analysis on factors which affect energy consumption in China during 1980-2006 based on logarithmic mean Divisia index (LMDI), and examines the factors driving the changes in energy consumption. The research shows the improvement of energy efficiency decreased energy consumption, In addition, the change of industry structure and population exhibit positive effect to the energy consumption increase. According to research, the author suggests energy consumption reduction strategies should aim at accelerate technological innovation and industrial structural adjustments, reform the energy pricing mechanism and perfect energy conservation management system.

articleTitle: An Integrity Control Model for Operating System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the integrity protect policy of secure operating system. A method to determine the integrity level of the users, processes and data was given. A way using roles to manage the integrity level of users according to their responsibilities was brought up. An integrity control model was proposed with its integrity axiom, model element, define of state system, setting of system and rules for states translation. The correctness of given model is proved.

articleTitle: A Comparative Research of Organizational Citizenship Behavior's Influencing Factors between Standard Employing and Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment has been coming an important method for organization to increase its flexible ability. Especial the nonstandard employing knowledge workers have been the vital part of organization's core competition. Nonstandard employing knowledge workers have different features and working context comparing with standard employing knowledge workers, and there are different factors to influence their Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB). However there is little research in this issue. This research explores main factors to influence OCB of nonstandard employing knowledge workers, and compare the influencing factors' difference between standard employing and nonstandard employing knowledge workers.

articleTitle: Building Materials' Optimization Based on Fuzzy Pattern-Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The conventional tiers analysis seems to be insufficient and imprecise to capture the importance of building materials' optimization. This paper aims at applying the comprehensive evaluation system in new economic village building materials, and makes the influence factors which are neither clear defined nor easily quantitative being quantification, then make a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to get their sort orders. Here a fuzzy pattern recognition model has been used to calculate the membership grade and its membership function then make comprehensive evaluation sequencing. Finally, an example of sorting three pro-environment village building materials is used to illustrate the proposed approach. The conclusion is that of establishing an optimization method, and confirms that is effective in evaluating new economic village building materials.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Customer-Orientation of NPOs and Performance - Intermediary Role of Service Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abundant researches focus on the relationship between the customer-orientation of enterprises and the performance. However, only a few discuss the effects of the customer-orientation of non-profit organizations (NPOs) on the performance. As for the intervening variables between the customer-orientation of NPOs and performance, scarcely any literature is available around the world. By reviewing and concluding the previous studies, this essay reveals that the customer-orientation of NPOs has positive effects on the performance, and that the service innovation is an important variable between customer-orientation and performance. Moreover, this essay utilizes the survey statistics of the NPOs in Zhejiang Province in structural equation modeling (SEM), and verifies the positive effects that the customer-orientation of NPOs have on the organizational performance and the intermediary role of service innovation between customer-orientation and performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Intangible Assets of University Based on EAHP Models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the arrival of knowledge economy era, intangible assets reveal more irreplaceable value than tangible assets. Since universities do not have a clear understanding of their own intangible assets, this kind of assets are lack of effective management and thus can not play their proper roles sufficiently. The paper first defines the connotation and constitutes of intangible assets of university, and builds up the evaluation index system for them, and then evaluates the university intangible assets status by using extension of analytic hierarchy process (EAHP), in order to obtain the enlightenment about managing, developing and utilizing university intangible assets.

articleTitle: Mobile Service: An Empirical Study of the Behavior of 2/2.5G and 3G Subscribers and Implications to Roll-Out of WiMAX Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research studies users' adoption process of WiMAX. This process cannot be viewed in isolation and must consider the effect of co-existing telecommunication networks and a highly saturated market. WiMAX success would involve getting existing mobile subscribers to switch over to WiMAX. Hence, 2/2.5G and 3G subscribers are used separately as subjects of investigation because they are likely to form the subscriber-base of WiMAX's early market and mainstream market respectively. 2/2.5G and 3G subscribers view mobile service and cost differently, hence resulting in differ in view about WiMAX. This study also shows the importance of killer applications and peer influence in the adoption process.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Lead Time in MRP System: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we first present an analytical example of MRP system when lead time is given full consideration principally, and consider the importance measures of lead times in system employing one fact at a time (OAT) approach subsequently. As the main result we obtain the expressions of importance indices of lead times. The result implies that decision makers or manufacturers should pay more attention to reducing the lead times of higher level items to reduce risk and cost in production inventory process.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Model on Concession Term for BOT Project Based on Profitable Operational Period
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is necessary for the government to determine a profitable operational period according to the building cost for BOT project and transfer one part of profitable operational period as the concession term to the project company. On the basis of game theory, this paper proposes a model to describe the competition between the government and the project company. The optimal strategies for them are discussed respectively by solving the game model. The obtained results can provide them with a decision-making support for BOT project.

articleTitle: Application of CYCLONE in the Optimization of Top-Down Earthwork Construction Machine Arrangement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are many difficulties in top-down earthwork construction, such as great difficulty in excavation, long time in construction and the diversity and complexity in arranging machine, etc. Cyclic operation network (CYCLONE) apply queueing theory and simulation technique to network planning technique, through the simulation of cyclic construction process and stochastic process, provide complete decision-making for cyclic construction process. It is acceptable for the analysis and resource optimization of cyclic construction process. This paper grasps the key factors in performing top-down earthwork construction, applies CYCLONE in the process. Subject to the characteristics and corresponding construction process of top-down earthwork construction, nodes with different type and functions were set to fulfill the different tasks in simulation, and then reasonable CYCLONE was build. At last computer simulation technique was used to simulate the whole construction process. And different simulation result for different machine arrangement plan was got. By the analysis of different simulation result, we can make choice of the best machine arrangement plan. This method is helpful for the construction organization planning of top-down earthwork project.

articleTitle: Study of Supply Chain Integration Process Based on Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reviewed the progress of research on supply chain integration, and analyzed the shortage of it. It is found that supply chain integration process is process of product value added, process of value chain formed and improved. Also a supply chain integration process mode was build in which have the characteristics of cross-organization integration, and divide the process into five stages to study and analyze. Finally, through case study the mode is proved feasibility and reality.

articleTitle: Bayesian Filtering for Markov Switching Stochastic Volatility Model with Heavy Tails
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we study the Markov switching stochastic volatility model with heavy-tails and its applications to capture changes in volatility which is caused by economic forces, market events and so on. Because there are two hidden levels of the latent variable in the model and the state space of the model has a nonlinear structure, it's difficult to get the analytical solution of the model. In the Bayesian framework we present an efficient auxiliary particle filtering algorithm to filter the hidden states and estimate the parameters. Moreover, we focus on the effect of heavy tails. Simulation demonstrates the performance APF algorithm applied to MSSV-t model compared to the basic MSSV model. Additionally, we apply the model to a real financial time series: the SSE composite index and show its power to distinguish volatility regimes and to improve the estimation precision.

articleTitle: Research on Implement Method of Eco-Environment Evaluation and Forewarning System of Mining Based on WebService
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To evaluate and forewarn the impact on ecological environment variations caused by exploitation activities in mining area, fundamental mining database, models database, criterions database and cases database were constructed in the prior period. On that basis, a kind of solution of mining eco-environment evaluation and forewarning system based on Web Service was explored. Information was shared and many services were provided for decision because SOA was applied in the system. Asynchronous call and partial refresh function were implemented with Ajax technique. Therefore, the efficiency of the system was improved. Application of implies data access and information exchange between service interfaces and internal components were completed by applying XML technology. Based on the result data returned by services, tendency charts and thematic maps were drawn on Web Chart control and map control. As a result, development trend and spatial distribution pattern of ecological environment variations were represented intuitively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A New Small Sample Method for Inference of the Characteristic Parameter about Explosive Devices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Context-Aware Approach for Personalized Information Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Personalized information service (PIS) aims at improving the information retrieval process by taking into account the particular interests of individual users. However, not all user preferences are relevant in all situations. It is well known that human preferences are complex, multiple, heterogeneous, changing, even contradictory, and should be understood in context with the user goals and tasks at hand. Therefore, a context-aware approach is proposed to improve PIS quality. In this paper, after the requirements of PIS are analyzed, the context aware PIS process is put forward, and the keys to realize such a process are presented in details. An experiment study is conducted to verify the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Supplier Selection of Tourism Supply Chain Based on Information Entropy and Matter-Element Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tourism supply chain management (TSCM) has emerged as an important area in tourism research, and is attracting increasing attention from both the academic and practitioner communities. In TSCM, supplier selection and evaluation is a key phase. Based on the review of relevant literatures, a supplier evaluation index system was constructed in accordance with the features of tourism supply chain (TSC), and an entropy-weighted extension matter-element model for the comprehensive evaluation of supplier was also built according to matter-element model, extension method and theory of correlation function in this paper. By calculating entropy weight and comprehensive correlative degree, multi-index evaluation is boiled down to single-objective decision, and precise numerical rating result is given. This model is applied to the supplier selection process of a certain tour operator company, and the alternative suppliers are sequenced, so as to choose the optimal and suboptimal suppliers. The research shows that entropy-weighted extension matter-element model is characterize by easy operation, clear practical significance and precise evaluation results, which can be well applied to supplier selection of TSC.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Pavement Surface Rainwater on Groundwater Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, the effect of pavement surface runoff on roadside water resources has aroused widespread attention. According to the research project of "Study on the key drainage technology of down-traversing crossroad in North China Plain area", the paper investigates the climate, geology, and hydro-geology of the plain areas of north China, analyses their characteristic as low water table, good soil permeability, small and concentrated rainfall, deep drinking water well, and so on, discusses the main contamination, primary treatment methods and treatment mechanism of pavement surface runoff, soil self-purification and its effect and the quality standard of filtered rainwater, then puts forward the filtration well to collect surface runoff which can depends on soil self-purification function to filter. The influx water supplies to groundwater resource directly. The roadside water quality meets the requirement of existing standard and has not bad impact to groundwater quality according to the results of the project practice and site tests. The adopted design can reduce the average filled height of embankment and cost effectively, realize the sustainable development aim of highway construction.

articleTitle: Personalized User-Query Semantic Clustering Using Search Click Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of query's semantic ambiguity, search process of general SE can not meet the personalized demand of users concerning personal interests and professional backgrounds. To resolve this problem, a new personalized user-query semantic clustering approach is proposed in this paper. The search engine user logs are valuable resources which obtain the rich history information of user access records which reflect the user's interests and domain knowledge. For every specific user, we get three semantic relationships between user-query and their search click information, such as query contents, click sequence and selected documents. In this way, user-query semantic similarity can be calculated using search click information, then user-query can be clustered and disambiguated based on user's interests. Through the personalized query clustering to guide topic crawling, you can concentrate on more in-depth in the user's interesting field.

articleTitle: Modeling of Fragmentation in the Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study develops a self recruiting-subletting cost indifference point model to explain the fragmentation in the structure of the construction industry. Although a high proportion of small firms in the construction industry has be criticized as it prevents the exploitation of economies of scale, the self recruiting-subletting cost indifference point model theoretically proposes that subletting is usually profitable for construction firms; thus the size distribution of the construction industry should skewed towards small firms.

articleTitle: The Digital TV User Behavior Information Gathering System Based on the TS Stream of MPEG-2 System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the coming age of digital TV, new characteristics of digital TV have led to the feasibility to analyze the users' behavior. In this paper, we present the overall structure of this information gathering system based on MPEG-2. Also introduced is the specific technical description of this system.

articleTitle: Enterprise Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Worker's Effectiveness Research: Based on Contract and Embeddedness Theoretical Views
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment, special the nonstandard employing knowledge workers, has been coming an important method for organization to increase its flexible ability and competitive ability. However present literature show confusing results about its effectiveness, some show good effectiveness, and some show bad. Firstly this paper analyzes the nonstandard employing knowledge workers' effectiveness from labor contract and social embeddedness theories, and then divides nonstandard employment into four models based on these two theoretic views, finally test the effectiveness different among models by empirical research. The research show the effectiveness of nonstandard employing knowledge workers are various, the labor contract maturity and embeddedness degree into working organizational network are vital impacting views.

articleTitle: Pilot-Scale Modified Anaerobic Baffled Reaction (MABR) in Treatment of Sewage
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A pilot-scale modified anerobic baffled reactor (opposite folded plate anaerobic reactor) was designed and applied it to treat low concentration sewage by our research group. All the trials lasted 12 months, the results indicated that the start-up phase lasted 55 days and the optimal HRT was 6h. At this HRT with temperature 25 plusmn 2degC, the COD, TP and TN removal rates were 78.58%, 35.15%, 39.17%, respectively. Furthermore, the optimal anaerobic section rate was 45% ~ 65%, while the optimal influent COD concentration was 150 ~ 800 mg/L. sludge retention time (SRT) would be controlled under 105 days. When the temperature decreased to (7 plusmn 1)degC and the HRT was given as 6 h, the removal rates of COD, TP and TN were 64.37%, 20.72%, 23.65% respectively. The performance of trials indicated that the application of this proposed MABR to treat low concentration sewage is feasible at low temperature in North China. According to the results of trials, the efficiency of MABR in treatment of low concentration sewage could be owed to high efficient mass-transfer and two-double integrated staged multiphase anaerobe (TSMPA).

articleTitle: Joining an E-Marketplace: The Role of Resource and Structural Dependence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies the resource dependence theory to investigate a focal firm's decision on whether or not to join a particular e-marketplace. Specifically, this study distinguishes two types of interdependences-resource dependence and structural dependence and argues that these two types of dependences have both separate and joint positive effects on a firm's joining decision. The empirical findings from 19 e-marketplaces support our hypotheses.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Modeling of SARS Transmission - A Case Study of Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering three major ways of SARS diffusion in hospitals, families, and public communities, a conceptual and mathematic model of system dynamics for simulating mechanism of SARS spread and control is designed. A simulation software system, called STELLA, is employed to implement the model of system dynamics of SARS in Hebei province, China. The parameters of the model of system dynamics are assigned as varied values according to the real situations and the SARS related statistical data. The experiment results show there are similar characteristics of the new report SARS cases and accumulative cases per day between data produced by simulation and by individual based investigation. Sensitive analyses of onset-to-hospitalization interval and effective quarantine are carried out, and the shortening of onset-to-hospitalization interval, it proves, should be given the highest priority. In addition, the experimental results also show that the SARS situation in Hebei province is mostly affected by the import of SARS cases from near regions such as Beijing, Tianjing, Shan Xi province, and the inner Mongolia autonomous region because there is a great flow in population among the regions in 2003.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis Methods for Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The indexes system for electricity market is the basement for quantitative analysis of electricity market. It is very important to induce math tools to deal with these indexes. This paper will research on the quantitative analysis methods for electricity market, which is of significant meaning for the electricity market. It is a necessary mathematical tool helping the market supervisors to make decisions. This paper first put forward the quantitative analysis process, then introduce the vary mathematical models. At last, examples of the precaution indices system are presented in the paper to illustrate the qualitative analysis process, and the applications of many multi-analysis models, such as cluster, factor analysis, covariance analysis, etc., are introduced to explain the quantitative analysis process. Examples and actual application for an electricity market in China are presented throughout the paper to illustrate the ideas.

articleTitle: Study of Benchmarking Evaluation of Power Supply Companys' Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the current operation of China's power supply companies, a performance evaluation index system is established in this paper. Then, based on the concept of benchmarking and radar-graph method, an applicable bench-marking model for power supply company service is developed. With the data gathered from China Yunnan province grid company, the suggested model is demonstrated to be an efficient method which enables power supply companies to directionally find shortfalls in their service performance and take remedial measures.

articleTitle: Video Multicast over Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Using Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to high mobility, highly dynamic topology and unreliable communication medium, performing video multicast over a mobile ad hoc network (MANET) is a challenging task. In this paper, a robust multiple tree multicast routing (RMTMR) protocol for MANETs is proposed to ensure robust and efficient video multicast against high node mobility. RMTMR employ a practical stochastic upstream nodes assignment process based upon mobility-prediction to build multiple trees performing delivery of coded video packets encoded by network coding. Moreover, by applying such approach, both of mobility-aware video multicast and latency-aware one can be achieved. Extensive simulation results shows that such protocol perform well in terms of quality, normalized packet forwarding efficiency and startup delay even in the high speed scenario.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mobile Government's Influences on Government Managements
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of the background and applications of mobile government (MG), this paper studied the influences of MG on government managements and made some propositions on the development of MG, including perfecting MG relevant laws, regulations and standards, establishing information security system of MG, reengineering and optimizing the administrative business processes, and strengthening the evaluation of MG.

articleTitle: Multi-Player Game of Sports Event Reputation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Game theory is one of the primary theoretical tools in studying a system that contains several interest parties. By introducing game theory into the study of sports event reputation, we aim to regulate the rule making process to guarantee the reputation of sports events. First a game model is formulated to incorporate the various factors that influence sports event reputation. Further analysis reveals whether parties involved choose to obey or violate game rules depends largely on how much they can profit from the chosen behavior. We believe that if due consideration is given to the cost effect relation in shaping competition rules, then participants' impulse to break the rules will be fundamentally reduced, hence ensure sports event reputation.

articleTitle: SOM Clustering Analysis for Telecommunication Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A method for clustering complex, multivariate data, Kohonen self-organizing maps (SOMs), is suggested. The method is applied to telecommunications customer segmentation on real data from a telecom service provider. Customers were classified into 7 groups. The characteristics of each group are deeply analyzed in order to draw a clear outline of each group.

articleTitle: Study on the Value Chain Construct of the Cyclic Utilization of Waste Packages
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Household garbage such as waste packages not only pollutes environment, but also wastes resources. Although the possession of per capita resource in China is limited, there are a plenty of feasible resources in waste packages which should be utilized cyclically. Based on the successful experience in recycling the beer bottles, a value chain of the cyclic utilization of waste packages can be constructed. The following two problems should be solved: setting up united standards for packages and designing a recycling logistic system.

articleTitle: Research on Building Heating Energy Option of Lhaza and Development Energy Management Tools
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For Tibet, sustainable development requires cheap, secure and environmental-friendly energy supply and use. None of the current energy options, including cow dung, coal, and natural gas, and the current ways of their use for heating could fully meet the needs of growing economy and sustainability requirements. Evolutionary changes in the current energy systems to improve efficiency and reduce greenhouse gas per unit output are the most important first step in the sustainable development.
