The paper firstly analyzed Lhaza's weather conditions and data of the indoor temperature measure in a typical multi-storey residential building in the summer and winter. Then it separately demonstrated the feasibility and desirability of solar energy heating in the building of plateau city from the technical level and economic level. Lastly, from the management level, the paper raises to set up highly efficient management tools between people (users, designers and managers) and the solar energy building, namely, education and training tools, decision-making support tools and decision-making assessment tools. Tibet should continue to develop education and training tools in order to strengthen local people to create awareness of adopting solar energy.

articleTitle: A Study of the Optimal Timing of Land Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the effects of option value of on the investment timing of a real estate firm in the housing market. Based on the model's assumptions and specifications, this paper deduced the option value of land and land development threshold. Further, this paper conducted a comparatively statistic analysis and arrived at some important conclusions. First, there is an inverse relationship between the threshold and land development duration, therefore the developer with smaller land scale is more liable to postpone the project than the bigger firm. Moreover, only if the standard deviate rate of market shock rises to a certain value, more uncertainty will delay investments; when it is smaller, more uncertainty will accelerate the investment instead of delaying the investment.

articleTitle: Evaluating Temporal Change of the Land Intensive Use Level of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land is vitally related to human existence and development. It has being evidently proved that sustainable utilization of land resources is the core problems of sustainable development. Taking Beijing city as a model case, we used the Delphi and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) methods to assess the land intensive use level from 1996 to 2005. By building respective index system of intensive land use, we calculated the intensive use scores of different factors and then the integrated index was deduced by AHP. The results showed that during 1996-2005, the intensive land use level is in improvement, though it is in low level as a whole. The level of land intensive use in Beijing is 0.4743 and the value increased to 0.5881 in 2000 and to 0.7783 in 2005. This also shows that Beijing has the potential ability of intensive land-use. It is concluded that the level of land use should be suit the requirements of economy, the intensive level of land use should be further improved.

articleTitle: The Characteristics of Smoke Spreading of Fires in a Flat Underground Building in Cities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To understand the characteristics of smoke spreading of fires in a flat underground, experimental and numerical researches were conducted. By comparing the results of the experiment and simulations, the conclusions were drawn that when the maximum heat release rate (HRR) is higher than 480 kW in the flat-space building, it only took 10 s to reach a distance 15 m from the fire source, and 100 s to fill up the 964 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> volume of the upper part above 2.0 m height of the flat space, which was mainly due to the heat release rate (HRR). However, the HRR did not have obvious effect on the speed of the smoke propagation along the ceiling. Moreover, the temperature stratified vertically in the distance far from the fire source.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analyzing Early Market Potential and Strategies for Carpooling in China: A Case Study of Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Using Analytic Hierarchy Process Evaluating Collaborative Customer Relationship Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer management concepts developed in the past proved ineffective, as the quality of the data was not enough. The experience has shown that through a new management concept a few companies have been able to avoid the pitfalls of loosing value. The collaborative customer relationship management (CCRM) is a new form of customer management. The concept has been successfully implemented by leaders in the consumer goods sector. How to use the customer relationship management to reduce the enterprise's operating costs. Based on the above problems, the study by consulting the views of experts and scholars and see the related literature was informed of its selection criteria and the application of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) selection criteria and weights. The AHP can provide decision makers with a valuable reference basis. Importantly, the proposed model can provide Taiwan's enterprise management clients a reference material, making it highly applicable for academic and enterprise.

articleTitle: Cointegration Analysis on the Impact of Dollar Exchange Rate Change to International Oil Prices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To study the relationship of the international crude oil spot price and U.S. dollar, we carried on root test and cointegration test on the weekly data of international crude oil spot price and U.S. dollar index from 2002 to 2008, and the results show that there exists equilibrium relationship of long-term negative correlation between international crude oil spot price change and the U.S. dollar index; error correction shows that the dollar index's long-run equilibrium has little effect on short-term fluctuation of international crude oil spot prices; Granger causality test shows that there is a one-way Granger causality between them; impulse response and variance decomposition shows that other factors has a significant effect on the international crude oil spot prices.

articleTitle: The Authentication and Key Agreement Protocol Based on ECC for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, We proposed an efficient authentication and key agreement protocol based on elliptic curve cryptography (ECC). By which user to user, or user to network in the wireless communication system can authenticate one another and agree on a session key. We introduced ECC to the Diffie-Hellman key exchange protocol, and added new authentication scheme using a certificate in the protocol. The use of ECC techniques provide greater security using fewer bits, resulting the protocol which requires significantly less bandwidth, and furthermore, it has lower computational burden and storage requirements on the user side.

articleTitle: Study on Risk Assessment and Management of Landslide Hazard in New Bodong County, Three Gorge Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, considering geological environment and landslide development in New Badong County, 11 representative factors are decided to assess landslide hazard in New Badong County. By using the Artificial Neural Network landslide hazard evaluating model and the advantages of GIS technology in image processing and space-analysis, landslide hazard zonation of New Badong County is compiled. The result of the assessment can be a gist and ensure for the land planning and the emigration project in Badong. And it provides professional base for the landslide hazard risk management of Badong. The risk management system, which is a combination of professional risk control and government decision-making risk management, is proposed. And in this system the preventive professional research, landslide hazard emergency plan, management functions of government and some other key processes are discussed. It provides ideas for the risk management of landslide hazard of Badong County. This system provides an effective way for the landslide hazard risk management of each district in the Reservoir of Three Gorge Project.

articleTitle: Risk Management of Social Public Security Video Surveillance Project Based on Life Cycle Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the characters of social public security video surveillance project in China and creates a life cycle risk management model of social public security video surveillance construction project based on dynamic life cycle risk management theory. With comprehensive analysis and identification to the risk factors of such projects, it provides a basic risk identification table. Finally the paper gives the solutions to the risk of the project by giving the case.

articleTitle: Recognition of Acoustic Emission Signal Based on MAE and Propagation Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of containing several model waveforms, the source rub-impact acoustic emission (AE) signal transmitting in complicated body would cause waveform distortion for varying transmission speed of each model and dispersion effect. It is difficult to distinguish useful AE from complicated mixture singals by traditional detect methods. To avoid the deviation caused by these factors,. A transmission model of AE was established based on modal acoustic emission (MAE) and stochastic process theory, the mathematical expression of multi-modal AE signal was given, a mixed parameter composed of logarithm cepstral coefficients and fractal dimension was presented as the characteristic coefficients of rub-impact AE signal, and the AE recognition system based on improvement Gaussian mixture model was also established. The theory analysis and experiment result show that the system not only can be applied to recognize bursting AE signal, but also continuous signal.

articleTitle: Clustering Based on LLE For Financial Multivariate Time Series
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multivariate time series (MTS) data sets are common in many multimedia, medical, process industry and financial applications such as gesture recognition, video sequence matching, EEG/ECG data analysis or prediction of abnormal situation or trend of stock price. Multivariate time series clustering is an important task in time series data mining. The unique structure of time series makes many traditional clustering methods unable to apply directly. In order to efficiently perform clustering for financial MTS datasets, we present a clustering approach based on locally linear embedding (LLE), which first converts the raw time series data into lower dimension by using LLE algorithm, and then applies a modified kmeans algorithm to the extracted feature vectors. Several experiments on a financial MTS database are performed and the results show the effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: Ruin Probabilities for Markov-Modulated Jump-Diffusion Risk Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to describe the dependent structure in the jump-diffusion risk model in non-life insurance, a Markov-modulated model is considered in this paper. By introducing an external continuous-time Markov process, the classical jump-diffusion risk model is extended to a Markov dependent one, in which the inter-claim time, the claim amount, the premium rate and the volatility of the diffusion process are all regulated by the Markov process. In this case, we obtain a generalized Lundberg's fundamental equation and derive a system of integrodifferential equations of ruin probabilities for Markov-modulated jump-diffusion risk model, which can effectively measure a type of dependent risk.

articleTitle: Overview of Application Research on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-agent technology is one of the main research fields of distributed artificial intelligence. Nowadays, researchers are paying more and more attention to theories and applications of multi-agent. The paper introduces the definition and characteristic of agent and multi-agent, further it summarizes the several main application fields of multi-agent.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for the Vehicle Scheduling Problem in Public Transportation Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The vehicle scheduling problem (VSP) consists in assigning a set of scheduled trips to a set of vehicles in the public transportation, where the relation of every trip is not only cooperation but also competition. This paper analyzes two sorts of optimization models for vehicle scheduling problem in public transportation. The problems of minimizing vehicles' time headway for cooperation network and maximizing the value for competition network are formulated in this presented paper. Also, the departure interval model is presented. The above models are solved by the heuristic algorithms in the presented paper respectively, and the numerical results show that the solutions are more efficient.

articleTitle: Study on the Safety and Disaster-Prevention Signing System of the Subway Based on Site Investigation at Home and Abroad
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The subway has become an important form of transportation in our daily life. And the sign system is a part of the subway engineering, which plays an important role in improving the convenience and the efficiency of emergency dispersion. In the present paper, by site investigation of the subway sign system at home and abroad, such as Busan & Seoul (Korea), Tokyo (Japan), Beijing & Nanjing(China), analysis were made on the subway sign system of the cities mentioned above. On the basis of cognitive psychology and human body engineering, suggestions on the subway sign planning and design were made, which contain subway sign location, the impact of billboards on the signs, the relevance between the sign and the device and so on. The optimization suggestions on subway sign design are proposed to make it functional, systematic, international, concise and humanistic.

articleTitle: Study on Emergency Traffic Organization of Urban Road Traffic System under Abnormal State
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper defined the emergency levels of the abnormal events. After knowing the effects on urban traffic system, it set forth the concept of characteristics and principles of emergency traffic organization. It considers that the virtual work of emergency traffic organization is in order to help the evacuating by transferring the right-of-way from the non-emergency trip to the emergency trip, the right-of-way here is divided into pass-though right, prior-pass right and occupy right. The methods that based on the emergency levels and LOS of road for confirming the right-of-way of emergency trip are put forward innovatively. The methods for emergency traffic organization under abnormal state are put forward both on macroscopical and microcosmic aspects. It tends to study the strategies on the macroscopical aspect and tends to study the techniques on the microcosmic aspect. In the end, there is a forecasting and conceiving of the future development of emergency traffic organization.

articleTitle: Internet Marketing and Innovation Strategies: A Study of Marketing China's Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, the internet marketing has become an important way of marketing agricultural products. China's internet marketing of agricultural products started later until it was tried by China's agricultural products enterprises in 1996. Comparing with the developed countries, China's internet marketing of agricultural products generally has a lower level of development and is still at the initial stage, so there are still many problems. To solve these problems, this paper adopts the methods of induction and systems analysis and has expounded the actuality of China's internet marketing of agricultural products, analyzed the necessities of developing China's internet marketing of agricultural products, and proposed some corresponding innovative strategies about how to develop China's internet marketing of agricultural products. Finally such a conclusion has been reached: As long as we innovate continuously on the strategies of China's internet marketing of agricultural products in accordance with the actual situation of China's agricultural products, fully understand the importance of marketing agricultural products by the internet, and take corresponding measures to resolve current problems of China's internet marketing of agricultural products, then China's internet marketing of agricultural products will develop continuously and healthily, thus promote the development of China's agriculture.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Evaluation Methodology for Radio Spectrum Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The radio spectrum is a key and rare resource, and economic mechanisms have been begin to play an important role in radio spectrum resource management in China., the economic evaluation on radio spectrum applicants will provide an important reference for radio spectrum managers who make decisions based on economic mechanisms. On the basis of the analysis on the economic value of the radio spectrum resource, the economic evaluation indexes and their normalized methods are proposed, moreover, the weights for the economic evaluation indexes are computed based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process. Finally, the application examples are given, which explain how to make use of the methodology to evaluate the spectrum applicants and analyze the economic evaluation results from the different judge matrixes.

articleTitle: Application of Grey LS-SVM in Mid and Long Term Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mid-long term load is affected by many factors, it is difficult to forecast by a single method. This paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of grey forecasting method and least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) respectively, proposes a new forecasting model of grey least squares support vector machine which develops the advantages of accumulation generation in the grey forecasting method, weakens the effect of stochastic disturbing factors in original sequence, strengthens the regularity of data and avoids theoretical defects existing in the grey forecasting model. The simulation results show that this model performs well in generalization ability and forecasting precision.

articleTitle: Organisational-Oriented Service Architecture: Using the Workflow Management Approach to Control Service System Execution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research field "Services Science" deals with the opportunities and challenges arising inside and outside of organizations in service sectors, aiming at the industrialization (global division of labor and automation) of these sectors. This goal can only be reached when the performance know-how an individual needs to execute a task can be language-critically reconstructed and managed with the aid of computers, as is the case with application software. By transforming the performance know-how into a linguistic schema that has been set up according to a human task, this "materialized know-how" -through the linguistic carrierbecomes available like a serviceable tool. Under these circumstances, we could introduce a service abstraction with two types of services (composite and operational) which are controlled by workflow management systems.

articleTitle: Research and Extendable Application of Oligarch Competition Model in Monopolistic Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cournot oligarch competition model is the earliest model that has Nash balanced thought, policy-making question is studied when enterprises pursue maximization of profit in monopolistic market in this model. If enterprises' actions are not at the same time, the order is exogenously assigned, this model becomes famous Stacklberg oligarch competition model. This model is a typical complete information dynamic gambling. This paper carried on compare and research to the two kinds of competition models in pure oligarch vocation, and promoted Stacklberg oligarch competition model to n oligarchs n stages enter some vocation and carried on gambling analysis, extracted its Nash balanced strategy solution, and drew some useful conclusions. The conclusions have certain academic guiding sense and practical application value.

articleTitle: How Offline-To-Online Trust Transference Affect the Foundation of Online Banking Initial Trust: An Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this research is to reveal the mechanisms associated with the initial formation of people's trust in online banking and intention to use the service. And this research fills a research gap by focusing on offline to online trust transfer process, which has received almost no attention. For this, we attempt to understand the effect of three antecedent factors (structural assurance, compatibility and relative advantage) on shaping a customer's initial trust in online banking and usage intention. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of customers' offline banking trust on the initial trust in online banking and its antecedents. The study tests hypothesis by using a sample of 343 users who have available device to use online banking. Results show that offline trust positively influences initial trust in online banking and customers' perceived structural assurance, relative advantage and compatibility of online banking, just as proposed. Thus, offline-to-online trust transfer process should be considered when designing multichannel strategies and attracting customers to use online banking.

articleTitle: Principal Component Method in Analysis of Water Resources Sustainability Influence Factors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analysis and evaluation the capacity of water resources sustainable utilization is one of the important means to understand the development potential of a country or region. In this paper, principal component analysis was applied to quantitative assessment the main influence factors of water resources sustainability in Tianjin, analyzed the principal component scores in the case, and put forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions according the analysis results and realistic situations.

articleTitle: Team Approaches for Agricultural Nonpoint Source Water Pollution Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nonpoint source water pollution, primarily from agricultural sources, is a major cause of water quality impairment. Uncertainty and asymmetric information are the key regulatory difficulties in the control of agricultural NPSP. The main target of this study is to describe a potential incentive scheme that can be applied in limited information situations. Team contracts built upon principal-agent theory are proposed. To handle the incentive problems typical in many principal agent problems, it incorporates peer monitoring to induce the nonpoint sources water pollution to meet their contractual obligations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Construction Concept and Countermeasure of Undergraduate Employment Promotion and Insurance System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: BOT Project Risks Analysis of Guangzhou Logistics Parks Based on the Grid-Fuzzy Borda Number Analytical Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of the development of Guangzhou economy and logistics parks, this paper introduces the BOT project mode of Guangzhou logistics parks. Based on the BOT, this paper analyzes the risks which the Guangzhou logistics parks meet, and designs an evaluation system. And then, through grid method and fuzzy Borda number analytical method, this paper analyzes the BOT project risks of Guangzhou logistics parks based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. The result of practice proves this kind of mode is of science and feasibility.

articleTitle: A Process Material Requirement Improvement Model Based on a Strategy of BOM Disassembly
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The bill of materials (BOM) forms an integral part of material requirement control strategy in the process industries. The process product BOM is divided into a raw material BOM and a packing BOM to allow rapid and manageable separate calculations. Then by discussing the advantages of the basic types of BOM structure, a process BOM constructional model that focuses on the single-layer packing BOM and the Gozintograph-based raw material BOM is designed based on a proposed novel BOM disassembly strategy. Further a new material requirement improvement algorithm for process industries is proposed. Practice shows that the proposed models and algorithms are more targeted and effective, and can be used to solve problems such as the inefficient materials calculation and database data redundancy.

articleTitle: Blind Proxy Signature Scheme Based on Both ECDLP and IFP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After studying blind proxy signature scheme and a group of digital signature schemes based on two hard mathematical problems, a new blind proxy signature scheme based on both elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem and integer factoring problem is proposed and its security is analyzed. The analysis results show that the scheme satisfies all necessary security properties of the proxy signature schemes. Furthermore, the original signer can't confirm the proxy signer's identity from an effective proxy signature. This scheme's capability of anti-attacking is improved evidently comparing with existing blind proxy signature schemes based on one mathematical hard problem.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study of Corporate Financial Performance and Corporate Social Responsibility: Evidence from the Service Industry of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on POL Supply Scheduling Optimization System Based on POEM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the paper, POEM platform and NCL language are introduced. Then the main functions, operation logic and development steps of POL supply scheduling optimization system based on POEM platform are designed. At last, POEM VRP model for POL supply scheduling optimization is designed and the POEM using mode of POL supply scheduling optimization system is discussed.

articleTitle: Research of Neighborhood Design Method Based on Digital Simulation Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the rapid development of computer and digital technique, a neighborhood design method based on GIS and CFD technique is developed in this paper. The method includes suitability evaluation of surface factors by GIS at earlier stage, evaluation of environment factors by CFD model at middle stage, and comprehensive evaluation of environment suitability at last stage. A case of Qingshan depot project of the fourth Wuhan metro line is applied to show the application result of the design method, which is used to verify the method's feasibility and practicality. At the end of the paper, the advantages and disadvantages of the design method are described, which will provide reference for digital study on ecological architectural environment.

articleTitle: The Design of Road-Rail Intermodal Logistics Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Though advantages of the intermodal transportation is considered during logistics park development, the technical integration of various transportation modes and systemic management are not fully emphasized. In this thesis, I will review logistics park development in the world and analyze the construction of logistics park in China, Especially, I will examine the recently planning and designing of Shanghai Zhabei Beijiao Logistics Park, and propose how to construct a road-rail intermodal transportation platform.

articleTitle: Generalized Pareto Distribution Fit to the Risk of Operating Cash Flow - Empirical Evidence from China's Listed Companies of Real Estate
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cash-Flow-at-Risk (CFaR) is important to the finance and investment of companies, and it is a significant factor of the corporate risk management. We use the Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) to model the operating Cash-Flow-at-Risk of real estate listed companies of China. The empirical results show that the GPD outperforms the Normal distribution, allowing actuaries to estimate high quantiles, and providing evaluations of the relative reliability to managers.

articleTitle: The Measurement in Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Measurements for statistical model-Spatial Correlation Function (SCF) are studied. It describes the power density inside a microwave reverberation chamber. The model is extracted from a general complex cavity .The applicability of the model in the conditions is observed vary from non-ideal,multi-moded operation to "over moded".The low-frequency limit is proposed from the studies.The studies of SCF measurements provides useful insights into the physical behavior of the field.

articleTitle: Cost Effective and Sustainable?: Photovoltaic (PV) Rebate Program in Australia
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Australian government has recently announced a renewable energy target (RET) scheme to provide up front payments of $8,000 for around 25,250 households of income less than $100,000 per year installing a 150 watt solar panel system starting on 01 July 2009 using $202 million taxpayers' money. The scheme has not included households' with incomes greater than $100,000, nor developers who produce new houses. Whether the policies are effective and sustainable is arguable. This paper examines policies designed to encourage households to install solar panel system in Australia and demonstrates reasons for supporting developers to build green houses using net present value (NPV) analysis in a case study. The findings suggest that the government should support installation of solar systems by both households and the developers.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on External Influencing Factors of User Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on investigating QZONE users who once had experience of innovation, the paper explains external influencing factors of user innovation performance and existing moderating effects on the relationship between these factors and user innovation performance. Then managerial implications, limitations and future research directions are discussed.

articleTitle: A New Method for Clustering Analysis Based on Pseudo Parallel Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the fact that the conventional clustering algorithm based on the clustering criteria to initialize sensitive and easily to the local extreme, a new method of clustering analysis based on pseudo parallel genetic algorithm is designed. In the proposed PPGA-based clustering analysis method, each category is coded by real numbers, and some illegal chromosomes are repaired by identification and restoration of empty class. Two mutation operators including discrete random mutation operator and optimisation direction mutation operator are designed to balance the local convergence speed and the global convergence performance, which is then combined with migration strategy and insertion strategy. For the purpose of verification and illustration, the proposed PPGA clustering analysis method is compared with K-means clustering algorithm and standard genetic algorithms via a numerical simulation experiment. The experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the new PPGA-based clustering analysis algorithm.

articleTitle: Comparative Advantage Theory and Its Revelation to China's Foreign Trade
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Though comparative advantage theory was born in the nineteen century, its core thought still has been the important theoretic weapon for every country to guide the development of foreign trade and make foreign trade policies. The paper expatriated on the main idea of comparative advantage theory from the three aspects of why, how and what. Secondly, on the background of huge favorable balance between China and America, the paper pointed out the results of America's departure from comparative advantage theory. Finally, through comparing the service trade of Sino-India, the paper opened out China's defects in application of comparative advantage theory. The research was a revelation to us that comparative advantage was of dynamics characteristics, we should both give attention to the present comparative advantages and considerate the future competitive situation to create new comparative advantages. Therefore, facing up to the frequent trade frictions, one side, China should adjust the product structure and regional structure; on the other hand, China should quicken technology innovation in order to increase the value-added and technology content of export products.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evolution of Buyer-Supplier Relationships Based on Interdependence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Management of supplier relationship is the core of supplier chain links. Supplier relationship model is set up based on interdependence between buyer and supplier. Four kinds supplier relationship of advantage relationship, disadvantage relationship, complementation relationship, equal relationship are put forward. Dynamic evolution model of supplier relationship is constructed according to interdependence degree. Management of strategies of four kinds of supplier relationship is put forward. It is expected that the research can help the practice or theory of supplier management.

articleTitle: Study of Open Innovation on Electronic Information Industry in Shenzhen of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper elaborates development and evolution of electronics and information technologies in the region of Shenzhen in recent 20 years. The electronics and information industry, developed on the basis of open innovation, gradually makes Shenzhen a global center of production, manufacture, logistics, R&D of electronic and information products. In this process, electronics and information industry in the region of Shenzhen has experienced a great change from technical introduction, cooperation, imitation to innovative study which is a model of open innovation without borders between enterprises. The paper summarizes experiences of electronics and information technologies on open innovation, studies the problems existing in Shenzhen's electronics and information industry in the context of independent innovation emphasized by Chinese government and discuss the trend of government policies on open innovation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Enterprises' Decision-Supporting System for Foreign Direct Investment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes a theoretical model in enterprises' decision-supporting system for foreign direct investment. The model is divided into three levels, including quantifiable and non-quantifiable factors, as well as static model and dynamic model. It tries to reveal inherent laws and decision processes of foreign direct investment decision making. The model is able to explain the foreign direct investment activities of developed country enterprises and developing country enterprises on logical consistency basis; and it is able to explain the foreign direct investment activities of production enterprises and service enterprise with logical consistency.

articleTitle: Research on Profit Allocation of Supply Chain Based on Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To deal with the feature of various influencing factors of profit allocation, an evaluation method based on grey relational analysis is developed. When this method is used, evaluation index matrix of cooperative enterprise in supply chain is constructed by analysis and statistics of the influencing factors of profit allocation. Then, a judging matrix is established and solved through the calculation of grey relational degree. A weight for each index which affects the profit allocation of supply chain is determined accordingly. Finally, the concrete application of the method is tested by an example. The results indicate that the proposed evaluation method based on grey relational analysis effectively coordinates the profit allocation of supply chain, and is good for the supply chain successful performance; hence, it is reasonable and practical.

articleTitle: How Webpage Background Affect Online Shopping Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research explores how Web page background influences online shopping behavior and differentiations between genders through an online experiment of 192 university students. The results show: (1) Web page background influences online shopping behavior. Under the different Web page background conditions, subjects evaluate the prime features more important and spent more time on browsing the related prime features. They also prefer the products which consistent with the prime features and more purchasing decisions are made consist with the prime features. (2) There is a gender differentiation of how Web page background influences online shopping behavior. Female are more easily affected by Web page background.

articleTitle: Executive Stock Option Pricing and Incentives: Evidence from Asian Option Based on Volatility Estimated by SV-GED Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper develops an executive Asian stock option pricing model based on the volatility estimated by SV-GED model, considering both the features of the volatility of stock return and the abnormal fluctuation of stock price at the expiration date, estimates the parameters of SV-GED model using Markov chain Monte Carlo method, based on Chinese financial index, and compares the value and incentives of executive stock option calculated by the Asian option pricing model based on the volatility estimated by SV-GED model and Black-Scholes stock option model. It shows that SV-GED model has greater veracity in describing the volatility of stock returns; and the value and incentives of the executive stock option evaluated by Asian option pricing model under SV-GED model are larger than those calculated by Black-Scholes stock option model, and the divergence between the two values estimated by two models positively relates to the depth in the money of the option.

articleTitle: Survey and Research on Demand for Business Information Service of Firms in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is crucial for business information service providers to understand the demand motives of major clients, their interest and how they evaluate such services so as to develop services that meets the clients' expectation. In this research, based on questionnaire survey, we try to understand the demand awareness, the information needs, information seeking patterns, evaluation items and purchase intention of enterprises for business information in China. At the end of the study, we also try to make some recommendations for information service providers.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study on Evolution of Financial Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The financial innovation system is a complex adaptive system. Based on complex adaptive system theory, this paper simulates the process of financial innovation of multi-agents in the financial innovation system. The result implies that cooperative innovation and monopolistic competition are more propitious to the evolution of financial innovation system than independent innovation and oligopsony. It is also shown that cooperative innovation can bring on the network emergence of the financial innovation system.

articleTitle: The Interaction Mechanism between Olympics' Venues and Urban System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It has great theoretical and practical significance to explore the interaction mechanism between the Olympics' venues and urban system, within the context of life cycle, to conduct the Games successfully and improve post-Games development of the venues better. With the case of Qingdao Olympic Sailing Center, this paper uses case study as the method, project management theory, diamond theory and industry clusters theory as the basic theories to analyze the measures, ways and basic theories of interaction between the Olympics' venues and urban system previous, during and after the Games. Meanwhile, the conclusion is given that the Olympics' venues spur development of the cities by the relative industries, and urban system makes sure the Olympics' venues will be constructed, operated and developed successfully depending on the relative industries, within the context of life cycle.

articleTitle: The Study of Accessible Design Resources System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Accessible design resources play a significant role in legislation propelled accessible design. Investigations and studies on the resources from international have been done, information have been grouped into five parts, relationships have been found. Thus the Accessible Design Resources System is created, and a model is made to show the three parts: accessible design resources, people and environment, and their interaction relationships. Information of the three parts are discussed. From this model, problems can be put forward for further researches. It will help to understand accessible design better and create high quality and high efficiency accessible design resources. Some of the examples are given.

articleTitle: Research on Prototype Framework of a Multi-Threading Web Crawler for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web crawlers facilitate the search engine's work by following the hyperlinks in Web pages to automatically download a partial snapshot of the Web. Crawling is the initial and also the most important step during the Web searching procedure. A prototype framework of a multi-threading Web crawler for E-commerce application is proposed, in relationship to the former research of search engine. And the design and implementation of a multi-threading Web crawler is described and discussed. The experiment result demonstrates this prototype of Web crawler has better performance.

articleTitle: Study on Event Relationship of the Production Logistics System Based on Automobile Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims at the problems that the production logistics information of automobile manufacturing controls independently. By studying on the events happened among the involving subjects, the paper analyzes the logical relationship and uses professional logistics software to simulate the operation processes and event schedules of the production logistics system. It compares the simulation results got from traditional push mode with pull mode, by event relationship that verifies pull mode can improve bottleneck constraints, increase productivity, optimize inventory management etc, provides reliable basis for achieving integrated management.

articleTitle: The Benefit & Cost from Electronic Waste Recycling: An Empirical Analysis from the Qingdao Recycling Pilot in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines the social and private benefit and cost among consumer, producer and government in the recycling pilot of Qingdao. Results show net social benefit from the recycling pilot as well as net loss to the producer. The improper interest allocation between the main stakeholders explains the failure of the pilot. To keep a balance of incentives to all participants, it is necessary for government to provide compensation to producer in suitable forms. Besides, reasonable design of collective networks will contribute to maximum the net social benefit.

articleTitle: Explore Moderating Influence of Marketing in R&D Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the empirical study on 177 US manufacturing corporations, this paper analyzed the relationship between firms' R&D intensity and corporate financial performance while taking into account the moderating effect of marketing activities. Our finding continually proved a negative relation between R&D intensity and corporate performance, meanwhile, the lagged impact of integrated effect between R&D intensity and advertising intensity for firms' performance. Some significant interaction could also be found that advertising could significantly moderate the relationship between R&D intensity and firms' financial performance.

articleTitle: Study on China Tourism E-Business Based on Direct Marketing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study China tourism e-business, and to speed and improve the tourism e-business in China, based on direct marketing, an advanced marketing theory, since tourism e-business is one kind of direct marketing considered from certain aspects. Compared the actuality of China tourism e-business with direct marketing theory, there are some achievements in China tourism e-business: simply direct marketing and feedback, the unlimited marketing activity at a certain extent, simply two-way information communion, etc. But at the same time, there are some shortcomings in it: the variety of marketing things is not enough, the time and zone of marketing activity are limited, and the veracity and fluency of two-way information communion are not enough. Aim at solving these issues, the paper gave some advice to improve and perfect.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Hindering Factors of Implementation of Green Credit Policy Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Green credit policy as a new standard for bank loan has been known by more and more people. It is not only a new method to avoid bank's risks, but also a new measure to promote energy-saving, emission reduction and sustainable development. More qualitative analysis of green credit has been done. Yet, through the method of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to ensure the weights of each index and setting up membership function by use of statistical methods, this paper evaluates the extent of obstacle of green credit and the size of the impact of various factors by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. This paper has been designed to provide advice for decision-making.

articleTitle: Psychological Capital as Mediator in Relationship among Organizational Socialization, Knowledge Integration and Sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on the role of psychological capital, within the relationship among organizational socialization, knowledge integration and knowledge sharing. We developed a model in which psychological capital mediated between organizational socialization, knowledge integration and knowledge sharing. Our sample comprised 189 employees from south of China. Our research results showed that psychological capital fully mediated between organizational socialization and knowledge sharing as well as knowledge integration. Implicating for the theory and practice of results are discussed, and future research directions offered.

articleTitle: A Study of CEO Management Philosophy and Corporate Governance - Variation of Executive Compensation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to past empirical studies, the board of director has the function of increasing firm value. However, in Taiwan, where family control is the rule, the board does not play an effective monitoring role. We suggest that in this type of environment, CEO's honesty is the foundation of effective corporate governance. In this study, we develop a proxy variable to represent the CEO's management philosophy (MP) by calculating the ratio of executive compensation divided by the net income of the firm. Then, we use the variation in this ratio to evaluate the CEO's MP. If the ratio is less than zero, it means that the CEO is not only benefiting the stakeholder, but also him/herself. In contrast, if the ratio is more than zero, it means that CEO is primarily benefiting him/herself from taking advantage of the stakeholder. The aim of this paper is to investigate the relationship between MP and firm performance. We find that a decrease in MP will increase firm value. In addition, to evaluate conflict of interest, we also measure the impact of having bankers on the board of directors on firm value. The results show that the presence of bankers on boards does not improve the board's firm monitoring. Our results confirm that bankers on boards does however, offer protection to creditor faced with the dilemma of being both stockholder and creditor.

articleTitle: A Study on Service Positioning Based on Hotelling Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the strategy of service positioning of a potential entrant of the market within the Hotelling spatial competition model. It is shown that the entrant's service position in a two-stage game can be achieved from minimum differentiation and maximum differentiation, depending on the strength of the cooperation and competition. The effect of the cost differentiation on the entrant's service positioning is also analyzed.

articleTitle: To Prove Landen Transformation Based on Solution of Asymmetrical Coplanar Strips
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The distributed capacitance and characteristic impedance of asymmetrical coplanar strips (ACPS) and its complementary structure asymmetrical coplanar waveguide (ACPW) are important parameters to represent their peculiarities. In terms of linear fraction mapping, image theory and conformal transformation, ACPS is transformed to symmetrical coplanar strips (SCPS), and the exact solutions of its distributed capacitance and characteristic impedance are obtained. Based on the results, famous Landen transformation is proved easily.

articleTitle: Coordinating Three-Level Supply Chain with the Combination of a Quantity Discount Contract and a Revenue Sharing Contract
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the coordination problem of a three-level supply chain which consisted of a manufacturer, a distributor and a retailer. Using a quantity discount contract and a revenue sharing contract, we derived conditions under which the three-level supply chain can be coordinated so that the maximal potential profit is realized. By adjusting the parameters of the contracts, the profit of the supply chain can be arbitrarily divided among the manufacturer, the distributor and the retailer. The validity of the contracts is illustrated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Similarity and Disparity of China's Home Appliances' Diffusion Trajectory in Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Washing machine, refrigerator and color TV set, representing China's traditional home appliances, have got rapid diffusion in urban area with the continual economic development, and information of similarity and disparity of their diffusion trajectory and potential space is significant for domestic producers to make and adjust their strategy for more market share. Using Simple Logistic Growth Model and Logistic Growth Model within an Dynamic Carrying Capacity, this research forecasted home appliance's diffusion trajectory of urban area over the period 1981-2006 by data of quantity of per 100 households owned. The analytical results indicate that the second model is a useful one to forecast home appliances' diffusion trajectory because its estimated results are statistical significant and fit the actual situation. Based on the comparison of their diffusion' similarity and disparity, different innovation strategy for producers was suggested.

articleTitle: HGA-Based MES Dynamic Scheduling in a Complex Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Scheduling for manufacturing execution system (MES) is an important section of the overall running of the whole manufacturing system. Since MES is a bridge which links the upper planning system of the enterprise and the control system of the shop floor, various kinds of the information with different characteristics flow through the system. As a result, MES scheduling in this dynamic complex information environment becomes an important issue. Innovative and balanced perspectives of MES dynamic scheduling are discussed in this paper, and several achieved results and current developments are described. Firstly, the information environment of the MES and its effect on MES scheduling are analyzed. Then, the time decomposition-based MES dynamic scheduling strategy taking the balance of scheduling and execution into consideration is proposed. Moreover, a hybrid genetic algorithm-based dynamic scheduling framework is presented and several modified hybrid genetic algorithms (HGA) are developed. Satisfactory results are drawn from experiments and short comparative analysis about them is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: The Application of DEA Model in Predicting Corporate Financial Risks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies data mining technique and the DEA model to a sample of 87 ST listed companies in the securities market in China and 174 matching normal companies, with a view to identifying the relationship between the relevant variables and corporate financial risks. The research result indicates that asset-liability ratio, the rate of the current liability and the growth rate of operating income among others, are the greatest contributors to corporate financial risks and that the efficiency of the company varies in accordance with the varying macro-economic situations.

articleTitle: Inventory Control with Return Policy Under Conditional Value-at-Risk Criterion
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The classical risk-neutral newsvendor problem is to decide the order quantity to maximize the one period expected profit under a given demand distribution. In this paper, we consider a risk-averse newsvendor problem with return policy under the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) criterion. Unlike the traditional research, we don't use CVaR as the single decision criterion because it only consider the worst outcomes, while we choose the combination of the expected profit and CVaR as the objective function. Such a joint objective reflects the desire of the risk-averse retailer to maximize the profit and the desire to minimize the downside risk of his profit. Finally under the joint framework, we get the explicit form of the optimal inventory level.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Industrial B2B Websites' Profit-Making Pattern
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-commerce profit-making pattern is an operating mechanism that reflects the flow of products, services and information as well as the value creation process through e-market. Profit-making pattern could be briefly summarized into three basic composition elements-value creation, profit object and profit source. Based on these three basic composition elements, the paper analyzed the profit-making pattern of industrial B2B websites, and summarized three problems. To solve these problems, the paper put forward the improving countermeasures.

articleTitle: Research on Red Tide Warning and Emergency Disposal Technologies of Qingdao Olympic Sailing Competition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As red tide was one of global marine disasters, its monitoring and warning has been a hot topic research in recent years. In this paper, the author described red tide monitoring, warning, emergency disposal technologies, and discussed the construction of early warning system. The article described the warning system application in 2008 Qingdao Olympic sailing competition, providing an application example for early warning and forecasting of red tide.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Urban Reclaimed Water Network Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reclaimed water network differs from the drinking water network in many aspects and this sets a higher requirement for management. According to the practical situation of the reclaimed water network in Tianjin, the urban reclaimed water network management system based on ArcGIS Server is proposed. This system centers on one complete geographical database of reclaimed water network which is designed and constructed first of all. In the database, the potential data for management can be mined through all kinds of function of the system. This can not only simplify the daily work of all departments in the reclaimed water company but also provide technical support for manager to make decision. This system has been used formally in Tianjin reclaimed water company and works very well.

articleTitle: A Study on the Stability of Telecommunications Industry Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The stability of telecommunications industry ecosystem is very important. And the enhancement about resistance capability and recovery capacity is the first prerequisite that can guarantee the telecommunications industry ecosystem healthily develop in the complex environment. The paper introduces the expressiveness and character about the stability of telecommunications industry ecosystem. Besides, the paper also analyzes these factors which influence the stability of the telecommunications industry ecosystem from three different levels. Then base on the redundancy theory, the paper shows the relation of the structure and stability of telecommunications industry ecosystem. Finally the paper gives some strategies to enhance the stability of the telecommunications industry ecosystem.

articleTitle: Urban Residential Suburbanization in Yangtze River Delta Areas of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban residential suburbanization is a social issue which related to the country's stability, social development, and the immediate interests of ordinary people. In the background of our country which has such an accelerated development of urbanization, discussing this issue is with the urgency and necessity. This article attempted to propose some suitable strategies by observing the phenomenon, doing comparative analysis and carrying out questionnaire surveys. We hope our research can contribute to the development of Chinese urban residential suburbanization.

articleTitle: Measurement and MIS of House Water Meter Based on Button TM Card
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an house water meter net system which can offer service in city and country area. 1-wire bus TM (touch memory) card was adopted as meter's prepayment data memory to build up a MIS (Management Information System). Hardware design, low power loss design and info security design of meter controller were discussed. The study indicates that optimizing on the info security of memory card and on the action credibility of electromechanical system will play great role in improving house water meter's performance in measure precision, info security, reliability and battery longevity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Preventive Effect of Capital Structure on Moral Hazard: A Case Study of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Scenario Planning and Strategic Analysis ofthe Online Music Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Distribution of Net Operating Cash-Flow-at-Risk: The Dynamic Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adopting the basic principles of the comparables approach to measuring Cash-Flow-at-Risk, this paper examines the operating CFaR of Chinese non-financial listed firms with a Dynamic Panel Data estimation based on the comparable industry clusters and the economic determinants of the operating cash flow. The empirical structural functions of the net operating cash flow and the empirical distributions of CFaR are achieved, which provide a solid basis for cash flow risk management. The results show that the representative firm in the comparable industry cluster of construction and real estate industries is exposed to higher operating CFaR than that in the largely monopoly-dominated industry cluster of mining, transport and storage, and utilities industries, while the traditional manufacturing industry shows moderate operating CFaR exposure as compared with the above two industry clusters.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Conceptual Model of Producer Service Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Pricing Exchangeable Bonds Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper represents exchangeable bond, the new financial tool in Chinese market, pricing method based on the Monte Carlo method. We design a real case of exchangeable bond terms and pricing it based on the Monte Carlo algorithm.

articleTitle: The Study of Assessment Method of Market Potential of Emerging Technology Products
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many researchers have become to do the study of the assessment of future market potential of emerging technologies or products, and it has been one of the research hotspot in the field of MOT, while there're still not convincing methods that can complete the systematic analysis from the research results. This study proposes to present a systematic analysis method that combing the subjective and objective methods of market potential assessment and analyzing the matching up of the technology supply and market requirements, and this is expected to be the comprehensive assess method and with great practical value.

articleTitle: Study on Project Schedule Risk Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of modern project, project schedule management are influenced by lots of factors, such as delays and reworks. They also increase project schedule risk. Tradition project management methods can not guarantee project performance because they don't consider integrity, dynamism and nonlinearity of project. On basis of analyzing the project process flow, the paper applies System Dynamics to establishing the simulation model of project schedule which has considered the influences of quality and rework. Through qualitative and quantitative analysis, the results of the case indicate the model can give another insight to manage and control project schedule risk for project managers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comprehensive Evaluation and Prevention of Urban Rail Transit Operation on Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Signalling and Price Discovery in Initial Public Offerings: Evidence From the Alteration of Pricing Mechanism in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate whether the market-driven reform in pricing mechanism of IPOs has improve the price discovery efficiency in China. Using a new dataset of 403 IPOs, from the perspective of signalling hypothesis and the market function of price discovery in the short term and long term, we find a significant positive relationship between the degree of underpricing in bookbuilding IPOs and the buy-and-hold risk discovered by the market in both the short term and the long term. However, there is no such evidence for non-bookbuilding IPOs. Additionally, the empirical evidence on signalling hypothesis is mixed. The market-driven reforms on pricing IPOs improve the market ability in both pricing and discovering the value of IPOs.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Knowledge-Intensive Business Services within Cluster Innovation Systems: Types, Roles and Its Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Machinery Fault Diagnosis System Based on Fuzzy Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A fuzzy neural network fault diagnosis fault model, which is set up by fusing fuzzy Classification and traditional neural network, is applied to fault diagnosis of mine fan. In order to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm, the simulation model based on fuzzy neural network has been set up in the MATLAB environment. Simulation results show that the performance of fuzzy neural network is superior to traditional BP network.

articleTitle: The Summary of Methodology and Measurement Methods in City Operations and Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, city operations and development forms an important theme in research on city science. Many scholars study the city lifeline situation in different ways in order to evaluate the city's ability for sustainable development and eventually guide the structural transformation of city's economy and society in China. In our research, 11 different kinds of methods as to city operations and development are proposed and analyzed. In the end of this article, prospects and trends of research on city operations and development are discussed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Reflections on the Stages and Features of Knowledge Transfer Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Case-Based Reasoning Approach of Organizing Enterprise Dynamic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A case-based reasoning approach for enterprise dynamic alliance organization is studied in this paper. We emphasize on choosing partners according to product demands and history records instead of large indicators' value evaluated by different algorithms. A way of calculating the similarity degree based on grey-relational theory and fuzzy-set theory is put forward. Thus, similar cases can be procured easily and accurately. The way of establishing case base and detailed algorithm is discussed.

articleTitle: A DEA Approach for Eco-Efficiency Analysis with Categorical Variable
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this paper is to address a typical eco-efficiency analysis problem, in which undesirable outputs and categorical variables should be considered simultaneously. By analyzing the impacts of categorical variables on decision making units' (DMU) desirable and undesirable outputs, a modified DEA (Data Envelopment Analysis) model is proposed. In the proposed model, a new approach of defining a reference set is developed. Based on the proposed model, the efficient input/output targets for DMU managers to improve DMUs' efficiencies are also provided. A Chinese city case is employed to illustrate the proposed model.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Business Process of 4PL Based on GSPN
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Business process reengineering (BPR) of supply chain is a most important approach to improve the supply chain competency. Modeling and analysis of the business process performance is both the base of BRP and a hot spot of process reengineering in the last few years. Petri net becomes a popular business process modeling tool as it has both graphic description languages for model and strict mathematical definitions. This paper firstly describes the definition of generalized stochastic Petri net and the performance analysis process of 4PL with it, and then a practical calculation is presented to show the practicality and effectiveness of this methodology.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Web Toolkit for Various Mass Customization Users
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mass customization (MC) requires a toolkit to quickly and precisely transfer customer demand information to each production stage of the company and better satisfy customer requirements. But, the existing Web toolkits in MC environments, also known as configurators, choice boards, customer-company interaction systems cannot be commonly used in different kinds of companies or different customization levels of a company. In addition, they may not provide different customization information for different customers or provide information for company decisions intelligently. Because of the shortcomings of those toolkits, the toolkit presented in this paper put forward a customization interaction module to adapt different enterprises, which means different companies can select different customization modules. Simultaneously, the toolkit integrated with the personalization module and the decision support system (DSS) module is capable of adapting to different customers and different customization level.

articleTitle: Research of Services Experiential System for Digital Convergence Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With advancement in digital technology , a span-new industry time has been opening by the converged development of Internet industry, communication industry, and radio & television industry. Achieving the goal of "creating new customers' experience, and enhancing new customers' value", the service experiential system is constructed and composed of 4 subsystems, which are product design subsystem, experiential subsystem, services marketing subsystem, as well as relationship management subsystem. With bicyclol structure, the services experiential system for the digital convergence services clearly manifests the operation through the whole process of customer consumption. Under the influence of the external factors, the system cooperatively operates with dynamic and open characters.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Risk Management of Thermal Power Construction Projects in China: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the Multi-Stakeholders Oriented BOE Integrated Management Conceptual Model of Public Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on defining BOE mode researches describing the characteristics of the general framework of BOE mode, put forward the conceptual model of BOE integrated management and introduce the four dimensions of the integration model: multi-stakeholders, BOE whole process cycle, management elements and information platform.

articleTitle: Evaluation of New Product Selection Indices System Based on Analytic Network Process in ERP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: New product selection is evaluated as a critical factor in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP). There may be dependence and feedback among factors of new product selection evaluation indices system. In this study, analytic network process (ANP) was adopted to model a multi-criteria new product selection evaluation indices system with dependence and feedback. The criteria were included into the model to rate benefits, opportunities, costs and risks (BOCR). Final synthesis of alternatives was obtained by using rated BOCR. The proposed approach can be adopted as an evaluation tool by decision-makers in systems which include feedback and dependence.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Sharing about Benchmarking Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The knowledge sharing of benchmarking management may urge the choice of enterprise benchmarking, the determination about the benchmarking content and the enterprise innovation. The factors that influence range pole the knowledge sharing between the competitors are the environment recognition ability, organization learning capability, resources deployment ability and imitation-innovation ability, which is a result guidance target. Analyzing the relations about knowledge sharing factor of benchmarking management, establishing the multi-objective optimization model, then optimizing knowledge sharing system, which can provide the support to designate the target of the benchmarking and determinate the benchmarking content.

articleTitle: Research on Device Identify Mechanism in Performance Lighting Network Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The device identifies protocol of DMX512, Art-Net and ACN were analyzed in this paper. The devices identify mechanism of performance light network control system was studied. The composition of ideal device identify system was proposed. Our research has certain theoretical significance and practical value to the development of performance light network control technology.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on Financial Crisis Early Warning and Emergency Management Based on Wolf Philosophy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: How Companies Setting Up Businesses Abroad Manage Human Resources
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reviewed theories and models on international human resource management and discussed how companies setting up businesses abroad should manage their human resources.

articleTitle: Price Game Analysis on Strategic Aeronautic Material Purchasing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on total purchasing amount and supply risks, a 4-quadrant method could be used to classify aeronautic materials into common materials, lever materials, strategic materials and bottle-neck materials. In this paper, a 3-side purchasing price game model of strategic aeronautic material is constructed by using the economic Bertrand model and with considering the characteristics of strategic aeronautic markets. Based on which the purchaser's pricing strategies are also discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Optimization of Coagulant for Raw Water in Ganjiang River in Winter: An Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper aims to determine the optimal coagulant for raw water in Ganjiang River in winter. Using FeCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, PAC, PFS as coagulants, we conducted six-jar test, to find out their respective effect on turbidity and organic matters removal.
