With technical analysis, we finally come to the conclusion that Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is the best coagulant.

articleTitle: Data Structure Design and Order-Picking Optimization for Irregular Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to calculate the distance between every two storage points, this paper proposed a data structure to store irregular warehouse layout diagram. A warehouse unit can be defined as four kinds, which are storage point, passage, node and block respectively. Storage point is a unit to store goods. Passage is an aisle by which the operator can access goods stored on storage point. Node is the intersection of a vertical passage and a horizontal passage. The number of nodes is evidently smaller than the number of storage points. So, we can compute out the shortest distance and route between every two nodes and save these data in disk. Then, when we need to calculate the shortest distance and route between two storage points, we can turn to these two storage points' adjacent nodes. Because of the limit of the order-picking vehicle's capacity, an order usually needs to be divided into several order-picking operations. In this paper, a hybrid genetic algorithm is proposed to optimizing order-picking. A chromosome consists of storage point's order in an order and the order-picking beginning point. A chromosome determines the number of order-picking operations and the total distance. The chromosomes evolve by special designed crossover and mutation operators. The experimental results revealed this new hybrid genetic algorithm's better performance<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">.</sup>

articleTitle: A Discriminatory Pricing Model and Simulation to Different Users of Eastern Route of the South-to-North Water Transfers Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To solve the problem of pricing to various consumers, we analyze the environment of Eastern Route market with multi-resources and multi-users, design both combined and decentralized pricing models based on supply chain theory. Through comparison, we find that the fitness of the two models depends on the purchasing cost by retail to the agriculture users. Based on OA (operation research) and Eastern Route example, we also expand the model with constraints of floating and progressive price and analyze its validity by simulation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Application of Strategic Cost Management in the R&D of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Scheduling Behaviors in Project Management: A Viewpoint of "Prospect Theory"
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The TOC technique for project management is often referred to as the "critical chain" technique. It's pivotal to determine the buffer which is suggested to providing sufficient protection against delays in project completion time. Owing to the "Student syndrome", many buffer sizing techniques have been investigated to increase project performance. However, the decision maker is human, "bounded" in its ability to acquire and process information. Further research is needed to be able to make reliable predictions of individual behavior in more complex real-world decision situations. We attempt to explore the application of prospect theory to investigate such phenomenon. Furthermore, a value function defined over variations of wealth and a probability weighting function reflects the subjective probability distortion shown by most individuals will be used. Given such findings, it becomes critical to observe the decision maker's perception when the buffer allocations are resolved.

articleTitle: Research on Modes of the Third-Party B2B E-Marketplaces Influencing the Global Production Networks Embeddedness of SMEs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At first the four modes that the third-party B2B e-marketplaces influence the global production networks (GPN) embeddedness of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are presented. Namely, they are transaction mode, manufacturing factory mode, technology factory mode, and mixed mode. Afterwards the different mechanisms in the four modes that the third-party B2B e-marketplaces influence the GPN embeddedness of SMEs are analyzed. At last these four modes and the mechanisms are verified with four cases.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Space-Time Expansion Characteristic of Urban Construction Land in Taizhou Metropolitan Area, Jiangsu, 1988-2008: An Analysis from the Perspective of Mega-Events Driving Forces
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the transformation of China's economy and social development, the issue of spatial expansion of the urban construction land and its driving forces has drawn extensive attention from both academic researchers and government departments. The analysis from the perspective of mega-events driving forces is firstly adopted in this paper, to take Taizhou metropolitan area in Jiangsu Province as a case study, which is a representative in the Yangtze River Delta in China's urbanization process. Remote sensing interpretation data of Landsat TM, and ALOS which represent main years' images of Taizhou metropolitan area within the last 20 years are used in the analysis. From the perspective of mega-events driving forces, statistical analysis, together with remote sensing, geographic information system methods and procedure analysis, is adopted to analyze the spatial expansion of urban construction land in Taizhou metropolitan area. The main conclusions are: the mega-events driving forces play an important role in spatial expansion of the urban construction land. In different periods the driving forces of spatial expansion of the urban construction land are significantly influenced by the national, regional and urban mega-events. For the last two decades, the dominant patterns of Taizhou metropolitan area urban construction land, in terms of spatial expansion, are spot-filling and extension, as well as transformation, point-axle corridor pattern, and satellite city pattern, which jointly form an net expansion pattern. The temporal expansion, however, is characterized by rotating development between the south and the north districts, and between urban districts, rural villages, and port regions along the Yangtze River. No research on such issue before was from the perspective of the mega-events driving forces, so this is the academic innovation in this paper.

articleTitle: Update on City Emergency Response System with Environmental Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environmental risk management (ERM) is updated on the city emergency response system (CERC) in Nanning City, China. The technical routine developed better support effective urban ERM in the Nanning CERC. Started from identification of risk sources, programs of sources monitoring, risk prediction and early warning, treatment and disposal, and management with update were discussed. This work highlights major steps in the procedure for update on the CERC with ERM, which provides a demonstration case for integrating urban emergency response and environmental management with functional enhancement.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Assessment of Porous Pavement Impact on Urban Ecological Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, factors that impact urban ecological environment such as pavement performance, physical environment and economical index have been synthetically estimated by the method of multi-level fuzzy pattern recognition, It turned out to be that physical environment is very good with 34% and ecological environment is good with 31%, this proved that porous pavement can improve urban ecological environment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Industrial Cluster's Profit Based on the Cluster's Production Load Balance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The definition of industrial cluster's production load balance and the approximate formula of lg on rho based on nonlinear break-even analysis are presented for solving the problem of industrial cluster's production load imbalance. Based on the approximate formula, a cluster's profit during production load balance is compared with the cluster's profit during production load imbalance under different cluster's production load rate. The result shows that production load balance can make the cluster gain high profit when the cluster's production load is appropriate or large. Only when a cluster's production load is too small, the conclusion fails.

articleTitle: The Association Analysis for Construction Laws and Regulations Data
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Association analysis is especially important to users. It is becoming very important to provide association recommendation by the association analysis of construction laws and regulations data for the users. Extracted features from each document, the cumulative frequency of 85% of the requirement that has made the feature bearing the most message of the text, summary of all text feature form the feature set of laws and regulations of construction data and make it impossible for association analysis of outlier text features. In gray correlation analysis, the system features is corresponding to the features of laws and regulations of construction data, the corresponding 'sequence item' is corresponding to 'text' that the sub-vector of feature vector. Furthermore, according to the features of construction laws and regulations and referring to the modeling thinking of text vector space model, the vector space model of the data characteristics is established. From analyzing the definition of the frequency item sets, the method to obtain the data characteristic frequent item sets laws and regulations of construction is expounded. From the angle of data characteristic association the generalized gray absolute association degree is improved. Then the association rules of data characteristic are educed and the recall rate of construction laws and regulations data is raised. The effectiveness of this association analysis method is verified on the experiments of construction laws and regulations date sets of Shannxi province.

articleTitle: Knowledge Sharing in Green Supply Chain Based on Trust Adjustment Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge sharing is the key for green supply chain to operate successfully. How to make knowledge sharing in supply chain successfully is the main study to which the scholars devoted much at present. In this paper, on the basis of knowledge sharing in green supply chain, trust mechanism is introduced to set up a structural equation model. The adjustment mechanism of trust to knowledge sharing in green supply chain is analyzed, and the positive function is discussed from the perspective of game theory. At last, some suggestions are given on how to establish trust among node enterprises in green supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Staff's Knowledge Sharing in Enterprise Based on Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the stable equilibrium problems in staffs knowledge sharing in enterprise using the method of evolutionary game theory. Through setting up the evolutionary game model of staffs knowledge sharing, it analyzes the relationships between the staffs learning costs, knowledge sharing benefits as well as stable equilibrium. The analysis indicates that, it's key to build a motivating and restraining mechanism that in favor of encouraging staff to share knowledge, including enhancing the mutual trust between staff, complimenting knowledge sharing behaviors, increasing the costs of opposite behaviors, and so on.

articleTitle: The Study on Ecological Factors and Adaptability of IT Business Based on SEM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evolution of creatures in the biological world strongly depends on their ecosystem. Quite similarly, for a business, it can't evolve without the support and influence comes from its business ecosystem. In this paper, the authors are intended to introduce a methodology of business ecology to disclose the relationship between the adaptability of IT business and its ecological factors. Based on this view of point, this paper has employed structural equation model (SEM) to achieve this goal. We argue that business ecological factors can be subdivided into three types, namely: external adaptive factor, external optimized factor, and internal capability factor. The results of the research shows that, there are direct causalities between the adaptability of IT business and its ecological factors; moreover, we have also found that the internal capability factor plays the most important role in the process of IT business' evolution. Finally, we have concluded that an IT business could effectively improve its ecological adaptability by cultivating and embodying ultra-adaptability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The New Strategy of Enterprise by Cooperating with Nonprofit Organization: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination for Quality Improving
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retailer's effort for quality information collection and feedback is especially serious for product quality improving. The more effort, the quicker quality improving, the less defective returns in the product life cycle. In the decentralized supply chain, there is lack of incentive for retailer to exert more effort, which leads to the failure of supply chain coordination. In this paper, we designed a transfer payment punishment contract to coordinate the supply chain in order to reduce defective returns, which committed to transfer retailer a payment at the product' market entry stage for effort cost compensation, and charges penalty for each defective return at the end of product life cycle, the punishment will been deducted from the committed transfer payment. This contract provides an incentive to the retailer to increase his effort, thus decreasing the number of defective returns in the product life cycle. We show that this contract can achieve channel coordination and a win-win outcome for both manufacture and retailer.

articleTitle: New Information Multi-Variable Grey Optimization Model and Its Application in Urban Water Consumption
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban water consumption has some characteristics of grey because it is influenced by economy, population, standard of living and so on. Based on grey system theory and the new information principle, multi-variable grey optimal model NMGM (1, n, q, r) was introduced. The parameter q and r of NMGM (1, n, q, r) model was optimized with Matlab software. The model was validated by examining the urban water consumption. The result indicated that the new information multi-variable grey optimization model NMGM (1, n, q, r) is simple and practical, and has a generalizing value in data process.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Case Study on Improving Environment Management Efficiency through Stakeholder Relations Analysis and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Knowledge Development and Entry Mode - A Study of Foreign Investment Determinants by Taiwanese Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examined an original determinant of entry mode choice, proposed and tested the operationalization for a new theoretical construct, namely corporate culture diversity. Hypotheses were developed on the entry modes in relation to culture diversity at corporate level, a step beyond the conventional theory of how national cultural differences influence entry mode choice. The hypotheses were tested within the framework of organizational learning, using data on 1,156 foreign investment made by Taiwanese firms during 1986-2006.

articleTitle: Helper Mode Analysis in a Supply Chain : Based on Supermodular Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Consider a supply chain involving an independent supplier and an independent manufacturer, the manufacturer will help his supplier to invest in cost-reducing innovation. Based on the theory of supermodular games, we analyze two helper modes. The existence of pure strategy Nash equilibrium was proved by construction of potential function. The characteristics of the equilibrium were analyzed for simultaneous competition. We also prove that cooperating in effort decision will lead to a higher effort and higher profit for every player based supermodular games theory.

articleTitle: Key Factors Analysis of Complex Product Development in Equipment Manufacture Industry Test Inh
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The effect of equipment manufacture industry to zone and country economy is very important. However, poor new product development (NPD) capacity restricts its development. Complex characters of equipment manufacture industry include multi-discipline technology integration of product, cross-organization in management, tailor-made, special business processes. These complex characters cause management of NPD confronting many problems. The key factors which will affect NPD include strategic management, resources, organization structure, project management, and government assistance. Through analysis of these key factors, the company's NPD ability can be improved, and competition ability can be enhanced. So the study can hasten the development of equipment manufacture industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Technological Entrepreneurship Patterns in Chinese High-Tech Firms: The Case of Lenovo
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Assessing Conflicts in Knowledge Chain Based on Fuzzy Synthetic Assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article defines the concept of the conflicts in the knowledge chain, analyzes the main factors which cause interorganizational conflicts in the knowledge chain, builds the knowledge chain's conflicts assessment index system, establishes an assessment model based on fuzzy synthetic assessment process, and finally uses a case to illustrate the model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on the Motivity of Cash Balance in Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Study of Equity Division Reform Effect on Chinese Listed Companies Financing Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Few literature was made for the research of equity division reform effect on companies' innovation efficiency. In this paper, we do the empirical study of this topic. The result shows that the reform affects some factors of financing policy choosing. However, the financing behaviors of Chinese listed companies do not change radically.

articleTitle: The Provincial-Level R&D Efficiency Analysis of China in the Tenth-Five Period
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By applying input-oriented C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R and super-efficiency DEA model, this paper analyzed the provincial-level R&D efficiency of China in the tenth-five period based on regional data. The results indicate that the provincial-level R&D efficiencies are in decline as a whole and the gap between provinces experiences a process that enlarged at first and then narrowed, and the overall distinction is obvious. On the basis of analyzing results above, we give some advices on further improving the provincial-level R&D efficiencies and narrowing the distinctions.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Object Technologies in Media Assets Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new framework is presented in this paper to aggregate media resources with all kinds of manipulations. On the basis of analyzing some data modeling techniques, some urgent problems are resolved by taking the digital object as the data model, which totally satisfies the requirement and development of media asset management. Finally, a practical example is given to demonstrate how to modeling the media assets by using the object technology.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Logistics Finance Based on Third Party Logistics and the Financing Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the increasingly growing globalization, the logistics industries of countries all over the world are developing rapidly. Logistics finance as a new financial innovation product, is creating a tremendous market demand. Through client-agent game analysis ,this paper conducts the necessity of carrying out logistics finance based on the center of Third Party Logistics(TPL), and then proposes the financing model ,as well as the strength of the financing model. We hope our research can provide some references for the development of TPL.

articleTitle: Accuracy of Protein Secondary Structure Prediction Continues to Rise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At first, this paper reviews the development of the protein secondary structure prediction. Some concerned secondary structure prediction methods are introduced. Then we propose a novel method to predict protein secondary structure , which substantially improves the prediction accuracy both over 80% in CB513 and RS126 database. At the end, we point out some possible trends in the protein secondary structure prediction in the future.

articleTitle: Reduce the Uncertainty of Commodity Futures Delivery Return
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, commodity futures delivery must pay the value-added-tax. It leads to some uncertainty about the arbitrage between futures and cash markets. The investors who take or receive delivery may make an additional profit or incur an additional loss accordingly. This article analyzes this problem and gives a solution. To reduce the uncertainty, investors can make an offsetting by selling or buying some futures contracts at opposite direction simultaneously when they sell or buy futures contracts.

articleTitle: Grid-Based Early Warning and Emergency Management Mechanism of City Operation and Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Applying grid technology to early warning and emergency management of city operation and development will greatly improve the reliability of city operation and development. There are three levels in mechanism of grid-based early warning and emergency management mechanism: hardware and the resource database, Grid server system and users' portal. The appliance of the Mechanism in a section of Shanghai is proven it's efficiency.

articleTitle: Based on Capacity Planning of Order Selection Decision Model in Make-to-Order Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper addresses an order selection decision model in a make-to-order operation environment based on the short-term capacity-planning problem. Make-to-stock and make-to-order are two generic operation modes commonly used in the manufacturing world. The make-to-order enterprise makes the production systems to produce a product only after it is ordered. The enterprise must decide which orders can be accepted to get the optimal profit and meet the due time. This paper addresses a order selection decision model in a make-to-order operation environment. The mathematical model is proposed to select a set of customer orders to maximize the operational profit such that all the selected orders are fulfilled by their deadline. With a given capacity limit on each resource type and its cost rate, solving this model leads to an optimal production mix for the orders over a given time horizon. The conclusion shows that it is not a optimal choice to accept all customer's orders although they can be produced before deadline. This paper tells the enterprise how to select the order selection according to the cost and production capacity planning.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Review on Employee Job Performance Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on "Three-Links" Energy Management MAS Model for Paper-Making Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, multi-agent system is used to design "three-links" energy structure optimization management model for energy saving in paper-making process. As a core module for energy saving platform, the designed model deals the entire energy flow structure of paper-making process with the optimization and scheduling management, which is feasible for the industrial applications. The system design includes the policies for "three-links" MAS model, function of multi-agent, the classification of agents, and the theoretical model of a single energy agent in the context of paper-making process.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis for the Convergence of China's Regional Financial Developing Disparity: From the Point of Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Towards an Integrative Model of User Acceptance of E-Commerce Website
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper addresses why users accept the e-commerce website and how user's two important beliefs PU and PEOU are affected by the Website quality. In this study, we also introduce perceived playfulness as a new factor that reflects the user's intrinsic belief in user acceptance of e-commerce Website. A survey of 356 users was conducted to test our model. Information quality of e-commerce website is an important factor in affecting the user's two beliefs, but system quality and service quality have direct effect on PEOU. Additionally, in terms of predictive power, the model accounts for 57% of the variance in attitude and 60% of the variance in behavioral intention.

articleTitle: A Quantity Analysis on Optimizing Corporation's Capital Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to choose the capital structure has been the probe question of the economy circle in China. This paper has a quantity analysis on corporation's capital structure and puts forward a method to confirm the best capital structure about financing decision in order to help the business policy maker.

articleTitle: Do Technology Progress and Service Differentiation Bring Efficiency and Social Welfare in the Process of Network Service Enterprise's Marketization: Experience from China Post
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper finds that, in the process of marketization, network-type service monopoly enterprises tends to pursue their profit goal through product and service differentiation, by lowering the quality of universal service and increasing the price and quality of high-paid services, which usually expel customer from universal service to more expensive service, hence reduce the social welfare. After establishing a market strategy model of service enterprise in transition, this paper investigates the overall delivery time of ordinary mail, registered mail and express mail among eight cities, the investigation showed that even though the market presence, equipment, technology for China Post upgraded greatly, but the delivery time for all these mails are delayed, especially for the ordinary mail which belongs to the scope of universal service. The case of China Post shows that during the marketization transition, technology progress and service differentiation do not increase efficiency and quality of the service, nor increase social welfare. Finally, we proposed that market entry threshold for network-type service industry should be relaxed to encourage competition during marketization.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Software and Service Outsourcing on the Economic Growth in Recipient Country: An Empirical Analysis of Dalian, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of software and service outsourcing promotes the economic growth in recipient country. And this paper examines the impacts of international software and service outsourcing through an econometric model on economic growth in the aspects of the trade in service, the upgrading of industrial structure, the employment, and the labor productivity, with the data of Dalian, China from 1999 to 2007. The results are that the software and service outsourcing has comprehensive and profound influences on economy, and it also plays an important role in the further advancement of modern service industry.

articleTitle: The Importance of Railway Construction Norm and the Perfecting Ways
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thesis studies the railway project cost system, analyzes railway construction cost management system in recent railway project, and systematically discusses the importance of railway construction norm. Based on the insufficiency of the present stage figuring price foundation, the thesis puts forwards some constructive suggestions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Overseas Direct Investment and the Structure Adjustment of Jiangsu Textile & Garment Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Disruption Management in JIT Problem of Single Machine Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the disruption management problem in the middle of the JIT question based on common due date: if a hardware has been finished ahead of schedule, measures have to be adopted - the hardware has to be arranged over again in order to reach the optimization. In addition, this paper discusses the question which we do not punish but encourage the hardware ahead of schedule. Corresponding to such the disruption management problem, this paper gives neighborhood search algorithm, dynamic planning algorithm and an example.

articleTitle: Removal of Nitrogen by Immobilization Biological Activated Carbon (IBAC) Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The effect of IBAC on nitrogen removal was conducted and a mechanism of nitrogen removal was put forward. The results showed that the removal of ammonia and total nitrogen were 90% and 43.91% respectively when 03 dosage was 5.2 mg/l and hydraulic retention time was 41 min, alkalinity and 03 dosage affected nitrogen removal efficiency, combined reaction of microbe, physical chemistry and biochemistry can enhance the nitrogen removal.

articleTitle: Accuracy Analysis of the TDOA Method in a Lightning Location System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the most serious natural disasters, lightning disaster does significant harm to urban civilization. Lightning location system (LLS) detects natural lightning and obtains various kinds of spatial and physical parameters in real time, which provides basis information for lightning study and disaster prevention and mitigation. This paper elucidated the influence of time error on location accuracy in a lightning location network using TDOA method. Related computing method and error distribution law were discussed, which could be used in data processing and accuracy estimation for the improvement of the lightning location accuracy. The results can guide construction of detection network and facilitate determination of location technical index.

articleTitle: An Efficient Certificateless Authenticated Tripartite Key Agreement Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The key agreement protocol is an important primitive tool for establishing shared session keys among partners that communicate over open public networks. In this paper we present the first certificateless authenticated tripartite key agreement protocol which realizes the authentication by using a provably secure signature scheme. The discussion of our protocol shows that it has achieved all necessary security attributes.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Influence Factors for Organizations to Adopt B2B E-Marketplace in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, the research on e-commerce adoption become more necessary and important. To identify the key factors for organizations in China to adopt the B2B e-marketplace, first, this paper builds the concept model according to TOE framework and the relative theory. Then, the model and relative hypothesis are tested using data from 203 Chinese enterprises. The result indicates that relative advantage, network externality, technological trust, top manager support have significant positive affects the adoption intention of organizations in China.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study on the Influencing Factors of Customers' E-Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer loyalty is one of the most important factors that will bring profits and competition strength not only in traditional shopping environment but also in E-commence. In this study we explore six main effecting factors on customer e-loyalty including Website security, contact interactivity, Website reputation, initial trust, switch cost, customer satisfaction based on the survey for 200 undergraduates in Wuhan using structural equations modeling method. It shows that all the six variables have a significant effect on the e-loyalty. Management solutions are also suggested in details.

articleTitle: Spatial Analysis and Present Situation Evaluation of Urban Residential Land Suitability Based on GIS: A Case Study in Changchun, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analysis and evaluation of urban residential land suitability plays an important role in the overall plan of urban land and coordination subsystem, and has important significance in improving the quality of urban inhabited environment. This paper discussed how to analyze and evaluate the suitability of urban residential land qualitatively and efficiently, taking Changchun, China as study area by GIS technology. The study began with the establishment of evaluation index system which consisted of two steps: Index Selection and Indexes Weight Determination which applied the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method. Then analysis and evaluation was carried out on the spatial distribution map of residential suitability obtained by raster calculation in ArcGIS 9.2. The application of geometric road network is a great improvement compared with the previous methods which was based on straight line distance, thus making the spatial distribution map more reasonable. The analysis result indicates that the closer to the center of Changchun, the higher and the greater fluctuation of residential suitability presented. And the present situation evaluation result not only shows that the residential land distribution of Changchun basically corresponds with the analysis result talked above, but also proves that there is a significant negative correlation between the residential land suitability and the distance from residential areas to the city center by correlation analysis.

articleTitle: A Study on the Model for Psychological Motives of Compulsive Buying Online in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most prior researches of compulsive buying focused on compulsive purchase behavior offline. This paper, combining with the specific consumer culture in China, constructed and tested a model of psychological motives of compulsive buying online(CBO). The results confirmed previously documented point that materialistic value and psychological motives significantly affect compulsive buying tendency online (CBTO). Our extra findings were that: (1) materialistic value mediates the relationship between psychological motives and compulsive buying tendency online. (2) Psychological motives contain virtual experience motives other than emotional-related and identity-related motives. This paper is a new expansion of the study on psychological motives of compulsive buying and it provides some guiding significance for e-commerce practice.

articleTitle: Dynamic Information Management System of Mining Production in an Open Pit Based on GIS/GPS/GPRS/RFID
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using GIS (Geographic Information System), GPS (Global Positioning System), GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) and RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), a dynamic information management system of digital mining in an open pit has been designed and developed. A linear programming model is set up in a practical application. By the model, the system can automatically draw up production plan of ore blending well every day. The system can monitor and dispatch open-pit trucks and shovels well, and can play back their historical paths. It can monitor and control the process of mining production in real time. By RFID, The system can also count the number of trucks' delivery and shovels' loading automatically. Experiments on real scenes show that the performance of this system is stable and can satisfy production standards of ore blending in open pits.

articleTitle: Query by Humming: Comparing Voices to Voices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we describe a query by singing/humming (QBSH) system which compares voices to voices. Instead of comparing with MIDI database, our system compares humming queries directly with the songs sung or hummed by other people In our system, both humming queries and humming songs in the library are represented as sequences of <relative pitch, relative interval>. We use UDS string to represent notes. An improved harmonic product spectral (HPS) method is used for tracking pitch. Notes are segmented with a simple pitch segmenter. A modified approximate string matching method is used to measure the similarities between queries and humming songs in the library. Experiments reveal that voice-to-voice is a simpler and more effective way for QBSH.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Consumer's Online Purchase Intention in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the factors that affect consumer's online purchase intention. Proposed the research model and hypothesis. The proposed model was empirically tested using data collected from a survey of online consumer in Shanghai. Empirical data from structural equation model analysis reflects perceived ease of use positively affects perceived usefulness. Perceived usefulness, compatibility and trust positively affect attitude. Results also reveal that attitude positively affects consumer's purchase intention.

articleTitle: A Framework of Estimating Software Project Success Potential Based on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper proposes a framework to estimate the software project success potential using association rule mining technique. The framework aims to explore the relationship between the risk dimensions and project outcome. By the obtained association rules that take risk dimensions as the condition and the project outcome as the result, project managers can estimate whether a new project will be successful or failure based on its risk factor values as early as possible. At last we design a project data generator to illustrate how the framework works.

articleTitle: Absorptive Capacity: Enhancing the Absorption of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies how to enhance information technology (IT) absorption from the perspective of absorptive capacity. The research questions for this study are: What is the impact of absorptive capacity on a firm's IT absorption, and what would cause some firms to have a higher IT absorptive capacity than other firms? We examine the role of absorptive capacity in IT absorption, and identify five factors influencing IT absorptive capacity. The method of stochastic frontier estimation is used to estimate IT absorptive capacity and then explain the relationship between the five factors and IT absorptive capacity.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Vulnerable Groups in Basin Initial Water Right Allocation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theories of social vulnerable groups and harmonious management, vulnerable groups in basin initial water right allocation are defined in the paper. According to their characteristics and allocation principle of initial water right, the evaluation index system of vulnerable groups is established. All the indexes weights are calculated on the basis of AHP, and the vulnerable grade is divided into four grades: "very vulnerable, vulnerable, powerful, very powerful". Based on multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, the maximum membership degree of every index is determined and areas which are vulnerable groups are indentified.

articleTitle: Research of the Bargaining Process in Construction Claim with Discount Factor
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When claims happen in the process of construction, in order to determine an amount compensated to the contractor, normally the owner and the contractor have to negotiate with each other or even refer to mediation and arbitration, which is a bargaining process as a whole. This paper interprets the discount factor in this process as a kind of hidden cost and sets out its three influencing factors. Then by developing and solving a dynamic-game model with the Rubinstein Bargaining-game Theory the best quotes in each stage of the bargaining process are proposed for the two parties. Based on these, the paper concludes the key factors affecting the bargaining process and the two parties' quotes, including their discount factors, mediation and arbitration costs and so on. Several suggestions for the two parties solving claim problems rationally are summarized at the end.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Code for Seismic Design of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to satisfy the economic requirement of structure under the need of seismic design, based on the development and economic function of seismic design code, the economic benefit of improving the seismic fortification was studied from the development viewpoint of seismic design code. Taken the standard Code for Seismic Design of Buildings (GB50011-2001) as the reference, a simple type of structure with two different fortification intensities was chosen to calculate. The costs of the low intensity structure after reinforcement and the high intensity structure were compared. The possible economic losses of structures in different seismic fortification intensity were also compared to analysis the affect of intensity on the building economic effect. The result showed that the economic benefit of high intensity structure was 1.07, and the reinforced low intensity structure was 0.58. So the economic benefit of structure with reasonable seismic input was evident.

articleTitle: A Service-Oriented CRM For SMEs Based on the Enterprise Level Customer
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A traditional CRM stores all information about its customers in a database and uses this data to coordinate sales, marketing, and customer service. Obviously, this exclusive data is not enough and has less credibility for today's business transactions. As the internet grows very fast, we can obtain more information from the internet. In this paper, we propose a novel scheme that enables the exclusive data of the small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and the internet data to be seamlessly integrated in our CRM. We formulate three dimensions for our customer which will be described in details. It is worth mentioning that the customer here is on enterprise level, which means that one customer stands for one company. Using this scheme and SaaS model, we make the prototype of the new CRM, and we take 1,000 customers which are the real data to this experiment. The results show that the novel CRM provides us much important information from the internet and it reduces much time for the investigation of the customer.

articleTitle: Innovation Efficiency and Determinants in Chinese High-Tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an empirical study of the innovation efficiency in Chinese high-tech industry and its subdivision determinants, based on the panel data of 17 individual four-digit high-tech industries from 1996 to 2007 and the methods of Malmquist-Tobit. The results indicate that technological progress promoting the innovation efficiency level while technical efficiency are completely offset this trend cause a reduced innovation efficiency in the whole. In-depth analyze find that pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency has different influence of inefficient in micro industry. Industry concentration degree and Government funds significantly improve the innovation and technical efficiency with Government funds hindered technology progress at the same time. The degree of Market-oriented put significant positive effects on technological progress. Foreign direct investment have positive effect on innovation efficiency but not stable.

articleTitle: A Study on XML Path Similarity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The data model of XML document can be labeled as a tag tree of element nodes. Such tree model can be represented by the set of paths from the root node to leaf nodes, which describes the structure of XML document. This paper presents an approach for measuring similarity between two XML paths that consists of (1) ElementSim, a similarity function specifically designed for measuring linguistic similarity between two elements in two different paths, which take into account both semantic and syntactical information of elements. (2) NPathSim, a similarity function specifically designed for measuring similarity between two paths, which combines both the linguistic similarity between elements and the context descriptions of paths. Path retrieval was performed to evaluate the quality of NPathSim. The experiments show the proposed similarity approach can achieve higher quality on XML data set.

articleTitle: Managing New Product Development Performance: A Process-Based Automotive Product Realization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The new product development (NPD) is the process by which a new product idea is conceived, investigated, taken through the design process, manufactured, marketed and serviced. In the automotive industry, within the context of ISO/TS16949:2002 (the automotive quality management system international standard), these related to the product realization process (PRP) which consists of five phases: "Plan and Define Program", "Product Design and Development", "Process Design and Development", "Product and Process Validation", and "Production Launch, Feedback Assessment and Corrective Action". These phases may be done concurrently and have correlated activities. This paper proposes a process-based management concept focusing on controlling and measuring for their effective management including literature review of NPD performance measurement. Integrating the process-based management concept with the proper performance measure can initiate new knowledge which will contribute to the improvement of the automotive industry.

articleTitle: A Management Mode for Joint-Stock Rural Electric Power Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing rural electric power is one of the contents of China's building socialist new countryside. This paper analyses rural electric power supply enterprises' management problems at present in China, and puts forward the project of county-level power supply enterprises management innovation and organization configuration which changes the present organization mode into mixed course department structure mode. The methods include establishing centered platforms and operation mechanisms.

articleTitle: The Relationships among Organizational Socialization, Trust, Knowledge Sharing and Creative Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on the role of trust, knowledge sharing within the relationship between organizational socialization and creative behavior. Use multiple regression analysis and structure equation model with a sample of 311 employee from the industry in south of China. The aim of this research is to discover how organizational socialization, trust, knowledge sharing and creative behavior interact with employee. The result supports the assumptions: organizational socialization is positively related to the trust, the trust is positively related to the knowledge sharing, knowledge sharing is positively related creative behavior, trust and knowledge sharing are intermediate factors for organizational socialization and creative behavior.

articleTitle: Approach of Expert Opinion Acquisition Based on Cloud Model and Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to support the group argument is quite an important study of HWME research. An approach of expert opinion acquisition based on cloud model and evidence theory is proposed, with respect to the characteristic of group argument. According to the semantic relations between comments, this method uses cloud model to find out the opinion implicated in the comment, and synthesizes the implicated opinions into expert opinion on the base of evidence theory. A numerical example indicates that this approach can acquire expert opinion dynamically from the argument information and show the tendency of expert opinion.

articleTitle: Coupling 3G with DVB Networks for Low Cost Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Next generation networks will result from the convergence of the different existing technologies, taking benefit from their complementary properties . In this context, recent research has addressed digital video broadcast (DVB) networks, which benefit of very high broadcast capacities, and has tried to couple them with complementary networks. In our work, we focus on DVB-SH, satellite services for hand-held devices, which is a hybrid (satellite/terrestrial) standard. We couple DVB-SH with a 3G cellular network, thus providing a bidirectional interactivity path. DVB-SH benefits from a very high bandwidth capacity that allows unidirectional IP-TV channels broadcast. A residual bandwidth in the DVB-SH path may still be available because of two reasons; the variable bit rates of served flows and/or some DVB reserved channels by the 3G provider. In our work, we focus on this small residual bandwidth and its potential utilization. The idea is to realize an efficient switching of IP data, coming from 3G networks, to the residual bandwidth of DVB networks. The goal is to use this architecture in order to provide interactive low cost services over DVB networks.

articleTitle: Test of Co-Movement between Electricity Consumption and Economic Growth in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the paper, we propose a novel method based on wavelet analysis to test the impact of specific frequency fluctuation of series in establishing the cointegration and Granger causality among series. The method is rather time domain oriented and can rely on the standard procedure of error correction model. Then we use the method to test for electricity consumption and economic growth in China. Our test results indicate that electricity consumption is the frequency Granger cause of economic growth in both the short and long run. It also indicates that the cointegration between electricity consumption and economic growth is operated with the low frequency business cycle movement.

articleTitle: A Post Evaluation Technique for Engineering Project Investment Based on ANP-ENTROPY-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mutual influence always exists among the indices in engineering project investment evaluation system. Since ANP (Analytic Network Process) technique can scientifically reflect the mutual influence among the indices, it is introduced into this paper instead of AHP to overcome the defect that traditional AHP technique can not reflect the relationship among the indices. And in the weight determining process, entropy method is adopted in combination with ANP to avoid the respective unilateralism of subjective weight method and objective weight method. On this basis, TOPSIS method is applied in the comprehensive evaluation for the engineering project investment schemes to quantitatively rank these schemes. Finally, by means of Super Decision software, an example is provided to show the effectiveness and scientificity of this evaluation technique.

articleTitle: Urbanization Level in the Transitional Stage of China and Provincial Economic Growth: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There have been obvious differences among provinces in their urbanization level ever since China implemented reformation and opening policy. By establishing a panel data model, this paper probes into the correlation between provincial urbanization level and economic growth. It is concluded that industrialization in China goes hand in hand with its urbanization. Problems arising in the course of urbanization can not be solved solely by the reformation of the household registration system, but by the implementation of the strategies of developing small and middle-sized cities and towns and constructing new countryside.

articleTitle: Testing the Pecking Order Theory and Trade-Off Theory of Capital Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tests traditional capital structure models against the alternative of a pecking order model of corporate finance in Chinese stock market. We show that, the basic pecking order model, which predicts external debt financing driven by the internal financial deficit, has much greater explanatory power over the capital structure of Chinese listed companies than a static trade-off model. However, the trade-off model has greater explanatory power in explaining the debt maturity structure of firms.

articleTitle: Pre-Sale Visualization of Kitchen & Bath Equipment Self-Design to Purchase Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, for the network economic development of the current situation and the specific conditions in the enterprise domestic and abroad, we develop and construct pre-sale visualization of kitchen & bath equipment self-design to purchase service platform for domestic enterprises. The main economic instruments of pre-sales visualization of kitchen & bath equipment self-service designed to purchase platform is to make use of the network (such as e-commerce, etc.), based on GIS / virtual simulation technology, and build kitchen & bath equipment virtual platform so that customers can independently design kitchen & bath virtual environment and equipment procurement in interactive three-dimensional virtual display system. The platform transfer the client's ideas into a visible realtime display of a three-dimensional virtual environment and simulation objects, and provide the customers with reality and on-site sense cannot match , to fulfill the cognitive and perception needs of customer in Pre-sale visualization of kitchen & bath equipment. This measure cannot only prevent the customer from purchase decision-making mistakes, but also make clients purchase decision faster and more accurate, so the pace of equipment sales can be greatly accelerated, and it can greatly improve the potential market value of enterprises. Based on spatial information technology, the platform integrates a variety of modern information technology, such as virtual simulation technology, spatial analysis and decision support technology, modern logistics analysis and deployment of storage technology, location-based services, and ERP technology. On the basis of making full use of existing resources, it can reduce maximum operating costs of enterprises and create new revenue channels for enterprises then upgrade the operation and management mechanism.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Knowledge Management in Intelligent Tutoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the introduction of knowledge management, ontologies, intelligent tutoring systems, and the relationships among them, a model of ontology-based knowledge management in intelligent tutoring systems is presented in this paper. It consists of knowledge representation, organization and acquisition module, knowledge distribution module, and knowledge maintainess module. The knowledge representation, organization and acquisition module uses multi-media teaching material getting from textbook and Internet to represent and structure domain knowledge. The knowledge distribution module produces personalized learning units dynamically based on student models and domain knowledge bases in order to improve the self-adaptability and pedagogical effects of the system. Finally, the knowledge maintainess module updates student models and domain knowledge bases according to students' performance and their interactions with the system.

articleTitle: Energy Measurement Audit and Its Implementation in Coal-Fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper addresses energy measurement audit in coal-fired power plant. Energy audit, as an effective energy-saving and emission-reducing measure, was launched in thousands of high energy-consuming enterprises in China in 2006. The big part of energy audit is energy measurement audit. In this paper, the work center of energy measurement is obtained by analyzing the contents and characteristics of energy measurement works. According to Chinese standard, the basic requirement for equipping rate of the measuring instruments of energy in each class of organization and major energy-consuming equipment is introduced. A case of energy measurement audit in a coal-fired power plant is given. Auditing results show the equipping rate of the measuring instruments of most kinds of energy is unqualified.

articleTitle: An Integrated and Comprehensive Information Management Model for Construction Project Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information in construction engineering projects has always been scattered in every independent phase and used very inefficiently. In order to improve the project management performance, this paper presents an integrated information management model for construction engineering lifecycle to manage construction project through the lifecycle. In this model the information in the construction engineering project is acquired and shared in database where Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) is adopted to a standard information communication as a DB converter in it. The lifecycle construction information model is testified to eliminate information loss in construction engineering projects effectively.

articleTitle: An Integration Framework of ERM, SCM, CRM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the era of economic globalization and E-commerce, Enterprises are struggling with ERP, SCM and CRM application, aiming to maintain the competitive edge, access to the global trading environment. However, some enterprises have many difficulties in integrating all kinds of their internal and external resources. They are unable to take on exchanges of customer information streams, internal resources streams, and supply streams both internally and externally. Therefore, information isolated island has become the main bottle-necks in the development of enterprise. The information isolated island can be eliminated by integrating internal system (ERP) and external systems (SCM, CRM). This article makes a research on an integration framework of ERP, SCM and CRM, and makes a review of the relationship of information flow, cash flow, the commodities flow and logistics. Then the paper makes an analysis of basic category of enterprise integration: integration inside an enterprise, B2B integration, B2C integration, enterprise application integration. And it makes an introduction to related component of integration framework, and puts forward an integrated framework as well as proposes integration technologies in the end.

articleTitle: Virtual Enterprise Global Production Planning Based on Cost Optimization with Time Constraints
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper solved production planning problem in virtual enterprise (VE) considering time constraint on individual tasks and overall cost. The production planning is to minimize the overall cost of the VE with the time constraint of individual tasks. In this paper, we firstly build a mathematic model for the production planning problem and propose a heuristic algorithm to seek optimal solution for the problem. This algorithm consists of the method of solution existence judgment and strategy to adjust processing time of tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the model and algorithm with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Ability of Regional Sustainable Development Based on the Principal Component Analysis: A Case Study of Jiangsu Province, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The region, especially at the municipal level, plays a very important role in the implementation of sustainable development strategy, it is fundamental to evaluate the ability of regional sustainable development in Jiangsu Province for making the development strategies. The purpose of this study is to set up an index system for evaluating regional sustainable development, and evaluate the ability of regional sustainable development in Jiangsu province based on the method of principal component analysis (PCA). The results indicate that the scores of PCA correctly reflect the present regional development situation; different cities in Jiangsu province are faced with different problems in regional sustainable development, to improve the economic strength, reduce the spatial difference, simultaneously take use of resources rationally and protect environment should be the main contents of regional sustainable development in Jiangsu province.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Current Situation and Planning of the Greenspace System in Huaibei City Using GIS Based Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In rapid urbanization, how to construct the rational landscape network have great significances in keeping the urban ecosystem healthy and improving the quantity and quality of the current greenspace system. The basic research materials are urban current land use, greenspace current situation, green space system planning and satellite images of Huaibei in 2006. Supported by GIS , the research chooses the main urban area in Huaibei with an area greater than 10 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of afforestation space as the node, according to the analytic approach of the network, the research establishes the idealized ecological networks, through index alpha , index beta , index gamma, compare their network structure integrality, choose the best network. The paper analyzes with the landscape analysis software Fragstats, uses the method of landscape pattern analytical. It selects the indexes of many kinds of analysis landscape for use, analyzes the systematic current situation of greenspace, greenspace system planning and the idealized ecological network scheme of Huaibei in terms of landscape ecology. It is an effective route to evaluate and improve the greenspace system planning with the ecological network analysis combines with the pattern analysis of the landscape, and the ecological network scheme planning to be made on the greenspace system planning can further improve main quantity and quality with systematic current greenspace of urban area.

articleTitle: The Spatial Data Sharing Web Feature Service in Earthquake Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs a data sharing platform by OpenGIS technology. By using Web feature service (WFS), the spatial data circulation can reduce disaster, and carry on the disaster reduction work. We construct the server based on open source software named GeoServer. By using WFS, users can communicate with the server through the communication protocols and execute feature operation to the raw geography data file, database. For instance it can display feature elements directly, such as destroyed roads, house, bridge, etc. Meanwhile it can realize the real-time disaster data management, thus promote the usability and validity of earthquake disaster data sharing.

articleTitle: The Optimal Procurement Strategies for Online Spot Markets with B2B E-Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The forward contracts have recently emerged for a broad range of commodities and many companies have started to utilize them in addition to their traditional procurement via B2B e-market. This kind of procurement makes the most of the convenience of online e-market and function of risk evasion via forward contracts. We develop and solve mathematical models that determine the optimal order proportion to purchase via forward contracts and the optimal proportion to purchase via online spot e-markets. Considering the time value of the fund, this paper analyzes the pricing of the forward contract upon the floating interest rate. Based on the pricing of the forward contracts, we can make further analysis on the decision model of the enterprises' procurement strategy in B2B e-market.

articleTitle: Studies on Willingness to Pay and Payment Level for Ecological Compensation of the Yellow River Based on CVM - Taking Shandong Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the questionnaire towards the residents living around the Yellow River in Shandong Province, the contingent valuation method (CVM) research suggests that among interviewees who are willing to compensate, yearly payment level of residents' ecological compensation is 184.38 yuan on average. Logit and the linear regression model indicates that the education level and the income level present remarkable positive correlation with the willingness and payment level for ecological compensation, whereas the age has negative correlation with the willingness to pay. For willingness to pay, female has stronger willingness than male.

articleTitle: Tunnel Liner Quality Management with GPR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is regularly applied to examine tunnel liners, roads,railways and runways. Many applications have been pioneering proof-of-concept tests to define the benefits and limitations of GPR. For the quality of tunnel liners major include three parts: (1) the thickness of the liner (2) the Defects of the liner such as the voids , non-compacting area and crack (3) the number, diameter of the rebar and rebar corrosion. There are many situations where GPR signals do contain quantitative information useful for developing data needed for engineering decision making.

articleTitle: Biosorptional Removal of Lead and Cadmium from Water by Waste Materials
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the present study, waste materials like rice bran and pine sawdust were investigated to assess their potential for removal of lead and cadmium from water by the process of biosorption by batch adsorption experiments studies. The obtained results showed that chemical treatment of biomasses, pH and initial concentration of heavy metals highly affect the overall metal sorption capacity of biosorbent. The effect chemical treatment of biomasses on the sorption of heavy metals showed that modified by NaCl greatly enhanced metals removal. The maximal biosorption removals of Pb(II) and Cd(II) were 99.25 and 98.25% on rice bran and 95.25 and 90.21% on pine sawdust at pH 6. The removal of Pb(II) and Cd(II) by rice bran was high than that of pine sawdust. The two metal-biomass sorption processes were well fitted to the Langmuir equation. The two biosorbents presented quite high metals sorption ability, and all seemed to be especially suitable for removal of Pb(II). The two developed adsorbents were successfully applied for the effluent treatment of electroplating industry for Pb(I ) and Cd(II) removal and it was also a potential sorbent for Zn, Ca and Mg. This work showed that rice bran and pine sawdust can be used as efficient biosorbents for the metal ions, representing an effective and environmentally clean utilization of waste matter.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of MPEG-4 AAC Decoder on ARM Embedded System for CMMB Receiver
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: CMMB (China mobile multimedia broadcasting) adopts MPEG-4 HE AAC (high efficiency advanced audio coding) as its sound coding technology in video broadcast. In this paper, we first introduce the decoding flow of MPEG-4 HE AAC and its two key technologies, SBR (spectral band replication) and interbank. The IMDCT function was optimized especially because of its complicated calculation. Then we implemented the decoder into ARM embedded system and analyzed the complexity of each function in Linux OS. Test results indicate that the decoder can decode HE AAC bitstream with real time on the embedded system with ARM920T core.

articleTitle: Logistics Service Management in P. R. China Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competing on service is an absolute must in today's business environment. The globalization of business and the increase in competitive pressures have prompted many firms to develop logistics as a part of their corporate strategy for cost and service advantages, To fully satisfy the increasing requirements of customers for one-stop services, many logistics service providers (LSPs) have taken initiatives to broaden the scope of their services in P.R.China, Based on surveyed ,we found out industry firms hope the third party logistics (3PL) to reduce logistics costs and provide integrated logistics services, 3PL could make logistics strategy to satisfy customers requirements.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis Based Buildup of Index System for Evaluation of Brownfield Redevelopment Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on factor analysis, an index system for evaluation of brownfield redevelopment project is proposed. The index system includes six indicators of Environmental and Health Benefit Indicators, Financial Indicators, Brownfield Site Indicators, Societal Stability Indicators, Policy and Technical Indicators, Performance Indicators, which are extracted by means of principal components analysis from total 27 criteria, which are selected from four dimensions of social and economic, financial and accounting, environmental and health, and prospective value.

articleTitle: Fault Tree Analysis on Ship Drift Emergency of Three Georges Lock
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper conducts the fault tree analysis on ship drift emergency of three Georges lock with the method of safety system engineering, draws a map of fault tree analysis, representing intuitively the basic events which can bring about top events as well as the logic relationships between them, obtains the minimum cut set, minimum path set and structure importance through qualitative analysis of fault tree, and points out the possible ways to prevent the occurrence of accidents.

articleTitle: The Application of Product Data Management in Research and Development of Product
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper bends to the application of product data management in research and development of product. After generally introducing basic conception, keystone, structure of system and function, this paper will go along analyzing requirement of Research and development(R&D) of product. Aiming at the matters of product data management(PDM), the object of this analysis is the process of R&D in Z corporation. Then this paper puts forward the layout of implementing and scheme about PDM. The application of PDM resolves some problems, such as confusion of data, unclear edition, inquiring difficulty and so on. Z corporation explores the means of PDM which adapts to its the present developing.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy ANP Approach to Supplier Selection Based on Fuzzy Preference Programming
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper develops a supplier evaluation approach based on the analytic network process (ANP) and fuzzy synthetic evaluation under a fuzzy environment. Instead of the classical eigenvector prioritization method, employed in the prioritization stage of the ANP, a fuzzy preference programming method is applied, which obtains crisp priorities from inconsistent interval and fuzzy judgments. The resulting fuzzy ANP can enhance the potential of the ANP for dealing with imprecise and uncertain human comparison judgments. Then an integrated FANP and fuzzy synthetic evaluation methodology is proposed for evaluating and selecting the most suitable suppliers. A hypothetical example is presented and the results indicated that the combination of ANP and fuzzy synthetic evaluation provided useful tool to select the optimal supplier.

articleTitle: Analysis on Electronic Commerce Pattern of Vertical B2B in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With rapid development of e-commerce, B2B electronic commerce pattern has been one of the hot issues that people are paying much attention to. The paper is aimed at giving a brief introduction to the classification of B2B pattern and making analysis on the structure of vertical B2B pattern. The biggest threat to the development of vertical B2B is from the comprehensive B2B. By SWOT analysis from the inside of vertical B2B pattern and analysis on its external competition, the paper hopes to give competitive strategy concerning vertical B2B pattern in China.

articleTitle: Construction Enterprise Quality Management System Effectiveness of Impact Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes the index system of construction enterprise quality management system, adopts the real coded accelerating genetic algorithm AHP to evaluate the index system of construction enterprise quality management system. The comparison matrix is firstly constructed on basis of the expert ' s investigation questionnaires, MATLAB7.0 is used to design procedures to determine the relative important weight value of the various elements in various levels, and to transform the comparison matrix consistency checking into the non-linear system optimized question. The case study showed that this method is practicable, the effects of this evaluation are fine, the construction enterprises strengthen the management system operation quality effectively, and promote the development of the enterprises.
