articleTitle: Study on the Estimating Model of Shadow Prices for National Economy Evaluation of Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Shadow price is one of the most important parameters in national economy evaluation. The estimating model of shadow prices are studied based on Input-Output (IO) Analysis and the Input-output table 2005. An approach which uses accounting price ratios to express shadow prices is developed. Some improvements have been made against those past estimations of shadow prices. Case study said this approach has enhanced the credibility for the national economy evaluation system. Meanwhile, it has much higher practicability and maneuverability.

articleTitle: First-Line and Middle Manager IT Usage Intention: A Comparison of TAM, TRA and TPB
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, the appropriateness of TRA, TPB and TAM to predict the first-line and middle manager IT usage intention is compared due to the gap found in prior research and the practical need for more information in this area. Hierarchical regression analysis is conducted with the sample of 156 first-line and middle managers distributed in 73 companies. The results show that TRA is most appropriate to explain the first-line and middle manager IT usage intention compared with TPB and TAM, as both the TPB and the TAM can not yield an increase in the predictive ability over the TRA. Attitude is significant predictor of the first-line and middle manager IT usage intention, while the subjective norm, perceived behavioral control, perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use are not significant predictors of the first-line and middle manager IT usage intention.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Oriented Spatial Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since 2000, logistics becomes a popular subject and logistics industry becomes one of developed industries to government at all levels. Whatever on its operation level, management level or strategic level, logistics has a strong trend to use spatial data mining technology as one of its foundations. There are massive data information and much implicit and valuable knowledge in the database of logistics oriented GIS database. However, presently GIS is mainly limited to the collection, query, and statistic of data, so it can not discover effective relations and rules. We can mine massive spatial data which managed by GIS, analyze GIS data at higher level, and discover the important knowledge by the combination of data mining and GIS. The paper opens a new way for the development of logistics industry through knowledge discovery and data mining, associates GIS component MapX, offers a spatial data mining system architecture based on the MapX, and realizes model data preprocessing.

articleTitle: Dual-Network Model and Its Application in Algorithms for Solving the Designated Vertex Shortest Path Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we presented a dual-network model to solve the designated vertex shortest path (SP) problem. First we made bi-directional search using Bellman-Ford algorithm on the undirected network graph and labeled the vertexes with the shortest distance to build a dual-network. Then we proposed and proved the sum value theorem and the difference value theorem of vertexes. The theorems show that the length of the shortest path from source to destination passing an arbitrary vertex is equal to the sum value of the vertex, while the shortest path passing two vertexes will pass the vertex with smaller difference value firstly. Based on the theorems, we presented two procedures for solving the shortest path problem from source to destination passing one or two designated vertexes. The complexity analysis showed that our algorithms are better than Bellman-Ford algorithm in these cases. Finally we presented a computational example.

articleTitle: A Semantic DOM Approach for Webpage Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of electronic technology and e-commerce, technology for Web pages has attracted a lot of research efforts which becomes one of the hottest topics recently. This paper has proposed a semantic DOM (SDOM) approach for information extraction of e-commerce Web pages. With the combination of content and structure information, the precision and recall can achieve a good result which is shown in our experiments on listpage and tablepage data sets.

articleTitle: Integrating the Kano Model into Designing Service Quality of Online-Shopping Web to Enhance Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The customer satisfaction is one of important factors for service performance of online shopping Web. The Kano model is used to better understand the relationship between performance criteria and customer satisfaction, and to resolve trade-off dilemma in multiple-criteria optimization by identifying the key criteria in customer satisfaction. This study presents an approach incorporating the Kano model to obtain the optimal combination of service quality elements for online shopping Webs. On the basis of the study of the service quality of e-commerce, this study identifies 23 factors of service quality which impact of customer satisfaction of online shopping, then Carries out a customer satisfaction survey on online shopping, 173 valid questionnaires recovered. Based on Kano model analysis, the service quality elements can be divided into three categories that are the basic factor quality, performance quality, and attractive quality.

articleTitle: CodeAuditor: A Vulnerability Detection Framework Based on Constraint Analysis and Model Checking
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Open source applications have flourished over recent years. Meanwhile security vulnerabilities in such applications have grown. Since manual code auditing is error-prone, time-consuming and costly, automatic solutions have become necessary. In this paper we address program vulnerabilities by static code analysis. First, we use flow-insensitive and interprocedural constraint-based analysis to extract the vulnerability detection model from the source code. Second, we employ model checking to solve the model. In addition, we do alias analysis to improve the correctness and precision of the detection model. The presented concepts are targeted at the general class of buffer-related vulnerabilities and can be applied to the detection of vulnerability types such as buffer overflow, format string attack, and code injection. CodeAuditor, the prototype implementation of our methods, is targeted at detecting buffer overflow vulnerabilities in C source code. It can be regarded as a vulnerability framework in which a variety of analysis and model checking tools can be incorporated. With this tool, 18 previously unknown vulnerabilities in six open source applications were discovered and the observed false positive rate was at around 23%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Co-Integration and Volatility Spillover Effects between Chinese and International Agricultural Products Futures Markets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Daily futures data of hard wheat, cotton, soybean and corn from commodity exchanges of America Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT), Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange (CZCE) and Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE) are analyzed in this paper. First, the co-integration test and Granger causality test are used to study the integration relationship between Chicago and Chinese futures markets. Then, multivariate GARCH (MGARCH) model is used to analyze the risk spillover effect of price volatility between them. At last, the results of the analysis are given.

articleTitle: Foundation and Analysis on the Economic Effect Model of Manufacturing Enterprise Accessory Inventory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the accessory inventory system of manufacturing enterprise, n accessory providers and one manufacturer are selected to research on. Basing on the operating status of the system and using the inventory control theory of operational research, economic effect models of every participate enterprise are set up. The paper also analyzes and discusses the models, and the important significance of the models to optimize enterprises, accessory inventory system and the follow-up theory research are pointed out.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction Model of Soil Moisture Based on Wavelet De-Noising
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Soil moisture is one of the most important factors which affect crop yields directly. In recent years, although upland field area increased not too much, agricultural water resources utilization increased which has led to a waste of water resources in Sanjiang Plain. In order to solve the above problem, wavelet de-noising theory and time series analysis are adopted to analyze measured data of soil moisture after standardization. Then time series forecasting model of soil moisture based on wavelet de-noising is established to simulate and predict soil moisture in Farm Qixing. The results of precision testing and comparative analysis show that the model has high validity and reliability. The model can reveal the time change regulation of area soil moisture and provide scientific basis for reasonably making upland field irrigation system and making full use of soil water resource in Farm Qixing and even the Sanjiang Plain.

articleTitle: Research of Building the Customer Knowledge Acquisition Model: Based on Social Capital
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The core of customer knowledge acquisition model based on social capital is that how to promote acquiring the knowledge about customer and knowledge from customer through enhance the structural dimension, cognitive dimension and relational dimension of social capital, with the acquired knowledge changing into business-friendly knowledge after refining and integration as well. Moreover, the specific implementation strategies are also reflected in corresponding management inspiration.

articleTitle: Developing Spatial Information Framework for Urban Computing Environment: A Socio-Spatial Computing Framework for Smart Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Our research goal is to construct a novel spatial information framework for smart urban environment. The aim is to set up a system architecture which can demonstrate how urban dwellers make use of mobile platform and context-aware services in public settings by means of dynamic place information. The proposed urban computing framework with spatial information services is firstly introduced in this paper. To accomplish the goal, related works are studied and analyzed in the aspect of required components to construct urban computing environment. A new frame work composed of spatial data model, hardware and software is introduced. At the end, a prototype and a test-bed are constructed to demonstrate our idea.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Multi-Modal Transport of Full Loads with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multimodal transport of full loads with time limit is a complex problem. This paper analyzes conceptions and features of multimodal transport deeply. And, this paper probes into its organizing mode, which are collaborative and link-up multimodal transport. Thus, mode of multimodal transport can be selected based on virtual transport network. Finally, this paper presents a combination optimization model for multimodal transport of full loads with time windows.

articleTitle: Impact of Wage on Labor Productivity in Chinese Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, the construction industry is a labor-intense industry. The labor productivity heavily influences the development of the construction industry. Using the framework of VAR model, this paper studies the impact of wage on labor productivity in Chinese construction industry based on the data from 1984 to 2007 by exploiting ADF unitroot and Johansen co-integration test and impulse-function analysis model. The results have released that intensive wage input in three major units in construction industry, State-downed Units, Collective-owned Units, and other types of ownership, is responsible for labor productivity elevation the long run. This finding could become a fundamental make an effective strategy to promote the increasing productivity of China's construction.

articleTitle: Simulation of Epidemic Spread in Social Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The epidemic spread is definitely connected to the human social relationships and activities, and as a typical complex network, social network could be used to describe the relationships and activities between human beings. This paper proposed the recovery method for the incomplete relationship data in real complex social network according to statistical sampling. The epidemic spread model based on strength values of different relationships in social network was implemented according to the traditional SEIR model. The real demographic data were applied for simulation and analysis of epidemic spread in social network. The results showed the epidemic spread in social network is compatible with the macrocosmic spread and expressed the clustering characteristic of social network.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Primitive Classifiers without Features Selection in Credit Scoring
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Finding effective classifier is important because it will help people make an objective decision instead of them having to rely merely on intuitive experience. With the rapid growth in the credit industry, credit scoring classifiers are being widely used for credit admission evaluation. Effective classifiers have been regarded as a critical topic, with the related departments striving to collect huge amounts of data to avoid making the wrong decision. This study proposes three well-known classifiers, namely, k-nearest neighbor (KNN), support vector machine (SVM), and neural network (NN), to find the highest accuracy rate classifier without features selection. Two credit data sets from University of California, Irvine (UCI) are chosen to evaluate the accuracy of various classifiers. The results are compared and a nonparametric Wilcoxon signed rank test will be performed to show if there is any significant difference between these classifiers. Performance of the KNN classifier is better but not significant among the two data sets, whereas SVM classifier is significant superior to NN classifier in the German data set. The result of this study suggests that the primitive classifiers did not achieve satisfactory classification results. Combining with effective feature selection approaches in finding optimal subsets is a promising method in the field of credit scoring.

articleTitle: Evaluate the Performance of CRM in Logistics Enterprises Based on AnyLogic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The importance and performance of customer relationship management (CRM) have been central issues since many years. Recent papers focus on finding what factors impact the CRM and evaluating the performance of CRM. This paper puts forward a CRM evaluation model, which includes two agents (logistic enterprise and customers) and an index (customer life value) to evaluate CRM. Then, a mathematics model for CLV is built as the principle of the simulation model. The simulation system, aiming at estimating what factors impact the implementation of CRM, is build by using AnyLogic software. Finally, we know what factors impact the performance mostly, and give some suggestion about how to improve the performance.

articleTitle: Safety Risk Management of Adjacent Building during Urban Tunnel Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the congested urban areas, tunneling-induced ground movements may cause a serious damage to the adjacent buildings. Consequently, the safety risk management (SRM) of structures during tunnel excavation is critical for ensuring safety (including personnel safety inside the tunnel and safety of structures above) and construction quality. This paper describes the importance of SRM based on some building-damaged accidents first, and constituted the basic concept of SRM with the model mainly including risk identification, risk analysis, risk assessment, risk handling and risk supervision, etc. Accordingly, risk management system can be established for structures safety guarantee during urban tunnel construction.

articleTitle: AHP-Based Evaluation of Information Service Quality of Information Center Web Portals in High-Tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, web portals have become a useful way for high-tech information centers providing information services for high-tech enterprises. The importance of evaluating the information service quality of these Web portals has been recognized by both information service researchers and practitioners. By applying an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) approach, a hierarchical structure evaluation criteria model has been constructed, and the global priority weight of each criterion in the model has also been determined in this study. According to the model, a comprehensive score method has been used to evaluate the information service quality of ten primary high-tech industry information center Web portals in China. The findings of this study provide a useful instrument for researchers who wish to measure the information service quality of Web portals, as well as for high-tech information center managers who want to enhance their web portals service performance.

articleTitle: A Design and Implementation of LDPC Encoder Based on Mobile-Multimedia-Broadcasting System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper gives a channel coding solution which meets the national standards of mobile multimedia broadcasting, the result of simulation shows that QC-LDPC has a good performance while the signals with a extremely low SNR transmitted in AWGN channel. According to the standards, it analyzes the method of implementing the QC-LDPC with FPGA. For the specialty of the quasi-cycle coding matrix, it adopt a combination of pipelining and parallel architecture, with which it could optimize the coder in structure, memory space and sequential logic, also raises the coding efficiency. It implements the LDPC real-time coder based on the T-MMB. The coder meets the requirements both in real-time performance and resource utilization, thus it has a good practical value.

articleTitle: Hybrid Genetic-Saving Algorithm and Its Application in Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The hybrid algorithm, i.e. hybrid genetic-saving algorithm, is the combination of genetic algorithm and saving heuristic algorithm. It makes full use of different search structures in related procedures, keeps the merits of global and local optimization of the two methods respectively, and enhances the capability of optimization and solving efficiency.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Third-Party Online Payment Based on PEST Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, as an integral component of e-commerce, the online payment especially the third-party payment accomplishes rapid development and expansion, and formed a new industry, but at the same time, this industry also faces with various risks impeding development. By using the PEST model, this article analyzed the detailed risks faced by third-party payment companies in political, economic, social and technological aspects. In the mean time, taking the Alipay as an example, this article also provided a theoretical reference for companies to identify and deal with these risks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Short-Distance Wireless Voice Communication Technology Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Determinants of the Success of ISO 9000 Implementation and What That Means: The Case of Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Survey data from 441 firms in Taiwan were collected and used to test the theoretical model. Based on structural equation modeling, our empirical analysis demonstrates several key findings: (1) Good underlying pre-implementation planning is a solid foundation for ISO implementation. (2) Employee empowerment is essential, because it internalizes the need for maintenance activities. (3) Successful ISO implementation depends most on maintenance activities in, and this must become part of the routine-part of the organization. (4) These constructs are a series of chain, rather than parallel components, a firm cannot simply select some of the ISO 9000 practices discussed above and expect to realize full operational benefits from implementing partial ISO 9000.

articleTitle: Critical Factors Influencing the Successful Development of e-Micropayment Program
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Micropayment is common in retail outlets and public transport system. Electronic micropayment systems have been introduced to reduce the need for users to carry cash. However, many of such systems are not successful. Hence there is a need to understand the critical factors which help such systems to succeed. This study uses EasyCard, an electronic wallet widely used in northern Taiwan, for such an investigation. Through the DEMATEL method, this study shows that network effect plays a very important role in the success of e-micropayment system. The factors influencing the development of e-micropayment programs are highly inter-related and in fact, re-enforce one another, leading to positive feedback and bandwagon effect. It is found that factors such as reliability, more value-add locations, acceptance by merchants and users not only increases the popularity of the system, it also affects and re-enforces other factors through a positive feedback loop.

articleTitle: Researches on the Efficient Frontier of Mean-CVaR under Normal Distribution Condition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we present the mean-CVaR model under normal distribution condition on the basis of mean-variance model and obtain the calculation method of CVaR. Through comparing mean-CVaR model with mean-variance model, we find out that for any given confidence level, if the minimum CVaR portfolio exists, it lies above the minimum variance portfolio on the mean-variance efficient frontier and mean-CVaR method is more effective than mean-variance method as a risk management tool. An in-depth research on the efficient frontier of CVaR show that when the confidence level at which investors compute CVaR is not large enough, there would exist no mean-CVaR boundary and efficient frontier. Finally a calculation example show the result from using mean-CVaR portfolio model is more efficient than from using mean-variance portfolio model.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Chaotic Image Encryption Based on LFSR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the flaw precision degeneration under the computer limited precision, chaotic encryption can not be widely used in practice. Here proposes a novel method to solve the problem based on LFSR compounded system, which is proved to be effective and have many good security properties.

articleTitle: Secure Two-Party Multi-Dimensional Vector Comparison Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Secure two-party vector dominance means that the two sides of the computation want to judge whether their vectors have the dominance relation securely, a new problem which is called multi-dimensional vector comparison problem is proposed based on the vector dominance in this paper, it can be applied in many commercial areas, such as auction, bidding and so on. Two solutions are provided for this problem, using multiplication protocol and scalar products protocol respectively. Furthermore, we introduce the random algorithm to solve the problem, analyze the security, correctness and complexity, point out the differences between these two methods, and simulate by experiments.

articleTitle: Software Company Process Management and Process Audit Research
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, software outsourcing in China is growing rapidly. In the research and analysis on the status quo of China's software outsourcing industry, there are characteristics and main problems: most users being local small-scale enterprise users, a relatively dispersed software outsourcing market, deficient project management capability, deficient process audit mechanism etc. Therefore, the outsourcing industry in China are at a primary level of being a coding factory, and has the urgent need for becoming the contract dealer of business process outsourcing as a whole to enhance its developments and changes. Special requirements in the software outsourcing business, such as those on project management skill, domain knowledge, and staff language skills, are analyzed. The importance of software process management and the implementation steps of process enhancement are described. The necessity of process audit and the main steps as well as key points of implementing process audit are also described. For example, establish process audit policy and audit process, form audit team, select appropriate audit method, conduct audit and submit audit report etc. Finally, the following points are made in favor of China's software outsourcing business development proposals, which are creating the software outsourcing corporate model, introducing process management culture, and establishing process audit mechanism to enhance their competitiveness as well as to improve the product and process quality.

articleTitle: Nonfunctional Requirements Validation - A Game Theoretic Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network security requirements have recently gained widespread attention in the requirements engineering community. Despite this, it is not yet clear how to systematically validate these requirements given the complexity and uncertainty characterizing modern networks. Traditionally, network security requirements specification has been the results of a reactive process. This however, limited the immunity property of the software systems that depended on these networks. Security requirements specification prerequisite a proactive approach. Networks' infrastructure is constantly under attack by hackers and malicious software that aim to break into computers. To combat these threats, network designers need sophisticated security validation techniques that will guarantee the minimum level of security for their future networks. To that end, this paper presents a game-theoretic approach to security requirements validation. An introduction to game theory is presented along with a case study that demonstrates the application of the approach in a hypothetical network topology.

articleTitle: An Approach of User Community Preference Discovery Applied in IPTV Personalized Interactive Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: While the development of converged networks has led to the rapid increasing of IPTV content and service complexity, it is more and more difficult for IPTV subscribers to find in time the media content that they desire, thus effecting the consumption of IPTV media content service. This paper proposes a user community preference discovery strategy based on ant colony clustering algorithm, and presents the system solution to satisfy users' personalized service demands. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is verified via simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research Method of Customer Churn Crisis Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tells the basic concept of customer churn crisis. It provides a method of customer churn crisis based on decision tree. Also it describes how to apply the decision tree method analyzing the basic business customer information to get the characteristics of the customer churn and customer churn rules. Based on this analysis, businesses can improve customer relations in a targeted manner and avoid customer churn. The analysis experiment of customer churn risks on decision tree is illustrated deliberately based on the data from an enterprise, and experimental results are discussed. The experiment results show that the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on the City Logistics Development Evaluation System Based on Fuzzy Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Combining with the theory of fuzzy mathematics, an evaluation system of city logistics development level is built up, in order to find an effective way to evaluate a city logistics development level accurately and find out the constraining factors in the city logistics development process. Taking Wuhan city as an example, the evaluation indexes are fixed, and each index is given a suitable weight coefficient, then put into the evaluation model to compute and get the final result, which gives the overall evaluation of the logistics level in Wuhan city. The evaluation system is helpful to the effective improvements and acceleration of the city's economic development.

articleTitle: City Energy Management by AC Commissioning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The situation of energy consumption within a city especially by AC (air conditioning) systems is introduced in this paper. Due to the vast amount of energy consumption of AC systems, the reasonable design, optimal operation and efficient management of AC systems are inevitable and necessary to the whole city energy management. To achieve these objectives, the ideal AC systematic modeling, the establishment of optimal systematic pattern, the verification of systematic characteristics, practical approaches of fault diagnosis of AC systems should be taken as the premises and the most elementary works. AC commissioning is a theoretical system and a practical and efficient approach for AC systems including all the functions above referred to. The concept, theory, process of AC commissioning and the effect of AC commissioning which contribute to city energy management (CEM) are also introduced and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Validation of Course Prerequisites Based on Student Grade Using Fuzzy Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: One of the most valued approaches for identifying and assigning course prerequisites relies on statistical techniques. We propose a new statistical approach for validating prerequisites based on fuzzy association rules. Fuzzy association rules provide strong tools for mining quantitative data and representing dependencies between data. An experiment based on real student data from our department is conducted and some findings are reported.

articleTitle: Study from Building Density to Building 3D Density
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Building spatial density is presented to describe the urban fabric on the basis of the research on the urban fabric from three dimensions, which is as form of city characteristics. Evaluation system for the building 3D density is founded according to the theory of "figure-ground relation" and the algorithm for building density and floor-area ratio (FAR). This evaluation system puts forward a series of quantitative algorithms, together with a qualitative approach to 3D-fabric-based schema, to rationally describe the density of the buildings in certain district and the changes of spatial structure or the trends of spatial sprawl. The agreement between the data statistics and analysis on certain samples shows the applicability of the system and the accuracy of the computational methods. This system can help to estimation on land-use, as well as to urban design.

articleTitle: The Study of Harmonious Together-Development Model for Large Project with the Community during the Construction Stage of Shanghai 2010 Expo China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyses the mutual impact of large project with the nearby community, designs a harmonious together-development model for the case of Shanghai 2010 Expo China. The academic reason for the model is analyzed by the game theory explanation specially using construction project department and peripheral community as the two study objects. The effect of this model is showed finally.

articleTitle: A Petri Net-Based Model for Aspect-Oriented Web Service Composition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aspect-oriented programming is an emerging programming paradigm. Now the concept of aspect-orientation stretches over other development phases and other domains. Many researches have focused on aspect-oriented Web service composition domain. However, none of them offers a formal foundation for the aspect-oriented service composition. In this paper, we propose a Petri net-based algebra for aspect-oriented Web service composition. In our model, Web service composition is modeled as basic composition net and aspect nets, and then weaving mechanism is provided to compose the basic net and aspect nets. The formal semantics of the composition operation is expressed in terms of Petri nets. Thus, the properties of woven composite service can be verified and analyzed based on the underlying Petri net.

articleTitle: Analysis of Collaborative Decision-Making Consistency of Warship Formation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper deals with the collaborative campaign of pair-warships, whose decision-making process is described. Considering behavior and cognition factors of decision-makers, the mathematical model of two-decision-maker decision-making process with superior-subordinate relationship is constructed subsequently. Based on this issue collaborative decision-making consistency and its measurement are defined, and then the experimental environment of collaborative decision-making consistency is conceived, through which we can analyze the factors that influence the collaborative decision-making consistency. The mathematical model of two-decision-maker is extended to a more commonly form, the applicability of the model and the relations between influence factors are further discussed lastly.

articleTitle: Research on Sedimentary Fund of the Third-Party Payment Platform Based on Population Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: They had an in-depth study on microcosmic formation mechanism of sedimentary fund of third-party payment platform, and emphatically analyzed main sources of sedimentary fund and main factors which impact the scale of sedimentary fund. On this basis, They proposed a measure model of sedimentary fund of the third party payment platform based on population model and estimated the scale of sedimentary fund. Utilizing population policy, they forecasted the macro-development trend of sedimentary fund. These research results will provide the theoretical guidance for the patulous research on risk, supervision, law, and techniques of sedimentary fund of third-party payment platform and the scientific basis for survival and development strategy, early risk warning of financial institutions, financial supervision and perfection of the correlative legal system etc.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Construction Management System for Villages and Small Towns Based on Dissipative Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Management System-Based Model of E-Learning for Higher Education in Chinese Context
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The successful implementation of knowledge management system in many firms has shed light to the possibility of its application to the E-learning for higher education in Chinese context. Based upon knowledge management theory and in-depth analysis of functions of knowledge management system, this paper illustrates the key problems faced by E-learning in Chinese higher education, and build a knowledge management system-based model of E-learning that can share educational resources and meet the diverse education demands effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: A Long-Term Learning Algorithm in CBIR Based on Log-Analyzing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, the amount of images increase drastically. Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) has been proposed to efficiently manage these images. Traditional CBIR system extracts the low features of image automatically. Because of the difference between human comprehension and machine, the search results provided by CBIR system always can not satisfy the user's need. So relevance feedback has been used in content-based image retrieval (CBIR) to bridge the semantic gap, which is existing between image low-level features and high-level human perceptions. This paper proposes an extended-judging algorithm to analyze the information which includes both positive relevance and negative relevance. It uses the feedback log data and index table to expand the set of relevant images, and judging images in database by the current feedback record. Results show that compared with the traditional long-term learning method, the retrieval performance can be improved apparently.

articleTitle: Research on Traceability Integrated Logistics System of Dairy Products
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Establishing traceability systems is one of the effective approaches to dairy products safety. Based on the traceability mechanism of Integrated logistics, the article marks dairy products effectively and designs a architecture of traceability systems using modern information technology, after analyses the main security problem and its influencing factors of the dairy products logistics system. The article presents the process and characteristics of the architecture. Some advices are proposed to actualizing the traceability systems.

articleTitle: Product Master Structure for Product Family
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper focused on the product knowledge modeling for product family to reuse the product information and configure rapidly product instance for customer requires. The product master structure for product family was introduced in the paper based on design structure matrix (DSM). The hierarchy dependency relationship in product master structure was expressed by the component-based DSM. The tabular layout of article characteristics (ACT) was introduced to model the components and parts. The parametric dependency relationship in the ACT can be expressed by the dependency hyper graph and parameter-based DSM. The transfer between them was also given. The engineer can reuse the product structure information and product design process information. A PMS for the bearing seat of steam turbine was presented.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Support System in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the extensive application of various e-government systems, the decision support system for e-government (DSS for e-government) is required urgently. How to construct an effective data platform to provide support for government decision-making is a complicated matter. This paper analyzes the framework of the DSS for E-government firstly, which totally includes four subsystems: data warehouse and its management system, model library and its management system, knowledge library and its management system, and human-computer interaction system. Secondly, the paper puts forward five requirements of data processing in DSS for e-government from different aspects: processing all kinds of government data, integrating heterogeneous data together, centralized processing of various data, finding correlative data timely and high data security. Finally, it studies several key techniques refer to the development of a DSS for E-government, those techniques are mainly about data warehouse, online analysis and process, data mining, modeling, interface, knowledge representation and reasoning, and system integration.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm for Partner Selection in Market Oriented Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In our previous paper, we proposed a novel combinatorial auction (CA) based cloud market model for trading services that allows cloud providers (CPs) to make groups and submit their bids collaboratively as a single bid for winning the auction. But to find a good combination of CP partners and make groups is a NP-hard problem. Since each provider only has limited information about other providers, past collaborative task information (i.e. no. of times collaboratively win the auctions, failed to make groups, etc.) needs to be analyzed and utilized for partner selection. We call it multi-task and multi-objective optimization problem. To solve this problem, in this paper, we propose a hybrid algorithm that utilizes artificial neural network (ANN) for gathering and analyzing information about previous tasks and then uses multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA) to solve the partner selection problem. Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Research of Self-Adaptive Web Page Parser Based on Templates and Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web pages parsing is a concerned topic in recent years, how to get rid of human intervention and formulate extraction rules of subject information from a large number of Web pages at the fastest and most accurate speed has becoming an important research point in this field. This paper proposes a frame of self-adaptive web page parser based on templates and rules. Firstly, it uses the noise filter algorithm to filter irrelevant nodes and invalid nodes, and then combines the ways of page template and heuristic rule to generate extraction rules, at the same time it can adjust extraction rules dynamically according to external factors through automatic detection mechanism. Using this frame to generate parsers has better self-adaptability, being able to generate extraction rules better, and being able to locate and extract subject information better. The experimental result shows the effectiveness of the parser.

articleTitle: Study on Science Management of City Night Lighting Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: City night light environment can bring us some good or bad influences, therefore science management on it can promote night life quality and service environment. Functions of night light environment management for cities development, including the night economic stimulation, the night light pollution control, the night life and traffic security guarantee, were discussed. Evaluation of night light environment for science management, including the brightness zoning strategy, the sky glow scale for macro-control, was analyzed. Finally night sky brightness evaluation program and method for science management were summed up. The analyses results indicated that there are some reconcilable conflicts in the development of night light environment at present research. The good solvent method is to establish the system of management and evaluation system to monitor night light environment.

articleTitle: Web 2.0 Tools in the Context of Integrated Communication: New Technologies Revolutionizing the Business Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper wishes to analyze the impact of web 2.0 tools on the business world, particularly focusing on the ways in which companies can extend their communication channels with customers by making use of new, Internet revolutionizing applications. Companies used to be able to establish themselves when and in which way they would initiate the dialogue with their customers. Nowadays the roles have changed to some extent, as it is mostly the customers who decide with which company, through which channel and in which point in time they would like to communicate. So the business world has to adapt and in some cases catch up with the new era of the Internet, which has brought up some very easy-to-use (Web 2.0) applications. A considerable part of our paper will therefore deal with trying to explain these applications and how they can bring and improvement in the business life. Looking at the big picture, we will try to underline some of the most important implications of implementing such tools and last but not least pin point a few ways in which researching the topic of "enterprise 2.0" could go further, exploring other interesting territories.

articleTitle: Pollution Mechanism and Control Strategies of Corn Deep Processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article proposed the pollution control strategies of corn deep processing industry, which combined the characteristics and the pollution statuses of the union industry, to promote economy and protect environment. Then two aspects were discussed: cleaning production technics and recycle economic developed pattern of corn deep processing industry in Jilin Province. The results indicated that through the cleaning production technics and constructing ecology industrial chain of corn deep processing, it could realize to save the resources and energy availably and utilize the byproducts and residues effectively and could get better environmental, economic and social efficiency, therefore, it could promote sustainable and healthy development of corn deep processing industry.

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment on Risks of Enterprise-Customer Collaborative Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprise-customer Collaborative innovation is an effective way for enterprise to accumulate and innovate knowledge. This paper analyzes key risk factors existed in enterprise-customer collaborative innovation process, establishes matter element model for risk assessment, illustrates the usage of model and comes up with qualitative and quantitative assessment for the risk level of enterprise-customer collaborative innovation, which will provides new measures and a train of thought for risk decision-making in collaborative innovation process.

articleTitle: The Application of E-Commerce in Food Traceability System - Based on the Analysis of Consumers' Behavior of Online Searching for Traceability Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-commerce is applied to food traceability system. Chinese consumers just contact this new method which is acquiring food traceability information by network. This paper makes use of 1757 sample data collected from thirteen cities and builds logit model to analyze consumers' usage of this new method to promote the application and integration of ecommerce in food traceability system. The result indicates that consumers' behavior of online searching for traceability information is strongly affected by factors like their network usage capability, knowledge and attitude to information searching methods, trust on the information and income.

articleTitle: A New Design of Remote Diagnosis System for Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internet have changed people's life completely, and development of wireless communication network makes life more colorful, making so many dreams into reality. The whole world is filled with network. This paper introduced Internet and wireless network into medical image remote diagnosis system, which is helpful for its all-round development and suitable to meet the social needs. In this paper, the doctor wherever he is, as long as has a computer or mobile phones can be connected to Internet or wireless network, can login diagnosis system, browse the patients' images, do some image processing, and also can send reports. Although at present reports of this form does not have legal effectiveness, this paper provided a new thought for development of medical image remote diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Incentive and Supervision Mechanism within High Quality Pork Supply Chain Based on Principal-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For applying supply chain management, constructing strategic partnership among hoggeries, slaughtering and processing enterprises, and supermarkets, is the effective method to solve pork quality and safety problem in China at present. Based on the analysis of principal-agent issue in high quality pork supply chain, this paper comprehensively considers the elements of material incentive, mental incentive, supervision and punishment, and constructs and analyses incentive-supervision model of high quality pork supply chain. It is shown that incentive and supervision, material incentive and mental incentive play important roles in improving cooperation among hoggeries, slaughtering and processing enterprises, and supermarkets, and decreasing immoral interest coefficient, cooperation cost coefficient, and supervision cost coefficient will be benefit to avoiding immoral behaviours of hoggeries and supermarkets.

articleTitle: The Impact of Information upon the Exploitation Sequence of Exhaustible Resources: A Searching Model and the Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many scholars have studied the optimum exploitation sequence of the exhaustible resource, but one of its common characteristics is to establish a planning model and to seek the optimum solution under different bound conditions. This paper establishes a model from the angle of information searching and reveals the motives of the arrangement of exploitation sequence for the contemporary people. This model analyzes the mechanism of technical progress, exploitation reserves, information symmetry and searching cost in the system. The study finds out there is common influence of technology and reserves in the allocation of the exhaustible resources. The best degree of information symmetry in the exploitation sequence system is a special value decided by the increasing technical progress, the increasing exploitation reserves and single phase searching cost.

articleTitle: Study on Customer False Failure Returns Policies and Supply Chain Performance in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, decision models of a supply chain system consisting of one e-tailer and a group of consumers were established for issues of false failure returns in e-business. Considering the consumer's strategic decisions, the optimal price, optimal stocking quantity, and optimal return price as well as the critical selling cost based on e-business platform under the three different returns policies were given. In addition, the three return policies as well as their impacts on the supply chain performance were compared and discussed. Our results show that when product's purchasing/production cost or the salvage value is very low, no return policy is optimal compared with the full return policy, while the partial return policy is always superior to the full return policy for the supplier/manufacturer.

articleTitle: An Ancient Hydraulic Engineering: Safety Running of LingQu Canal, Guangxi in China and Its Thought of Environmental Geotechnical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Lingqu canal has been established about two thousand years, and it is still safely on working now. It conceived a lot of excellent construct techniques and plain thought of environmental geotechnical engineering, worthing being studied by the present engineer of hydroelectricity engineering. Especially for the engineering of channeling to transfer water in southward river into northward river in China, which channel will cross different river drainage area and channel water in large quantity for a long distance, it has extremely significance to summarize and abstract the key points of Lingqu canal construction and to sum up its scientific ideas. The idea of people-water in harmony development is the main cause to make Ling channel, the ancient notable hydraulic engineering, run safely. Under this idea, the ancient hydraulic engineering, by way of adjusting measures to suit to local conditions, planning rationally and reducing the disturbance to nature, successfully avoided or reduced the occur of environmental geotechnical engineering problem, skillfully used the assembly of projects to reduce hydraulic engineering problem. These experiences deserve to study deeply.

articleTitle: Quantifying Model of 3-Echelon Supply Chain Coordination Complexity Information Entropy Based
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering research progress of complexity study and characteristic of supply chain coordination, from the relation between the complexity of a system and the amount of information which is needed to describe the state of a system, this paper proposes a quantifying model of 3-echelon supply chain coordination complexity information entropy based. The model includes two parts: supplier-manufacturer interface entropy model and manufacturer-retailer interface entropy model. Finally, through an example, gives the value of supply chain coordinating complexity and analyzes the results.

articleTitle: Research on Work Breakdown Structure of IT Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Work breakdown structure of IT project is one basic part of IT project management. IT project valuation and price, IT project objective control, IT project procurement and IT project contract management are all connected with IT work breakdown structure. This paper studies IT work breakdown structure and the meaning of each level including IT project, monomial works, unit works, subsection works and subentry works by analyzing the purpose of IT work breakdown structure. Based on the research above, this paper makes a detailed research on the breakdown of monomial works including communication engineering, software development, system integration and Website construction, thus putting forward IT work breakdown structure and breakdown structure of the four monomial works mentioned above.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of Investor Relationship Management and Investment Satisfaction in Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the review of the relevant researches in the field of investor relationship management, this research analyzed the relationship between investor relationship management and investment satisfaction, developed a theoretical model, and made an empirical test. A sample of 241 investors of listed companies was used to test the model we presented. The result indicates that investor relationship management has a positive effect on governance structure, financial performance and investment satisfaction. At the same time, listed companies' governance structure and financial performance play partly intermediate roles in building and sustaining investment satisfaction.

articleTitle: The Application of Key Account Management in Chinese Aluminum Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the context of economic globalization, enterprises are now facing fiercer competition than ever from all sides. Key Account Management (KAM) has become the focus of marketing practice. This paper first briefly introduces the researches of the western KAM from the aspects of the resource, concept and execution etc., then points out the inadequacies in the existing researches and practical implementation. This paper has examined the KAM's implementation at Aluminum Corporation of China (CHINALCO), the biggest aluminum enterprise in China. Under marketing environment in China, the paper puts forward a model of two levels of KAM innovation that leads to the success. The results from the research also indicate that the classic KAM theories in western countries are not totally applicable to the Chinese enterprises. The paper also aims at offering certain practical basis to further enrich the Chinese KAM theory.

articleTitle: Empirical research on Information Flow between Share A and Share H Based on Price-Discovery Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article tests the information flow between Share A and share H adopting the common actor contribution method, which belongs to the price-discovery theory. We discover that in bear market information flow is lower relative to that in bull market. In bear market, information flow between closing price of share A and share H is largely the same as that of closing price of share H and opening price of share A. While In bull market, information flow between closing price of share A and share H is higher than closing price of share H and opening price of share A.

articleTitle: Credit Contract Selection and Wholesalers' Optimal Inventory Model under the Circumstances of Delay Payments
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It has demonstrated in previous studies that when the retailer confronted with the challenge of budget limitation or capital shortage, vendor financing could create value for the wholesalers and synchronize the supply chain at certain point as well. This paper discusses the relationship between the number of days delayed in payment and wholesale prices, wholesalers' order quantity, the initial capital (capacity to pay). And it studies the strategy selection of wholesalers on credit contract and the optimal inventory in large and medium size perishable item market under the circumstances of delay payment by retailers.

articleTitle: Ecological Research on Dependent Factors of Industries' Value-Added
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is committed to promoting the development of high-tech industry, and clarity of the evolution rules of high-tech industries is very important for making industrial policies. This paper presents development rules of high-tech industries from the view of relationship between innovation feature factors and value-added with statistics data from National Bureau of Statistics by dual-density dependent model and density dependence model. It was found that the R&D investment generated direct stronger promotion role for value-added growth than new product development investment (NPDI), but value-added redistributed more resources for NPDI than R&D investment in turn. Comparative analysis with the communication industry testified this conclusion.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Safety Problems in the Settlement's Spatial Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Minimizing the Makespan in Hybrid Flow Shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper propose a genetic algorithm based on extended Giffler & Thompson (EGT) procedure for hybrid flow shop (HFS) scheduling problem. In this method, each individual represents a complete schedule. The crossover and mutation operators are designed based on EGT algorithm. This algorithm is also used to generate initial population. Therefore, the search space is restricted to the active schedule space. Last, the performance of this algorithm is analyzed by computational experiments using benchmark instances. The results suggest that the proposed algorithm can find optimal solutions for all the easy problems, while optimal or near-optimal solutions for relatively hard problems.

articleTitle: Design and Achievement of the Single Sign-On Base on the CGSP Security Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An ideal grid system through the use of grid middleware platform. Shielding bottom hardware and software information. Completely transparent to the users computing environment.lt is based on the CERNET network CGSP provided a complete set of grid services to support platform.lt is integration the education and scientific research systems of the various resources. Shielding grid resources isomerization unit and dynamic.To ensure the security of the platform CGSP, through a single point of entry that would enable operational implementation process transparent to users, without reducing the security of identity authentication techniques.

articleTitle: Study on Incentive Mechanism of Knowledge Employees Based on Human Capital Property Rights
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes characteristics of human capital property rights (HCPR) of knowledge employees. Using the framework of multi-task principle-agent, we establish the principle-agent model which involves the tasks of hard studying & hard working and the incentive of performance & property rights, then discuss the interaction between performance incentive and property rights incentive, and analyze the effort of hard studying and hard working. The results show that the property rights incentive may promote employees' efforts to work hard and study hard, also optimize the performance incentive mechanism. Knowledge employees have the optimal efficiency if they keep all the surplus value. However the property rights incentive has to match the performance incentive, the stronger property rights incentive, the better. When property rights incentive is taken as a long-term incentive, the employees are willing to study hard. When performance incentive is taken as a short-term incentive, they are apt to work hard. When they are lack of property rights incentive, knowledge employees will not be interest in studying or be inclined to external studying behavior.

articleTitle: The Sustainable Growth of Enterprise's Core Intellective Talents and Its Countermeasure - In Terms of Environment Supply
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As knowledge becomes the key resource in modern enterprises, the core intellective talents represent the source of enterprises' core competitiveness. In this paper, the author tries to explain what leads to the deficiency of core intellective talent from the perspective of environmental supply, and proposes that we should create a favorable institutional and cultural environment as well as a system for nurturing and growth to realize a sustainable growth of the talent through setting up a general theory.

articleTitle: The Problems Paid Attention to the Development of Urban Agglomeration GIS in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the company wake of the quick urban development in China, the urban agglomeration region has been the core region that is the fullest of energy and potential in the economic development pattern of China. Moreover, sharing, cooperating and competing between the international urban agglomeration regions will decide a new global economic pattern. It is important to develop the urban agglomeration GIS for the continuable development of the urban agglomeration region. During the development of urban agglomeration GIS, attention must be paid to some problems, such as organization and management of urban agglomeration GIS, data quality and data criterion, data sharing and the principle employed during the development of urban agglomeration GIS, so that the application and study of GIS can be promoted between inter-organizations.

articleTitle: A Non-Parametric Method for Evaluating Reorganization Efficiency of an Enterprise Group
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For evaluating the problems of reorganization efficiency of an enterprise group, an input-output efficiency analysis table of a group is provided by comparing with some reference samples, and some methods are given based on this table, such as how to analyzing the overall efficiency and find the inefficient reasons of a group, how to improve the group efficiency. Then, a non-parametric approach for evaluating reorganization efficiency of a group is given by comparing with some reference samples. At last, these methods are applied to the reorganization of a state-owned enterprise in China.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Sintering Process Data Mining System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to obtain optimal process parameters for sintering process, a data mining system that mainly including the process parameters module, the data mining module, the process diagnosis module, the human-machine and data interface was developed. By integrated fuzzy cluster analysis, time series and artificial neural networks technology, the system can deduce optimal information from complex production data, and realize four kinds of analysis that include sinter chemical composition analysis, sintering process state analysis, energy consumption analysis and state diagnosis. The system was developed with Visual C++ programming language. And its application shows that the first-grade rates of sinter chemical composition are increased by 1%, the fluctuation of main state of sintering process were reduced about 20%.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Heat Transfer through Wall Subjected to Rain in Guangzhou
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Located in hot and humid climate region, Guangzhou has strong solar radiation and abundant rain. Its potential of utilizing climate resource is great, and its possibility to realize passive cooling is high. The rain hours are over half of the total hours a year and the annual average rainfall can reach 1830.8 mm. Rain has been found that affect the thermal performance of building walls in two ways, by cooling the surface during rain and by evaporation of the absorbed moisture after rain. The rain process reduces the heat transfer from outside to inside and decreases the energy consumption of building. An experimental study is conducted of the heat transfer process though wall subjected to rain of Guangzhou summer. It has been finished in rainy days. The experiment measures the climate factors, the inner and surface temperatures of the walls, and the heat flows of the wall. The results of the heat transfer measurements show that the effect of rain to the wall's heat transfer is not negligible. At the same time, this article also introduces a handheld microwave moisture meter named MOIST 200B, and proposes a calibration method of the mass moisture of the building material to the moisture index that the MOIST 200B measures. Additionally, the article discusses the moisture change pattern of the cement mortars simply.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Citizens' Happiness Based on B-P Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Chinese citizen's happiness became a hot issue in recent years, however, few of the scholars researched this issue from the angle of a quality method. Based on this phenomenon, we firstly analyzed the significance of evaluating the Chinese Citizens' happiness, then, we intended to find out the most important elements which may influence our research objects, according to the results of analysis, we selected a series representative indicators and established the evaluation system. The B-P neural networks (BPNN) we applied in this paper is an advanced method of evaluating, we described the mechanism of the BPNN and then tested the evaluation system by using the practical data. The results proved that the evaluation system is an effective way of appraisal the citizens' happiness, it also showed us what kind of indicators would bring us happiness mostly, therefore, we believed this paper may be a guidance of constructing the harmonious society in China.

articleTitle: The Establishment and Calculating Model Method of Unforeseen Expenses for Civil Aircraft Research Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In civil aircraft research project, it usually takes a certain percentage unforeseen expenses additionally in the budget process to cope with unexpected events brought by overspending, and ensure the funds required. In this paper, the objectivity of the unforeseen expenses establishment is first discussed, followed by expounding the decisive factors of establishing unforeseen expenses. At last we analyze the limitations of commonly used estimation methods and propose the calculating model method. We develop the existing methods which are too subject or too complicated, and this method is more compatible with civil aircraft research project.

articleTitle: Urban Environmental Management and Traffic Improvement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important part of urban environment, urban traffic environment is one of the key factors that cause urban environment pollution. This kind of pollution is comprehensive and involves natural environment, ecological environment, social environment and humanistic landscape, even people's mentality, etc. So it is a complicated system engineering to solve the urban traffic environmental problems, and traffic environment improvement is crucial for the urban environmental management. In this paper, the author illustrates the opinion of considering policy, regulation, management, technology and culture in urban environmental management, meanwhile, we should advocate green traffic, cultivate noble urban traffic culture, make the urban traffic convenient for people's living and working, so it can maintain the harmonious environment and realize the harmonious development between human and nature.

articleTitle: On Research & Solution of Konjac Supply Chain in Enshi Area of Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Konjac is fashionable all over the world for its unusual health care and medical effect. As a suitable planting area, Hubei Enshi area should find a way to display the mysterious alchemy of Konjac, to realize farmer's wealthy dream and lead the local economic development. After vast visit and investigation of Konjac supply chain in Enshi area of Hubei province, based on the theory of the supply chain, the article analyzes its existent questions, and researches the developing measure of the Konjac supply chain in Enshi including organization constructing, market exploiting, science and technology investing, policy supporting and so on.

articleTitle: Inter-Organizations Rents and Profit Allocation in Global Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Global value chain (GVC) has broadened the international division participation of a state or an area with economic policies. The actors in global value chain obtained different profit. The paper from economic rent view stressed the significance of inter-corporation rents and analyzed profit allocation in the global value chain. We find that the profits depend on the market structure of product stages. Who owns market power and leader power that will dominate whole integral process and gains more profit.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process for Evaluating Online Bookstores
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of electronic information technique, electronic e-commerce grows speedily, including online book-shopping. The evaluation of online bookstores is a multiple-criteria decision making (MCDM) problem with many quantitative and qualitative attributes. This paper proposes fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (FAHP) approach to evaluate online bookstores. In addition, a case study is presented to demonstrate how the approach can help in solving such problems in practice.

articleTitle: A Perspective on Digital Publishing Strategy in China: A Case Study on SPDG
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital publishing represented the merge of the most advanced information technology and traditional publishing industry. Put emphasis on digital publishing becomes Chinese publishing groups strategically development decision. This paper demonstrated the current Chinese digital publishing situation and its future growth direction. It presented the problems and barriers existed in digital publishing industry in China. At the end, it analyzed Shenzhen publication and distribution group as an example for digital publishing strategy, plan and construction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Social Capital and Employee Creativity: Evidence from the PRC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Elasticity of Supply Chain Based on Abrupt Change in Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The abrupt change in environment refers to the condition or state in which natural disaster, war and financial crisis etc. occur suddenly and unexpectedly. The abrupt change in environment can suddenly interrupt stability of supply chain, and bring the risk to supply chain. The elasticity of supply chain based on abrupt change in demand and price is studied in this paper. The model provided in this paper can be used for firms to recover rapidly the supply chain system to original or the ideal state shortly after the risk comes out.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Systemic Analysis about Construction of Three-Dimensional Network of Logistics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on the Method for Constituting an Operable Emergency Plan
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Influence and Application of XML Web Services on Web Publishing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article first introduces basic theory about the XML Web services and then explores the ideas of XML Web services, at last analyzes the active influence and specific application of XML Web services on Web publishing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Controlling the Moral Risks in Medical Insurance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Forecast Method of Economic Data and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a economic data analysis model is been proposed. There are three step in the mode. First, the economics data is decomposed by wavelet analysis. Second, some of the data is combined according to the cycle of the data. At last. The ARIMA model is been used to analysis.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Factors of Recreational Area around Metropolis: A Case Study of Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recreational area around metropolis is a main direction of tourism development of the surrounding area around the city, so it is very important to know the development mechanism of ReBAM. A development mechanism model of ReBAM was founded and the empirical test was carried on the factors of the ReBAM by taking the visitors in Wuhan city as samples. The results show that eight factors, which are resource natural endowment, population gathering, economy development, transition of resident's consumption idea, economic behavior of suburb government and residents, investment behavior of the travel developer, promotion of the travel agency, medias, influence the development of ReBAM prominently. At last the paper discusses the results and puts forward the future research.

articleTitle: The Research on Cross-Enterprise Coordination in Purchasing Service Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
