abstract: It is a new kind of purchase modes produced to purchase in coordination under supplying the chain environment. This text is on the basis of explaining SOA (service oriented architecture service-oriented framework), according to the thought which faces modeling and framework of serving of IBM, adopt law from top to bottom (field decompose) to produce manufacturing purchase business go on analysis served to face in coordination across enterprise, thus confirm the candidate range served, find that service.

articleTitle: A Study on Transportation Problem Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the first linear programming models in practice, the model of transportation problem has got attentions from the experts, especially the unique structure of its table operations method. Therefore, from a critical and constructive perspective, this paper attempted to complete the optimization methods and bring forward some valuable ideas, so as to improve the special structure of transportation model and accelerate the process of resources distribution. In the end, the case of the physical distribution of Cotton Island was analyzed as an example for the further research.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Lightning Location Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currently, lightning location system (LLS) is one of the important bases for urban lightning protection. A key factor of the TDOA technology prevalently adopted in LLS is the time error of detection stations. According to the stochastic property of the time error measured by detection stations, the lightning information containing error is simulated using Monte Carlo method. The location error is determined through the results of many times revolving of a particular lightning point, and error ellipse is plotted based on the location error. The results can guide the lightning location network construction and the location error analysis.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on the R&D Activities of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the research and development (R&D) process of enterprises, the difference and information asymmetry of the benefit goals between the investors and the R&D personnel often cause the R&D projects unable to complete successfully. Using the game theory, this article proposes an effective incentive mechanism, which can arouse the working enthusiasm of R&D personnel, discusses the questions of how the investors and R&D personnel should do to share risks, and develops the dynamic performance incentive contract, thus provides the theoretical basis for the enterprises to implement their R&D activities effectively.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-Objective Decision-Making for Planning of Land Reclamation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the factors influencing the overall structure and layout of the planning of land reclamation, proposes a multi-objective and multi-level comprehensive evaluation index system for the planning of land reclamation based on fuzzy thoughts, and then establishes a multi-objective decision-making model. The paper also uses concrete examples to illustrate the index system is rational and the decision-making model feasible, and thus hopefully serves as an approach and reference for the land reclamation projects with regard to initiation, plan designing and construction management.

articleTitle: A Scheme of Robust Audio Watermarking Based on FRFT for Copyright Protection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital watermarking is an efficient and promising approach to protect intellectual property rights of digital media. In this paper, a new scheme of robust audio watermarking based on Fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) domain for copyright protection is proposed, which utilizes the idea that FRFT can be considered as a rotation in time-frequency joint domain. Test results for imperceptibility of the watermark and its performance of detection are presented. The simulation study shows that the watermark performance is better than the classical spread spectrum audio watermarking scheme.

articleTitle: An LMIs Method for the Mean-Variance Model of Portfolio Selection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) method for the mean-variance model of portfolio selection is studied Two kinds of optimal models for determining the portfolio selections are analyzed. By applying the portfolio theory, these models are transformed to equivalent models respectively, in which the objects and constraints are expressed by quadratic functions. And then, by applying the S-procedure, corresponding optimal models based on LMIs are established respectively. From this, the methods for determining the optimal solutions of these portfolio models are given. Finally, an illustration example is given to show their application.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Game Theory and Applications in Financing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationship between an original shareholder and a possible investor in financing is studied by using fuzzy game theories and methods. The results show that either the original shareholder's share of the incremental value or the possible investor's investment has a reasonable upper bound, an enterprise may obtain more investment if the original shareholder reduces his share of the incremental value properly, and the original shareholder tends to play a cooperative game, while the possible investor tends to play a noncooperative game if the incremental value is distributed between the two players according to the same ratio. The study discovers the two players' relationship effectively, and the results are helpful to some real problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the Safety Risk of Subway Maintenance Operation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Telecommunication Corporation Growth Evaluation Model Based on AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper introduces the firm growth theory into the telecommunication industry. It analyzes the internal and external factors of telecommunication enterprises, and builds an entire system that depicts the major factors concerning firm growth. On this foundation, Delphi method and analytic hierarchy process (AHP) are used to determine the weight of each factor of the primary, secondary and tertiary indicators. This system is supposed to help telecom corporations to evaluate their own firm growth.

articleTitle: Oriented Complexity Analyzing and Designing Method of War System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly analyzes the complexity of war system, and proposes eight factors attributed to the complexity of war system from the view of scenario, cognition, core interest zero-sum gaming, interfering strategies, in-house corresponding, un-repeatability and etc. On this basis, the paper points out the four most important integration problems of all challenges to methodology, method and technology that the war complex system (WCS) is confronted with in the research of war system, namely tactics and equipment integration, future scenario and interfering strategies integration, heterogeneity group experts wisdom integration, quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis integration. At last, the effective method, war design engineering (WDE), is presented to solve the four integration problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Rapid Assessment: A New Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Strategic Consideration and Developmental Characteristics of Small Towns in Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluating Organizational Success through E-Phenomena with Reference to Faster IT Trends
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic business is the term, which covers various aspects of different business activities, like CRM, SCM, ERP, ECOM, MCOM and based on the universally accepted networked environment of today's fast paced changing technological era. The power, which remained with the sellers before the advent of Internet, has now shifted to the buyers because of the umpteen choices available due to the Internet, which made every organization ubiquitous. The commonality of IT literacy around the world has inspired the organization to have Web existence and offer what they have in any where of the world. The technology has brought lots of miraculous facilities, which has relaxed the customers from very complicated traditional methods. There is lots of research has been conducted on the topic but still some room available on empirical and theoretical electronic business aspects which are marginally touched upon in this paper. The type of the research in this paper is basic and more towards exploratory nature based on the literature survey, interviews (structured & unstructured) from top-notch executives of national & multinational organizations, email interviews and inquiries from different IT and electronic business domain companies. The paper consists of five sections in general: first is about the introduction, concepts and definitions, second part focuses on the electronic business and its similar level of categories. This will cover the Ebusiness, Ecom innovations, cases and technological facilities. Third is regarding the relevance of some aspects based on technological patterns. Fourth is about the futuristic perspective of the topic, its complications and benefits. Fifth is followed by the conclusions, recommendations, some important key words, references and bibliography.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Strategies for Managing Service Demand
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Factors Influencing the Energy Consumption Pattern of Two Million Level Cities In China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study aimed to explore main factors influencing energy consumption patterns, and investigate which one had main effect in the cities of developing China having greater than two million populations. 40 parameters related to city energy consumption of core areas of 21 major cities with population above two million were collected from statistical data for 2006. These parameters were divided into live groups: city attribute, demography, economy, industries, city transport and domesticity. By using bivariate correlation analysis 23 significant parameters were selected, and then they were reduced to 4 independent influencing factors in factor analysis. Regression analysis on the relation between the influencing factors and the city energy consumption indicator showed that two factors associating with city level have more influence than another two factors describing household level effects.

articleTitle: Adverse Selection Model in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adverse selection means the selection by the consumer when faced with the circumstance of asymmetric information. Adverse selection model was suggested by the American economist George Akerlof (1970), who is one of Nobel Economics Prize laureates in 2001. With this model, Akerlof indeed explains many economic institutions and many important aspects of uncertainty. But the model studies the traditional markets (tangible markets), how about the e-commerce that are based on the Internet? Based on Akerlof model, this paper builds up the adverse selection model in the e-commerce markets, and probes into resolving approaches about the adverse selection in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on Lifecycle Strategy of Group Data Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is analyzed the characteristics of available group data service in the mobile communication market on the basis of product life cycle in this paper. Then the obstacle factors of group data service development in different life cycle phases are analyzed and also the corresponding strategies are given. At the end of the paper the key points of life cycle management about this kind of service are concluded.

articleTitle: Customer Service Competition in Crossed Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the background that competition of enterprise has changed into the competition between supply chains, we studied the customer service competition of two-echelon supply chains that exists crossed structure, and compared service level and profit in three different scenario, which consist of uncoordinated scenario, coordinated scenario, and hybrid scenario. Finally, we discussed the influence of different parameters to service level decision of members in supply chains.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrator's Control Channels of Complex Products and Systems Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the characteristics of complex products and systems (CoPS) firstly. According to the CoPS cross-enterprise organizational form and project management features, as well as system integrators' leading role in the project management of CoPS, we research on system integrators' control channels at different stages of innovation, which the four control aspects (progress, cost, quality, safety) are undertaken with the stakeholder theory as a framework. Finally, we concluded that the projects can be achieved through balancing the benefits and power of the various stakeholders.

articleTitle: Rough Set-Based Power Supply Enterprise Customer's Evaluation of Credit
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Credit customers to pay electricity is electricity power supply enterprises to ensure the safety and efficacy claims of an important means, this article describes in detail the basic theory of rough sets to build a credit rating of the power user evaluation and made attribute reduction, delete redundant attribute. And then select the 12 samples of power supply enterprises as its customers credit for empirical evaluation of the method to verify the feasibility and practicality, with a view to recovery of power supply enterprise to avoid the risk of electricity to provide reference.

articleTitle: Impacts of Geographic Clusters and Network Status on Innovation Performance: An Empirical Study on Manufacturing Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As competition becomes increasingly intensified nowadays, many a corporations have become wary of their resource limitation and choose cooperating with others. By collaborative efforts they can acquire outside knowledge and resources by which firms generates better innovation performance. As the article illuminates, external factors and inter-organizational network relationships are significant conduits via which companies are able to expeditiously acquire resources and knowledge requisite for innovation. This article utilizes a social network approach and a clustering approach to explore the relationship between geographic clustering and network status and their impact on innovation performance. The results of this study may have many managerial and practical implications.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Field Geological Map System Based on Ajax
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Ajax is one of the core technologies of RIA, which implements the asynchronous interaction between the browser and the Web server. In traditional field geological map system of B/S mode, the disadvantages such as low visiting speed and bad security of such kind of field geological map system have emerged. To solve the problem of low visiting speed caused by the large-volume data of filed geological map transmitted on network, the author applies the technology of Ajax to the field geological map system and implements the asynchronous interaction between the browser and the Web map server. Compared with the system of B/S synchronous mode, the system avoids putting a computational burden on the browser and keeps the response time shorter to provide a higher level of interaction. In addition, the introduction of the concepts of role and privilege improves the security of the filed geological map information greatly.

articleTitle: The Impact of Port Infrastructure on Port Handling Capacity in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Port handling capacity is a key indicator of the development of port economy. There are numerous factors that influencing port handling capacity, the port infrastructure and development play a prominent role among which. In this paper, to examine what are the factors and how they influence the port handling capacity in China, we employed panel data from China's 14 ports between 1997 and 2006. The results suggest that port infrastructure do affect port handling capacity in China, on which the development of port infrastructures has a long-run effect in particular. Furthermore, quay length, integrated port traffic capacity and number of port berths for 10,000 ton-class or larger ships, increase port handling capacity by 12%, 50% and 91% respectively, while the influence of number of port berths is limited and not significant.

articleTitle: Customer Requirements Assessment Model of Fitness Club in International Tourist Hotel
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on famous international tourist hotels in Taiwan. The five criteria of the service quality model (PZB) serve as basis during fitness club customer survey conductions. Firstly, data is collected using literature review method. Then experts and customers opinions are obtained using Delphi Method. After that, calculations and analysis are done using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Finally, the indicator weight ranking results show that the most important criteria consist of tangible equipments. In terms of indicator, equipment repair and maintenance is regarded as an important assessment indicator.

articleTitle: The Research of Multivariate Statistical Process Control Based on EIV Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper develops a new multivariate statistical process control method based on one kind of EIV model. The main idea is to propose a fitted error from EIV model to convert the multi-variable to single variable. Theory and method are discussed. Three examples of multivariate statistical process illustrate the capabilities of the new method. The new control scheme is universal in application but some problems need to be studied further.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Capillary Depth to Soil Water Transport under Line Source Permeation of SDI
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on a primary experiment in the laboratory, the soil-water distribution of subsurface drip irrigation is observed and analyzed. The results show that the wetting front move speed and migration distance reduce in the vertical direction and horizontal direction along with the increment of the capillary depth under the same flow rate and water volume. Under the same capillary depth, the level of water content under the emitter soil is higher than in the other direction. The water content in the horizontal direction presents symmetry distribution. Under the same emitter distance, the moisture content is higher when capillary depth become greater. With the increment of the capillary depth, the moisture content decreases, increasing the ball saturated humid region, particularly in the vertical direction.

publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Fishing Gear, Methods and Protection of Fisheries Resources in Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science

articleTitle: A Standardizing Architecture Model for B2B Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic commerce (EC) can be defined as to use information technology for improving business relations between trading partners. The objectives of this work are to develop the reference model for EDEFO based B2B electronic commerce and to implement a prototype system for its fundamental issues such as business process, information standards, and information system integration. The research scope is to develop standards for related business processes and their information exchange, to develop XML EDI as the standard exchange method, and to implement a prototype system.

publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Replenishment Batch Model Based on Virtual Warehousing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper addresses the multi-period dynamic replenishment batch problem under stochastic demand, real-time items prices fluctuation in the equipment manufacturing industry. The dynamic replenishment batch model based on virtual warehousing is presented to minimize the expected total cost. It is assumed that the total cost is comprised of fixed ordering costs, items costs, transportation costs, inventory holding costs and shortage costs. And the heuristic algorithm based on fast seeking method and golden section method is developed. The effectiveness of the algorithm is demonstrated by numerical results.

articleTitle: The Financial Analysis of Communications Equipment Industry Listed Companies Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the many financial indicators, it is difficult to comprehensive evaluate the financial situation of listed companies. DuPont traditional financial analysis system has only considered the relationship between a limited numbers of financial indicators, the summarized information is inadequate. Through an analysis of the many financial indicators, concentrated the indicators, extracted the key factor, the factor analysis can come to the financial situation of an integrated scoring, which can guide the business and financial strategy selection, and then set up a financial analysis method which is different from the DuPont analysis system.

articleTitle: Bank Assets and Liabilities Portfolio Optimization Model Based on the Dual-Gap Immunity of the Directional Duration and Directional Convexity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Changes in market interest rates led to the changes of bank's assets and liabilities values, which led to the change of the owner's equity of the bank and bring in risk to the bank owners. As a result, interest rate risk management of commercial banks is extremely important. We built a portfolio optimal model for bank assets and liabilities management by controlling the interest risk, which controls directional duration and directional convexity at the same time.

articleTitle: The Effects of Capital Adequacy Ratio on Risk Early-Warning of Credit Guarantee Institution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new concept and technique of risk management for credit guarantee institution is proposed. The key of credit guarantee risk management is to control the institution risk to be in the safe area. Take capital adequacy ratio (CAR) as the institution risk early-warning index which defined as DCAR. A formula to calculate DCAR is established in the base of new Basel capital agreement, VaR and CVaR models by analyzing the constitution and characteristics of credit guarantee institution risk.

articleTitle: Consumer Returns Policies and Supply Chain Coordination Contracts
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes supply chain models involving in consumer returns policies. In the model, the demand is made up of consumers and it is uncertainty, at the same time, consumers face valuation uncertainty and realized their valuation only after purchase. In this environment, consumers decide whether to purchase and then whether to return the product, whereas the retailer sets the price, quantity and refund. Using the model, we analyze the optimal decisions in both centralized and decentralized scenarios. Due to the double-marginalization effect of the decentralized supply chain, buy-back contract and differentiated buy-back contract are designed for supply chain coordination. Results show that the latter can attain supply chain coordination but the former does not.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Entrepreneurial Competency: Perspectives, Structures and Practices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Establish and Implement the Strategy of the Agile Supply Chain of the Dynamic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The supply chain operation of the dynamic alliance is the one of important factors effect on competitive power of the market.Highly effective, agile supply chain management pattern will guarantee the raw material supply and product going on the market promptly, and will cause the enterprise to seize the market to take the initiative, it has the competitive advantage, enable the customer to obtain the order product promptly, and makes the customer satisfaction. This article discusses the agile supply chain substantive characteristics of the dynamic alliance and some problems, analyzes the actual example to study the strategy of agile supply chain of the dynamic alliance establishment and implementation.

articleTitle: Impact of Macro-Economic Variables on China Costal Bulk Freight Indices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: t-The purpose of this paper is to investigate the impact of macroeconomic variables on China Coastal Bulk Freight Indices. This paper applies VAR model, and uses impulse response analysis, variance decomposition method and Granger test to study the influence. The results of VAR model show that IFA and BOT have remarkable effect on CCBFIR, and CPI and VAI have no obvious influence. Granger test validate the conclusion, too. Impulse response analysis show that the coastal shipping returns have time lagged trait for macro-economic variables. Variance decomposition analysis show that contribution of CPI to CCBFIR is biggest all of the four variables, and the smallest is VAI.

articleTitle: Visual Data Mining of SARS Distribution Using Self-Organization Maps
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From a public health perspective, the socioeconomic conditions correlate with occurrences of infectious diseases. Our premise is that the number of SARS patients is a non-linear function of socioeconomic effects that are not normally distributed among regions. The objective was to integrate multivariate data sets representing social and economic factors to evaluate the hypothesis that regions with similar socioeconomic characteristics exhibit similar distributions of SARS disease. The SOM algorithm used the intrinsic distributions of 21 social and economic variables to classify 31 regions into five clusters. SOM determined clusters were compared with the distributions of SARS outcomes. The result picture shows that the variability between regions clusters was significant with respect to the distribution of SARS occurrence. Our study demonstrated a positive relationship between socioeconomic conditions and SARS outcomes in regions using the SOM method to overcome data and methodological challenges traditionally encountered in public health research. Results demonstrated that community health can be classified using socioeconomic variables and that the SOM method may be applied to multivariate socioeconomic health studies.

articleTitle: Design a Faceted Classification System for the Iron and Steel Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the perspective of information resources organization, classification is one of the most widely used methods, but the traditional method of enumerated classification has deficiencies. Therefore, the study of application of faceted classification in Web information organization has both highly practical and strongly theoretical significances. The purpose of classification is to provide a navigation environment in any of the media of knowledge, e.g. the enterprises' knowledge portal. This paper discusses the application of faceted analysis in knowledge portal construction for the iron and steel enterprises. The architecture and interface model are built and characteristics of faceted classification system are concluded.

articleTitle: Modeling Life Insurance Liability at Fair Value: An Analysis of Embedded Options in With-Profit Policy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Life insurance contracts are often very complex financial products which embed interest rate guarantee and other implicit options. Focusing on the With-Profit life insurance policy in China, this paper presents a dynamic model to develop suitable fair valuation techniques for liability of this category contract. Unlike traditional actuarial valuation method, the model captures several essential elements of With-Profit policy, such as interest rate of return guarantee, annual bonus option and terminal bonus option. Based on the classical contingent claim pricing theory, Monte Carlo techniques are used to calculate the values of these options. The numerical results obtained show that the liability value of With-Profit policy is highly sensitive to changes in model parameters, especially for bonus strategy and interest rate of return guarantee.

articleTitle: Using EAM to Enhance the Level of Asset Management: An Application Case in Telecommunications Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: EAM (enterprise asset management) is a solution for information program of asset-intensive enterprises, which can be used to maintain and track the high-value fixed assets.This paper introduces the function, characteristic and the advanced management concept of EAM,and then indicates that EAM can bring many benefits to telecommunications company.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Safety Input-Output for Construction Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction is one of the most hazardous industries due to its unique nature. The safety records of construction sites are poor in China. Safety issues have gained vital importance throughout the construction industry. As a prerequisite to realize safety goals in construction sites, how to predict safety input and make a reasonable distribution is an important issue in the construction industry. This paper aims to find an appropriate method to calculate reasonable safety input. By analyzing the basic characteristics of safety input and using the method of input-output econometrics, the safety input is classified reasonably and an input-output model for construction enterprises is established. Based on the investigation to Huayu company, satisfying safety data, as a reliable reference, has been obtained by the input-output model. According to the data, each building enterprise can provide related safety input data to the government, enterprises and relative departments as an important foundation for future safety policy, and the enterprise may decide its operation policy and investment. In a word, it is of great practical significance.

articleTitle: The System of Dynamic Multi-Dimensional Piece-Rate Calculation Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Chinese township enterprises, multi-dimensional piece-rate wages calculation are very common. Because of the diverse types of products and the multi-dimensional floating price, the automatic wages-calculation system is needed. Considering that the rapid development of markets, thus, it is very important that the wages settlement systems to be carried out the adjustment and optimization of dynamic along with the floating proportion of prices. And it is necessary to develop the township enterprises informatization which is one of the key components in China development. In this paper, based on artificial neural network with back-propagation (BP) algorithm and enterprise management information system, a dynamic calculation system for multi-dimensional piece-rate wages is proposed. The accuracy and dynamic of the system is verified by a practical example. Obviously, this dynamic model can be widely used in clearing a variety of piece-rate calculation system for enterprise information and automation to provide active technical support.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Levels of Equity-Based Incentives and Company Performance -An Empirical Study Based on China Listed Companies after Equity Division Reform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Sampled on listed companies which implemented equity incentives after equity division reform, this paper studied the relationship between levels of equity-based incentives and company performance, which is represented by market and integrated accounting performance. We find that a significant difference of companies' performance after giving executive equity-based incentive. Moreover, there's a significantly positive relationship between companies' performance and the levels of restricted stock incentive, but there's a non-significantly positive relationship between companies' performance and the levels of stock option incentive. At the same time, the findings also revealed a number of issues in China's securities market, as well as internal governance structure of listed companies.

articleTitle: The Model about "One-Stop" E-Government Service Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government is the organic combination of information technology and government management function. From the point of service integration, "One-stop" e-government service integration can take CRM (customer relation management) as the guidelines, VO (virtual organization) as the method and TQM (total quality management) as the guarantee. Then, following such a principle of "making the application convenient, making the examination and approval declined, making the transaction normative and making disposal transparent", "One-stop" E-government application model and its function are put forward based on the combination of above-mentioned CRM, TQM and VO.

articleTitle: The Complexity Measure of Groundwater Depth Series in Sanjiang Plain Based on Approximate Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Influenced by high-strength agricultural activities, climate and so on, the system of groundwater resources has gained more characters of complex system in Sanjiang Plain. Take Jiansanjiang Bureau for example, the approximate entropy is adopted to analyze the complexity of groundwater depth series in 7 production teams. The results show the complexity order from big to small as follows: 4th production team of Qianjin Farm, 69th production team of Qixing Farm, 22th production team of Qianjin Farm, 1th production team of 859 Farm, 26th production team of 859 Farm, 11th production team of Qianjin Farm, 21th production team of 859 Farm. We can see that the groundwater exploitation is the key factor in groundwater dynamic variation. The results reveal the essence of complex dynamic system, providing a basis for decision-making in managing groundwater resources scientifically in Jiansanjiang Bureau and even the Sanjiang Plain.

articleTitle: Study on Interactions between Urban Extension and Urban Metro Construction in Tianjin Built-Up Area
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban extension is a direct reflection of the development of urbanization. The analysis of dynamic changes of urban extension can provide effective support for the government's decision-making for sustainable development. Urban metro constructions in major cities have started, and its impacts on urban development are also of great concern. Taking Tianjin built-up area as an example, this article first explored the urban expansion over two time spans during 15 years from 1993 to 2008, for which multi-source images were acquired for change detection. Results of classification were unified to two-value map of built and non-built areas in the same spatial resolution. Then the relationship between urban extension and metro planning was analyzed through overlaying the results together with vectors of subway distribution, which was achieved by vectoring Tianjin metro planning map. Different buffering areas were extracted for metro stations and overlaid with the urban extension areas for spatial analysis, which shows that there exists high correlativity between metro construction and urban expansion. Urban expansion in Tianjin results in more people and more traffic, so that it calls for metro construction to alleviate traffic pressure, while, on the other hand, metro lines play an engine of directing the pattern of urban expansion. Based on the relationship reached in this article, a brief prediction of the future urban expansion of Tianjin built-up area was made according to the construction time plan of new metro lines.

articleTitle: Service Management Improving on Hedonic Pricing Function for Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on how to improve the service management level through analysis of price and product characteristics in the automobile industry in China. We estimate "hedonic pricing functions" that relate the automobile characteristics to their prices. Then we examine how the prices influence the customers' perception and how the customers' perception relates to service management. We also briefly consider the related methods of how improves the service management in automobile industry.

articleTitle: Mode Selection of Project Team Human Capital Structure and Research on Its Performance: An Analysis Based on Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the most crucial factor of team production, team human capital is of important research significance. By reviewing on relevant researches on the team human capital at home and abroad, this article summarizes the definition and features of project team human capital and classifies individual human capital in the team. Based on the similarity in terms of systematic characteristics between team human capital and circuit model, we establish a circuit model of project team human capital and analyze how team human capital structure and team synergy influence on output efficiency. By optimizing and integrating the structure, this article finally puts forward the best way to maximize the production of project team human capital.

articleTitle: Tabu Search for Container Dock Handling Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Container dock handling scheduling is a combinatorial optimization problem. It has important significance to improve the dock production efficiency. This problem belongs to NP-hard problems. It is very similar to hybrid flow shop scheduling in the form. But it is more complex than HFS because of the physical properties of ship structure and handling equipment. This paper establishes a mathematical model of this problem. And based on tabu rules, this paper proposes the neighborhood structure and neighborhood shrinkage method based on key line and assignment restriction. Combining instances, this paper illustrates the realization principle of tabu search algorithm.

articleTitle: The Design of Reverse Logistics Network Based on Remanufacturing for a Diesel Engine Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Remanufacture is an important option for OEM to manage their end-of-life products. Efficient implementation of product remanufacture requires appropriate network structures. In this paper, we study the reverse logistics network design problem for a diesel engine enterprise. The company manufactures new diesel engines and will remanufacture returned engines in its facilities for after-sale service. We design the reverse logistics network through extending the existing service network for W company. A MILP model is developed for determining the disassembly centres' quantity and position among the existing spare parts warehouses. So company may construct its reverse logistics network at the lowest cost. The result has been accepted by W company.

articleTitle: Spatial Variance Characters of Urban Land Use Indices: A Case Study of Haidian District in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the theory support of "the first law of geography" the spatial variance of the land use landscape in Haidian District of Beijing is analyzed with the geostatistic tool and grid sampling method. The spatial organization and mechanism of urbanization can be well understood by the reveal of spatial characteristics of artificial impact and ecological effect. The results show that: (1) the characteristic of spatial variance can be well described with the GIS-based geostatistic method. The spatial correlation characteristic has been shown clearly in the indices, especially for human impact index, which has stronger spatial organization. (2) the spatial correlation of two indices are strongly dependent at this study scale. And the spatial variance is mainly produced by the structure factors, namely regional factors such as hydrology, soil and light etc.

articleTitle: A Tree Model for Pricing Credit Default Swaps with Equity, Market and Default Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article presents a trinomial tree model for pricing Credit Default Swaps (CDSs) on a defaultable zero-coupon bond with equity, market and default risk. Interest rates are assumed to follow a mean-reverting square root process. We generalize the reduced-form approach to include a constant elasticity of variance (CEV) process for equity prices prior to default, which is capable of reproducing the volatility smile observed in the empirical data. Based on the empirical results, we specify the default intensity as a function of the stock price and the interest rate. The correlation between interest rates and equity prices is also considered. Illustrative examples show the use of the model and numerical results explain the impact of different parameters on the prices of CDSs.

articleTitle: Intensive Model Used in Secure Protocol Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Strand space inherits the merit of algebra method, which can prove the security of protocol more precisely. Meanwhile, it overcomes the shortcoming of inconvenience. But because of shortage of primitives, it can't describe some protocols as IKE, let alone verification. This paper makes an improvement to the original strand space by adding the description of hash function and some definitions and lemmas about the description. So we can use the intensive model to analyze the protocols using hash function. At last, we analyze one IKE sub-protocol protocol.

articleTitle: Validating a Cognitive Model of Entrepreneurial Opportunity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Opportunity recognition belongs to a special cognitive processing. Research based on entrepreneurial cognitive pattern could provide a deep exploration on its nature. The articles supposed three hypotheses concentrated on three features of opportunity recognition: (1) key chunks, (2) rapid perception available, (3) experienced pattern to refer. The empirical analysis of two samples supported the validity of those proposals.

articleTitle: Speaker Identification Using GMM with Embedded AANN
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a modified gaussian mixed model (GMM) with an embedded auto-associate neural network (AANN). It integrates the merits of GMM and AANN. GMM and AANN are trained as a whole by means of maximum likelihood. In the process of training, the parameter of GMM and AANN are updated alternately. AANN reshapes the distribution of the data and improves the similarity of the data in one class. Experiments show that the proposed system improves accuracy rate against baseline GMM at all SNR, maximum to 19%.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Decision Model Based on Interval Number for Project Financing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are many factors of uncertainty that will influence the project financing. This paper presents a multiobjective decision-making method to solve this problem. When choosing project financing schemes, the target value is represented by interval number, and ranked on the basis of standardized interval number. Then, it can describe the impact of the changes from various factors, and get a more effective result.

articleTitle: Study on Provincial Ocean & Fisheries Information Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Provincial Ocean & Fisheries Information Sharing Service Platform is the important part of government information sharing resolving scheme. This paper has put forward an Ocean & Fisheries information sharing scheme in FuJian province under the background of Digital Ocean. It focuses on the three main aspects: information sharing structure, database sharing scheme, data exchanging in developing the Information Sharing Service Platform. This scheme can be used in other resources information sharing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Field Study on New Rural Cooperative Medical System in China - Based on a Field Investigation in Anhui, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of Risk Evaluation of Knowledge Transfer in IT Outsourcing Based on RS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: IT outsourcing of enterprise has been developing fast during last decade with great risk. It inherits essential risks of IT and possesses unique risks, on which attracts many research interests and achievements. This paper, after reviewing on the research development on IT outsourcing risk of enterprise, fist using theory and the method of rough set (RS) constructs the knowledge decision table of IT outsourcing risk and carry on the reduction to the related attribute; And then using support vector machines (SVM) in the decision-making data classification, helping policy maker assess and forecast the risk factors more quickly, thereby enhancing the scientific and accuracy of evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Management of Water Running Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The integration of knowledge management and water running scheduling could make the proper knowledge passed to the very person promptly in the right way, thus promotes the management level and efficiency of water running scheduling. In this paper the features of knowledge management existing in the water running scheduling are analyzed, the scheduling flow is integrated with knowledge management and the knowledge management framework is set based on the water running scheduling though integrating the knowledge and it's context in the process of scheduling flow. Moreover, the key technique to implement the knowledge management of water running scheduling is also under discussion.

articleTitle: A Group Trust Model with Control Flow Constraint Based on Subjective Logic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From perspective of subjectivity of trust, a group Trust model which is used to depict constraint relationships among individuals in a particular group through covering four basic constraint patterns and their nesting; what's more, gauging methods of direct trust degree and recommendation trust degree of basic constraint patterns and their nesting are brought up based on subjective logic theory respectively, and these methods remarkably support group trust relationship, especially trust relationship of software groups. Analysis on expressive power and validity of group Trust model proves that this model has outstanding adaptability and practicability.

articleTitle: Challenges of E-Payment Service in Commercial Bank of Ethiopia
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using secondary data this paper shows that Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) has faced some challenges relating with e-payment service. Among the challenges security, standardization, regulatory and legal issues, infrastructure, heavy investment costs, and socio-cultural challenges are the serious ones. And it affected the development of the service as expected. Thus, the valuable suggestion to increase the services is that government has to pay much effort to establish nation wide network at least to the town level. Similarly national, and regional laws, rules and regulations are important prerequisites for successful implementation of e-payment. In addition, standardization of software is necessary to offer the services properly.

articleTitle: The Forecasting of 3G Market in China Based on a Multi-Generation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese 3G market has been officially launched at the end of 2008. In order to make strategies of timely merchandise design, system capacity planning, distribution channels planning, and introduce of propel fee for 3G market, it is very important to estimate the growing paths of the 3G and 2G market and then to forecast the trend. Taking the interact effect between 2G and 3G into account, the paper, reveals the growth pattern of 3G in China based on the NB model (which utilizing the concepts of the ldquotechnical substitutionrdquo). We solve the problem that there is no historical data of 3G in China. And the empirical study result proves that the model fit very well with the actual data, which shows the predict value is quite credible.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling and Stress Analysis of Automobile Transmission Gears
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, Pro/E software is used building an accurate parameterized cylindrical helical gear model, which is an accurate analysis model for ANSYS finite element analysis. The finite element calculation is conducted by use of the software ANSYS, analyzing the position of the most unfavorable load line of involute helical gear engagement as well as applying load on gear in virtue of the most unfavorable load line, increasing the accuracy of analysis and calculation of gear strength, and offering more accurate data for gear design. At the meantime, the effect of different fillets on the maximum root stress is studied, providing a quantitative basis for the case hardening method that enhances the bending strength of gear.

articleTitle: Study on Motivation to Protect Existing Valued Resources in Employee Retention
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on employee retention research and social resources theory, this paper proposes a construct of motivation to protect existing resources, the purpose of which is to develop and validate an instrument measuring the construct, in order to indicate the motivation mechanism behind the predictors in employee retention research. The paper develops a three-factor structure scale to measure the motivation based on a qualitative research such as the interview and the literature and validates the scale by empirical study. Finally, the implications of the construct to theory and practice are discussed.

articleTitle: A Review of Literature on Knowledge Information Service for Regional Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, Regional Innovation Systems (RIS) have been rapidly developed. Knowledge Information Service (KIS) construction for regional innovation system is the enterprise innovation guarantee factor and is one essential part for superior national innovation system. Deficiency of knowledge information service has restricted innovation system development. This paper covered a certain number of key research achievements concerning this subject and it contributes a comprehensive review. The literature is further classified by its topic and the major outcomes and existing problems are addressed. Following implications for future research are provided.

articleTitle: A Research on Service Failure and Culture's Impact on Service Recovery Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service recovery is an important topic in the field of service quality management, it is also one of the hotspots that scholars focusing on. From the existing research, we found service failure seriousness and culture's impact on service recovery effectiveness is still worthy of further researching. The paper adopted experiment, ANOVA to explore service recovery effectiveness in different service failures and also analyze power distance's impact on service recovery. At last, the paper expounded the result's management implication and further study direction.

articleTitle: Enhanced Nitrogen and Phosphorus Removal by Humus Soil Activated Sludge SBR Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study has investigated the effect of humus soil activated sludge on the nitrogen and phosphorus removal. The results from experiments indicate that humus soil SBR (HS-SBR) process did not have a better effect on the COD removal compared it with SBR process. They had about 89% removal efficiency on average. HS-SBR process could enhance the removal of nutrient salt, especially TP. The removal efficiency of TN and TP was 80.5% and 90.8%, higher than SBR process by 11.05% and 20.5% respectively. At the typical cycle, HS-SBR could fast deplete organic and enhance nitrification and denitrification. HS-SBR could enhance the phosphorus removal, but the mechanism should go deep into study.

articleTitle: How Does Limit Order Book Information Affect Trading Strategy and Market Quality: Simulations of an Agent-Based Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we focus on the role of limit order book in trading behavior and market quality by simulation analysis. We develop a model of an order-driven market where traders set bids and asks and post market or limit orders according to their expectation of asset's future price. In order to facilitate the comparison, agents are assumed to have four components of the expectation of future asset price, namely fundamentalist, chartist and noise strategy, as well as order book information in one type of simulations, while order book state won't be considered in the other type. Through a series of simulations we conclude limit order book contains information of present supply-demand relation, which make more accuracy in trading strategy and higher market quality.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Secure Audit Mechanism Based on LSM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The secure audit mechanism based on Linux security modules (LSM) is presented. The SAM enhances LSM in audit, makes security domain of process task structure point to the specified data structure, and adds audit hooks and hook functions to capture comprehensive audit information. Additionally, register functions and unregistered functions are provided to implement dynamic addition and deletion of security audit modules. Buffer with double-linked list structure is designed to solve easy lost of audit information and buffer overflow. Normal activities rule base, RVA, and its dynamic response algorithm are presented. And real-time security warning and punishment mechanisms are achieved by constraint control algorithm and the set of warning threshold and punish threshold. Audit log format based on efficiency is designed. And five kinds of basic query are provided to achieve effective log storage and query. The tested results indicate the mechanism has better security and running performance, less influence on the kernel, and adaptive kernel's upgrade.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Endogenous Public Regulation in the Marketization of Credit Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The M-Commerce Architecture Study Based on SaaS Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the M-Commerce (mobile commerce) has become a hotspot of the e-commerce development, enterprises focus their eyes on how to make greater profits by M-Commerce. The emergence of SaaS has provided an opportunity for the mobile commerce development of the enterprises, especially SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises). Aiming at the existing problems of M-Commerce (such as the limited resource of mobile terminals, network security, physical security, the high cost of building a mobile commerce system and so on), this paper puts forward a mobile commerce architecture based on the SaaS model, then introduces the business operations under this architecture by mobile terminals, and pointes out the advantages of the architecture.

articleTitle: The Study for Data Security Mechanism in WebGIS Based on Tile Caches
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tile caches technique creates a new release pattern of network maps which can enrich the representation form of WebGIS and dramatically decrease the loading time consumed for high quality image visualizations. However, it also makes the intellectual property rights of information not effectively protected. In order to build the data security mechanism in WebGIS based on tile caches and B/S architecture, this paper analyzed the potential data security problem in some main WebGIS from three aspects: client-code scripting, transmission of vector data and request of attribute information. The scripts usually records the calling methods of tile caches with plaintext, which makes the algorithm open and may leak the organizing structure of the tile caches; The transmission way of the vector data is included in the scripts that executed in the Browser, which makes it easy to download them from server side to client side; All the attribute information in WebGIS are classified and usually can be obtained through malicious request continuously. It also presented the corresponding measures of enhancing security mechanism, such as information hiding, digital watermarking, vector data encryption and request information restrictions. Furthermore, this paper gives the implementation of encrypting the http request and vector data using JavaScript program language. The empirical results show that these measures can avoid the data leakage and protect the data copyright effectively. The study is of special importance from the theoretical and applicative points of view.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Intelligent Computing Platform for Industrial Process Based on the Mobile Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current status of the industrial production process was introduced in this paper firstly, and then, this paper introduced the purpose and meaning of designing the intelligent computing platform, it makes detailed description about the architecture and design schema, and specifies function of modules respectively. It introduces the related technology of J2EE and .net standard framework, discusses how to put up the basic architecture of industrial intelligent computing platform, which could provide an intelligent computing platform with high reliability, ease expansibility, reusability and security. On this basis, the overall design and related technology of the platform is mainly discussed, furthermore, it also gives a simple implementation of the platform. With the platform, the guiding function of the history industrial data to the production process will be improved. It realizes the data value increment, and it is beneficial to realize the goal of the "informatization driving industrialization".

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Corporate Governance and Governance Premium: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Geodetic Number of Cm × Cn
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Graph theory is the theoretical fundamental of network technologies. This paper reports an investigation of stability issues of the network technologies based on the graph theory. It also presents solutions of the geodetic number of graph C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> times C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>. There are many parameters which can measure to some extent the robustness of an interconnection network with respect to link failures, such as domination number and bondage number. Another parameter, the geodetic number, has been studied widely in the recent literature. Determining the geodetic number of an arbitrary graph however can be proved to be NP-hard. Therefore it is natural to investigate some specific cases for the geodetic number of special graphs. The solving process of one of such cases is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban Disaster Prevention Engineering Investment: Cost-Benefit Analysis and Cost-Effectiveness Analysis Approaches
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to develop an improved model of the analysis of urban disaster prevention engineering investment by cost-benefit analysis and cost-effectiveness analysis. This improved model isolates the economic benefits, but also the social and environmental benefits. This paper distresses the question how to measure the indirect effects of the urban disaster and the how to analysis the efficiency of the investment for the prevention engineering from the social and environmental aspects based on CBA and CEA approaches.

articleTitle: Character Retrieval Based on the Improved Contour Feature and Texture Feature
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to retrieve the character images but avoid the OCR system which is limited in some application, a method for Chinese characters retrieval is presented in this paper. It firstly extracts the improved contour feature of Chinese character images, which is used to match roughly. Then, the candidate character images attained above are divided by the centroid of each one. For each part divided, the texture feature of the Fourier spectrum is extracted for scrutinized detection to obtain the final results. The experiment results imply that the method proposed is efficient in retrieving different grays, different fonts and sizes of Chinese character images.

articleTitle: Research on Allocation Schemes of Water Resources Sustainable Utilization Based on Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A global optimization method is described to solve a nonconvex, nonlinear optimization problem for an allocation schemes model of water resources sustainable utilization. The objective was to determine the optimal process design and operating conditions for a given water production. Although the model was derived from a simplified hypothesis, it considers all the most important aspects of the process. The model takes into account the water demand constraints (urban domestic water consumption, industrial water, agricultural water, rural water and ecological water), water supply and its balance constraints. The resulting mathematical model contains inherently nonlinear and nonconvex constraints. The algorithm optimization was applied to the simplified model developed previously by a kind of linear iterative calculation of an approbatory least-square sphere fitting model. The global optimal solutions obtained by the algorithm provide scientific allocation schemes for water resources sustainable utilization. Moreover, these solutions are used as a starting point to solve more complex models efficiently. A case study is presented and discussed in order to illustrate the methodology and computational performance. Results show that it is simple and convenient to use global optimization to find the solution of water resources sustainable use allocation. Especially, it is very effective to solve the problems with multi-scale and non-linear constraints in resource management.

articleTitle: Symbiotic Relationship of Producer Services and Manufacturing Industries in Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Producer services is the hot topic, as well as the main subject which researchers focus on. Producer services has been an important role in developed countries. The paper addresses that in the condition of industry cluster, the relationship of producer services and manufacturing industries is symbiotic based on the analysis of their interaction. And then it gives the theoretic interpretation on the symbiotic relationship which is in industry cluster from different perspectives. The paper takes use of Lorka-Volterra competition equations to construct symbiotic model of producer services and manufacturing industries in industry cluster on the basis of previous analysis, and get relevant conclusions.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Collaboration and Disruption Mitigation Capability
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Today's market is characterized by high levels of uncertainty and turbulence. Outsourcing and globalization have created longer and more complex supply chains, which are more vulnerable to business disruptions. Thus it is critical for firms to enhance supply chain disruption mitigation capabilities. This research investigates the impact of supply chain collaboration on disruption mitigation capability. Through the use of the structural equation modeling technique, it is shown that supply chain integration has direct influence on the disruption warning and recovery capability, supply chain visibility has direct influence on disruption warning capability, and disruption warning capability has a strong influence on recovery capability.

articleTitle: Influence of Dispositional Trust and Technology Trust on B2C E-Commerce Trust Belief in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to research on initial e-commerce trust in the introduction stage, this study developed a model to explain the influence of individual's dispositional trust and technology trust on initial e-commerce trust belief based on previous research. Empirical data was collected from a survey of B2C e-commerce users in China to verify proposed hypotheses. The result shows that consumers' e-commerce trust belief is positively affected by both dispositional trust and technology trust. However, dispositional trust shows no obvious influence on technology trust.

articleTitle: Stochastic Volatility in Underlyings and Downside Risk of Derivative Portfolios
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We carry out a Monte-Carlo simulation of the downside risk of a standard derivative portfolio as a function of a change in stochastic volatility of the underlyings. We find that the reduction in downside risk for most loss levels becomes statistically significant only for very high volatility reversion levels. Those levels are hardly found in practice, and they lead to mild reductions of downside risk. The paper illustrates the counterintuitive property that the common selection of underlyings with low fluctuations in volatility does not significantly reduce the downside risk of derivative portfolios, whereas it severely narrows down the set of tradable assets.

articleTitle: Decision Models of Task Assignment for Virtual Enterprises Based on Multi-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays a sophisticated match-making mechanism is necessary for appropriate collaborations in virtual enterprise (VE). In a VE, any member enterprise should take initiative in involvement according to the internal production condition, which is changing dynamically with independent management sovereignty. Just under the environment, this paper develops a dynamic multi-agent-based task assignment system comprising production agent, information control center agent, task agent and resource agent, for VEs, attempting to address the selection of individually managed partners and the process of assigning tasks to them. Finally, decision-making models of task assignment such as partner-selection decisions, resource agent-selection decisions as well as task-selection decisions were studied.

articleTitle: Connotation and Value Measurement of CSM Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: CSM integration theory is one of the 5 basic theories of complexity science management (CSM) put forward by professor Xu xusong. In the paper, connotation of the CSM integration is implemented in an in-depth analysis, including concept of CSM integration and rules of CSM integration as well as steps of CSM integration, on the basis of which, the resource systems are classified. According to net value brought to organizations due to exchanges of substance, fund and effectiveness as well as information etc, a method for value measurement of CSM integration is provided.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Career Success of Knowledge Employees: The Effects of Individual and Organizational Career Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Co-Operation between Bank and 3rd-Party Payment Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-party payment accelerates the development of electronic payment. It provides a successful solution to two base problems that restrict the development of e-commerce for a long time in China, on-line payment and creditability. Using models and theories of game theory, the paper analyses the co-operative relationship between bank and 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-party payment. There are two steps to analyze the issue in the paper. Firstly, the article discusses bank's rational attitude to 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-party payment: cooperation or non-cooperation. Secondly, using the principle and agents theory, the paper answers the question of how to cooperate. At last, the paper advises bank to establish a cooperative mechanism with 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-party payment.

articleTitle: Agent Organization Modeling and Its Evolution Mechanism in SOA-Based Collaborative Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Distributed component technology and Web service increasingly have become the important cornerstones of showing dynamic, virtual and agility of collaborative commerce system. As a main modeling method in the theoretical research field of collaborative commerce, multi-agent system has not met the development trend of open, network distributed of the application environment. The paper plans from agent organization modeling, then constructs service nodes, designs the structure of organization model as three-hierarchy: virtual alliance organization, agent role organization and service unit, and discusses the formation and evolution mechanism of organizational structure. So that it expands the new connotation about the application of multi-agent organization behavior theory in collaborative commerce system.

articleTitle: Digital Composite Component Production Line System for Aircraft Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The present research work deals with the production line architecture based on Single Source Product Data (SSPD) to solve the integration problem of multi-systems for digital composite components production line. Owing to fewer relative cases in this area it requires the through analysis of the digital composite component production line and the architecture of digital product line from various aspects. The architecture described in this paper is related to the data generation and traffic of product manufacturing and application by expanding the baseline of SSPD to two-dimensional. It comprises the transmission platform for the product data, and then to a three-dimensional structure. The research work has been implemented in an aircraft manufacturing industry. The product data integration, validation has been executed via an integration system including design and manufacturing departments by smoothening of data flow of digital production lines.

articleTitle: Research of E-Commerce System Based on Multi-Agent Negotiation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new multi-agent automated negotiation model is developed and evaluated, in which two competitive agents, such as the buyer and seller, have firm deadlines and incomplete information about each other. The negotiation is multi-dimensional in different cases. The model improves the model of Wooldridge and that of Sycara to a certain extent. An e-commerce model based on multiagent automated negotiation model is also illustrated for the e-commerce application in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Anycast for Lighting Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Advantages and disadvantages of traditional for lighting control system are firstly analyzed. Defects in data transport among lighting devices in lighting control system is also pointed out. Low available bandwidth and low reliability are the two key factors. So anycast is introduced into lighting control system. Alternate employment of broadcast, unicast, multicast and anycast are proposed, which makes lighting control system adapt to the development of Web technology, the defects will be overcame efficiently. Reliability and high available bandwidth for data transport are easily realized. The strategy has a good profile in lighting control system in the future.

articleTitle: Analysis on Patent Distribution of VESTAS, GAMESA and GOLDWIND
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: VESTAS and GAMESA are tycoons of global wind power industry, while GOLDWIND is the bellwether of Chinese wind power industry. Based on patent data of Derwent Innovations Index, we made a comparative analysis on regional distribution and technical distribution of patent application between VESTAS, GAMESA and GOLDWIND, using patent analysis method. After identified market strategy of core enterprises and technical trend of wind power industry, we made some suggestions on development of Chinese domestic wind power enterprises.

articleTitle: RosettaNet-Based Implementation of CPFR Using Semantic Web Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Synergistic effect and competitive pressure drive firms to participate in supply chain coordination which depends on the alignment of business goals, interaction processes and information flow across the supply chain. This paper presents the implementation of supply chain coordination focusing on CPFR using RosettaNet and semantic Web services. We use CPFR to define the closed-loop functionality connection within supply chain and guarantee that customers' demands are the source and goal of multi-partners coordination.
