Further, we utilize the Rosettanet PIPs to create the sharing process templates of CPFR, and map business logic, message flow, actions and message contents into composition rule, composition process, Web services and message of Web service interactions respectively so that it is easy to specify the roadmap of Web service composition and improve the efficiency of Web service composition. Besides, we formularize the composition of web services. Finally, we design the architecture of server according to three interoperability levels: message, process and business.

articleTitle: Research of Speed Model and Simulation Based on Vehicle Braking Tyre Imprint
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For accurately calculating the former speed of vehicle braking, by analyzing the vehicle wheels braking-forces, and considering the changing position of gravity center and the speed changing of braking-force during time increasing, constructing the vehicle speed calculating models which is based on tyre imprint. Considering the variety types of tyre printing on accident site and the requirements for quickly and accurately collecting data, according to the modifying coefficient of the braking tyre imprint and braking-force increasing coefficient, applying the energy balance law. Calculated the braking-force increasing coefficient by the real data, compared with the real vehicle speed, the vehicle speed that is calculated by the vehicle speed model and the original model through the data, it is proved the effectiveness and accuracy for the new method.

articleTitle: Urban Traffic Noise and Quieter Pavement Research
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban traffic noise has become a growing public concern and the public is requiring 'quieter pavement' be constructed to abate traffic noise levels. On the traffic noise concerned by developed countries, the research and development of traffic noise control and quieter pavement were introduced and discussed, some program of quieter pavement research and test methods and research results were presented. The tire/pavement noise is greatly influenced by pavement surface characteristics such as gradation, macro texture, age, and presence of distresses.

articleTitle: Based On Multi-Agent System to Bundle Services in the Publishing House Service Marketing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the past, the books are the only market products and the only way to profit of the publishing house. Recently, it is recognized that free services can enhance the book sale. From the customer viewpoint and the service supplier viewpoint, the services descriptions and services management is different. The customer except to acquire different books information as much as possible. Information relations between different books are important. But the service suppliers can well manage the various services of every book and are short of books relations management. Both have some divergences of service definition, service management and other issues. In this paper, we present a solution based on agent and ontology to solve these questions. We use multi-agent technology to provide the atomic or combined service to customers.

articleTitle: Developing Brand's Love to Consumer in Service: A Study of Sedan Maintenance Service Brand in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on worldwide development of experience economy, service brand and newly born brand love research, this paper aims to brand's love to consumer (BLTC) and proposes a model based on theoretical review. Using data from sedan maintenance service brand in China, we find support for the existence of love from brand to consumer which can be divided into three dimensions. The implications of this study are discussed along with suggestions for future research.

articleTitle: An Integration Model of Workflow and Knowledge Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Workflow technology has become a hot research field in collaborative system. However, with rapid development of the Internet, there are some barriers to the widespread use and efficiency of collaborative system based on workflow, because research of knowledge flow isn't to be paid enough attention in collaborative system. To solve the issue in collaborative environment, in this paper we attempt to analysis the attributes of knowledge flow during the procession, and propose an integrated model of workflow and knowledge flow in collaborative system. Our purpose is to increase whole efficiency of collaboration and effective knowledge share, and further to provide intelligence services such as push some relative knowledge in time during the process via Internet or Intranet. This paper performs the following tasks: (1) introduction of collaborative system, workflow and knowledge flow; (2) discussion of interaction mechanism between workflow and knowledge flow during a business process; (3) presentation an integration model of workflow and knowledge flow; and (4) conclusion and expectation of the further work.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi-Protocol RFID Tag Simulation Platform Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of automatic identification technology, ultra high frequency radio frequency identification (UHF RFID) tags are used more and more widely in supply chain. One of the major challenges is the bulk reading. According to the most widely used UHF RFID standards, this paper proposed a multi-protocol RFID tag simulation platform which can simulate multiple UHF tag signals almost simultaneously. The simulation platform is based on a multi-processor hardware target which consists of a Texas Instruments TMS320C6713 digital signal processor and Altera Stratix II EP2S60 FPGA. The tag simulation platform could be used to verify UHF RFID system performance and collect processing data for further analysis to improve anti-collision or security algorithm. The platform also allows some configurations and shows very good performance.

articleTitle: Research and Development of MIS for Port & Waterway Engineering Supervision
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research introduces the process of PWESMIS based on the network information technology and the port & waterway engineering supervision experiences, and expatiates the main functions, flow of data and specialty of technology of the system. The result of testing operation indicates that the PWESMIS is of great practical significance.

articleTitle: Threshold Cointegration Relationships between Oil and Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to study the oil price adjustment dynamics and to implicitly test the efficiency hypothesis for the oil market. Thus, we study the oil price evolution in a nonlinear framework and investigate the interdependence hypothesis between oil and stock markets for two countries: Mexico and the Philippines. On the one hand, we highlight significant linear linkage between stock markets and oil industry indicating the presence of significant long-run relationships between oil and stock markets, and rejecting efficient capital market hypothesis. On the other hand, we propose a new nonlinear modeling to reproduce the oil price adjustment dynamics. It takes into account both stock and oil market variations.

articleTitle: Business, Network, and Entrepreneur: The Drivers of Rapid Internationalization of the Born Global Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the role of business-, network and entrepreneur - specific factor in driving rapid internationalization of the born global firms. Drawing upon a sample of 74 born global firms in the Yangtze Delta, results of a LISRELL analysis reveal that business-, network and entrepreneur - specific factor have a positive influence on the rapid internationalization of the born global firms. Furthermore, this research shows that entrepreneur-specific factor is positively related to business and network. The results illustrate that entrepreneur-specific factor plays an important role in driving rapid internationalization of the born global firms.

articleTitle: Building Business Intelligence Application with SAP BI
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Business intelligence systems based on SAP BI which is used by an enterprise is an effective option to inform and guide our decision making to keep our products and services competitive. This paper systematically describes SAP BI's components and analyzes how to build business intelligence systems with SAP BI.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supply Chain Management Based on Product Types and Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain management (SCM) has been given much attention in academic research and industrial application. However, failures in SCM are still not uncommon in today's industries. In order to improve and optimize supply chain performance, different products should match different SCM strategies and SCM strategies should change over the life cycle of the product. This paper synthesizes past research about SCM based on product and product life cycle and discusses the product classification and supply chain types. We close the paper with recommendations for future research in supply chain management based on product and product life cycle.

articleTitle: Enterprise Energy Saving and Emission Reduction Level Assessment Research Based on the Capability Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the status quo of Chinese enterprises' environmental management and their practice on the the current hot spots "Energy Saving and Emission Reduction", and combine with the idea of Capability Maturity Model of "continuous improvement", this paper puts forward a enterprise SER-CMM model which is able to assess enterprises' level of Energy Saving and Emission Reduction, works out the KPA of every level in enterprise ESER-CMM through the Delphi method, and also describes the algorithm for the level assessment. In a word, this paper provides a method for the evaluation of the enterprises' capability in Energy Saving and Emission Reduction.

articleTitle: Influence of Cyclist Behavior on Mixed Traffic Flow at Signal Intersection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents driver and bicyclist crossing behavior, including the crossing speeds, crossing gap/lag acceptance behavior parameters at intersection. Traffic behaviors data recordings from a signalized intersection were measured with the video collected with right-turn vehicle speeds, gap/lag distribution and bicyclist group-riding crossing behavior whether under traffic guide or not. The results are useful for understanding the performance of mixed traffic flow behaviors at signalized intersections and building microscopic simulation models. This paper includes five sections, first part introduce the bicycle basic research harvest in resent years, Section two shows the relation of conflict points with signalized phases. The third part are the intersection traffic status and data collection. Fourth part is behavior parameter stat.. The last part is interference conclusion, bicycle behavior distribution.

articleTitle: Process Models and Profit Models in Tourism Electronic Wisdom Design
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of witkey model has become increasingly popular within both the academic and business arena. And witkey mode continues to grow and evolve as a vital basis with which electronic wisdom can upgrade its capabilities and grow its businesses. With the segmentation of electronic wisdom market, tourism electronic wisdom has also made the progress. In this paper the author analysis the profit models and process models of electronic wisdom, and combine the advantages and disadvantages of electronic wisdom model in order to find a perfect model for the development of tourism electronic wisdom. And the author believe that tourism electronic wisdom is an important Internet application that is going to significantly change the way of commercial transaction and people's life style.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Real Estate Syndicate with Game Theory in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Study on the Calculable Method about Business Logistics Cost
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on logistics cost calculational method of Activity-based costing, the thesis puts forward a new calculational method about business logistics cost based on a combination of activity and time, presents a computation model of this method, And compares this method with ABC method through analyzing a case.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Estimation Model for Information Systems Security Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a probabilistic estimation model for information systems security (ISS) risk analysis based on evidential reasoning approach is presented. The modeling process consists of four phases: specification of the model structure, estimation of evidence strength, computation of beliefs on assertions, and ISS risk monitoring and analysis. Using the changes of strength of evidences obtained in the organization's information systems, the model can continually estimate the probability of risk, and identify the sources of risk. The significance of the work is that the model provides objective and visible support for ISS risk analysis.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of a Monitoring System of Local Fiscal Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the summarization of the study of local fiscal risk, this paper considers that Local Fiscal Risk focus on the local government debt and correlate the local finance and economy nearly. By this point, it puts forward two layers' monitoring indicators which are local government debt indicator and combined indicator of local finance and economy, and set up two monitoring standard which are value L of risk of local government debt and value F of combined risk of local finance and economy. Then it chooses the data of A province in China, calculates L and F by using the Appraising Model of AHP weight of entropy ,and analyzes the relativity and multi-linear regression between L and F, thereby putting forward the monitoring standard of local fiscal risk.

articleTitle: The Confirmation of the Organizational Learning Module and Index of the Evaluation in Library
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the four factors analyses of the organizational learning in library. This paper point s out the organizational learning is mostly the result of the common thinking module of the individual behavior according to this result. We construct the process module of the library organizational learning and also put forward the evaluation index corresponding t o the organizational learning.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Based Logistics System of 3PL in P. R. China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intensified globalization and consequent competitive pressures have reemphasized the importance of third party logistics (3PL) in managing logistics processes as well as customer and supplier relationships within the supply chain management (SCM). 3PL providers and their upstream and downstream parties within the whole chain have usually interacted as disconnected entities in the logistics performance management process.This paper studied the main ideas of the knowledge-based logistics system, The results of testing and applying the tool in companies are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Projects Risk Evaluation Based on Unascertained Measure Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk evaluation of water conservancy investment projects is a complicated and unascertained system decision making problem. Combining with the character of water conservancy investment projects risk evaluation, index system of risk evaluation is established and the method of computing evaluation index weight which combines analytic hierarchy process method and information entropy method is built. The model of water conservancy investment projects risk evaluation based on unascertained measure model is established. The case shows that the unascertained measure model is applicable for risk evaluation of water conservancy investment projects. It is also helpful for risk management to water conservancy investment projects.

articleTitle: The Research on the Method of Process Knowledge Representation and Acquisition in the Process of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In aim to solve the problem of process knowledge(PK) which can't easy to be accumulated and to be shared effectively in the process of project management, in this paper we tried to apply the systems science method to analyze and manage these knowledge, then suggested a method with ameliorative multi-factor flow chart (MFFC-II) and multi-level document (MLD-II ), and according to the characteristic of PK and the factual procedure of project management established a method for acquiring these PK .

articleTitle: Research on Internal Evaluation of the Service Quality of Power Supply Based on the Improved Fuzzy AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose to develop internal evaluation on the service quality of power supply is to satisfy the need to provide high quality service for customers. In this paper, through the research on operating links of client service and quality control process of power supply enterprises, an index system for internal evaluation on the service quality of power supply is constructed. On this basis, the improved fuzzy AHP is used to build the certainty model of index weight, which solved the fuzzy uncertainty problem when constructing a comparison-judgment matrix. At last, this paper takes a power supply company in a certain city for example to carry the empirically analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluation of GRAL for the Pollutant Dispersion under Low Wind Speed Conditions from Two Road Tunnel Portals in Nanjing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A Lagrangian atmospheric dispersion model GRAL dealing with the dispersion of pollutants from a roadway tunnel portal has been introduced, with its application in Nanjing. The results show the dispersion characteristics under local meteorological conditions, especially in low wind speed conditions. A comparison with a Gaussian point source model and a CFD model (FLUENT), has been made. Under the low wind speeds and parallel-to-the-road wind conditions, GRAL has advantages over the Gaussian and CFD models, while the latter two overestimate concentrations as a result of neglecting the influence of the ambient wind fluctuations on position of the jet flow from the portal. The cases here might be useful in someway for pollution controlling, environment impact assessment and project design.

articleTitle: Adoption of Mobile Video: An Empirical Study in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although mobile video has provided high-speed, convenient and personalized services, reports now on mobile video show that potential users may not be using the systems. Thus, research is needed to identify the factors determining users' acceptance of mobile video. Theoretical and empirical analysis were undertaken and reported to explain the factors that influence potential users' adoption of it by extending the technology acceptance model. Seven factors are identified: perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, subjective norm perceived fun, perceived cost, network quality, and attitude. Perceived usefulness is the most important factor affecting attitude. Moreover, several implications for mobile video acceptance research and practices are discussed.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On Promotion Mechanism of the Knowledge Chain's Social Capital to Its Inter-Organizational Knowledge Creation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring and Analysis of Yanming Lake No.2 in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Yanming Lake No.2 in Xi'an Chan-Ba Ecological District is taken as the main research target in this paper. We analyze the changing rules and the influencing factors of each indicator from July, 2008 to March, 2009 by monitoring the physical and chemical indexes of the water, such as pH, TN, TP, DO, COD etc. Experimental results show that: Lake No.2 belongs to alkalescent basic with a DO content reaching Standard II and a bit high value of TN and COD.

articleTitle: Real-Time Flood Forecasting System Based on B/S Mode
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: C/S structure and B/S structure are analyzed respectively, with the combination of watershed hydrological model and new technologies such as ASP.NET, WebGIS and database connection, a real-time flood forecasting system in 3-layer B/S mode is developed. Based on B/S mode, the system realizes the functions like query, maintenance and display of remote information, real-time flood forecasting, correction of model parameters and distance interactive consultation, etc. Practical application shows that the system has good usability, extensibility and maintainability.

articleTitle: Mutual Fund Performance Dynamic Evaluation Using Data Envelopment Windows Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we mainly present data envelopment analysis (DEA) based method for evaluating portfolio performance in two aspects, (a) To reflect the pervasive fat tails and asymmetry in return distributions of mutual funds, we introduce risk measure CVaR into DEA indices for measuring relative performance of portfolios more objectively, (b) We creatively treat the same funds during different time periods as different decision making units (DMUs) to fairly observe the performance variation. Our empirical results show that our model can better evaluate mutual funds' overall performance variation during a long time period.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Urban Emergency Management Capability and Application Based on AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of research on the urban emergency management capability evaluation methods, the disadvantages of the commonly used methods are found and the overall indicators of urban emergency management capacity together with three chronological stages are determined by analyzing the influencing indicators of urban emergency management capability. On the basis of three stages and indicators the application of AHP evaluation methods helps to establish the comprehensive evaluation model of the urban emergency management capability and provides a new quantitative evaluation method for the urban emergency management capability combined with a case study.

articleTitle: Strategical Role of Organizational Learning and Knowledge Sharing on Relationship between Human Resource Management System and Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To explore the relationships among human resource system, organizational learning, knowledge sharing and firm performance, Chinese enterprises participated in this investigation. We found that HRM system influenced organizational learning while organizational learning influenced knowledge sharing and firm performance positively, and knowledge sharing also had a direct influence on firm performance. As anticipated, the intervening effect of organizational learning and knowledge sharing between HRM system and firm performance was significant. Implications, limitations and future research directions for the study are discussed.

articleTitle: Research of Software Defect Prediction Model Based on Gray Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The software testing process is an important stage in the software life cycle to improve software quality. An amount of software data and information can be obtained. Based on analyzing the source and the type of software, this paper describes several use of the defects data and explains how to estimate the density of the software by using the software defects data collected in the practical work, and to use GM model to predict and assess the software reliability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Feasibility Study on the Service Economy in the Rise of Central China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Verifiable Investigation on the Independent Innovation and Performance Appraisal of Enterprises Based on DEA Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Independent innovation becomes an important force for enterprises in China facing the economic global challenges and ever development. A performance appraisal to the independent innovation activities of enterprises in China will be benefit for enterprises to manage their independent innovation activities more scientific and reasonable. The present study makes choices to independent innovation and performance appraisal model of enterprises and selects indexes based on DEA method, and makes verifiable investigation and evaluation through innovation data of several enterprises.

articleTitle: H.264 Video Encoder Implementation Based on TMS320DM642 DSP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Real-time requirement is the key problem in video applications. Due to its complicated computation, the video compression standard H.264 cannot meet the real-time encoding constraints. In the paper, the hardware platform of video encoding and decoding based on the TMS320DM642 is designed and constructed, the DSP implementation of H.264 video compression standard is discussed in the paper. We transplant the reference model of H.264 into the hardware platform based on the DM642 and describe in detail how to modify the JM Code and how to optimize the modified reference code in order that the H.264 code can be executed well on the DM642 platform. The experiment on the hardware platform verifies that the proposed video encoder can distinctly reduce the computational complexity and increase encoding speed with little quality loss of the rebuild image, hence it enable to meet the real-time encoding constraints.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management Quality, Maturity and Consistency
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article constructed a measurement model of human resource management quality (HRMQ) from the perspective of total quality management (TQM) and enterprise internal service management quality, testing the validity of the model based on 326 enterprises' samples which collected by a questionnaire developed by the author independently. The result showed that HRMQ could be appraised form the level of technique, profession and strategy. At the same time, empirical results validated the seven levels maturity model of enterprise human resources management (HRM), it showed that the variance of the technical level, professional level and strategic level of HRMQ balanced mutually while upgrading HRMQ, reflecting that the high quality HRM emphasized the consistency of management more than the low quality HRM. This paper validated the rationality and universality of the theory and methods of BSC in enterprise management from the perspective of HRMQ.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Conceptual Framework and Key Issues of Project Management Based on Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Degree Evaluation on Economic System Vulnerability of Daqing City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of resources-based cities, Daqing encounters plenty of knotty problems relevant to vulnerability that even more serious than Comprehensive cities'. One of the most compelling questions has to do with petroleum city directed vulnerable economic system. This paper focused on two aspects, the ability of economic system react on petroleum resource decrease; degree of sensibility in vulnerability. Indeed, construct an evaluation index system of vulnerability with 16 elements. Moreover, apply with principle component analysis method to evaluate the degree on economic system vulnerability of Daqing city. In conclusion, the tendency of development on vulnerability economic system of Daqing city is decline, however, still in the medium level. Also, this paper discuss the feature of vulnerability on economic system of Daqing city, See if the direct of development and proposal ways of moderation and evasion.

articleTitle: A Smart-Card Based DRM Authentication Scheme for Mobile TV System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel three party authentication scheme which could realize the mutual authentication among the involved parities (service provider, terminal and smart-card), and our scheme can be used for more fair-use oriented DRM scheme framework design. The scheme is highly efficient and secure, and it's immune to many existing attacks.

articleTitle: CBR Approach in BOT Project Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses case-based reasoning (CBR) approach to establish estimation method of build-operate-transfer (BOT) project risk, through a CBR assessment system that helps stakeholder to master the specific features of the BOT project under the present conditions. Affected by numerous factors related both to the specific features of the project and dynamically changed situations, BOT projects risk assessment problems are highly unstructured. Risk management aims to anticipate the future performances of the project and the economic parameter range of the project. Through the CBR system, similar cases can be retrieved to assess the possible influence of BOT project risk degree. An example of garbage burning power plant in china is explained and evaluated to demonstrate the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Establishment of Vector Model for Construction Engineering Management of Military Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationship of the three main factors of engineering management, is analyzed based on the concept of construction engineering management, which are resource, technology and management. Then, vector model is established which can quantitatively describe the mutuality of each element and its sub-element. The level of engineering management, the defects and loopholes at construction preparation stage can be assessed by this model, and quantitative evaluation to the realized level of management objective when project finished can also be assessed.

articleTitle: Climate Change Impacts on Water Resources and Ecological Environment of Inland Watersheds in the Hexi Region of West Gansu, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Water resources characteristics in meltwater-fed watersheds of the Qilian Mountains and Hexi region were analyzed with respect to observed changes in climate, extent of glaciation and snow cover, river water yields, groundwater resources, and vegetation during the past 47 years (1960-2006). Results show with global warming, the rate of temperature increase in the Qilian Mountains has exceeded national (0.5 degC) and global (0.74 degC) rates by about 1.0 degC in the last 47 years. Although not spatially uniform, yearly precipitation levels in the Qilian Mountains have generally risen, on average by 28 mm in the past 47 years. Over the same time period, extent of glaciation in the Qilian Mountains has decreased by about 8% from a initial area of 1619 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in 1956 to 1489 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in 2000. The extent of snow cover in the eastern to middle portions of the Qilian Mountains decrease from 1997 to 2006 based on the NOAA and EOS/MODIS remote sensing monitoring data, but increase in the western Qilian Mountains. Water yields in the Shiyang River have declined by about 4.5times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> over five decades from 1.7times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1950s to 1.25times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1990s; while in the west, in the Shule River system, water yields have increased by about 9.3times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1990s from an initial 8.1times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1960s. Groundwater resources have decreased by about 46% in the past 50 years from 6.51times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1950s to 3.58times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the 1990s. In the past decade (1997-2006), the total vegetated areas in the Shiyang River and Hei River watersheds have decreased as a result of desertification and the remaining vegetation communities have generally undergone compositional changes from tree communities to low-lying shrub complexes. Climate change and unconstrained land use practices have put the ecological environment and sustainable development of the Hexi Corridor at enormous risk. The authors provide recommendations as how to protect the water resources in the Qilian Mountains and inland watersheds of the Hexi Corridor.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Digital DX Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The digital innovation for transmitter is a key technology of MW&SW digital broadcasting technology. The paper studies the digital innovation for DX transmitter based on the principles and structures of DX series MW transmitters which are employed widely. The design of a transmitter innovation scheme, the adapter circuits of transmitter for digital broadcasting and the software are provided in this paper. The implementation of digital DX transmitter is achieved successfully. The discussion of the principle of DX MW transmitter and the key technologies for the digital innovation, the detail design and a final test result are also included in this paper.

articleTitle: Visual Dynamic Simulation Based Optimal Scheduling of RCC Dam Construction Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Roller compacted concrete (RCC) is quite sensitive and construction scheduling for RCC is less forgiving than for conventional concrete. Therefore, systematically managing and scheduling are critical to ensure all related activities be meticulously planned, as well as equipment, workers and materials be well organized and allocated well before construction starts. In view of this, a solution called visual dynamic simulation (VDS) based scheduling approach is built up. It could propose the optimal construction scheduling, simulate and demonstrate the whole construction process in 3-d computer animation, and give the results analyses via tables and graphs. With a case study of longkaikou RCC gravity dam, its effect has successfully proved.

articleTitle: Generation, Environmental Impact and Treatment of Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The generation of waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) has been increasing continuously year by year. In this paper, the generation and environmental impact of WEEE were reviewed. The related treatment of WEEE also was discussed.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy System Improving Security for City Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduce the possibility of the city energy shortage in the summer and dealing with the emergency cases with the gas-electricity peak shaving method to ensure security energy supply of city in accordance with distributed energy system (DES), such as the gas turbine power generation central heating and cooling technologies. Simultaneously, this paper explain the feasibility of gas fired of heat, cold and power cogeneration system in building through typical example of model project and give some suggestions of energy supply emergency response system in the main city with a diversified city energy system.

articleTitle: Information Security Risk Assessment Based on AHP/DST
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To enhance the security management on information systems, it is urgent to apply some effective approaches for assessing their security. In this paper, a novel approach, in which analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and Dempster-Shafer theory of evidence (DST) can be combined organically, is presented. In this approach, AHP is applied to acquire all propositions' basic probability assignments (BPA) based on a large amount of experts' opinion when assessing the security. Thus, the DST's ability of dealing with uncertain information and AHP's performance of quantitative and qualitative analysis may be utilized fully. Furthermore, a hierarchical risk assessment model for the information security is established. Finally, an illustrative example is given to explain the application of the proposed approach and its feasibility.

articleTitle: Information Sharing Risk in Supply Chain and Its Preventive Measures
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In supply chain, information asymmetry will bring risk to cooperative enterprises when they are sharing information and the risk may also make them lose their interests, so it's very important to weak the information sharing risk as far as possible. This article gives some examples of the information sharing risk in several forms, analyzes the causes and proposes several corresponding preventive measures.

articleTitle: Covariance Adjusting and Asset Pricing: Under Investor Overconfidence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces a method to model asset price. The covariance would be adjusted in light of overconfidence, which make asset prices reflect both rational covariance risk and whole components arising from mispricing. The models imply, for same quantity, the price variation about positive signals is more drastic than that on the negative.

articleTitle: Safety Benefit Evaluation of Power Supply Enterprise Based on Entropy Weight and AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, diversified factors and calculation methods which affect the safety input and output of power supply enterprise are analyzed. The index system of safety benefit is established and also safety benefit evaluation model of power supply enterprise is established based on the AHP (analytic hierarchy process) which uses the entropy method. In the end, the validity and applicability of the safety benefit indicators and evaluation models are validated by using the practice data of power supply enterprise sustainable.

articleTitle: Consumer Information Search Behavior with Time Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on perceived trust and search time, this paper develops a consumer utility model that describes consumer information search behavior in online retailer. The model reveals that consumer utility is direct proportion to perceived trust in online retailer and inverse proportion to search time. Furthermore, consumer utility increases as search time increases within time threshold, while consumer utility decreases as search time increases. Finally, the time threshold of consumer information search is inverse proportional to price.

articleTitle: Fast Generation of Animation Character's Gestures Using Dynamic Line
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we present a sketch-based method for generating animation character's gestures using dynamic line. The process begins by sketching a character to be animated. And the dynamic line is sketched too. The character's gesture is then generated automaticlly by analysing the motion character according to the dynamic line. The method emphasizes the style of handwriting, and helps to create the gestures quickly. It can be widely used in animation design.

articleTitle: House Site Selection Decision Support System Based on ArcGIS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Housing problem is a best solution problem with multi limits, which are related to specific geographic bodies. A geographic decision support system is formed for house site selection evaluation based on spatial and network analysis of ArcGIS and the use of the system is demonstrated with a practical example in Xi'an. Various factors are defined by time-based distance or straight-line distance and overlaid to form the site selection result.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Urban River-Crossing Traffic Infrastructure Based on TIA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Economic analysis is the core content of project feasibility study and evaluation, and an important basis for decision making. Its role is to minimize the risk and improve returns on investment. Traffic impact analysis (TIA) is to analyses the extent and scope of the influence of the project on the urban traffic, according to the study of the inner relationship between urban development project and traffic demand growth. It then advances countermeasures of maintaining the LOS, and implements the compensation policy to reduce traffic load impact of the development. Based on the idea of TIA, this paper analyses and evaluates the impact of urban river-crossing traffic infrastructure on surrounding network, using the technology of TIA for benefit analysis on traffic infrastructure.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Knowledge Sharing in the Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the definition of knowledge and knowledge-sharing, analyzes the model of knowledge-sharing, points that the process of knowledge-sharing between employees is the dynamic-repeated games, through using KMRW theory, analyzes the possibilities of knowledge-sharing and the problems should be paid attention to in the process of implementing knowledge sharing, and presents interrelated proposals and suggestions of implementing knowledge sharing in the organization.

articleTitle: Innovation of Design Quality Management Based on Project Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The improvement of design quality is an important issue in project quality management. In this paper, the project life cycle theory is first introduced in design quality management to expand the connotation of design quality. Through questionnaire and expert interview, the design quality indicators based on project life cycle are concluded, which are used in establishing the design quality matrix based on Engineering Breakdown Structure (EBS) -Objective Breakdown Structure (OBS). The framework of project life cycle design is proposed. With the application of concurrent engineering, the interaction of design quality information in project life cycle comes true and the continuous improvement of design quality based on project life cycle can be achieved.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Scheduling in BitTorrent File Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, BitTorrent file distribution network has been more and more widely used for media file distribution. Its build-in resource scheduling policies (local rare first, tit-for-tat, etc.) work well in file distribution in single swarm environments. However, the resource scheduling policy is missing in multiple swarms environments and the resource utilization has not been optimized. In this work, our goal is to optimize the resource utilization in multiple swarms environments according to link utilization and peer satisfaction. We propose our optimizing resource policies based on swarm parameters, namely hidden-seed policy and weight-leecher policy. Our evaluation results show that the hidden-seed policy increases the link utilization while the weight-leecher policy improves the peer satisfaction in the system.

articleTitle: Establishment of Combining Grey Model with Partial Least Squares Regression for City Energy Consumption Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a forecasting method, combining grey model (GM) with partial least squares regression (PLS), was applied to forecasting city terminal energy consumption for the first time. PLS is of the advantage of overcoming the correlative affect among independent variables, distinguishing the system signal from noises, and explaining dependent variables well; GM (1, 1) model is able to overcome the non-linear interference of parameters. The more accurate prediction could be achieved by the combination of these two methods to forecast the complicated and non-linear energy consumption system. The single model and combined model based on Dalian's historical data were established, verified and compared. The result showed that relative err from the combined method was 2.93%, less than that from any method alone. From the prediction results by the combined method including seven variables, the city terminal energy consumption of Dalian were 18.76 Mtce, 29.85 Mtce, and 46.90 Mtce in 2010, 2015 and 2020, respectively, providing reference frame for energy planning and decision-making.

articleTitle: An Improved Genetic Algorithm for Multiple-Machine Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA) is one of the most effective methods to solve combination optimal problem of machine scheduling. The aspect application of GA is limited because limitations of itself. The paper purposes an improved GA with self adaptation selection of crossover probability and mutation probability, and non-equiprobability selection of crossover sites through analyzing the limitation of rareripe and heterogeneous search. The application and simulation in a steel rope enterprise multiple-machine scheduling problem are given using the method. The result is correct and rational.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method of Network Security Situation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A prediction method of network security situation based on gen expression programming (PCN_GEP) has been proposed. The main contribution include: (1) Propose cycle-weighted sliding window prediction method to deal with the cycle-changing network risk situation. (2) Fibonacci-weight is added to the preprocess of training dataset to ensure that the latest data have the most impaction to the future. Immunity model which can dynamically reflect the network real-time state has been introduced into computer network risk evaluation to get the initial training data in our experimentation, the experimentation results proved that this method has high precision in the forecasting of computer network security situation.

articleTitle: Construction Quality-Cost Trade-Off Using the Pareto-Based Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A successful construction project management aims to maximize construction quality, minimize construction cost, satisfy the finish deadline assigned by owners and stipulated in the contract. In the paper, a Pareto-based ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm, which is an innovative algorithm to solve combinatorial optimization problem was firstly employed to solve two-dimensional quality-cost trade off problem in construction management. A case study was employed to verify the feasibility of the proposed Pareto-based ACO algorithm. The results showed it is feasible to use the Pareto-based ACO algorithm to solve the trade-off problems in the construction management.

articleTitle: The Risk Evaluation of Human Resources for Power Supplying Company Based on Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to know the human resources conditions of power supplying companies and to avoid the potential risks, this paper sets up an evaluation index system for the risk of human resources according to the characteristics of power supplying company. Then the scores of human resources risk are obtained by AHP method and linear weighted method. The cloud model is introduced to get concept partition of human resources risk instead of the hard division method in previous studies. The concepts gained by this way can reflect the data distribution characteristics more obviously. After that, by backward cloud generator, the cloud parameters can be got, which are used for evaluation. The example in this paper shows that the model is feasible and effective since it can offer more hidden information.

articleTitle: Registration Correction for Augmented Reality in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Current e-commerce technologies cannot provide enough information to buyers. By overlaying virtual information of products on the real world, augmented reality (AR) technology might improve the performance of e-commerce. Too many registration errors are the key hindering factors in AR actual system. Hybrid tracking is a key technique in combating the effects of dynamic errors. In this paper we present a multi-stage close-loop correction algorithm for reducing dynamic registration errors in AR system. The control law in this algorithm is based on 2D visual servoing or image-based camera control that allows control of a virtual camera to reduce registration error. The experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: ID-Based Threshold Proxy Signature Scheme from Bilinear Pairings
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Proxy signature can be combined other special signature to obtain some new types of proxy signature. Threshold proxy signature is a variant of the proxy signature. Most of existing threshold proxy signature schemes based on the certificate-based public key systems. But, in some cases, the receiver cannot find out who signed the proxy signatures. In this paper, we put forward to a novel identity-based threshold proxy signature scheme from bilinear pairings without a dealer. Using our scheme, the original signer can know who generated the proxy signature and the receiver can certify the actuality of the group signers. Moreover, the constructions of our scheme would be simpler but still with high security.

articleTitle: Analysis on Group Factors of Engineering Quality Problems Based on Evidenced-Management Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The engineering quality problems in construction projects in China are investigated. It can be known that the main problems could be divided into 9 categories and 24 subcategories. There are 11 factors that resulted in the problems, which are engineering design, management methods, organizing rules, materials, instruments, technologies, project personnel, environment, objective factors, funds and schedule. By analyzing the relationships among the 11 factors according to the evidenced-management method, it is found that there exist individual effects of each factor and polyploidy effect of related factors. The polyploidy is classified and the effect degree is determined according to the judgments of 29 project management specialists. The result proves that the method of evidenced-management can be used in identifying the reason of engineering quality problem efficiently.

articleTitle: Evaluating on the Industrial Pollution Emission Intensity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of the industrial economic development and pollutant emission trend, this paper, taking Shaanxi Province as an example, used the data of pollutant emission from 2001 to 2006 in various industrial sectors in Shaanxi Province and got the pollution emission intensity of various industrial sectors by using the method of comprehensive evaluating indicator. The clustering analysis on industry GDP contribution rate and pollution emission intensity was made by the method of K-means algorithm. The paper classifies industrial sectors into four types, including adjustment-based development industry, encouragement-based development industry, transformation-based development industry and restriction-based development industry and provides theoretical and practical basis for further adjusting industrial structure.

articleTitle: Debt Financing, Investment and Corporate Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By building simultaneous equations and using 333 Chinese manufacturing listed companies in the panel data from 2001 to 2007, the paper examines the relationship among debt financing, investment and corporate performance. The empirical results indicate that there exists a nonlinear inverse U shape relationship between capital structure and corporate performance, there also exists the same relationship between investment expenditure and corporate performance; corporate performance has a significantly negative influence on capital structure; nonshild has a negative influence on capital structure and debt financing has a significantly negative influence on investment.

articleTitle: External Evaluation Model of Power Supply Service Quality Based on Service Blueprint Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The more drastic competition in power market needs power supply companies to improve service level in order to enhance their competitiveness, and service external evaluation to companies is the basis of the service improving. This paper studies on the external evaluation of power supply service quality. Firstly, the paper confirms main layer indexes of the external evaluation according to power supply business. Secondly, it designs the service blueprints of the various service operations to build point layer indexes. Finally, it builds the evaluation model of power supply enterprise's service quality.

articleTitle: Application of AHP and Fuzzy Multi-Objective Programming to Oilfield Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Oilfield development plan is an important issue to energy exploitation. In addition to the deterministic and stochastic models brought forward in the past studies, this paper proposes a multi-objective programming model for oilfield development plan, in which parameters are fuzzy variables. In order to solve this model, we use AHP to weigh objective functions and design a hybrid intelligent algorithm integrating fuzzy simulation and genetic algorithm. A numerical example is given to illustrate the validity and effectiveness of multi-objective fuzzy programming model and its algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Design of Legal Responsibility System to Controlling Credit Disorder of Construction Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: On Distributed Data Mining of Information Service of Meta-Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Meta-search engine usually lacks own independent backstage database, relying on the database system of underlying independent search engine to provide users with information services. The information services that meet the complex and advanced demand retrieval of customers shows considerable constraints and inadequate. One of the means of improvement is the use of the distributed data mining tools more scientifically and reasonably, setting up its distributed data mining systems, and making use of CDM system thought, agent technology based on advanced mobile and some of the key technologies in the whole system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Transformation of Urban Development Mode in China: From City Marketing to Endogenous Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on ATIS Information Service Media Choice Behavior of Public Transit Traveler
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the special investigation of public transit information requirement in Dalan, the study examines influencing factors of ATIS information service media choice behavior of public transit travelers. After the analysis of public transit information service media, a binary logistics model is presented to research the relativity and internal relationship among the factors influencing public transit travelers' choice behavior. The results indicate that the factors such as vocation, age, types of public transit information, the usage frequency of mobile phone and Internet have significant influences on public transit travelers' choice behavior. The paper provides a reference for the department of urban transportation management to choose the rational information service media for public transit travelers.

articleTitle: Study of e-CRM Based on Distributed Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the development of grid business, e-CRM system receives a mass of data every day. So, how to process and utilize these disorderly massive data are important elements of enterprise business intelligent. However, distributed data mining technology can solve this problem perfectly, which analyzes and processes the data with a distributed method. The system is able to meet real-time and dynamic needs of information in enterprises. Firstly, the paper elaborates working mechanism of distributed data mining, describes the implementation of distributed data mining algorithms. On the basis of this, the paper gives a framework of distributed data mining system model of e-CRM, describes function and characteristics of this system as well as the problems which should be paid attention in the application. All of these provide an effective way for enterprises to deal with distributed massive data.

articleTitle: Partial Least Squares Regression and Its Modeling Realization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, partial least squares regression is introduced. And the modeling steps and the realization of the modeling algorithm for building a PLSR2 model are given. Moreover, a numerical example is presented.

articleTitle: A New Decision Model Based on Entropy for Supplier Selection of Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A scientific and rational method for supplier selection is one of the most important parts in supply chain management. In this paper, a new model based on entropy technology is presented and applied in China telecom industry. First, this paper establishes an index system of supplier selection for telecom operators. Then, a multiple criteria decision-making model is given by using entropy techniques. Finally, this model is applied in telecomm industry. The result shows that this method is very effective for telecomm operator's equipment supplier selection.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Asset-Liability Portfolio Based on Controlling Liquidity Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes the principle of time structure symmetry in asset liability management, and establishes assets liability portfolio optimization model based on double liquidity risk control, which uses maximum of loan interest as objective function and time matching of asset liability as constrain. The contributions of this paper lie on two aspects: firstly, it controls the liquidity risk through the time matching of asset and liability, so as to solve the problem of bank run resulting from shortage of liquidity; secondly, it controls the liquidity risk through the quantity matching of asset and liability, so as to ensure the legitimacy and compliance of bank asset's allocation and avoid liquidity crisis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Financial Crisis: A Perspective Based on Catastrophe Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory of complex system brittleness, this paper focuses on analyzing the causes of financial system's brittleness and holds the idea that the outbreak of brittleness is the root cause of financial crisis. By analyzing the financial brittleness potential function model and studying the brittleness critical points on which catastrophe of the financial system was triggered in quantitative methods, we get the conclusion that through controlling these critical points we can achieve the goal of forecasting the financial crisis. Finally, we take cusp catastrophe model for example to analyze sub-loan crisis and use catastrophe progression method to evaluate the brittleness of financial system.

articleTitle: Conceptualized Discussion on Port Supply Chains: Structure, Characteristics and Evolution Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although the term of Port Supply Chain has been mentioned in some studies, the concept of the term is still not clear enough and needs to be discussed further. This paper aims to make a contribution in this respect by providing a conceptualized model of port supply chains based on the analysis of the relationship between supply chains and logistics chains. Characteristics of port supply chains are analyzed and compared with that of manufacturing supply chains. The causes for the formation of port supply chains are probed into and the evolution process of port supply chains are provided. Finally, some conclusions are given and implications for future research are pointed out.

articleTitle: The Vehicle Scheduling Model and Algorithm of Hazardous Materials under Social Acceptable Risk Constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Vehicle scheduling of hazardous materials is one of effective means to prevent accidents and reduce the loss of lives and property. On the basis of previous studies, this paper adds the constraint of social acceptable risk, and studies the vehicle scheduling problem of hazardous materials based on the transportation risks which vary with time. After a mixed integer programming model is proposed, a novel heuristic algorithm is designed. Finally, a numerical example is presented to show its validity and feasibility of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Cell Formation and Cell Layout Design in Cellular Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, researchers have devoted continuous efforts to study different facet of cellular manufacturing system (CMS). However, very few of them have tried to investigate both cell formation and the cell layout simultaneously. Different order/sequence of machine cells allocation may result in different total intercellular movement distance unit. Solving this problem is indeed very important in reducing the total intracellular and intercellular part movements which is especially significant with large production volume. In this paper, a mathematical model has been proposed to tackle the cell formation and cell layout simultaneously with consideration of both alternative routing and production volume. Due to the combinatorial nature of this model, a hybrid tabu search algorithm was applied to solve it. Unlike the existing method, the proposed algorithm does not demand a priori specification of the number of cells. Moreover, it can determine linear single-row layout or linear double-row layout. The results of the proposed method are compared with well-known approaches that are introduced in literature. These comparisons show that the proposed method offers good solutions for the CMS problem.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deniable Authentication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Source authentication is a research hotspot at the present time. It can be classified as deniable authentication and non-deniable authentication. In recent years, many efficient non-deniable authentication protocols have been proposed. However, much less attention is on the deniable authentication. This paper is mainly focused on the research of deniable authentication. A deniable authentication protocol enables a receiver to identify the true source of a given message, but not to prove the identity of the sender to a third party. This property is very useful for providing secure negotiation over the Internet. To our knowledge, some of the previously proposed protocols are interactive and less efficient, some are non-interactive but failure to resist the forgery attack. So, it is very necessary to design a deniable authentication protocol which is non-interactive, efficient and security. In this paper, we analyze some of the previous schemes and put forward a novel deniable authentication protocol based the generalized EIGamal signature. Finally, we prove the new proposed protocol is more secure compared with the other schemes and it is more efficient to achieve deniable authentication.

articleTitle: Application of Tabu Search Algorithm in Collaborative Logistics Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses a new way to solve the vehicles routing problems of logistics distribution with the use of TSA (Tabu Search Algorithm). TSA is used to calculate the cost of the dealer or the company of all filiale, which is based on the actuality that there are distribution tasks among filiale (or distribution centers) in the cooperative distribution. A new way here is established considering the distribution among filiale to aim at cost and most load. With an example in this paper, the optimal solution is obtained using the special way of Tabu Search Algorithm.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development Applications on Urban Environment Based on Climate Regulation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urbanization is the inevitable outcome of development of society and economy, which necessarily brings about city problems and environmental problems, and intensifies the contradiction among population, resources and environment. In recent years, with the rapid development of urbanization, the municipal area and population of city increase by degrees in China, industry and economy growing rapidly, and the sources of energy were continually consumed. Large amount of heat was discharged, which results in the worse situation of urban environment of metropolis. City climate, as one of the important component of city environment, plays an important role in affecting city space environment and urban planning. Based on protecting the urban ecomanagement, It is of great significance to study the acclimated urban planning and design in order to create comfortable environment and energy saving environment, which is one of the strategies of city sustainable development principles. In this research, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is applied to study the mutual relation between city climate and urban planning. Taking the Hanyang new city of Wuhan in China as a study case, this paper introduces how to apply the CFD stimulation of the digital model of metropolis to thermal environment study. According to the simulation, the analysis is given, which can be used to optimize the design continually and explore the regular pattern to make the project design improved. Based on these analysis, the problems related to the architecture and urban design are explored, which plays a very important role in studying for the thermal environment of metropolis and investigating the adaptability of different city shapes, building shapes to the climate.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Learning Strategy for Knowledge-Enabled Customer Relationship Management Based on SOA and CBR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Combined with the demand for supply chain collaboration, this paper uses Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) technology to build dynamic supply chain integration architecture. In the meanwhile, this paper introduces Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) to achieve intelligent knowledge reasoning and discusses the knowledge-enabled Customer Relationship Management (KCRM) intelligent learning processes based on SOA and CBR and puts forward intelligent learning solution of expert heterogeneity according to the information of customer heterogeneous training characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Pagination Algorithm over Massive Data Based on Ajax Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It's a common technology to query and paginate in Web information system. In traditional method, it usually paginates in client or Web terminal. But if we need operate massive data, traditional methods will have many defects, such as high maintenance cost, low query efficiency. The experiment results indicate that optimization algorithm of pagination based on stored procedure combining Ajax technology can not only improve query efficiency of data in massive data pagination, but also implement asynchronous data transfer between client and server. The method can reduce network bottleneck considerably so that information can be display without loading interface again, user's waiting time can be decreased, and network loads can be lightened greatly.

articleTitle: Intelligent Agents Improving the Efficiency of Ubiquitous e-Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As handheld computing initiatives continue to proliferate, the portability and immediate communication properties of mobile devices influence the learning processes in interacting with peers, accessing resources and transferring data. This paper proposes a ubiquitous e-learning environment that can be used to provide customized learning. It utilizes a set of interacting intelligent agents that can improve automate information gathering, lesson planning, learning material customization, and collaboration among learners and instructors, hence enhance the efficiency of ubiquitous e-learning.

articleTitle: Technology on Aspect-Oriented XML Querying
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article proposes an effective method to describe XML documents and resolve the problem of re-coding XML documents node when XML document nodes are altered in the original method and improve the efficiency of the structural query. This paper proposes object-oriented programming mode to definite XML documents. In the definition of XML documents we introduce weave-in and realise an increase of XML documents. Through the realisation of the expansion of the XML schema it enables the definition of XML documents to possess the function of object-oriented programming technology and provides relevant structural connecting algorithm. The XML document based on the aspect-oriented avoids re-coding the node due to the expansion of XML documents and reduces the frequency of node information modification and increases documents reusability.The author provides diverse experiment results of weave-in documents and compares different structural connecting algorithm function. The result demonstrates that the work of this paper is meaningful and the performance of this approach is very good and the algorithm is fairly effective.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Multiple Attribute Decision-Making Problems Based on Subjective Weight and Objective Weight Integrated
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper deals with the hybrid multiple attribute decision-making problem, in which the information about attribute weights is completely unknown. In order to simplify computation, we turn interval numbers and fuzzy numbers into precise numbers. Then, we propose three weights models based on distance, entropy and index function. Finally, the subjective weight and the objective weight are integrated into resultant weight linearly by trade-off coefficient beta, which reflects both the subjective considerations of the DM and the objective information. Sensitive analysis for the order of project is put up in the example, which illustrates the practicability and validity of this approach.

articleTitle: "Per Capita Building Energy Consumption Occupied Space(PCEOS)" for Assessment of Building Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Prediction and evaluation of building energy consumption are usually based on energy consumption of per unit floor area per year. Considering the factor of human in building energy consumption , the concept of the Per Capita Building Energy Consumption Occupied Space(PCEOS) was proposed for the index of building energy consumption, which means that building energy consumption is essentially the energy consumption of human in buildings and it can reveals not only building energy consumption but also energy use equity. The relationship between the population density and the energy consumption was analyzed in the paper. The method to evaluate building energy consumption as well as function and significance of the PCEOS was proposed .

articleTitle: Using GIS for the Estimation of Water Supply Demand in Wujiang City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A GIS-based water supply demand model has been developed in order to estimate the water supply demand. The developed model was used to predict the future water demand of Wujiang City in the year of 2010, 2015 and 2020. The results indicated an increase of about 9.8%, 24.0%, 31.8% in water demand due to future development of Wujiang City. The results show that the water demand model is sufficient enough to be employed to predict water demand in urban areas in Wujiang City.

articleTitle: A Growth Model of E-Commerce Market: An Empirical Research in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this article, we explored the impact of the growth of e-commerce market based on the theory of economic growth and studied the difference factors between B2B and B2C in the same environment. The factors we identified are investment in ICTs, network infrastructure, globalization, urbanization and Internet users. The data is collected from 2001 to 2007 in China, which is a typical developing country with great potential. We got some interesting results through empirical research. And these results have never been raised in the previous study.

articleTitle: Cross-Culture Study on the Consumption Behavior in Mobile Data Services
