Two scenarios were simulated by the rainstorm simulation model in Shanghai Flood Risk Information Center and a hazard assessment model was built to compare the disaster situation among different regions. The result reveals that Xuhui District faces the most dangerous situation and Hongkou District, Putuo District, Changning District and Zhabei District are also in high risk once waterlogging hazards happen, which is proved to almost accord with the fact in historical events. This method of waterlogging hazard assessment is applicable, which can provide not only necessary information but guidance for Shanghai Municipal Government to make proper policy.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Influence of Mutual Funds on Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an emerging force in corporate governance, institutional ownership is increasingly becoming a hot topic. As the main component of institutional investors, mutual funds grow quickly. The paper chooses part of our country's listed companies as the sample to study the relationship between mutual funds' ownership and firm performance from two aspects of market value and operating performance. The result shows that mutual funds' stock ownership has a positive effect on firm performance significantly.

articleTitle: A Domain-Role-Based Control Model for CSCW System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Joint access to shared resources(e.g., objects, applications, and services) among autonomous domains that form a coalition has recently become important in computer supported cooperative work(CSCW) system. The brass tacks in coalition are that these domains have different self interests although they focus on achieving a common goal. In this paper, to enable effective protection of jointly owned resources and prevent the right abuse, a domain role based access control model based on basis of the traditional RBAC model is proposed. The domain in this model has been express a group data and a group operations to every data in group, deferent domain's access right is deferent to same data, that fulfil the control right demand of deferent space to data. By role dynamic connecting to domain, indirect defining the access right of user to data, predigesting right management, avoiding direct authorization and cancellation between user and data. In addition, DRBAC model's access control information express method and how to apply this model has been presented, and intrduce a instance system based on this model.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Effect of FDI on Economic Growth-Evidence from Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Economic globalization, entry into WTO and the status of national economic center make Shanghai the highland for FDI in China. Based on time series data of Shanghai from 1981 to 2008, this paper carries out empirical research on relationship between FDI and economic growth in Shanghai by using ADF test, Granger causality test and multivariate regression model. The result shows that FDI is the Granger cause of economic growth in Shanghai. Meanwhile, in view of capital itself, capital attachment as well as capital circulation, the spillover effect of FDI is also very obvious, and in succession brings positive effect to economic growth of Shanghai.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study of Virtual Producer Services Construction Based on Lead User and Integration Operation Mode in the Bottom and Middle of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Reducing Consumers' Perceived Risk through Website Service Quality Cues in C2C E-Commerce Trading
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on reducing consumers' perceived risk through Website service quality cues in C2C e-commerce trading. It reveals a negative correlation between consumers' perceived risk and Website service quality in C2C E-commerce trading, and explores the internal composition of this relationship. Functional, physical, service, and psychological risks are found to be negatively affected mainly by reliability, guarantee, security, information integrality and communication of service quality. However, financial and functional risks are positive influenced by personalization cue of Website service quality simultaneously.

articleTitle: Industry-Oriented Basin Initial Water Right Harmonious Allocation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The definition of industry-oriented basin initial water right harmonious allocation is put forward, and the criterions of harmony analysis are constructed on the basis of system harmonious theory. Then, based on interactive decision theory, interactive objective step tradeoff coupling model is given combining interactive step tradeoff method with objective programming model, to take the knowledge on water right initial allocation of different water sectors in different regions into account, and constantly adjust the water right allocation schemes of each regional water sector in the basin, finally, new schemes of industry-oriented basin water right harmonious allocation could be gained to pass the harmony analysis, realizing industry-oriented basin initial water right harmonious allocation.

articleTitle: Study on the Correlation between Employability and Career Success of Knowledge Workers - Based on the Boundaryless Careers
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of complex and volatile career situation in boundaryless careers, this study explored the correlations between employability and career success of knowledge workers with the survey. This study tested the employability scale based on 124 samples from 10 foreign-owned or private-owned enterprises in Dalian and Shanghai. Then 184 knowledge workers from several enterprises were invited to join the final survey, and 184 questionnaires were taken hierarchical multiple regression. The result indicated that the relationships between employability and career success were positive, and employability was a power predict of career success beyond demographics variables.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Insider Control and the Interest Flow in the Transfer of Control Rights - Case Study on the M&A of Goldman Sachs over Shuanghui
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Effects of Trust in Leader on Individual Performance: Empirical Study from Knowledge Work Teams
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of character-based and relation-based perspectives, a theoretical model of the effects of trust in team leader on performance of knowledge employees was put forward. 519 leader-subordinate dyads from knowledge-based work teams of high-tech organization were used to test the model by SPSS11.5 and LISREL 8.30. The results indicated that the reliabilities and validities of all the measures were well. Both of cognition-based and affect-based trust in team leader had positive effects on organizational citizenship behavior and task performance of knowledge employees. Comparing with cognition-based trust in team leader, affect-based trust had stronger effects on employee's organizational citizenship behavior and task performance.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Metadata for Distributed CAS Appliance System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Now content search and management have become critical problems for large-scale storage system. Since metadata plays crucial role both in storage and content management, integrating various metadata and providing an efficient mechanism can greatly improve content search and simplify management of digital objects. Therefore, a kind of integrated metadata model based on object storage is proposed to implement the full fusion of CAS and content management. A kind of distributed CAS appliance system based on the integrated metadata is established and demonstrated in this paper. As a result, CAS appliance system can provide strong content search and navigation services, and it is more efficiently to store and retrieve data.

articleTitle: Analysis Based on AHP about the Factors of E-Government Services Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With continuous improvement in the development level of China's information technology, e-government services outsourcing market is gradually taking shape, and is playing an increasingly important role in e-government construction of China. Based on the survey of 93 different government departments in Chengdu, this paper used AHP to establish the evaluation model of the e-government services outsourcing, and sorted the factors which affect e-government services outsourcing. The results showed that the will of the government was the key influence factor to e-government services outsourcing, followed by cooperation relationship, management and contractor selection factors.

articleTitle: Application of AHP Fuzzy Preference Programming to Evaluate Environmental Externality of Emission Sources
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on environmental economics literature review and in-depth analyses, this paper identified five rules to evaluate environmental externality of emission sources, which are current environmental condition, amount of people injured, economic development level, physical geography characters, and natural scenery and cultural heritage. Under the framework of analytic hierarchy process (AHP), this paper presented a method to evaluate the priorities of several emission sources by combing with fuzzy preference programming. Numerical example shows that emission source's environmental externality can be valued by the AHP fuzzy preference programming, and the application of this method is beneficial to administrative management and the construction of emission trading system.

articleTitle: Coordination Mechanism in Supply Chain Management Based on Arbitration Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on arbitration rules, this paper puts forward a combined coordination mechanism-hierarchical coordination and nonhierarchical coordination-to settle the disputes occurred between/among the supply chain partners. Introduction of intelligent agents system which has the advantage of a more systematic and organizational method in reality without causing unnecessary emotional and behavioral side effects is an effective instrument to utilize this coordination mechanism and realize its established goals.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Managerial Perquisites and Shareholders' Welfare Loss
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Managerial Turnover and Strategic Turnaround
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Governance Efficiency, Substitution Effect and Optimal Research on Corporate Governance of Ultimate Controlled Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Application of Third-Party Certification for Supplier Selection Based on Signaling Game
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The supplier selection process is a strategic decision making process in supply chain management, and independent third-party certification (TPC) agency plays an important role in supplier selection. The signaling game model is established after analyzing the behaviors of the buyer and supplier under the circumstances of incomplete market information, and separating equilibrium and pooling equilibrium are worked out and analyzed. The efficient supplier certified by authoritative TPC shall be encouraged and selected by the buyer. The speculative supplier has to give up due to the prohibitive costs, and the market order shall be maintained.

articleTitle: Controlling Bifurcations in an OLG Economy with PAYG Pension Schemes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bifurcation control refers to the task of designing a controller to modify the bifurcation properties of a given nonlinear system, thereby achieving some desirable dynamical behaviors. This paper deals with the controlling of bifurcations in an overlapping generation (OLG) economy with pay-as-yougo (PAYG) pension schemes. A brief overview is given of the basic OLG model with very complicated dynamics, such as bifurcations. By employing the washout filter controller, the complicated motions stem from the system can be controlled without changing the original properties. Finally, we show the effectiveness and feasibility of the developed methods in an OLG model with explicit functions.

articleTitle: The Research of Customer's Repeat-Purchase Model Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It costs something like five times to serve a new customer than a regular customer. Regular customer is very import to enterprise. This paper proposes a model of customer's repeat-purchasing. Customer behavior patterns are first identified using association rule mining. Then, the customer's repeat- purchase model is identified by comparing two sets of association rules generated from datasets of different periods. The experimental results demonstrated that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on Information Resources Allocation Based on Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Given the characteristics of information resources and the mechanisms of allocation well, introduce complex network theory to build a complex network model of information resources allocation (IRA). Through simulating the model, some useful conclusions were put out: the network of IRA with some characteristics of scale-free network and small world network, could reduce the network cost while keeping network efficiency in a steady level. Consequently, the topology structure of networks proposed in this paper may help to realize optimal allocation of information resources.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Ecotourism Carrying Capacity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Transmission-Distribution Pricing Regulation Based on Yardstick Competition Incorporated with Market Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, an incentive regulation model based on yardstick competition for the transmission-distribution (T&D) enterprises is presented which combines pricing regulation and market equilibrium. The change rate of T&D price and the elastic coefficient of electricity consumption are studied in detail which are important for the pricing regulation model. The data envelopment analysis approach (DEA) is followed to establish the model which is used to evaluate and analyze the productivity of T&D enterprises. The numerical example is given to prove its feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: An Integrated Framework for Understanding the Allocating of Service Recovery Resource
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, an integrated framework is proposed by summarizing current service recovery concepts. The framework, which introduces the service recovery from the perspectives of both the customers and the firms, is also an analysis tool for allocating service recovery resource. Also we try to model and quantify this framework, converting the framework into an optimization problem, which is subjected to the interactions between organic components of service recovery and the limitation of the investment on service recovery. We argued that service recovery should act as a system instead of focusing on customer recovery. This paper would contribute to researchers and practitioner by reminding the cooperation of customer, employee, process recovery when encountering service recovery.

articleTitle: Constructing Geo-Information Sharing GRID Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the development of Internet, Geoinformation Sharing and Open GIS are of increasing importance for GIS application fields. Spatial Information Grid (SIG) is the fundamental application of Grid technology in spatial information application service domain. This paper presents a pilot platform for Resource and Environment Geo-information Sharing for Southwestern China based on Web Services, .NET, OGC, Web GIS and SIG is constructed. The architecture in the pilot platform consists of 3 tiers: application layer, service layer and resource layer. Via the pilot platform, distributed heterogeneous geo-information, software and hardware resource from four provinces and one municipality in Southwestern China is integrated.

articleTitle: Incentives in Engineering Contracts: A Critical Review of the Principle of Optimal Risk Sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Incentive is widely used in engineering contracts to elicit the contractor's best efforts in hope of reducing construction cost. The intensity of incentive is normally determined in accordance with the principle of optimal risk sharing from the Principal-Agent theory. As evidenced by the ongoing financial crisis, this doctrine may lead to overuse of incentive and bring about systemic risk. This crisis has exposed a fundamental flaw in this mainstream theory that the contract breakup cost is exceedingly higher than that already accounted for. This research sets out a numerical example in the context of project procurement to make a case for the necessity of redressing this pitfall and calls for a new line of thinking that can fully accommodate the risk-bearing capacity of a contract into the design of contract.

articleTitle: Research of the Owner's Inner Management System of the Construction Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article analyzes the relationship of the various main bodies of the owner's inner management system in project. It considers that except the main body of the real estate development projects belong to socialization and specialization construction main body, other construction main body replaced by the capital construction department and construction headquarters of invested enterprise(the first owner). In view of the abuse of the current owner project management model, it proposes that the capital construction department and construction headquarters will be replaced by the socialization and specialization project management enterprise, and these enterprises will become the organization of the invest main body, assume the role of the construction main body.

articleTitle: Double Normal Inverse Gaussian Copula with Random Factor Loadings Model for Synthetic CDO Pricing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents another version of the one factor double NIG copula model with random factor loadings. The model is used to price synthetic CDOs. We compare the properties of our new model with those of the Gaussian factor copula and the numerical results shows that the new model has produced a very good fit to market data and can improve the fit of the one factor Gaussian copula model.

articleTitle: Simulating Optimization of Time-Cost in Construction Project Based on Nash Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A construction project composed of a series unique events is a group of given goals set which should be achieved by the limited resources during a certain period. These characteristics of the construction project put forward a number of requirements to project managers, especially in the control of construction time and cost. Fortunately, the network graph provides a reasonable method of project plan to managers. It can display the project activities graphically and describe the priority relationships between activities, which put a great effort for project managers to pay more attentions to the most critical activities. But, there are many uncertain factors affecting the cost and the construction time of the project, which will destroy the normal execution of the original network planning. Therefore, during the actual construction managers have to revise the original network graph repeatedly. Even in some medium scale projects, the production and rapid renewal of project network graph are also very complex, at the same time the time-cost equilibrium has been the most important problem for managers to solve during renewing. To make a rational decision fast, modern computer simulation technology and Nash equilibrium principle are used for analysis and a example demonstrates that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Development of the Digital City Based on the Virtual Community and Electronic Game Technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the developments of the Internet and electronic technology, the digital city construction was put on the agenda. In this paper, the idea to develop the digital city by combining the virtual community and electronic game technologies reasonably was proposed. Meanwhile, suggestions for the digital city management were provided in detail.

articleTitle: Services Analysis in Apparel Quotation System Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of quote business processes, as well as the characteristics of SOA, a quotation system is brought forward based on SOA for apparel international trade, in order to enhance the Quote's diversity, accuracy as well as efficiency. This paper puts great importance on analyzing how to define, extract, as well as implement services, not only for needs from quotation business process, but also from quotation business goals. Based on the analysis of services, finally, an apparel quotation architecture is described in details.

articleTitle: Memetic Algorithm for Solving Construction Time-Cost Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The time-cost optimization (TCO) problem is a multiobjective optimization problem, which attempts to strike a balance between resource allocation costs and project schedule duration. In this paper, memetic algorithm (MA) which uses order crossover and a new mutation based on neighborhood search after each crossover and mutation operation, and an improved simulated annealing algorithm utilized for local search, is employed to model time-cost optimization problem. A prototype example using MA for TCO problem is simulated with Matlab7.0. The test results show that the MA based model can generate a more optimal cost under the same duration and achieve a better Pareto front than other models. Therefore, the MA can be regarded as a useful approach for solving construction project TCO problems.

articleTitle: The Research of the Realization Model in Large-Scale Equipment's Value Occupying Based on the Time Value
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Equipment is the active part in fixed investments of the construction project. In manufacturing engineering construction where Organic formation of capital is high, the equipment price accounts for a ratios of the construction costs. However, it takes a long process to complete the contract of large-scale equipment introducing and there also exists many uncertainty factors, which lead to the obvious difference between the value and price of the equipment while settling ultimately. This paper employed the principle of time value of money, established a equivalent settlement model and further built a model in large-scale equipment's value occupying realization. By calculating analysis to prove that the time value of money is an objective existence that it become a basic principle in investment, namely, take full advantage of the time value of money, maximize access to the equipment's value and cut down the cost disbursement, so as to control the construction costs effectively.

articleTitle: Study on Game of Investment for Controlling Pollution about Oligopolists
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environmental pollution, a global hot spot, relates to the existence and development of human race. In accordance with the one who pollutes is responsible and the established Cournot model , the game model of pollution control is set up. According to this model, the success rate of pollution control and the function describing the relationship between the added value of pollution control cost and investment are got. Through example simulation, a reference to decision-making for enterprises and government is provided.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Time Series Prediction Based on Wavelet Transform and ARMA Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High-frequency time series prediction method based on wavelet transform and ARMA model (WARMA) is proposed. By wavelet decomposition and reconstruction, the original time series is decomposed into an approximate series and several detail series, the reconstructed series is more unitary than the original series in frequency, so it can be predicted with ARMA model. The prediction result of the original series can be obtained by the superposition predicting value of each reconstructed series. Experiment results show that the method gains advantage over the ARMA solely.

articleTitle: Study and Application of Construction Face Stability in Tunnel and Shaft Excavation Safety
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the failure modes for tunnel construction face, this paper establishes the sliding body models in cylinder and wedge types. The applied forces on the two types are analyzed. Through the sliding body diagrams, the relationship among different factors is fined out, especially the safety factors of cylinder and wedge types are determined. The calculation of the vertical frictional force against the sliding body through the diagram analysis has special meanings. It means that the complex parameters are easy to obtain, and other parameters can be defined through simple calculations or according to the certain knowledge. When the safety factor drops to 1, the yield strength of the tunnel construction face is reached and the technical and practical treatment must be put into effect. Finally, the application of the sliding body diagrams is also discussed. It shows that the results of the diagrams, of the theoretical analysis and of the finite elements have essential identical conclusions. Of course, only through the analysis of the sliding body diagrams, the applied area is limited. For special conditions, the differences are too large to explain the immediate roof collapse. Therefore, the other suitable methods are also necessary.

articleTitle: Research on the Effects of Technical Innovation on Manufacturing Enterprise Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although a large volume of literature in available study on the competitiveness of enterprises, as a pop topic, enterprises competitiveness has been still paid closed attention on and has great potential to research on in the further. To answer the question whether technical innovation could effect the competitiveness of enterprises, this paper reviews the literature on the relationship between them, proposed four hypothesis and a new theoretical model: Technical innovation can improve the competitiveness of manufacturing enterprises on delivery, quality, cost and flexibility. Meanwhile, based on the methods of factor analysis, correlation analysis and data mining, using IMSS database, an empirical analysis has been done and the conclusion is proved to be true.

articleTitle: Institutional Ownership and Capital Structure --Evidence from China Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we study the relationship between institutional ownership and capital structure. Based on the principle of minimizing financing cost, this paper firstly constructs a dynamic optimizing model of capital structure from the angle of institutional ownership. Then, it uses panel data of 539 China listed companies of manufacturing industry from 2005 to 2007 to make regression of fixed effects model. The results indicate that the percentage of institutional stock holdings has positive relation with capital structure, and the decentralized degree of institutional ownership is negatively related to capital structure. The robustness check agrees with these results. Finally, this paper points that developing institutional investors is one way to solve the current low debt ratio of China listed companies.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Simulations of Wealth Transfer and Accumulation in an Agricultural Society
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agent-based simulations of a simplified system model implemented on the swarm platform show that during the early stages of an agricultural society, wealth grows rapidly and migrates to a small percentage of landowners. Analysis of this simplified model indicate that the growth of wealth mainly results from the utilization of land and the rise of land prices, and that wealth aggregation occurs with positive feedback as one gains wealth, one becomes more risk resistant, and one who is risk resistant gains more wealth.

articleTitle: Studies on Emerging Technology Industrialization Potential by System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emerging technology industrialization potential growth was studied by system dynamics. The system dynamics model of emerging technology industrialization potential growth was set up, and the relevant model parameters and initial value was identified, based on the model the industrialization potential growth of fuel cell was evaluated.

articleTitle: Construction of International Unified E-Commerce Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the transformation from traditional business model to e-commerce model, e-commerce has become a necessary condition for the survival and development of enterprises and public institutions. In order to implement the party and government's strategy of accelerating e-commerce construction, some regions have begun the construction of regional unified e-commerce information platform one by one. Local governments provides funds for the construction ,and commissions China international electronic commerce center to build it on the third party electronic commerce platform of the center, realizing resource sharing and embodying local characteristics. All regional unified e-commerce information platforms of the country form one-stop international e-commerce information platform. This kind of regional unified information platform is a comprehensive website integrating various industrial websites and information management systems of enterprises and public institutions in the region. The application of this kind of platform can reduce the time needed in business process, and improve business environment, and adjust industrial structure, and improve economic benefits. To build such a comprehensive website into an efficient information platform, people concerned should carry out a deep research and discussion on the solution of platform construction. This paper just gives a deep research on platform construction from multiple aspects such as requirement analysis, function orientation, platform framework, construction solution and principle. Hence, it is significant to the construction of international unified e-commerce information platform.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Enterprise Group Financial Risk Conduction and Governance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Temporal-Spatial Patterns and Incentives Analysis on Urban Land Expansion of Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The temporal-spatial patterns and incentives of the urban land expansion are studied, taking Wuhan city as a case. The construction land data was captured according to land use database standard of CAS from Landsat TAT images of 1995, 2000 and 2005 respectively. With the Supermap GIS software platform, the spatial analysis of construction land was made during two periods of 1995-2000 and 2000-2005. Based on the land use data we captured and the authoritative statistical data, the temporal-spatial characteristics of the urban land expansion as well as structure evolution was analyzed applying several indices, such as expansion intensity, population flexibility and land-use structure proportion. The result shows that there are quite different characteristics of urban land expansion in the two periods. The expansion intensity index is 0.1948 during the period of 1995-2000 while it is 0.4894 during the period of 2000-2005. And the expansion pattern has experienced a conversion from the simplified external expansion to the combination of external expansion and internal fill, or from continuous expansion in the shapes of axes or ribbon to non-continuous counterpart centered on a growth polar or grown as conglomeration. Related analysis shows that the expansion of Wuhan city has been driven by the integration of multiple impetuses, such as the increase of population, economic development and traffic infrastructure improvement, together with periodic industrial policies.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Dynamic Features and Driving Factors of Urban Construction Land in Nanjing Over the Past Twenty Years
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Early Warning Index System of Vulnerability for Overseas Port Built Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Vulnerability evaluation is the basis of effective early warning and restoration of inherent defects, so it's of great theoretical and practical significance to establish an early warning index system of vulnerability for overseas port built project (OPBP). Firstly, some foundation research about the vulnerability of OPBP was carried out, including the relationship between the internal vulnerability and external risks of the project, the types of risks and vulnerability of OPBP, the model frame and operation mechanism of vulnerability of OPBP. Then, an early warning index system was established. This system was a multi-level index system, and mainly evaluated by the vulnerability of elemental management and the vulnerability of functional management and their sub index. The establishment principles and significance of the index system were discussed. Then, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method was used to confirm the index weight and the index value. Finally, a case study on the Jeddah port project in Saudi was conducted.

articleTitle: The Research of Value Nets and Application in Knowledge-Intensive Business Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Before several years, the overseas outstanding enterprise like Cisco and Dell already started to use one kind of service pattern, which is more advanced than supply chain - the value nets. The value nets is a new high-level concept of supply chain. Based on sharing information and knowledge, value nets can make the members match with each other and meet the diversified needs of consumers together. Especially in the knowledge-intensive business service (KIBS), the predominance of value nets is more clearly. In this article, we will use the software business as the example to explain how to use the value nets in the knowledge-intensive business service.

articleTitle: Design of Visiting MDT Solid Model Program Based on ObjectARX
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on a close research of the interior representation of CAD model in MDT, ObjectARX application program is developed using the development tools of ObjectARX and MDT API offered by Autodesk Inc in MDT environment, according to which the database is expatiated particularly. So that this thesis picks-up the interior topological and geometrical information of model expressed in the boundary representation (B-Rep). The picking-up information makes it successful to visit the database in MDT.

articleTitle: Youth Staff Career Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, enterprises at home are all bothered by jobhopping of young employees, and the managers are fed up with the turbulence of staff team and the resignation of person with ability. Numerous researches have shown that the main reason of the jobhopping of young employees is the dissatisfaction of individual career development. They feel their development is limited, and want to find a new break through. However, the managers complain that the young employees are full of impractical fancies, they have no impersonal understanding on themselves and the enterprises, they always reach for what is beyond their grasp and have a poor professional stability; the frequent flow of the young employees has caused huge loss of the enterprises. Accordingly, this paper attempts to explore young employees' career needs, their evaluation on importance of organizational career management, the practice actuality of the enterprises, and employees' career self-management. It is directed to put forward a corresponding career management strategy on the basis of personal psychological demand and behavior, and is hoped to provide a reference for the enterprises at home to manage the young employees' career better and to retain the talents.

articleTitle: The Building of Mobile Phone TV Standard in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, there are many arguments on the mobile phone TV standard, the main debate comes from broadcasting and telecom operators. This paper mainly focus on how to build the mobile phone TV standard in China to solve the debate and get the cooperative win-win industrial chain.

articleTitle: Development of a Design Plan for Industrialized Housing in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The housing industrialization process could reduce the amount of site work associated with production and thereby accelerate the on-site construction process. This implies that design should be coordinated and integrated to ensure easy and proper fixture. The key features of housing industrialization are standardization of housing design. The design plan for industrialized housing development in Chongqing should accommodate the small-middle components in key areas of a housing unit. Such units include staircase, partition wall, facades and floor slabs. Classification of housing component systems is first given, and an alternative design plan for producing housing components is presented. The investigation includes the major housing parameters such as most preferable type of housing, appropriate number of storeys, and room height. Attention is drawn to the importance of the inter-relations between design and supply chain and coordination between designer and producer.

articleTitle: The Study of a Comprehensive Assessment Method for Service Quality of ISO 9000 Consulting Service Based on a Hierarchical Grey Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Today, more and more corporations are adopting and implementing ISO9000 standard to improve their competitive advantage. Numerous realities showed that service quality of ISO9000 consulting service has become a key that decide the organizations' success or failure in introducing and implementing ISO9000 standard. Accurate measurement of service quality of ISO9000 consulting service has become a major concern to consulting firms and their clients as well. However, in the established literatures, few references researched on how to assess the service quality of ISO9000 consulting service. The purpose of this paper is to propose a method to evaluate the service quality of ISO9000 consulting service properly by using an integrated evaluation model based on the hierarchical grey analysis. First, the paper introduces the method to synthetically evaluate the service quality of ISO9000 consulting service, subsequently, a case study is presented. The results show that the method is applicable and realistic because it can largely reduce the negative effects cased by subjective consciousness and artificial randomness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Selection of Construction Project Transaction Mode Based on Fuzzy SMARTS Decision Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Defining construction project transaction mode as research object, this paper firstly classifies common used construction project transaction modes, and then attempts to improve the existing transaction mode selection approach - SMARTS to a more precise method called fuzzy SMARTS, which comprised a fuzzy evaluation part. Finally, this paper illustrates the method is practicable for providing the owner strong supports to select transaction mode appropriately through empirical study.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Economic Development Level of Dalian's County
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The county economy is an important carrier of China's economic development. Dalian is an important city in Northeast China, so its county economic development can promote the plan of revitalizing northeast old industrial base. Therefore it is necessary to have a clear understanding of the county economy of Dalian. This article use the Grid and Fuzzy Borda Number method to constructed an evaluation model of the economic development level of dalian's county. And use it to appraisal the economic development level of Dalian's county, at last to provide references to the government for decision-making.

articleTitle: A Model and Empirical Analysis on Financial Distress Forecasting of Listed Companies Based on Least-Square Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies least-square support vector machine (LS-SVM), a statistic machine learning methods, and establishes a model of financial distress prediction. Based on information of listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen during the year 2005 to 2006, the paper gives an empirical analysis of financial distress prediction. Research conclusions show that prediction and self discriminate capability of the prediction model is increasing by year as the coming of financial distress, and the remained discriminate capability is higher than the prediction capability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Methodology of Identifying and Choosing Customer Values
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Study on the Analysis of Academic Websites Co-Citation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web site co-citation is the URL of two Web sites cited in a paper. This is an exploring study to apply the co-citation in the analysis of academic Web sites, where Chinese top 100 universities' Web sites are taken as an example in the empirical analysis. Through multi-dimensional scaling (MDS) analysis and Pajek tool, the relationships among Web sites are evaluated and visualized. The experimental results show that co-citation approach, despite some drawbacks, is efficient to discover the relatedness among Web sites. Furthermore, it possesses unique advantages and good development prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Innovation-Oriented SMEs Based on Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SMEs (Small and Medium Enterprises) in economic development has become an important force in China over the past 30 years since its reform and opening-up. Firstly, facing with the deteriorating environment for the survival and the fierce market competitiveness, the SMEs must rely on the core competitiveness in order to survival and develop. Therefore, the SMEs have entered the age of the core competitiveness, and its survival and development only rely on the core competitiveness. Secondly, it is discussed that the innovation is the source of the core competitiveness of enterprises. It is pointed out that the innovation-oriented SMEs have an innovative gene and establishes the innovative system, innovate all-round and continuously by everyone, and has rich achievements of the innovation. In a word, the significant feature of innovation-oriented SMEs is innovation. Therefore, building innovation-oriented SMEs is an effective way to improve the core competitiveness of Chinese SMEs. Lastly, it is discusses that the SMEs development highly depend on the quality of enterprise managers, whether or not they have the entrepreneurship is the key to build innovation-orientated SMEs, and it is suggested how to cultivate the entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: Regulation Policy of Service Industry and International Trade in Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper argues that the regulatory policy of service industries affects the international trade in service. Indicators of Product Market Regulation are introduced in a gravity model to quantify these effects. It is found that outward and inward oriented regulation policies of service import country constitute an entry cost for foreign service providers; Further, inward oriented regulation policies of service export country have no effects for export country, but outward oriented regulation policies distinctly decrease the local services sector's export performance.

articleTitle: Application of Basket-Cabinet Methodology in Urban Design: Taking Waterfront for Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the complexity and synthesis characteristic of urban design, we propose an effective method - "Basket-Cabinet Methodology", which exists in the public information management domain to deal with the complicated problems. Base on the concept of this method, we construct its space model, and point out that it has intuitional, scientific, multiplex, and flexible features to be suitable for the urban design program. Taking Jilin Songhua Riversides Comprehensive Design for example, we elaborate the basic principle of the "Basket-Cabinet Methodology" to be applied to the urban design process as follows: the determination of research direction, the selection of key point, the establishment of plan strategy and the implementation of circulatory adjustment, making preliminary research on the cooperation of "Basket-Cabinet Methodology" and urban design.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Development Level for Social Security System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social security system which is a necessary means to retain social stability and economic development is an important sign of modern nations and society with civilization. Firstly, this paper analyses the relations among the sub indexes of development level for social security systems. Secondly, it sets up differential equations model to quantitatively analyze the relations among the sub indexes based on the hypotheses. Finally, it studies the solutions by the entropy method and estimates the parameters by the nonlinear least square method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Industrial Clusters' Formation Based on Entrepreneurs' Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial clusters provide ecological system for entrepreneurs to grow and the latter tend to agglomerate. However the influence of industrial cluster on entrepreneur's behavior in different stages of clusters is rarely studied. We argue the clusters can entrepreneurs' behavior in different stage of development of stage and entrepreneurs tend to agglomerate through learning mechanism. The relation of development stages of clusters and entrepreneurs' choice is discussed.

articleTitle: Enable SOAP to Support Service Composition in Multimedia Application
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, most of multimedia information processing application systems are still realized in the monolithic and stovepipe manner. This design pattern makes building and maintaining such multimedia systems intractable, costly and time-consumed. As a new style software design model, service oriented architecture promises a more agile solution for developing largescale Internet-based applications and has been widely accepted by the academic community and industries. However, the current service invoking method: SOAP does not apply to the multimedia area directly. This paper intends to solve this problem. Aiming at it, this paper proposes a new remote object access protocol based on SOAP which defines the correlative message format and the interaction model between the service and its client. According to the proposed approach, a service-composition-based prototype multimedia information processing system is constructed and the validity of our method is confirmed.

articleTitle: The Role of Market Orientation and Relational Embeddedness in Customer Participation Relation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer participation in the production of goods and services appears to be growing. Most previous research on customer participation relations has focused on the direct relationship of organizational and relational factors promoting performance related outcomes. But reported numbers of failing customer participation relations vary between 50 and 70%. Thus, companies need to deal with the double sided edge of the sword. On the one hand, firms need customers to learn about market needs and solutions for new product. On the other, customer participation opens the door for opportunistic behaviour and failure. Considering this tension between external knowledge acquisition in the generation of a continuous stream of innovations and the high number of product failures, this paper investigates how customers in customer participation relations contribute to the supplier's acquisition of new marketing knowledge that is needed to sustain and renew strategic advantage. By studying the current literature, we think SEML is a kay factor in the customer participation process. By examing the sources and consequences of SEML we find proactiveness of both participants in customer participation relationships has a positive effect on suppliers' exploratory marketing learning outcomes and the results show that supplier exploratory marketing learning does not have a direct positive effect on new product financial performance.

articleTitle: Effects of Perceived Marketing Stimuli on Retailer Loyalty: Perspective of Store Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Exploring the effects of marketing stimuli on retailer loyalty from the perspective of consumer consciousness facilitates efficient management of retailer loyalty, but extant relative literature focuses the mediator of these effects on customer satisfaction. The author uses associative network memory model to integrate the conception of store knowledge, examining the effects of five perceived marketing stimuli on retailer loyalty through the mediating role of store knowledge dimensions. The results indicate that retailer awareness, retailer associations and retailer perceived quality are related positively to retailer loyalty. Perceived price, reputation, merchandise, shopping environment and employee service positively affect retailer loyalty through the mediating role of these three store knowledge dimensions. Some implications of findings are also discussed finally.

articleTitle: The Thin Coal Mining Equipment Multi-Objectives Fuzzy Decision Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thin coal mining equipment multi-rank choice and it is traditional choice method subjective capriciousness question, This paper is intended to discuss and analyze the assessment of mining method by the utilization fuzzy set and fuzzy mathematic theory, the equipment to carry on the multi-ranks to decompose, carries on the quantification recursive operation according to the normalizing formula, calculates all levels of membership function separately, thus it has established the thin coal mining way multistage fuzzy decision-making model.

articleTitle: Trends on Interactive Platforms for Social Media through Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, social networking on Web2.0 becomes a novel social media for mass communication. It relies on new online technologies and practices to enable ordinary people to share opinions, insights, expertise, experiences, and interests with each other and further reduce the barriers to collaboration, skill-building and discovery. Web2.0 as the next generation of networking services emphasizes social interaction and share of user-generated content in a collaborative environment. It has evolved and transferred the Internet into a platform by supporting rich digital media technology for the development of innovative business, educational, and cultural applications. In conjunction with Web 3D technology, social networking has already begun to foster an intuitive and immersive system that allows effective visual communication and delivers real time natural interactive experience for enhancing user motivation and engagement compared with the traditional static and text-oriented online information systems and content management systems.

articleTitle: The Study on Mathematical Model of Urban Land Subsidence Based on Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the main reasons which cause urban land subsidence, and discusses the mechanisms of the effects caused by building loading and the change of groundwater level. Using the theory of statistical analysis, mathematical model of land subsidence is built, and the effect of the model is also validated by practical data. The analysis results show the fitting effect is good and the model has highly practical value.

articleTitle: Modelling Inbound Tourism Demand in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper suggests a first-order autoregressive distributed lag (FADL) model, which estimated base on the data of inbound tourism demand in Shanghai, form 1978 to 2008. The estimated results show the impacts of crisis events on inbound tourism, and the difference of the impacts between "1997 Asian financial crisis" and "2007 subprime mortgage crisis". One of the forecasts for Shanghai is 9.12% growth rate of the number of inbound tourists in 2009.

articleTitle: The Study of Relationship between Learning-Oriented Culture, Flexible Strategy and Service Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service innovation is an inherent power of service business growth, organizational learning is the main initiatives to optimize enterprises' strength. Taking hotel industry as an example for empirical study, this paper finds that different dimensions of organizational learning have different impact on service innovation. Commitment to learning can affect service innovation directly, shared vision and open mindedness can affect service innovation by coordinating flexibility and resource flexibility. So the managers should adjust their behavior with these paths to maximize the value of learning resources.

articleTitle: Analysis of Liquidity Risk in Private Equity Fund Investment Based on Fuzzy Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The feature and eluding strategy of liquidity is an important aspect in studying private equity fund. This thesis begins with analyzing three features of liquidity fund in PE investment. Then based on effect factors of liquidity risk brought forward by scholars, it constructs an index system for identifying liquidity risk, and establishes a fuzzy evaluation model based on AHP. In the end this thesis brings forward some strategies to reduce PE liquidity risk.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Connotation, Targets and Content of Modernization of Water Conservancy Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: PaaS Mode in Network Game Advertising
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article proposed the PaaS mode as a solution to the problems affecting the development of the advertising industry in the network game. This mode has solved the bottleneck problems in such aspects as the operating mode, the IGA technology, the result supervision and the cost effectiveness, adapting well to the requirements of standardized and repeatable in the development tendency of the Advertising industry in the network game. The PaaS mode enables the Advertising industry in the network game to form a leading power which is benefit to the further clarity of the mode of the whole industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Evaluation Method of Water Resources Utilazation Sustainbility: A Case of Tianjin Districts and Counties in 2007
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on Improvement Measure of Chinese Commercial Banks Efficiencies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the improvement measure of Chinese commercial banks efficiencies based on analysis of the endogenous influence factors of bank efficiencies. The relationships between factors and bank efficiencies are figured out with simultaneous equations considering the cross interference of cost efficiency, technical efficiency and scale economy. According to the analysis results, we provide some advices to Chinese commercial banks for improving their efficiencies and performances. These advices are that Chinese banks must pay more attention to improve the validity of their inside resource, scale efficiency, noncredit operations and monitor five important financial factors which are ratio of credits to deposits, ratio of credits to total assets, ratio of interest expenditure to interest income, nonperforming ratio and assets of bank embranchment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Structural Characteristics of Liquidity and Its Impact on Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Museum Exhibition Design Project Management Based on Cost Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Inventory Games of Manufacturer and Supplier under Symmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the decentralization and centralization strategy of the manufacturer and supplier under symmetric information, this paper discusses the inventory coordination strategy using coalitional game with transferable payoff. Then we probe into the coordination strategy and its validity fewer than three kinds of asymmetric information. The principle of how to get to "win-win " is put forwarded at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: On Dynamic Pricing in Market-Based Resource Management for Clusters
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional cluster resource management systems (RMSs) focused on metrics such as maximizing throughput and minimizing mean waiting time, but failed to capture utility of users and revenue for providers. Consequently, researchers have been examining the appropriateness of market-based resource management techniques. This paper presents a market-based RMS for clusters. A dynamic pricing mechanism is proposed, with which the cluster owner can determine the level of sharing within a cluster. In addition, a scheduling algorithm that incorporates the pricing function to enforce market-based resource allocation is introduced. Finally, simulation is carried out to analyze the performance of the market-based RMS. Results show that the proposed resource allocation strategy improves the revenue of the cluster owner and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: An Ontology-Based Framework for Personalized Mobile Content Services
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Personalization in mobile content services means to provide the appropriate contents in suitable ways for mobile users according to the context factors of spatio-temporal environment, personal characteristics, and conditions of terminals and networks. Different types of context data are required for diverse mobile services. In this paper, context and content service ontologies are constructed and a multi-agent framework is introduced to support personalized content services in wireless environment. Further, the relevancy between contexts and services is discussed. Finally, the working procedure of service platform is illustrated by an instance.

articleTitle: Study on Decision-Making of Reclaimed Water Reuse in Water-Ample Urban
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Reclaimed water reuse is one of the technical methods of water saving, and it's the inevitable development trend of urban water saving work. In this paper, the purpose and significance of developing reclaimed water reuse is discussed from the core issue of water resources management. The viewpoints that carrying out centralized reclaimed water reuse is not suitable in water-ample urban and decentralized reclaimed water reuse should be vigorously promoted, is put forward. Taking example by Wuhan, water resources management, conservation of resources, benefit analysis and operability were analyzed specifically in this city. Some concrete opinions and suggestions are given for promoting dispersal reclaimed water reuse, it is of a certain theoretical and practical significance for government decision-making of this job.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Knowledge Compensation Strategy for Existed System Supplier in Information Systems Integration Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study and Construction on Evaluation Index System of the Modernization of Water Conservancy Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Research on the Evaluation of Enterprise Marketing Ethics Based on 4C Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the current market competition mechanism, in order to obtain business interests immoral acts take place frequently in the marketing activities, this has seriously affected the interests of consumers and society. In this paper, on the basis of the 4C theory, the target system of ethical evaluation of enterprise marketing is established from production, cost, service and communication. The fuzzy theory is used to evaluate enterprise marketing ethics level. Using the model, the ethics level of a simulative enterprise has been appraised. Aims at the ethical problem of enterprise marketing, the strategies are gained to raise the ethics level of enterprise marketing.

articleTitle: Research on the Naval Vessels Information System Based on the System Dynamic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The management of naval vessels in naval base becomes more and more difficult as the number and the complexity increase. This mission requires a comprehensive information system. Although branch support systems in the naval base are dedicated to emergency management, the existing systems are inadequate to meet the threats and challenges inherent in this new technology infrastructure. The systems used to support crisis decision-making may not be fully capable of serving the mission. To optimize coordination in crises, an information system to manage the naval vessel is needed to meet the challenges presented in this new information environment. This paper mainly discusses the use of modeling and simulation in the information system. Upon the completion of the conceptual models, the structure and organization of the data were validated through a computerized conceptual model representation system. System dynamic experiments were carried to study the properties of information system. According to the simulation results, this information system is capable of managing the naval vessels effectively. Also, the structure and the simulation model was validated.

articleTitle: The Research on Theoretical Model of Knowledge Spillover under the Triple Helix Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Now the Triple Helix model has been the new paradigm of research on technological innovation. Previous research has shown that from a macro perspective, the knowledge transfer among University Industry Government is quite clear. But the social property of micro-actors has great effects on the knowledge transfer. Based on this, this article proposed three theoretical models of knowledge spillover: the Triple Helix model of knowledge spillover that does not consider the social property, the Triple Helix model of knowledge spillover that strengthens the social property, the Triple Helix model of knowledge spillover that has moderate social property. So we can measure the spillover of knowledge transfer.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Mechanism of Independent Innovation Based on Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: On Border Effect Gravity Model for Agricultural Trade
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Three border effect models capturing the unique characteristics of agricultural trade based on the gravity model are put forward and further contrasted to study China-U.S. border effects for agricultural trade covering the panel data over the period of 1987-2007. The results show that the third model -fixed effects model considering the heterogeneity of each trading pair is preferred in this regard. The border effects for agricultural trade tend to be significantly large, and vary from international trade direction and across regions, but the models without considering these differences tend to overestimate the border effects for China-U.S. agricultural trade over this period.

articleTitle: Constructing Knowledge Innovation Models of Communication Management in Research Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the intersection and fusion of different disciplines need to tackle a joint research. By the cooperation of different disciplines, knowledge innovation has become the important element of innovation in research organization. Communication management of knowledge innovation is one of the most essential management systems, which is beneficial for members in research organization to share information. It is of great significance for knowledge innovation and research innovation with communication management. This paper discusses the effect of specific communication means in knowledge innovation systems and precisely explores the dynamic relationship among the communication management's elements and knowledge innovation, and at last constructs knowledge innovation models of communication management in research organization.

articleTitle: The Effect of Chinese Interest Rate Liberalization on Corporate Debt Maturity Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Debt maturity model is constructed under constant interest rate in this paper, combined with the reformation characteristic of financial system in China. The analysis suggests that under fixed interest rate caused by financial repression, none but enterprises with high quality could choose optimal debt maturity structure to maximize their own utility; most of firms with average quality or poor quality could not choose optimal debt maturity structure on their own initiative, while they would only be distribute debt of different maturity structure by bank who estimate the risk of loan with debt repay index. So the lower of corporate debt paying ability, the less of long-term debt banks would distribute, which result in overmuch proportion of short term debt in debt maturity structure in Chinese firms. With the deepening of interest rate market reformation, the control of float rate would be reduced step by step. As a result, the structural shortage of long-term debt in corporate debt maturity structure will be settled effectively. Banks relieve risk of debt repayment by adjust level of interest rate, and all the firms could achieve optimal debt maturity structure to maximize own utility. On the other hand, with the liberalization of interest rates, the signaling function of debt maturity structure would be resumed so that we can distinguish private information of corporate quality by its debt maturity structure.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Modeling the Influential Factors on Determination of CODP in Service Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Sequence of the Logistics Park Based on Entropy-Weight
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For reducing the resource wasting on the logistics park construction, we established a model researching on the construction sequence of the logistics park, with the theory of entropy-weight got the power weight of each target. By establishing this model, the optimal construction sequence is derived, and the multiple targets decision making promble could be better addressed. A numerical example is used to demonstrate that this method could solve the actual plan and construction promble, and could propose some opinions for the urban planning and logistics park planning.

articleTitle: Econometrics Model Analysis of the Shipping Market Considering the Financial Crisis Influences
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The U.S. financial crisis makes the global economic show serious sliding trend. Highly international shipping market is hit heavily accordingly. Question is widely concerned that how long will the financial crisis effect to the shipping industry last. Based on theory of maritime economics, this article try to reveal the relation in quantity among international trade, supply and demand of shipping and then predict short run freight of future shipping market by establishing and solving econometrics model. The result shows that freight of shipping market in 2009 will fall further, so the situation of the surplus of transport capacity is hard to turn around in a short term. Related enterprises should formulate corresponding to the strategy to seize the opportunity to survive the crisis.

articleTitle: Using Analytical Hierarchical Process to Match IT Portfolio Management Processes to Strategy Maps
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information technology (IT) represents a significant portion of capital expenditures for a firm. With the current financial crisis, it has become increasingly important to ensure that IT investment decisions are aligned with corporate strategy. Strategy maps use a balanced-scorecard approach to help companies formulate their strategy. This paper presents a new technique that uses the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to elicit the decision making structure underlying IT portfolio management processes in a company. Different prototypical strategy maps are then evaluated against this structure to determine alignment between the current portfolio management processes and the company's strategy. A case study from a university is used to illustrate the technique.

articleTitle: Contract-Based Trilateral Game Research of Private License or Transferring Behavior During the Operating of Patent Pool
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this article trilateral game model which is based on contract during the operating of patent pool is established. The three parties in the game model are the internal members of patent pool, patent demand persons and management organization of patent pool. Based on the basic models, three types of specific situations are been further discussed and each ones are be solved and concretely analyzed. The ultimate conclusion is that the management organization of patent pool can reduce or prevent the private license or transferring behavior which occur between the internal members of patent pool and patent demand persons by five methods, which are reducing cost of supervision and inspection, improving quality of supervision and inspection, dealing with the punishment more severely, enlarging both losses of image and reputation and increasing propaganda ram which make those people fully understand the negative influence of the private license or transferring behavior.

articleTitle: Risk Factor Analysis of Liquid Ammonia Cross-Border Air Pollution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Research into cross-border air pollution caused by the continuous leakage of liquid ammonia has been carried out based on the standard allowable concentration of short-term exposure to ammonia of 30 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and the more strict maximum allowable concentration of harmful substances in residential areas of 0.2 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, assuming that the cross-border distances are 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km. The atmospheric stability classes, the range of wind speeds and the time required for the pollution to reach a border were studied for source intensities ranging from 3 to 20 kg/s. The results of the study show that the D and E stability classes are the most likely to trigger cross-border pollution events. The range of crossborder wind speeds leading to exceedance of the maximum allowable level narrows as the distance to the boundary increases. Irrespective of the source intensity, the travel time for the pollution to reach the same distance of boundary is similar under the same wind speeds which are in the range of transboundary wind speeds, and the duration of the pollution event is longer with increasing source intensity for the same wind conditions. The pollution arrives faster and the duration of the event becomes shorter with increasing wind speed, for the same source intensity.

articleTitle: The Study of Competitive Advantages and Formation Mechanism of Strategic Alliances
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the changeable environment, obtaining external resources through cooperation has been an important resource of competitive advantage of enterprises. Strategic alliances are the vital organizational models used to seek competitive advantages through enterprises. In this paper, the Game Theory Approach was used to study the reasons of the formation, problems and countermeasures of strategic alliances.

articleTitle: The Micro Mechanism of Entrepreneurial Decision Making: Causal Model Validation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to 277 entrepreneurial questionnaires, this article testified the causal model of micro mechanism on the entrepreneurial decision making. The result of structural equation modeling indicated entrepreneurial alertness and prior knowledge were the direct factor to the entrepreneurial opportunity recognition. They influenced the entrepreneurial decision via the variables of opportunity recognition. Thus, opportunity recognition played a mediating role in the full model.

articleTitle: Integrative Approach to the Situational and Dispositional Antecedents of Job Satisfaction
