publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines the relationship between job satisfaction, positive affectivity, negative affectivity, distributive justice, and work group cohesion in China. All the survey instruments used in this study are well established multi-item scales that have been validated in English speaking populations. The statistical analysis shows that distributive justice, work group cohesion and positive affectivity are positively related to job satisfaction. The relationship between positively affectivity and job satisfaction is partially mediated via work group cohesion, and the relationship between negative affectivity and job satisfaction is completely mediated via work group cohesion and distributive justice. The research also finds that older workers are happier with their jobs than their younger counterparts.

articleTitle: Upgrading "Chain-Type Risk" of Local Industrial Cluster in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With economic globalization, more and more local industrial clusters in developing countries chose to "Upgrade" in order to pursue the developing goal. And upgrading by insertion in global value chain is one of main ways to quickly upgrade for many local industrial clusters. But upgrading only by the insertion in the chain is risky (we call it chain-type risk). The paper first introduces global value chain and upgrading patterns and paths for local industrial clusters in developing countries, then analyses the risks facing local industrial clusters in developing countries, finally puts forward countermeasures to elude the risks.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method on Product/Services Based on Market Consumer Psychology Preferences
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, under the circumstance that the levels of customer demand for product/services are increasing improved and their demand types have diversity and individuality increasingly, the problem which should be primarily concerned by product/services suppliers is how to meet customer willingness for different product/services from various aspects. In this regard, the product/services evaluation from consumer is a measure standard of product/services quality strengths and weaknesses and is also the decisive factors to measure the operating performance and development potential of the product/services suppliers. Different from the traditional evaluation angles and means to product/services, a comprehensive evaluation index system based on consumer psychological preferences of product/services by analyzing the psychological preference factors of customer consumption is set up in this paper, and which emphasize and highlight the importance of the affective response indexes, the purchase interest and intention indexes as well as the subjective overall evaluation indexes in the evaluation of product/services based on consumer psychology. Then, a comprehensive evaluation method is put forward to accomplish the evaluation task based on considering the relations between the consumer psychological preferences and the traditional evaluation indexes. At last, the reasonable analysis by using a calculation example is given.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Stimulation of Knowledge Share in Knowledge Chain Based on Different Levels
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Research of River Regeneration and Green Water Transport System Construction in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Green Water Transport System is an important part in the regeneration of urban river in Hangzhou. The rivers and their areas are experiencing a transformation from decline. As a significant factor that can improve the environment rebuilding, to set up the Green Water Transport System will bring regeneration to the vacant and derelict land all along the river banks, raise the tourism industry and help to lift investment and activity. Green Water Transport System will also be considered as a possible solution to relieve the land transport pressure in surrounding areas.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Researches on Stage Recognition and Model of Marketing Force Synergy Interface Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Equity Promotion Based on Four-Dimensional Measurement Model: Application on the Mobile Communication Field
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ultimate goal of customer equity measurement and management is to promote the firm's customer equity. The measurement model we illustrate can be used to determine the weight coefficients which show the influence degree of each sub-driver to the firm's customer equity. We apply this approach on the mobile communications firms and discuss the customer equity promotion strategies guided by the influence degree of each sub-driver, which is different from qualitative approach used in the literature on promotion of customer equity.

articleTitle: Mining Association Rules Using Value Dependence and Pseudo Intension
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Association rules are useful for determining correlations between items and have applications in marketing, financial and retail sectors. Lots of algorithms have been proposed for finding the association rules in databases. In this paper, we propose a new algorithm to find out association rules. First, attention is paid to value dependence theory. Then we study a theory called pseudo intension which is usually used in formal concept analysis (FCA). Finally, we propose an algorithm based on value dependence and pseudo intension theories to mine association rules.

articleTitle: Design of ETL Aggregation Policy in Local Tax System (LTS)
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The design of extract transform loading (ETL) aggregation policy for data warehouse in LTS is introduced in the paper. Firstly, we analyze the characters of data storage in LTS, and according to the subject and logic model analyzed to LTS, estimate the data scale and classify the refresh frequency, then design the ETL aggregation policy, including aggregation tables and the process of aggregation transformation. The paper proposes new and be executed rules for selecting aggregation dimension and presents the process of aggregation calculation and transformation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Rethinking the Design Decision-Making Process Based Whole Life Cost Benchmark
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Modeling Firms' Location Choice in an Industrializing City: Spatial Effect of the Generalized Regional Plan
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the fast industrializing China, sustainable regional development requires study on the mechanism of the industry's spatial distribution. The regional industry development plan was usually thought to be the backbone. However, the relationship between the governmental planning and the development route in reality wasn't objectively identified. We proposed the generalized perspective on the regional plan, which covers factors not only of the industry policy, but also the infrastructure, land resource, environmental constraints and socio-economic status. The discrete logit location choice model is built based on the behavior of firms and its interactions with local government. The variables are the above factors of the alternative locations (towns). Deyang city's industrial plants invested during 2003-2007 is used as the empirical data for estimating the parameters. The result implies that the generalized regional plan factors are partially consistent in planning. The location choices resulted from the above factors' synthetic effect while the 6 sectors are different. The plant-size heterogeneity matters in location choices.

articleTitle: A Canonical Correlation Analysis on the Correlative Development of the Industrial Cluster and Urbanization in the Region of Pearl River Delta
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper utilizes the canonical correlation analysis to analyze the two series of variables of the industrial cluster and urbanization in Pearl River Delta region. The result of this research is that the relationship of interdependency and correlative development does exist between industrial cluster and urbanization in Pearl River Delta.

articleTitle: The Relativity and Functional Mechanism between Tourism Development and National Economic - Empirical Analysis Based on the Relationship between GDP of Zhejiang Province and Tourism
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the relationship between tourism development and national economic, this paper studied the internal relations between some important index of tourism and economic development by using grey system theory and quantitative economic method, put forward the basic views that we should give full play to the important functions of tourism industry in economic development at the present stage, promote national economic growth, tourism and economic coordination and sustainable development in order to achieve the goal of boosting domestic demands.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Branding-Based Corporate Value Proposition and Brand Culture
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Multiple Subspace Skyline Queries in Service Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Subspace Skyline query processing has recently received a lot of attention in service management community. The AOMSSQ algorithm is the most efficient method for optimizing multiple subspace skyline queries in multi-user environments. In this paper, we first study the performance of the AOMSSQ algorithm. Then based on the Bloom Filters technology, an novel solution is proposed to improve the efficiency of the AOMSSQ algorithm. We present the extensive experiments that demonstrate our improved solution is both efficient and effective.

articleTitle: Reducing the Information Quality Risk in Decision Support for a Finance Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper describes an information quality risk in decision support for a finance company as part of a larger project in auto finance loaning. A methodology to estimate the risks of data accuracy, completeness and consistency on the data aggregate functions count, sum and average is presented. This methodology ensures decisions based on fit-for-purpose information for projects that harvest warehouse data for decision support to the management. By developing a risk assessment program for information quality focused on business initiatives and treating information as a true enterprise asset, high-quality information for credits can be assured.

articleTitle: The Quantitative Analysis on Accessibility and Trade Areas Delimitation of Big Scale Supermarkets Based on GIS in Central Shanghai, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The distance and retail store attraction have effect on consumer shopping action. Recently most relative quantitative modeling study on retail location did not simultaneously consider those factors including traffic network, traffic grade, store attraction and competition based on GIS. This paper aims at these shortages and attempt to integrate above factors and make quantitative analysis about large scale shops based on accessibility method, breaking point laws and GIS technique. The result indicates that accessibility of large scale supermarket in Shanghai central city is good, the west of city is better than east. Shops' market region areas in near out ring are greater. Trade areas between inner loop and middle loop are smaller. Market size near out loop and inside inner loop is greater. Market scale of between inner loop and middle loop is smaller. This study can make urban planner know about retail network layout. Managers can quickly understand the shop trade areas and provide the consult for choosing shops location.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study of Independent Innovation on Foshan Ceramics Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Impacts of the Internal Structure of GDP on the Electricity Consumption in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using a new prediction model based on rough set theory, we investigate the impacts of the internal structure of GDP on the electricity consumption with annual data over the period 1980~2004 in China. The new prediction model is established by presenting a related relation prediction method according to the concept of objects, information entropy, and rules in rough set theory. The empirical results show that the internal structure of GDP has different impacts on the electricity consumption. The largest contributor to the change of electricity consumption is disposal income, followed by investment and export. However, the price has no significant impacts on the change of electricity consumption. The results show that the prediction model not only can be used to effectively reveal the influence mechanism and influence degree of the four explanatory variables on electricity consumption in china, but also can be used to forecast electricity consumption. Finally, policy implications to save electricity power are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Employee's Occupational Commitment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research mainly examines the factors that affect an employee's occupational commitment. Respondents of the questionnaire were all insurance agents, and a total of 246 valid questionnaires were completed. After going through correlation and regression analysis of the collected data, it is implied that insurance agents' affective occupational commitment, is higher than their affective organizational commitment. Also, their organizational commitment is positively correlated to their occupational commitment. Meanwhile, the agents' affective occupational commitment is also positively influenced by their job satisfaction. On the other hand, the respondents' job satisfaction has a positive effect on their affective organizational commitment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction of Employee Trust Mechanism in Enterprise - Based on the Integration of Economic Contract and Psychological Contract
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Cost and Cost Parameter Estimation in Whole-Set Equipment Multi-Attribute Procurement Auction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In whole-set equipment multi-attribute procurement, the buyer not only cares about the exchange price, but also pays more attention to the influence of lead-time and equipment quality on his value. According to the practice of equipment procurement, this paper formulates the suppliers' cost function with parameters which are unknown to the buyer, and the buyer's value resulted from the procurement is expressed by value function. Both the cost and value relate to quality, leadtime and quantity attributes. In order to get the more concrete cost function, we study the cost parameters by multi-round bidding. In the end, We provide a numerical example to illustrate our method and get a reasonable solution.

articleTitle: Choice of Demonstration Experts for Momentous Project Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Momentous project is a strategic project with which a country, in responding to challenges in the development of economy, society or science and technology, pools a large amount of social resources to program and put it into practice. The optimization grouping of experts is one of key problems before making the feasibility study for the momentous project. This paper constructs a mathematic model of choosing demonstration experts for the momentous project and develops a genetic algorithm to solve it. A numerical example is examined to show that the constructed model and the developed algorithm are effective and feasible to solve the problem of choosing demonstration experts for the momentous project.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Dynamic Mechanism of Enterprise Information System Growth
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper developed a dynamic mechanism model of IS growth. Five hypotheses were proposed and were validated based on the data collected from 158 Chinese enterprises. The results indicate that information technology (IT) absorption is a direct impetus that drives IS growth; meanwhile it is impelled by the equilibrium of enterprise demand and technology supply. Trace to the source, it is competition that motivates enterprise demand, and IT advancement guarantees technology supply. Due to the interaction of various forces, IS grows up as a spiral process.

articleTitle: Research on the Stability of Supply Chain Base on Eco-System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After discussed the stability of supply chain base on ecosystem, the measurement of the stability of supply chain was researched using the models of Logistic and Differential Equation.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Game in the Investment Decision-Making of Developing Visitor Attractions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the development of the resource-based visitor attractions (RVA), the government and the local residents have the greatest impact on the investor. This paper discusses the relationship between them, and analyzes the game between the investor and the government, and the local residents respectively, with conclusions about protecting the host community and cooperation by the investor. Corresponding countermeasures and suggestions are made for the government and the investor to develop and protect the RVA effectively.

articleTitle: Towards an Adaptive Multi-Level RBAC Mechanism for Countering Insider Misuse
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes an extended RBAC model for countering insider misuse, which provides scalability and flexibility. Multi-level security and context-awareness are introduced into the model to fit in with the particular appliance. A mechanism for insider misuse prevention is presented based on the model. To detect and prevent insider misbehavior, the insider's behavior pattern is analyzed and the probability of misuse is estimated, based on the enforced prevention policies. As a proof, finally an experimental verification is carried out based on the approach.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of Consumer Behavior on the Power Structure in Manufacturer-Retailer Relationship: Conceptual Framework and Research Propositions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Innovation Network and Performance of Technology Clusters: Evidence from Communication Equipment Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on the performance of technology clusters over the period 1998-2005 in communication equipment industry within USA. We explore the relationship between the cluster network properties and the cluster performance at the cluster level. Our analysis shows that the average network distance has a negative impact on the cluster performance. We also find that the cluster coefficient has positive influence on the cluster performance. This finding is consistent with a view that knowledge spillover plays important role in the economic performance of technology clusters.

articleTitle: A Qualitative Research to Classifying Comments in Online Shops Based on Contents
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A research aimed at classifying comments in online shops based on contents. Data were collected from nine real online shops (include 6 B2C online shops and 3 C2C ones), while 904 comments were used in the final. Method mainly used is grounded theory which belongs to qualitative research. Results show the comments in online shops can be classified into four categories, nine factors, and they are: service (includes 3 factors: customer service, logistics and packaging, post-sales service and problem solving), Product and price (includes 2 factors: product, price and payment), Author self-display (includes 2 factors: background describing, sensation) and post-sales action (includes 2 factors: action, suggestion). Besides, results also show there are some relationships within the categories of comments and the types of online shops (B2C vs. C2C), published areas of comments, and types of products commented. Findings tell both online retailers and product producers should pay attention to the advices and items written in comments system of online shops, try hard to mine useful knowledge and discover shortages, so as to improve their services or products effectively.

articleTitle: Innovative Mobile Operators' Business Model Classification in the Process of Transformation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At the crossroads of the rapid developing mobile communications industry, mobile operators are sensitive to seize the trend of transformation in order to achieve its long-term sustainable development. The transformation of mobile operators calls for its own suitable business models. This paper begins by defining mobile operators' business model. Then, based on the relationship between business model and value chain theory, the paper offers an innovative way a two dimensions way considering both the elements of value chain and the customer demands to sort the mobile operators' business models. According to this method, the business models of mobile operators can be sorted as three kinds: the basic communication model corresponding to mobile communications service provider, and the information service model corresponding to mobile information service provider, and the business application model corresponding to the mobile integrated application provider. This paper attempts to describe the deeper structure of mobile operators' business model by doing the classification and thereby generates novel insights for researchers, managers and investors.

articleTitle: Evolution of Business Information Systems on the Integration and Intelligence Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through proposing the intelligence dimension and integration dimension, this paper builds a new research system to study the evolution of contemporary business information systems (BIS). From the two dimensional perspective, the author analyzes some typical BIS such as management information systems (MIS), decision support systems (DSS), enterprise resources planning (ERP), and business intelligence (BI), probes into their individual development and their interrelationships during the process, and based on that, builds the model for the evolution and reaches the conclusion that the evolution of contemporary BIS is a non-linear process of various types of integration and intelligence enhancement.

articleTitle: Research on Trusted Electronic Commerce Semantic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web service composition lets developers create applications on top of service-oriented computing native description, discovery, and communication capabilities. Such applications are rapidly deployable and offer developers reuse possibilities and users seamless access to a variety of complex services. Most existing Web service composition ways construct chains of services based on semi-automatic or automatic process includes presenting matching services to the user at each step of a composition, filtering the possibilities by using semantic descriptions of the services. The generated composition is then directly executable through the WSDL grounding of the services. We provide composition architecture of trusted web services based on ontology. The objective of this paper is to research a framework that enables trusted semantic search of web services and trusted dynamic composition of workflows to answer complex questions from the user expressed in their natural language electronic commerce requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Utilization and Environmental Impact for Chinese Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the course of booming economic growth based on mass production and consumption, China has been discharging an enormous amount of wastes giving rise to a wide range of environmental impacts. The method of economy-wide material flow analysis (EW-MFA) is one of the effective tools to examine and assess the metabolic performance of physical economies, but relevant researches in China most focus on throughput but rarely concern utilization of recycling resource and environmental impact. This paper analyzes the characteristics of resource utilization and environmental impact for the years 1990-2005 using the indicators derived from EW-MFA. The ration of recycled material (RRM) is added as the new indicator in order to be in accordance with the need of circular economy being promoted in China. Finally some deficiencies of EW-MFA are pointed out.

articleTitle: Towards a Resource-Based Integration Strategy of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-commerce offers buyers and sellers a new form of communication and provides an opportunity to create new marketplaces. This paper introduces the e-commerce integration strategy focused on the issues of resource-based view and its impact on firm performance. When the hard information resources of time, people and computers are wisely used, these make communication a core competence for the company. As the soft information resources are added, that is, the intellectual capital, knowledge sharing and willingness to learn, organizational culture and ideology is developed, which feeds business success. According to the resource-based view, the ability of a firm to develop capabilities enhances its ability to adapt to the changing competitive environment and improves its survival prospects. In this paper, several relationships are examined. 1st: Information resource integration and knowledge sharing would contribute positively to the organizational learning behaviors, and associate with the integration of firm's soft information resources such as organizational culture and ideology. 2nd: The integration of information resources and the extent of knowledge sharing in a firm would promote its business process improvement initiative. 3rd: Information resource integration and knowledge sharing in a firm would contribute positively to its service standardization integration. 4th: The integration of organizational culture and ideology and learning behaviors practiced by a firm would contribute positively to its service standardization integration. 5th: The extent of business process integration would contribute positively to its service standardization integration. 6th: Business process integration of a firm would associate with its firm performance. 7th: The standardization and quality of services offered by a firm would have a positive effect on its firm performance. The paper finds that information resource integration, business process integration, knowledge sharing and organizational learning behaviors positively affect firm performance.

articleTitle: The Development Situation and Suggestions of Modern Logistics Industry of Hebei Province, China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This text has described the intension of modern logistics industry, and pointed out the important function of modern logistics industry to the development of national economy. Combining domestic and international modern development of logistics industry, we analyze Hebei modern logistics industry current situation of the development and advantage and inferior position of development. Aiming for the actual conditions of Hebei, we provide Hebei modern logistics industry suggestion of development from four respects: the development of the logistics industry in every area of Hebei, construction of logistics gardens of Hebei, the important logistics enterprises and the building of modern software and hardware of logistics industry in Hebei.

articleTitle: Energy Utilization Economical Analysis of Heating/Cooling Sources for Ecological Buildings Based on City Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The economical analysis of heating/cooling sources for ecological building using renewable energy was mainly discussed. Firstly, the application patterns of natural resources which used in heating and air conditioning system for ecological buildings were generalized, then the famous AHP method was introduced into the decision-making process of scheme selection of heating/cooling sources for an ecological residential district, while the economic evaluation indexes which related to energy conservation and environmental protection were adopted to compare and analyze the economic technology. At last, a computer program that based on AHP method was established to simplify the process of calculation and improve the work efficiency. Based on saving energy and environment protection, it is shown that using of renewable energy in the ecological buildings can get visible economic efficiency, energy-saving efficiency and environmental efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Tech-Innovation Mode of Independent-Brand Automakers in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on QoS-Based Web Service Description Language
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of the Web services, how to provide quality of service (QoS) becomes a key factor to achieve success in business. This paper proposes a QoS-based Web service description language approach, which can improve the effectiveness in Web services discovery.

articleTitle: Logistics Service E-Procurement Mechanism Affected by Information Resources Sharing Attribute
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The theory of procurement auction of production traditionally assumes that the bidder profit is affected by his own attribute, such as cost and quality. In our paper, we consider a logistics service e-procurement mechanism affected by information resources sharing attribute of both sides, which is based on a simple multidimensional auctions model. We also discuss an application framework of our mechanism in real logistics network.

articleTitle: Evolutionary-Economics Research on the Governance of Conflict between Information Integration and Complexity in a Firm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the idea "evolution", this article will define information integration as a logical connection from the three dimensions of technology, economy and institution. Some main concepts of evolutionary economics are used to analyze the contents on diversification and complexity which are induced in the process of information connection. As some kind of knowledge, the information is taken as certain routine caused by emergence and self-organization of multi-level information connection. We imply there is a conflict between the integration and complexity of information, and the diversified boundary of a firm will be generated from it to conquer this question. A model of governance based on evolutionary economics is put forward.

articleTitle: Value-Added Analysis about Construction Supply Chain Based on Information Sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain, of which value-added management is a key to the whole value chain management, is an important part of the external value chain of the construction enterprise. Therefore, the future competition will mainly be presented as supply chain competition. Facing the problems and defects of the supply chain in current construction fields, this paper introduces several information sharing modes, combined with the value adding process of supply chain, analyzes the supply chain value adding based on information sharing. And further set up a supply chain optimization model of the construction enterprises. Through empirical analysis, we compare the benefits gained by construction enterprises before and after the application of the model, thus conclude that the optimization model would significantly improve the supply chain management.

articleTitle: The Research of Cities' Technological Potential in Metropolitan Region: The Case of Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper makes studies on the cities' technological potential in metropolitan region. It firstly introduces the main points about the spatial structure theory for metropolitan innovation system, explains the concept of city technological potential, and then presents a potential model of the spatial interaction theory. Then the research takes Fujian Province as a case to calculate the city technological potential and analyze the hierarchy accordingly. The difference between the case study and programming shows that the hierarchy of the metropolitan innovation system should be the result brought out by market rather than administrative instrument.

articleTitle: The Benefits of Trade on the Base of Comparative Advantage Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In comparative advantage model, no matter for complete or partial specialization, trade is determined by factors endowment. The results of trade, such as consumption, utility and terms of trade, are influenced by elements such as factors endowment and production efficiency. Consumption preference and demand strength can also affect trade to some extent.

articleTitle: Research on Real Futures Dynamic Hedging Based on S-GARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The key point of hedging is determination of hedge ratio. The existing hedging researches emphasize particularly on static hedging, which can't effectively reflect the time-varying characteristic of market risk, thus cause hedge effect distortion. The main innovation is establishing a much simpler S-GARCH model to estimate the dynamic hedge ratio. There are three idiographic characteristics. Firstly it dynamically estimates the futures and spot combination's volatility, and primely portrays the time-varying variance effect of the futures and spot's price volatility, and enhances the hedge ratio's precision. Secondary the proposed S-GARCH model uses GARCH (1,1) model to estimate the variance-covariance matrix, so that it is considerably easier to estimate than existing multivariate GARCH models and does not suffer from the computationally burdensome problem. Thirdly the demonstration indicated that, this model's validity was higher than the popular existing models.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Investigation on the Relationship between Labor System and Construction Safety
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: State VS Private Controlling Shareholders and Earnings Management in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigates the essential ownership difference and distinct effects of this difference on earnings management between state and private controlling shareholders in China. Controlling shareholders in State Controlled Companies (SCCs) own control rights but no real cash flow rights. This control-ownership divergence creates incentive for controlling shareholders to expropriate corporate resources and further manage corporate earnings to disguise this expropriation behavior. In contrast, Controlling shareholders in Privately Controlled Companies (PCCs) generally own symmetric control and ownership, and thus the earnings management is likely not be linked to the benefits expropriation of controlling shareholders. Empirical results show that the earnings management level is positively correlated to the proportion of shares held by the controlling shareholders and negatively correlated to the balance ratio of other major shareholders for SCCs. However, this is not the case for PCCs. The results support the tunneling hypothesis of earnings management. The evidence of this study should also be useful to policymakers in a number of countries as they plan reforms of state ownership.

articleTitle: System Dynamic Analysis of Relationship between Individuals' Opportunity Perception Bias and Risk Perception Bias in Entrepreneurial Team
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Several psychological factors influence the choices of entrepreneurs' strategy in entrepreneurial risk decision-making. The main work of this paper is to explore these psychological factors. Based on the related researches, a causality graph is drawn. Therefore, the formation mechanisms and the interactive laws of individual's opportunity perception bias (OPB) and risk perception bias (RPB) in entrepreneurial team are researched. Finally, a mental system dynamics model of entrepreneurial risk decision-making is constructed and some regulations in entrepreneurial risk decision-making are explored.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Risk Identification of Private Capital Participating in Government Project Based on Risk Matrix
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Issues in the Bullwhip Effect Agricultural Supply Chain in Heilongjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Investment Risk Assessment and Control in Tourism Project Based on Portfolio Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By applying mean variance model and CAPM model of modern portfolio theory, the paper constructs portfolio risk decision making model in tourism project. Then, we assess investment risk in tourism project by combining the model with present situation of tourism investment in China. The analysis provides proof for enterprises when making risk controlling strategies in tourism project investment.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for D&U of GIR Based on Information Resources Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly puts forward an evaluation method for development and utilization (D&U) of government information resources (GIR) based on the information resources lifecycle, which can be divided into six stages: planning, acquisition, processing, dissemination and utilization, storage and maintenance, and disposition and destruction. The paper defines the meaning of each stage and also the capability maturity level features of them on five levels: initial level, managed level, defined level, quantitatively managed level, and optimizing level, which are the bases of constructing indicators of evaluation system. Next, the paper presents the applied method and implemental steps of the evaluation system. Finally, some considers are given for selecting key indicators.

articleTitle: Study on the Decision-Making Method Based on VaR
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on VaR this paper puts forward the concept of RaR(return rate at risk) and analyses the result of RaR under the two common distributions to draw a conclusion that the relation of RaR, expected return rate and risk is linear. Found on that, the paper advances a new investment decision-making method. The study discovers that method can substitute the traditional utility function. Finally, we test the method through a case of portfolio selection.

articleTitle: Software Crisis, What Software Crisis?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The popular explanation for software development challenges and failures is that the software industry is immature and software is complex. However, historical evidence suggests that software development can be highly successful, especially in the pre-packaged software (PPSW) sector. The software challenges are usually associated with information systems development (ISD) projects for developing custom-build software (CBSW). This paper argues that in order to effectively tackle the software crisis, it is important to separate CBSW from PPSW for consideration. Based on the dichotomy of the software industry, this paper presents a new explanation for the software crisis. A client in ISD projects usually engages with its supplier(s) through a competitive-bidding-monopolized-development. Such a process potentially reduces creativity vital for software development. The paper points out the implications of this explanation and poses a number of further research questions.

articleTitle: Towards Strategy Model on Supply Chain Coordination with Option Contracts
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The option contract is one of the effective financial instruments for avoiding risk. There always exists the risk in supply chain especially when facing uncertain or random demand. By introducing the real option into a two-stage supply chain, the part of the buyer risk due to demand uncertainty can be shifted to the supplier, and the supplier, in turn, is recovered by the additional revenue obtained from the option contract. The decision-making model without considering options is studied, and the optimal strategy model with option contract is established while market demand following stochastic distribution and a numerical example is also included to illustrate the feasibility of the coordination strategy model with option contracts.

articleTitle: Proposing a Methodology to Evaluate the Quality of the Urban Sanitation Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A methodology is presented to evaluate the quality of the road cleaning service in Cordoba (Spain). It has been developed as a collaborative endeavor by SADECO, the company responsible for the sanitation service, in conjunction with members of the Department of Statistics at the University of Cordoba. The proposed methodology involves identifying the main types of urban garbage and their impact on residents, as well as the requirement levels depending on the zone considered.

articleTitle: Seismic Risk Management Framework of Bridge Engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Seismic damages of bridges may have great effects on traffic transport. In order to reduce the losses of the disaster, it is necessary to carry out seismic risk management of bridge engineering. In the paper, the seismic risk management framework was proposed and the main steps of risk management including risk identification, risk analysis, risk assessment and risk control were analyzed considering the characters of bridge engineering. From the theoretic framework, it can be seen that seismic risk management of bridge engineering is feasible.

articleTitle: On Evaluating Variation of Desirability Function: A Monte Carlo Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The desirability function method is widely used for simultaneous optimization of several independent or uncorrelated responses. In practical application, a second order polynomial is usually employed to represent each response based on RSM, and a functional form of the overall desirability is obtained. This paper proposes a Monte Carlo approach to evaluate variation of the overall desirability function resulting from the variance of future responses, with input variables fixed at each optimum point. In this approach the variance of the estimated mean response as well as that of the random error are taken into consideration. Research shows that the probabilistic risk analysis using Monte Carlo simulation is a useful supplement to simultaneous optimization and robust analysis. A numerical example with two factors and three output responses is discussed for illustrative purpose.

articleTitle: Project Risk Analysis Based on VB Procedures
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the study is how to make use of VB program for the project risk analysis. Program design is based on the idea of the principles of Monte Carlo. The key is the set-up of random variables and steps for realization.

articleTitle: Interoperability of Digital Rights Management via G-Schema
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital rights management (DRM) systems provide a means for content providers and distributors to address the unauthorized copying issue, in order to meet consumer's expectations, DRM approaches and related services and applications upon which they are based should coexist in an environment that supports interoperability. In this paper, we propose a General-Schema (G-Schema) approach to DRM interoperability problem, the concept model of G-Schema is based on the China DRM metadata standard draft, rights information can derive from G-Schema to generate specific DRM licenses based on different rights expression mechanism; Since Windows Media rights management (WMRM) is one of the most widely-used systems for protecting digital content, a testing project is also discussed for providing example implementation of interoperability with WMRM via G-Schema.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Overview of Financial Product in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation System for Supply Chain Partners Based on Evidential Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A comprehensive evaluation method oriented to supply chain partners based on evidential reasoning was put forward. Compared with existing evaluation methods, it can perfectly deal with the diversification of evaluation objectives, incomplete information of evaluation objectives, variance of evaluation index etc. Furthermore, it pays more attention on society and environment.

articleTitle: Material Procurement Based on the Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An agent system, which is characterized by self-organization, self-maintain, independence and self-learning abilities, has the ability of communicating with each other among different computer platforms. Therefore, the agent technology, as a new solution to material procurement, is attempted to be applied. The paper analyzes and discusses this issue.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the Age Distribution of Highly Cited Scientists' Scientific Productivity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Service Recovery's Influence on Perceived Justice and Relationship Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Influencing Factors of Executive Equity Incentive Efficiency and Levels
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the dates come from 569 companies listed before 2006, we test the factors which affect the executive equity-based incentive levels and performance. The equity-based incentive performance is significant positive correlation with the levels of executive equity-based incentive. It shows equity-based incentive can improve company performance. When adding interaction variables in equation, we found the sensitivity for the company performance to levels of executive equity-based incentive would be affected by other factors. There are interactions between proportions in executive stock holding and market competition, risk level faced by the company, company scale and capital structure. And the efficiency of executive equity-based incentive is negative correlation with risk endured by the companies, proportions of independent directors and capital structure shows the internal and external governance structure of listed companies in China are still exist some problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Fusion Algorithms of Membership Based on Data-Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Assembly Task Scheduling Method for Aircraft Development Project Based on Critical Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on critical chain theory, a new method for aircraft development project was proposed on assembly task scheduling, which can effectively improve flexibility of assembly scheduling scheme. In the method, the priority rules for critical chain identification was established by the three characteristic parameters, and then the algorithm steps which identifies critical chain was listed by project network planning. Afterwards, a buffer setting method based on elasticity coefficient was utilized in improving flexibility of scheduling scheme, which can absorb duration fluctuation and avoid rescheduling situations. In addition, the application of the aircraft wing assembly was introduced, and the result demonstrated the functionality of the method.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of Newpay Mechanisms Based on Campus Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the discovery of electronic payment in campus network environment, build a micro-payment model: Newpay mechanism, which suitable for campus network environment. Discussed the application scope, payment process and functions of the new payment model, analyze the new model's performance in five aspects of the efficiency, security, fairness, and anonymity and transaction costs.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Realization of Product Innovation of New and Hi-Tech Industrial Clusters through Knowledge Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Measurement of Realized Range-Based Volatility Based on Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the realized range-based volatility, a nonparameter and integrated measurement method of volatility is presented to describe volatility dynamics. In this paper, a combination of the realized range-based volatility based on the high-frequency data at different time scale by using the method of multiple regression is presented, and the multiple regression model is proposed by enduring the power in the Almon function. Through empirical analysis of the index of China's Stock Market, we analyze integrated measurement method of volatility at different time scale, and find the best combination of the realized range-based volatility to estimate and forecast volatility. It is confirmed that the integrated measurement method of volatility based on 1-120 minutes time scale is a better measurement than others to describe volatility of the high-frequency data.

articleTitle: Franchise Value and Bank Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thesis analyses the source of bank franchise value, the relationship between franchise value and bank risk-taking behavior and capital-level.Introduces a model to illustrate how the regulator can deter bank risk-taking behavior by using bank closure policy from the point view of the franchise value. Finally, analyses the Chinese bank franchise value and gives some suggestions.

articleTitle: The City Development Strategy: Based on the System Dynamics Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the principles of system dynamics modeling, the authors develops a system dynamics model for the urban development strategy of a special city that derived from the natural resources exploitation. Considering that urban agglomeration has becoming the economy growth poles in the regional economy and the determination of region development, the SD model takes the urban agglomeration as the main body of the system. In the simulation, 4 development environment scenarios of the urban agglomeration and 3 development modes are given. At the end of the paper, the coordination function is introduced for the mining-dependent city to choose the scheme for the urban development strategy.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction of Rolling Coil Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The inspection process of rolling coil wastes time and increases cost of enterprise. The enterprise is eager to find a prediction analysis method which can predict performance of rolling coil by some of relative data. Data Warehouse provide plenty of data for performance prediction. Because productive process is complicated, the statistical analysis method and the traditional machine learning method have some limitations in the application in this field. This paper reviews the construction of data warehouse and use support vector machine to solve the prediction problem. It is proved that by using the support vector machine, the enterprise's requirement can be met, and it can improve efficiency of production.

articleTitle: Partner Selection Based on Matching of Parameterized Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The problem of partner selection for virtual enterprise recombination is resolved by the parameterized service matching in this paper. A process model for this kind of service matching is established by means of adopting Petri net. Service and request in matching are formally described and a mathematical model is formulated for the matching. Based on this model, relevant service matching algorithm is proposed and matching rules are designed according to different matching precision in order to fulfill virtual enterprise leader's various requirement. And the feasibility of this partner selection method is further verified the by analyzing instance.

articleTitle: Analysis on How to Measure the Development of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rise of 'e-government', both as a recognized field of practice and an identifiable and legitimate field of study, has occurred extraordinarily rapidly throughout the world. The term 'e-government' has come to capture and de-limit into what might be termed the agenda for government in the age of the Internet. This article questions the value of the orthodox interpretation, the paradigm that has so rapidly emerged around e-government, in particular the casual assumption that e-government is ipso facto 'citizen-centric'. In so-doing this article reveals a concern that different questions must be asked in order to understand 'egovernment' and its implications fully and fundamentally. The driving objective of this paper is to identify different approaches to measure the development of e-government.

articleTitle: A GIS-Based Accessibility Modeling Process for Estimating Transit Travel Demand
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Transit planning requires forecasting travel demand. In the aggregate transport modeling system, the forecasting is accomplished through a four-stage process, in which transit demand is separated from other modes during modal split. Transit travel demand may also be forecasted at a less aggregate level with other methods, such as regression and accessibility models. These disaggregate models measure transit demand based on walking distance to transit stops. This paper presents a pragmatic GIS-based accessibility modeling approach to transit demand forecasting. Principles and data requirements of accessibility models are described. Based on appropriate data model in GIS, an implementation framework is developed for applying the accessibility models.

articleTitle: Electronic Commerce System Research Based on XML
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis has put forward a kind of new data presentation and analysis model based on XML and script language, it can express data information with the form that accords with the specification of XML , so makes it have good nature witch is unconcerned with platform, and it can be effective to have so alleviated the burden of server end using customer end resource. This kind of model has provided one new way for the electronic commerce system development.

articleTitle: Innovation in Knowledge Supply Chain: Research on Synergetic Factors and Innovation Models
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we will construct the comprehensive synergetic diamond-shaped model and the process model of the innovation factors in KSC. On this basis, we propose 4 kinds of KSC innovation models, respectively based on innovation subject, conversion of knowledge, knowledge breadth and knowledge depth. Finally we will analyze the combination and application of the 4 kinds of KSC innovation patterns. This study will be of importance in promoting scientific and technical conversion, as well as help the government foster the integrative construction of the universities, research institutes and the enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Development Mode of Equipment Manufacturing Industry under Concept of Circular Economy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of Cluster-Based Data Mining Techniques in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The data mining in electronic commerce is mainly Web data excavation; this article introduces the general process of Web excavation, studies the k-means cluster algorithm and analyzes some insufficiencies in k-means cluster algorithm. On basis of that, an improved algorithm of k-means cluster algorithm is proposed which can enhance the recommendation speed by compressing the size of recommendation pond, thus enhance the cluster efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Vertical Integration Based on Scarce Supplies and Overcapacity
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Scarce supplies and overcapacity are the main characteristics of many industries in transition economies. This paper focuses on the motives, conditions and impacts of vertical integration under these characteristics. Based on the extension of Hart-Tirole model, we show scarce supplies create motivation for vertical integration, and the motivation is decreasing with the M&A cost. Eager bandwagon becomes possible while certain conditions are satisfied. Vertical integration may foreclose the surplus capacity out of market, and the likelihood is increasing with the downstream investment cost. At last, we check the adaptability of these suggestions to Chinese aluminum industry, and points out the influence of government intervention on the adaptability.

articleTitle: Shot Boundary Detection Based on Macroblock and DC Image
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, shot boundary detection (SBD) algorithm based on macroblock and DC image is presented. We get the macroblock type information and simultaneously extract DC images from MPEG compressed domain. The statistics of macroblock type information is applied to coarse detection, and DC images are applied to scrutiny detection. The results of experiments show that our algorithm is efficient, and of low time consumption, hence the overall performance of the system is greatly improved. For its good performance in real time detection, SBD can be applied to online video shot detection and multimedia net.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Assessment Model of Commercial Banks Based on Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Scope: Commercial banks, as the key of the nation's economy and the center of financial credit, play a multiple irreplaceable role in the financial system. Credit risks threaten the economic system as a whole. Therefore, predicting bank financial credit risks is crucial to prevent and lessen the incoming negative effects on the economic system. Objective: This study aims to apply a credit risk assessment model based on support vector machines (SVMs) in a Chinese case, after analyzing the credit risk rules and building a credit risk system. After the modeling, it presents a comprehensive computational comparison of the classification performances of the techniques tested, including back-propagation neural network (BPN) and SVMs. Method: In this empirical study, we utilize statistical product and service solutions (SPSS) for the factor analysis on the financial data from the 157 companies and Matlab and Libsvm toolbox for the experimental analysis. Conclusion: We compare the assessment results of SVMs and BPN and get the indication that SVMs are very suitable for the credit risk assessment of commercial banks. Empirical results show that SVMs are effective and more advantageous than BPN. SVMs, with the features of simple classification hyperplane, good generalization ability, accurate goodness of fit, and strong robustness, have a better developing prospect although there are still some problems with them, such as the space mapping of the kernels, the optimizing scale, and so on. They are worthy of our further exploration and research.

articleTitle: The Study on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Enterprise's Core Competence Based on Knowledge Capital
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The enterprise's core competence is one of the key factors which affects whether an enterprise succeeds or not. So, it is important to evaluate enterprise's core competence. First, this paper establishes the enterprise's core competence model based on the knowledge capital theory. Second, this paper constructs the evaluation index system of enterprise's core competence based on this model. Third, the paper determines the weights of the indexes by AHP, and constructs a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of enterprise's core competence using the fuzzy mathematics theory. Finally, with an example, the paper calculates the core competence of the enterprise using this model. This study helps the enterprise to strength its core competence.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of the Current Situation of Enterprise Logistics Risk Management in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Independent Directors Incentive Mechanism Based on the Principal-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the principal-agent relationship exists between independent directors (IDs) and shareholders, the incentive compatibility problems which are still unsolved should be given more attention. The traditional fixed-pay system could preserve the independence of IDs, however, lack of incentives; the performance-related incentive mechanisms have great impact on IDs' independence which is the core of the system. This paper consider the reputation incentive mechanism (RIM) as an effective way to solve this dilemma. Appropriate RIM can maintain IDs' independence as well as their incentive compatibility.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Application on Suzhou Logistics Center Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the extensive application of information technology, e-commerce plays an increasingly important role on the development of logistics centers. In this paper, the author takes Suzhou Logistics Center Co., Ltd. as an example, describing the company's basic situation and the basic situation of e-business applications, focusing on an analysis of the successful experience of the promotion of their e-commerce applications, as well as the main problems. On the basis of above, the author pushes countermeasures and suggestions for promoting their e-commerce development with a view to reference and help for e-commerce development of China's logistics centers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Succession in Chinese Family Firms: Do the Offspring Intend to Take over the Businesses?
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Analysis of Chinese Stock Market Indices
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Safety Risk Management of ATSMS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concerning about the risks and the current situation of management afterwards in air traffic services management system(here in after called ATSMS), the thesis probes into prevention in advance model of ATSMS security risk management using the theory of early warning management and safety risk management, based on which it draws up the structure and organization of ATSMS security risk management and the running process of risk management and also puts forward specific implementation plans from the aspects of risk identification, risk assessment , risk management operation and so on, then enables ATSMS safety management to change from the post-response model to more proactive beforehand prevention model, keeps air traffic at an acceptable level of safety, and promotes the construction of air traffic safety system.

articleTitle: Financial Performance Evaluation of Product Innovation by High-Tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To achieve sustainable development of high standards high efficiency, high-tech enterprises must continuously improve their product innovation ability which is the key of enterprise innovation. This paper constructs a set of index system for evaluating the financial performance for product innovation for high-tech enterprises. Through the evaluation model some proposals are argued for such enterprises to better control their new product development.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Over-Speculation Behavior and Arbitrage Opportunities in China Equity Warrant Market: The Empirical Evidence from the Baotou Steel Equity Warrant
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Research of Information Framework Building in Construction Enterprises in Zhejiang
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article reveals the status and problems in informationalization of the construction enterprise bases on the investigation and study of the building of enterprise informationalization through some typical cases. According to the indicator system of enterprise informationalization at present, the article puts forward the main contents, the features and some key issues of informationalization of construction enterprises in Zhejiang as the different sorts.

articleTitle: Progress and Tendency of Research on the National Geopark Tourism Services System in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article focuses on the construction of Geopark tourism services system model through the statistical analysis from the perspective of system theory to evaluate the progress of the Geopark tourism studies in China and to figure out the research tendency regarding the Geopark tourism in future. Based on the review and statistical analysis of the literature of 627 kinds in amount, including journal articles, conference papers, Master's Degree theses and doctorate dissertations, the theoretical studies of Geopark tourism services system demonstrated an unbalanced trend with the research mainly concentrated on the investigation and evaluation of the geologic relics or the strategies concerning the geological tourism resources development. Few studies have been made in the fields of the core attraction system in the Geopark tourism or the services guarantee system of Geopark tourism, which have not drawn enough concerns from the research professionals. In terms of the currently existing studies, the empirical studies of the individual cases account for the main part with fairly weak theoretical foundation while the qualitative descriptive studies outweigh the quantitative ones. Due to the absence of interdisciplinary studies, the systematic and comprehensive studies of the above-mentioned theme are left to be furthered. Despite the fact that the present studies of the national Geopark mainly fall into the range of the investigation and evaluation of the geologic relics or the strategies concerning the geological tourism resources development, the tourism development of Geopark is focused on the resources-oriented mode. The six major tendencies shall be paid to more attention regarding the Geopark studies, namely tendency of specialization and refinement, the tendency of multidisciplinary research, the tendency of scientific management, ecological immersion tendency, caring for humanism and tendency of more quantitative methods involved.

articleTitle: Research on Catastrophe Insurance in China: Government, Public and Private Partnership
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is intended to explore the mechanism of catastrophic insurance in China. First, we examined the causes of catastrophic insurance market failure. Inadequate insurance demand and supply are the main reasons. A new management mode, government, market, and public partnership (GMPP), is put forward and its characteristics, objectives, principles and strategies are discussed This new mode emphasizes the leading role of government, which drives the market into full play through public-private partnership, and induces the public initiatives through public participation. It is emphasized that government, the public, and market should be united to manage risks. The model also suggests that partnerships among government, the public, and market would be maintained. Finally the feasibility of catastrophe insurance program based on GMPP is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on the E-Government Service in Rural China: From Digital Division, Penetration Bottleneck to E-Inclusion
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The modern information technology revolution is developing vigorously around the whole world. And with that irreversible trend, China's e-service has improved a lot and has made great progress in both economic and social fields. However, against the background of both new socialist countryside construction and informazation, we can find that serious problems like digital division and transparent bottleneck exist in the process of rural and urban development, regional development and practical information utilization, which may be due to complicated factors such as geographical gap, age and educational differences. And those problems have seriously delayed the construction of rural e-service in China. Based on the theory of e-inclusion and relative methods, after analyzing the existing barriers in China's informazation process, this paper tries to put forward some useful suggestions to China's rural e-service construction.

articleTitle: Research on Copyright Authorization Mode under Digital Environment in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Copyright authorization mode is an unavoidable issue to be confronted in digital era. There are approximately 7 copyright authorization modes in China. Each mode has its own characteristics, strength and weakness. Collective management of copyright is the most important mode of copyright authorization under digital environment. It serves as a bridge between the author and the users and is the most economic way in obtaining copyright authorization. Based on the fact that collective copyright management organizations in China are still under developed, four copyright authorization practices are recommended. However, the most fundamental and the final solution to having easier access to copyright authorization with lower costs is to define the rights to copyright and improve the collective management of the rights.

articleTitle: Urban Nonpoint Source Pollution in Qingdao
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Non-Point Source (NPS) pollution is of wide interests in the research on urban environmental protection and pollution treatment. This paper aims to review the typical research work on environmental monitoring and control for NPS pollution in Qingdao City, China. It is indicated that the major sources of NPS pollution in this city are rainfall runoff, dry and wet atmospheric deposition, river sediment release, aquaculture wastewater, and water transportation. Meanwhile, effective methods including engineering and non-engineering measurements to control the NPS pollution are also discussed.

articleTitle: The Impact of Network Competence on New Ventures Performance: Evidence from Chinese New Ventures
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study is aim to explore the relationship between network competence and new ventures performance through theoretical and empirical tests. We carry out empirical research on 219 new ventures in Chinese regions. As the result shown, network competence can be divided into four dimensions, that is, social qualification, relation-specific task execution, specialist qualification and cross-relational task execution; Network competence has positive impact on new ventures performance; Qualification and task execution, respectively, have positive impact on new ventures performance. This study enriches and complements the research on network competence in Chinese context.

articleTitle: The Relation of Entrepreneurs' Social Responsibility Orientation with the Social and Organizational Performances of the Corporate
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is certain relationship among leaders' social responsibility orientation, social performance and organizational performance of the corporate. According to the past research, the corporate social responsibility includes four dimensions-economic responsibility, legal responsibility, ethical responsibility and philanthropic responsibility. Corporate social performance can be divided into seven factors-employee, consumer, stockholder, compulsory environment protection, voluntary environment protection, community, special groups; organizational performance can also be divided into three factors- market performance, financial performance, human resource performance. The research shows that among the corporate social responsibility orientation, corporate social and organizational performance, the corporate social performance plays as the intermediary role. The questionnaire of the corporate social responsibility orientation designed by Aupperle was localized on the basis of Carroll's research. The corporate social responsibility orientation, corporate social and organizational performances were considered in a research frame.

articleTitle: Risk Allocation Framework in Agent-Construction Project in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agent-construction system is an innovative management method for the Chinese government in delivering public project, in which the government client choose a professional company to undertake the managing responsibilities of investment and construction, and hand over to the user party when the project completed.
