abstract: A supply chain process involves variant departments and organizations and has its specialties distinguishing it from other business processes. To implement it in a SOA framework, unified service description is required. Nevertheless, the work of deriving service description from process models is arduous and inaccurately. To solve the problem, a novel approach is proposed. Firstly, meta-data for process model is extracted from SCOR (supply chain operation reference model), which provides standardized terminology and definitions for supply chain management. Thereafter, XML-Nets, a high-level Petri-Net, is employed for description of such process models and relevant characteristics of supply chain, as well for the following mapping models to service description. Finally, with aids of mapping rules, general description for service interface and orchestration can be smoothly derived, which comprehensively describe supply chain process and well support further IT development, analysis and improvements of supply chain management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Antecedents of Organizational Cronyism
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Risk Factors for Running Public Private Partnerships (PPP) - An Empirical Comparison between Government and Private Sector
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A research project looking at risk management for PPP projects in China is currently being conducted. The aim of this research is to develop and validate an equitable risk sharing mechanism for PPP participants in Chinese specific circumstance. As part of this research project an empirical questionnaire survey was conducted. Respondents of questionnaire were invited to rate a total of thirty-four risk factors which was gleaned from the literature. The data of this survey were analyzed by Kendall's concordance test, Spearman rank correlation test and independent 2-sample test technique. The results show that there is no significant disagreement between government and private sector with respect to the perception of risk factors.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Chaotic Frequency Hopping Sequence
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on Chaos theory, a new hybrid chaotic frequency hopping sequence generation method is proposed, which combines Tent Chaotic Mapping with improved Logistic, then exclusive OR with balanced gold sequence .This sequencing will benefit the system with aspects such as the high system sensitivity to its initial conditions, sufficient amount of reproducible non correlation pseudo random. Simulations were done by MATLAB to study the performances of the new hybrid Chaos Frequency Hopping Sequence, which included the balance, correlation, sensitivity to initial conditions. The results show the new sequence is superior to the existing combined chaos frequency hopping sequence (Exclusive or of logistic sequence and m-sequence).

articleTitle: The Diffusion and Adoption Research of Mobile Commerce - A Review
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although many literatures are available on diffusion and adoption of mobile commerce, the topic is still under development and offers potential opportunities for further research and applications. This paper reviews the literature on diffusion and adoption of m-commerce. The paper points out the current problems in the study and provides a source of idea for the understanding of the key factors for diffusion and adoption of mobile commerce and the whole process from adoption to diffusion of mobile commerce. We hope that the findings of this research will provide useful insights and be a good source for anyone who is interested in diffusion and adoption of m-commerce. The paper also provides some future directions for researched.

articleTitle: A Research on the DRM Content Server
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital radio mondiale (DRM) is the world's only standard-open digital radio system for short-wave, medium-wave/AM and long-wave radio broadcasting with the ability to use existing frequencies and bandwidth across the globe. Implementation of digital radio in today's AM bands (i.e. long, medium and shortwave) based on DRM will enable operators to provide services which will be successful with both existing and future high-quality services. DRM content server is important part of the DRM radio system. This paper gives a design solution of DRM content server's structure.

articleTitle: ERP Implementation Based on Risk Management Theory: Empirical Validation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study is to empirically explore the enterprise resources planning (ERP) implementation strategies based on risk management theory. Five risks are proposed, namely: system risk, implementation risk, change risk, organization risk, staff risk after widely literature review. A survey is developed to collected data from ERP suppliers and firms in Xi'an to test the proposed model. The results from our survey show that ERP success significantly depends on staff risk and implementation risk.

articleTitle: Recognition of the City's Centricity: A Density Estimation in the Commerce Arrangement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Centricity is the most significant characteristic of the cities. In this research, we perform a quantitative analysis on the centricity of the Jingzhou city in both the location and the hierarchy of the city centers by means of the kernel density estimate of GIS applications. The arrangement of the commerce in the urban planning of 2020 is also compared with the current (2008) city morphology to judge whether such arrangement is considerate and realizable.

articleTitle: Route Planning with Uncertain Information using Dempster-Shafer theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this paper is to find a solution for route planning in a road network, where the costs of roads are uncertain. Our concept is based on the Dempster-Shafer theory and Dijkstra's algorithm, which helps to find the best routes. We model the influencing factors of the traffic congestion on the roads using uncertain probabilities described by probability intervals. Based on these intervals the cost intervals of each road can be calculated. Taking the uncertain values of costs into account an algorithm has been outlined for determination the best routes from a node to all other nodes comparing the cost intervals and using decision rules. Decision rules can be defined by the end user, if necessary node by node.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Simulation System of Vitrified Bond CBN Grinding Wheel Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The traditional study on grinding is testing the same material in conditions of different grinding parameters on a dedicated grinder, or testing different materials separately, which will not only waste a lot of human and material resources, but also extend the research and development cycle of wheel products, increase wheel product development costs, reduce the efficiency of study. If virtual reality and simulation technology are used to replace or reduce the actual experimental work, the grinding wheel manufacturing costs can be decreased and the competitiveness of R & D departments are increased, especially the diamond, CBN and others higher-cost super hard abrasives. This paper briefly introduce to some of the basic theory about the virtual reality simulation technology, then develop the grinding process modeling and simulation system of vitrified bond CBN grinding wheel by the MFC with OpenGL graphics library in the Microsoft Visual C + + 6.0 platform. After system simulation testing, the wear state of vitrified bond CBN grinding wheel on different conditions and different periods in the grinding process are predicted.

articleTitle: Estimation of Depression Risky of Family Health Tree System- Using the Family Functioning Scale
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Healthy population is the base of a society to function well. As we know, family plays a significant role in the development and maintenance of depression. According to the hygienic statistical data of WHO, depression is the leading cause of disability as measured by YLDs and the 4th leading contributor to the global burden of disease (DALYs) in 2000. By the year 2020, depression is projected to reach 2nd place of the ranking of DALYs calculated for all ages, both sexes. Accordingly, depression increasing the medical and nursing cost compared to other diseases. Because of limited the diversification of depression and risky concept. This study develops an online family health tree system which implements orientation systematic analytic method together with Beavers systems model. Through inputting the medical history of family members by interaction Web site design, it can real-time calculate the risk information of getting depression and transmit this information to family doctor to search assistance and carefulness plan for patients. It also helps family sentiments and improves medical information management. In addition, we use samples from teachers and students of Chung Shan Medical University. Our study shows this system can screen out kinds of high risky depression patients and have good management of health risk. Finally, the relevant content is also described.

articleTitle: Pricing Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefits: a PDE Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a financial engineering method is developed for pricing guaranteed minimum withdrawal benefits which are extremely popular in variable annuities markets. The embedded options of the contract which provide money-back guarantees and market guarantees on invested principal regardless of market performance are separated. By analyzing the periodic cash-flows of the policy and using the Feynman-Kac formula, a new pricing model which is characterized by a simple two-dimensional partial differential equation (PDE) is presented. Then the effect of the key parameter on the policy value and the fair insurance charge are also obtained by combining the finite difference approach with search method. Finally, the numerical results show that the pricing method is efficient and in accord with the current model.

articleTitle: Urban Salinization and Its Ecological Remediation Principles
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With world population growth, urbanization is speeding up. However, due to climatic change and vegetation cover decreasing, soil salinization is getting serious and expanding widely in urban areas. Especially in China that is the most populated country in the world, while it's cultivated land area could not match with the population; thus in some regions saline land is gradually transformed to urban areas with urbanization progress, which accordingly created some environmental problems. Owing to the natural characteristics of trees, forestation is not only one way for saline-alkali soil utilization, but also can improve soil property, prevent land salinization and maintain ecological balance in urban areas. Therefore in the viewpoint of biological amelioration of salt-affected soil, planting trees is necessary and significant in urban areas for constructing an ecological city. After trees are established in the land, the watertable could be declined through increasing discharge and decreasing recharge. Additionally total salt content could be decreased, especially in soil surface profile and topsoil as well as soil physical & chemical state could be ameliorated.

articleTitle: Study of Customer Knowledge Management in Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of rapid shift of customers' demand, Mass Customization is more fit for nowadays. This style of production balance price and feature. Success of MC depends on comprehension about customers, so manufacturers should develop a system to manage knowledge of customers. CKM (Customer Knowledge Management) is a useful tool to understand and interact with customers. This paper discusses content CKM in MC and the process of this management. In the end, the paper founds a framework of CKM to acquire, edit, share, apply customer knowledge to service mass customization.

articleTitle: Electronic Check System Design Based on NFC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A kind of new intelligent electronic check scheme is put forward in this article : embed NFC(near field communication) tag into the traditional paper check, which will be presenting many advantages, such as more safety , information stored in computer, visibility, rapidity and convenience based on the electronic check transmitted on network . The scheme utilizes the third-party identity of CA(Certificate Authority) to extend the use of electronic check and traditional check , to strengthen the safety of traditional check. So it will be producing great profit for the development of electronic check, and the thinking mode of the business from traditional check to e-check. Because of this, there will be a great development for B2B e-commerce.

articleTitle: Project Management through States
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Looking at computer science, rising complexities, durations and costs for software and hardware development make it necessary to employ a new holistic model to manage those development processes. This paper introduces a new model which is based on abstract states in order to calculate a project's complexity. Based on this complexity it is now possible to estimate key variables such as costs, duration and progress. An abstract definition of states allows users to adjust this model to their project and to their specific requirements.

articleTitle: Construct Personal Learning Environment Based on Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explains some of the ideals and characters about PLE (personal learning environment). And introduce web2.0 social software and technology to construct PLE, where there is the difficulty for learners to integrate these dispersive tools and technologies. So it proposes a framework for an open source Personal Learning Environment which is called PLEF. The emphasis is on the process to build PLE in the PLEF. The final section provides a chart of my own PLE based on Web2.0 as an example to explain how it accelerates my study.

articleTitle: A Study on GA-Based WWN Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intrusion detection (ID) technology is a very important means to improve network security, therefore intrusion detection system should have a good performance. However, the traditional detection method cannot meet actual demands. Applying wavelet neural network (WNN) to intrusion detection has become a research focus recently, but some inherent defects in WNN reduce its efficiencies in operation and identification. Aiming at eliminating these limitations, we propose a new improved WNN algorithm basing on genetic algorithm (GA). This new algorithm combines WNN with GA in order to optimize network parameters and improve network performance. Making use of the actual data extracted from the intrusion detection system, this paper tests the newly constructed algorithm emulationally. The results show that used in intrusion detection, the new algorithm has higher identification rate and it can increase network running efficiency and the success rate of training. Thereby it can reduce undetected rate and false alarm rate. Thus it proves the validity of the new algorithm.

articleTitle: An Approach to Construct Secure View for XML
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: XML has been in prevalent use nowadays, so it is necessary to take measures to ensure the security of XML data. Recently, many access control models have been presented and many models are based on the concept of security views, which provide for each user group (a) an XML view consisting of all and only the information that the users are authorized to access, and (b) a view DTD that the XML view conforms to. Security views effectively protect sensitive data from access and potential inferences by unauthorized users, and provide authorized users with necessary schema information to facilitate effective query formulation and optimization. In this paper we study secure access control policies and provide new methods to build secure views for XML DTD with recursion. The main idea is to transform recursive DTD to the equipollent DTD without recursion. And we present a more efficient algorithm to derive such security views.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model Based on Entropy Weight to Project Investment Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at project investment decision-making issue, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model was used to solve fuzziness in investment decision-making. Entropy weight method was applied to calculate weights of the influencing factors of investment decision-making, which avoided the subjective interference of fuzzy method in valuing weight matrix. Water saving irrigation project investment decision-making issue of a certain region was taking as an application example. The results indicated that fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model based on entropy weight estimated the advantages and disadvantages of schemes effectively. And the research in the paper provides new method and idea for investment decision-making issues.

articleTitle: Study of WAPI Infrastructure and Wireless City Operation in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The deployment of WLAN emerged weaknesses in security and manageable, controllable characters, which also limited wireless city plans to discover a successful business model. The paper analyzes the effort of choosing WAPI from three key factors: firstly, the infrastructure of WAPI improves WLAN's authentication system; secondly, the certificate authority of WAPI adapts to flexible network construction and diverse billing design; thirdly, WAPI contributes to current business models to carry out sustainable operation. In the end, the authors discuss the relative merits of the broad and narrow wireless city concept, and propose the specific strategy to put into effect.

articleTitle: Monitoring Grassland Desertification around the Built-Up Area of the City Based on Multi-Temporal Remotely Sensed Images
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents the spatial extent, magnitude and temporal behavior of grassland desertification caused by urban expansion. A time-series of Landsat TM images covering a period of 20 years from 1987 to 2006 was used. The data sets were geometrically and radiometrically pre-processed in a rigorous fashion, followed by a linear spectral mixture unmixing approach to derive the vegetation fraction images and sand fraction images. Through combing the vegetation fraction images, sand fraction images, and NDVI images, the grassland desertification information on the extent and spatial distribution around the built-up area of the city was extracted based on ANN (Artificial Neural Networks) algorithm. The results of our studies indicate that there is a gradual increase in urban expansion from 1987 to 2006, and the similar trend was observed in the temporal magnitude behavior of the severe grassland desertification around the built-up area of the city; the severe grassland desertification is always in the shape of a triangle around the built-up area of the city, and developed to the east quickly with the help of the monsoon; there is a positive correlation between the built-up area of the city and the area of severe desertification, so the built-up area of the city can serve as an important assessment and prediction indicator for grassland desertification due to urban expansion.

articleTitle: Online Dial-A-Ride Problem with Unequal-Length Time-Windows
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the online dial-a-ride problem (ODARP) with time windows, objects are to be transported between points in a metric space. Transportation requests are released over time, specifying the objects to be transported and the corresponding source and destination. One serve travels in the metric space at constant unit speed, picking up the objects at their sources and drops them at their destinations. Each request also specifies a deadline. If a request is not be served by its deadline, it will be called off. The goal is to plan the motion of server in an online way so that the maximum number of requests is met by their deadlines. Usually it is assumed that the time windows are equal length. That is, each request has the same length of maximum waiting time. We study the problem in a more general case in which the lengths of maximum time that requests can wait are different. We perform competitive analysis of two online strategies for the problem in two special metric spaces, the uniform metric space and the K-constrained metric space, respectively. The competitive ratios of the strategies are obtained.

articleTitle: Study on Government Supervision Game Mechanism for Enterprises Establish Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we establish the supervision game model between government quality supervision department and production enterprises who establish a quality management system, based on the production enterprises decide how to establish a quality management system in order to improve the products quality level and government quality supervision department decides how to supervise more effectively. Through analyzing the game theory model of pure strategy Nash equilibrium, dominant strategy and mixed strategy Nash equilibrium, we reveal the supervision game internal operations mechanism between the government quality supervision department and the production enterprises who establish a quality management system, which points out the direction for the supervision game model to apply in practice.

articleTitle: XQuery Optimization In Heterogeneous Data Integration System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The integration of heterogeneous data sources, which can effectively make use of the information sources and data sharing, is a hotspot within the field of current data processing research. This paper firstly describes an architecture of heterogeneous data integration system based on a Mediator-Wrapper middleware, and then makes a deep research on the XQuery query processing, especially the key issues, such as query decomposition and optimization technology. Popular techniques of XQuery query processing are based on decomposition. XQuery has a complex syntax such as FOR clauses, and its complexity causes some considerations for the decomposition of global XQuery query. In this paper, we propose an algorithm to decompose a global query into local queries and to construct the result of the global XQuery query from the results of the local queries. Furthermore, it illustrates the realization of query decomposition and optimization with examples.

articleTitle: Reuse-Oriented Information Model of Product Design Process Module
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To deal with the problem of product design process reuse, with the thought of modularization and based on the configuration technology, an information model of product design process module is proposed. This paper, firstly, presents the concept of design process module(DPM). Then, a three-layer structure model of DPM is introduced, including module layer, activity layer and parameter layer, further the description of activity model of DPM is put forward from the perspectives of design specifications and design resources. For the availability of hierarchy description of DPM in design process, a DPM structure tree is constructed, and the DPM module classes are described with the object-oriented methods. Finally, an implementation framework on the basis of DPM is developed to support the reconfiguration and reuse of design process.

articleTitle: Study on Building Life-Cycle Assessment Model in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Life-cycle assessment (LCA) is an effective method by which the energy consumption and environmental impact of commodities and services can be evaluated and calculated. Firstly, this paper introduces the development path of life-cycle assessment methodology, then, illustrates theoretical and computational knowledge of each life-cycle assessment model and summarizes their characters respectively. Finally, focusing on the characters of each model and status quo of building LCA in China, this paper provides instruction on model choosing, which aims to advance and accelerate relevant research in China.

articleTitle: Innovation 2.0 as a Paradigm Shift: Comparative Analysis of Three Innovation Modes
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The convergence and emergence of modern information and communication technologies opens up new horizons for organizations in a knowledge-based society. Modern ICT transcended the traditional service delivery pattern and innovation pattern by bringing personalized, localized and context aware services close to users. The traditional boundary of organization is dissolving as well as the traditional innovation and R&D boundaries. This paper conducted a preliminary comparative case study of Living Lab, Fab Lab and Application Innovation Park (AIP) based on extended technology-organization-environment framework, and argues the emergence of innovation 2.0 as a paradigm shift from manufacturing paradigm to service paradigm in a knowledge-based society. We need to shift from manufacturing mentality to service mentality and be aware of the potentials of modern ICT on the transformation of the innovation patterns to be more cooperative, open, user-centric and service oriented.

articleTitle: Application of GC-TOPSIS Method in the Process of Supplier Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The job of supplier evaluation becomes the key of the manufacturing enterprises to improve competitiveness in networked manufacturing. A method of weight calculation for the supplier evaluation criteria is introduced in this article entropy method. The paper combines Gray Correlation method and TOPSIS method and forms GC-TOPSIS method. The method reflects the closeness between ideal program and actual program about Euclidean distance and gray correlation degree separately from the distance and shape similarity, so the method has a characteristic of dual-baseline. Finally through an example, this evaluation method is shown feasible.
